CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[GetGeneralLedgerById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@UnGetStatement int
AS
BEGIN
	if(@UnGetStatement=0)
	begin
		select gl.Id,gl.Level5HeadId,gl.Name,gl.IsSynced,sc.Name Level5HeadName, c.Name Level4HeadName,sc.Level4HeadId,cc.NatueOfAccountId,c.SubCategoryId,ssc.Name SubCategoryName
			   ,isnull(gl.COADescriptionId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),coa.Name CoADescriptionName,gl.GLCodeNo,gl.IsControlAccount,gl.IsCostCenter,gl.BankCashOth
			   ,gl.IsActive,gl.IsRecurringCost,isnull(mws.Id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') StatementMappingId,isnull(mws.StatementSubHeadId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') StatementSubHeadId,isnull(sh.StatementBroadHeadId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') StatementBroadHeadId,sh.Name StatementSubHeadName,bh.Name StatementBroadHeadName
		  from [Account].[GeneralLedgers] gl left join
			   [Account].[Level5Heads] sc on gl.Level5HeadId=sc.Id left join
			   [Account].[Level4Heads] c on sc.Level4HeadId=c.Id left join
			   [Account].[SubCategories] ssc on c.SubCategoryId=ssc.Id left join
			   [Account].[Categories] cc on ssc.CategoryId=cc.Id  left join
			   [Account].[COADescription] coa on gl.COADescriptionId=coa.Id left join
			   [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] mws on gl.Id=mws.GeneralLedgerId left join
			   [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sh on mws.StatementSubHeadId=sh.Id left join
			   [Account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on sh.StatementBroadHeadId=bh.Id
		 where gl.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	end
	else
	begin
		select gl.Id,gl.Level5HeadId,gl.Name,gl.IsSynced,sc.Name Level5HeadName, c.Name Level4HeadName,sc.Level4HeadId,cc.NatueOfAccountId,c.SubCategoryId,ssc.Name SubCategoryName
			   ,gl.COADescriptionId,coa.Name CoADescriptionName,gl.GLCodeNo,gl.IsControlAccount,gl.IsCostCenter,gl.BankCashOth
			   ,gl.IsActive,gl.IsRecurringCost
		  from [Account].[GeneralLedgers] gl left join
			   [Account].[Level5Heads] sc on gl.Level5HeadId=sc.Id left join
			   [Account].[Level4Heads] c on sc.Level4HeadId=c.Id left join
			   [Account].[SubCategories] ssc on c.SubCategoryId=ssc.Id left join
			   [Account].[Categories] cc on ssc.CategoryId=cc.Id  left join
			   [Account].[COADescription] coa on gl.COADescriptionId=coa.Id 
		 where gl.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	end
END

--exec [Account].[GetVoucherDataByDate] '2023-04-03','2025-04-05','a2773f48-585d-441b-483d-08dcc0013471'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[GetVoucherDataByDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime,
	@VMID as uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	select vm.Id,vm.VoucherNo,vm.PostingDate,vm.JournalTypeId,vm.FYearId,vm.Note,vm.PaidTo,vm.TenantId,vm.ServiceUnitId,vm.VoucherMode
			,vm.IsReversal,vm.DocumentDate,sum(vmd.Credit) Credit, sum(vmd.Debit) Debit, jt.Name JournalTypeName
	  from [Account].[VoucherMasters] vm inner join
		   [Account].[JournalTypes] jt on vm.JournalTypeId=jt.Id inner join
	       [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] vmd on vm.Id=vmd.VoucherMasterId inner join
		   [Account].[GeneralLedgers] gl on vmd.GeneralLedgerId=gl.Id 
	 where (CONVERT(DATE, vm.PostingDate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate) and @VMID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or vm.Id=@VMID
  group by vm.Id,vm.VoucherNo,vm.PostingDate,vm.JournalTypeId,vm.FYearId,vm.Note,vm.PaidTo,vm.TenantId,vm.ServiceUnitId,vm.VoucherMode
			,vm.IsReversal,vm.DocumentDate,jt.Name
END

--exec [Account].[GetVoucherDetailByVMID] 'e9a4f5cd-d55a-41a9-3ee1-08dcbf705a9c','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[GetVoucherDetailByVMID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@VMID as uniqueidentifier,
	@GLID as uniqueidentifier,
	@ReferenceTypeId int
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT vmd.ID,vmd.VoucherMasterId,vmd.GeneralLedgerId,vmd.CostCenterId,vmd.SubLedgerTypeId,vmd.SubLedgerId,vmd.Debit,vmd.Credit,vmd.Narration,vmd.ServiceUnitId,vmd.SeriveId,vmd.CheqDate,vmd.CheqNo,
	       gl.Name GeneralLedgerName,cc.Name CostCenterName,sl.Name SubLedgerName
	  FROM [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] vmd inner join
		   [Account].[VoucherMasters] vm on vm.Id=vmd.VoucherMasterId inner join
		   [Account].[GeneralLedgers] gl on vmd.GeneralLedgerId=gl.Id left join
		   [Account].[CostCenters] cc on vmd.CostCenterId=cc.Id left join
		   [Account].[SubLedgers] sl on vmd.SubLedgerId=sl.Id
	 WHERE (vmd.VoucherMasterId=@VMID  and vm.ReferenceTypeId=@ReferenceTypeId and @GLID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or (vmd.GeneralLedgerId=@GLID and @VMID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	         
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Account].[IPDReceivableServicePatientWiseDetails]
@ParameterType nvarchar(max)=''
----exec [Account].[IPDReceivableServicePatientWiseDetails] 'IPDServicesBill_CTU Care_ABG'
--exec [Account].[IPDReceivableServicePatientWiseDetails] 'Diag_PATHOLOGY_BIOCHEMISTRY'
AS
BEGIN
	
	declare @NursingCare INT =500

	select * into #TempNotAllowCabinType from 
	(
		select '17' CabinTypeId
		union 
		select '22'
		union 
		select '27'
	)T

		IF @ParameterType ='AdmissionFee'
		BEGIN
		
		select  'Admission Fee' [ServiceName],count(distinct p.Id) * 2000 [Amount],'AdmissionFee' ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
		join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
		left  join #TempNotAllowCabinType t on t.CabinTypeId =   c.Id
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and isnull(t.CabinTypeId,0) =0
		and @ParameterType ='AdmissionFee'
		END

		ELSE IF @ParameterType ='AdmissionFee'
		BEGIN
			select  'Bed and Cabins', 0,'BedAndCabins' ReportType
		END
		ELSE IF @ParameterType ='AdmissionFee'
		BEGIN

			select 'Nursing Care',sum(DATEDIFFCount) *@NursingCare,'NursingCare' ReportType from 
			(
				select  p.Id,DATEDIFF(DAY,p.AdmissionDateTime,GETDATE() ) DATEDIFFCount
				from 
						[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
				left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
				join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
				left  join #TempNotAllowCabinType t on t.CabinTypeId =   c.Id
				where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				and isnull(t.CabinTypeId,0) =0
			
				group by p.Id,p.AdmissionDateTime
			)T
		END	
		
		ELSE IF CHARINDEX('FBRoomService_', @ParameterType)>0  
		BEGIN

			select p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,s.InvoiceNo,sum(d.Qty * d.SaleRate) Amount
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Canteen].SaleInvoices s on s.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
			left join	[Canteen].SaleInvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = s.Id
			left join	[Canteen].Items i on i.id = d.ProductId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and s.ServType ='Room Service'
			and 'FBRoomService_'+i.Name =@ParameterType
			group by p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,s.InvoiceNo

		END
		ELSE IF  CHARINDEX('ConsultantFee_', @ParameterType)>0  
		BEGIN

			select  p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,v.Name ConsultantName, sum(r.Qty * r.Rate) Amount
			from 
						[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
			left join	[VWDoctors] v on v.Id = r.ConsultantId
			left join	[Hospital].ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.id = r.ServiceId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and h.Id is not null
			and 'ConsultantFee_'+H.HeadName =@ParameterType
			group by  p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,v.Name


		END
		ELSE IF CHARINDEX('Medicine', @ParameterType)>0 
		BEGIN

			select p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,s.InvoiceNo,sum(d.Qty) qty, sum(d.Qty * d.SaleRate) amount
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Pharmacy].Invoices s on s.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
			left join	[Pharmacy].InvoiceDetails d on  d.InvoiceId = s.Id
			left join	[Pharmacy].BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = d.BrandExtensionId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and 'Medicine_'++b.ProductName =@ParameterType
			group by p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,s.InvoiceNo,d.SaleRate
		END
		ELSE IF   CHARINDEX('IPDServicesBill', @ParameterType)>0 
		BEGIN

			select p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,sum(r.Qty) qty, sum(r.Amount) Amount
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
			left join   [Hospital].ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.Id = r.ServiceId
			join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and 'IPDServicesBill_'+c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName+'_'+h.HeadName =@ParameterType
			group by c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName,h.HeadName,p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName
		END
		ELSE IF   CHARINDEX('Diag_', @ParameterType)>0 
		BEGIN

			select p.InvoiceNo, p.FullName,t.Name,sum(d.Qty) Qty,sum(d.Total) Total
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] r on r.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
			LEFT JOIN   [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
			LEFT Join   [Diag].TestItems t on t.Id = d.TestItemId
			LEFT Join   [Diag].TestGroups g on g.Id = t.TestGroupId
			LEFT Join   [Diag].ParentGroup  pg on pg.Id = g.ParentGroupId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and pg.Id is not null
			and 'Diag_'+pg.Name+'_'+g.Name =@ParameterType
			group by p.InvoiceNo, p.FullName,t.Name

		END
	


END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[IPDReceivableSummary]

----exec [Account].[IPDReceivableSummary]
AS
BEGIN
	
	declare @NursingCare INT =500

	select * into #TempNotAllowCabinType from 
	(
		select '17' CabinTypeId
		union 
		select '22'
		union 
		select '27'
	)T

		select [ServiceName],round([Amount],2) [Amount], ReportType from 
		(
		select  'Admission Fee' [ServiceName],count(distinct p.Id) * 2000 [Amount],'AdmissionFee' ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
		join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
		left  join #TempNotAllowCabinType t on t.CabinTypeId =   c.Id
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and isnull(t.CabinTypeId,0) =0
		
		union all

		select  'Bed and Cabins', 0,'BedAndCabins' ReportType

		union all

		select 'Nursing Care',sum(DATEDIFFCount) *@NursingCare,'NursingCare' ReportType from 
		(
			select  p.Id,DATEDIFF(DAY,p.AdmissionDateTime,GETDATE() ) DATEDIFFCount
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
			join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
			left  join #TempNotAllowCabinType t on t.CabinTypeId =   c.Id
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and isnull(t.CabinTypeId,0) =0
			group by p.Id,p.AdmissionDateTime
		)T
		
		union all

		select 'F & B Room Service',sum(s.GrandTK),'FBRoomService' ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Canteen].SaleInvoices s on s.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and s.ServType ='Room Service'


		union all

		select 'Consultant Fee', sum(r.Qty * r.Rate),'ConsultantFee' ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		
		union all

		select 'Medicine',sum(s.GrandTotal),'Medicine' ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Pharmacy].Invoices s on s.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		
		union all

		select c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName,sum(r.Amount),'IPDServicesBill_'+c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
		join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		group by c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName

		union all

		select pg.Name,sum(d.Total),'Diag_'+pg.Name ReportType
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] r on r.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
		LEFT JOIN   [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
		LEFT Join   [Diag].TestItems t on t.Id = d.TestItemId
		LEFT Join   [Diag].TestGroups g on g.Id = t.TestGroupId
		LEFT Join   [Diag].ParentGroup  pg on pg.Id = g.ParentGroupId
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and pg.Id is not null
		group by pg.Name

		)T
	


END
GO

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Account].[IPDReceivableSummaryDetails]
@ParameterType nvarchar(max)=''
----exec [Account].[IPDReceivableSummaryDetails] 'IPDServicesBill_CTU Care'
AS
BEGIN
	
	declare @NursingCare INT =500

	select * into #TempNotAllowCabinType from 
	(
		select '17' CabinTypeId
		union 
		select '22'
		union 
		select '27'
	)T

		 IF  CHARINDEX('AdmissionFee', @ParameterType)>0  
		BEGIN
		
		select  p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,count(distinct p.Id) * 2000 [Amount]
		from 
				[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
		left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
		join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
		left  join #TempNotAllowCabinType t on t.CabinTypeId =   c.Id
		where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and isnull(t.CabinTypeId,0) =0
		and @ParameterType ='AdmissionFee'
		group by p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName
		END

		ELSE IF @ParameterType ='AdmissionFee'
		BEGIN
			select  'Bed and Cabins', 0,'BedAndCabins' ReportType
		END
		ELSE IF  CHARINDEX('NursingCare', @ParameterType)>0  
		BEGIN

			select T.InvoiceNo,T.FullName,sum(DATEDIFFCount) *@NursingCare Amount from 
			(
				select   p.Id,DATEDIFF(DAY,p.AdmissionDateTime,GETDATE() ) DATEDIFFCount,p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName 
				from 
						[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
				left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
				join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
				left  join #TempNotAllowCabinType t on t.CabinTypeId =   c.Id
				where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				and isnull(t.CabinTypeId,0) =0
			
				group by p.Id,p.AdmissionDateTime,p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName
			)T
			group by T.InvoiceNo,T.FullName
		END	
		
		ELSE IF  CHARINDEX('FBRoomService', @ParameterType)>0  
		BEGIN

			select i.Name,sum(d.Qty * d.SaleRate) Amount,'FBRoomService_'+ i.Name ReportType
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Canteen].SaleInvoices s on s.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
			left join	[Canteen].SaleInvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = s.Id
			left join	[Canteen].Items i on i.id = d.ProductId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and s.ServType ='Room Service'
			group by i.Name

		END
		ELSE IF  CHARINDEX('ConsultantFee', @ParameterType)>0  
		BEGIN

			select  h.HeadName, sum(r.Qty * r.Rate) Amount,'ConsultantFee_'+ h.HeadName ReportType
			from 
						[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
			left join	[VWDoctors] v on v.Id = r.ConsultantId
			left join	[Hospital].ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.id = r.ServiceId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and h.Id is not null
			group by  h.HeadName

		END
		ELSE IF CHARINDEX('Medicine', @ParameterType)>0 
		BEGIN

			select b.ProductName,sum(d.Qty * d.SaleRate) Amount,@ParameterType+'_'+b.ProductName ReportType
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Pharmacy].Invoices s on s.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
			left join	[Pharmacy].InvoiceDetails d on  d.InvoiceId = s.Id
			left join	[Pharmacy].BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = d.BrandExtensionId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			group by b.ProductName
		END
		ELSE IF   CHARINDEX('IPDServicesBill', @ParameterType)>0 
		BEGIN
			
			select h.HeadName,sum(r.Amount) Amount,@ParameterType+'_'+h.HeadName [ReportDetailsType]
			
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] r on r.IPDPatientId = p.Id
			left join   [Hospital].ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.Id = r.ServiceId
			join	[Hospital].[CabinTypes] c on c.Id = r.DeliverySectionId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and 'IPDServicesBill_'+c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName =@ParameterType
			group by c.IPDServicesBillingHeadName,h.HeadName
		END
		ELSE IF   CHARINDEX('Diag_', @ParameterType)>0 
		BEGIN

			select g.Name,sum(d.Total),@ParameterType +'_'+g.Name ReportType
			from 
					[Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p
			left Join	[Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] r on r.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
			LEFT JOIN   [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
			LEFT Join   [Diag].TestItems t on t.Id = d.TestItemId
			LEFT Join   [Diag].TestGroups g on g.Id = t.TestGroupId
			LEFT Join   [Diag].ParentGroup  pg on pg.Id = g.ParentGroupId
			where isnull(p.DischargeByUserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			and pg.Id is not null
			and 'Diag_'+pg.Name =@ParameterType
			group by pg.Name,g.Name

		END
	


END

--exec [Account].[SpGetBalanceSheetDetailsReport] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2024,5,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , , , ,EE7D0807-816B-459B-A4F0-08DC08F7D0C9'

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HoD 24.@MManager 25.@MOfficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID 28. GLAccountID


CREATE PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetBalanceSheetDetailsReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementSubHeadsID uniqueidentifier

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD int=1
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity int=6
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'

	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	Select @StatementSubHeadsID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=28
	
	
	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	--insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport

	create table #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)

	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets
	and (l5.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.id,l5.Name


	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementCurrentAssetAssets
	and (l5.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.id,l5.Name


	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 3 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity 
	and (l5.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.id,l5.Name

	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 4 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities 
	and (l5.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.id,l5.Name

	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 5 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities 
	and (l5.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.id,l5.Name


	update #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
			where l.Id = #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	



	update #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			 when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id

				where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterSoftwareStartDate
				and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	update #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] = [AmountinTaka]*-1
	where [AmountinTaka] <0

		select (
	select 
	--@FilterStartdate FilterStartdate,
	--	@FilterEnddate FilterEnddate,
	--	@Year [Year],
	--	@Month [Month],
		ReportType ,
		Particulars ,
	--	[Note] ,
	
		[AmountinTaka] 
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	order by ReportOrderID
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END
GO

--exec [Account].[SpGetBalanceSheetReport] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetBalanceSheetReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C'
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='4286E499-2DC4-487C-8FAF-86C52D8E2E83'
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @StatementShareHolderEquity   uniqueidentifier ='2D8779CB-748F-4049-A5A2-FE507FAC7BF9'
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'


	

	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
	DECLARE @LessNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)

	--insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport

	Create table #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float
	)

	create table #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)


	 
	 -- Fixeed Asset
	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.Name,l5.id,sub.Name


	
	-- Current Asset
	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementCurrentAssetAssets
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.id, l5.Name,sub.Name
	--Shareholders Equity
	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 3 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity 
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,l5.name,l5.Id
	
	--Long Term Liabilities
	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 4 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.Name,l5.Id,l5.Name
	-- Current Liabilities
	insert into #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport
	select 5 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name



	
	--------insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	--------select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.id,sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	--------from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	--------join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	--------join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	--------join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	--------join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	--------where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD --and sub.id =@StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	--------group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	--------insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	--------select 3 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, 'Less '+sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @LessNote [Note], g.Id ,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	--------from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	--------join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	--------join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	--------join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	--------join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	--------where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID --and sub.id <> @StatementSubRevenueHead and sub.id <> @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	--------group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	update #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Level5HeadId = l5.id
			where g.Id = #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	



	update #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterSoftwareStartDate
				and 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	update #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] = [AmountinTaka]*-1
	where [AmountinTaka] <0
	
	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 0,null StatementSubHeadID,'Non Current Assets'  ReportType,'' Particulars,'' Note,0
	


	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select t.ReportOrderID,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,t.Particulars



	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 2,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Non Current Assets' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	--group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID


	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 3,null StatementSubHeadID,'Current Assets' Particulars ,'','' Note,0
	
	 	

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 4,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	


	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 5,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Current Assets' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2


	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 6,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Property & Assets' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(isnull(AmountinTaka,0)) 
	from #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport t
	where ReportType ='Total Non Current Assets' or ReportType ='Total Current Assets'
	



	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 7,null StatementSubHeadID,'Shareholders Equity & Liabilities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0
	
	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 8,null StatementSubHeadID,'Shareholders Equity' Particulars ,'','' Note,0

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 9,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	--==============================================================--
	


	DECLARE @RetainedEarnings float
	select  @RetainedEarnings = [Account].[fnGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings](@FilterSoftwareStartDate,@FilterEndValue)
	


	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 10,null StatementSubHeadID,'Retained Earnings' Particulars ,'','' Note,@RetainedEarnings
	

	--================================== Retained Earnings  ============================--



	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	
	select 11,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Shareholder''s Equity' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	FROM 
	(

	select sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	union all

	select sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
	from #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport t
	where  ReportType ='Retained Earnings'

	)T

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 12,null StatementSubHeadID,'Long Term Liabilities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 13,null StatementSubHeadID,'Current Liabilities & Provision' Particulars,'' ,'' Note,0

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 14,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =4
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 15,null StatementSubHeadID,'Current Liabilities & Provision' Particulars ,'','' Note,0
	
	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 16,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =5
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 17,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Current Liabilities & Provision' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	FROM 
	(

	select sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =4
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	union all

	select sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
	from #TempBalanceSheetDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =5
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	)T

	insert into #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport
	select 18,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Shareholders Equity & Liabilities' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(AmountinTaka) 
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport t
			where  ReportType ='Total Shareholder''s Equity'

			union all

			select sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport t
			where  ReportType ='Total Current Liabilities & Provision'

	)T
	
	

	select (
	select 
	
		@FilterStartdate FilterStartdate,
		@FilterEnddate FilterEnddate,
		@Year [Year],
		@Month [Month],
		ReportType,
		Particulars ,
		StatementSubHeadID StatementSubHeadID,
		--'exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossDetailsReport] '''+@FilterStartValue+','+@FilterEndValue+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,'+convert(nvarchar(40),StatementSubHeadID)+''''
		--reportlink 
		
		case when StatementSubHeadID is null then ''
			 else 'Details' end as [Note] ,

	
		isnull([AmountinTaka],0) [AmountinTaka] 
	from #TempSpGetBalancceSheetReport t
	order by ReportOrderID
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	

	
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetBankBook]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec [Account].[SpGetBankBook] '2023-05-01,2024-06-30,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId


CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetBankBook]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 
	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(20) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @CashAtBankID uniqueidentifier ='567DA77F-C0CC-4D1A-6ECC-08DC08746240'
   
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)

	
	Create Table #TempSpGetBankBook
	(
		Autoid Bigint identity(1,1),
		[Date] Date,
		[VoucherCreateDate] datetime,
		[Particulars] nvarchar(max),
		[Debit] float,
		[Credit] float,
		[Balance] float,
		[VoucherNO] nvarchar(max),
		[DisplayAutoid] bigint,
		[GLAccountID] uniqueidentifier
	)

	select gm.GeneralLedgerId,n.Id nid,g.Name,bh.id bhid
	into #TempSpGetBankBookId
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
	join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
	where (bh.id ='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C' or bh.id ='509DC9CD-3CF6-4222-A04C-6C1969A5D5DD')
	and l4.Id =@CashAtBankID
	group by gm.GeneralLedgerId,n.Id,g.Name,bh.id
	
						

						insert into #TempSpGetBankBook
						([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit])
						select @FilterStartdatePreDate,'All Bank Opening',0,0

						insert into #TempSpGetBankBook
						([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit],[GLAccountID])
							select 
							@FilterStartdatePreDate,
							'Opening Balance',
							case 
							when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit])>= sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit])-sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
							when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) < sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit]) - sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
							else 0
							end [OpeningAmountDebit],
							case
							when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit]) < sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
							when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) >= sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
							else 0
							end [OpeningAmountCredit]
							,GeneralLedgerId
							from 
							(

							select tbl.id, tbl.Name ,OpeningAmountDebit,OpeningAmountCredit,DuringPeriodDebit,DuringPeriodCredit,
							OpeningAmountDebit +DuringPeriodDebit [ClosingDebit],
							OpeningAmountCredit + DuringPeriodCredit [ClosingCredit],
							natuarID,ID  GeneralLedgerId
							
							from 
							(

									select tt.GeneralLedgerId id ,tt.Name, sum(debit) OpeningAmountDebit, sum(credit) OpeningAmountCredit, 0 DuringPeriodDebit , 0 DuringPeriodCredit
									,tt.nid natuarID,d.GeneralLedgerId
										from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
									join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
									and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
									join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
									right join #TempSpGetBankBookId tt on tt.GeneralLedgerId = g.Id
									group by tt.GeneralLedgerId,tt.Name,tt.nid,d.GeneralLedgerId
									
							
							
								) tbl 
								
								
								)
								T
								group by T.Id,T.natuarID,T.Name,T.GeneralLedgerId
								order by t.GeneralLedgerId

								Update #TempSpGetBankBook set
								Balance = [Debit]+[Credit]

								update #TempSpGetBankBook set
								Debit =(select sum(Debit) from #TempSpGetBankBook),
								Credit =(select sum(Credit) from #TempSpGetBankBook),
								Balance =(select sum(Debit) -sum(credit) from #TempSpGetBankBook)
								where [Particulars] = 'All Bank Opening'

								
									
								

							
							insert into #TempSpGetBankBook
							([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit],[VoucherNO],[VoucherCreateDate],[GLAccountID])
							select v.PostingDate, gl.Name,0,d.Debit,v.Id,v.CreatedOn,
							(
								select dd.GeneralLedgerId from account.VoucherMasterDetails dd where dd.VoucherMasterId = v.Id and  dd.Credit <>0
							)
							from Account.VoucherMasters v
							join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id
							join account.GeneralLedgers gl on gl.id = d.GeneralLedgerId
							where v.Id in 
							(
									select distinct v.Id from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id
									join #TempSpGetBankBookId t on t.GeneralLedgerId = d.GeneralLedgerId
									where v.VoucherMode ='D' and d.Credit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

									union all

									select distinct v.Id from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id
									join #TempSpGetBankBookId t on t.GeneralLedgerId = d.GeneralLedgerId
									where v.VoucherMode ='JV'  and d.Credit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

							)
							and d.GeneralLedgerId not in (select GeneralLedgerId from #TempSpGetBankBookId)


							insert into #TempSpGetBankBook
							([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit],[VoucherNO],[VoucherCreateDate],[GLAccountID])
							select v.PostingDate, gl.Name,d.Credit,0,v.Id,v.CreatedOn,
							(
								select dd.GeneralLedgerId from account.VoucherMasterDetails dd where dd.VoucherMasterId = v.Id and dd.Debit <>0
							)
							from Account.VoucherMasters v
							join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id
							join account.GeneralLedgers gl on gl.id = d.GeneralLedgerId
							where v.Id in 
							(
									select distinct v.Id from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id	
									join #TempSpGetBankBookId t on t.GeneralLedgerId = d.GeneralLedgerId
									where v.VoucherMode ='C' and d.Debit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

									union all

									select distinct v.Id from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id	
									join #TempSpGetBankBookId t on t.GeneralLedgerId = d.GeneralLedgerId
									where v.VoucherMode ='JV'  and d.Debit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

							)
							and d.GeneralLedgerId not in (select GeneralLedgerId from #TempSpGetBankBookId)
							

DECLARE @AutoID bigint
DECLARE @CurrentRowID bigint
DECLARE @CurrentBalance float
DECLARE @Debit float
DECLARE @Credit float
DECLARE @GLAccountID uniqueIdentifier
DECLARE @CurrentGLAccountID uniqueIdentifier

set @CurrentRowID =0
set @CurrentBalance =0
set @CurrentGLAccountID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

 


DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR SELECT Autoid,debit,Credit,GLAccountID 
        FROM 
       #TempSpGetBankBook
	   order by GLAccountID,[Date],[VoucherCreateDate]

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @AutoID,@Debit,@Credit,@GLAccountID;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        
		IF @CurrentGLAccountID <> @GLAccountID
		BEGIN
				set @CurrentBalance =0
		END 
		set @CurrentBalance = @CurrentBalance + @Debit - @Credit
		set @CurrentRowID = @CurrentRowID +1
		
		update #TempSpGetBankBook set
		DisplayAutoid =@CurrentRowID,
		Balance = @CurrentBalance  
		where Autoid = @AutoID

		set @CurrentGLAccountID = @GLAccountID

        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
            @AutoID,@Debit,@Credit,@GLAccountID;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;




Update #TempSpGetBankBook set
[Date] = DATEADD(day,1,[Date])
where DisplayAutoid =0


set @CurrentRowID = @CurrentRowID +1

insert into #TempSpGetBankBook
([Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO],[DisplayAutoid],[GLAccountID])
select 
@FilterEnddate, 'Sub Total'/* +g.Name*/ [Particulars],sum([debit]),sum([Credit]),sum(debit)- sum(credit) [Balance],null [VoucherNO],@CurrentRowID [DisplayAutoid],
g.Id
from #TempSpGetBankBook t
join Account.GeneralLedgers g on g.id = t.GLAccountID
where t.Particulars <> 'All Bank Opening'
group by g.Id,g.Name

set @CurrentRowID =99999


insert into #TempSpGetBankBook
([Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO],[DisplayAutoid],[GLAccountID])
select @FilterEnddate,'Total of All Bank',sum(Debit),sum(credit),sum(debit)-sum(credit),'',@CurrentRowID,null from #TempSpGetBankBook t where t.Particulars like '%Sub Total%'


select(
	select [Date],
		case
			when Particulars='All Bank Opening' then 'Opening'
			when Particulars='Total of All Bank' then 'Total'
			else [Name]
		end [BankName],
		case
			when Particulars='All Bank Opening' then 'Opening'
			when Particulars='Total of All Bank' then 'Total'
			else [Particulars]
		end [Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO]
	from 
	
	(
		select
		--[Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO]
		t.*,g.Name,1 ReportType
		from #TempSpGetBankBook t
		left join Account.GeneralLedgers g on g.Id = t.GLAccountID
		where [Particulars] <> 'Total of All Bank'
		union all
		select
		--[Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO]
		t.*,g.Name,2 ReportType
		from #TempSpGetBankBook t
		left join Account.GeneralLedgers g on g.Id = t.GLAccountID
		where [Particulars] = 'Total of All Bank'

		)TT
		order by ReportType, name, [DisplayAutoid]
	
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
