--exec [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReport] '2024-05-1,2025-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId



CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C'
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='4286E499-2DC4-487C-8FAF-86C52D8E2E83'
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @StatementShareHolderEquity   uniqueidentifier ='2D8779CB-748F-4049-A5A2-FE507FAC7BF9'
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'
	DECLARE @CashInHandGLID   uniqueidentifier ='BD52240A-D093-4F02-6EF4-08DC73F57D74'
	DECLARE @AdvancesDepositsPrepayments uniqueidentifier ='5657A979-7625-4707-61F2-08DC0871A2EB'



	

	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
	DECLARE @LessNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)


	Create table #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[CurrentAmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)

	create table #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float
	)


	--==================================Current Asset start ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sc.Id, SC.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka],0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sc.id =@AdvancesDepositsPrepayments --@StatementCurrentAssetAssets
	and gm.GeneralLedgerId <> @CashInHandGLID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.id, l5.Name,sub.Name,sc.Id, SC.Name

	
	--==================================Current Asset end ============================--

	--==================================Current Libility ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name,sub.name

	--insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	--select 3 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	--from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	--join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	--join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	--join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	--join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	--where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities
	--group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name

	
	--==================================Current Libility ============================--

	
	--==================================Fixed Asset ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 4 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.Name,l5.id,sub.Name,sub.id

	--==================================Fixed Asset ============================--

	--==================================Shareholders Equity ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 5 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity 
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,l5.name,l5.Id
	
	--==================================Shareholders Equity ============================--

	--==================================Long Term Liabilities ============================--


	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 6 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.ID,l5.Id,l5.Name

	--==================================Long Term Liabilities ============================--
	

	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Level5HeadId = l5.id
			where g.Id = #TempCashFlowDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	

		
	
	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterSoftwareStartDate
				and 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempCashFlowDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

		--PRINT 'x'
	DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max) =''
	Create table #tempPreviousCashFlow
	(
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueIdentifier ,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float
	)
	--Create table #tempPreviousCashFlow

	set @Query = '  insert into #tempPreviousCashFlow  exec [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportForPreviousMonthYear] '''+@FilterSoftwareStartDate+','+convert(varchar(20),@FilterStartdatePreDate)+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'''
	exec(@Query)

	

	
	/*

	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReport set
	[PreviousAmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(Credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
				and #TempCashFlowDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)
	*/
	
	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 1,null StatementSubHeadID,'Cash Flow from Operating Activities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	--======================================   Retained Earnings  start  ========================--
	


	
	
	DECLARE @RetainedEarnings float

	DECLARE @RetainedEarningsPrevious float
	select  @RetainedEarnings = [Account].[fnGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings](@FilterStartValue,@FilterEndValue)
	select  @RetainedEarningsPrevious = [Account].[fnGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings](@FilterSoftwareStartDate,convert(varchar(max),@FilterStartdatePreDate))

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 2,null StatementSubHeadID,'Comprehensive Income/ (Loss) ' Particulars ,'','' Note,@RetainedEarnings,@RetainedEarningsPrevious,@RetainedEarnings +@RetainedEarningsPrevious

	--================================== Retained Earnings  End ============================--

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 3,null StatementSubHeadID,'Depreciation' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0


	DECLARE @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG float=0
	select @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG =sum(AmountinTaka) from #tempPreviousCashFlow where ReportType ='Increase/(Decrease) in Advance,Deposite & Prepayment'
	 
	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 4,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/(Decrease) in Advance,Deposite & Prepayment' Particulars,'' ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG,@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG -sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars



	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 5,null StatementSubHeadID,'Preliminary expreses written off' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	select @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG =sum(AmountinTaka) from #tempPreviousCashFlow where ReportType ='Increase/ (Decrease) in Provision for expanses'


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 6,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/ (Decrease) in Provision for expanses' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG, sum(AmountinTaka)-@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	select @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG =sum(AmountinTaka) from #tempPreviousCashFlow where ReportType ='Increase/ (Decrease) in current liabilities'

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 7,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/ (Decrease) in current liabilities' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG,sum(AmountinTaka) - @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3 or t.ReportOrderID =6
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 8,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Cash Generated from Operating activities' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka)
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(CurrentAmountinTaka)  CurrentAmountinTaka,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) PreviousAmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReport t
			where  ReportType ='Comprehensive Income/ (Loss)' 
			or
			ReportType ='Depreciation' 
			or
			ReportType ='Increase/(Decrease) in Advance,Deposite & Prepayment' 
			or
			ReportType ='Preliminary expreses written off' 
			or
			ReportType ='Increase/ (Decrease) in Provision for expanses' 
			or
			ReportType ='Increase/ (Decrease) in Current liabilities' 

		)T

		
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 9,null StatementSubHeadID,'Cash Flows from Investing Activities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	select @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG =sum(AmountinTaka) from #tempPreviousCashFlow where ReportType ='Increase / (Decrease) in Property, Plant & Equipment'

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 10,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase / (Decrease) in Property, Plant & Equipment' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) ,@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG,@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG - sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =4
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	
	select 11,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Cash Used in Investing activities' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(CurrentAmountinTaka)  CurrentAmountinTaka,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) PreviousAmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReport t
			where  ReportType ='Increase / (Decrease) in Property, Plant & Equipment' 
			
			

		)T


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 12,null StatementSubHeadID,'Cash Flow from Financing Activities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	select @LastPreviousAmountFromLOG =sum(AmountinTaka) from #tempPreviousCashFlow where ReportType ='Paid up Capital'


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 13,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Paid up Capital' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) ,@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG, sum(AmountinTaka) -@LastPreviousAmountFromLOG
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =5
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars
		
	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 14,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Cash Generated from Financing Activities' Particulars ,'',null Note,ISNULL(sum(CurrentAmountinTaka),0) ,ISNULL(sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0),ISNULL(sum(AmountinTaka),0) AmountinTaka
	FROM 
	(

			select ISNULL(sum(CurrentAmountinTaka),0)  CurrentAmountinTaka,ISNULL(sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0) PreviousAmountinTaka,ISNULL(sum(AmountinTaka),0)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReport t
			where  ReportType ='Paid up Capital' 
			
			

		)T



	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 15,null StatementSubHeadID,'Increase in Cash and Cash Equivalents' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	DECLARE @PreviousAmount float
	DECLARE @PreviousAmountForPreviousYear float

	
	--Create table #tempPreviousCashFlow
	
	--set @Query = '  insert into #tempPreviousCashFlow  exec [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportForPreviousMonthYear] '''+@FilterSoftwareStartDate+','+convert(varchar(20),@FilterStartdatePreDate)+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'''
	--exec(@Query)
	--print @Query
		
		
	select @PreviousAmount = sum([AmountinTaka])
	from #tempPreviousCashFlow
	where ReportType ='Closing Cash and Cash Equivalents'

	select @PreviousAmountForPreviousYear = sum([PreviousAmountinTaka])
	from #tempPreviousCashFlow
	where ReportType ='Closing Cash and Cash Equivalents'


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 16,null StatementSubHeadID,'Opening Cash and Cash Equivalents' Particulars ,'','' Note,@PreviousAmount,@PreviousAmountForPreviousYear,@PreviousAmount+@PreviousAmountForPreviousYear

	

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 17,null StatementSubHeadID,'Closing Cash and Cash Equivalents' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) 
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) CurrentAmountinTaka ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) PreviousAmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReport t
			where  ReportType ='Net Cash Generated from Operating activities' 
			or
			ReportType ='Net Cash Used in Investing activities' 
			or
			ReportType ='Net Cash Generated from Financing Activities' 
			or
			ReportType ='Opening Cash and Cash Equivalents' 
			

		)T

		update #TempSpGetCashFlowReport set
		CurrentAmountinTaka =null,
		PreviousAmountinTaka =null
		where Particulars = 'Closing Cash and Cash Equivalents'


	select (
	select 
		
		ReportType ,
		--Particulars ,
		[Note] ,
		[CurrentAmountinTaka],
		[AmountinTaka] ,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka],
		StatementSubHeadID 
		
	from #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	order by ReportOrderID
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportDetailsReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportDetailsReport] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2024,5,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , , , ,EE7D0807-816B-459B-A4F0-08DC08F7D0C9'

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HoD 24.@MManager 25.@MOfficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID 28. GLAccountID


CREATE PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportDetailsReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

	

	DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD int=1
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity int=6
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @StatementShareHolderEquity   uniqueidentifier ='2D8779CB-748F-4049-A5A2-FE507FAC7BF9'
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'
	DECLARE @CashInHandGLID   uniqueidentifier ='BD52240A-D093-4F02-6EF4-08DC73F57D74'
	DECLARE @AdvancesDepositsPrepayments uniqueidentifier ='5657A979-7625-4707-61F2-08DC0871A2EB'


	

	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
	DECLARE @LessNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @StatementSubHeadsID  uniqueIdentifier
	Select @StatementSubHeadsID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=28

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)


	Create table #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[CurrentAmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)

	create table #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float
	)


	--==================================Current Asset start ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sc.Id, SC.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka],0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sc.id =@AdvancesDepositsPrepayments and @AdvancesDepositsPrepayments =@StatementSubHeadsID
	and gm.GeneralLedgerId <> @CashInHandGLID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.id, l5.Name,sub.Name,sc.Id, SC.Name

	
	--==================================Current Asset end ============================--

	--==================================Current Libility ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities and @StatementCurrentLiabilities =@StatementSubHeadsID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name

	

	--insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	--select 3 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	--from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	--join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	--join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	--join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	--join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	--where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities
	--group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name

	
	--==================================Current Libility ============================--


	--==================================Fixed Asset ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 4 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets  and @StatementFixedLongTermAssets =@StatementSubHeadsID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.Name,l5.id,sub.Name

	--==================================Fixed Asset ============================--

	--==================================Shareholders Equity ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 5 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity and @StatementShareHolderEquity =@StatementSubHeadsID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,l5.name,l5.Id
	
	--==================================Shareholders Equity ============================--

	--==================================Long Term Liabilities ============================--

	
	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	select 6 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities  and @StatementLongTermLiabilities =@StatementSubHeadsID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.Name,l5.Id,l5.Name

	--==================================Long Term Liabilities ============================--


	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Level5HeadId = l5.id
			where g.Id = #TempCashFlowDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	
	

	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterSoftwareStartDate
				and 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempCashFlowDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReport set
	[PreviousAmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
				and #TempCashFlowDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	
	

	

	

	
	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 4,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/(Decrease) in Advance,Deposite & Prepayment' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) -sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 6,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/ (Decrease) in Provision for expanses' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 7,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/ (Decrease) in current liabilities' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) - sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3 or t.ReportOrderID =6
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	

	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 10,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase / (Decrease) in Property, Plant & Equipment' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) - sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =4
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReport
	select 13,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Paid up Capital' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =5
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	
	

	DECLARE @PreviousAmount float

	Create table #tempPreviousCashFlow
	(
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueIdentifier ,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float
	)


	

	
	
	--select (
	select 
		StatementSubHeadID ,
		ReportType ,
		Particulars ,
		[AmountinTaka] ,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka]
		
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	order by ReportOrderID
	--FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data




END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportForPreviousMonthYear]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--exec [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportForPreviousMonthYear] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId



CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetCashFlowReportForPreviousMonthYear]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C'
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='4286E499-2DC4-487C-8FAF-86C52D8E2E83'
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @StatementShareHolderEquity   uniqueidentifier ='2D8779CB-748F-4049-A5A2-FE507FAC7BF9'
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'
	DECLARE @CashInHandGLID   uniqueidentifier ='BD52240A-D093-4F02-6EF4-08DC73F57D74'
		 DECLARE @AdvancesDepositsPrepayments uniqueidentifier ='5657A979-7625-4707-61F2-08DC0871A2EB'

	
	 

	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
	DECLARE @LessNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartValue)


	Create table #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[CurrentAmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)

	create table #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka] float
	)


	

	--==================================Current Asset start ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sc.Id, SC.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka],0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sc.id =@AdvancesDepositsPrepayments --@StatementCurrentAssetAssets
	and gm.GeneralLedgerId <> @CashInHandGLID
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.id, l5.Name,sub.Name,sc.Id, SC.Name

	
	--==================================Current Asset end ============================--

	--==================================Current Libility ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name,sub.name

	--insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReport
	--select 3 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	--from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	--join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	--join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	--join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	--join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	--where sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities
	--group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id,l5.Id,l5.Name

	
	--==================================Current Libility ============================--


	--==================================Fixed Asset ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 4 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,l5.Name,l5.id,sub.Name,sub.id

	--==================================Fixed Asset ============================--

	--==================================Shareholders Equity ============================--

	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 5 [ReportOrderID],l5.id, l5.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity 
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,l5.name,l5.Id
	
	--==================================Shareholders Equity ============================--

	--==================================Long Term Liabilities ============================--

	
	insert into #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 6 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  sub.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka], 0 [PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.ID,l5.Id,l5.Name

	--==================================Long Term Liabilities ============================--


	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Level5HeadId = l5.id
			where g.Id = #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear.id
			group by n.id
	)
	



	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterSoftwareStartDate
				and 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	update #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear set
	[PreviousAmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t on t.id = g.Id
				where 
				convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
				and #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 1,null StatementSubHeadID,'Cash Flow from Operating Activities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	--======================================   Retained Earnings  start  ========================--
	



	DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max) =''
	DECLARE @RetainedEarnings float=0

	DECLARE @RetainedEarningsPrevious float=0
	select  @RetainedEarnings = [Account].[fnGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings](@FilterStartValue,@FilterEndValue)
	select  @RetainedEarningsPrevious = [Account].[fnGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings](@FilterSoftwareStartDate,convert(varchar(max),@FilterStartdatePreDate))

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 2,null StatementSubHeadID,'Comprehensive Income/ (Loss) ' Particulars ,'','' Note,@RetainedEarnings,@RetainedEarningsPrevious,@RetainedEarnings +@RetainedEarningsPrevious

	
	--================================== Retained Earnings  End ============================--


		
		
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 3,null StatementSubHeadID,'Depreciation' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 4,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/(Decrease) in Advance,Deposite & Prepayment' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) -sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 5,null StatementSubHeadID,'Preliminary expreses written off' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 6,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/ (Decrease) in Provision for expanses' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 7,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase/ (Decrease) in current liabilities' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) - sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3 or t.ReportOrderID =6
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 8,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Cash Generated from Operating activities' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka)
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(CurrentAmountinTaka)  CurrentAmountinTaka,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) PreviousAmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear t
			where  ReportType ='Comprehensive Income/ (Loss)' 
			or
			ReportType ='Depreciation' 
			or
			ReportType ='Increase/(Decrease) in Advance,Deposite & Prepayment' 
			or
			ReportType ='Preliminary expreses written off' 
			or
			ReportType ='Increase/ (Decrease) in Provision for expanses' 
			or
			ReportType ='Increase/ (Decrease) in Current liabilities' 

		)T


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 9,null StatementSubHeadID,'Cash Flows from Investing Activities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 10,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Increase / (Decrease) in Property, Plant & Equipment' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) - sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t
	where t.ReportOrderID =4
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear	
	select 11,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Cash Used in Investing activities' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(CurrentAmountinTaka)  CurrentAmountinTaka,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) PreviousAmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear t
			where  ReportType ='Increase / (Decrease) in Property, Plant & Equipment' 
			
			

		)T


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 12,null StatementSubHeadID,'Cash Flow from Financing Activities' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 13,t.StatementSubHeadID,'Paid up Capital' Particulars,ReportType ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0 
	from #TempCashFlowDetailsReportPreviousMonthYear t
	where t.ReportOrderID =5
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID,Particulars

	--PRINT 'X'
	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 14,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Cash Generated from Financing Activities' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka
	FROM 
	(
		select ISNULL(sum(CurrentAmountinTaka),0)  CurrentAmountinTaka,ISNULL(sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),0) PreviousAmountinTaka,ISNULL(sum(AmountinTaka),0)  AmountinTaka
		from #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear t
		where  ReportType ='Paid up Capital' 
	)T

		


	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 15,null StatementSubHeadID,'Increase in Cash and Cash Equivalents' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0

	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 16,null StatementSubHeadID,'Opening Cash and Cash Equivalents' Particulars ,'','' Note,0,0,0



	insert into #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	select 17,null StatementSubHeadID,'Closing Cash and Cash Equivalents' Particulars ,'',null Note,sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka),sum(AmountinTaka) 
	FROM 
	(

			select sum(CurrentAmountinTaka) CurrentAmountinTaka ,sum(PreviousAmountinTaka) PreviousAmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka)  AmountinTaka
			from #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear t
			where  ReportType ='Net Cash Generated from Operating activities' 
			or
			ReportType ='Net Cash Used in Investing activities' 
			or
			ReportType ='Net Cash Generated from Financing Activities' 
			or
			ReportType ='Opening Cash and Cash Equivalents' 
			

		)T



	--select (
	select 
		StatementSubHeadID ,
		ReportType ,
		Particulars ,
		[Note] ,
		[AmountinTaka] ,
		[PreviousAmountinTaka]
	from #TempSpGetCashFlowReportPreviousMonthYear
	order by ReportOrderID
	--FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

END


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetCategoryById]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetCategoryById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select c.Id,c.Name,c.CodeNo,c.NatueOfAccountId,na.Name NoA
	  from [Account].[Categories] c left join
		   [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] na on c.NatueOfAccountId=na.Id
	 where @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or c.Id=@Id
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[spGetDueBills]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec [Account].[spGetDueBills] '2af75c29-4265-485d-0df5-08db8e5c44f0','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',7,'2023-07-01', '2023-09-10'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[spGetDueBills]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier,
	@ReferranceId uniqueidentifier, --Supplier's Invoice or Bill No or Stock Receive Id 
	@ServiceUnitId int,
	@datefrom date,
	@dateto date
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	
	CREATE Table #TempAccountspGetDueBills
	(
		Id uniqueIdentifier,
		RefrenceID uniqueIdentifier,
		InvoiceNo nvarchar(max),
		SupplierId bigint,
		Bill nvarchar(max),
		VoucherDate datetime,
		GLId uniqueIdentifier,
		Name nvarchar(max),
		DueBill float,
		ToatlPayment float,
		isPaymentStatus int
		--,
		--debit float,
		--credit float
	)

	
	
  if(@ServiceUnitId=7) -- Pharmacy Stock Receive
  Begin
  insert into #TempAccountspGetDueBills
  select * from (
	Select vm.Id,vm.RefrenceID, sr.InvoiceNo, isnull(sr.SupplierId, 0) SupplierId, 'Bill' as Bill,  vm.VoucherDate,
	isnull(L.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') GLId,L.Name,
	sum(d.Credit)-SUM(d.Debit) as DueBill,0   ToatlPayment,
	--n.id isPaymentStatus,sum(debit) debit,sum(credit) credit
	case when SUM(d.credit) > 0 and n.Id in (1,4) then 1 else 0 end isPaymentStatus
	
	from [Account].VoucherMaster vm join [Pharmacy].StockReceives sr on vm.RefrenceID=sr.Id
	join [Account].VoucherMasterDetail d on vm.Id=d.VMID  
	join  [Account].[GeneralLedgers]  L on d.DTLID=L.Id
	
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] ll on ll.id=l.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] s on s.id=ll.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.id=s.CategoryId
	join [Account].NatureOfAccounts n on n.id=c.NatueOfAccountId

	where (d.DTLID=@SupplierId or @SupplierId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and  (vm.RefrenceID=@ReferranceId or @ReferranceId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	and vm.ServiceUnitId=@ServiceUnitId and VM.VoucherDate>=@datefrom and vm.VoucherDate<=@dateto
	group by  vm.Id, sr.InvoiceNo, vm.VoucherDate,L.Name,l.Id,sr.SupplierId,vm.RefrenceID,n.Id
	) tbl where tbl.DueBill>0
  
  
  
  update #TempAccountspGetDueBills set
  ToatlPayment =
  isnull((
	select sum(DueBill) from #TempAccountspGetDueBills t where t.InvoiceNo = #TempAccountspGetDueBills.InvoiceNo
	and t.isPaymentStatus =1
  ),0)




 -- update #TempAccountspGetDueBills set
 -- DueBill = DueBill - ToatlPayment
 -- where Name <> 'CASH AT HEAD OFFICE'



	select * from (
	Select vm.Id,vm.RefrenceID, sr.InvoiceNo, isnull(sr.SupplierId, 0) SupplierId, 'Bill' as Bill,  vm.VoucherDate,
	isnull(L.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') GLId,L.Name,
	case when SUM(d.credit) > 0 and n.Id in (1,4) then sum(d.Credit)-SUM(d.Debit)
	else
	sum(d.Credit)-SUM(d.Debit) 
	-
	(
		select tt.ToatlPayment from #TempAccountspGetDueBills tt where tt.GLId = isnull(L.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and tt.InvoiceNo =  sr.InvoiceNo
	)
	end DueBill
	
	from [Account].VoucherMaster vm join [Pharmacy].StockReceives sr on vm.RefrenceID=sr.Id
	join [Account].VoucherMasterDetail d on vm.Id=d.VMID  
	join  [Account].[GeneralLedgers]  L on d.DTLID=L.Id 
	
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] ll on ll.id=l.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] s on s.id=ll.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.id=s.CategoryId
	join [Account].NatureOfAccounts n on n.id=c.NatueOfAccountId


	where (d.DTLID=@SupplierId or @SupplierId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and  (vm.RefrenceID=@ReferranceId or @ReferranceId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	and vm.ServiceUnitId=@ServiceUnitId and VM.VoucherDate>=@datefrom and vm.VoucherDate<=@dateto
	group by  vm.Id, sr.InvoiceNo, vm.VoucherDate,L.Name,l.Id,sr.SupplierId,vm.RefrenceID,n.Id
	) tbl where tbl.DueBill>0
  
  
  End
  
  --select 
  
  --Id ,
		--RefrenceID ,
		--InvoiceNo ,
		--SupplierId ,
		--Bill ,
		--VoucherDate ,
		--GLId ,
		--[Name],
		--DueBill 


  --from #TempAccountspGetDueBills




END
GO

--Exec [Account].[SpGetGLMappingWithStatementByGlId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetGLMappingWithStatementByGlId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@GLId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select ms.Id,ms.GeneralLedgerId,ms.StatementSubHeadId,sh.StatementBroadHeadId,sh.Name StatementSubHeadName,bh.Name StatementBroadHeadName
	  from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] ms inner join
		   [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sh on ms.StatementSubHeadId=sh.Id left join
		   [Account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on sh.StatementBroadHeadId=bh.Id
	 where @GLId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or ms.GeneralLedgerId=@GLId
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
---------exec [Account].[SpGetHISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordByIdOrDates] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','2024-01-01','2024-08-01'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetHISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordByIdOrDates]
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime
AS
BEGIN
	select mr.Id,mr.InvoiceNo,mr.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId,mr.PaymentDate,mr.UserId,mjo.Name [MediaName],u.UserName,sum(mrd.PaidAmount) TotalPaid,mr.Addition,mr.Deduction,mr.Remarks,mr.Discount
	  from [Account].[HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords] mr left join
		   [Account].[HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails] mrd on mr.Id=mrd.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId left join
		   [Marketing].[MarketingJOfficerOrMedias] mjo on mr.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId=mjo.Id left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on mr.UserId=u.Id
	 where (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and convert(date, mr.PaymentDate)>=convert(date, @DateFrom) and convert(date, mr.PaymentDate)<=convert(date,@DateTo)) or
	 mr.Id=@Id
	 group by mr.Id,mr.InvoiceNo,mr.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId,mr.PaymentDate,mr.UserId,mjo.Name,u.UserName,mr.Addition,mr.Deduction,mr.Remarks,mr.Discount
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetLedgerReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec [Account].[SpGetLedgerReport] '2024-06-1,2024-06-30,2024,6,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , , , ,BD52240A-D093-4F02-6EF4-08DC73F57D74'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId
--28.GLAccountId

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetLedgerReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 
    DECLARE @GeneralLedgerId uniqueidentifier
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
	Select @GeneralLedgerId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=28

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddateAfterDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)
	select @FilterEnddateAfterDate = DATEADD(Day,1,@FilterEnddate)


	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C'
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='4286E499-2DC4-487C-8FAF-86C52D8E2E83'
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @StatementShareHolderEquity   uniqueidentifier ='2D8779CB-748F-4049-A5A2-FE507FAC7BF9'
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'

	
	

	select @FilterStartdatePreDate [Date], NName NName ,NID Id, Particulars,'Opening Balance' [ReportType],sum(AmountDebit) AmountDebit ,sum(AmountCredit) AmountCredit,
	case when NID=1 or NID =4 then sum(AmountDebit) - sum(AmountCredit)
	else sum(AmountCredit) - sum(AmountDebit) end [Balance], gid,getdate() To_Date
	into #TempLedger
	from 
	(
	
			select n.Name NName ,n.Id NID,g.Name Particulars,'Opening Balance' [ReportType],debit AmountDebit ,credit AmountCredit,
			case when n.Id=1 or n.id =4 then debit - credit
			else credit - debit end [Balance],g.Id gid,getdate() To_Date
			from 
			[Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
			join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
			join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
			join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
			join [Account].[VoucherMasters] m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
			join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			where 
			(
				(bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets)
				or
				(bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementCurrentAssetAssets)
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity )
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities)
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities)
		
			)
			and 
			(d.GeneralLedgerId=@GeneralLedgerId or @GeneralLedgerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			
			union all

			select n.Name NName ,n.Id NID,g.Name Particulars,'Opening Balance' [ReportType],0 AmountDebit ,0 AmountCredit,
			0 [Balance],g.Id gid,getdate() To_Date
			from 
			[Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
			join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
			join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
			join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			where 
			(
				(bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets)
				or
				(bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementCurrentAssetAssets)
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity )
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities)
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities)
		
			)
			and 
			(g.Id=@GeneralLedgerId or @GeneralLedgerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

		)T
		group by T.NName,NId,Particulars,gId

		
		

	select convert(date,m.PostingDate) [Date],n.Name ,n.Id,g.Name+' Voucher No : '+convert(nvarchar(50),isnull(m.VoucherNo,'') ) + isnull(m.Note,'') Particulars,''[ReportType],sum(debit) AmountDebit ,sum(credit) AmountCredit,
	case when n.Id=1 or n.id =4 then sum(debit) - sum(credit)
	else sum(credit) - sum(debit) end [Balance],g.Id GID,m.CreatedOn
	into #TempLedgerDetails
	from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
	join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
	join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
 	where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterStartdate
	and   convert(date,m.PostingDate)<=@FilterEnddate and (d.GeneralLedgerId=@GeneralLedgerId or @GeneralLedgerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by convert(date,m.PostingDate),n.Name,n.Id,g.Name,g.Id,m.Id,m.VoucherNo,m.Note,m.CreatedOn
	order by m.CreatedOn
	
	

	update #TempLedgerDetails set
	[Balance] =
	isnull((
		select tt.Balance from #TempLedger tt
		where tt.GID =#TempLedgerDetails.GID
	),0)
	+
	isnull(
		(select sum(tt.Balance) from #TempLedgerDetails tt
		where tt.GID =#TempLedgerDetails.GID
		and tt.CreatedOn <=#TempLedgerDetails.CreatedOn)
	,0)

	
	
	

	select 
	 @FilterEnddateAfterDate [Date],Particulars Name ,Id,Particulars,'CLosing Balance' [ReportType],0 AmountDebit ,0 AmountCredit,
	0[Balance],gid,getdate() To_Date
	into #TempClosingBalance
	from #TempLedger t 

	


	update #TempClosingBalance set
	AmountDebit =
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountDebit) from #TempLedger t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0),
	AmountCredit =
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountCredit) from #TempLedger t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0),
	Balance =
		isnull((
			select sum(Balance) from #TempLedger t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0)

		

	update #TempClosingBalance set
	AmountDebit = AmountDebit+ 
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountDebit) from #TempLedgerDetails t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0),
	AmountCredit = AmountCredit+
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountCredit) from #TempLedgerDetails t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0)

		 

		update #TempClosingBalance set
		Balance=
		isnull((
			select case when id =1 or id=4 then AmountDebit -AmountCredit 
			else AmountCredit- AmountDebit end Amount
			from #TempClosingBalance tt
			where tt.gid =#TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0)

		 

		select( 
select * from (
	select [Date],Particulars,[ReportType],AmountDebit,AmountCredit,[Balance]
	from 
	(
	select * from #TempLedger t 
	union all
	select * from #TempLedgerDetails
	union all 
	select * from #TempClosingBalance
	
	)T
	
		) tbl order by tbl.Date,tbl.Particulars FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END



GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMarketingOfficerSalesReportDetails]
@paramas NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @FilterStartDate DATE, @FilterEndDate DATE, @mofficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

    SELECT @FilterStartDate = CONVERT(DATE, v.Value)
    FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) AS v WHERE v.OrderNo = 1;

    SELECT @FilterEndDate = CONVERT(DATE, v.Value)
    FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) AS v WHERE v.OrderNo = 2;

    SELECT @mofficer = CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, v.Value)
    FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) AS v WHERE v.OrderNo = 10;

    DECLARE @Pathology TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @Pathology VALUES
    ('5BDDDE43-2E5B-4AAF-91DC-118F7D34E5E2'), ('50D87D65-3B1F-4BE7-9778-BD60879F409A'),
    ('D6D73AA3-9758-4A37-85A1-CBA718E77AE8'), ('F08A3B24-4349-4AA4-8551-D4485F2733A1'),
    ('78950F18-C750-4EAA-9BB1-EA1B4A9A2BA8'), ('2E13D4DF-D393-4D74-9DDB-FB69691769A4');

    DECLARE @ECG TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @ECG VALUES
    ('DE2D6E38-E531-42B4-AFFB-0246EA0C9390'), ('AEBCB2B8-25E4-4B0F-A09D-719457D19EC6'),
    ('14B4BBCB-FCBD-4BB8-9B05-7EB259BEF8FD'), ('BE4F7F25-CF4A-4CE3-B49E-974A4B252617'),
    ('8810CDC4-BD4E-4D9F-9C29-F8BB1E8A6F40');

    DECLARE @USG TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @USG VALUES
    ('BED85DB7-025E-41F1-91CE-23D300BAB1C4'), ('C016F7EA-76D4-4243-9AE1-3DF84B161E40'),
    ('C3248786-B3CC-4009-93FF-BCDBAC18A780'), ('E8C6D67B-8CE2-4A8C-B628-EA78587D234E'),
    ('22E9D9F1-1C7F-4769-BE4F-FB9F2DFE72B1');

    DECLARE @XRay TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @XRay VALUES
    ('FF238E9F-58D7-4311-A34A-002832B20429'), ('2BF7E8D6-1DE6-4E43-8178-232D64E26520'),
    ('53C7CEDC-D3A4-43EF-AB59-6B204B888944'), ('3991609B-079E-43BD-AC30-C5C4879AAAFC'),
    ('76E7E7EE-C615-48E7-9B6C-D14173904A46'), ('E47EF753-910A-46AE-AC55-F2CF4BE13A62');

    DECLARE @Echo TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @Echo VALUES
    ('2685DA00-911D-4FEF-8929-1A8C2D050441'), ('B63C3CCD-B4D6-4FF9-8336-1F1943F87B97'),
    ('CA395D04-023C-49D9-8AD2-89513427C41A'), ('B1E49255-83AC-4B87-909E-D69A80740DB1'),
    ('35CB6A20-FD05-420B-8D67-E8A8B32EE2AD');

    DECLARE @Endoscopy TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @Endoscopy VALUES
    ('13AA44F8-6B6F-4215-8140-2652A21C8D08'), ('8372741B-2363-4400-A5BF-723DA20A8905'),
    ('24269BFC-372B-41C8-A127-913C1FC0D9DA'), ('C1B49C5D-AE6D-4D54-90F5-99A96B1E5B7B'),
    ('825C7259-345E-4AE2-B9BA-DF5379C5964F');

    CREATE TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport (
        MRID NVARCHAR(MAX), MRName NVARCHAR(MAX), Code NVARCHAR(MAX),
        JmoName NVARCHAR(MAX), Address NVARCHAR(MAX), PhoneNumber NVARCHAR(MAX),
        TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, Total FLOAT
    );

    INSERT INTO #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport
    SELECT CAST(o.Id AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), o.Name, j.Code, j.Name, j.Address, j.PhoneNumber,
           g.Id, d.Total
    FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
    JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails d ON d.InvestigationInvoiceId = i.Id
    JOIN Diag.TestItems t ON t.Id = d.TestItemId
    JOIN Diag.TestGroups g ON g.Id = t.TestGroupId
    JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias j ON j.Id = i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
    JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers o ON o.Id = j.MarketingOfficerId
    WHERE CONVERT(DATE, i.EntryDate) BETWEEN @FilterStartDate AND @FilterEndDate
      AND (@mofficer = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR o.Id = @mofficer);

    CREATE TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary (
        MRID NVARCHAR(MAX), MRName NVARCHAR(MAX), Code NVARCHAR(MAX), JmoName NVARCHAR(MAX),
        FullAddress NVARCHAR(MAX), ContactNo NVARCHAR(MAX),
        Pathology FLOAT, ECG FLOAT, USG FLOAT, XRay FLOAT, Echo FLOAT, Endoscopy FLOAT,
        Other FLOAT, TotalAmount FLOAT
    );

    INSERT INTO #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary
    SELECT r.MRID, r.MRName, r.Code, r.JmoName, r.Address, r.PhoneNumber,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN e.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN u.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN x.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN h.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN en.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.TestGroupId IS NULL AND e.TestGroupId IS NULL AND u.TestGroupId IS NULL
                         AND x.TestGroupId IS NULL AND h.TestGroupId IS NULL AND en.TestGroupId IS NULL
                    THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END),
           SUM(ISNULL(r.Total, 0))
    FROM #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport r
    LEFT JOIN @Pathology p ON r.TestGroupId = p.TestGroupId
    LEFT JOIN @ECG e ON r.TestGroupId = e.TestGroupId
    LEFT JOIN @USG u ON r.TestGroupId = u.TestGroupId
    LEFT JOIN @XRay x ON r.TestGroupId = x.TestGroupId
    LEFT JOIN @Echo h ON r.TestGroupId = h.TestGroupId
    LEFT JOIN @Endoscopy en ON r.TestGroupId = en.TestGroupId
    GROUP BY r.MRID, r.MRName, r.Code, r.JmoName, r.Address, r.PhoneNumber;

    SELECT (
        SELECT * FROM #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary
        ORDER BY MRID, MRName
        FOR JSON AUTO
    ) AS Data;

    DROP TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport;
    DROP TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary]
    @paramas NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @FilterStartDate DATE, @FilterEndDate DATE, @mofficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

    SELECT 
        @FilterStartDate = CONVERT(DATE, v.Value)
    FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) AS v
    WHERE v.OrderNo = 1;

    SELECT 
        @FilterEndDate = CONVERT(DATE, v.Value)
    FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) AS v
    WHERE v.OrderNo = 2;

    SELECT 
        @mofficer = CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, v.Value)
    FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) AS v
    WHERE v.OrderNo = 10;


    -- Table variables for TestGroupId lookup
    DECLARE @Pathology TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @Pathology VALUES
    ('5BDDDE43-2E5B-4AAF-91DC-118F7D34E5E2'),
    ('50D87D65-3B1F-4BE7-9778-BD60879F409A'),
    ('D6D73AA3-9758-4A37-85A1-CBA718E77AE8'),
    ('F08A3B24-4349-4AA4-8551-D4485F2733A1'),
    ('78950F18-C750-4EAA-9BB1-EA1B4A9A2BA8'),
    ('2E13D4DF-D393-4D74-9DDB-FB69691769A4');


    DECLARE @ECG TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @ECG VALUES
    ('DE2D6E38-E531-42B4-AFFB-0246EA0C9390'),
    ('AEBCB2B8-25E4-4B0F-A09D-719457D19EC6'),
    ('14B4BBCB-FCBD-4BB8-9B05-7EB259BEF8FD'),
    ('BE4F7F25-CF4A-4CE3-B49E-974A4B252617'),
    ('8810CDC4-BD4E-4D9F-9C29-F8BB1E8A6F40');
	
    DECLARE @USG TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @USG VALUES
    ('BED85DB7-025E-41F1-91CE-23D300BAB1C4'),
    ('C016F7EA-76D4-4243-9AE1-3DF84B161E40'),
    ('C3248786-B3CC-4009-93FF-BCDBAC18A780'),
    ('E8C6D67B-8CE2-4A8C-B628-EA78587D234E'),
    ('22E9D9F1-1C7F-4769-BE4F-FB9F2DFE72B1');
	
    DECLARE @XRay TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @XRay VALUES
    ('FF238E9F-58D7-4311-A34A-002832B20429'),
    ('2BF7E8D6-1DE6-4E43-8178-232D64E26520'),
    ('53C7CEDC-D3A4-43EF-AB59-6B204B888944'),
    ('3991609B-079E-43BD-AC30-C5C4879AAAFC'),
    ('76E7E7EE-C615-48E7-9B6C-D14173904A46'),
    ('E47EF753-910A-46AE-AC55-F2CF4BE13A62');

    DECLARE @Echo TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @Echo VALUES
    ('2685DA00-911D-4FEF-8929-1A8C2D050441'),
    ('B63C3CCD-B4D6-4FF9-8336-1F1943F87B97'),
    ('CA395D04-023C-49D9-8AD2-89513427C41A'),
    ('B1E49255-83AC-4B87-909E-D69A80740DB1'),
    ('35CB6A20-FD05-420B-8D67-E8A8B32EE2AD');

    DECLARE @Endoscopy TABLE (TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO @Endoscopy VALUES
    ('13AA44F8-6B6F-4215-8140-2652A21C8D08'),
    ('8372741B-2363-4400-A5BF-723DA20A8905'),
    ('24269BFC-372B-41C8-A127-913C1FC0D9DA'),
    ('C1B49C5D-AE6D-4D54-90F5-99A96B1E5B7B'),
    ('825C7259-345E-4AE2-B9BA-DF5379C5964F');
		
    -- Temp data store
    CREATE TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport
    (
        MRID NVARCHAR(MAX),
        MRName NVARCHAR(MAX),
        TestGroupId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        Total FLOAT
    );

    INSERT INTO #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport
    SELECT
        CAST(o.Id AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS MRID,
        o.Name AS MRName,
        g.Id AS TestGroupId,
        d.Total
    FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
    JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails d ON d.InvestigationInvoiceId = i.Id
    JOIN Diag.TestItems t ON t.Id = d.TestItemId
    JOIN Diag.TestGroups g ON g.Id = t.TestGroupId
    JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias j ON j.Id = i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
    JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers o ON o.Id = j.MarketingOfficerId
     where convert(date,i.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
and (o.Id = @mofficer or @mofficer ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


			
    CREATE TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary
    (
        MRID NVARCHAR(MAX),
        MRName NVARCHAR(MAX),
        Pathology FLOAT, ECG FLOAT, USG FLOAT, XRay FLOAT, Echo FLOAT, Endoscopy FLOAT, Other FLOAT, TotalAmount FLOAT
    );

	

    INSERT INTO #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary (MRID, MRName, Pathology, ECG, USG, XRay, Echo, Endoscopy, Other, TotalAmount)

	SELECT
    r.MRID,
    r.MRName,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Pathology,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS ECG,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS USG,
    SUM(CASE WHEN x.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS XRay,
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Echo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN en.TestGroupId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Endoscopy,
    SUM(CASE WHEN 
        p.TestGroupId IS NULL AND
        e.TestGroupId IS NULL AND
        u.TestGroupId IS NULL AND
        x.TestGroupId IS NULL AND
        h.TestGroupId IS NULL AND
        en.TestGroupId IS NULL
        THEN ISNULL(r.Total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Other,
    SUM(ISNULL(r.Total, 0)) AS TotalAmount
FROM #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport r
LEFT JOIN @Pathology p ON r.TestGroupId = p.TestGroupId
LEFT JOIN @ECG e ON r.TestGroupId = e.TestGroupId
LEFT JOIN @USG u ON r.TestGroupId = u.TestGroupId
LEFT JOIN @XRay x ON r.TestGroupId = x.TestGroupId
LEFT JOIN @Echo h ON r.TestGroupId = h.TestGroupId
LEFT JOIN @Endoscopy en ON r.TestGroupId = en.TestGroupId
GROUP BY r.MRID, r.MRName;

    -- Output as JSON
    SELECT (
        SELECT *
        FROM #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary
        ORDER BY MRID, MRName
        FOR JSON AUTO
    ) AS Data;

    -- Clean up temp tables
    DROP TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReport;
    DROP TABLE #TempMarketingOfficerSalesReportSummary;
END;
