-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
---------exec [Account].[SpGetMediaCommissionStatementForHospitalAndDiagnostic] '2024-01-01','2024-11-01','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMediaCommissionStatementForHospitalAndDiagnostic]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@MediaId uniqueidentifier,
	@IsPaid int=0
AS
BEGIN


			select 
						BillNo,PatientName,
						CONVERT(DATE,EDate)EDate,
						case when Department = 'Diagonistic' then 
						[Diag].[GetAllTestNameByPatientID](id,'WithPrice') else  [Hospital].[GetAllServiceNameByAdmissionID](id) end TestOrServiceName,
						MediaPName,
						Department,
						isnull(sum(TotalCost),0) TotalCost,
						case when Department = 'Diagonistic' then 
						[Diag].[GetAllMarketingCommisionJMOWisePatientID](BillNo,id)
						else
						isnull(sum(Commission),0) end Commission,
						isnull(sum (Discount),0) Discount,
						isnull(
						case when Department = 'Diagonistic' then 
						[Diag].[GetAllMarketingCommisionJMOWisePatientID](BillNo,id)
						else
						isnull(sum(Commission),0) end
						,0) - isnull(sum (Discount),0)   PayableAmount,

						--isnull(sum (PaidAmount),0) PaidAmount,
						--isnull (sum (DueCollection),0) DueCollection,
						--isnull(sum (PaidAmount),0) + isnull(sum (DueCollection),0)+isnull(sum(AdvanceCollection),0) NetCollection,
						isnull(DueAmount,0) DueAmount,
						isnull(MediaCode,'') MediaCode,
						isnull(MediasPhoneNo,'')MediasPhoneNo,
						Id
						into #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForHospitalAndDiagnostic
			
			from 
			(

			select distinct 'Diagonistic' Department,p.InvoiceNo BillNo,p.FullName PatientName,  convert(date,p.EntryDate) EDate,
			m.Name  MediaPName,m.Code MediaCode,m.PhoneNumber MediasPhoneNo,
			
			0 as Commission,
			p.id,
			case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end TotalCost,
			case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end Discount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			case when l.TransactionType =3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,
			0 AdvanceCollection,
			(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers ll where ll.InvestigationInvoiceId = p.id) DueAmount

			from Diag.InvestigationInvoices  p
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails  t on t.InvestigationInvoiceId = p.id
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  m on m.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers  l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=t.InvestigationInvoiceId

			where CONVERT(DATE,p.EntryDate) >=@filterstartDate and 
			CONVERT(DATE,p.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (m.id = @MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and p.IsMediaCommissionPaid=0
			and t.IsCancelApproved <>1




			union all

			select distinct 'Hospital', p.InvoiceNo BillNo,p.FullName PatientName,  convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) EDate,
			m.Name MediaPName,m.Code MediaCode,m.PhoneNumber MediasPhoneNo,
			0 Commission,
			p.id,
			case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end Totalcost,
			--case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end 
		0  Discount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,		
			case when l.TransactionType = 10 then (Credit) end AdvanceCollection,
			(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll where ll.FinalBillId =  hb.id) DueAmount
			from 
			Hospital.IPDPatientRecords  p
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  m on m.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			join Hospital.FinalBills   hb on hb.IPDPatientRecordId = p.id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers  l on l.FinalBillId = hb.Id

			where CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@filterstartDate and CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (m.id = @MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and p.IsMediaCommissionPaid=0

			union all
			

			select distinct 'Hospital', p.InvoiceNo BillNo,p.FullName PatientName,  convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) EDate,
			m.Name MediaPName,m.Code MediaCode,m.PhoneNumber MediasPhoneNo,
			p.MediaHonorarium Commission,
			p.id,
			0 Totalcost,
			0 Discount,
			0 PaidAmount,
			0 DueCollection,		
			0 AdvanceCollection,
			0 DueAmount
			from 
			Hospital.IPDPatientRecords  p
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  m on m.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			

			where CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@filterstartDate and CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (m.id = @MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and p.IsMediaCommissionPaid=0

			)T
			--where isnull(DueAmount,0) =0 
			GROUP BY t.id,EDate,MediaPName,BillNo,PatientName,
						Department,t.DueAmount,MediaCode,MediasPhoneNo
						
						
						


						 
						
						select 
						BillNo,PatientName,
						EDate,
						TestOrServiceName,
						MediaPName,
						Department,
						isnull(sum (TotalCost),0) TotalCost,
						isnull(sum (Commission),0) Commission,
						isnull(sum (Discount),0) Discount,
						isnull(sum (PayableAmount),0) PayableAmount,
						isnull(sum(DueAmount),0) DueAmount,
						isnull(MediaCode,'') MediaCode,
						isnull(MediasPhoneNo,'')MediasPhoneNo,
						Id
						from #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForHospitalAndDiagnostic t
						GROUP BY 
						t.Id,
						BillNo,PatientName,
						EDate,
						TestOrServiceName,
						MediaPName,
						Department,
						MediaCode,
						MediasPhoneNo
						--t.id,EDate,MediaPName,BillNo,PatientName,
						--Department,t.DueAmount,MediaCode,MediasPhoneNo,T.TestOrServiceName
						Having isnull(sum(DueAmount),0) = 0
						order by Department,EDate

END


--------------------------------

--exec [Account].[SpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMIS]'2021-01-15,2025-03-19,2024,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0'

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMIS]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

--@FilterStartDate date,
--@FilterEndDate date,
--@MediaId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@FilterStartDate date
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
	DECLARE @MediaId uniqueidentifier
				
				Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
				Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
				Select @MediaId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

				

			select InvoiceNO,sum(addition)/sum(PatientIDCount) addition,sum(Deduction)/sum(PatientIDCount) Deduction
			into #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISAdditionDiscount
			from 
			(
			select 
			h.InvoiceNO,h.addition,count(d.PatientID) PatientIDCount,h.Deduction
			from Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords h join
						Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails d on h.Id= d.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId
						join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.id=d.PatientId
						join [Identity].Users u on u.id=h.CreatedBy
						join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias m on m.id=h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						where convert(date,h.CreatedOn) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,h.CreatedOn)<=@FilterEndDate
						and (h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId=@MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			
			group by h.InvoiceNO,h.addition,h.Deduction
			)T
			group by T.InvoiceNO

			--SELECT * FROM #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISAdditionDiscount RETURN 

			select (
			 select 
			 ReffCode, ReffName, ReffPhone,  ReffAddress,  Paydate,PatientId,
			 FullName,  MobileNo,  Commission,  round(PaidAmount,2) PaidAmount,  PaidBy--,
			, PaidAmount1, Addition,  deduction

			  from 
			 (
			select m.Code ReffCode, m.Name ReffName,m.PhoneNumber ReffPhone, '' as ReffAddress, convert(datetime,h.CreatedOn) as Paydate,i.InvoiceNo as PatientId,
			i.FullName as FullName, i.MobileNo as MobileNo, d.Commission as Commission, (isnull(d.PaidAmount,0) + isnull(tt.Addition,0) - isnull(tt.Deduction ,0) ) as PaidAmount, u.UserName as PaidBy--,
			,d.PaidAmount PaidAmount1,tt.Addition as Addition, tt.Deduction as deduction
			from Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords h join
			Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails d on h.Id= d.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.id=d.PatientId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id=h.CreatedBy
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias m on m.id=h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			join #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISAdditionDiscount tt on tt.InvoiceNO = h.InvoiceNO
			where convert(date,h.CreatedOn) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,h.CreatedOn)<=@FilterEndDate
			and (h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId=@MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

			
			)T
			FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISHospital]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

--@FilterEndDate date,
--@MediaId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@FilterStartDate date
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
	DECLARE @MediaId uniqueidentifier
				
				Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
				Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
				Select @MediaId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

				

			select InvoiceNO,sum(addition)/sum(PatientIDCount) addition,sum(Deduction)/sum(PatientIDCount) Deduction
			into #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISAdditionDiscount
			from 
			(
			select 
			h.InvoiceNO,h.addition,count(d.PatientID) PatientIDCount,h.Deduction
			from Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords h join
						Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails d on h.Id= d.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId
						join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.id=d.PatientId
						join [Identity].Users u on u.id=h.CreatedBy
						join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias m on m.id=h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						where convert(date,h.CreatedOn) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,h.CreatedOn)<=@FilterEndDate
						and (h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId=@MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			
			group by h.InvoiceNO,h.addition,h.Deduction
			)T
			group by T.InvoiceNO

			--SELECT * FROM #TempSpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISAdditionDiscount RETURN 

			select (
			 select 
			 ReffCode, ReffName, ReffPhone,  ReffAddress,  Paydate,PatientId,
			 FullName,  MobileNo,  Commission,  round(PaidAmount,2) PaidAmount,  PaidBy--,
			, PaidAmount1, Addition,  deduction

			  from 
			 (
			select m.Code ReffCode, m.Name ReffName,m.PhoneNumber ReffPhone, '' as ReffAddress, convert(datetime,h.CreatedOn) as Paydate,i.InvoiceNo as PatientId,
			i.FullName as FullName, r.MobileNo as MobileNo, d.Commission as Commission, (d.PaidAmount+h.Addition-h.Deduction) as PaidAmount, u.UserName as PaidBy
			,0 Addition, 0 deduction,0 PaidAmount1
			from Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords h join
			Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails d on h.Id= d.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId
			join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i on i.id=d.PatientId
			join Hospital.RegRecords r on r.UHID=i.UHID
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id=h.CreatedBy
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias m on m.id=h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			where convert(date,h.CreatedOn) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,h.CreatedOn)<=@FilterEndDate
			and (h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId=@MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMediaCommissionStatementForMISUnpaid]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	
	--@FilterStartDate date,
	--@FilterEndDate date,
	--@MediaId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
		
		DECLARE	@FilterStartDate date
		DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
		DECLARE @MediaId uniqueidentifier
					
					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

					select(
							select * from(

					select 
					 MediaPName,EDate,BillNo,PatientName,TotalCost,isnull(Discount,0)Discount,DueAmount,TReceive, 
					
					isnull(Commission,0)- isnull(Discount,0)  Commission, MediaCode, MediasPhoneNo,Id
					from 
					(

				select 
						MediaPName,
						CONVERT(DATE,EDate)EDate,
						BillNo,
						PatientName,
						------Department,
						isnull(sum(TotalCost),0) TotalCost,
						isnull(sum (Discount),0) Discount,
						isnull(DueAmount,0) DueAmount,
						isnull(sum (PaidAmount),0) TReceive,

						case when Department = 'Diagonistic' then 
						[Diag].[GetAllMarketingCommisionJMOWisePatientID](BillNo,id)
						else
						isnull(sum(Commission),0) end Commission,
						--isnull(
						--case when Department = 'Diagonistic' then 
						--[Diag].[GetAllMarketingCommisionJMOWisePatientID](BillNo,id)
						--else
						--isnull(sum(Commission),0) end
						--,0) - isnull(sum (Discount),0)   PayableAmount,

						--isnull (sum (DueCollection),0) DueCollection,
						--isnull(sum (PaidAmount),0) + isnull(sum (DueCollection),0)+isnull(sum(AdvanceCollection),0) NetCollection,

						isnull(MediaCode,'') MediaCode,
						isnull(MediasPhoneNo,'')MediasPhoneNo,
						Id
			
			from 
			(

			select distinct 'Diagonistic' Department,p.InvoiceNo BillNo,p.FullName PatientName,  convert(date,p.EntryDate) EDate,
			m.Name  MediaPName,m.Code MediaCode,m.PhoneNumber MediasPhoneNo,
			
			0 as Commission,
			p.id,
			case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end TotalCost,
			case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end Discount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			case when l.TransactionType =3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,
			0 AdvanceCollection,
			(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers ll where ll.InvestigationInvoiceId = p.id) DueAmount

			from Diag.InvestigationInvoices  p
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails  t on t.InvestigationInvoiceId = p.id
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  m on m.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers  l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=t.InvestigationInvoiceId

			where CONVERT(DATE,p.EntryDate) >=@filterstartDate and 
			CONVERT(DATE,p.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (m.id = @MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and p.IsMediaCommissionPaid=0
			and t.IsCancelApproved <>1



			--union all

			--select distinct 'Hospital', p.InvoiceNo BillNo,p.FullName PatientName,  convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) EDate,
			--m.Name MediaPName,m.Code MediaCode,m.PhoneNumber MediasPhoneNo,
			--p.MediaHonorarium Commission,
			--p.id,
			--case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end Totalcost,
			--case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end Discount,
			--case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			--case when l.TransactionType = 3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,		
			--case when l.TransactionType = 10 then (Credit) end AdvanceCollection,
			--(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll where ll.FinalBillId =  hb.id) DueAmount
			--from 
			--Hospital.IPDPatientRecords  p
			--join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  m on m.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			--join Hospital.FinalBills   hb on hb.IPDPatientRecordId = p.id
			--join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers  l on l.FinalBillId = hb.Id

			--where CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@filterstartDate and CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			--and (m.id = @MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and p.IsMediaCommissionPaid=0
			)T
			GROUP BY t.id,EDate,MediaPName,BillNo,PatientName,
						Department,t.DueAmount,MediaCode,MediasPhoneNo
			)TT
						
				
				) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END

			and t.IsCancelApproved <>1



			union all

			select distinct 'Hospital' Department, p.InvoiceNo BillNo,p.FullName PatientName,  convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) EDate,
			m.Name MediaPName,m.Code MediaCode,m.PhoneNumber MediasPhoneNo,
			p.MediaHonorarium Commission,
			p.id,
			case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end Totalcost,
			case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end Discount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,		
			case when l.TransactionType = 10 then (Credit) end AdvanceCollection,
			(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll where ll.FinalBillId =  hb.id) DueAmount
			from 
			Hospital.IPDPatientRecords  p
			join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  m on m.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			join Hospital.FinalBills   hb on hb.IPDPatientRecordId = p.id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers  l on l.FinalBillId = hb.Id

			where CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@filterstartDate and CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (m.id = @MediaId or @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and p.IsMediaCommissionPaid=0
			)T
			WHERE Department='Hospital'
			GROUP BY t.id,EDate,MediaPName,BillNo,PatientName,
						Department,t.DueAmount,MediaCode,MediasPhoneNo
						
			)TT
						
				
				) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

-- Author:

-- Description: <Description,,>

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HOD 24.@mmanager 25.@mofficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID

--exec [Account].[SpGetMediaPaidSummary]'04/28/2025,04/28/2025,2025,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,, ,,'

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMediaPaidSummary] @paramas NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''

--@FilterStartDate date,
--@FilterEndDate date,
--@MediaId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @FilterStartDate DATE
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate DATE
	DECLARE @MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

	SELECT
		@FilterStartDate = CONVERT(DATE, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 1
	SELECT
		@FilterEndDate = CONVERT(DATE, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 2
	SELECT
		@MediaId = CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 11

	SELECT
		(
				SELECT
				ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by ReffCode) As SerialNo, 
			   ReffCode AS MediaCode
			   ,ReffName AS MediaName
			   ,ReffPhone AS Phone
			   ,ReffAddress AS Address
			   ,SUM(Commission) Commission
			   ,SUM(T.discount) Discount
			  ,ROUND(SUM(Commission)+SUM(Addition)-SUM(deduction)-SUM(T.discount),2) PaidAmount
			   ,PaidBy
			   ,SUM(Addition) Addition
			   ,SUM(deduction) deduction
			   ,PatientGroup
			FROM (
			SELECT 
					h.id,
					m.Code ReffCode
				   ,m.Name ReffName
				   ,m.PhoneNumber ReffPhone
				   ,m.Address AS ReffAddress
				   ,CONVERT(DATETIME, h.CreatedOn) AS Paydate
				  
				   ,d.Commission AS Commission
				   ,d.PaidAmount AS PaidAmount
				   ,u.UserName AS PaidBy
				   ,0 Addition
				   ,0 deduction
				   ,0 discount
				   ,d.PatientGroup
				FROM Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords h
				JOIN Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails d
					ON h.Id = d.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId
				JOIN [Identity].Users u
					ON u.Id = h.CreatedBy
				JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias m
					ON m.Id = h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
				WHERE CONVERT(DATE, h.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
				AND CONVERT(DATE, h.CreatedOn) <= @FilterEndDate
				AND (h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId = @MediaId
				OR @MediaId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				UNION ALL
				SELECT
				DISTINCT 
				    h.id,
					m.Code ReffCode
				   ,m.Name ReffName
				   ,m.PhoneNumber ReffPhone
				   ,m.Address AS ReffAddress
				   ,CONVERT(DATETIME, h.CreatedOn) AS Paydate
				   ,0 Commission
				   ,0 PaidAmount
				   ,u.UserName AS PaidBy
				   ,h.Addition Addition
				   ,h.Deduction deduction
				   ,h.Discount AS discount
				   ,'Diagonistic' PatientGroup
				FROM Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecords h
				JOIN Account.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordDetails d
					ON h.Id = d.HISandDiagMediaPaymentRecordId
				JOIN [Identity].Users u
					ON u.Id = h.CreatedBy
				JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias m
					ON m.Id = h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
				WHERE CONVERT(DATE, h.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
				AND CONVERT(DATE, h.CreatedOn) <= @FilterEndDate
				AND (h.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId = @MediaId
				OR @MediaId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND D.PatientGroup='Diagonistic'
					) T WHERE PatientGroup='Diagonistic'
			GROUP BY ReffCode
					,ReffName
					,ReffPhone
					,ReffAddress
					,PaidBy
					,PatientGroup
					FOR JSON AUTO)
	AS Data

END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: <Description,,>

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HOD 24.@mmanager 25.@mofficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID

--exec [Account].[SpGetMediaWiseTopContributionReport]'2021-01-15,2025-03-19,2024,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0'

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetMediaWiseTopContributionReport]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

--@FilterStartDate date,
--@FilterEndDate date,
--@MediaId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@FilterStartDate date
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
	DECLARE @MediaID uniqueidentifier
				
				Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
				Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
				Select @MediaID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

Create Table #TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport
(
JMOID uniqueidentifier,
MediaCode nvarchar(max),
MediaFullName nvarchar(max),
Diagnosis float,
Medicine float,
Release float,
Total float
)
				
insert into #TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport
select j.id, j.Code,j.Name,0,0,0,0 
from Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias j


update #TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport set
Diagnosis =
isnull((
select sum(d.Total)
from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
					join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = i.Id
					join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias j on j.id = i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
where convert(date,i.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
and j.Id =#TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport.JMOID  
),0)

update #TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport set
Medicine =
isnull((
select sum(d.TotalAmount)
from Pharmacy.Invoices i
					join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId  = i.Id
					join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords r on r.id = i.IPDPatientRecordId
					join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias j on j.id = r.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
where convert(date, r.DischargedDateTime ) >= @FilterStartDate
and convert(date,r.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
and j.Id =#TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport.JMOID 
),0)


update #TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport set
Release =
isnull((
select sum(s.Amount)
from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords r
					join Hospital.FinalBills f on f.IPDPatientRecordId = r.Id
					join  Hospital.FinalBillSummarys s on s.FinalBillId = f.Id
					join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias j on j.id = r.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
where convert(date, r.DischargedDateTime ) >= @FilterStartDate
and convert(date,r.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
and j.Id =#TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport.JMOID
and (s.SummaryHeadid  <> '4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4' OR
s.SummaryHeadid  <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or s.SummaryHeadid  <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  )
),0)



select (
	select * from(
		select 
		
		isnull(MediaCode,'') MediaCode ,
		isnull(MediaFullName,'') MediaFullName ,
		round(isnull(Diagnosis,0),2)  Diagnosis,
		round(isnull(Medicine,0),2) Medicine,
		round(isnull(Release,0),2) Release ,
		round(isnull(Diagnosis,0)+ isnull(Medicine,0)+isnull(Release,0),2) Total 

		 from #TempMediaWiseTopContributionReport t
		where t.Diagnosis <>0 or t.Medicine <> 0 or t.Release <> 0
	) tbl  order by MediaCode,MediaFullName
				FOR JSON AUTO
				) as Data




					
			
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--exec [Account].[SpGetPettyCashBook] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetPettyCashBook]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 
	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(20) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @CashInHandGLID uniqueidentifier ='BD52240A-D093-4F02-6EF4-08DC73F57D74'
   
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)

	
	Create Table #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
	(
		Autoid Bigint identity(1,1),
		[Date] Date,
		[VoucherCreateDate] datetime,
		[Particulars] nvarchar(max),
		[Debit] float,
		[Credit] float,
		[Balance] float,
		[VoucherNO] nvarchar(max),
		[DisplayAutoid] bigint
	)



	select gm.GeneralLedgerId,n.Id nid,g.Name,bh.id bhid
	into #TempSpGetTrialBalanceReportGeneralLedgerId
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
	join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
	where (bh.id ='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C' or bh.id ='509DC9CD-3CF6-4222-A04C-6C1969A5D5DD')
	and g.Id=@CashInHandGLID
	group by gm.GeneralLedgerId,n.Id,g.Name,bh.id


								



						insert into #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
						([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit])
							select 
							@FilterStartdatePreDate,
							'Opening Balance',
							case 
							when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit])>= sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit])-sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
							when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) < sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit]) - sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
							else 0
							end [OpeningAmountDebit],
							case
							when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit]) < sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
							when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) >= sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
							else 0
							end [OpeningAmountCredit]
							


							
							
							from 
							(

							select tbl.id, tbl.Name ,OpeningAmountDebit,OpeningAmountCredit,DuringPeriodDebit,DuringPeriodCredit,
							OpeningAmountDebit +DuringPeriodDebit [ClosingDebit],
							OpeningAmountCredit + DuringPeriodCredit [ClosingCredit],
							natuarID
							
							from 
							(

									select g.Id,g.Name, sum(debit) OpeningAmountDebit, sum(credit) OpeningAmountCredit, 0 DuringPeriodDebit , 0 DuringPeriodCredit
									,tt.nid natuarID
										from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
									join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
									and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
									join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
									right join #TempSpGetTrialBalanceReportGeneralLedgerId tt on tt.GeneralLedgerId = g.Id
									group by g.Id,g.Name,tt.nid
							
							
							
								) tbl 
								
								
								)
								T
								group by T.Id,T.natuarID,T.Name
								Update #TempSpGetPettyCashBook set
								Balance = [Debit]+[Credit]

								
									

							
							insert into #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
							([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit],[VoucherNO],[VoucherCreateDate])
							select v.PostingDate, gl.Name,0,d.Debit,v.Id,v.CreatedOn
							from Account.VoucherMasters v
							join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id
							join account.GeneralLedgers gl on gl.id = d.GeneralLedgerId
							where v.VoucherNo in 
							(
									select distinct v.VoucherNo from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id	
									where v.VoucherMode ='D' and D.GeneralLedgerId = @CashInHandGLID and d.Credit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

									union all

									select distinct v.VoucherNo from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id	
									where v.VoucherMode ='JV' and D.GeneralLedgerId = @CashInHandGLID and d.Credit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

							)
							and d.GeneralLedgerId <> @CashInHandGLID


							insert into #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
							([Date],[Particulars],[Debit],[Credit],[VoucherNO],[VoucherCreateDate])
							select v.PostingDate, gl.Name,d.Credit,0,v.Id,v.CreatedOn
							from Account.VoucherMasters v
							join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id
							join account.GeneralLedgers gl on gl.id = d.GeneralLedgerId
							where v.VoucherNo in 
							(
									select distinct v.VoucherNo from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id	
									where v.VoucherMode ='C' and D.GeneralLedgerId = @CashInHandGLID and d.Debit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

									union all

									select distinct v.VoucherNo from Account.VoucherMasters v
									join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.VoucherMasterId = v.Id	
									where v.VoucherMode ='JV' and D.GeneralLedgerId = @CashInHandGLID and d.Debit <>0
									and v.PostingDate >=@FilterStartdate
									and v.PostingDate <=@FilterEnddate

							)
							and d.GeneralLedgerId <> @CashInHandGLID
							

DECLARE @AutoID bigint
DECLARE @CurrentRowID bigint
DECLARE @CurrentBalance float
DECLARE @Debit float
DECLARE @Credit float

set @CurrentRowID =0
set @CurrentBalance =0

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR SELECT Autoid,debit,Credit 
        FROM 
       #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
	   order by [Date],[VoucherCreateDate]

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @AutoID,@Debit,@Credit;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        
		set @CurrentBalance = @CurrentBalance + @Debit - @Credit
		set @CurrentRowID = @CurrentRowID +1
		
		update #TempSpGetPettyCashBook set
		DisplayAutoid =@CurrentRowID,
		Balance = @CurrentBalance  
		where Autoid = @AutoID



        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
            @AutoID,@Debit,@Credit;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;




Update #TempSpGetPettyCashBook set
[Date] = DATEADD(day,1,[Date])
where DisplayAutoid =0

insert into #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
([Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO],[DisplayAutoid])
select @FilterEnddate,'Total',0,0,@CurrentBalance,'',@CurrentRowID

--select * from #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
									--return 
select(
	select [Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO] from 
	
	(
		select
		--[Date],[Particulars],[debit],[Credit],[Balance],[VoucherNO]
		*
		from #TempSpGetPettyCashBook
		
		)TT
		order by [DisplayAutoid]
	
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END


GO

--exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossDetailsReport] '04/01/2024,05/20/2024,2024,5,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, , ,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,810914FC-E16C-4275-8687-0859E5EAE2EA,,'
--exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossDetailsReport] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2024,5,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , , , ,810914FC-E16C-4275-8687-0859E5EAE2EA'

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HoD 24.@MManager 25.@MOfficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID 28. GLAccountID


CREATE PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetProfitLossDetailsReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementSubHeadsID uniqueidentifier

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID int=2
	DECLARE @StatementSubRevenueHead uniqueidentifier ='810914FC-E16C-4275-8687-0859E5EAE2EA'
	DECLARE @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead uniqueidentifier ='794B5D44-7B63-4020-BF88-004910DBF67D'
	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	Select @StatementSubHeadsID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=28
	
	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	--insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport


	create table #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)




	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sub.Name [ReportType], g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id =@StatementSubRevenueHead
	and (sub.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id =@StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	and (sub.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 3 [ReportOrderID],'Less '+sub.Name [ReportType],g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note],g.Id ,
	0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id <> @StatementSubRevenueHead and sub.id <> @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	and (sub.id = @StatementSubHeadsID or @StatementSubHeadsID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name

	update #TempProfitLossDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
			where l.Id = #TempProfitLossDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	



	update #TempProfitLossDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			 when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id

				where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterStartdate
				and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempProfitLossDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	select (
	select 
	--@FilterStartdate FilterStartdate,
	--	@FilterEnddate FilterEnddate,
	--	@Year [Year],
	--	@Month [Month],
		--ReportType ,
		Particulars ,
		--[Note] ,
	
		Sum([AmountinTaka]) as TotalAmount
	from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	group by Particulars,ReportOrderID order by ReportOrderID
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	
END
GO

--exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReport] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2024,5,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 



	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='4DBD97D6-38C4-41F3-AC7D-70AC133C08FA'
	DECLARE @StatementSubRevenueHead uniqueidentifier ='810914FC-E16C-4275-8687-0859E5EAE2EA'
	DECLARE @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead uniqueidentifier ='794B5D44-7B63-4020-BF88-004910DBF67D'
	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
	DECLARE @LessNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	--insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport


	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)


	Create table #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float
	)

	create table #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)


	 

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id =@StatementSubRevenueHead
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.id,sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id =@StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 3 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, 'Less '+sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @LessNote [Note], g.Id ,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id <> @StatementSubRevenueHead and sub.id <> @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	update #TempProfitLossDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Level5HeadId = l5.id
			where g.Id = #TempProfitLossDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	



	update #TempProfitLossDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterStartdate
				and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempProfitLossDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select t.ReportOrderID,t.StatementSubHeadID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 2,null StatementSubHeadID,'Gross Profit/ (Loss)'	,Note,sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select t.ReportOrderID,t.StatementSubHeadID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 4 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Operating Profit/ (Loss)' Particular	,'' Note,sum(GrossAmount) - sum(AmountinTaka) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,'Gross Profit/ (Loss)' Particular,'0' note,0 AmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka) GrossAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Gross Profit/ (Loss)'

			union all

			select  t.ReportOrderID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),0  GrossAmount
			from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
			where ReportOrderID =3
			group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note
	)T

	 

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 5,null StatementSubHeadID,'Other Income','',isnull(sum(AmountinTaka),0) AmountinTaka
	from 
	(
	
	select t.ReportOrderID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note
	
	)T


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 6 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Profit/ (Loss) Before Tax' Particular	,'' Note,sum(Operation) - sum(OtherIncomeAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) Operation,0 OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Operating Profit/ (Loss)'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 Operation,sum( AmountinTaka) OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Other Income'
	)T

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 7 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Less: Income tax expenses' Particular	,'' Note,0 [AmountinTaka]
	 
	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 8 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Profit/ (Loss) After Tax' Particular	,'' Note,sum(Beforetax) - sum(OtherIncomeAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) Beforetax,0 OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Net Profit/ (Loss) Before Tax'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 Beforetax,sum( AmountinTaka) OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Less: Income tax expenses'
	)T



	



	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 9 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Less: Generel Reserve' Particular	,'' Note,0 [AmountinTaka]
	
	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 10 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Profit or Loss' Particular	,'' Note,sum(aftertax) - sum(OtherGeneralAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) aftertax,0 OtherGeneralAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Net Profit/ (Loss) After Tax'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 aftertax,sum( AmountinTaka) OtherGeneralAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Less: Generel Reserve'
	)T
	
	
	
	--===============================   Retained Earnings  ===============================--
	

	

	Create table #TempSpGetProfitLossReportTB
	(
		FilterStartDate date,
		FilterEndDate date,
		[Year] int,
		[Month] int,

		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float
	)

	DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max) =''
	set @Query = '   insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReportTB exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings] '''+@FilterSoftwareStartDate+','+convert(nvarchar(20),@FilterStartdatePreDate)+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'''

	exec( @Query)
	
	DECLARE @RetainedEarnings float

	select @RetainedEarnings = sum([AmountinTaka])   from  #TempSpGetProfitLossReportTB
	where Particulars ='Total Profit or Loss'


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 11 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Previous Total Profit or Loss' Particular	,'' Note,@RetainedEarnings [AmountinTaka]

	
	--======================================  Retained Earnings   ========================--


	select (
	select 
	
		@FilterStartdate FilterStartdate,
		@FilterEnddate FilterEnddate,
		@Year [Year],
		@Month [Month],
		Particulars ,
		StatementSubHeadID,
		--'exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossDetailsReport] '''+@FilterStartValue+','+@FilterEndValue+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,'+convert(nvarchar(40),StatementSubHeadID)+''''
		--reportlink 
		case
		when StatementSubHeadID is null then ''
		else 'Details'end as [Note] ,

	
		[AmountinTaka] 
	from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
	order by ReportOrderID
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings]] '2024-05-1,2024-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 

	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='4DBD97D6-38C4-41F3-AC7D-70AC133C08FA'--int=2
	DECLARE @StatementSubRevenueHead uniqueidentifier ='810914FC-E16C-4275-8687-0859E5EAE2EA'
	DECLARE @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead uniqueidentifier ='794B5D44-7B63-4020-BF88-004910DBF67D'
	DECLARE @RevenueNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
	DECLARE @LessNote nvarchar(max) ='Details'
   DECLARE @StatementDepreciationHeadName nvarchar(max) ='Less Depreciation Expenses'
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	--insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)


	Create table #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float
	)

	create table #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	(
		ReportOrderID int,
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		id uniqueidentifier,
		[NatuarofAccount] int,
		[AmountinTaka] float

	)


	 

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 1 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id =@StatementSubRevenueHead
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 2 [ReportOrderID],sub.id,sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @RevenueNote [Note], g.Id,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id =@StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	insert into #TempProfitLossDetailsReport
	select 3 [ReportOrderID],sub.id, 'Less '+sub.Name [ReportType],  g.Name [Particulars], @LessNote [Note], g.Id ,0 [NatuarofAccount], 0 [AmountinTaka]
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	where bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsRevenuID and sub.id <> @StatementSubRevenueHead and sub.id <> @StatementSubOtherIncomeHead
	group by g.Name ,  g.Id,sub.Name,sub.id

	update #TempProfitLossDetailsReport set
	[NatuarofAccount]=
	(
			select  n.id
			from [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Level5HeadId = l5.id
			where g.Id = #TempProfitLossDetailsReport.id
			group by n.id
	)
	



	update #TempProfitLossDetailsReport set
	[AmountinTaka] =
	isnull((
		select sum(Amount) from 
		(
			select 
			case when t.ReportType =@StatementDepreciationHeadName then 0
			when t.[NatuarofAccount] =1 or t.[NatuarofAccount] =4 then  sum(debit)  -sum(credit) 
			else sum(credit)  -sum(debit) end Amount
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
				join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
				join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
				join #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t on t.id = g.Id
				where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterStartdate
				and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
				and #TempProfitLossDetailsReport.id = g.Id
				group by t.[NatuarofAccount],t.ReportType
			)T
	),0)

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select t.ReportOrderID,t.StatementSubHeadID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 2,null StatementSubHeadID,'Gross Profit/ (Loss)'	,Note,sum(AmountinTaka)
	from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where ReportOrderID =1
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select t.ReportOrderID,t.StatementSubHeadID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =3
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note,t.StatementSubHeadID

	

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 4 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Operating Profit/ (Loss)' Particular	,'' Note,sum(GrossAmount) - sum(AmountinTaka) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,'Gross Profit/ (Loss)' Particular,'0' note,0 AmountinTaka,sum(AmountinTaka) GrossAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Gross Profit/ (Loss)'

			union all

			select  t.ReportOrderID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka),0  GrossAmount
			from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
			where ReportOrderID =3
			group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note
	)T

	 

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 5,null StatementSubHeadID,'Other Income','',isnull(sum(AmountinTaka),0) AmountinTaka
	from 
	(
	
	select t.ReportOrderID,ReportType Particulars ,t.Note,sum(AmountinTaka) AmountinTaka from #TempProfitLossDetailsReport t
	where t.ReportOrderID =2
	group by  t.ReportType,t.ReportOrderID,t.Note
	
	)T


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 6 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Profit/ (Loss) Before Tax' Particular	,'' Note,sum(Operation) - sum(OtherIncomeAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) Operation,0 OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Operating Profit/ (Loss)'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 Operation,sum( AmountinTaka) OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Other Income'
	)T

	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 7 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Less: Income tax expenses' Particular	,'' Note,0 [AmountinTaka]
	
	
	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 8 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Net Profit/ (Loss) After Tax' Particular	,'' Note,sum(Beforetax) - sum(OtherIncomeAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) Beforetax,0 OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Net Profit/ (Loss) Before Tax'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 Beforetax,sum( AmountinTaka) OtherIncomeAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Less: Income tax expenses'
	)T


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 9 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Less: Generel Reserve' Particular	,'' Note,0 [AmountinTaka]
	
	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 10 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Profit or Loss' Particular	,'' Note,sum(aftertax) - sum(OtherGeneralAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) aftertax,0 OtherGeneralAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Net Profit/ (Loss) After Tax'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 aftertax,sum( AmountinTaka) OtherGeneralAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Less: Generel Reserve'
	)T

	

	/*
		--===============================   Retained Earnings  ===============================--
	

	

	Create table #TempSpGetProfitLossReportTB
	(
		FilterStartDate date,
		FilterEndDate date,
		[Year] int,
		[Month] int,

		Particulars nvarchar(max),
		StatementSubHeadID uniqueidentifier,
		[Note] nvarchar(max),
		[AmountinTaka] float
	)

	DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max) =''
	set @Query = '   insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReportTB exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings] '''+@FilterSoftwareStartDate+','+convert(nvarchar(20),@FilterStartdatePreDate)+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'''

	exec( @Query)
	
	DECLARE @RetainedEarnings float

	select @RetainedEarnings = sum([AmountinTaka])   from  #TempSpGetProfitLossReportTB
	where Particulars ='Total Profit or Loss'


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 11 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Profit or Loss' Particular	,'' Note,@RetainedEarnings [AmountinTaka]

	
	--======================================  Retained Earnings   ========================--


	insert into #TempSpGetProfitLossReport
	select 13 ReportType,null StatementSubHeadID,'Total Profit or Loss' Particular	,'' Note,sum(CurrentAmount) + sum(PreviousAmount) [AmountinTaka]
	from 
	(
		
			select 0 ReportOrderID,sum( AmountinTaka) CurrentAmount,0 PreviousAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Current Total Profit or Loss'

			union all

			select 0 ReportOrderID,0 CurrentAmount,sum( AmountinTaka) PreviousAmount
			from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
			where t.Particulars ='Previous Total Profit or Loss'
	)T
	*/

	--select (
	select 
	
		@FilterStartdate FilterStartdate,
		@FilterEnddate FilterEnddate,
		@Year [Year],
		@Month [Month],
		Particulars ,
		StatementSubHeadID,
		--'exec [Account].[SpGetProfitLossDetailsReport] '''+@FilterStartValue+','+@FilterEndValue+','+@Year+','+@Month+',00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,'+convert(nvarchar(40),StatementSubHeadID)+''''
		--reportlink 
		case
		when StatementSubHeadID is null then ''
		else 'Details'end as [Note] ,

	
		[AmountinTaka] 
	from #TempSpGetProfitLossReport t
	order by ReportOrderID
	--FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	
END


GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:Alamin Kibria
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: <Description,,>

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HOD 24.@mmanager 25.@mofficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID

--exec [Account].[SpGetRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetDetails]'2021-01-15,2025-03-19,2024,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0'

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetDetails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@FilterStartDate date
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
	DECLARE @RadiologistID uniqueidentifier
				
				Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
				Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
				Select @RadiologistID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

											select 
											 d.DoctorCodeNo as DoctorCode, d.Name DoctorName,rd.PatientID,i.id,
											sum(rd.ReportingFee) as GetDoctor, sum(r.Addition) as Addition, sum(r.Deduction) as deduction,
											convert(date,r.PaymentDate) as InvDate,r.InvoiceNo as InvoiceNo,
											isnull((
												select sum(Total-Discount) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id  
												join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rdd on rdd.TestItemId = id.TestItemId
												where  id.InvestigationInvoiceId = i.id  and rdd.id  = rd.id
											),0) TotalActual,
											rd.id FeePaymentRecordDetailsID
											into #TempRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetDetails
											from Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r
												join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on r.id=rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId
												join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId
												join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i  on i.Id = rd.PatientID
												
											where convert(date,r.PaymentDate) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,r.PaymentDate)<=@FilterEndDate
												and (r.DoctorId=@RadiologistID or @RadiologistID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
											group by d.DoctorCodeNo,d.Name,rd.PatientID,i.id,convert(date,r.PaymentDate) ,r.InvoiceNo ,rd.id 

											--select * from #TempRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetDetails return
											select(
											select DoctorCode,DoctorName,InvDate,InvoiceNo,Code,[Description], Total, [Less] ,Actual
											,TotalActual,TotalGetDoctor,GetDoctor
											from(

											select DoctorCode,DoctorName,InvDate,InvoiceNo, 
											isnull(i.TestCode,'') as Code,
											i.Name as Description, id.Total as Total,id.Discount [Less],
											isnull(id.Total,0) - isnull(id.Discount,0) as Actual,TotalActual,GetDoctor TotalGetDoctor,
											round((GetDoctor*(isnull(id.Total,0) - isnull(id.Discount,0)))/ TotalActual,2) GetDoctor
											from #TempRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetDetails t
											join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on rd.id = t.FeePaymentRecordDetailsID
											join  Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId = t.id and rd.testitemid = id.TestItemId
											join Diag.TestItems i on i.id=id.TestItemId
											) tbl 
												order by tbl.DoctorName
												FOR JSON AUTO
												) as Data
											return 




				select(
						select * from(


							select 
										distinct DoctorCode,DoctorName, InvDate,InvoiceNo,Code,Description,
										isnull(Total,0) Total, isnull(Less,0) Less , isnull(Total,0) - isnull(Less,0) as Actual, 
										isnull(ReportingFee,0) + isnull(Addition,0) - isnull(deduction,0) GetDoctor
									
									from 
									(
									select 
											 d.DoctorCodeNo as DoctorCode, d.Name DoctorName, convert(date,r.PaymentDate) as InvDate,r.InvoiceNo as InvoiceNo,isnull(t.TestCode,'') as Code,
											rd.TestName as Description, id.Total as Total, --[Diag].[Get_Discount_BaseOn_TestID_PatientID](id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.Total) 
											id.Discount [Less] ,
											rd.ReportingFee as ReportingFee, r.Addition as Addition, r.Deduction as deduction


											from Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r
												join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on r.id=rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId
												join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId
												join Diag.TestItems t on t.id=rd.TestItemId
												join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.InvoiceNo = rd.BillNo
												join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.TestItemId=rd.TestItemId and i.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId

												--join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
												--join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.TestItemId=rd.TestItemId  
												
												--join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i  on i.id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
											--from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i  
											--join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.id
											--join  Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
											--join Diag.TestItems t on t.id=id.TestItemId
											--join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on rd.TestItemId=t.id
											--join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r on r.id=rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId
											--join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId

											where convert(date,r.PaymentDate) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,r.PaymentDate)<=@FilterEndDate
												and (r.DoctorId=@RadiologistID or @RadiologistID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


								)T
								--order By t.InvoiceNo

										--select 
										--	d.DoctorCodeNo as DoctorCode, d.Name DoctorName, convert(date,r.PaymentDate) as InvDate,r.InvoiceNo as InvoiceNo,isnull(t.TestCode,'') as Code,
										--	rd.TestName as Description, t.Rate as Total 
										--	--case when l.TransactionType=
										--	from Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r
										--		join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId=r.Id
										--		left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=rd.PatientId
										--		left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
										--		left join Diag.TestItems t on t.id=id.TestItemId
										--		join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId

										
								
								



			) tbl 
			order by tbl.InvoiceNo
			FOR JSON AUTO
						) as Data
END
GO

-- Author:Alamin Kibria

--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID

--exec [Account].[SpGetRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetSummary]'2021-01-15,2025-03-19,2024,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0'

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetSummary]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@FilterStartDate date
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
	DECLARE @RadiologistID uniqueidentifier
				
				Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
				Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
				Select @RadiologistID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

										
						
											select 
											 d.DoctorCodeNo as DoctorCode, d.Name DoctorName,rd.PatientID,i.id,
											sum(rd.ReportingFee) as GetDoctor, sum(r.Addition) as Addition, sum(r.Deduction) as deduction
											into #TempRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetSummary
											from Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r
												join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on r.id=rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId
												join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId
												join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i  on i.Id = rd.PatientID
												--join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId =i.id
												--join Diag.TestItems t on t.id=rd.TestItemId

											where convert(date,r.PaymentDate) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,r.PaymentDate)<=@FilterEndDate
												and (r.DoctorId=@RadiologistID or @RadiologistID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

											group by d.DoctorCodeNo,d.Name,rd.PatientID,i.id

										select(
										select * from(

											select DoctorName,sum(GetDoctor) GetDoctor from #TempRadiologyConsultantPaymentSheetSummary 
											group by DoctorName
											) tbl 
												order by tbl.DoctorName
												FOR JSON AUTO
												) as Data

											return 

				--------select(
						select * from(


							select 
										DoctorName, 
										isnull(sum(GetDoctor),0) + isnull(sum(Addition),0) - isnull(sum(deduction),0) GetDoctor
									
									from 
									(
											select 
											 d.DoctorCodeNo as DoctorCode, d.Name DoctorName,
											sum(rd.ReportingFee) as GetDoctor, sum(r.Addition) as Addition, sum(r.Deduction) as deduction


											from Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r
												join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on r.id=rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId
												join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId
												join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i  on i.Id = rd.PatientID
												join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId =i.id
												join Diag.TestItems t on t.id=rd.TestItemId

											where convert(date,r.PaymentDate) >=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,r.PaymentDate)<=@FilterEndDate
												and (r.DoctorId=@RadiologistID or @RadiologistID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

											group by d.DoctorCodeNo,d.Name,rd.PatientID
								)T
								group by t.DoctorName
								--order By t.InvoiceNo

										--select 
										--	d.DoctorCodeNo as DoctorCode, d.Name DoctorName, convert(date,r.PaymentDate) as InvDate,r.InvoiceNo as InvoiceNo,isnull(t.TestCode,'') as Code,
										--	rd.TestName as Description, t.Rate as Total 
										--	--case when l.TransactionType=
										--	from Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecords r
										--		join Account.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordDetails rd on rd.RadiologicalReportingFeePaymentRecordId=r.Id
										--		left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=rd.PatientId
										--		left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
										--		left join Diag.TestItems t on t.id=id.TestItemId
										--		join VWDoctors d on d.id=r.DoctorId

										
								
								



			) tbl 
			order by tbl.DoctorName
			------------FOR JSON AUTO
			------------			) as Data
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetReceiptsAndPayment]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
