GO






--exec [Account].[SpGetReceiptsAndPayment] '2024-03-1,2024-03-30,2024,5,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetReceiptsAndPayment]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 


	Create Table #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
		ReceiptMainHead nvarchar(max),
		ReceiptHead nvarchar(max),
		ReceiptAmount float,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount float,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField int,
		PaymentMainHead nvarchar(max),
		PaymentHead nvarchar(max),
		PaymentAmount float,
		PaymentSummeryAmount float,
		PaymentDisplayBoldField int,
		Receiptstatus int,
		PaymentStatus int
	)

	DECLARE @CashAtBank uniqueIdentifier ='567DA77F-C0CC-4D1A-6ECC-08DC08746240'
	DECLARE @CashinHand  uniqueIdentifier ='E708B25D-E4A9-4649-6ECE-08DC08746240'
	
	Select @FilterStartdate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEnddate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Opening Balance',0,1,1
	union all
	select 'Cash at Bank',0,1,2

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select l.Name,sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit),0,3  from account.Level4Heads l4
	join account.Level5Heads l5 on l5.Level4HeadId = l4.Id
	join account.GeneralLedgers l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
	join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.GeneralLedgerId = l.Id
	join account.VoucherMasters m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	where l4.ID =@CashAtBank 
	and m.DocumentDate <@FilterStartdate
	group by l.Name

	
	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =3
	)
	where  Receiptstatus =2

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Cash in Hand ',0,1,4
	
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select l.Name,sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit),0,5  from account.Level4Heads l4
	join account.Level5Heads l5 on l5.Level4HeadId = l4.Id
	join account.GeneralLedgers l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
	join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.GeneralLedgerId = l.Id
	join account.VoucherMasters m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	where l4.ID =@CashinHand 
	and convert(date,m.DocumentDate) <@FilterStartdate
	group by l.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =5
	)
	where Receiptstatus =4

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =3 or Receiptstatus=5
	)
	where Receiptstatus =1 

--========================= Hospital Service Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Service Revenue',0,1,10
	union all
	select 'Income From Hospital Service',0,1,11

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select sg.Name,sum(Rate),0,12  
	from Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.ServiceSubSubGroupId = sg.Id
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeadRates r on r.ServiceExecutingHeadId = h.Id
	where convert(date, r.CreatedOn) >=@FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, r.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEnddate
	group by sg.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =12
	)
	where Receiptstatus=11
--========================= Hospital Service End ================================--
--========================= Hospital OT Service Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Income From Hospital OT Service',0,1,13

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select sg.Name,sum(Rate),0,14  
	from Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.ServiceSubSubGroupId =sg.Id
	join Hospital.OTServiceDetails D on d.ServiceHeadId = h.Id
	join Hospital.OTServices s on s.Id = d.OTServiceId
	where convert(date, s.ServiceEntryDate) >=@FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, s.ServiceEntryDate) <=@FilterEnddate
	group by sg.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =14
	)
	where Receiptstatus=13
--========================= Hospital OT Service End ================================--

--========================= Hospital IPD Service Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Income From Hospital IPD Service',0,1,15

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select sg.Name,sum(Rate),0,16  
	from Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.ServiceSubSubGroupId =sg.Id
	join Hospital.IPDServiceRecords r on r.ServiceId = h.Id
	where convert(date, r.ServiceDatetime ) >=@FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, r.ServiceDatetime) <=@FilterEnddate
	group by sg.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =16
	)
	where Receiptstatus=15
--========================= Hospital IPD Service End ================================--

--========================= Hospital IPD Service Consultant Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Income From Hospital IPD Consultant Service',0,1,17

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select sg.Name,sum(Rate*Qty),0,18  
	from Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.ServiceSubSubGroupId =sg.Id
	join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices r on r.ServiceId = h.Id
	where convert(date, r.EntryDate ) >=@FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, r.EntryDate) <=@FilterEnddate
	group by sg.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =18
	)
	where Receiptstatus=17
--========================= Hospital IPD Consultant Service End ================================--



--========================= Diagonistic Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Diag Investigation Income',0,1,19

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select tg.Name,sum(d.Rate * d.Qty),0,20  
	from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails d
	join Diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.id = d.InvestigationInvoiceId
	join Diag.TestItems t on t.id = d.TestItemId
	join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.id = t.TestGroupId
	where convert(date, i.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, i.EntryDate) <= @FilterEnddate
	group by tg.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =20
	)
	where Receiptstatus=19

	
--========================= Diagonistic End ================================--

	
--========================= OPD  Emergency  Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'OPD Emergency Income',0,1,21

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select sg.Name,sum(d.Rate * d.Qty),0,22  
	from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices s
	join OPD.ServiceDetails d on d.PatientId = s.Id
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.Id = d.ServiceId
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeadRates r on r.ServiceExecutingHeadId = h.id
	join Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg on sg.ID = h.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	where convert(date, s.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, S.EntryDate) <= @FilterEnddate
	group by sg.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =22
	)
	where Receiptstatus=21

--========================= OPD  Emergency  End ================================--

--========================= OPD  Consultant  Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'OPD Consultant Income',0,1,23

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select v.Name,sum(d.Rate * d.Qty),0,24  
	from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees s
	join OPD.ConsultancyDetails d on d.PatientId = s.Id
	join VWDoctors v on v.Id = d.ServiceId
	where convert(date, s.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, S.EntryDate) <= @FilterEnddate
	group by v.Name
	
	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =24
	)
	where Receiptstatus=23

	
--========================= OPD  Consultant  End ================================--

--========================= OPD  CP(Chamber Practioner)  start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'OPD CP(Chamber Practioner) Income',0,1,25

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select v.Name,sum(d.VisitFee),0,26  
	from OPD.CPPatientRecords s
	join OPD.CPFeeCollectionRecords d on d.CPPatientRecordId = s.Id
	join VWDoctors v on v.Id = d.CPId
	where convert(date, d.VisitDate) >= @FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, d.VisitDate) <= @FilterEnddate
	group by v.Name

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =26
	)
	where Receiptstatus=25
--========================= OPD  CP(Chamber Practioner)  End ================================--


--========================= Pharmacy OPD  Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Pharmacy OPD  Income',0,1,27

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Pharmacy OPD',sum(d.Qty * d.SaleRate),0,28  
	from Pharmacy.Invoices i
	join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
	where convert(date, i.Invdate) >= @FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, i.Invdate) <= @FilterEnddate
	and i.IPDPatientRecordId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	
	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =28
	)
	where Receiptstatus=27
--========================= Pharmacy OPD  End ================================--
--========================= Pharmacy IPD  Start ================================--
	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Pharmacy IPD Income',0,1,29

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptHead,
		ReceiptAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Pharmacy IPD',sum(d.Qty * d.SaleRate),0,30  
	from Pharmacy.Invoices i
	join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
	where convert(date, i.Invdate) >= @FilterStartdate
	and convert(date, i.Invdate) <= @FilterEnddate
	and i.IPDPatientRecordId <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =30
	)
	where Receiptstatus=29
--========================= Pharmacy IPD  End ================================--

update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment 
		where Receiptstatus =12  or Receiptstatus =14 or Receiptstatus =16 or Receiptstatus =18 or Receiptstatus =20
		or Receiptstatus =22 or Receiptstatus =24  or Receiptstatus =26 or Receiptstatus =28 or Receiptstatus =30
 	)
	where Receiptstatus=10

	insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	(
		ReceiptMainHead,
		ReceiptSummeryAmount,
		ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
		[Receiptstatus]
	)
	select 'Total Receive',0,1,21

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	(
		select sum(ReceiptSummeryAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where  Receiptstatus =1 or Receiptstatus =10	
 	)
	where Receiptstatus=21
	
	
	
	
	DECLARE 
    @LedgerName VARCHAR(MAX),
	@Level5HeadName VARCHAR(MAX),
    @GeneralLedgersId   UniqueIdentifier,
	@Amount float,
	@TempReceiveAutoID bigint,
	@MaxReceiveAutoID bigint,
	@PaymentMainHead nvarchar(max)='',
	@PaymentMainHeadAmount float =0,
	@IsPaymentMainHead int =0,
	@TotalAmount float =0,
	@PreviousPaymentMainHead nvarchar(max) ='';


	select @TempReceiveAutoID= min(Autoid) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	select @MaxReceiveAutoID= max(Autoid) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentMainHead='Cost Of Revenue'
	where Autoid =@TempReceiveAutoID
	set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1


	DECLARE cursor_Payment CURSOR
	FOR 
	select g.Name,l5.name,
	sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit),g.Id
	from 
	 [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g 
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
	join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
	join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on d.GeneralLedgerId = g.Id
	join [Account].[VoucherMasters] m on m.id = d.VoucherMasterId
 	where n.id = 4
	and m.DocumentDate >= @FilterStartdate
	and m.DocumentDate <=@FilterEnddate
	group by g.Name,l5.Name,g.Id;

	OPEN cursor_Payment;

	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Payment INTO 
		@LedgerName, 
		@Level5HeadName,
		@Amount,
		@GeneralLedgersId;

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			set @TotalAmount = @TotalAmount + @Amount

			IF @PaymentMainHead =  @Level5HeadName
			BEGIN 
				set @IsPaymentMainHead = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				set @IsPaymentMainHead =1
			END 

			IF @TempReceiveAutoID <= @MaxReceiveAutoID and @IsPaymentMainHead =0
			BEGIN 
				Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
				PaymentHead =  @LedgerName ,
				PaymentAmount = @Amount,
				PaymentDisplayBoldField =0
				where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1

				Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
				PaymentSummeryAmount =  PaymentSummeryAmount +@Amount
				where PaymentMainHead = @Level5HeadName


				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1

				
			END
			Else IF @TempReceiveAutoID <= @MaxReceiveAutoID and @IsPaymentMainHead =1
			BEGIN 
				
				

				Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
				PaymentMainHead = @Level5HeadName,
				PaymentAmount = 0,
				PaymentSummeryAmount = @Amount,
				PaymentDisplayBoldField =1
				where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID

				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1

				Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
				PaymentHead =  @LedgerName ,
				PaymentAmount = @Amount,
				PaymentDisplayBoldField =0
				where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID
				
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1
				

				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment 
				(PaymentMainHead,PaymentHead,PaymentAmount)
				values(@Level5HeadName,@LedgerName,@Amount)
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1
			END

			

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Payment INTO 
				@LedgerName, 
				@Level5HeadName,
				@Amount,
				@GeneralLedgersId;
		END;

	CLOSE cursor_Payment;

	DEALLOCATE cursor_Payment;


	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentSummeryAmount = @TotalAmount
	where PaymentMainHead ='Cost Of Revenue'


	--====================  Closing Balance Start   ==============================--

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentMainHead  ='Closing Balance'
	where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID

	set @TempReceiveAutoID = @TempReceiveAutoID +1

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentMainHead  ='Cash at Bank'
	where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID

	set @TempReceiveAutoID = @TempReceiveAutoID +1
	set @TotalAmount =0
	
		

	DECLARE cursor_Payment_Bank CURSOR
	FOR 
	select l.Name,sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit)  from account.Level4Heads l4
	join account.Level5Heads l5 on l5.Level4HeadId = l4.Id
	join account.GeneralLedgers l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
	join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.GeneralLedgerId = l.Id
	join account.VoucherMasters m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	where l4.ID =@CashAtBank 
	and m.DocumentDate <=@FilterEnddate
	group by l.Name;

	OPEN cursor_Payment_Bank;

	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Payment_Bank INTO 
		@LedgerName, 
		@Amount;

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			set @TotalAmount = @TotalAmount + @Amount

			IF @TempReceiveAutoID <= @MaxReceiveAutoID 
			BEGIN 
				Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
				PaymentHead =  @LedgerName ,
				PaymentAmount = @Amount,
				PaymentDisplayBoldField =0
				where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1
								
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment 
				(PaymentMainHead,PaymentHead,PaymentAmount)
				values(@Level5HeadName,@LedgerName,@Amount)
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1
			END

			

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Payment_Bank INTO 
			@LedgerName, 
			@Amount;

		END;

	CLOSE cursor_Payment_Bank;

	DEALLOCATE cursor_Payment_Bank;

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentSummeryAmount = @TotalAmount
	where PaymentMainHead ='Cash at Bank' or PaymentMainHead ='Closing Balance'


	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentMainHead  ='Cash In Hand'
	where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID

	set @TempReceiveAutoID = @TempReceiveAutoID +1
	set @TotalAmount =0
	
		

	DECLARE cursor_Payment_Cash CURSOR
	FOR 
	select l.Name,sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit)  from account.Level4Heads l4
	join account.Level5Heads l5 on l5.Level4HeadId = l4.Id
	join account.GeneralLedgers l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
	join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.GeneralLedgerId = l.Id
	join account.VoucherMasters m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	where l4.ID =@CashinHand 
	and m.DocumentDate <=@FilterEnddate
	
	group by l.Name;

	OPEN cursor_Payment_Cash;

	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Payment_Cash INTO 
		@LedgerName, 
		@Amount;

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			set @TotalAmount = @TotalAmount + @Amount

			IF @TempReceiveAutoID <= @MaxReceiveAutoID 
			BEGIN 
				Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
				PaymentHead =  @LedgerName ,
				PaymentAmount = @Amount,
				PaymentDisplayBoldField =0
				where Autoid = @TempReceiveAutoID
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1
								
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment 
				(PaymentMainHead,PaymentHead,PaymentAmount)
				values(@Level5HeadName,@LedgerName,@Amount)
				set @TempReceiveAutoID =@TempReceiveAutoID +1
			END

			

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Payment_Cash INTO 
			@LedgerName, 
			@Amount;

		END;

	CLOSE cursor_Payment_Cash;

	DEALLOCATE cursor_Payment_Cash;

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentSummeryAmount = @TotalAmount
	where PaymentMainHead ='Cash In Hand'

	update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentSummeryAmount = PaymentSummeryAmount + @TotalAmount
	where PaymentMainHead ='Closing Balance'


	IF @TempReceiveAutoID <= @MaxReceiveAutoID
	BEGIN
		
		update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
		PaymentMainHead = 'Total Payment'
		where Autoid = @MaxReceiveAutoID
	END 

	Update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	PaymentSummeryAmount = 
	(
		select sum(PaymentSummeryAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment  tt  where tt.PaymentMainHead ='Cost Of Revenue' or tt.PaymentMainHead ='Closing Balance'
	)
	where PaymentMainHead = 'Total Payment'

	--insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	--(
	--	ReceiptHead,
	--	ReceiptAmount,
	--	ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
	--	[Receiptstatus]
	--)
	--select l.Name,sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit),0,3  from account.Level4Heads l4
	--join account.Level5Heads l5 on l5.Level4HeadId = l4.Id
	--join account.GeneralLedgers l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
	--join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.GeneralLedgerId = l.Id
	--join account.VoucherMasters m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	--where l4.ID =@CashAtBank 
	--and m.DocumentDate <@FilterStartdate
	--group by l.Name

	--update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	--ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	--(
	--	select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =3
	--)
	--where  Receiptstatus =2

	--insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	--(
	--	ReceiptMainHead,
	--	ReceiptSummeryAmount,
	--	ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
	--	[Receiptstatus]
	--)
	--select 'Cash in Hand ',0,1,4
	
	--insert into #TempReceiptsAndPayment
	--(
	--	ReceiptHead,
	--	ReceiptAmount,
	--	ReceiptDisplayBloadField,
	--	[Receiptstatus]
	--)
	--select l.Name,sum(d.Debit) - sum(d.Credit),0,5  from account.Level4Heads l4
	--join account.Level5Heads l5 on l5.Level4HeadId = l4.Id
	--join account.GeneralLedgers l on l.Level5HeadId = l5.Id
	--join account.VoucherMasterDetails d on d.GeneralLedgerId = l.Id
	--join account.VoucherMasters m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	--where l4.ID =@CashinHand 
	--and convert(date,m.DocumentDate) <@FilterStartdate
	--group by l.Name

	--update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	--ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	--(
	--	select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =5
	--)
	--where Receiptstatus =4

	--update #TempReceiptsAndPayment set
	--ReceiptSummeryAmount=
	--(
	--	select sum(ReceiptAmount) from #TempReceiptsAndPayment where Receiptstatus =3 or Receiptstatus=5

	--====================  Closing Balance End     ============================--

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetSubLedgerReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec [Account].[SpGetSubLedgerReport] '2024-06-1,2024-06-30,2024,6,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , , , ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,E8CEEAF8-8374-47EE-F3AE-08DCBF6FE07C'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId
--28.GLAccountId 29.SubLedgerID

CREATE PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetSubLedgerReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 
    DECLARE @SubLedgerId uniqueidentifier
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
	Select @SubLedgerId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=29

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(max) ='2000-1-1'
	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddateAfterDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)
	select @FilterEnddateAfterDate = DATEADD(Day,1,@FilterEnddate)


	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD int=1
	DECLARE @StatementBroadHeadsOwnersEquity int=6
	DECLARE @StatementFixedLongTermAssets uniqueidentifier ='9B984B78-8D08-4C59-B09B-0C9DEDC8DF6F'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentAssetAssets uniqueidentifier ='996EE725-6545-4A12-B371-982B25280774F'
	DECLARE @StatementShareHolderEquity   uniqueidentifier ='2D8779CB-748F-4049-A5A2-FE507FAC7BF9'
	DECLARE @StatementLongTermLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='AC0BA7DB-1CCB-4B27-8FF2-66CF2DF81649'
	DECLARE @StatementCurrentLiabilities uniqueidentifier ='0BD41D44-993A-42D4-A133-8B9F0F071A98'

	
	

	select @FilterStartdatePreDate [Date], NName NName ,NID Id, Particulars,'Opening Balance' [ReportType],sum(AmountDebit) AmountDebit ,sum(AmountCredit) AmountCredit,
	case when NID=1 or NID =4 then sum(AmountDebit) - sum(AmountCredit)
	else sum(AmountCredit) - sum(AmountDebit) end [Balance], gid ,getdate() To_Date
	into #TempLedger
	from 
	(
	
			select n.Name NName ,n.Id NID,g.Name Particulars,'Opening Balance' [ReportType],debit AmountDebit ,credit AmountCredit,
			case when n.Id=1 or n.id =4 then debit - credit
			else credit - debit end [Balance],d.SubLedgerId gid,getdate() To_Date
			from 
			[Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
			join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
			join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
			join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
			join [Account].[VoucherMasters] m on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
			join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
			join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
			join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
			join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
			join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
			join [Account].[SubLedgers] sl on sl.Id = d.SubLedgerId
			where 
			(
				(bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementFixedLongTermAssets)
				or
				(bh.Id =@StatementBroadHeadsBalanceSheetD and sub.id =@StatementCurrentAssetAssets)
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementShareHolderEquity )
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementLongTermLiabilities)
				or
				(sub.Id =@StatementCurrentLiabilities)
		
			)
			and 
			(d.GeneralLedgerId=@SubLedgerId or @SubLedgerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			
			union all

			select null NName ,null NID,sl.Name Particulars,'Opening Balance' [ReportType],0 AmountDebit ,0 AmountCredit,
			0 [Balance],sl.Id gid,getdate() To_Date
			from 
			[Account].[SubLedgers] sl
			where sl.Id = @SubLedgerId

		)T
		group by T.NName,NId,Particulars,gId

		

		

	select convert(date,m.PostingDate) [Date],n.Name ,n.Id,g.Name+' Voucher No : '+convert(nvarchar(50),isnull(m.VoucherNo,'') ) + isnull(m.Note,'') Particulars,''[ReportType],sum(debit) AmountDebit ,sum(credit) AmountCredit,
	case when n.Id=1 or n.id =4 then sum(debit) - sum(credit)
	else sum(credit) - sum(debit) end [Balance],d.SubLedgerId GID,m.CreatedOn
	into #TempLedgerDetails
	from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
	join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
	join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
 	where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterStartdate
	and   convert(date,m.PostingDate)<=@FilterEnddate and (d.SubLedgerId=@SubLedgerId or @SubLedgerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by convert(date,m.PostingDate),n.Name,n.Id,g.Name,d.SubLedgerId,m.Id,m.VoucherNo,m.Note,m.CreatedOn
	order by m.CreatedOn
	
	update #TempLedger set
	Id =
	(
	select distinct ID from #TempLedgerDetails
	)
	update #TempLedger set
	NName =
	(
	select distinct Name from #TempLedgerDetails
	)

	

	update #TempLedgerDetails set
	[Balance] =
	isnull((
		select tt.Balance from #TempLedger tt
		where tt.GID =#TempLedgerDetails.GID
	),0)
	+
	isnull(
		(select sum(tt.Balance) from #TempLedgerDetails tt
		where tt.GID =#TempLedgerDetails.GID
		and tt.CreatedOn <=#TempLedgerDetails.CreatedOn)
	,0)

	
	
	

	select 
	 @FilterEnddateAfterDate [Date],Particulars Name ,Id,Particulars,'CLosing Balance' [ReportType],0 AmountDebit ,0 AmountCredit,
	0[Balance],gid,getdate() To_Date
	into #TempClosingBalance
	from #TempLedger t 

	


	update #TempClosingBalance set
	AmountDebit =
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountDebit) from #TempLedger t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0),
	AmountCredit =
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountCredit) from #TempLedger t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0),
	Balance =
		isnull((
			select sum(Balance) from #TempLedger t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0)

		


	update #TempClosingBalance set
	AmountDebit = AmountDebit+ 
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountDebit) from #TempLedgerDetails t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0),
	AmountCredit = AmountCredit+
		isnull((
			select sum(AmountCredit) from #TempLedgerDetails t where t.gid = #TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0)

		

		update #TempClosingBalance set
		Balance=
		isnull((
			select case when id =1 or id=4 then AmountDebit -AmountCredit 
			else AmountCredit- AmountDebit end Amount
			from #TempClosingBalance tt
			where tt.gid =#TempClosingBalance.gid
		),0)

		 

		select( 
select * from (
	select [Date],Particulars,[ReportType],AmountDebit,AmountCredit,[Balance]
	from 
	(
	select * from #TempLedger t 
	union all
	select * from #TempLedgerDetails
	union all 
	select * from #TempClosingBalance
	
	)T
	
		) tbl order by tbl.Date,tbl.Particulars FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Account].[SpGetTrialBalanceReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec [Account].[SpGetTrialBalanceReport] '2024-05-1,2026-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId, 23. PatientId

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Account].[SpGetTrialBalanceReport]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year nvarchar(4),
	@Month  nvarchar(2)

	DECLARE @FilterStartValue nvarchar(20) 
	DECLARE @FilterEndValue  nvarchar(20) 

	DECLARE @FilterStartdate date 
	DECLARE @FilterEnddate  date 
	DECLARE @FilterSoftwareStartDate nvarchar(20) ='2000-1-1'
   
	
	Select @FilterStartValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndValue=  Convert(nvarchar(20),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @Year=  Convert(nvarchar(4),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(nvarchar(2),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	IF isnull(@FilterStartValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterStartValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =(convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterStartDate =convert(date,@FilterStartValue)
	END
	
	IF isnull(@FilterEndValue,'')='' or len(rtrim(ltrim(@FilterEndValue))) =0  
	BEGIN
	print 2
		select @FilterEnddate =EOMONTH (convert(date,@year+'-'+@Month+'-1'))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @FilterEnddate =convert(date,@FilterEndValue)
	END

	DECLARE @FilterStartdatePreDate date 
	select @FilterStartdatePreDate = DATEADD(Day,-1,@FilterStartdate)

	


	select gm.GeneralLedgerId,n.Id,g.Name,bh.id bhid
	into #TempSpGetTrialBalanceReportGeneralLedgerId
	from [Account].[GLMappingWithStatements] gm  
	join [Account].[StatementSubHeads] sub on sub.Id = gm.StatementSubHeadId
	join [account].[StatementBroadHeads] bh on bh.Id = sub.StatementBroadHeadId
	join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = gm.GeneralLedgerId
	join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
	join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
	join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
	join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
	join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
	where bh.id ='3BD08065-2A27-4EB6-9062-43F8DD83A66C' or bh.id ='509DC9CD-3CF6-4222-A04C-6C1969A5D5DD' 
	group by gm.GeneralLedgerId,n.Id,g.Name,bh.id

	
	--===============================   Retained Earnings  ===============================--
	
	DECLARE @RetainedEarnings float
	DECLARE @RetainedEarningsForRunning  float =0
	select  @RetainedEarnings = [Account].[fnGetProfitLossReportRetainedEarnings](@FilterSoftwareStartDate,@FilterStartdatePreDate)
	
	--======================================  Retained Earnings   ========================--

	
	select(
	select * from 
	(
	select null Id,'Retained Earnings' Name,0 OpeningAmountDebit, isnull(@RetainedEarnings,0) OpeningAmountCredit, 0 DuringPeriodDebit ,isnull(@RetainedEarningsForRunning,0) DuringPeriodCredit,0 ClosingDebit,isnull(@RetainedEarnings,0)  + isnull(@RetainedEarningsForRunning,0) ClosingCredit

	union all 
	select id,Name,sum(OpeningAmountDebit) OpeningAmountDebit,sum(OpeningAmountCredit) OpeningAmountCredit,sum(DuringPeriodDebit) DuringPeriodDebit,
	sum(DuringPeriodCredit) DuringPeriodCredit,
	case 
	when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit])>= sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit])-sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
	when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) < sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit]) - sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
	else 0
	end [ClosingDebit],
	case
	when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit]) < sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
	when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) >= sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
	else 0
	end [ClosingCredit]
	from 
	(

	select tbl.id, tbl.Name ,OpeningAmountDebit,OpeningAmountCredit,DuringPeriodDebit,DuringPeriodCredit,
	OpeningAmountDebit +DuringPeriodDebit [ClosingDebit],
	OpeningAmountCredit + DuringPeriodCredit [ClosingCredit],
	n.Id natuarID
	
	from 
	(
			
			
			
								

							select id,Name,
							case 
							when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit])>= sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit])-sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
							when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) < sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingDebit]) - sum([ClosingCredit]),0)
							else 0
							end [OpeningAmountDebit],
							case
							when (T.natuarID =1 or T.natuarID =4) and (sum([ClosingDebit]) < sum([ClosingCredit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
							when (T.natuarID <>1 or T.natuarID <>4) and (sum([ClosingCredit]) >= sum([ClosingDebit])) then isnull(sum([ClosingCredit]) - sum([ClosingDebit]),0)
							else 0
							end [OpeningAmountCredit],
							0 DuringPeriodDebit,
							0 DuringPeriodCredit
							
							from 
							(

							select tbl.id, tbl.Name ,OpeningAmountDebit,OpeningAmountCredit,DuringPeriodDebit,DuringPeriodCredit,
							OpeningAmountDebit +DuringPeriodDebit [ClosingDebit],
							OpeningAmountCredit + DuringPeriodCredit [ClosingCredit],
							n.Id natuarID
							
							from 
							(

									select g.Id,g.Name, sum(debit) OpeningAmountDebit, sum(credit) OpeningAmountCredit, 0 DuringPeriodDebit , 0 DuringPeriodCredit
									
										from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
									join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
									join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
									
									where convert(date,m.PostingDate) <@FilterStartdate
									group by g.Id,g.Name
							
							
							
								) tbl 
								join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = tbl.Id
								join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
								join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
								join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
								join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
								join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId
								join #TempSpGetTrialBalanceReportGeneralLedgerId tt on tt.GeneralLedgerId = g.Id
								)
								T
								group by T.Id,T.natuarID,T.Name
								

			
						
					
			--=================================   Opening Calculation end ==============================================--
			union all
			select g.Id,g.Name,0 OpeningAmountDebit, 0 OpeningAmountCredit, sum(debit) DuringPeriodDebit ,sum(credit) DuringPeriodCredit
			
				from [Account].[VoucherMasters] m
			join [Account].[VoucherMasterDetails] d on m.Id = d.VoucherMasterId
			join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = d.GeneralLedgerId
			
 			where convert(date,m.PostingDate) >=@FilterStartdate
			and convert(date,m.PostingDate) <=@FilterEnddate
			group by g.Id,g.Name


				
	
	
		) tbl 
		join [Account].[GeneralLedgers] g on g.Id = tbl.Id
		join [Account].[Level5Heads] l5 on l5.Id = g.Level5HeadId
		join [Account].[Level4Heads] l4 on l4.Id = l5.Level4HeadId
		join [Account].[SubCategories] sc on sc.Id = l4.SubCategoryId
		join [Account].[Categories] c on c.Id = sc.CategoryId
		join [Account].[NatureOfAccounts] n on n.Id = c.NatueOfAccountId 
		)
		T
		group by T.Id,T.natuarID,T.Name
		)TT
		order by Name 
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END


GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Admin].[spGetNextCanteenInvoiceNo]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
  @TenantId int,
  @ServiceUnitId uniqueidentifier,
  @UserId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	
	
	declare @message nvarchar(max)=''
	declare @NotAvalableQty int =0 

    declare @trancount int;
    

			DECLARE @RandomNumber int=6
			DECLARE @AutoRegNo bigint
			DECLARE @VarAutoRegNo varchar(12)
			DECLARE @NumberOfCurrentRegNo int =0
			DECLARE @NumberOfRegNo int =1
			DECLARE @IfExitsAutoRegNo int = 0
			DECLARE @LoopCount int =0
			DECLARE @DataFoundCount int =0
			DECLARE @OrgCode varchar(1) ='2'
			DECLARE @FinalUHID nvarchar(20)
			DECLARE @TotalRowCount int 
			

			SET @VarAutoRegNo =''

								select @VarAutoRegNo = @VarAutoRegNo + RIGHT(Year(getDate()),2)
								select @VarAutoRegNo = @VarAutoRegNo + RIGHT('00'+ CAST(Month(getDate()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
								select @VarAutoRegNo = @VarAutoRegNo + RIGHT('00'+ CAST(Day(getDate()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)

			DECLARE @LastNumber bigint

			

			WHILE @LoopCount = 0
			BEGIN

							BEGIN TRY
							-----------------BEGIN TRANSACTION;

												

													IF @ServiceUnitId ='B7358DAA-E21E-4821-DA36-08DD12BD3FD3'
													Begin
															select @LastNumber = 
															isnull(

															max(
															convert(bigint,
															substring(
															convert(varchar(20),[InvoiceNo]),
															7,
															--len([InvoiceNo])-8
															5
															)
															)


															),convert(bigint,'00')
															) from  [Admin].[InvoiceStores]
															where  len([InvoiceNo])>8
															and [InvoiceNo]>0 
															and substring(convert(varchar(20),[InvoiceNo]),0,7)= @VarAutoRegNo
															and TenantId = @TenantId
															and ServiceUnitId=@ServiceUnitId
		
															 set @LastNumber =@LastNumber+1

															set @AutoRegNo = convert(bigint,@VarAutoRegNo+RIGHT('00000'+ CAST(@LastNumber AS VARCHAR(5)), 5)+RIGHT('00'+ CAST(@TenantId AS VARCHAR(2)), 2))
													end
													else
													begin

															select @LastNumber = 
															isnull(

															max(
															convert(bigint,
															substring(
															convert(varchar(20),[InvoiceNo]),
															9,
															--len([InvoiceNo])-8
															13
															)
															)


															),convert(bigint,'00')
															) from  [Admin].[InvoiceStores]
															where  len([InvoiceNo])>8
															and [InvoiceNo]>0 
															and substring(convert(varchar(20),[InvoiceNo]),0,7)= @VarAutoRegNo
															and TenantId = @TenantId
															and ServiceUnitId=@ServiceUnitId

															 set @LastNumber =@LastNumber+1

															set @AutoRegNo = convert(bigint,@VarAutoRegNo+RIGHT('00'+ CAST(@TenantId AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)+RIGHT('00000'+ CAST(@LastNumber AS VARCHAR(5)), 5))

													end

													

																				INSERT INTO [Admin].[InvoiceStores]
																			   ([Id]
																			   ,[TenantId]
																			   ,[InvoiceNo]
																			   ,[ServiceUnitId]
																			   ,[UserId]
																			   ,[CreatedDate]
																			   ,[LastModifiedDate]
																			   ,[CreatedBy]
																			   ,[LastModifiedBy])

																				SELECT NEWID(),@TenantId,@AutoRegNo,@ServiceUnitId,@UserId,getdate(),null,@UserId,@UserId

																				 IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
																				BEGIN
																						set @LoopCount =0
																						
																				END
																				else
																				begin
																						set @LoopCount =1
																						
																				end
																				
													
											END TRY
											BEGIN CATCH
													set @LoopCount =0
											END CATCH


				END -- End While loop



	SELECT @AutoRegNo As InvoiceNo
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Admin].[SPGetNextLabNo]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


--select * from Diag.TestSamples where TestItemId='A13E917D-9DF9-49E3-35EC-08DBD389B544'
--delete [Admin].LabNoStores where InvoiceId='B80B723E-5095-4C74-1670-08DD5CC775B8'
--Exec [Admin].[SPGetNextLabNo] 'B80B723E-5095-4C74-1670-08DD5CC775B8','285F9D70-2343-4CDC-F7C2-08DADFE7EDC4,7B511B9C-7461-49CB-FB93-08DB23E00BDE,A13E917D-9DF9-49E3-35EC-08DBD389B544', 1

CREATE PROCEDURE [Admin].[SPGetNextLabNo]
    @InvoiceID uniqueIdentifier,
    @CSVofTestitemIds Nvarchar(max),
    @TenantId int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @TestItemID uniqueidentifier;
    DECLARE @MaxLabNo bigint;
    DECLARE @TestSampleID uniqueidentifier;
    DECLARE @VacutainerGroupExits uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
    DECLARE @PathologicalMachineGroupId nvarchar(MAX);
    DECLARE @AlreadyExitLabNoCount int;

    CREATE TABLE #TempSPGetNextLabNo (
        Id uniqueIdentifier,
        InvoiceId uniqueIdentifier,
        TestItemId uniqueIdentifier,
        TestSampleId uniqueIdentifier,
        LabNo int,
        TenantId int,
        PathologicalMachineGroupId uniqueIdentifier
    );

    DECLARE cursor_SPGetNextLabNo_TestItem CURSOR FOR 
        SELECT T.Value FROM (
            SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@CSVofTestitemIds)
        ) T;

    OPEN cursor_SPGetNextLabNo_TestItem;

    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_SPGetNextLabNo_TestItem INTO @TestItemID;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        PRINT @TestItemID;
        SET @PathologicalMachineGroupId = NULL;
        

        -- Get all Test Sample IDs for the Test Item
        DECLARE sample_cursor CURSOR FOR 
            SELECT t.ID FROM Diag.TestSamples t WHERE t.TestItemId = @TestItemID;

        OPEN sample_cursor;

        FETCH NEXT FROM sample_cursor INTO @TestSampleID;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
			SELECT @MaxLabNo = ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(int, ISNULL(LabNo, 0))), 0) + 1 FROM [Admin].LabNoStores;
            SELECT @VacutainerGroupExits = tg.Id 
            FROM diag.TestGroups tg 
            JOIN diag.TestItems tt ON tt.TestGroupId = tg.Id
            WHERE tt.Id = @TestItemID;

            IF @VacutainerGroupExits = '24269bfc-372b-41c8-a127-913c1fc0d9da'  -- Vacutainers
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [Admin].LabNoStores
                VALUES(NEWID(), @InvoiceID, @TestItemID, @TestSampleID, @MaxLabNo, @TenantId, NULL);
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @PathologicalMachineGroupId = CONVERT(varchar(MAX), t.PathologicalMachineGroupId) 
                FROM Diag.MachineGroupAndTestMapping t
                JOIN Diag.TestSamples s ON s.Id = t.TestSampleId
                WHERE s.TestItemId = @TestItemID AND s.Id = @TestSampleID;

                SELECT @AlreadyExitLabNoCount = COUNT(t.LabNo) 
                FROM [Admin].LabNoStores t
                JOIN Diag.MachineGroupAndTestMapping m ON t.TestSampleId = m.TestSampleId
                WHERE t.InvoiceId = @InvoiceID
                AND m.PathologicalMachineGroupId = @PathologicalMachineGroupId;

                IF @AlreadyExitLabNoCount > 0 
                BEGIN
                    SELECT TOP 1 @MaxLabNo = t.LabNo 
                    FROM [Admin].LabNoStores t
                    JOIN Diag.MachineGroupAndTestMapping m ON t.TestSampleId = m.TestSampleId
                    WHERE t.InvoiceId = @InvoiceID
                    AND m.PathologicalMachineGroupId = @PathologicalMachineGroupId;

                    INSERT INTO [Admin].LabNoStores
                    VALUES(NEWID(), @InvoiceID, @TestItemID, @TestSampleID, @MaxLabNo, @TenantId, @PathologicalMachineGroupId);
                END
                ELSE 
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [Admin].LabNoStores
                    VALUES(NEWID(), @InvoiceID, @TestItemID, @TestSampleID, @MaxLabNo, @TenantId, @PathologicalMachineGroupId);
                END
            END

            FETCH NEXT FROM sample_cursor INTO @TestSampleID;
        END;

        CLOSE sample_cursor;
        DEALLOCATE sample_cursor;

        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_SPGetNextLabNo_TestItem INTO @TestItemID;
    END;

    CLOSE cursor_SPGetNextLabNo_TestItem;
    DEALLOCATE cursor_SPGetNextLabNo_TestItem;

    SELECT * FROM [Admin].LabNoStores WHERE InvoiceId = @InvoiceID ORDER BY LabNo;
END
GO

-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec [Admin].[SpGetParentMentWithVisibility] '122cb478-1aec-4232-8495-34a64ba1189b'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Admin].[SpGetParentMentWithVisibility]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RoleId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	select pmt.Id,pmt.Name,pmt.Description,
		   CASE
				WHEN tbl.ParentId <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				   THEN cast ('299999F4-ED33-4973-AEC8-CF253CD3B687' as uniqueidentifier)
				   ELSE cast ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' as uniqueidentifier)
		   END as ParentId
		  ,pmt.NavigationPage,pmt.DisplayOrder,pmt.IsActive,pmt.IconName,pmt.LandingPageIconUrl
	  from 
		(
		select pm.Id,pm.Name,pm.Description,
			   pm.ParentId
			   ,pm.NavigationPage,pm.DisplayOrder,pm.IsActive,pm.MenuIcon as IconName,pm.LandingPageIconUrl
		  from [Admin].[ProjectMenus] pm
		 where pm.ParentId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		 ) pmt left join
		 ( select m.ParentId from [Menu].[MenuPermissions] mp inner join 
			(select Id,
				case	
					when ParentId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
						then Id
						else ParentId
				end as ParentId
				from [Admin].[ProjectMenus]) m on mp.MenuId=m.Id where mp.RoleId=@RoleId group by m.ParentId
		 ) tbl on pmt.Id=tbl.ParentId
	where pmt.Id!='2E40139B-D86F-476C-960A-11111A8FC66B' order by pmt.DisplayOrder
END
GO

-- Exec [Admin].spGetPermittedMenuList '0969a1a8-431d-416a-8c5b-b53c7cd2793c'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Admin].[spGetPermittedMenuList]
	@RoleId nvarchar(36)='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN
	
	Select P.Id, m.Name as Menu, p.MenuId,p.RoleId,r.Name as RoleName,CONVERT(bit,0) IsPermissionGranted  from [Admin].ProjectMenus M Join [Menu].MenuPermissions p on M.Id=p.MenuId
	Join [Identity].UserRoles ur on ur.RoleId=p.RoleId join [Identity].Roles r on r.Id=ur.RoleId
	where (p.RoleId = @RoleId or @RoleId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

END

-- =============================================

-- Exec [Admin].[spTruncateTables] 'SuperAdmin'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Admin].[spTruncateTables]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@SchemasName nvarchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
	

--select schema_name(t.schema_id) as schema_name,
--       t.name as table_name,
       
--from sys.tables t
--where schema_name(t.schema_id) = @SchemasName -- put schema name here
--order by table_name;

DECLARE @Table_Name nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max)


print '--------- Cur1 NOCHECK CONSTRAINT ALL for --------------'

DECLARE Cur1 CURSOR READ_ONLY
FOR

		select t.name as table_name
       
		from sys.tables t
		where schema_name(t.schema_id) = @SchemasName -- put schema name here
		order by t.create_date;
OPEN Cur1
FETCH NEXT FROM Cur1 INTO @Table_Name
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
			
				set @Query ='ALTER TABLE '+@SchemasName+'.'+@Table_Name+' NOCHECK CONSTRAINT ALL'
				print @Query
				exec(@Query)
				FETCH NEXT FROM Cur1 INTO @Table_Name
      END
CLOSE Cur1
DEALLOCATE Cur1

print '--------- Cur2 Delete From ALL for --------------'


DECLARE Cur2 CURSOR READ_ONLY
FOR
		select t.name as table_name
		from sys.tables t
		where schema_name(t.schema_id) = @SchemasName -- put schema name here
		order by t.create_date;
		
OPEN Cur2
FETCH NEXT FROM Cur2 INTO @Table_Name
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
				
				set @Query ='DELETE FROM '+@SchemasName+'.'+@Table_Name+' '
				print @Query
				exec(@Query)
				FETCH NEXT FROM Cur2 INTO @Table_Name
      END
CLOSE Cur2
DEALLOCATE Cur2

print '--------- Cur3 DBCC CHECKIDENT ALL for --------------'


DECLARE Cur3 CURSOR READ_ONLY
FOR
		select t.name as table_name
		from sys.tables t
		where schema_name(t.schema_id) = @SchemasName -- put schema name here
		order by t.create_date;
		
OPEN Cur3
FETCH NEXT FROM Cur3 INTO @Table_Name
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
				
				set @Query ='DBCC CHECKIDENT ( '''+@SchemasName+'.'+@Table_Name+''' , RESEED, 0) '
				print @Query
				exec(@Query)
				FETCH NEXT FROM Cur3 INTO @Table_Name
      END
CLOSE Cur3
DEALLOCATE Cur3


print '--------- Cur4 CONSTRAINT ALL for --------------'


DECLARE Cur4 CURSOR READ_ONLY
FOR
		select t.name as table_name
		from sys.tables t
		where schema_name(t.schema_id) = @SchemasName -- put schema name here
		order by t.create_date;
OPEN Cur4
FETCH NEXT FROM Cur4 INTO @Table_Name
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
				
				set @Query ='ALTER TABLE '+@SchemasName+'.'+@Table_Name+' CHECK CONSTRAINT ALL'
				print @Query
				exec(@Query)
				FETCH NEXT FROM Cur4 INTO @Table_Name
      END
CLOSE Cur4
DEALLOCATE Cur4


END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatement]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatement]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-10-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	Declare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDate date
	Declare @LoyerMemberID uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @LoyerMemberID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	

	
	select lml.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo
	into #TempCanteenDueStatementTemp
	FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml 
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = lml.LoyalMemberId
	WHERE (lml.LoyalMemberId= @LoyerMemberID 
	OR  @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND convert(date,lml.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,lml.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	AND lml.IsDeleted<>1
	group by lml.InvoiceNo



	

	 	select(
	Select  MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, DueTk from
	(

	select s.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,
	[Canteen].[FnGetAllProductName]('Invoice',s.InvoiceNo) [ProductList],	
	
	(
		select sum(debit)-sum(credit) from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
		where lml.InvoiceNo = s.InvoiceNo
		and convert(date,lml.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
		AND lml.IsDeleted<>1
	)
	DueTk
	,l.Name MemberName,s.Invdate,LoyalMemberId
	from #TempCanteenDueStatementTemp t
	join [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] s on s.InvoiceNo = t.InvoiceNo
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = s.LoyalMemberId
	--where s.IsDeleted<>1
	group by s.InvoiceNo,l.Name,s.Invdate,s.LoyalMemberId
	
	 
	 )tbl  
	 where tbl.DueTk <> 0
	 ORDER BY tbl.InvoiceNo desc FOR JSON AUTO) As Data
	
	return


	select(
	Select  MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, DueTk from
	(
	
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MemberName DESC) AS Id, MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, DueTk
	From (
	SELECT  MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, 
	DueTk FROM
	(
	select s.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,
	[Canteen].[FnGetAllProductName]('Invoice',s.InvoiceNo) [ProductList],	
	(ISNULL(s.GrandTK,0) -ISNULL((s.ReceivedTK),0)) DueTk
	,l.Name MemberName,s.Invdate,LoyalMemberId
	from [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] s
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = s.LoyalMemberId
	where convert(date,s.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,s.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and s.DueTK <> 0 
	and (l.Id = @LoyerMemberID or @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and s.IsDeleted<>1
	--And s.IsDeleted <>1
	
	UNION
    select s.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,
	[Canteen].[FnGetAllProductName]('Invoice',s.InvoiceNo) [ProductList],	
	--(ISNULL(s.GrandTK,0) -ISNULL((s.ReceivedTK),0)) DueTk
	ISNULL(sl.Credit,0) DueTk
	,l.Name MemberName,s.Invdate,LoyalMemberId
	from [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] s
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = s.LoyalMemberId
	 JOIN  Canteen.SaleLedgers sl ON s.Id=sl.InvoiceId AND sl.TransactionType=2
	where 
	convert(date,s.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,s.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	--and s.DueTK <> 0 
	and (l.Id = @LoyerMemberID or @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and s.IsDeleted<>1
		
	)T 
	where convert(date,T.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,T.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	--and  T.IsDeleted<>1

	UNION 
	SELECT 
	l.Name MemberName,LoyalMemberId, 0 InvoiceNo,lml.TransactionType ProductList, ISNULL( lml.Credit*-1,0) DueTk
	FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml 
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = lml.LoyalMemberId
	WHERE (lml.LoyalMemberId= @LoyerMemberID 
	OR  @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND Credit>0
    AND lml.TransactionType<>'Sale'
	AND convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEndDate

	) tbl1 
	 )tbl  ORDER BY tbl.Id desc FOR JSON AUTO) As Data

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementSummary]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementSummary]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementSummary]'2025-03-01,2025-03-01,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	Declare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDate date
	Declare @LoyerMemberID uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @LoyerMemberID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

	--SELECT @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@LoyerMemberID
	--return
	insert into temp_2024_11_2 (Column1,Column2,Column3) values(@FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@LoyerMemberID)

select InvoiceNo ,1 [recievedOnSaleFound]
into #TempRecievedOnSaleInvoice
from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
where TransactionType='recieved on sale'
and IsDeleted <> 1
group by InvoiceNo




 

				select(
				select EntryDate,LoyalMemberName,sum(TotalSale) TotalSale,sum(TotalDiscount) TotalDiscount,sum(TotalReceived) TotalReceived,
				sum(RemainingDue) RemainingDue
				
				from(
		SELECT T.EntryDate, T.LoyalMemberName ,
				SUM(T.TotalSale)TotalSale, SUM(T.TotalDiscount)TotalDiscount, 
				(
				SUM(T.TotalReceived) 

				-
				SUM(T.changeOnReceive) 
				)
				TotalReceived,
				case when invoiceno =0 then 0 else 
				SUM(t.TotalSale)-isnull(SUM(T.TotalDiscount),0)
				-(isnull(SUM(T.TotalReceived),0) - isnull(SUM(T.changeOnReceive),0)) end
				RemainingDue

				 
				FROM (
				SELECT CONVERT(DATE,lml.CreatedOn) EntryDate, lm.Name LoyalMemberName ,lml.invoiceno, 
				--CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='Sale' and isnull(r.recievedOnSaleFound,0) =0 THEN ISNULL((lml.Debit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalSale,
				0 TotalSale,
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='discount for due collection' THEN ISNULL((lml.Credit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalDiscount,
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='pay for due collection' OR lml.TransactionType='recieved on sale' 
				THEN ISNULL((lml.Credit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalReceived,
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='change on recieve' THEN ISNULL((lml.Debit),0) ELSE 0 END changeOnReceive
				FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
				JOIN Account.LoyalMembers lm ON lm.id=lml.LoyalMemberId
				LEFT JOIN #TempRecievedOnSaleInvoice  r on r.InvoiceNo =lml.InvoiceNo
				WHERE  convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEndDate
						AND (lm.id=@LoyerMemberID OR @LoyerMemberID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND lml.IsDeleted<>1

				UNION ALL 
						SELECT CONVERT(DATE,lml.CreatedOn) EntryDate, lm.Name LoyalMemberName ,lml.invoiceno, 
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='Sale' and isnull(r.recievedOnSaleFound,0) =0 THEN ISNULL((lml.Debit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalSale,
				0 TotalDiscount,
		        0 TotalReceived,
				0 changeOnReceive
				FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
				JOIN Account.LoyalMembers lm ON lm.id=lml.LoyalMemberId
				LEFT JOIN #TempRecievedOnSaleInvoice  r on r.InvoiceNo =lml.InvoiceNo
				WHERE  convert(date,lml.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,lml.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
						AND (lm.id=@LoyerMemberID OR @LoyerMemberID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND lml.IsDeleted<>1

						)T
						GROUP BY T.EntryDate,T.LoyalMemberName,invoiceno
						--ORDER BY t.LoyalMemberName
						)tbl  
						GROUP BY EntryDate,LoyalMemberName
						ORDER BY tbl.LoyalMemberName
						FOR JSON AUTO) As Data
					

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementSummaryDetails]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementSummaryDetails]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementSummaryDetails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	Declare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDate date
	Declare @LoyerMemberID uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @LoyerMemberID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

				select(select * from(
		SELECT T.EntryDate, T.LoyalMemberName ,invoiceno,
				SUM(T.TotalSale)TotalSale, SUM(T.TotalDiscount)TotalDiscount, 
				case when invoiceno =0 then 
				SUM(T.TotalReceived) else 0 end PreviousDueReceived,
				case when invoiceno <>0 then 
				SUM(T.TotalReceived) else 0 end Received,
				SUM(T.changeOnReceive) changeOnReceive,
				(
				SUM(T.TotalReceived) 
				
				-
				SUM(T.changeOnReceive) 
				)
				TotalReceived,
				case when invoiceno =0 then 0 else 
				SUM(t.TotalSale)-isnull(SUM(T.TotalDiscount),0)
				-(isnull(SUM(T.TotalReceived),0) - isnull(SUM(T.changeOnReceive),0)) end 
				RemainingDue
				
				
				 
				FROM (
				SELECT CONVERT(DATE,lml.CreatedOn) EntryDate, lm.Name LoyalMemberName ,lml.invoiceno, 
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='Sale' THEN ISNULL((lml.Debit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalSale,
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='discount for due collection' THEN ISNULL((lml.Credit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalDiscount,
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='pay for due collection' OR lml.TransactionType='recieved on sale' 
				THEN ISNULL((lml.Credit),0) ELSE 0 END TotalReceived,
				CASE WHEN lml.TransactionType='change on recieve' THEN ISNULL((lml.Debit),0) ELSE 0 END changeOnReceive
				FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
				
				JOIN Account.LoyalMembers lm ON lm.id=lml.LoyalMemberId
				WHERE  convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEndDate
						AND (lm.id=@LoyerMemberID OR @LoyerMemberID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND lml.IsDeleted<>1

						)T
						GROUP BY T.EntryDate,T.LoyalMemberName,invoiceno
						--order by T.EntryDate,T.LoyalMemberName,invoiceno
						--ORDER BY t.LoyalMemberName
						)tbl  ORDER BY tbl.LoyalMemberName
						FOR JSON AUTO) As Data
						


END
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementTemp]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[CanteenDueStatementTemp]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	Declare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDate date
	Declare @LoyerMemberID uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @LoyerMemberID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

	
	select lml.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo
	into #TempCanteenDueStatementTemp
	FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml 
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = lml.LoyalMemberId
	WHERE (lml.LoyalMemberId= @LoyerMemberID 
	OR  @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEndDate
	group by lml.InvoiceNo


	


	 

	select s.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,
	[Canteen].[FnGetAllProductName]('Invoice',s.InvoiceNo) [ProductList],	
	
	(
		select sum(debit)-sum(credit) from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
		where lml.InvoiceNo = s.InvoiceNo
		and convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEndDate
	)
	DueTk
	,l.Name MemberName,s.Invdate,LoyalMemberId
	from #TempCanteenDueStatementTemp t
	join [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] s on s.InvoiceNo = t.InvoiceNo
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = s.LoyalMemberId
	where s.IsDeleted<>1
	group by s.InvoiceNo,l.Name,s.Invdate,s.LoyalMemberId
	
	 
	
	return


	select(
	Select  MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, DueTk from
	(
	
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MemberName DESC) AS Id, MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, DueTk
	From (
	SELECT  MemberName,LoyalMemberId, InvoiceNo,ProductList, 
	DueTk FROM
	(
	select s.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,
	[Canteen].[FnGetAllProductName]('Invoice',s.InvoiceNo) [ProductList],	
	(ISNULL(s.GrandTK,0) -ISNULL((s.ReceivedTK),0)) DueTk
	,l.Name MemberName,s.Invdate,LoyalMemberId
	from [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] s
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = s.LoyalMemberId
	where convert(date,s.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,s.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and s.DueTK <> 0 
	and (l.Id = @LoyerMemberID or @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and s.IsDeleted<>1
	--And s.IsDeleted <>1
	
	UNION
    select s.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,
	[Canteen].[FnGetAllProductName]('Invoice',s.InvoiceNo) [ProductList],	
	--(ISNULL(s.GrandTK,0) -ISNULL((s.ReceivedTK),0)) DueTk
	ISNULL(sl.Credit,0) DueTk
	,l.Name MemberName,s.Invdate,LoyalMemberId
	from [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] s
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = s.LoyalMemberId
	 JOIN  Canteen.SaleLedgers sl ON s.Id=sl.InvoiceId AND sl.TransactionType=2
	where 
	convert(date,s.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,s.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	--and s.DueTK <> 0 
	and (l.Id = @LoyerMemberID or @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and s.IsDeleted<>1
		
	)T 
	where convert(date,T.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,T.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	--and  T.IsDeleted<>1

	UNION 
	SELECT 
	l.Name MemberName,LoyalMemberId, 0 InvoiceNo,lml.TransactionType ProductList, ISNULL( lml.Credit*-1,0) DueTk
	FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml 
	join [Account].[LoyalMembers] l on l.Id = lml.LoyalMemberId
	WHERE (lml.LoyalMemberId= @LoyerMemberID 
	OR  @LoyerMemberID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND Credit>0
    AND lml.TransactionType<>'Sale'
	AND convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,lml.CreatedOn) <=@FilterEndDate

	) tbl1 
	 )tbl  ORDER BY tbl.Id desc FOR JSON AUTO) As Data

END

CREATE  Procedure [Canteen].[sp_CancelSale]
@Id as Uniqueidentifier ,
@returnValue as varchar(200)  =''  out  
as begin 
declare @Invno as int 
declare @VMID  as Uniqueidentifier 
select @Invno=InvoiceNo From [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] where ID=@Id

SELECT @id = NEWID()

--select @id
Select VMID,VoucherNo,2 as VtypeID,TenantId  into #master From [Account].[GLMaster] where VoucherNo=@Invno

Select DTLID,Debit,Credit into #Detail From  [Account].[GLMasterDetail] where VMID=(select VMID from #master)
-------------------------inert into Master 
insert into [Account].[GLMaster](VMID,VoucherNo,VoucherDate,VTYPEID,FYearId,REMARKS,PaidTo,TenantId,RefrenceID,IsDeleted,ServiceUnitId,POST,POSTEDBY,POSTEDDATE,VoucherMode,IsReversal,id,CreatedOn)
select @id, 0 as voucherNo ,GETDATE(),2 as VtypeID ,0,'',0,TenantId,VMID,0 ,0,0,0,GETDATE(),0 ,0,VMId,GETDATE() from #master
set  @VMID = @id



insert  into   [Account].[GLMasterDetail] (VDID,DTLID,SUBDTLID,Debit,Credit,DESCRIPTION,VMID,ServiceUnitId,SeriveId)
select NEWID(),DTLID ,0,Credit as Debit  , debit as Credit ,'Cancell Sale ',@VMID,0,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' from #Detail

--update  [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] set S =1 where InvoiceNo=@Invno 

 select 'Invoice cancelled successfully ' as ResponseMessage,'200' as ResponseCode

end

CREATE     PROCEDURE[Canteen].[sp_CashCollection] 
@FromDate DateTime,
@ToDate  DateTime
as begin 


create table #TempDues
(
    InvoiceNo int, 
    ReceivedAmount int, 
    
    Name varchar(200), 
	Type varchar(20), 
	CSType varchar(20), 
	InvoiceDate datetime 

) 

select* into #SaleInvoices From [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] where CONVERT(DATE, Invdate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate) 


select* into #DueCollection  from [Account].[DueCollection] where CONVERT(DATE, Duedate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate) 

insert into #TempDues 
select InvoiceNo,ReceivedTK as Received,st.EmployeeName as Name ,'Regular Sale' as Type,'Staff' as CSType,Invdate as InvoiceDate
From #SaleInvoices  s
inner join HR.StaffRecords st on s.StaffRecordId=st.Id
  where StaffRecordId !='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

  insert into #TempDues 
select InvoiceNo,ReceivedTK as Received,m.Name as Name ,'Regular Sale' as Type ,'Member' as CSType,Invdate as InvoiceDate
From #SaleInvoices s
 inner join Account.LoyalMembers m  on s.LoyalMemberId=m.Id
  where LoyalMemberId !='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
---------------------------Due Collection Section 


insert into #TempDues 
select 0 as  InvoiceNo , ReceivedAmount as Received ,s.EmployeeName as Name,'Due Collection' as Type,'Staff' as CSType,Duedate as InvoiceDate
 From #DueCollection d
 inner join HR.StaffRecords s on d.StaffRecordId=s.Id
  where StaffRecordId !='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

  insert into #TempDues 
 select 0 as  InvoiceNo , ReceivedAmount as Received ,Name ,'Due Collection' as Type ,'Member' as CSType,Duedate as InvoiceDate 
 From #DueCollection d
 inner join Account.LoyalMembers m  on d.LoyalMemberId=m.Id
  where  LoyalMemberId !='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

select '' as FileContents,'' as FileDownloadName ,*From  #TempDues 
end

GO






--exec [Canteen].[SP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History]  '2023-02-04','2023-02-04'
--return
--exec [Canteen].[SP_SET_Canteen_Opening_Stock] '2023-02-04' (for Data insert)

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date
AS
BEGIN
-- Exec SP_Get_Current_Product_Stock_Date_Wise_History '2020-09-01','2020-09-01'
DECLARE 
    @ProductId int, 
    @CurrentStock   float,
	@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
	@Char char ='#',
	@AvgCost char ='@'
	DECLARE @AvgCost_Vat char ='$'
	
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_ID nvarchar(50)
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_stock float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCostVat float

Create table #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
(
		[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
		ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
)


Create table #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
	(
		[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
		FilterDate date,
		ProductID nvarchar(250),
		FilterStartDateStock float,
		FilterEndDateStock float,
		FilterStartProductAvgCost float
	)

	create Table #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
	(
		Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
		ProductName nvarchar(max),
		OpeningBalance float,
		OpeningAvgAmount float,
		PQty float,
		Prate float,
		SQty float,
		SaleRate float,
		TPAmount float,
		TSaleamnt float,
		Closingbalance float
	)
	

select @ProductStock= t.ProductStock from [Canteen].[CanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterStartDate
--select * from [Canteen].[CanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistories]

insert into #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
	(ProductWiseStock)
	select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStock,',')

DECLARE 
@ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
			--print '-----'
			--print @ProductCurrentStock


			select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

						select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))


		--print @CurrentProduct_ID
		--print @CurrentProduct_stock
		--print @FilterStartProductAvgCost

		insert into #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost)
		select @FilterStartDate,Convert(int, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost


	        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;



Insert into #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
	(
		ProductName ,
		OpeningBalance ,
		OpeningAvgAmount,
		PQty ,
		Prate ,
		SQty ,
		SaleRate ,
		TPAmount ,
		TSaleamnt ,
		Closingbalance 
	)


select T.ProductName,sum(T.OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance,sum(OpeningAvgAmount) OpeningAvgAmount,
 sum(PQty) PQty, sum(Prate) Prate, 
	sum(SQty) SQty, sum(SaleRate) SaleRate, 
	sum(TPAmount) TPAmount, sum(TSaleamnt) TSaleamnt, sum(Closingbalance) Closingbalance

FROM 
(
	select i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount, 0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance
	from 
	Canteen.Items i

	union all

	select i.Name [ProductName], sum(t.FilterStartDateStock) OpeningBalance, sum(t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) OpeningAvgAmount, 0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance  
	from #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
	join Canteen.Items i on i.id = t.productid
	group by i.Id,i.Name

	-- Purchase Information
	union all

	select i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount , sum(rd.Qty) PQty, convert(decimal(10,2), sum(rd.PurchaseRate * rd.Qty)/sum(rd.Qty)) Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance  
			from
				Canteen.StockReceiveRecords r
				join Canteen.StockReceiveRecordDetails rd on rd.StockReceiveId=r.Id
				join Canteen.Items i on i.Id = rd.itemid
			where convert(date,r.RDate) >= @FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,r.RDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			group by i.Name

	-- Sales Information

	union all
				select i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount,0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
				sum(rd.Qty) SQty, convert(decimal(10,2), sum(rd.SaleRate * rd.Qty)/sum(rd.Qty)) SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance

				from
				Canteen.SaleInvoices r
				join Canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails rd on rd.InvoiceId=r.Id
				join Canteen.Items i on i.Id = rd.ProductId
			where convert(date,r.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
			and   convert(date,r.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
			group by i.Name


)T
group by T.ProductName

select 				
		Autoid ,
		ProductName ,
		OpeningBalance ,
		OpeningBalance * OpeningAvgAmount OpeningTotalAmount,
		PQty ,
		Prate ,
		SQty ,
		SaleRate ,
		PQty*Prate  TPAmount ,
		SQty *SaleRate  TSaleamnt ,
		OpeningBalance + PQty - SQty Closingbalance ,
		(OpeningBalance * OpeningAvgAmount) + (PQty*Prate) - (SQty *SaleRate) ClosingTotalAmount

 from #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History

drop table #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
drop table #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
drop table  #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory

END
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[sp_SaleInvoiceListByDate]
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime ,
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier
as begin 
	select  lm.Name as LoyalMember ,'' as  StaffRecord,si.Id,
        [Invdate]
      ,[InvoiceNo]
      ,[TotalTK]
      ,[DiscountTK]
      ,[GrandTK]
      ,[ReceivedTK]
      ,[ChangeTK]
      ,[DueTK]
      ,isnull([Remarks],0)Remarks
      ,isnull([UHID],0)[UHID]
      ,[LoyalMemberId]
      ,[StaffRecordId]
      ,si.[TenantId]
      ,isnull(si.CreatedBy,'')[CreatedBy]
      ,si.CreatedOn
      ,isnull(si.LastModifiedBy,0) as [LastModifiedBy]
      ,isnull(si.LastModifiedOn,'')as [LastModifiedOn]
      ,si.IsDeleted
      ,[InvoicePrefix]
	  ,[IPDPatientRecordId]
	  ,[VatInTk]
	  ,isnull([SaleCancelReason],'')CancelReason
	  ,isnull([MealType], '') MealType
	  ,'' UserName
	  ,si.CanteenOutLetId
	  ,co.Name OutletName
 From [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] si 
	join Canteen.CanteenOutlets co on co.Id = si.CanteenOutLetId
	left join [Account].[LoyalMembers] lm on si.LoyalMemberId = lm.Id   
 where (si.CanteenOutLetId = @outletId or @outletId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and CONVERT(DATE, Invdate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate)

end
