--exec [Canteen].[SP_SET_Canteen_Opening_Stock] '2024-09-08'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SP_SET_Canteen_Opening_Stock]
	@FilterDate date
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
		@ProductId int, 
		@CurrentStock   float,
		@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
		@Char char ='#',
		@EndFilterChar char ='@',
		@EndFilterCharWithVat char ='$',
		@EndFilterCharWithOurtlet char ='*',

		@ProductAvgCost float,
		@ProductAvgCostWithVat float,

		@Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@Stock float,
		@PurchaseRate float,
		@CanteenOutLetId uniqueIdentifier,
		
		@RowNumberCount int =0

		set @ProductStock =''

		DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
		FOR 
		/*
			--SELECT 
			--	[Id]
			--  ,sum([Stock]) [Stock]
			--  ,AVG([PurchaseRate]) [PurchaseRate]
			 
		 -- FROM [Canteen].[ViewStock]
		 -- group by [Id]

		 select ID,
		 case when (sum(purchaseStock) -sum(salesStock)) >=0 then (sum(purchaseStock) -sum(salesStock)) else 0.00 end
		  [stock],
		 --avg(puchaserRate) puchaserRate
		 case when sum(purchaseStock) = 0 then 0 else 
		convert(decimal(18,2),sum(Totalpuchaser)/sum(purchaseStock)) end [PurchaseRate],
		CanteenOutLetId
		 from
		 (
				 select 
				 i.Id [ID],
				 0 purchaseStock,
				 0 salesStock,
				 0 Totalpuchaser,
				 0 salesRate,
				 o.id CanteenOutLetId
				 from 
				 Canteen.Items i,
				 Canteen.CanteenOutlets o 

				 union all

				 select
 				  i.Id [ID],
				 d.Qty purchaseStock,
				 0 salesStock,
				 d.Qty * d.PurchaseRate Totalpuchaser,
				 0 salesRate,
				 m.CanteenOutLetId
		 
				 from 
				 Canteen.StockReceiveRecordDetails d
				 join Canteen.StockReceiveRecords m on m.Id = d.StockReceiveId
				 join Canteen.Items i on i.id = d.ItemId
				 where  convert(date,m.RDate ) <@FilterDate

				 union all

				 select
 				  i.Id [ID],
				 0 purchaseStock,
				 d.Qty salesStock,
				 0 puchaserRate,
				 d.SaleRate salesRate,
				 m.CanteenOutLetId
		 
				 from 
				 Canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails d
				 join Canteen.SaleInvoices m on m.Id = d.InvoiceId
				 join Canteen.Items i on i.id = d.ProductId
				 where  convert(date, m.Invdate) <@FilterDate
		)T
		group by T.ID,T.CanteenOutLetId
	
		*/

		SELECT vs.Id,vs.Stock,vs.PurchaseRate,vs.CanteenOutletId FROM Canteen.ViewStock vs
		--WHERE name LIKE '%NESCOFFEE%'

		OPEN cursor_product;

		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
				@Id
			   ,@Stock
			  ,@PurchaseRate
			 ,@CanteenOutLetId

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
				
				set @ProductStock = @ProductStock + ','+convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),@Id) +@Char
				+convert(varchar(max),@Stock) +@EndFilterChar
				+ convert(varchar(max),isnull(@PurchaseRate,0)) + @EndFilterCharWithVat
				+ convert(NVARCHAR(max),isnull(@CanteenOutLetId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')) + @EndFilterCharWithOurtlet
				
				set @RowNumberCount = @RowNumberCount +1

				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
				@Id
			   ,@Stock
			  ,@PurchaseRate
			  ,@CanteenOutLetId

		END;

CLOSE cursor_product;
DEALLOCATE cursor_product;


set @ProductStock = substring(@ProductStock,2,len(@ProductStock)+1)

print @ProductStock

Declare @RowCount int =0
Declare @RowAutoID int
select  @RowCount = count(*) from [Canteen].[CanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterDate


if  @RowCount =0 
begin 
	insert into [Canteen].[CanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistories]
	(FilterDate,ProductStock)
	values (@FilterDate,@ProductStock)
	print '---Done-'
End


END



GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetCanteenProductWiseSalesProfitDynamic]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






CREATE       PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetCanteenProductWiseSalesProfitDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Canteen].[SpGetCanteenProductWiseSalesProfitDynamic] '2025-03-1,2025-03-1,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN

	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	set @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @ProductName=''

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	--Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14

	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetCanteenSalesProfitDynamicReport
	(
		grouptId uniqueidentifier ,
		GroupName nvarchar(max),
		SalesQty float,
		SalesAmount float,
		PuchaseAmount float,
		SalesProfitPersentage float
		
	)

	
	insert into #TempSpGetCanteenSalesProfitDynamicReport
	SELECT 
	grouptId,GroupName,sum(Qty),sum(TotalSaleAmount)-sum(TotalDiscount)  SalesAmount, sum(TotalPurchaseAmount) Purchase,
	(((sum(TotalSaleAmount)-sum(TotalDiscount)) -sum(TotalPurchaseAmount))*100)/
	(sum(TotalSaleAmount)-sum(TotalDiscount))
	 SalesProfitPersentage	 
	from 
	(
		select g.id grouptId, g.name GroupName,AVG(d.SaleRate) SaleRate ,sum(d.Qty) Qty ,AVG(d.SaleRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalSaleAmount,
		case when i.DiscountTK =0 or i.TotalTK = 0 then 0 else (i.DiscountTK * d.SaleRate * d.Qty)/i.TotalTK end TotalDiscount,
		AVG(d.PurchaseRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalCostAmount,
		AVG(d.PurchaseRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalPurchaseAmount
		from 
		Canteen.Items V
		join Canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails d on d.ProductId  = V.id
		join Canteen.SaleInvoices i on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
		join Canteen.Groups g on g.Id = v.GroupId
 		where ( V.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
		and convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and (i.CanteenOutLetId   = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  
		
		) 
		group by  v.id,v.name,i.TotalTK,i.DiscountTK,d.SaleRate,d.qty,i.id,g.id,g.Name
	)T
	group by grouptId,GroupName
	
		select(
	select * from(

	select 
	grouptId  ,
		GroupName ,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesQty) SalesQty,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesAmount) SalesAmount,
		Convert(decimal(18,2),PuchaseAmount)PuchaseAmount,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesProfitPersentage )SalesProfitPersentage
		
	from
	#TempSpGetCanteenSalesProfitDynamicReport
		) tbl  
		FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END


GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetCanteenSalesReportUserWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS

BEGIN
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[SpGetCanteenSalesReportUserWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'




	DECLARE 
	--@OutletId int,
	--@BrandExtensionsId bigint,
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserID uniqueidentifier
	--@FilterTypeId int

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		Select @UserID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

		select(
	select * from(


	select InvoiceNo,Invdate,count(*) CountRecored,
	round(sum(TotalSales),0) TotalSales
	,0 AO
	,0 DWD
	,round((sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount)),0) NetSales		--Invoice Total Amount - Discount = Netsale

	,round((sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount) - (select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Canteen.SaleLedgers ll
			join Canteen.SaleInvoices  ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
			where ii.InvoiceNo = T.InvoiceNo
		) - sum(Cancell)),0) NetCollection		--Total Invoice Amount - discount- due- cancel amount- check if there is any more = Net Collectipn
	,round(sum(Discount),0) TotalDiscount
	,sum(Refund) TotalRefund
	,round((select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Canteen.SaleLedgers  ll
		join Canteen.SaleInvoices  ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
		where ii.InvoiceNo = T.InvoiceNo
	),0) TotalDue,
	round(sum(Cancell),0) Cancell,
	round(sum(DiscountAdjustment),0) DiscountAdjustment,
	round(sum(RegularCash),0) RegularCash,
	round(sum(RegularCard),0) RegularCard,
	round(sum(RegularMobileBanking),0) RegularMobileBanking,
	round(sum(RegularCheque),0) RegularCheque,
	round(sum(DueCash),0) DueCash,
	round(sum(DueCard),0) DueCard,
	round(sum(DueMobileBanking),0) DueMobileBanking,
	round(sum(DueCheque),0) DueCheque

	from 

	(
			select i.InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ) Invdate,
			case when d.TransactionType = 0 then d.debit else 0 end TotalSales,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then d.Credit else 0 end Discount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 5 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Refund,
			case when d.TransactionType = 4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Cancell,
			case when d.TransactionType = 6 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DiscountAdjustment,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCheque


			from Canteen.SaleInvoices  i 
			join Canteen.SaleLedgers  d on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			where 
				convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			--and (i.ServeTypeId = @FilterTypeId or @FilterTypeId=0)
			and (i.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and i.IsDeleted<>1
			--and (i. = @OutletId  or @OutletId=0)
	)T
	group by InvoiceNo,Invdate

	
		) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	--group by InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ),TransactionType
END

GO

--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[SPGetCanteenStockDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SPGetCanteenStockDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
-- Exec [Canteen].[SP_GetDateWiseStock] '2023-01-05','2023-03-05'
DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
    @ProductId uniqueIdentifier, 
    @CurrentStock   float,
	@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
	
	@Char char ='#',
	@AvgCost char ='@',
	@EndFilterCharWithOutlet char ='*',
	@Outlet char ='$',
	@LastChar char ='*',



	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ParamOutletId Nvarchar(max),
	@OutLetWiseDateArchive date ='2025-1-19'
	

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	--Select @ProductId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

	Select @ParamOutletId=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12

	select @OutletId = convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, Ltrim(@ParamOutletId))

	

	--Select @ProductId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4



	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@ParamOutletId,@OutletId return 

	DECLARE @AvgCost_Vat char ='$'
	
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_ID nvarchar(50)
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_stock float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @OpeningOutletID uniqueidentifier

Create table #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
(
		[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
		ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
)


Create table #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
	(
		[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
		FilterDate date,
		ProductID uniqueidentifier,
		FilterStartDateStock float,
		FilterEndDateStock float,
		FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
		OutletID uniqueidentifier
	)

	create Table #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
	(
		Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
		ProductID UniqueIdentifier,
		ProductName nvarchar(max),
		OpeningBalance float,
		OpeningAvgAmount float,
		PQty float,
		Prate float,
		SQty float,
		SaleRate float,
		TPAmount float,
		TSaleamnt float,
		Closingbalance float
	)
	

select @ProductStock= t.ProductStock from [Canteen].[CanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterStartDate
--select * from [Canteen].[CanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistories]



insert into #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
	(ProductWiseStock)
	select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStock,',')

 

DECLARE 
@ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)


DECLARE cursor_product_display CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product_display;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product_display INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
			--print '-----'
			--print @ProductCurrentStock


			select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

						select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				IF @FilterStartdate >@OutLetWiseDateArchive
				Begin
					select @OpeningOutletID =   substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,36)
				end 
				--,( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				--select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				--( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				--)


		--print @CurrentProduct_ID
		--print @CurrentProduct_stock
		--print @FilterStartProductAvgCost

		insert into #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterStartDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID


	        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product_display INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product_display;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product_display;



Insert into #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
	(
		ProductID,
		ProductName ,
		OpeningBalance ,
		OpeningAvgAmount,
		PQty ,
		Prate ,
		SQty ,
		SaleRate ,
		TPAmount ,
		TSaleamnt ,
		Closingbalance 
	)

	  
		
select T.ProductID, T.ProductName,sum(T.OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance,sum(OpeningAvgAmount) OpeningAvgAmount,
 sum(PQty) PQty, sum(Prate) Prate, 
	sum(SQty) SQty, sum(SaleRate) SaleRate, 
	sum(TPAmount) TPAmount, sum(TSaleamnt) TSaleamnt, sum(Closingbalance) Closingbalance

FROM 
(
	select i.Id ProductID,  i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount, 0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance
	from 
	Canteen.Items i
	
	union all

	select i.Id ProductID,i.Name [ProductName], sum(t.FilterStartDateStock) OpeningBalance, sum(t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) OpeningAvgAmount, 0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance  
	from #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
	join Canteen.Items i on i.id = t.productid
	where ((t.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and @FilterStartDate >@OutLetWiseDateArchive )
	group by i.Id,i.Name

	union all

	select i.Id ProductID,i.Name [ProductName], sum(t.FilterStartDateStock) OpeningBalance, sum(t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) OpeningAvgAmount, 0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance  
	from #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
	join Canteen.Items i on i.id = t.productid
	where  @FilterStartDate <=@OutLetWiseDateArchive
	group by i.Id,i.Name
	
	-- Purchase Information
	union all

	select i.Id ProductID,i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount , sum(rd.Qty) PQty, convert(decimal(10,2), sum(rd.PurchaseRate * rd.Qty)/sum(rd.Qty)) Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance  
			from
				Canteen.StockReceiveRecords r
				join Canteen.StockReceiveRecordDetails rd on rd.StockReceiveId=r.Id
				join Canteen.Items i on i.Id = rd.itemid
			where convert(date,r.RDate) >= @FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,r.RDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			AND (r.CanteenOutLetId=@OutletId OR @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			group by i.Name,i.Id

	-- Sales Information

	union all
				select ProductID,[ProductName],
				 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount,0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
				 sum(SQty),
				sum(SaleRate)/  sum(SQty) ,
				 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance
				 from 
				 (

							select i.Id ProductID,i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount,0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
							(rd.Qty) SQty, 
							(rd.Qty) * Canteen.FnGetItemWisePurchaseRate (i.id,r.Invdate) SaleRate, 
							--convert(decimal(10,2), sum( Canteen.FnGetItemWisePurchaseRate (i.id,r.Invdate) * rd.Qty)/sum(rd.Qty)) SaleRate, 
							0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance

							from
							Canteen.SaleInvoices r
							join Canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails rd on rd.InvoiceId=r.Id
							join Canteen.Items i on i.Id = rd.ProductId
						where convert(date,r.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
						and   convert(date,r.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
						AND (r.CanteenOutLetId=@OutletId OR @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and r.IsDeleted=0
					)T
					group by T.ProductName,T.ProductID
			--group by i.Name,i.Id,r.Invdate


			

)T
group by T.ProductName,T.ProductID

select (
select * from 
(
select 				
		Autoid ,
		gg.Name GroupName,
		ProductName ,
		round(OpeningBalance,2)OpeningBalance ,
		round(OpeningBalance,2) * round(OpeningAvgAmount,2) OpeningTotalAmount,
		round(PQty,2)PQty ,
		round(Prate,2)Prate ,
		round(SQty,2)SQty ,
		round(SaleRate,2) SaleRate,
		round(PQty,2) * round(Prate,2)  TPAmount ,
		round(SQty,2) *round(SaleRate,2)  TSaleamnt ,
		round(OpeningBalance,2) + round(PQty,2) - round(SQty,2) Closingbalance ,
		(round(OpeningBalance,2) * round(OpeningAvgAmount,2)) + (round(PQty,2) * round(Prate,2)) - (round(SQty,2) *round(SaleRate,2)) ClosingTotalAmount
		

 from #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History  t
 join [Canteen].[Items] ii on ii.Id = t.ProductID
 join [Canteen].[Groups] gg on gg.id = ii.Groupid
 where (OpeningBalance<>0 or PQty<>0 or SQty<>0)   
 )T 
 FOR JSON AUTO )as Data

drop table #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
drop table #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
drop table  #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory

END



GO

	union all

	select i.Id ProductID,i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount , sum(rd.Qty) PQty, convert(decimal(10,2), sum(rd.PurchaseRate * rd.Qty)/sum(rd.Qty)) Prate, 
	0 SQty, 0 SaleRate, 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance  
			from
				Canteen.StockReceiveRecords r
				join Canteen.StockReceiveRecordDetails rd on rd.StockReceiveId=r.Id
				join Canteen.Items i on i.Id = rd.itemid
			where convert(date,r.RDate) >= @FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,r.RDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			AND (r.CanteenOutLetId=@OutletId OR @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			group by i.Name,i.Id

	-- Sales Information

	union all
				select ProductID,[ProductName],
				 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount,0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
				 sum(SQty),
				sum(SaleRate)/  sum(SQty) ,
				 0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance
				 from 
				 (

							select i.Id ProductID,i.Name [ProductName], 0 OpeningBalance, 0 OpeningAvgAmount,0 PQty, 0 Prate, 
							(rd.Qty) SQty, 
							(rd.Qty) * Canteen.FnGetItemWisePurchaseRate (i.id,r.Invdate) SaleRate, 
							--convert(decimal(10,2), sum( Canteen.FnGetItemWisePurchaseRate (i.id,r.Invdate) * rd.Qty)/sum(rd.Qty)) SaleRate, 
							0 TPAmount, 0 TSaleamnt, 0 Closingbalance

							from
							Canteen.SaleInvoices r
							join Canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails rd on rd.InvoiceId=r.Id
							join Canteen.Items i on i.Id = rd.ProductId
						where convert(date,r.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
						and   convert(date,r.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
						AND (r.CanteenOutLetId=@OutletId OR @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and r.IsDeleted=0
					)T
					group by T.ProductName,T.ProductID
			--group by i.Name,i.Id,r.Invdate


			

)T
group by T.ProductName,T.ProductID

select (
select * from 
(
select 				
		Autoid ,
		gg.Name GroupName,
		ProductName ,
		round(OpeningBalance,2)OpeningBalance ,
		round(OpeningBalance,2) * round(OpeningAvgAmount,2) OpeningTotalAmount,
		round(PQty,2)PQty ,
		round(Prate,2)Prate ,
		round(SQty,2)SQty ,
		round(SaleRate,2) SaleRate,
		round(PQty,2) * round(Prate,2)  TPAmount ,
		round(SQty,2) *round(SaleRate,2)  TSaleamnt ,
		round(OpeningBalance,2) + round(PQty,2) - round(SQty,2) Closingbalance ,
		(round(OpeningBalance,2) * round(OpeningAvgAmount,2)) + (round(PQty,2) * round(Prate,2)) - (round(SQty,2) *round(SaleRate,2)) ClosingTotalAmount
		

 from #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History  t
 join [Canteen].[Items] ii on ii.Id = t.ProductID
 join [Canteen].[Groups] gg on gg.id = ii.Groupid
 where (OpeningBalance<>0 or PQty<>0 or SQty<>0)   
 )T 
 FOR JSON AUTO )as Data

drop table #TempSP_Get_Current_Canteen_Stock_Date_Wise_History
drop table #tempCanteenStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
drop table  #tempCanteenStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory

END



GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetDateWiseMemberDueCollectionInvoices]
	@from Date,
	@to Date
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		inv.InvoiceNo,
		isnull(m.Name, '') MemberName,
		isnull(u.UserName, '') PreparedBy,
		inv.Due,
		inv.Discount,

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDChangedMealReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE      PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetIPDChangedMealReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId,12. OutletId, 13. IPDMealtypeID

---exec [Canteen].[SpGetIPDChangedMealReport]'2025-01-15,2025-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN



DECLARE		
	@UserID UniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@MealTypeid uniqueIdentifier,
	@Floorid uniqueIdentifier,
	@TempInvoiceNo nvarchar(max),
	@TempMealTypeid nvarchar(max),
	@ItemName nvarchar(max)

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @MealTypeid=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
	Select @Floorid=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14;

	
	select *
	into #TempSaleInvoices
	from Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	where convert(date,si.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and  convert(date,si.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
	AND si.IsDietChanged=1
	
	 

		select  si.Invdate [ChangedDateAndTime],
		si.InvoiceNo InvoiceNumber, 
		convert(nvarchar(max),'') RoomNumber,
		si.FoodPatternName [FoodPattern], 
		convert(nvarchar(max),'') [ItemName],
		SI.Remarks Remarks
		,isnull(U.UserName,'')  [UserNameDietNutrition],
		mt.Name [IPDTypeReport],
		mt.id MTID,
		f.Name  [FloorsName]
		,f.id [FloorID],
		SI.ServType,
		fd.Status,
		ir.InvoiceNo irInvoiceNo
		,
		--isnull(Ufd.UserName,'')  
		'' [DietitianName],
		mt.Name AS MealType -----------------New added
		into #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList
		from 
		#TempSaleInvoices si
		JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
		JOIN Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ii ON ii.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
		JOIN  Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd ON fd.IPDFoodIndentId=ii.Id
		JOIN Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Name=si.MealType
		Join [Identity].[Users] U on U.Id = si.UserId
		--Join [Identity].[Users] Ufd on Ufd.Id = fd.ReviewedByUserId
		join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords r on r.PatientId = ir.id and IsOccupiedByPatient=1
		join Hospital.cabins c on c.id = r.CabinId
		join Hospital.Floors f on f.id = c.FloorId
		--and fd.Status ='Served'
		--and (mt.id =@MealTypeid or @MealTypeid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		--AND SI.ServType <> 'Room Service'
		group by   si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo,U.FullName,si.FoodPatternName ,mt.Name,mt.OrderValue,ir.InvoiceNo,mt.Id,
		SI.Remarks,f.Name,f.id,fd.Status,SI.ServType,fd.Status,si.UserId,u.UserName
		--,Ufd.UserName
		,mt.Name

		
		


		select * 
		into #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise
		from #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList t
		where  t.Status ='Served'
		and (t.MTID =@MealTypeid or @MealTypeid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		and (t.floorid =@Floorid or @Floorid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		AND t.ServType <> 'Room Service'
	

		

			
		update #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise set
		RoomNumber =
		(
			SELECT top 1 CabinNo
			FROM Hospital.RegRecords
			INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ON Hospital.RegRecords.UHID = Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.UHID
			INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ON Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.Id = Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.PatientId
			INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins ON Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.CabinId = Hospital.Cabins.Id
			WHERE   Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.InvoiceNo = #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise.irInvoiceNo  and Hospital.Cabins.CabinTypeId<>'5E070277-BB3F-46AF-8FEB-422A47330C3D'
			order by Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.AllocationDateTime desc
		)


		 
DECLARE names_cursor CURSOR Read_Only
FOR
select distinct i.Name +'['+ Convert(nvarchar(max),fdd.Qty) +']',si.InvoiceNo,mt.id
	from Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	JOIN #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise t on t.InvoiceNumber = si.InvoiceNo
	JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
	JOIN Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ii ON ii.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
	JOIN Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd ON fd.IPDFoodIndentId=ii.Id
	JOIN canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails fdd on fdd.InvoiceId =si.id
	JOIN canteen.Items i on i.Id  = fdd.ProductId  
	JOIN Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Name=si.MealType
	
	OPEN names_cursor FETCH NEXT
	FROM names_cursor INTO @ItemName,@TempInvoiceNo,@TempMealTypeid WHILE @@Fetch_status = 0 BEGIN
			update #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise set
			ItemName =isnull(ItemName,'') +' '+@ItemName 
			where InvoiceNumber = @TempInvoiceNo and mtid = @TempMealTypeid
			
	FETCH NEXT
	FROM names_cursor INTO @ItemName,@TempInvoiceNo,@TempMealTypeid END 
	CLOSE names_cursor 
	DEALLOCATE names_cursor 

	
	select (
	select * from (
	select CONVERT(DATETIME,ChangedDateAndTime) ChangedDateAndTime,
		 InvoiceNumber, 
		 RoomNumber,
		 [FoodPattern], 
		 [ItemName],
		ISNULL(Remarks,'') Remarks,
		[UserNameDietNutrition],
		[FloorsName],
		[DietitianName],
		'' IndentNo,
		t.MealType


	from #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise t 
	) tbl
	order by RoomNumber
		for json auto
	) as Data

		drop table #TempSaleInvoices
		drop table #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList
		drop table #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise
		
		return 

	
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentDetailByFromAndTo]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

---------EXEC [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentDetailByFromAndTo] '2024-09-01', '2024-12-25'
CREATE PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentDetailByFromAndTo] @StartDate DATETIME
	,@EndDate DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT fi.Id
		,fi.IPDPatientId
		,fi.CabinNo
		,fi.CabinType
		,fi.IndentDateTime
		,fi.CanteenOutLetId IndentToOutletId
		,ci.Name OutletName
		,fi.UserId
		,fi.IndentNo
		,fi.Priority
		,fi.STATUS
		,u.UserName
		,CAST(CASE 
				WHEN fi.Priority = 0
					THEN 'Routine'
				WHEN fi.Priority = 1
					THEN 'Emergency'
				WHEN fi.Priority = 2
					THEN 'Critical Care'
				ELSE 'Others'
				END AS NVARCHAR) AS PriorityText
		,pd.FullName
		,ISNULL(CASE 
				WHEN pd.AgeYear <> ''
					THEN pd.AgeYear + 'Y '
				ELSE pd.AgeYear
				END + CASE 
				WHEN pd.AgeMonth <> ''
					THEN pd.AgeMonth + 'M '
				ELSE pd.AgeMonth
				END + CASE 
				WHEN pd.AgeDay <> ''
					THEN pd.AgeDay + 'D'
				ELSE pd.AgeDay
				END, '') AS Age
		,pd.InvoiceNo
		,fp.Name FoodPatternName
		,d.Name AssignedDoctorName
		,fi.Remarks
		,fi.Qty
		,st.Name StatusTxt
	FROM [Canteen].[IPDFoodIndents] fi
	LEFT JOIN [Canteen].[CanteenOutlets] ci ON fi.CanteenOutLetId = ci.Id
	LEFT JOIN [Identity].[Users] u ON fi.UserId = u.Id
	LEFT JOIN [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd ON fi.IPDPatientId = pd.Id
	LEFT JOIN [Nutrition].[FoodPatternGroups] fp ON fp.Id = fi.FoodPatternGroupId
	LEFT JOIN [Admin].[ServeTypes] st ON fi.STATUS = st.Id
	LEFT JOIN [Marketing].[Doctors] d ON pd.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE, fi.IndentDateTime) >= CONVERT(DATE, @StartDate)
		AND CONVERT(DATE, fi.IndentDateTime) <= CONVERT(DATE, @EndDate)
	ORDER BY fi.IndentDateTime DESC
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentRecordByDate]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--------- EXEC [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentRecordByDate] '2025-07-30','2025-07-30', 1
CREATE  Procedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentRecordByDate]
	@EntryDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@GetType int
as begin 
with cte as (select ca.PatientId, c.CabinNo, ct.CabinType, f.Id FloorId, f.Name FloorName from Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ca 
	INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
	INNER JOIN Hospital.Floors f on c.FloorId=f.Id 
	INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id
	and ca.AllocationOrder = (select max(AllocationOrder) from Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords where PatientId = ca.PatientId))


select fi.Id,fi.IPDPatientId,
 cte.CabinNo,
 cte.CabinType,
fi.IndentDateTime,fi.CanteenOutLetId IndentToOutletId,ci.Name OutletName, fi.UserId,fi.IndentNo,fi.Priority,fi.Status,u.UserName,
	CAST(case when fi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when fi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when fi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,st.Name StatusTxt,fi.IsContinue,fi.FoodPatternGroupId,pg.Name FoodPatternGroupName,fi.Qty,pr.FullName,fi.Remarks,fi.IsRead,fi.StoppedDate
			  ,pr.InvoiceNo, iif(CAST(fi.LastViewDate as Date) = CAST(GETDATE() as Date), fi.LastViewedMealOrder, 0) LastViewedMealOrder, fi.LastViewDate,fi.LastChangedDate,
			  cte.FloorId, cte.FloorName,
			  fi.IsDietChanged
	from [Canteen].[IPDFoodIndents] fi inner join
		 [Canteen].[CanteenOutlets] ci on fi.CanteenOutLetId=ci.Id inner join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on fi.UserId=u.Id left join
		 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on fi.Status=st.Id left join
		 [Nutrition].[FoodPatternGroups] pg on pg.Id=fi.FoodPatternGroupId left join
		 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on fi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id 
		 left join cte on pr.Id = cte.PatientId
		 
	where (CONVERT(date, fi.IndentDateTime)>=CONVERT(date, @EntryDate) and CONVERT(date, fi.IndentDateTime)<=CONVERT(date, @ToDate)
	
	and @GetType=0) or @GetType=1 and pr.DischargeByUserId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
	-- and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1)
	order by fi.IndentDateTime DESC
 
end 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentRecordById]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


--EXEC [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentRecordById] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE  Procedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDFoodIndentRecordById]
	@Id uniqueidentifier
as begin 
select fi.Id,fi.IPDPatientId,c.CabinNo,ct.CabinType,fi.IndentDateTime,fi.CanteenOutLetId IndentToOutletId,ci.Name OutletName, fi.UserId,fi.IndentNo,fi.Priority,fi.Status,u.UserName,
	CAST(case when fi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when fi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when fi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,st.Name StatusTxt,fi.IsContinue,fi.FoodPatternGroupId,pg.Name FoodPatternGroupName,fi.Qty,pr.FullName,fi.Remarks,fi.IsRead,fi.StoppedDate
			  ,pr.InvoiceNo,fi.LastViewedMealOrder,fi.LastViewDate,fi.LastChangedDate,f.Id FloorId,f.Name FloorName,fi.IsDietChanged
	from [Canteen].[IPDFoodIndents] fi inner join
		 [Canteen].[CanteenOutlets] ci on fi.CanteenOutLetId=ci.Id inner join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on fi.UserId=u.Id left join
		 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on fi.Status=st.Id left join
		 [Nutrition].[FoodPatternGroups] pg on pg.Id=fi.FoodPatternGroupId left join
		 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on fi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id INNER JOIN
		 Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON pr.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
		 Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id INNER JOIN 
		 Hospital.Floors f on c.FloorId=f.Id INNER JOIN
		 Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id
	where (fi.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1)

 
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleInvoiceByDatesOrId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleInvoiceByDatesOrId] '2025-07-09', '2025-07-09', '72f611d8-dc45-4017-55ab-08ddbee642b4'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleInvoiceByDatesOrId]
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime,
	@Id as uniqueidentifier
as begin 

	SELECT si.Id
		,si.DailySerial
		,si.InvoiceNo
		,si.Invdate
		,isnull(fd.ReviewedAt, fd.CreatedOn) ReviewedAt
		,isnull(pr.InvoiceNo, 0) PatientInvNo
		,pr.FullName PatientName
		,si.ReceivedTK
		,si.ChangeTK
		,si.TotalTK
		,si.DiscountTK
		,si.GrandTK
		,u.UserName
		,si.VatInTk
		,si.DueTK
		,Hospital.GetCabinNumber(pr.Id) CabinNo
		,si.InvoicePrefix
		,isnull(lm.NAME, sr.EmployeeName) EmployeeName
		,si.CustomerType CustomerType
		,si.SaleCancelReason SaleCancelReason
		,si.Remarks
		,si.FoodPatternName
		,si.MealType
		,si.IsDeleted
		,si.IsDietChanged
		,si.AfterDischargeCleared
		,o.Name OutletName
	FROM [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] si
		left join Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd on fd.Id = si.FoodDeliverableId
		left join Canteen.CanteenOutlets o on o.Id = si.CanteenOutLetId
		LEFT JOIN [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr ON si.IPDPatientRecordId = pr.Id
		LEFT JOIN [Identity].[Users] u ON si.UserId = u.Id
		LEFT JOIN [Account].[LoyalMembers] lm ON si.LoyalMemberId = lm.Id
		LEFT JOIN [HR].[StaffRecords] sr ON si.StaffRecordId = sr.Id
	WHERE (
			(
				@Id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				AND (
					CONVERT(DATE, si.Invdate) BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate)
						AND CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate)
					)
				AND pr.Id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				)
			OR (si.Id = @Id)
			)


end 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO





CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReport]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN


DECLARE		
	@UserID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5;


	--SELECT @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserID

	select (
		select  si.Invdate [DteTime],si.InvoiceNo  [InvoiceNumber],
		dbo.GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge(ir.InvoiceNo) RoomNumber,
		[Canteen].[GetItemInvoiceWise](si.InvoiceNo,'ItemAndQty') [ItemName]
	
		,sum(si.GrandTK) Price,U.FullName [UserNameCafetaria]
		from 
		Canteen.SaleInvoices si
		Join [Identity].[Users] U on U.Id = si.UserId
		JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
		where convert(date,si.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
		and  convert(date,si.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
		and si.IndentNo = 0
		group by   si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo,U.FullName,ir.InvoiceNo
		order by si.InvoiceNo 
		for json auto ) as Data
END



GO

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId,12. OutletId, 13. IPDMealtypeID

--exec [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--exec [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,25472308-9C2E-45D5-1E33-08DBFEC16DBB'
AS
BEGIN



DECLARE		
	@UserID UniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@MealTypeid uniqueIdentifier,
	@Floorid uniqueIdentifier,
	@TempInvoiceNo nvarchar(max),
	@TempMealTypeid nvarchar(max),
	@ItemName nvarchar(max)

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @MealTypeid=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
	Select @Floorid=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14;

	
	select *
	into #TempSaleInvoices
	from Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	where convert(date,si.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and  convert(date,si.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
	AND si.IsDietChanged<>1
	
	 

		select  si.Invdate [DateAndTime],si.InvoiceNo InvoiceNumber, 
		--dbo.GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge(ir.InvoiceNo) RoomNumber,
		convert(nvarchar(max),'') RoomNumber,
		si.FoodPatternName [FoodPattern], 
		convert(nvarchar(max),'') [ItemName],
		SI.Remarks Remarks
		,isnull(U.UserName,'')  [UserNameDietNutrition],mt.Name [IPDTypeReport],mt.id MTID,
		f.Name  [FloorsName]
		,f.id [FloorID],
		SI.ServType,
		fd.Status,
		ir.InvoiceNo irInvoiceNo
		,
		--isnull(Ufd.UserName,'')
		'' [DietitianName]
		into #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList
		from 
		#TempSaleInvoices si
		JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
		JOIN Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ii ON ii.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
		JOIN  Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd ON fd.IPDFoodIndentId=ii.Id
		JOIN Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Name=si.MealType
		Join [Identity].[Users] U on U.Id = si.UserId
		---Join [Identity].[Users] Ufd on Ufd.Id = fd.ReviewedByUserId
		join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords r on r.PatientId = ir.id and IsOccupiedByPatient=1
		join Hospital.cabins c on c.id = r.CabinId
		join Hospital.Floors f on f.id = c.FloorId
		--and fd.Status ='Served'
		--and (mt.id =@MealTypeid or @MealTypeid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		--AND SI.ServType <> 'Room Service'
		group by   si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo,U.FullName,si.FoodPatternName ,mt.Name,mt.OrderValue,ir.InvoiceNo,mt.Id,
		SI.Remarks,f.Name,f.id,fd.Status,SI.ServType,fd.Status,si.UserId,u.UserName
		--,Ufd.UserName

		
		


		select * 
		into #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise
		from #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList t
		where  t.Status ='Served'
		and (t.MTID =@MealTypeid or @MealTypeid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		and (t.floorid =@Floorid or @Floorid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		AND t.ServType <> 'Room Service'

		

			
		update #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise set
		RoomNumber =
		(
			SELECT top 1 CabinNo
			FROM Hospital.RegRecords
			INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ON Hospital.RegRecords.UHID = Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.UHID
			INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ON Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.Id = Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.PatientId
			INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins ON Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.CabinId = Hospital.Cabins.Id
			WHERE   Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.InvoiceNo = #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise.irInvoiceNo  and Hospital.Cabins.CabinTypeId<>'5E070277-BB3F-46AF-8FEB-422A47330C3D'
			order by Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.AllocationDateTime desc
		)


		 
DECLARE names_cursor CURSOR Read_Only
FOR
select distinct i.Name +'['+ Convert(nvarchar(max),fdd.Qty) +']',si.InvoiceNo,mt.id
	from Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	JOIN #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise t on t.InvoiceNumber = si.InvoiceNo
	JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
	JOIN Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ii ON ii.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
	JOIN Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd ON fd.IPDFoodIndentId=ii.Id
	JOIN canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails fdd on fdd.InvoiceId =si.id
	JOIN canteen.Items i on i.Id  = fdd.ProductId  
	JOIN Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Name=si.MealType
	
	OPEN names_cursor FETCH NEXT
	FROM names_cursor INTO @ItemName,@TempInvoiceNo,@TempMealTypeid WHILE @@Fetch_status = 0 BEGIN
			update #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise set
			ItemName =isnull(ItemName,'') +' '+@ItemName 
			where InvoiceNumber = @TempInvoiceNo and mtid = @TempMealTypeid
			
	FETCH NEXT
	FROM names_cursor INTO @ItemName,@TempInvoiceNo,@TempMealTypeid END 
	CLOSE names_cursor 
	DEALLOCATE names_cursor 

	
	select (
	select * from (
	select * from #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise t 
	) tbl
	order by RoomNumber
		for json auto
	) as Data

		drop table #TempSaleInvoices
		drop table #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList
		drop table #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise
		
		return 

	
END
GO

--exec [Canteen].[SpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, , ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,25472308-9C2E-45D5-1E33-08DBFEC16DBB'
AS
BEGIN



DECLARE		
	@UserID UniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@MealTypeid uniqueIdentifier,
	@Floorid uniqueIdentifier,
	@TempInvoiceNo nvarchar(max),
	@TempMealTypeid nvarchar(max),
	@ItemName nvarchar(max)

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @MealTypeid=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
	Select @Floorid=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14;

	
	select *
	into #TempSaleInvoices
	from Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	where convert(date,si.Invdate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and  convert(date,si.Invdate) <= @FilterEndDate
	AND si.IsDietChanged<>1
	
	 

		select  si.Invdate [DateAndTime],si.InvoiceNo InvoiceNumber, 
		--dbo.GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge(ir.InvoiceNo) RoomNumber,
		convert(nvarchar(max),'') RoomNumber,
		si.FoodPatternName [FoodPattern],

		,isnull(U.UserName,'')  [UserNameDietNutrition],mt.Name [IPDTypeReport],mt.id MTID,
		f.Name  [FloorsName]
		,f.id [FloorID],
		SI.ServType,
		fd.Status,
		ir.InvoiceNo irInvoiceNo
		,
		isnull(Ufd.UserName,'')  [DietitianName]
		into #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWiseList
		from 
		#TempSaleInvoices si
		JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
		JOIN Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ii ON ii.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
		JOIN  Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd ON fd.IPDFoodIndentId=ii.Id
		JOIN Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Name=si.MealType
		Join [Identity].[Users] U on U.Id = si.UserId
		Join [Identity].[Users] Ufd on Ufd.Id = fd.ReviewedByUserId
		join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords r on r.PatientId = ir.id and IsOccupiedByPatient=1
		join Hospital.cabins c on c.id = r.CabinId
		join Hospital.Floors f on f.id = c.FloorId
		--and fd.Status ='Served'
		--and (mt.id =@MealTypeid or @MealTypeid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
		--AND SI.ServType <> 'Room Service'
		group by   si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo,U.FullName,si.FoodPatternName ,mt.Name,mt.OrderValue,ir.InvoiceNo,mt.Id,
		SI.Remarks,f.Name,f.id,fd.Status,SI.ServType,fd.Status,si.UserId,u.UserName
		,Ufd.UserName

		
		


		select *

		update #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise set

			FROM Hospital.RegRecords
			INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ON Hospital.RegRecords.UHID = Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.UHID
			INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ON Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.Id = Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.PatientId
			INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins ON Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.CabinId = Hospital.Cabins.Id
			WHERE   Hospital.IPDPatientRecords.InvoiceNo = #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise.irInvoiceNo  and Hospital.Cabins.CabinTypeId<>'5E070277-BB3F-46AF-8FEB-422A47330C3D'
			order by Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords.AllocationDateTime desc
		)


		 
DECLARE names_cursor CURSOR Read_Only
FOR
select distinct i.Name +'['+ Convert(nvarchar(max),fdd.Qty) +']',si.InvoiceNo,mt.id
	from Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	JOIN #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise t on t.InvoiceNumber = si.InvoiceNo
	JOIN Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir ON ir.id=si.IPDPatientRecordId
	JOIN Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ii ON ii.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
	JOIN Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd ON fd.IPDFoodIndentId=ii.Id
	JOIN canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails fdd on fdd.InvoiceId =si.id
	JOIN canteen.Items i on i.Id  = fdd.ProductId  
	JOIN Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Name=si.MealType
	
	OPEN names_cursor FETCH NEXT
	FROM names_cursor INTO @ItemName,@TempInvoiceNo,@TempMealTypeid WHILE @@Fetch_status = 0 BEGIN
			update #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise set
			ItemName =isnull(ItemName,'') +' '+@ItemName 
			where InvoiceNumber = @TempInvoiceNo and mtid = @TempMealTypeid
			
	FETCH NEXT
	FROM names_cursor INTO @ItemName,@TempInvoiceNo,@TempMealTypeid END 
	CLOSE names_cursor 
	DEALLOCATE names_cursor 

	
	--select (
	--select * from (
	select * from #TempSpGetIPDSaleReportMealTypesWise t 
	--) tbl
	--	for json auto

-- exec Canteen.SpGetMemberDueCollectionInvoice 0

Create     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetMemberDueCollectionInvoice]
	@InvoiceNo bigint
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		inv.InvoiceNo,
		isnull(m.Name, '') MemberName,
		isnull(u.UserName, '') PreparedBy,
		inv.Due,
		inv.Discount,
		inv.ReceivedAmount,
		isnull(inv.Remarks,'') Remarks,
		inv.CreatedOn ReceiveDate
	from [Canteen].[MemberDueCollectionInvoices] inv
	join [Identity].Users u on inv.UserId = u.Id
	join Account.LoyalMembers m on m.Id = inv.MemberId
	where inv.InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo = 0
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetMemberDueInvoicesByMemberId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- EXEC [Canteen].[SpGetMemberDueInvoicesByMemberId] '3F9B73B4-FA24-4040-C51E-08DD3EA55E52', '2025-01-27', '2025-01-27'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetMemberDueInvoicesByMemberId]
	@loyalMemberId as uniqueidentifier,
	@From as Date,
	@To as Date
as 
begin 
	select * from (select 
		inv.Id InvoiceId,
		inv.InvoiceNo,
		(select sum(Debit) from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lm where lm.InvoiceNo = inv.InvoiceNo and lm.TransactionType = 'Sale') TotalSale,
		isnull((select sum(Credit) from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lm where lm.InvoiceNo = inv.InvoiceNo and lm.TransactionType = 'Discount'),0) Discount,
		isnull((select sum(Credit) from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lm where lm.InvoiceNo = inv.InvoiceNo and lm.TransactionType in ('pay for due collection', 'recieved on sale')),0) TotalPaid,
		isnull((select sum(Debit - Credit) from Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lm where lm.InvoiceNo = inv.InvoiceNo),0) TotalDue
	from  Canteen.SaleInvoices inv
	where inv.LoyalMemberId = @loyalMemberId 
		and Cast(inv.Invdate as Date) between @From and @To
		and inv.IsDeleted = 0
	group by inv.InvoiceNo, inv.Id) t where t.TotalDue > 0;
end 



GO

CREATE    PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SPGetOutletWiseTotalVatCollectionReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId,12. OutletId, 13. IPDMealtypeID

---exec [Canteen].[SPGetOutletWiseTotalVatCollectionReport]'2025-01-15,2025-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE		
	@UserID UniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@OutletID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER


	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @OutLetID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12

		select (
	select * from (

	SELECT si.InvoiceNo AS InvoiceNo, CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) AS InvoiceDate, si.TotalTK AS TotalTK,
	si.VatInTk AS VAT, si.GrandTK AS GrandTK, ISNULL(si.DiscountTK,0) AS DiscountTK
	FROM Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	AND (si.CanteenOutLetId=@OutletID OR @OutletID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (si.UserId=@UserID OR @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and si.IsDeleted<>1
		) tbl
		WHERE tbl.VAT>0
		ORDER BY tbl.InvoiceNo

		for json auto
	) as Data

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SPGetPoductWiseSaleReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SPGetPoductWiseSaleReport]
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@ItemId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
			SELECT 
			--id,
			ProductName, SUM(SaleQty) SaleQty,(PurchaseRate) PurchaseRate, (SaleRate) SaleRate,
			SUM(SaleQty) * (SaleRate) TotalSaleAmount
			FROM 
			(
					SELECT 
					--ISNULL(i.id,0) id,
					i.Name ProductName, SID.Qty SaleQty, SID.PurchaseRate AS PurchaseRate,SID.SaleRate AS SaleRate
					FROM Canteen.SaleInvoices si
					JOIN Canteen.SaleInvoiceDetails sid ON sid.InvoiceId=si.id
					JOIN Canteen.Items i ON i.id=sid.ProductId
					WHERE CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate and
					CONVERT(date,si.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate AND 
					(i.id=@ItemId OR @ItemId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			)T
			GROUP BY --t.id,
			t.ProductName, T.PurchaseRate,T.SaleRate
			order by ProductName
END



GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetPurchaseStatement]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetPurchaseStatement]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId

--exec [Canteen].[SpGetPurchaseStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	Declare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDate date
	Declare @SupplierId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

	select (

		select 
			ProductId,
			ProductName,
			sum(Qty) Qty,
			sum(round(PurchaseRate,2)) PurchaseRate,
			sum(Qty) * sum(round(PurchaseRate,2)) GrandTotal,
			SupplierName
				from 
				(
				Select i.Id ProductId,i.Name ProductName, srd.Qty Qty, srd.PurchaseRate PurchaseRate, s.Name SupplierName
				from Canteen.StockReceiveRecords sr
				join Canteen.StockReceiveRecordDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
				join Canteen.Items i on i.Id=srd.ItemId
				join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s on s.Id=sr.SupplierId
				where isnull(convert(date,sr.RDate),'') >=@FilterStartDate and isnull(convert(date,sr.RDate),'') <=@FilterEndDate
				and (s.Id=@SupplierId or @SupplierId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				)T
				group by t.ProductId, t.ProductName, T.SupplierName
				FOR JSON AUTO) As Data  
				
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetReviewedIPDFoodIndentRecordByDateAndMealType]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





--3c83a568-2bf6-4ad3-9392-47825705f4bf
--EXEC [Canteen].[SpGetReviewedIPDFoodIndentRecordByDateAndMealType] '2025-06-17',0, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetReviewedIPDFoodIndentRecordByDateAndMealType]
	@ReviewedDate datetime,
	@MealTypeOrder INT=0,
	@MealTypeId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@FloorId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
as begin 

with cte as( select c.Id CabinId, c.FloorId FloorId, Ir.Id PatientId  from 
Hospital.IPDPatientRecords Ir inner join
Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ICAR  on Ir.Id = ICAR.PatientId inner join
Hospital.Cabins c on ICAR.CabinId = c.Id and ICAR.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1)

select fi.Id,fi.IPDPatientId,fi.CabinNo,fi.CabinType,fi.IndentDateTime,fi.CanteenOutLetId IndentToOutletId,ci.Name OutletName, 
fi.UserId,fi.IndentNo,fi.Priority,fi.Status,u.UserName,
	CAST(case when fi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when fi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when fi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,st.Name StatusTxt,fi.IsContinue,
			  fi.FoodPatternGroupId,pg.Name FoodPatternGroupName,fi.Qty,pr.FullName,
			  fd.Remarks,fi.IsRead,fi.StoppedDate
			  ,pr.InvoiceNo,fi.LastViewedMealOrder,
			  
			  
			  --fi.LastViewDate LastViewDate, ---It was first
			--CASE
			--WHEN fd.LastModifiedOn IS NOT NULL THEN fd.LastModifiedOn   
			--ELSE fd.CreatedOn
			--END AS LastViewDate,---------3rd
			  fd.CreatedOn LastViewDate, -----2nd
			  uu.UserName ReviewedBy, ------------Reviewed By
			  STRING_AGG(i.Name,', ') ItemsName
			  ,mt.Name AS MealType
	from [Canteen].[IPDFoodIndents] fi inner join
		 [Canteen].[CanteenOutlets] ci on fi.CanteenOutLetId=ci.Id inner join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on fi.UserId=u.Id left join
		 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on fi.Status=st.Id left join
		 [Nutrition].[FoodPatternGroups] pg on pg.Id=fi.FoodPatternGroupId left join
		 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on fi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id left join
		 [Nutrition].[FoodDeliverables] fd on fi.Id=fd.IPDFoodIndentId and (fd.MealTypeId=@MealTypeId OR @MealTypeId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

		join [Identity].[Users] uu on fd.ReviewedByUserId=uu.Id ------------For reviewed BY
		left JOIN [Nutrition].[FoodDeliverableDetails] fdd on fd.Id=fdd.FoodDeliverableId 
		left JOIN [Canteen].[Items] i on fdd.ItemId=i.Id
		JOIN  Nutrition.MealTypes mt ON mt.Id=fd.MealTypeId left Join
		  cte on pr.Id = cte.PatientId

	where convert(date, @ReviewedDate)=convert(date, fd.CreatedOn) AND ------------There was fi.LastViewDate
	(cte.FloorId = @FloorId or @FloorId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (i.Name <>'')
	--AND (fi.LastViewedMealOrder=@MealTypeOrder OR @MealTypeOrder=0)
	group by fi.Id,fi.IPDPatientId,fi.CabinNo,fi.CabinType,fi.IndentDateTime,fi.CanteenOutLetId,ci.Name, fi.UserId,fi.IndentNo,fi.Priority,fi.Status,u.UserName,
	         fi.Priority,st.Name,fi.IsContinue,fi.FoodPatternGroupId,pg.Name,fi.Qty,pr.FullName,fd.Remarks,fi.IsRead,fi.StoppedDate,fd.MealTypeId,mt.Name
			  ,pr.InvoiceNo,fi.LastViewedMealOrder,
			  --fi.LastViewDate--,
			  uu.UserName, ----------------Reviewed BY
			  fd.CreatedOn,
			  fd.LastModifiedOn
			  
			  ORDER BY fi.CabinNo
 
end 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SpGetSaleInvoiceDetailByInvoiceNo]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- Exec [Canteen].[SpGetSaleInvoiceDetailByInvoiceNo] 2507300000009,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',''

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SpGetSaleInvoiceDetailByInvoiceNo]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@ServeType varchar(50),
	@IsDeleted int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
		SELECT si.InvoiceNo,sum(id.TotalPrice) TotalInvoicePrice ,max(si.VatInTk) VatInInvoiceTk
		into #TempSpGetSaleInvoiceDetailByInvoiceNo
			FROM [Canteen].[SaleInvoiceDetails] id INNER JOIN
				 [Canteen].[Items] i ON i.Id=id.ProductId INNER JOIN
				 [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] si ON id.InvoiceId=si.Id left JOIN
				 [Account].[LoyalMembers] lm ON lm.Id = si.LoyalMemberId
			WHERE (si.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0) and (si.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId or @PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	--and (si.ServType=@ServeType or @ServeType='') --and (si.IsDeleted=0 or @IsDeleted=1) 
	group by si.InvoiceNo
	IF @InvoiceNo>0 
		BEGIN  
			SELECT id.Id,id.InvoiceId,i.Name Item,id.ProductId,id.Qty,id.PurchaseRate,id.SaleRate,id.TotalPrice,id.Discount,
			--si.VatInTk,
			ROUND((tt.VatInInvoiceTk *id.TotalPrice)/ tt.TotalInvoicePrice,2) VatInTk,
			id.IsDeleted,lm.Name as LoyalmemberName,si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo
			--,tt.TotalInvoicePrice,tt.VatInInvoiceTk,
	
			FROM [Canteen].[SaleInvoiceDetails] id INNER JOIN
				 [Canteen].[Items] i ON i.Id=id.ProductId INNER JOIN
				 [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] si ON id.InvoiceId=si.Id left JOIN
				 [Account].[LoyalMembers] lm ON lm.Id = si.LoyalMemberId
				 JOIN #TempSpGetSaleInvoiceDetailByInvoiceNo tt ON tt.InvoiceNo = si.InvoiceNo
			WHERE (si.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0) and 
			(si.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId or @PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
			--AND (si.ServType='Room Service')
			--and (si.ServType=@ServeType or @ServeType='') and (si.IsDeleted=0 or @IsDeleted=1)
			order by si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo, id.CreatedOn
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN


	
	SELECT id.Id,id.InvoiceId,i.Name Item,id.ProductId,id.Qty,id.PurchaseRate,id.SaleRate,id.TotalPrice,id.Discount,
	--si.VatInTk,
	ROUND((tt.VatInInvoiceTk *id.TotalPrice)/ tt.TotalInvoicePrice,2) VatInTk,
	id.IsDeleted,lm.Name as LoyalmemberName,si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo
	--,tt.TotalInvoicePrice,tt.VatInInvoiceTk,
	
	FROM [Canteen].[SaleInvoiceDetails] id INNER JOIN
		 [Canteen].[Items] i ON i.Id=id.ProductId INNER JOIN
		 [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] si ON id.InvoiceId=si.Id left JOIN
		 [Account].[LoyalMembers] lm ON lm.Id = si.LoyalMemberId
		 JOIN #TempSpGetSaleInvoiceDetailByInvoiceNo tt ON tt.InvoiceNo = si.InvoiceNo
	WHERE (si.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0) and 
	(si.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId or @PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	AND (si.ServType='Room Service')
	--and (si.ServType=@ServeType or @ServeType='') 
	and (si.IsDeleted<>1)
	order by si.Invdate,si.InvoiceNo 
		END
    

	
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- EXEC [Canteen].[SpGetServedIPDFoodIndentRecordByDate] '2025-07-30','2025-07-30'

CREATE  Procedure [Canteen].[SpGetServedIPDFoodIndentRecordByDate]
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime
as begin 
select fi.Id,fi.IPDPatientId,c.CabinNo,ct.CabinType,fi.IndentDateTime,fi.CanteenOutLetId IndentToOutletId,ci.Name OutletName, fi.UserId,fi.IndentNo,fi.Priority,fi.Status,u.UserName,
	CAST(case when fi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when fi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when fi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,
			  st.Name StatusTxt,
			  fi.IsContinue,
			  fi.FoodPatternGroupId,
			  pg.Name FoodPatternGroupName,
			  fi.Qty,pr.FullName,
			  fi.Remarks,
			  fi.IsRead,
			  fi.StoppedDate
			  ,si.InvoiceNo, 
			  iif(fd.LastModifiedOn is null, fd.CreatedOn, fd.LastModifiedOn) ReviewDateTime, 
			  fd.ServedAt,
			  isnull(fd.ReviewedAt, fd.CreatedOn) as ReviewedAt,
			  fi.LastViewedMealOrder,
			  si.Invdate LastViewDate,
			  fi.LastChangedDate,
			  f.Id FloorId,
			  f.Name FloorName,
			  fi.IsDietChanged,
			  si.MealType
			  
	from [Canteen].[IPDFoodIndents] fi inner join
		 [Canteen].[SaleInvoices] si on fi.IndentNo=si.IndentNo 
		 left join Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd on fd.Id = si.FoodDeliverableId
		 inner join [Canteen].[CanteenOutlets] ci on fi.CanteenOutLetId=ci.Id inner join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on fi.UserId=u.Id left join
		 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on fi.Status=st.Id left join
		 [Nutrition].[FoodPatternGroups] pg on pg.Id=fi.FoodPatternGroupId left join
		 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on fi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id  INNER JOIN
		 Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON pr.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
		 Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id INNER JOIN 
		 Hospital.Floors f on c.FloorId=f.Id INNER JOIN
		 Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id
		 
	where CONVERT(date, si.Invdate)>=CONVERT(date, @DateFrom) and
	CONVERT(date, si.Invdate)<=CONVERT(date, @DateTo) and fi.IsContinue=1 
	and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1)
	order by fi.IndentDateTime DESC
end 
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Canteen].[SPGetUserWiseCollectionSummaryDateWise]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================


CREATE       PROCEDURE [Canteen].[SPGetUserWiseCollectionSummaryDateWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@productname, 10.FilterTypeId, 11. LoyalMemberId,12. OutletId, 13. IPDMealtypeID

---exec [Canteen].[SPGetUserWiseCollectionSummaryDateWise]'2025-01-15,2025-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE		
	@UserID UniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@OutLetID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER


	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @OutLetID=  Convert(UniqueIdentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12

		select (
	select * from (

						SELECT 
						CollectionDate, SUM(TotalTK) TotalTK , SUM(VAT) VAT , SUM(GrandTK) GrandTK ,SUM(DiscountTK) DiscountTK,
						SUM(ReceivedTK) ReceivedTK, SUM(TotalDueCollection) TotalDueCollection, SUM(ChangeTK) ChangeTK,
						ISNULL(SUM(ReceivedTK),0) + ISNULL(SUM(TotalDueCollection),0) - isnull(SUM(ChangeTK),0)  AS NetReceivedTK
	
						FROM
								(
						SELECT  CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) AS CollectionDate, SUM(si.TotalTK) AS TotalTK,
						SUM(si.VatInTk) AS VAT, SUM(si.GrandTK) AS GrandTK, ISNULL(SUM(si.DiscountTK),0) AS DiscountTK,ISNULL(SUM(si.ReceivedTK),0) AS ReceivedTK,
						0 TotalDueCollection,ISNULL(SUM(si.ChangeTK),0) AS ChangeTK,0 NetReceivedTK
						FROM Canteen.SaleInvoices si
						WHERE CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
						AND (si.CanteenOutLetId=@OutletID OR @OutletID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND (si.UserId=@UserID OR @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and si.IsDeleted<>1
						GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate)

						UNION ALL

						SELECT
							CONVERT(DATE,lml.CreatedOn) AS CollectionDate, 0 AS TotalTK,
						0 AS VAT, 0 AS GrandTK,0 AS DiscountTK,0 AS ReceivedTK,
						ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) TotalDueCollection,0 AS ChangeTK,0 NetReceivedTK
						FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
						JOIN [Identity].[Users] u
							ON u.Id = lml.UserId
						WHERE lml.TransactionType = 'pay for due collection'
						and (isnull(u.id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') >= @FilterStartDate
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') <= @FilterEndDate
						AND ((@OutletId ='7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F') 
						or (@OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
						GROUP BY lml.CreatedOn

						UNION ALL 

						SELECT
							CONVERT(DATE,lml.CreatedOn) AS CollectionDate, 0 AS TotalTK,
						0 AS VAT, 0 AS GrandTK,ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) AS DiscountTK,0 AS ReceivedTK,
						0 TotalDueCollection,0 AS ChangeTK,0 NetReceivedTK

							
						FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
						JOIN [Identity].[Users] u
							ON u.Id = lml.UserId
							and (isnull(u.id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						WHERE lml.TransactionType='discount for due collection'
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') >= @FilterStartDate
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') <= @FilterEndDate
						AND ((@OutletId ='7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F') 
						or (@OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
						GROUP BY lml.CreatedOn

						
						)T
						GROUP BY T.CollectionDate
						--ORDER BY T.CollectionDate

		) tbl
		ORDER BY tbl.CollectionDate
		for 
		
		json auto
	) as Data

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--------exec [Canteen].[UserWisereport] '2024-12-11','2024-12-11','','7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Canteen].[UserWisereport]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserName nvarchar(max),
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @PayForDueSiscount decimal(18,2)
DECLARE @disforduecollection decimal(18,2)

IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#TempCollection') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
DROP TABLE #TempCollection
END

CREATE TABLE #TempCollection
(
UserName nvarchar(20)
, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
, TotalSale decimal(18,2)
, Discount decimal(18,2)
, ReceivedTk decimal(18,2)
, ChangeTK decimal(18,2)
, NetReceived decimal(18,2)
) ;



			SELECT *
			into #TempUserWisereportCanteenReport
			FROM(
				SELECT tbl1.InvoiceID,SUM(TotalSale)TotalSale,
				SUM(Discount) Discount, SUM(ReceivedTk)ReceivedTk, ChangeTK
				FROM (
					select i.Id InvoiceID, 
					CASE WHEN sl.TransactionType=0 THEN convert(decimal(18,2),isnull(sl.Debit,0)) ELSE 0 END  TotalSale, 
					CASE WHEN sl.TransactionType=1 THEN convert(decimal(18,2),isnull(sl.Credit,0)) ELSE 0 END   Discount,
					CASE WHEN sl.TransactionType=2 THEN convert(decimal(18,2),isnull(sl.Credit,0)) ELSE 0 END   ReceivedTk, 
					convert(decimal(18,2),isnull(i.ChangeTK,0)) ChangeTK
			 
					--
					from Canteen.SaleInvoices i
					join Canteen.SaleLedgers sl on sl.InvoiceId=i.Id 
					join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=sl.UserId
					where isnull(convert(date,i.Invdate),'') >=@FilterStartDate and
					isnull(convert(date,i.Invdate),'') <=@FilterEndDate 
					and (isnull(u.UserName,'')=@UserName or @UserName='')
					AND (@OutletId=i.CanteenOutLetId OR @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					and i.IsDeleted<>1
				)tbl1 GROUP BY tbl1.InvoiceID,ChangeTK
			)Tbl

			

			select u.id UserID,u.FullName UserName,id.InvoiceID InvoiceID
			into #TempInvoiceWiseUserInfor
			from Canteen.SaleLedgers id
			join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=id.UserId
			join #TempUserWisereportCanteenReport t on t.InvoiceId  = id.InvoiceId
			group by u.id,u.FullName,id.InvoiceID

			

			IF(@UserName='')
			BEGIN
			

						 INSERT INTO #TempCollection 
				SELECT *
					
						FROM(

						SELECT
							u.FullName AS UserName,
							lml.UserId,
							0 TotalSale,
							0 Discount,
							ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) ReceivedTk,
							0 ChangeTK,
							0 NetReceived
						FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
						JOIN [Identity].[Users] u
							ON u.Id = lml.UserId
						WHERE lml.TransactionType = 'pay for due collection'
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') >= @FilterStartDate
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') <= @FilterEndDate
						AND ((@OutletId ='7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F') 
						or (@OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
						GROUP BY u.FullName,lml.UserId
						UNION
						SELECT
							u.FullName AS UserName,
							lml.UserId,
							0 TotalSale,
							ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) Discount,
							0 ReceivedTk,
							0 ChangeTK,
							0 NetReceived
						FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
						JOIN [Identity].[Users] u
							ON u.Id = lml.UserId
						WHERE lml.TransactionType='discount for due collection'
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') >= @FilterStartDate
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') <= @FilterEndDate
						AND ((@OutletId ='7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F') 
						or (@OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
						GROUP BY U.FullName,lml.UserId
						) tblCollection

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #TempCollection 
						SELECT *
						FROM(

						SELECT
							u.FullName AS UserName,
							lml.UserId,
							0 TotalSale,
							0 Discount,
							ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) ReceivedTk,
							0 ChangeTK,
							0 NetReceived
						FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
						JOIN [Identity].[Users] u
							ON u.Id = lml.UserId
						WHERE lml.TransactionType = 'pay for due collection'
						and (isnull(u.UserName,'')=@UserName or @UserName='')
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') >= @FilterStartDate
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') <= @FilterEndDate
						AND ((@OutletId ='7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F') 
						or (@OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
						GROUP BY u.FullName,lml.UserId
						UNION
						SELECT
							u.FullName AS username,
							lml.UserId,
							0 TotalSale,
							ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) Discount,
							0 ReceivedTk,
							0 ChangeTK,
							0 NetReceived
						FROM Account.LoyalMemberLedgers lml
						JOIN [Identity].[Users] u
							ON u.Id = lml.UserId
							and (isnull(u.UserName,'')=@UserName or @UserName='')
						WHERE lml.TransactionType='discount for due collection'
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') >= @FilterStartDate
						AND ISNULL(CONVERT(DATE, lml.CreatedOn), '') <= @FilterEndDate
						AND ((@OutletId ='7A4E92D1-C136-4799-BCAA-4DAFFE19E88F') 
						or (@OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
						GROUP BY u.FullName,lml.UserId
						) tblCollection
		END

	SELECT * INTO #TempInvoiceWiseUser FROM(	
	select  
	UserName,
	sum(TotalSale) TotalSale,
	ISNULL(ISNULL(sum(Discount),0)+ ISNULL(@disforduecollection,0),0) Discount,
	ISNULL(ISNULL(sum (ReceivedTk),0)+ISNULL(@PayForDueSiscount,0),0) ReceivedTk,
	ISNULL(sum(ChangeTK),0) ChangeTK,
	ISNULL(ISNULL(sum (ReceivedTk),0)+ISNULL(@PayForDueSiscount,0) - sum(ChangeTK),0) NetReceived
	from
	(
			select  
			A.*,U.UserID,u.UserName
			from  #TempUserWisereportCanteenReport A
			join #TempInvoiceWiseUserInfor u on u.InvoiceID = A.InvoiceID
	)T
	group by t.UserName
	)tbl


	SELECT UserName
		  ,SUM(TotalSale) TotalSale
		  ,SUM(Discount) Discount
		  ,SUM(ReceivedTk) ReceivedTk
		  ,SUM(ChangeTK) ChangeTK
		  ,SUM(NetReceived ) NetReceived
		   FROM (
	SELECT 
	UserName
		  ,TotalSale
		  ,Discount
		  ,ReceivedTk
		  ,ChangeTK
		   ,Discount+ReceivedTk AS NetReceived 
	FROM #TempCollection tc
	UNION 
	SELECT UserName
		  ,TotalSale
		  ,Discount
		  ,ReceivedTk
		  ,ChangeTK
		  , NetReceived 
		  FROM
	#TempInvoiceWiseUser
	) t1 
	GROUP BY t1.UserName
	--,TotalSale,Discount,ReceivedTk,ChangeTK
END
GO

insert into HealthCareArchiveData.dbo.DailyDatabaseMonitorTask
SELECT TOP 50000 
    p.name AS [ProcedureName],
    qs.total_worker_time AS [TotalCPUTime],
    qs.total_worker_time / qs.execution_count AS [AvgCPUTimePerExec],
    qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_logical_reads AS [TotalLogicalReads],
    qs.total_logical_reads / qs.execution_count AS [AvgLogicalReadsPerExec],
    qs.total_elapsed_time / qs.execution_count AS [AvgElapsedTimePerExec],
    qs.total_elapsed_time AS [TotalElapsedTime],
    qs.last_execution_time,
	'Stored Procedures with High CPU Usage'
FROM 
    sys.dm_exec_procedure_stats AS qs
JOIN 
    sys.procedures AS p ON qs.object_id = p.object_id
where convert(date,qs.last_execution_time)= DATEADD(day,-1,@CurrentDate)
ORDER BY 
    [TotalCPUTime] DESC;


insert into HealthCareArchiveData.dbo.DailyDatabaseMonitorTask
	SELECT TOP 50000 
    p.name AS [ProcedureName],
	qs.total_worker_time AS [TotalCPUTime],
    qs.total_worker_time / qs.execution_count AS [AvgCPUTimePerExec],
	qs.execution_count,
	qs.total_logical_reads AS [TotalLogicalReads],
    qs.total_logical_reads / qs.execution_count AS [AvgLogicalReadsPerExec],
    qs.total_elapsed_time / qs.execution_count AS [AvgElapsedTimePerExec],
    qs.total_elapsed_time AS [TotalElapsedTime],
    qs.last_execution_time,
	'Stored Procedures with High Memory Usage'
	
FROM 
    sys.dm_exec_procedure_stats AS qs
JOIN 
    sys.procedures AS p ON qs.object_id = p.object_id
ORDER BY 
    [TotalLogicalReads] DESC;


END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAcknowledgedSamplesPatients]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDateTime datetime,
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	Select * from  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] where Id in  
	   (SELECT distinct [InvoiceId] from [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sc where sc.SampleReceiveDateTime>=@StartDate and  sc.SampleReceiveDateTime<=@EndDateTime
	  )  Or (Id = @InvoiceId or Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
END

--Create this Sp at the zkbiotime db
-----------------------------------------------


--exec [dbo].[GetAttendanceData] '2022-01-01', '2023-02-02'
Create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAttendanceData]
@FromDate DateTime,
@ToDate DateTime
AS
BEGIN
select ct.emp_code EmployeeCode,ct.terminal_sn MachineSerialNo,ct.punch_time EntryTime,
CAST(case when ct.punch_state=0 then punch_time else null end as datetime) as InTimeNormal,
CAST(case when ct.punch_state=1 then punch_time else null end as datetime) as OutTimeNormal,
CAST(case when ct.punch_state=4 then punch_time else null end as datetime) as InTimeOverTime,
CAST(case when ct.punch_state=5 then punch_time else null end as datetime) as OutTimeOverTime
from dbo.iclock_transaction ct
where ct.punch_time>=@FromDate and ct.punch_time<=@ToDate
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetDiagStatmentForAppView]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDiagStatmentForAppView]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@datefrom date,
	@dateto date,
	@UHID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

	With Cte_Ledger
	as(
	
	   Select l.InvestigationInvoiceId, Sum(l.Debit) as Amount from [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l where
	   
	   l.InvestigationInvoiceId in (Select Id from [Diag].InvestigationInvoices where UHID=@UHID and EntryDate>=@datefrom and EntryDate<=@dateto)
	   and
	   l.TransactionType=0 group by l.InvestigationInvoiceId
	
	)

	SELECT inv.Id, inv.InvoiceNo, inv.EntryDate as InvoiceDate, l.Amount,u.UserName,inv.InvestigationIndentId from [Diag].InvestigationInvoices inv join Cte_Ledger l on inv.Id=l.InvestigationInvoiceId join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on inv.UserId=u.Id

END
GO
