GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





----- Patient Statement Web ------

-- Exec [dbo].[SP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydateWise] '2023-01-01','2024-01-11','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','OPD'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydateWise]
@DateFrom date,
@DateTo date,
@OperatorBy UniqueIdentifier ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
@InvoiceType nvarchar(10) ='All'
AS
BEGIN


SELECT i.Id [Patient], l.TransactionType,l.Debit,l.Credit,l.TranDate,i.EntryDate,
pc.Name [PaymentChannelsName],
pm.Name [PaymentModename],
pc.id [PaymentChannelsId],
pm.Id [PaymentModeId]

into #TempSP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydate

FROM [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] l JOIN [Diag].InvestigationInvoices i ON l.InvestigationInvoiceId = i.ID

left join [admin].[PaymentChannels] pc  on pc.Id = l.PaymentChannelId
left join [admin].[PaymentModes] pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId

WHERE convert(date,l.TranDate) BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo 
AND (l.UserId = @OperatorBy OR @OperatorBy ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
AND ( 
		(isnull(i.IPDPatientRecordId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @InvoiceType ='OPD') 
	OR	(isnull(i.IPDPatientRecordId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND @InvoiceType ='IPD')
	OR	@InvoiceType ='All'
	)


 SELECT 
 CONVERT(UniqueIdentifier,[Patient]) [PatientId], P.InvoiceNo  BillNo,p.fullname--, p.CancelRemarks
 
 , CONVERT(float,sum(T.[Total Sales])) [TotalSales] , CONVERT(float,sum(T.[Total Due])) [TotalDue] ,

   case when p.EntryDate >=@DateFrom and p.EntryDate <=@DateTo then
  CONVERT(float,sum([Total Discount])) +  CONVERT(float,sum([Total Discount Due Cal]))
  else CONVERT(float,sum([Total Discount])) end

 [Discount],
 case when p.EntryDate >=@DateFrom and p.EntryDate <=@DateTo then 0
 else
 CONVERT(float,sum([Total Discount Due Cal]))
  end
  [TotalDiscountDueCal],
 CONVERT(float,sum(T.[Total Discount])+ sum([Total Discount Due Cal])) [TotalDiscount],

 CONVERT(float,sum(T.[Total Sales]) - sum(T.[Total Discount]) - sum([Total Discount Due Cal]) -sum(T.[Total Due]))
 
 [TotalWithoutDisc], CONVERT(float,sum([Total Refund])) [cashRefund],
 CONVERT(float,sum([Discount Refunded])) [DiscountRefunded],
 
 sum([Total Refund]) + sum([Discount Refunded]) AS [RefundTk],
 CONVERT(float,sum([Discount Refunded])) [DiscountWithdraw],
 CONVERT(float,sum(T.[Total Sales]) - sum(T.[Total Discount]) - sum([Total Discount Due Cal]) - sum([Total Refund]) - sum([Discount Refunded])-sum(T.[Total Due])) NetPayable,
 CONVERT(float,sum([Due Collection]+T.DueCollecCard+T.DueCollecMobile)) DueCollection,
 
 Sum(T.DueCollecCard) DueCollecCard,

 Sum(T.DueCollecMobile) DueCollecMobile,
 case when p.EntryDate >=@DateFrom and p.EntryDate <=@DateTo then
Sum(T.[Due Collection]+T.DueCollecCard+T.DueCollecMobile)
 else 0 end [RunningDueCollec],

  case when p.EntryDate >=@DateFrom and p.EntryDate <=@DateTo then
Sum(T.[Due Collection])
 else 0 end [RunningDueCollecCash],

 case when p.EntryDate >=@DateFrom and p.EntryDate <=@DateTo then
Sum(T.DueCollecCard)
 else 0 end [RunningDueCollecCard],

 case when p.EntryDate >=@DateFrom and p.EntryDate <=@DateTo then
Sum(T.DueCollecMobile)
 else 0 end [RunningDueCollecMobile],
case when p.EntryDate <@DateFrom then
Sum(T.[Due Collection])
else 0 end
[PreviousDueCollecCash],

case when p.EntryDate <@DateFrom then
Sum(T.DueCollecCard)
else 0 end
[PreviousDueCollecCard],

case when p.EntryDate <@DateFrom then
Sum(T.DueCollecMobile)
else 0 end
[PreviousDueCollecMobile],

 CONVERT(float,sum([OnEntryPayment])) OnEntryPayment,

 CONVERT(float,sum(T.[OnEntryPayment]) - sum([Total Refund]) ) PaidAmount ,
  CONVERT(float,sum(T.[MobilePayment])) MobilePayment ,
  CONVERT(float,sum(T.[CardPayment])) CardPayment ,
 CONVERT(float,sum([TestCancelled])) [TestCancelled],CONVERT(float,sum([TestCancelled])-sum([Discount Refunded])-sum([Total Refund])) AOC --Adjustment On Cancel
 ,EntryDate,
 (
 --select sum(t.cost) from  TestsCost t where t.PatientId = [Patient] and isnull(status,'') <> 'Cancelled'
 0
 ) [Total Cost]

FROM (


-- Total Patient Count

select 
DISTINCT t.[Patient] [Patient], 0 AS [Total Sales],0 AS [Total Due],0 AS [Total Discount],
0 AS [Total Discount Due Cal],0 AS [Total Refund],0 AS [Discount Refunded],0 AS [Due Collection],
0 AS [OnEntryPayment] , 0 as MobilePayment, 0 as CardPayment,  0 as [TestCancelled],0 as DueCollecCard, 0 as DueCollecMobile 
from #TempSP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydate t 


--2 Total Sales Count 

UNION ALL

SELECT T.[Patient] AS [Total Patient] ,sum(debit-Credit) [Total Sales], 
0 AS [Total Due],0 AS [Total Discount],
 0 AS [Total Discount Due Cal],0 AS [Total Refund],
 0 AS [Discount Refunded],
 0 AS [Due Collection],
 0 AS [OnEntryPayment] ,
 0 as MobilePayment, 0 as CardPayment, 0 as [TestCancelled],0 as DueCollecCard, 0 as DueCollecMobile

FROM #TempSP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydate t
WHERE t.TranDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
AND t.EntryDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
AND TransactionType in(0) --'TestCost'
 GROUP BY T.[Patient]

 -- 3 Total Due Count

 UNION ALL


 SELECT a.[Patient] AS [Total Patient] , 0 [Total Sales],
 sum(debit)-sum(Credit) AS [Total Due],0 [Total Discount], 0 [Total Discount Due Cal],0 AS [Total Refund],
 0 AS
 [Discount Refunded],0 AS [Due Collection],0 AS [OnEntryPayment] ,  
 0 as MobilePayment, 0 as CardPayment, 0 as [TestCancelled] ,0 as DueCollecCard, 0 as DueCollecMobile
 FROM #TempSP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydate a

 WHERE a.EntryDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND a.TranDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
 AND a.[Patient] IN ( SELECT p.[Patient] from
 #TempSP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydate p
 WHERE 
 p.TranDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo 
 ) GROUP BY a.[Patient]

 --  4  Total Discount  -- 5  [Total Discount Due Cal]  -- 6 [Total Refund]
 -- 7 [Discount Refunded] -- 8 [TestCancelled] -- 10 [OnEntryPayment]
 -- 11 MobilePayment --12 DueCollecMobile  --13 CardPayment --13 DueCollecMobile
 --14 DueCollecCard

 UNION ALL

SELECT T.[Patient] AS [Total Patient] ,0 [Total Sales], 0  AS [Total Due],
case when T.TransactionType = 1 then sum(Credit-Debit) else 0 end AS [Total Discount],
---- Discount
----  AND TransactionType in( 'DiscountOnRegularCollection')-- ,'DiscountRefunded')
case when T.TransactionType = 0 then sum(Credit) else 0 end AS [Total Discount Due Cal],
--- ????  DiscountOnDueCollection
----AND TransactionType = 'DiscountOnDueCollection'
case when T.TransactionType = 5 then sum(debit) else 0 end AS [Total Refund],
---- Refund
----AND TransactionType = 'DiscountOnDueCollection'
case when T.TransactionType = 6 then sum(debit) else 0 end AS [Discount Refunded],
--DiscountAdjustment
----AND (TransactionType = 'DiscountRefunded'
case when T.TransactionType = 3 and  isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0) =1  then sum(credit) else 0 end AS [Due Collection],
---- DueCollection
----AND TransactionType in ('DueCollection', 'IPDC')
case when T.TransactionType = 2 and  isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0) =1  then sum(Credit) else 0 end AS [OnEntryPayment],
----Payment
----AND TransactionType = 'OnEntryPayment'
case when T.TransactionType = 2 and  isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0) =3  then sum(Credit) else 0 end AS [MobilePayment],
----AND TransactionType in( 'PaymentbyMobileBanking' ,'MobilePayment')
case when T.TransactionType = 2 and  isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0) =2  then sum(Credit) else 0 end AS [CardPayment],
----AND TransactionType in( 'PaymentbyCard','CardPayment')
case when T.TransactionType = 4 then sum(credit) else 0 end AS [TestCancelled],
----AND (TransactionType = 'DiscountRefunded'
case when T.TransactionType =  3 and  isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0) =2 then sum(credit) else 0 end AS [DueCollecCard],
---- AND TransactionType in( 'DueCollectionByMobile')
case when T.TransactionType =  3 and  isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0) =3 then sum(credit) else 0 end AS [DueCollecMobile]
---- TransactionType in( 'DueCollectionByMobileBanking','DueCollectionByMobile')

FROM #TempSP_Diag_Income_Statement_ByEntrydate t
 
WHERE t.TranDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo --AND t.EntryDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
GROUP BY T.[Patient],T.TransactionType,isnull(T.[PaymentChannelsId],0),isnull(T.PaymentModeId,0)

--------    AND TransactionType = 'DiscountOnDueCollection'

)T 
join [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] p on p.Id = T.Patient
GROUP BY T.[Patient], p.InvoiceNo, p.fullname ,p.EntryDate
ORDER BY T.[Patient], p.InvoiceNo, p.fullname--, p.CancelRemarks
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[SP_Get_Outdoor_Service_Sharing_Sheet]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-----------exec SP_Get_Outdoor_Service_Sharing_Sheet '2022-01-01','2023-12-01','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Get_Outdoor_Service_Sharing_Sheet]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEnddate   date,
	@ConsultantID uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	Declare @NewVisitDoctor float=200 
	Declare @NewVisitHospital float=100
	
	Declare @OldVisitDoctor float=130 
	Declare @OldVisitHospital float=70
	
	DEclare @DoctorPercent float =60
	Declare @HospitalPercent float =40
	select  
	'1st Visit',sum(d.qty),d.rate, sum(d.qty) * d.rate [Total],sum(d.qty)*@NewVisitDoctor [DoctorAmount] ,sum(d.qty)*@NewVisitHospital [HospitalAmount]
	--v.name,d.qty,d.rate ,d.*
	from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
	join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
	join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id 
	where v.name ='OPDNew'
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) <=@FilterEnddate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by v.name,d.rate
	
	UNION ALL


	select  
	'2nd Visit',sum(d.qty),d.rate, sum(d.qty) * d.rate [Total],sum(d.qty)*@OldVisitDoctor [DoctorAmount] ,sum(d.qty)*@OldVisitHospital [HospitalAmount]
	--v.name,d.qty,d.rate ,d.*
	from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
	join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
	join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id 
	where v.name ='OPDOld'
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) <=@FilterEnddate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by v.name,d.rate



	select *,([Total]*@DoctorPercent)/100 [DoctorAmount]
	,([Total]*@HospitalPercent)/100 [HospitalAmount]
	from 
	(
		select h.headname ,sum(o.qty) Nocast,o.rate,sum(o.qty) *o.Rate [Total]
		from hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg --on s.id = sg.servicesubgroupid
		join hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.servicesubsubgroupid =sg.id
		join opd.ServiceDetails o on o.serviceid = h.id
		join opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op on op.Id=o.PatientId
		where sg.id =57
		and convert(date,op.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,op.EntryDate) <=@FilterEnddate
		and (o.ServiceByDoctorId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		group by h.headname,o.rate
	)T
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetAdmittedPatientsForFinalBill]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAdmittedPatientsForFinalBill]
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		p.Id,
		p.UHID,
		p.InvoiceNo,
		p.FullName,
		d.Name + ' ' + d.ProfessionalIdentity1 as AssignedDoctorName,
		p.IsNotified, 
		p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		rr.MobileNo,
		c.CabinNo
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
		join Hospital.RegRecords rr on p.UHID = rr.UHID
		join Marketing.Doctors d on d.Id = p.AssignedDoctorId
		JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		
	where p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetBrandDetailsSummaryList]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec spGetBrandDetailsSummaryList '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'na', 0

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetBrandDetailsSummaryList]
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier,
	@filter nvarchar(10),
	@limit int
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT -- top (@limit)
		bd.ProductId, 
		bd.ProductName, 
		ISNULL(
		lr.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		) AS LotId, 
		ISNULL(lr.BatchNo, '') AS BatchNo, 
		ISNULL(lr.ExpireDate, '') AS ExpireDate, 
		ISNULL(cs.CurrentStock, 0) AS CurrentStock, 
		bd.PurchasePrice, 
		bd.SalePrice, 
		bd.Manufacturer, 
		bd.Generic, 
		bd.GenericId, 
		bd.PkgUnit, 
		bd.QtyPerBox, 
		ISNULL(ro.ROL, 0) AS ROL, 
		ISNULL(
		cs.OutLetId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		) AS OutLetId, 
		bd.ManufacturerId, 
		bd.FormationId, 
		bd.IsActive 
	FROM 
		Pharmacy.BrandDetails AS bd 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN Pharmacy.ViewCurrentStock AS cs ON bd.ProductId = cs.BrandExtensionId 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN Pharmacy.LotRecords AS lr ON cs.LotRecordId = lr.Id 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN Pharmacy.ROLRecords AS ro ON bd.ProductId = ro.BrandExtensionId AND cs.OutLetId = ro.OutletId 
	WHERE (cs.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and (bd.IsActive = 1) ----and cs.CurrentStock > 0 -- and bd.ProductName like '%' + @filter + '%'
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetDatabaseDatasetByStudyInstanceId] 
	@StudyInstanceUId nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	select dd.Id,dd.PatientId,dd.PatientName,dd.PatientBirthdate,dd.PatientSex,dd.AccessionNumber,dd.StudyDescription,dd.SeriesDescription,dd.StudyId,dd.StudyDate,dd.SeriesDate,dd.Modality

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetDoctorAppointmets]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@datefrom date,
	@dateto date,
	@UHID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	
	Select d.Name as DoctorName, da.AppointmentDate,da.AppointmentTime, vt.Name as VisitType, da.Fee from [OPD].[DoctorAppointments] da join [Marketing].Doctors d
	on da.DoctorId=d.Id  Join [OPD].PatientVisitTypes vt on da.VisitTypeId=vt.Id  where [AppointmentDate]>=@datefrom and  [AppointmentDate]<=@datefrom and ([UHID]=@UHID or 0=@UHID)


END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetEmergencyServiceChargesDynamic]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec spGetEmergencyServiceChargesDynamic ''

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetEmergencyServiceChargesDynamic]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

	Declare @HospitalShareInPercent int
	Declare @DepartemntShareInPercent int
	Declare @DoctorShareFromDeptInPercent int
	Declare @NurseShareFromDeptInPercent int

	Select @HospitalShareInPercent=  HospitalShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	Select @DepartemntShareInPercent=  DepartmnetShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	Select @DoctorShareFromDeptInPercent=  DoctorShareFromDepartmentInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	Select @NurseShareFromDeptInPercent=  NurseShareFromDepartmentInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	
	Select h.HeadName as [Procedure], '' as ProcedureWeight, r.Rate as Fee, (r.Rate*@HospitalShareInPercent)/100 as Hospital,
	(r.Rate*@HospitalShareInPercent)/100 as [Emergency], '60%' Hospital, '40%' Emergency, (((r.Rate*@HospitalShareInPercent)/100) * @DoctorShareFromDeptInPercent)/100 as Doctor,
	(((r.Rate*@HospitalShareInPercent)/100) * @NurseShareFromDeptInPercent)/100 as Nurse 
	from [Hospital].ServiceExecutingHeads h join [Hospital].ServiceExecutingHeadRates r on h.Id=r.ServiceExecutingHeadId Join [Hospital].ServiceSubSubGroups sssg
	on h.ServiceSubSubGroupId=sssg.Id Join [Hospital].ServiceSubGroups ssg on ssg.ServiceGroupId=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
	Join [Hospital].ServiceGroups sg on sg.Id=ssg.ServiceGroupId where sg.Id=2

END

Create   procedure [dbo].[spGetHandOverSheetFormsByPatientsId]
	@patientIds nvarchar(max)
as 
begin
	select 
		f.Id FormId,
		p.Id PatientId,
		f.Fields
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
		join EMR.HandOverSheetForms f on f.DepartmentId = p.DeptId
		where @patientids like '%' + CAST(p.Id as nvarchar(100)) +'%'
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetHandOverSheets]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--------------------------------


-- exec spGetHandOverSheets '2025-01-01', '2025-12-20'

CREATE       procedure [dbo].[spGetHandOverSheets]
	@from Date,
	@to Date
as 
Begin
	select 
		s.Id,
		p.Id PatientId,
		p.InvoiceNo,
		p.UHID,
		d.Name Department,
		p.FullName PatientName,
		([Hospital].[GetCabinNumber](p.Id)) CabinNo,
		p.AgeYear,
		rr.Sex Gender,
		isnull(cru.UserName,'') CreatedBy,
		isnull(u.UserName,'') UpdatedBy,
		(select ct.CabinType from Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ca 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = ca.CabinId
			join Hospital.CabinTypes  ct on ct.Id = c.CabinTypeId
			where ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1 and PatientId = p.Id) CabinType,
		s.Data,
		p.AssignedDoctorId
	from EMR.HandOverSheets s
	join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p on s.PatientId = p.Id
	join Hospital.RegRecords rr on rr.UHID = p.UHID
	join Hospital.HDepartments d on d.Id = p.DeptId
	left join [Identity].Users cru on s.CreatedBy = cru.Id
	left join [Identity].Users u on s.LastModifiedBy = u.Id
	where s.IsDeleted = 0 and p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
End

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetIPDPatientsForSearch]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

-- exec spGetIPDPatientsForSearch '6CC9533A-1D9E-4E61-6391-08DBF5762762'
-- exec spGetIPDPatientsForSearch '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 

CREATE   PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetIPDPatientsForSearch]
	@floorId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		p.Id PatientId,
		p.FullName PatientName,
		p.UHID,
		p.InvoiceNo,
		rr.MobileNo,
		c.CabinNo,
		c.FloorId,
		p.DeptId DepartmentId
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
		join Hospital.RegRecords rr on rr.UHID = p.UHID
		join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ca on ca.PatientId = p.Id
		join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = ca.CabinId
	where DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		and rr.IsDeleted = 0
		and ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1 AND ca.AllotType = 'PAB'
		and (c.FloorId = @floorId or @floorId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')  
END
GO

---------exec [dbo].[SPGetManagementDashboardData] '2024-02-08','2020-02-01','2024-02-08',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SPGetManagementDashboardData]
@Today date,
@FilterStartDate date,
@FilterEndDate date,
@TenantID int
AS
BEGIN

	
	DECLARE 
	@Autoid bigint,
    @DashboardType [nvarchar](max) ,
	@GroupName [nvarchar](max) ,
	@TitleName [nvarchar](max) ,
	@Amount [float] ,
	@ActiveStatus [int] ,
	@Query [nvarchar](max) ;

		SELECT 
		autoid,
       [DashboardType]
      ,[GroupName]
      ,[TitleName]
      ,[Amount]
      ,[ActiveStatus]
      ,[Query]
	  INTO #TempSPGetManagementDashboardData
	  
	  FROM  [SuperAdmin].[ParameterDashboard]
	  WHERE DashBoardType= 'Management'
	  --AND GroupName <>'All Department'
	  ORDER BY autoid


DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	  SELECT 
       AutoID
	   ,[DashboardType]
      ,[GroupName]
      ,[TitleName]
      ,[Amount]
      ,[ActiveStatus]
      ,[Query]
	  FROM  [SuperAdmin].[ParameterDashboard]
	  WHERE DashBoardType= 'Management'
	  --AND GroupName <>'All Department'
	  order by Autoid

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
       @Autoid
	   ,@DashboardType
      ,@GroupName
      ,@TitleName
      ,@Amount
      ,@ActiveStatus
      ,@Query;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @MainQuery nvarchar(max)

		IF @GroupName ='All Department' 
		BEGIN
				set @Query = ' update #TempSPGetManagementDashboardData set Amount =
				(select sum(Amount) from #TempSPGetManagementDashboardData where autoid in ('+ @Query +') )
				where Autoid ='+ CONVERT(nvarchar(max),@Autoid)
				exec(@Query)
				PRINT @Query
			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
	
							set @Query = REPLACE(@Query,'@Today',@Today)
							set @Query = REPLACE(@Query,'@FilterStartDate',@FilterStartDate)
							set @Query = REPLACE(@Query,'@FilterEndDate',@FilterEndDate)
							set @Query = REPLACE(@Query,'@TenantID',@TenantID)
		


							set @MainQuery = ' update #TempSPGetManagementDashboardData set
							amount= ('+@Query+ ') where autoid ='+convert(varchar(max),@Autoid)

							IF @Autoid =4
							BEGIN
								PRINT @autoID
								--PRINT @Query
								PRINT @MainQuery
							END
								exec(@MainQuery)

								set @MainQuery =''
								set @Query =''

								print @autoID
		END
        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
           @Autoid
       ,@DashboardType
      ,@GroupName
      ,@TitleName
      ,@Amount
      ,@ActiveStatus
      ,@Query;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

		

	


	select 
	[GroupName]
      ,[TitleName]
      ,[Amount]
	from #TempSPGetManagementDashboardData
	ORDER BY AutoID


END
-- drop table #TempSPGetManagementDashboardData
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetMonthlyIncomeTaxByEmployee]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- Note SP sa like [Payroll].[SpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTax]
-- =============================================
--------exec [spGetMonthlyIncomeTaxByEmployee] '98DA1A69-DD9F-4AE2-B207-0184D833C583'

CREATE     PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetMonthlyIncomeTaxByEmployee]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StaffRecoredId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
DECLARE @EmployeeId uniqueidentifier 
set @EmployeeId = @StaffRecoredId

DECLARE @Source nvarchar(max) ='spGetMonthlyIncomeTaxByEmployee'
DECLARE @TaxYearFilter int
DECLARE @TaxMonthFilter int

select @TaxYearFilter	= YEAR(getdate())
select @TaxMonthFilter	= MONTH(getdate())

Declare @TaxStartYear int = YEAR(getdate())
Declare @TaxEndYear int = YEAR(getdate())

if(@EmployeeId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	Set @EmployeeId=null

Create Table #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate
(
AutoID int identity(1,1),
EmployeeId [uniqueidentifier],
EmployeeNo nvarchar(max),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
TaxYear int,
TaxMonth int,
NetTaxPayablePerMonth float
)



CREATE TABLE #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate(
	EmployeeId [uniqueidentifier],
	[Id] [int]  NOT NULL,
	[GroupName] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Particulars] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Amount] [float] NULL,
	[Column4] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Column5] [nvarchar](50) NULL
	)
insert into #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo ,
EmployeeName ,
TaxYear ,
TaxMonth ,
NetTaxPayablePerMonth 
)

select distinct  s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,@TaxYearFilter,@TaxMonthFilter,0
from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join [Payroll].SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab slab 
				on slab.taxyear in 
				(
					select max(Taxyear) from  [Payroll].SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab 
				)
				where (s.id = @EmployeeId or @EmployeeId is null)

			
			
			DECLARE @MaxAutoID bigint
			DECLARE @MinAutoID bigint
			DECLARE @CurrentAutoID bigint
			DECLARE @CurrentEmployeID [uniqueidentifier]
			DECLARE @NetTaxPayablePerMonth float
			
				select @MaxAutoID = max(AutoID),@MinAutoID= min(Autoid) from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate
				set @CurrentAutoID =@MinAutoID
	
				while @CurrentAutoID <= @MaxAutoID
				BEgin
						select @CurrentEmployeID= EmployeeId from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate where autoid = @CurrentAutoID
						INSERT INTO #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate
						Exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax] '2023-07-01','2024-06-30',@CurrentEmployeID,'',1,1
						
						--===================================     start  SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax     =======================================================--
						DECLARE @ProcessForIncomeTax int =0
						DECLARE @FilterEndDate date
						DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date 
							set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),Year(getdate()))+'-'+convert(varchar(2),MOnth(getdate()))+'-01')
							SELECT @FilterEndDate = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))


						CREATE TABLE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee 
						(
							[EmpID] [uniqueidentifier] NULL,
							[EmpCode] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[EmpName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[EmpNature] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[JoinDate] [date] NULL,
							[DptName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[DesigName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[BasicAmount] [float] NULL,
							[HouseRent] [float] NULL,
							[MedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ConvAllow] [float] NULL,
							[FestBonus] [float] NULL,
							[PFContrib] [float] NULL,
							[OthersAllow] [float] NULL,
							[OverTimeAllow] [float] NULL,
							[SpecialAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionBasicAmount] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionHouseRent] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionConvAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionFestBonus] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionPFContrib] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionOthersAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionOverTimeAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ExemptionSpecialAllow] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableBasicAmount] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableHouseRent] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableConvAllow] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableFestBonus] [float] NULL,
							[TaxablePFContrib] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableOthersAllow] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableOverTimeAllow] [float] NULL,
							[TaxableSpecialAllow] [float] NULL,
							[TaxYear] [int] NULL,
							[CurrentStatus] [int] NULL,
							[TotalTaxCalculation] [int] NULL,
							[Userid] [int] NULL,
							[calculationdate] [datetime] NULL,
							[calculationsource] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[TotalAmount] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[TotalExemption] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[TotalTaxableIncome] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[slabAutoid] bigint,
							IsFirstSlabthisYear int,
							[Slab] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[SlabAmount] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[SlabRate] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
							[SlabTax] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[SlabRangeMin] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[SlabRangeMax] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[MaximumLimit] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[YearWiseTaxableIncomePrecentage] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[SlabExemptionHouseRent] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[SlabExemptionMedicalAllow]  [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[SlabExemptionConvAllow]  [decimal](18, 2) NULL,

							[TaxableIncome] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[ActualInvestment] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[ApprovalAmount] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[AllowableForRebate] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[AllowforRebateAmount] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[NetTaxPayable] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
							[TaxMonth] [int] NULL,
							[TaxYearDisplay] [int] NULL,
							[ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount] int
						) 

						DECLARE @CalCurrentMonth date 

						if @ProcessForIncomeTax = 1
						begin
							set @CalCurrentMonth = @FilterEndDate
						end
						else 
						begin
							set @CalCurrentMonth = @FilterEndDate
						end

						while @CalCurrentMonth <= @FilterEndDate
						BEGIN
	
								insert into #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee
								(
								EmpID ,
								EmpCode ,
								EmpName ,
								EmpNature ,
								JoinDate ,
								DptName ,
								DesigName ,

								TaxYear ,
								CurrentStatus , -- 1 means last ; 2 -- means previous or cancel
								TotalTaxCalculation ,
								Userid ,
								calculationdate ,
								calculationsource, -- report load; New UI where tax calculation request generate ; Auto database schudle ; Process call from UI,
								slabAutoid,
								IsFirstSlabthisYear,
								Slab,
								SlabAmount,
								SlabRate,
								SlabTax,
								SlabRangeMin,
								SlabRangeMax,
								[SlabExemptionHouseRent],
								[SlabExemptionMedicalAllow],
								[SlabExemptionConvAllow],
								TaxMonth,
								TaxYearDisplay,
								ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount
								)

								select  distinct s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,s.ServiceNature EmpNature , s.JoiningDate JoinDate, d.Name DptName, dg.Name DesigName
									,year(@CalCurrentMonth),1,0,1,getdate(),@Source,
									slab.autoid,
									slab.IsFirstSlabthisYear,
									slab.SlabDisplay,
									slab.SlabAmount,
									slab.SlabRateDisplay,
									slab.SlabTax,
									slab.SlabRangeMin,
									slab.SlabRangeMax,
									[ExemptionHouseRent],
									[ExemptionMedicalAllow],
									[ExemptionConvAllow],
									month(@CalCurrentMonth),
									slab.taxyear,
									0
									from hr.StaffRecords s 
									join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
									join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
									left join payroll.SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab slab on @CalCurrentMonth between slab.slabstartdate and slab.slabenddate
									--join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets sl on sl.StaffRecordId=s.Id 
									--and sl.SalaryYear = year(@CalCurrentMonth)
									--and sl.SalaryMonth = Month(@CalCurrentMonth)
									where (s.id = @EmployeeId or @EmployeeId is null)
									order by slab.autoid


									--==================  Basic Calculation ========================--
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				BasicAmount = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p


					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount =
				isnull(round((
					select count(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId =  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0),0)
				 

				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				BasicAmount = isnull(BasicAmount,0.00) + 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount = isnull(ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount,0) +
				isnull(round((
					select count(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0),0)

			


				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				BasicAmount =
				isnull(round(BasicAmount,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(BasicAmount)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0)

	
				--==================  House Rent Calculation ========================--

				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				HouseRent = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(HouseRent) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				MedicalAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(MedAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								ConvAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Conveyence) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								PFContrib = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OthersAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Allowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OverTimeAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Overtime) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				SpecialAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(SpecialAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
					ActualInvestment = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF)*2 from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0)


				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				HouseRent = isnull(HouseRent,0.00) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(HouseRent) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				MedicalAllow = isnull(round(MedicalAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(MedAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								ConvAllow = isnull(round(ConvAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Conveyence) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								PFContrib = isnull(round(PFContrib,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OthersAllow = isnull(round(OthersAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Allowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OverTimeAllow = isnull(round(OverTimeAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Overtime) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				SpecialAllow = isnull(round(SpecialAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(SpecialAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ActualInvestment = isnull(round(ActualInvestment,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF)*2 from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0)




				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				HouseRent =
				isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(HouseRentInPercentOfBasic)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								MedicalAllow =
				isnull(round(MedicalAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								ConvAllow =
				isnull(round(ConvAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Conveyance)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								PFContrib =
				isnull(round(PFContrib,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Pf)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OthersAllow =
				isnull(round(OthersAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Others)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				SpecialAllow =
				isnull(round(SpecialAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(SpecialAllowance)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ActualInvestment =
				isnull(round(ActualInvestment,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Pf)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount ) *2  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0)



				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				FestBonus =
				 isnull(round((
					select sum(BasicAmount)* 2   from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
				),0.00),0)


							--==================  Basic Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
					update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
					ExemptionBasicAmount =0,
					ExemptionFestBonus =0,
						ExemptionPFContrib =0,
						ExemptionOverTimeAllow =0,
						ExemptionSpecialAllow =0,
						ExemptionOthersAllow =0
	
					--==================  House Rent Exemtion Taxable ========================--
					update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
					ExemptionHouseRent =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.HouseRent
					where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.HouseRent < #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionHouseRent

					update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
					ExemptionHouseRent =   #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionHouseRent
					where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.HouseRent >= #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionHouseRent

					--==================  Medical Exemtion Taxable ========================--
			
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				ExemptionMedicalAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.MedicalAllow
				where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.MedicalAllow < #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionMedicalAllow

				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				ExemptionMedicalAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionMedicalAllow 
				where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.MedicalAllow >= #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionMedicalAllow
				
			--==================  ExemptionConvAllow  Taxable ========================--
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
			ExemptionConvAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ConvAllow
			where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ConvAllow < #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionConvAllow

			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
			ExemptionConvAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionConvAllow --- #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ConvAllow
			where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ConvAllow >= #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SlabExemptionConvAllow


			--====================== Total  taxable  =========================


		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
		TaxableBasicAmount =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.BasicAmount,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionBasicAmount,0.00),0),
		TaxableHouseRent =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.HouseRent,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionHouseRent,0.00),0),
		TaxableMedicalAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.MedicalAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionMedicalAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableConvAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ConvAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionConvAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableFestBonus =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.FestBonus,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionFestBonus,0.00),0),
		TaxablePFContrib =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.PFContrib,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionPFContrib,0.00),0),
		TaxableOthersAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.OthersAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionOthersAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableOverTimeAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.OverTimeAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionOverTimeAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableSpecialAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.SpecialAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.ExemptionSpecialAllow,0.00),0)


			--======================  taxable  =========================



			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
			TotalAmount = BasicAmount + HouseRent + MedicalAllow +ConvAllow+FestBonus+PFContrib+OthersAllow+OverTimeAllow+SpecialAllow,
			TotalExemption = ExemptionBasicAmount + ExemptionHouseRent + ExemptionMedicalAllow + ExemptionConvAllow+ExemptionFestBonus+ExemptionPFContrib+ExemptionOthersAllow+ExemptionOverTimeAllow+ExemptionSpecialAllow,
			TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise = TaxableBasicAmount + TaxableHouseRent + TaxableMedicalAllow + TaxableConvAllow+TaxableFestBonus+TaxablePFContrib+TaxableOthersAllow+TaxableOverTimeAllow+TaxableSpecialAllow

			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
			TotalTaxableIncome =
			isnull(round((
				select sum(TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise)
				from 
				(
					select max(TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise) TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise 
					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee  tt
					where tt.EmpID =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
					and tt.TaxYearDisplay = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.TaxYearDisplay
					group by tt.EmpID,tt.TaxYearDisplay,tt.TaxMonth
				)T
			),0.00),0)
					

			--==========================  SlabAmount  Start =========================================--

			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
			SlabAmount =   SlabRangemax - SlabRangeMin+1,
			SlabTax    =  (slabrate * (SlabRangemax - SlabRangeMin+1))/100
			where TotalTaxableIncome > SlabRangeMin and TotalTaxableIncome >  SlabRangemax


			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
			SlabAmount =   TotalTaxableIncome - SlabRangeMin +1,
			SlabTax    =  (slabrate * (  TotalTaxableIncome -SlabRangeMin+1))/100
			where  TotalTaxableIncome > SlabRangeMin and TotalTaxableIncome <  SlabRangemax

			
			--==========================  SlabAmount  Start =========================================--

			DECLARE @TaxYear int,
			@MaximumLimit decimal(18,2),
			@YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome decimal(18,2),
			@Remarks nvarchar(max),
			@AllowableRebatePrecentage int

			select 
			@TaxYear = max(TaxYear),
			@MaximumLimit = max(MaximumLimit),
			@YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome = max(YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome),
			@AllowableRebatePrecentage = max(AllowableRebatePrecentage)
			from 
			payroll.SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab
			where TaxYear = year(@CalCurrentMonth)

					update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				[TaxableIncome]= 
				round((
					select sum(SlabTax) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee tt
					where tt.EmpID =  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.EmpID
					and tt.TaxYear = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.TaxYear
					and tt.TaxMonth =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee.TaxMonth
				),0)
		
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				[MaximumLimit] = @MaximumLimit ,
				[YearWiseTaxableIncomePrecentage] = @YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome,
				[ApprovalAmount] =[ActualInvestment],
				[AllowableForRebate] =@AllowableRebatePrecentage,
				AllowforRebateAmount =(@AllowableRebatePrecentage*[ActualInvestment])/100,
				[NetTaxPayable] = 0.00
		
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee set
				[NetTaxPayable] = [TaxableIncome] -AllowforRebateAmount

								select @CalCurrentMonth = DATEADD(Month,1,@CalCurrentMonth)
								print @CalCurrentMonth
						END
						delete from [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]

						if @ProcessForIncomeTax =0
						begin
								INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
								   ([GroupName]
								   ,[Particulars]
								   ,[Amount]
								   ,[Column4]
								   ,[Column5])
							values('A.Salary & Allowance','Basic Salary',(select max(BasicAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
							(select max(ExemptionBasicAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
							(select max(TaxableBasicAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

															INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','House Rent Allowance',(select max(HouseRent) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionHouseRent) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableHouseRent) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Medical Allowance',(select max(MedicalAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionMedicalAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableMedicalAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Conveyance Allowance',(select max(ConvAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionConvAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableConvAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Festival Bonus',(select max(FestBonus) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionFestBonus) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableFestBonus) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','PF Contribution',(select max(PFContrib) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionPFContrib) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxablePFContrib) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Others Allowance',(select max(OthersAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionOthersAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableOthersAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Overtime Allowance',(select max(OverTimeAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionOverTimeAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableOverTimeAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 
										   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Special Allowance',(select max(SpecialAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(ExemptionSpecialAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
									(select max(TaxableSpecialAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee))

									--select * from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
									--drop table #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
									--return
									INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
										   ([GroupName]
										   ,[Particulars]
										   ,[Amount]
										   ,[Column4]
										   ,[Column5]) 

									select  distinct  'B.Tax Calculation',slab,0,0,0 from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee --where isFirstSlabthisYear=1
									--order by SlabRangeMin

										update [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] set
											amount =
											(
												select distinct SlabAmount from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee where slab =[Particulars]
											)
											where [GroupName]= 'B.Tax Calculation'


											update [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] set
											Column4 =
											(
												select distinct SlabRate from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee where slab =[Particulars]
											)
											where [GroupName]= 'B.Tax Calculation'
	
	


											update [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] set
											Column5 =
											(
												select distinct SlabTax from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee where slab =[Particulars]
											)
											where [GroupName]= 'B.Tax Calculation'

	


											INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
												   ([GroupName]
												   ,[Particulars]
												   ,[Amount]
												   ,[Column4]
												   ,[Column5]) 
												   values('C.Tax Rebate',(select convert(varchar(20),max(MaximumLimit)) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
											(select max(TaxableIncome) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
											(select max(ActualInvestment) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
											(select max(ApprovalAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee)
											)
										end 
												INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
												   ([GroupName]
												   ,[Particulars]
												   ,[Amount]
												   ,[Column4]
												   ,[Column5]) 
												   values('D.Net Tax','',
											(select max(AllowableForRebate) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
											(select max(AllowforRebateAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee),
											(select max(NetTaxPayable) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee)
											)

											drop table #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax_Employee


						--end
						--===================================     end    SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax     =======================================================--
						
						
						set @CurrentAutoID = @CurrentAutoID +1
						
				END
			
				delete from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax
				where TaxYear = @TaxYearFilter and TaxMonth = @TaxMonthFilter
				and EmployeeId in 
				(
					select EmployeeId from #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate
				)

				insert into Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax 
				select EmployeeId,@TaxYearFilter,convert(float,Column5),
				case when convert(float,Column5) <=0.00 then 0.00
				else convert(float,Column5)/12 end ,getdate(),@TaxMonthFilter from #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate
				
				select 
				AutoID ,
				EmployeeId,
				EmployeeNo ,
				EmployeeName ,
				TaxYear ,
				TaxMonth ,
				--T.Sex,
				--NetTaxPayablePerMonth,
				--TotalSalary,
				case 
				when T.Sex ='Male' and T.TotalSalary >=50000 and T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0 then 417
				when T.Sex ='Female' and T.TotalSalary >=57140  and T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0 then 417
				when T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth < 417 and  T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth  > 0 then 417
				else convert(decimal(12,2),NetTaxPayablePerMonth) end NetTaxPayablePerMonth
				from 
				(
					select 
					t.AutoID ,
					t.EmployeeId ,
					t.EmployeeNo ,
					t.EmployeeName ,
					t.TaxYear ,
					t.TaxMonth ,
 					case when convert(float,Column5) <=0.00 then 0.00
					else convert(float,Column5)/12 end NetTaxPayablePerMonth,
					h.Sex,
					s.TotalSalary
					from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate t
					join #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate c on c.EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId
					join Hr.StaffRecords h on h.Id = c.EmployeeId
					join Payroll.IndividualSalaries s on s.EmployeeId = h.Id
				)T
				

end 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetPatientInfoForUserDepartments]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec spGetPatientInfoForUserDepartments '8a9fffa0-a8da-472e-8209-f5e266322700'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetPatientInfoForUserDepartments]
	@userId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	WITH depts AS (
		SELECT item DeptId 
		FROM [Hospital].[IPDIndentForwardAndPatientAccesses]  
		CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](DeptIds, ',') 
		WHERE UserId = @userId
	),

	CteIPDPatient AS (
	  SELECT Top(500)
		Id, 
		UHID, 
		InvoicePrefix, 
		InvoiceNo, 
		FullName, 
		AgeYear, 
		AgeMonth, 
		AgeDay, 
		AdmissionDateTime, 
		RefdDoctorId, 
		AssignedDoctorId, 
		AdmittedCabinId, 
		Status, 
		MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
		ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		DischargedDateTime, 
		CorporateClientId, 
		d.DeptId, 
		IsCCCHold, 
		IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		StaffRecordId, 
		TenantId, 
		AdmissionByUserId, 
		DischargeByUserId, 
		IsClearedForDischarge, 
		IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		IsClearedFromDoD, 
		IsCCHold, 
		IsNotified, 
		Remarks, 
		MediaId, 
		CreatedBy, 
		CreatedOn, 
		LastModifiedBy, 
		LastModifiedOn, 
		IsDeleted, 
		IsSynced, 
		IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType, 
		AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		BillingMode, 
		IsEMRLoaded, 
		IsTransferredFromOrigin 
	  FROM 
		Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p 
		join depts d on d.DeptId = p.DeptId
	  WHERE 
		(
		  DischargedDateTime < AdmissionDateTime
		) 
		AND (
		  DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		)
	), 
	CtePateintDemographic AS (
	  SELECT 
		p.*, 
		ISNULL(rr.PatientAddress, '') AS Address, 
		ISNULL(rr.MobileNo, '') AS MobileNo, 
		ISNULL(rr.Cpmobile, '') AS Cpmobile, 
		ISNULL(rr.Sex, '') AS Sex, 
		ISNULL(rr.MembershipType, '') AS MembershipType, 
		ISNULL(rr.MaritalStatus, '') AS MaritalStatus, 
		ISNULL(rr.Profession, '') AS Profession, 
		ISNULL(rr.NationalId, '') AS NationalId, 
		ISNULL(rr.FatherName, '') AS FatherName, 
		ISNULL(rr.MotherName, '') AS MotherName, 
		ISNULL(rr.PatientAddress, '') AS PatientAddress, 
		ISNULL(rr.Cpname, '') AS Cpname, 
		ISNULL(rr.Cpaddress, '') AS Cpaddress, 
		ISNULL(rr.CareOf, '') AS CareOf, 
		ISNULL(rr.RelationWithPatient, '') AS RelationWithPatient, 
		ISNULL(rr.BloodGroup, '') AS BloodGroup, 
		ISNULL(rr.CpnationalId, '') AS CpnationalId, 
		ISNULL(rr.SpouseName, '') AS SpouseName, 
		ISNULL(rr.Title, '') AS Title, 
		ISNULL(rr.Religion, '') AS Religion
	  FROM 
		CteIPDPatient AS p 
		INNER JOIN Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID 
		and rr.IsDeleted = 0
	), 


	CtePateintDemographicWithSubLedgerAndAllocationRecords AS (
	  SELECT 
		p.*, 
		ca.Id AS AllotId, 
		ca.CabinId, 
		ca.AllotType, 
		ISNULL(ca.Status, '') AS CabinStatus, 
		p.DeptId AS CurrentDeptId
	  FROM CtePateintDemographic AS p 
		INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
	  WHERE (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) AND (ca.AllotType = 'PAB')
	) 

	SELECT p.Id, 
	  ISNULL(p.InvoicePrefix, '') AS InvoicePrefix, 
	  p.InvoiceNo, 
	  p.UHID, 
	  p.FullName, 
	  p.Address, 
	  p.MobileNo, 
	  p.Cpmobile, 
	  ISNULL(
		CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END, 
		''
	  ) AS Age, 
	  p.Sex, 
	  p.MembershipType, 
	  p.MaritalStatus, 
	  p.Profession, 
	  p.NationalId, 
	  p.AdmissionDateTime, 
	  p.DischargedDateTime, 
	  p.AssignedDoctorId, 
	  p.RefdDoctorId, 
	  ISNULL(d.Name, '') AS AssignedDoctorName, 
	  ISNULL(d2.Name, '') AS RefDoctorName, 
	  ISNULL(p.Status, '') AS Status, 
	  p.FatherName, 
	  p.MotherName, 
	  p.PatientAddress, 
	  p.Cpname, 
	  p.Cpaddress, 
	  ISNULL(p.AgeYear, '') AS AgeYear, 
	  ISNULL(p.AgeMonth, '') AS AgeMonth, 
	  ISNULL(p.AgeDay, '') AS AgeDay, 
	  p.CareOf, 
	  p.RelationWithPatient, 
	  p.BloodGroup, 
	  p.CpnationalId, 
	  p.SpouseName, 
	  p.AllotId, 
	  p.CabinId, 
	  p.AllotType, 
	  p.TenantId, 
	  c.FloorId, 
	  p.CabinStatus, 
	 -- ISNULL(
		--Hospital.GetCabinNumber1(p.Id), 
		--''
	 -- ) AS CabinNo, 
	  c.CabinNo,
	  ISNULL(ct.CabinType, '') AS CabinType, 
	  c.Id AS Expr1, 
	  ISNULL(dept.Name, '') AS DeptName, 
	  dept.Id AS HDepartmentId, 
	  p.BillingMode, 
	  p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
	  p.Title, 
	  p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
	  p.AdmissionByUserId, 
	  c.CabinTypeId, 
	  ISNULL(u.UserName, '') AS UserName, 
	  p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
	  p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
	  p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
	  p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
	  p.IsCCHold, 
	  p.IsNotified, 
	  ISNULL(ma.Name, '') AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName, 
	  p.Religion, 
	  p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
	  p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
	  p.Remarks, 
	  c.DisplayOrder, 
	  p.IsEMRLoaded, 
	  p.IsTransferredFromOrigin, 
	  ISNULL(
		ap.PackageId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	  ) AS PackageId 
	FROM 
	  CtePateintDemographicWithSubLedgerAndAllocationRecords AS p 
	  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
	  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON p.CabinId = c.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON p.CurrentDeptId = dept.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id 
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id 
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId 
	  left join Hospital.AdmittedPackages ap on p.Id = ap.IPDPatientRecordId 
	where 
	  ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null 
	  or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1 
	ORDER BY 
	  p.InvoiceNo

END

-- exec spGetPatientServiceRecords '2025-05-01', '2025-08-10';

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetPatientServiceRecords]
	@from Date,
	@to Date
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		CONVERT(DATE,EntryDate)EntryDate,
		InvoiceNo,
		p.FullName PatientName,
		isnull(MobileNo, '') MobileNo,
		d.ServiceId,
		isnull(s.HeadName, '') ServiceName,
		ssg.Id ServiceTypeId,
		isnull(d.ServiceByDoctorId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') ServiceById, 
		isnull(u.Name, '') ServiceByName,
		ssg.Name ServiceTypeName,
		d.TotalAmount Amount,
		isnull(p.Remarks, '') Remarks
	from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices p
	join OPD.ServiceDetails d on p.Id = d.PatientId
	join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads s on s.Id = d.ServiceId
	join Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups ssg on ssg.Id = s.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	left join Marketing.Doctors u on u.Id = d.ServiceByDoctorId
	where CONVERT(DATE,EntryDate) between @from and @to
	ORDER BY EntryDate
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- =============================================
-- Author: Abdul Halim
-- =============================================


-- exec spGetServiceDetailsForCancel 24091616808, 1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetServiceDetailsForCancel]
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@Type int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    declare @patientId uniqueidentifier;

	if(@Type = 0)
	begin
		select @patientId = Id from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices where InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
		select 
			@PatientId PatientId,
			InvoiceNo,
			(select sum(Debit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 0) TotalSale,
			(select sum(Credit - Debit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 1) Discount,
			(select sum(Credit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 2) Paid,
			(select sum(Debit - Credit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id) Due
		from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices p
		where Id = @patientId

		select 
			d.Id,
			d.ServiceId,
			s.HeadName ServiceName,
			d.Qty,
			convert(float, d.Rate) Rate,
			d.IsDeleted
		from Opd.ServiceDetails d
		join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads s on s.Id = d.ServiceId
		where PatientId = @patientId and IsCancelApproved = 1 and d.IsDeleted = 0
	end
	else 
	begin

		select @patientId = Id from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees where InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
		select 
			@PatientId PatientId,
			InvoiceNo,
			(select sum(Debit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 0) TotalSale,
			(select sum(Credit - Debit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 1) Discount,
			(select sum(Credit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 2) Paid,
			(select sum(Debit - Credit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id) Due
		from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p
		where Id = @patientId

		select 
			d.Id,
			d.ServiceId,
			s.Name ServiceName,
			d.Qty,
			convert(float, d.Rate) Rate,
			d.IsDeleted
		from Opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		join Marketing.Doctors s on s.Id = d.ServiceId
		where PatientId = @patientId and IsCancelApproved = 1 and d.IsDeleted = 0
	end
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[SpGetStockByOutLetId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--  SpGetStockByOutLetId   '97b3b6d5-e2bf-4ecc-90c8-5d1f226ac54c',''
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SpGetStockByOutLetId]  
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier,
	@filterString nvarchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

 
--TotalStockIn
 drop table #tmpTotalStock
SELECT        sd.BrandId, sr.OutletId, SUM(srd.Qty) AS TotalStockIn  into #tmpTotalStock
FROM            Pharmacy.StockReceives AS sr INNER JOIN
                         Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails AS srd ON sr.Id = srd.StockReceiveId
						 JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions as  sd On srd.BrandExtensionId =  sd.Id
WHERE        (sr.OPDReturnBillId IN ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
GROUP BY sd.BrandId, sr.OutletId

--select * from #tmpTotalStock
-- TotalStockOut
drop table #StockOut
SELECT    Sd.BrandId ,    i.MedicineOutletId,  SUM(id.Qty) AS TotalStockOut  INTO #StockOut
FROM            Pharmacy.Invoices AS i INNER JOIN
                         Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails AS id ON i.Id = id.InvoiceId
						 join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions As Sd On id.BrandExtensionId = sd.Id
WHERE        (i.ServeTypeId NOT IN (14))
GROUP BY Sd.BrandId, i.MedicineOutletId

--select * from #StockOut
-- CurrentStock


select distinct stockIn.BrandId, stockIn.OutletId,
iif( (sum (isnull(stockIn.TotalStockIn,0)- isnull(stOut.TotalStockOut,0)))> 0, sum (isnull(stockIn.TotalStockIn,0)- isnull(stOut.TotalStockOut,0)),0) CurrentStock
INTO #currentStock
from #tmpTotalStock as stockIn left join #StockOut as stOut ON stockIn.BrandId = stOut.BrandId
group by stockIn.BrandId, stockIn.OutletId

select * from #currentStock
--- Show Data
    if(@filterString is null or @filterString ='' )
	BEGIN
		select  bd.Id ProductId,bd.Name ProductName ,
		   cast(isnull(sd.CurrentStock,0.0) as real) CurrentStock,isnull(bdx.PurchasePrice,0) PurchasePrice,isnull(bdx.SalePrice,0) SalePrice,isnull(m.Name,'') Manufacturer
		   ,g.Name As  Generic, bdx.GenericId GenericId,isnull(bdx.PkgUnit,0) PkgUnit,isnull(bdx.QtyPerBox,0) QtyPerBox,isnull(rol.ROL,0) ROL
		   ,isnull(sd.OutLetId,@OutletId) OutLetId,isnull(m.Id,0) ManufacturerId
	  from [Pharmacy].BrandNames bd  join
		   #currentStock  sd on bd.Id=sd.BrandId 
		  left join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions as bdx On bd.Id = bdx.BrandId
		left   join Pharmacy.Generics as g On g.Id = bdx.GenericId
		left   join Pharmacy.Manufacturers as m On m.Id = bd.ManufacturerId
		  Left join Pharmacy.ROLRecords as rol On bdx.Id = rol.BrandExtensionId
		  
		  -- sd.OutLetId=@OutletId
	END
 



END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetAcknowledgedSamplesPatients]

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec [Diag].[GetCSReportDataByDates] '2023-03-23','2025-08-28'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetCSReportDataByDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	select tbl.*,bal.Balance Total from
	  (
	  select distinct i.FullName,i.InvoiceNo,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,ti.Id TestItemId,ti.Name TestName,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,
	         i.UHID,i.Gender,(i.AgeYear+'Y '+i.AgeMonth+'M '+i.AgeDay+'D') Age,d.Name ReportDoctorName,u.UserName,pr.ReportDoctorId,pr.ReportTechnologistId,pr.IsCSGrowth,pr.Id PathologyReportId
	    from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id INNER JOIN
			 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
			 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on ti.Id=id.TestItemId inner join
			 [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=pr.PatientId inner join
			 [Diag].[CSOthersValues] ov on pr.Id=ov.PathologyReportId and id.TestItemId=ov.TestItemId left join
			 [VWDoctors] d on pr.ReportDoctorId=d.Id left join
			 [Identity].[Users] u on i.UserId=u.Id
	   where cast(pr.ReportDate as date)>=cast(@DateFrom as date) and cast(pr.ReportDate as date)<=cast(@DateTo as date) and pr.IsCSReport=1
	  ) tbl inner join
	  (
	  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId
	    from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
			 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  ) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Diag].[GetPathologyDescriptiveReportByInivoiceNoOrId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

GO






-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec [Diag].[GetPathologyDescriptiveReportByInivoiceNoOrId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',123123,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetPathologyDescriptiveReportByInivoiceNoOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@TestId uniqueidentifier,
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDate datetime,
	@Flag int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF @Flag=0
	BEGIN
		select rr.Id,rr.ReportDateTime,rr.InvoiceNo,rr.TestItemId,rr.ReportContent,rr.FinalizedByDoctorId,rr.SampleStatus,i.FullName,i.UHID,i.Gender,
		isnull(CASE WHEN i.AgeYear <> '' THEN i.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE i.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN i.AgeMonth <> '' THEN i.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE i.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN i.AgeDay <> '' THEN i.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE i.AgeDay END,'') AS Age,
		d.Name RefdDoctorName,d1.Name ReportDoctorName,ss.Name SampleStatusTxt,ti.Name TestName
		 from [Diag].[PathologyDescriptiveReports] rr inner join
			  [Diag].[TestItems] ti on rr.TestItemId=ti.Id inner join
			  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo inner join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
			  [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on ss.Id=rr.SampleStatus left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d1 on rr.FinalizedByDoctorId=d1.Id
		where (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and rr.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo and rr.TestItemId=@TestId) or rr.Id=@Id
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select rr.Id,rr.ReportDateTime,rr.InvoiceNo,rr.TestItemId,rr.ReportContent,rr.FinalizedByDoctorId,rr.SampleStatus,i.FullName,i.UHID,i.Gender,
		isnull(CASE WHEN i.AgeYear <> '' THEN i.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE i.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN i.AgeMonth <> '' THEN i.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE i.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN i.AgeDay <> '' THEN i.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE i.AgeDay END,'') AS Age,
		d.Name RefdDoctorName,d1.Name ReportDoctorName,ss.Name SampleStatusTxt
		 from [Diag].[PathologyDescriptiveReports] rr inner join
			  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo inner join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
			  [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on ss.Id=rr.SampleStatus left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d1 on rr.FinalizedByDoctorId=d1.Id
		where CONVERT(DATE, rr.ReportDateTime)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @StartDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @EndDate)
	END
	
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Diag].[GetRadiologyInvoiceByDates]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO



-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>

-- =============================================

-- Exec [Diag].[GetRadiologyInvoiceByDates] '2025-01-19','2025-01-19',6,0,'b736ab64-5fc4-4867-9826-9551a3a6099d'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetRadiologyInvoiceByDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDateTime datetime,
	@FinalizeFlag int,
	@DueFlag int,
	@ParentGroup uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	if(@ParentGroup='B736AB64-5FC4-4867-9826-9551A3A6099D')
	begin
		select tbl.*, bal.Balance Total from(
		select distinct i.InvoiceNo, rr.SampleStatus, id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.TestCode,ti.Name TestName,ti.Rate,i.InvoicePrefix,id.Qty,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount,id.IsCancelApproved,
			   id.IsDeleted,id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,
			   '' ReportDeliveryUserName,i.FullName PatientName,tg.Name GroupName,ti.TestGroupId,id.IsAllSampleCarried,IsAllSampleCollected,IsAllSampleReceived,id.LabNoPrefix,id.IsUrgent,tg.MovementRoomNo
			   ,(i.AgeYear + 'Y ' + i.AgeMonth + 'M ' + i.AgeDay + 'D') Age, i.Gender,id.ImagingReportStatus,ss.Name ImagingReportStatusTxt
		 from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i 
			  left join [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId 
			  left join [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id 
			  left join [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id 
			  left join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id 
			  left join [Diag].[RadiologyReports] rr on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo and rr.TestItemId=ti.Id 
			  left join [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
		where CONVERT(DATE, i.EntryDate)>=CONVERT(DATE, @StartDate) 
			and CONVERT(DATE, i.EntryDate)<=CONVERT(DATE, @EndDateTime) 
			and (@FinalizeFlag=0 or rr.SampleStatus>=@FinalizeFlag) 
			and tg.ParentGroupId=@ParentGroup
		) tbl left join
		  (
		  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId --and bal.Balance=0
			from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
				 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
		  ) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId
	end
	else
	begin
		select tbl.*, bal.Balance Total from(
		select distinct i.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.TestCode,ti.Name TestName,ti.Rate,i.InvoicePrefix,id.Qty,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount,id.IsCancelApproved,
			   id.IsDeleted,id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,
			   '' ReportDeliveryUserName,i.FullName PatientName,tg.Name GroupName,ti.TestGroupId,id.IsAllSampleCarried,IsAllSampleCollected,IsAllSampleReceived,id.LabNoPrefix,id.IsUrgent,tg.MovementRoomNo
			   ,(i.AgeYear + 'Y ' + i.AgeMonth + 'M ' + i.AgeDay + 'D') Age, i.Gender,id.ImagingReportStatus,ss.Name ImagingReportStatusTxt
		 from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i inner join
			  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
			  [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id inner join
			  [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
			  [Diag].[PathologyDescriptiveReports] rr on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo and rr.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
			  [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
		where CONVERT(DATE, i.EntryDate)>=CONVERT(DATE, @StartDate) and CONVERT(DATE, i.EntryDate)<=CONVERT(DATE, @EndDateTime) and (@FinalizeFlag=0 or rr.SampleStatus>=@FinalizeFlag) and tg.ParentGroupId=@ParentGroup
		) tbl left join
		  (
		  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId
			from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
				 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
		  ) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId --and bal.Balance=0
	end
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetRadiologyReportByInivoiceNoOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@TestId uniqueidentifier,
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDate datetime,
	@Flag int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF @Flag=0
	BEGIN
		select rr.Id,rr.ReportDateTime,rr.InvoiceNo,rr.TestItemId,rr.ReportContent,rr.FinalizedByDoctorId,rr.SampleStatus,i.FullName,i.UHID,i.Gender,
		isnull(CASE WHEN i.AgeYear <> '' THEN i.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE i.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN i.AgeMonth <> '' THEN i.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE i.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN i.AgeDay <> '' THEN i.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE i.AgeDay END,'') AS Age,
		d.Name RefdDoctorName,d1.Name ReportDoctorName,ss.Name SampleStatusTxt,ti.Name TestName
		 from [Diag].[RadiologyReports] rr left join
			  [Diag].[TestItems] ti on rr.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
			  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
			  [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on ss.Id=rr.SampleStatus left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d1 on rr.FinalizedByDoctorId=d1.Id
		where (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and rr.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo and rr.TestItemId=@TestId) or rr.Id=@Id
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select rr.Id,rr.ReportDateTime,rr.InvoiceNo,rr.TestItemId,rr.ReportContent,rr.FinalizedByDoctorId,rr.SampleStatus,i.FullName,i.UHID,i.Gender,
		isnull(CASE WHEN i.AgeYear <> '' THEN i.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE i.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN i.AgeMonth <> '' THEN i.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE i.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN i.AgeDay <> '' THEN i.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE i.AgeDay END,'') AS Age,
		d.Name RefdDoctorName,d1.Name ReportDoctorName,ss.Name SampleStatusTxt
		 from [Diag].[RadiologyReports] rr left join
			  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
			  [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on ss.Id=rr.SampleStatus left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d1 on rr.FinalizedByDoctorId=d1.Id
		where CONVERT(DATE, rr.ReportDateTime)>=CONVERT(DATE, @StartDate) and CONVERT(DATE, rr.ReportDateTime)<=CONVERT(DATE, @EndDate)
	END
	
END
