-- Exec [Diag].[GetReportDeliveryDetailsByInvoiceId] 'A4414FC7-7F80-4112-A85E-08DB7AE931F6'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetReportDeliveryDetailsByInvoiceId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpTbl;

	Create table #tmpTbl
	(
		Autoid int identity(1,1),
		InvoiceNo bigint,
		InvestigationInvoiceId uniqueidentifier,
		TestItemId uniqueidentifier,
		TestName nvarchar(max),
		EntryDate datetime2,
		EntryTime  nvarchar(50),
		Age nvarchar(50),
		Gender  nvarchar(50) ,
		PatientName nvarchar(50) ,
		LabNo int,
		Balance real,
		ReportType int
	)

	insert into #tmpTbl (InvoiceNo,InvestigationInvoiceId,TestItemId,TestName,EntryDate,EntryTime,Age,Gender,PatientName,LabNo,Balance,ReportType)
	select tbl.*, bal.Balance Total,1 ReportType
		from(
		select distinct i.InvoiceNo,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.Name TestName,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,
				(i.AgeYear + 'Y ' + i.AgeMonth + 'M ' + i.AgeDay + 'D') Age, i.Gender,i.FullName PatientName,0 LabNo
			from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i inner join
				[Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
				[Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id inner join
				[Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id and tg.ParentGroupId= 'b736ab64-5fc4-4867-9826-9551a3a6099d' inner join
				[dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
				[Diag].[RadiologyReports] rr on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo and rr.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
				[Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
		where i.Id=@InvoiceId and rr.SampleStatus=7
		) tbl left join
			(
			select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId --and bal.Balance=0
			from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
					group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
			) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId

	insert into #tmpTbl (InvoiceNo,InvestigationInvoiceId,TestItemId,TestName,EntryDate,EntryTime,Age,Gender,PatientName,LabNo,Balance,ReportType)
	select tbl.*, bal.Balance Total,2 ReportType
		from(
			select distinct i.InvoiceNo,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.Name TestName,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,
				(i.AgeYear + 'Y ' + i.AgeMonth + 'M ' + i.AgeDay + 'D') Age, i.Gender,i.FullName PatientName,0 LabNo
			 from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i inner join
				  [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
				  [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id inner join
				  [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id and tg.ParentGroupId= '93D52C58-8961-4636-B57C-6C543CB20A32' left join
				  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
				  [Diag].[PathologyDescriptiveReports] rr on rr.InvoiceNo=i.InvoiceNo and rr.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
				  [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
			where i.Id=@InvoiceId and rr.SampleStatus=7
			) tbl left join
			  (
			  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId
				from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
					 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
			  ) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId

	insert into #tmpTbl (InvoiceNo,InvestigationInvoiceId,TestItemId,TestName,EntryDate,EntryTime,Age,Gender,PatientName,LabNo,Balance,ReportType)
	select tbl.*,bal.Balance,3 ReportType from
	  (
	  select distinct i.InvoiceNo,i.Id,('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') TestItemId,tg.Name,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,
	         (i.AgeYear+'Y '+i.AgeMonth+'M '+i.AgeDay+'D') Age,i.Gender,i.FullName,sr.LabNo
	    from [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sr inner join
		     [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId=id.Id inner join
			 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
			 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on ti.Id=id.TestItemId inner join
			 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id inner join
			 [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on sr.InvoiceId=pr.PatientId and sr.LabNo=pr.LabNo inner join
			 [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on pr.SampleStatus=ss.Id left join
			 [VWDoctors] d on pr.ReportDoctorId=d.Id
	   where i.Id=@InvoiceId and sr.SampleStatus=7
	  ) tbl inner join
	  (
	  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId
	    from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
			 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  ) bal on tbl.Id=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId

	select Autoid,InvoiceNo,InvestigationInvoiceId,TestItemId,isnull(TestName, '') TestName,EntryDate,EntryTime,ISNULL(Age,'') Age, isnull(Gender,'') Gender,isnull(PatientName,'') PatientName,LabNo,Balance,ReportType from #tmpTbl
	
END

--EXEC [Diag].GetReportTitleSettingsByReportTitleId '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
create   PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetReportTitleSettingsByReportTitleId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ReportTitleId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	
	Select r.Id,r.ReportTitleId,r.TestItemId,t.Name TestName,rt.Name TitleName,r.testorder,u.UserName from Diag.ReportTitleSettings r 
	join Diag.TestItems t on r.testitemid=t.Id 
	join Diag.ReportTitles rt on rt.id=r.reporttitleid
	join [Identity].Users u on r.createdby=u.Id  
	where (r.ReportTitleId=@ReportTitleId or @ReportTitleId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	order by r.testorder

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatients]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatients] '2024-10-01','2024-10-28','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
-- Exec [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatients] '2025-07-07','2025-07-08','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatients]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDateTime datetime,
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

;WITH LastPrint AS (
    SELECT upr.PatientId, upr.TestId, upr.LabNo, upr.UserId, upr.CreatedOn,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upr.PatientId, upr.TestId, upr.LabNo ORDER BY upr.CreatedOn DESC) AS rn
    FROM [Diag].[UserPrintReports] upr
)

select tbl.*, bal.Balance Total
from (
    select distinct  
        i.FullName, i.InvoiceNo, i.EntryDate, i.EntryTime, sr.LabNo, tg.Id TestGroupId, tg.Name TestGroupName,
        id.InvestigationInvoiceId, i.UHID, i.Gender, 
        (i.AgeYear + 'Y ' + i.AgeMonth + 'M ' + i.AgeDay + 'D') Age,
        d.Name ReportDoctorName,
        ISNULL(u.UserName, '') as UserName,
        i.IPDPatientRecordId,
        CASE 
            WHEN lp.UserId IS NULL THEN 'Not Printed' 
            ELSE 'Printed' 
        END AS Status,
        tg.Id AS TestId,
        pr.PatientId
    from [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sr 
        inner join [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId = id.Id 
        inner join [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on i.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId 
        inner join [Diag].[TestItems] ti on ti.Id = id.TestItemId 
        inner join [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId = tg.Id 
        inner join [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on sr.InvoiceId = pr.PatientId and sr.LabNo = pr.LabNo 
        inner join [VWDoctors] d on pr.ReportDoctorId = d.Id

        left join LastPrint lp on lp.PatientId = pr.PatientId and lp.TestId = tg.Id and lp.LabNo = pr.LabNo and lp.rn = 1
        left join [Identity].[Users] u on lp.UserId = u.Id

    where (
            (
                cast(sr.CreatedOn as date) >= cast(@StartDate as date)
                and cast(sr.CreatedOn as date) <= cast(@EndDateTime as date)
                and @InvoiceId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
            )
            or i.Id = @InvoiceId
        )
        and sr.SampleStatus = 7
) tbl
inner join (
    select 
        (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,
        il.InvestigationInvoiceId
    from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
    group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId = bal.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  
END


GO

	    from [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sr inner join
		     [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId=id.Id inner join
			 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i on i.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
			 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on ti.Id=id.TestItemId inner join
			 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id inner join
			 [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on sr.InvoiceId=pr.PatientId and sr.LabNo=pr.LabNo inner join
			 [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on pr.SampleStatus=ss.Id left join
			 [VWDoctors] d on pr.ReportDoctorId=d.Id left join
			 [Identity].[Users] u on i.UserId=u.Id
	   where i.UHID=@UHID and sr.SampleStatus=7
	  ) tbl inner join
	  (
	  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId
	    from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
			 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  ) bal on tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

-- Exec [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatients] '2024-10-01','2024-10-28','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
-- Exec [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatientsPrac] '2025-06-25','2025-06-25','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetResultFinalizedSamplesPatientsPrac]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here 
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDateTime datetime,
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH LastPrint AS (
        SELECT upr.PatientId, upr.TestId, upr.LabNo, upr.UserId, upr.CreatedOn,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upr.PatientId, upr.TestId, upr.LabNo ORDER BY upr.CreatedOn DESC) AS rn
        FROM [Diag].[UserPrintReports] upr
    )

    SELECT tbl.*, bal.Balance AS Total
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT  
            i.FullName,
            i.InvoiceNo,
            i.EntryDate,
            i.EntryTime,
            r.Id AS ReportTitleId,
            r.Name AS ReportTitleName,
            tg.Id AS TestGroupId,
            tg.Name AS TestGroupName,
            id.InvestigationInvoiceId,
            i.UHID,
            i.Gender,
            (i.AgeYear + 'Y ' + i.AgeMonth + 'M ' + i.AgeDay + 'D') AS Age,
            d.Name AS ReportDoctorName,
            ISNULL(uprint.UserName, '') AS UserName,
            i.IPDPatientRecordId,
            CASE 
                WHEN lp.UserId IS NULL THEN 'Not Printed' 
                ELSE 'Printed' 
            END AS Status,
            tg.Id AS TestId,
            pr.PatientId
        FROM [Diag].ReportTitles r
        INNER JOIN [Diag].ReportTitleSettings rt ON r.Id = rt.ReportTitleId
        INNER JOIN [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id ON rt.TestItemId = id.TestItemId 
        INNER JOIN [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i ON i.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId 
        INNER JOIN [Diag].[TestItems] ti ON ti.Id = id.TestItemId 
        INNER JOIN [Diag].[TestGroups] tg ON ti.TestGroupId = tg.Id 
        INNER JOIN [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr ON i.Id = pr.PatientId 
        INNER JOIN [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sr ON sr.InvoiceId = pr.PatientId
        LEFT JOIN [VWDoctors] d ON pr.ReportDoctorId = d.Id
        LEFT JOIN LastPrint lp ON lp.PatientId = pr.PatientId AND lp.TestId = tg.Id AND lp.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN [Identity].[Users] uprint ON lp.UserId = uprint.Id
        WHERE (
                (
                    CAST(pr.ReportDate AS date) >= CAST(@StartDate AS date)
                    AND CAST(pr.ReportDate AS date) <= CAST(@EndDateTime AS date)
                    AND @InvoiceId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
                )
                OR i.Id = @InvoiceId
            )
            AND sr.SampleStatus = 7
    ) tbl
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            (SUM(il.Debit) - SUM(il.Credit)) AS Balance,
            il.InvestigationInvoiceId
        FROM [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
        GROUP BY il.InvestigationInvoiceId
    ) bal ON tbl.InvestigationInvoiceId = bal.InvestigationInvoiceId
	  
END
GO

-- Exec [Diag].[GetSampelCollectionLogByDates] '2025-07-08','2025-07-08'
CREATE         PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetSampelCollectionLogByDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StartDate as datetime,
	@EndDateTime as datetime
	
AS
BEGIN
print  @StartDate
print  @EndDateTime

Select i.UHID, i.InvoiceNo, i.EntryDate , t.Name as TestName, t.Id as TestId, t.TestCode , sr.LabNo 
, i.FullName,i.MobileNo, i.Gender, i.AgeYear,id.IsUrgent , isnull(ss.Name,'') SampleStatus, d.Name as DoctorName, lp.InstrumentName as SampleRunningAtWhichMachine
from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on i.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId
left join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = id.TestItemId
left join Diag.SampleCollectionRecords sr on sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId = id.Id
left join VWDoctors d on i.RefdDoctorId = d.Id
left join Diag.SampleStatuses ss on sr.SampleStatus=ss.Id
left join LISPatientRecord lp on lp.PatientId = i.Id and lp.LabNo = sr.LabNo
----where   @StartDate >= i.EntryDate and  @EndDateTime<= i.EntryDate
where CONVERT(Date,i.EntryDate) >= CONVERT(DATE, @StartDate)  and CONVERT(Date,i.EntryDate)<= CONVERT(DATE, @EndDateTime) 

END

-- Exec [Diag].[GetSampelCollectionLogDetailsByInvoiceNoAndTestId] 'B6E5A2FF-E887-43D6-F855-08DADFE7EDC4',2507080200001
Create       PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetSampelCollectionLogDetailsByInvoiceNoAndTestId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@TestId uniqueidentifier,
	@InvoiceNo bigint
	
AS
BEGIN
Select i.UHID, i.InvoiceNo, i.EntryDate, t.Name as TestName , t.TestCode, sr.LabNo , i.FullName,i.MobileNo, i.Gender, i.AgeYear, sr.SampleStatus, d.Name as DoctorName,  u2.UserName as InvoiceBy, 
sr.SampleCollectionBy as SampleCollectionById 
,u1.UserName as SampleCollectionBy, sr.SampleCarriedBy as SampleCarriedById, sc.Name as SampleCarriedBy 
,sr.SampleReceiveByAtLab as SampleReceiveByAtLabId,u3.UserName as SampleReceivedBy,sr.SampleCarriedDateTime,sr.SampleCollectionDateTime,sr.SampleReceiveDateTime,
pr.ReportDoctorId,d2.Name as FinalizedBy,Tl.Name as LabResultEntryBy,rv.Name as ReportVerifiedBy, pr.ReportTechnologistId, pr.ReportVerifierId, upr.UserId as PrintedBy, u4.UserName as PrintedByName
from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
inner join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on i.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId
inner join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = id.TestItemId
inner join Diag.SampleCollectionRecords sr on sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId = id.Id
left join [Identity].Users u1 ON sr.SampleCollectionBy = u1.Id
left join [Diag].SampleCarriers sc ON sr.SampleCarriedBy = sc.StaffRecordId
left join [Identity].Users u2 on i.UserId = u2.Id
left join [Identity].Users u3 ON sr.SampleReceiveByAtLab = u3.Id

left join VWDoctors d on i.RefdDoctorId = d.Id
left join Diag.PathologyReports pr on pr.PatientId = i.Id
left join Diag.PathologyReportDetails prd on prd.PathologyReportId = pr.Id
left join VWDoctors d2 on pr.ReportDoctorId = d2.Id
left join [Diag].Technologists tl on tl.Id = pr.ReportTechnologistId
left join [Diag].ReportVerifiers rv on rv.Id = pr.ReportVerifierId
left join Diag.UserPrintReports upr on upr.PatientId = i.Id and prd.TestItemId = id.TestItemId
left join [Identity].Users u4 ON upr.UserId = u4.Id


where id.TestItemId = @TestId and i.InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
END
GO

-- Exec [Diag].[GetTestItemById] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[GetTestItemById] 
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@ParentGroupId uniqueidentifier,
	@TestGroupId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @emptyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	if(@ParentGroupId!=@emptyId)
	begin
		select ti.Id,isnull(ti.Name,'') [Name],ti.ShortName, ti.IsActive, ti.Rate,ti.Specimen,ti.SampleExtractionType,ti.NumberOfSample,ti.TestCode,ti.DayNeededForReportDelivery,ti.EscapeDayNeededForReportDeliveryDayCount
			   ,ti.TestGroupId,ti.DisplayOrder,tg.Name TestGroupName,ti.TestMethodId,tm.Name TestMethodName,ti.DeliveryTimeOnReportDay,ti.IsReportInTableFormat,ti.NoOfColumn,ti.DefaultVacutainerId
				   ,ti1.Name VacutainerName,ti.IsDiscountAllow
		  from [Diag].[TestItems] ti left join
			   [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id left join
			   [Diag].[TestMethods] tm on ti.TestMethodId=tm.Id left join
			   [Diag].[TestItems] ti1 on ti.DefaultVacutainerId=ti1.Id
		 where tg.ParentGroupId=@ParentGroupId
		-- AND ti.IsActive=1
	end
	else
	begin
		if(@TestGroupId!=@emptyId)
		begin
			select ti.Id,isnull(ti.Name,'') [Name],ti.ShortName, ti.IsActive, ti.Rate,ti.Specimen,ti.SampleExtractionType,ti.NumberOfSample,ti.TestCode,ti.DayNeededForReportDelivery,ti.EscapeDayNeededForReportDeliveryDayCount
				   ,ti.TestGroupId,ti.DisplayOrder,tg.Name TestGroupName,ti.TestMethodId,tm.Name TestMethodName,ti.DeliveryTimeOnReportDay,ti.IsReportInTableFormat,ti.NoOfColumn,ti.DefaultVacutainerId
				   ,ti1.Name VacutainerName,ti.IsDiscountAllow
			  from [Diag].[TestItems] ti left join
				   [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id left join
				   [Diag].[TestMethods] tm on ti.TestMethodId=tm.Id left join
			   [Diag].[TestItems] ti1 on ti.DefaultVacutainerId=ti1.Id
			 where ti.TestGroupId=@TestGroupId
			  --AND ti.IsActive=1
		end
		else
		begin
			select ti.Id,isnull(ti.Name,'') [Name],ti.ShortName, ti.IsActive, ti.Rate,ti.Specimen,ti.SampleExtractionType,ti.NumberOfSample,ti.TestCode,ti.DayNeededForReportDelivery,ti.EscapeDayNeededForReportDeliveryDayCount
				   ,ti.TestGroupId,ti.DisplayOrder,tg.Name TestGroupName,ti.TestMethodId,tm.Name TestMethodName,ti.DeliveryTimeOnReportDay,ti.IsReportInTableFormat,ti.NoOfColumn,ti.DefaultVacutainerId
				   ,ti1.Name VacutainerName,ti.IsDiscountAllow
			  from [Diag].[TestItems] ti left join
				   [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id left join
				   [Diag].[TestMethods] tm on ti.TestMethodId=tm.Id left join
			   [Diag].[TestItems] ti1 on ti.DefaultVacutainerId=ti1.Id
			 where ti.Id=@Id or @Id=@emptyId
			 -- AND ti.IsActive=1
		end
	end
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO


CREATE       PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetConsultantBasedInvestigationQtyandAmt]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetConsultantBasedInvestigationQtyandAmt]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'




AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14


						select(
							select * from(
					

				
							Select GroupName,Name,COUNT(TVWTakenTest.TestItemId) as TotalTest,
							convert(decimal(12,2),Sum(TVWTakenTest.Rate)) as TestAmount,
							convert(decimal(12,2),sum(TestWiseDiscountCollection))Discount,
								(convert(decimal(12,2),Sum(TVWTakenTest.Rate) - sum(TestWiseDiscountCollection)))-
							(convert(decimal(12,2),sum(TestWiseDueCollection)))
							[Received],
							
							convert(decimal(12,2),sum(TestWiseDueCollection))Due,

							--convert(decimal(12,2),Sum(TVWTakenTest.Rate) - sum(TestWiseDiscountCollection)) 
							0 [Commission]
						
	
										FROM 

										(

									SELECT [T].[InvestigationInvoiceId]
										  ,[T].[TestItemId]
										  ,[Name]
--										  ,[id]
										  ,[T].[Rate]
										  ,[T].[IsCancelApproved]
										  ,[EntryDate]
    
										  ,[GroupName]
										  ,[TokenOrder]
										  ,[T].[DisplayOrder]
										 -- ,[SummaryGroup]
										  ,[T].[RefdDoctorId]
										  ,[T].[UHID]
										  ,[FullName]
										  ,[AgeYear]
										  ,[AgeMonth]
										  ,[AgeDay]
										  ,[T].[Gender]
      
										  ,totalcost
										  ,totalDue
										  ,totalDiscount
										  ,isnull((totalDue*[T].[Rate])/totalcost,0)  TestWiseDueCollection
										  ,isnull((totalDiscount*[T].[Rate])/totalcost,0)  TestWiseDiscountCollection
	 
										  FROM
										  (

									SELECT         
									tc.InvestigationInvoiceId, tc.TestItemId, ti.Name, tc.Rate, tc.IsCancelApproved, 
											dpr.EntryDate, tg.Name AS GroupName, tg.TokenOrder, ti.DisplayOrder, 
											 dpr.RefdDoctorId, dpr.UHID, dpr.FullName, dpr.AgeYear, dpr.AgeMonth, 
											dpr.AgeDay, dpr.Gender,
											(
											select sum(t.Rate) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails t
											where t.InvestigationInvoiceId =  tc.InvestigationInvoiceId
											) totalcost,
											(
											select isnull(sum(Debit-credit),0) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers p
											where p.InvestigationInvoiceId = tc.InvestigationInvoiceId
											) totalDue,
											(
											select isnull(sum(credit),0) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers  p 
											where (p.TransactionType =1 
											--or p.TransactionType ='DiscountOnDueCollection'
											)
											and p.InvestigationInvoiceId = tc.InvestigationInvoiceId
											) totalDiscount
											--, dbo.GetDueCollectedPerentage(dbo.TestsCost.PatientId, dbo.TestsCost.TestId) 
											--AS TestWiseDueCollection
											--, 
											--dbo.GetDiscountCollectedPerentage(dbo.TestsCost.PatientId, dbo.TestsCost.TestId) AS TestWiseDiscountCollection
									FROM              Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails  tc INNER JOIN
													  Diag.TestItems  ti ON tc.TestItemId = ti.id INNER JOIN
													  Diag.InvestigationInvoices  dpr ON tc.InvestigationInvoiceId = dpr.id INNER JOIN
													  --dbo.ReportTypes rt ON ti.ReportTypeId =rt.ReportTypeId INNER JOIN
													  Diag.TestGroups tg ON tg.id = ti.TestGroupId 
													  JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=dpr.RefdDoctorId
													LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=dpr.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
													--AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
													LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=dpr.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
													--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
													LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
													LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
													LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
													LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type
									WHERE       
									(tc.IsCancelApproved <>1) and

									CONVERT(DATE,dpr.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,dpr.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
									AND (dpr.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
									AND 
									(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
									(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
									(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
									(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
									(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND 
									(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')
									) T


									)TVWTakenTest
									Group by TVWTakenTest.GroupName,TVWTakenTest.Name



								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Diag].[SpGetCorporateClientsDettails]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetCorporateClientsDettails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetCorporateClientsDettails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'




	DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@CorporateClientID int



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @CorporateClientID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13

	



	select distinct v.* into #TempInvestigationInvoices 
	from diag.InvestigationInvoices v
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceDetails d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = v.Id
	where convert(date,v.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,v.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
	and isnull(d.IsCancelApproved,0) =0

	select(
	select * from( 

	select 
	BillDate, UHID, PatientName, MobileNo,BillNo,LISRISNO,SponsorName,DoctorName,
	sum(BillAmount) BillAmount,
	sum(DiscountAmount) DiscountAmount,
	sum(BillAmount) - sum(DiscountAmount) [NetAmount],
	sum(WriteOffAmount) WriteOffAmount,
	sum(CreditNote) CreditNote,
	sum(RefundAmount) RefundAmount,
	sum(ReceiveAmnt) ReceiveAmnt,
	(select sum(Debit)-sum(Credit) 
	from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
	join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.Id
	where i.InvoiceNo=T.BillNo
	)BalanceAmount,
	EncodedBy,
	sum(Copayment) Copayment
	

	from 
	(
			Select v.EntryDate BillDate, v.UHID UHID, v.FullName PatientName, v.MobileNo MobileNo,v.InvoiceNo BillNo, '' LISRISNO,
			c.Name SponsorName, m.Name DoctorName,
			case when il.TransactionType=0 then Debit else 0 end [BillAmount],
			case when il.TransactionType=1 then Credit else 0 end [DiscountAmount],
			0  WriteOffAmount,
			case when il.TransactionType=4 then Credit else 0 end CreditNote,
			case when il.TransactionType=5 then Credit else 0 end [RefundAmount],
			case when il.TransactionType=2 then Credit else 0 end [ReceiveAmnt],
			u.UserName EncodedBy,
			0 Copayment
	
			from 
			--diag.InvestigationInvoices v
			--join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceDetails d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = v.Id
			#TempInvestigationInvoices v
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on il.InvestigationInvoiceId=v.Id
			join VWDoctors M on M.Id = V.RefdDoctorId
			join Marketing.CorporateClients c on c.Id=v.CorporateClientId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.Id=il.UserId
			where convert(date,v.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,v.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
			and (c.Id=@CorporateClientID or @CorporateClientID=0)
	)T
	group by BillDate, UHID, PatientName, MobileNo,BillNo,LISRISNO,SponsorName,DoctorName,EncodedBy
	 

	) tbl  
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


	--



END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Diag].[SpGetDepartmentWiseCensusSummary]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO









CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDepartmentWiseCensusSummary]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetDepartmentWiseCensusSummary]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



	DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserID uniqueIdentifier,
	@TenatnId int



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @TenatnId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=6



	select * into #TempInvestigationInvoices  from Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii  
				where CONVERT(DATE,ii.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate and
					CONVERT(DATE,ii.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate	and
					--(u.Id =@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and
					(ii.TenantId =@TenatnId or @TenatnId=0)

	--select * from #TempInvestigationInvoices
	--return

	select(
	select * from(

			select ServiceName,sum(OPDCount) OPDCount, sum(IPDCount) IPDCount,
			sum(OPDCount)  +  sum(IPDCount) [TotalCount],
			round(sum(OPDCount * NetAmount ),2) OPDAmount,
			round(sum(IPDCount * NetAmount ),2) IPDAmount,
			round(sum(OPDCount * NetAmount ) + sum(IPDCount * NetAmount ),2) [TotalAmount],
			GroupName
			FROM
			(
					select ti.Name ServiceName,
					case when i.IPDPatientRecordId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then 1 else 0 end OPDCount,
					case when i.IPDPatientRecordId <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then 1 else 0 end IPDCount,
					id.Total NetAmount,
					tg.Name GroupName
			
					from #TempInvestigationInvoices i
					join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.Id
					--join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on il.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.Id
					join Diag.TestItems ti on ti.Id=id.TestItemId
					join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
					join [Identity].Users u on u.Id=i.UserId

					where CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate and
							CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate	and
							(u.Id =@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and
							(i.TenantId =@TenatnId or @TenatnId=0)
							and isnull(id.IsCancelApproved,0) <> 1
							--and il.TransactionType =0
					
		)
		T
		group by T.ServiceName,t.GroupName
		


	) tbl  Order by GroupName, ServiceName   FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDepartmentWiseCollectionDatails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetDepartmentWiseCollectionDatails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'





	DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@GroupID int



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @GroupID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15

	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserID




	select(
	select * from(

	SELECT 
	*,
	[NetAmount] -[CashDiscount] [TotalNetAmount]
	FROM 
	(
	select 
	v.UHID,
	v.InvoiceNo [BillNo],
	V.EntryDate [BillDate],
	v.FullName [Patientname],
	M.Name [RefBy],
	I.Name [InvName],
	d.Total [GrossAmount],
	0 [CorDiscount],
	d.Total - 0 [NetAmount],
	[Diag].[Get_Discount_BaseOn_TestID_PatientID](v.id,I.ID,d.Total) [CashDiscount],
G.Name [GroupName]
	from 
	diag.InvestigationInvoices v
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceDetails d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = v.Id
	join [Diag].[TestItems] I on I.Id = d.TestItemId
	join [Diag].[TestGroups] G on G.Id = I.TestGroupId
	join VWDoctors M on M.Id = V.RefdDoctorId
	where CONVERT(DATE,v.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and CONVERT(DATE,v.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
	)T

	) tbl  
	ORDER BY GroupName,BillNo
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


	--



END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDiagnosticDetailsReportDepartmentwise]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetDiagnosticDetailsReportDepartmentwise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14

					
				
					SELECT  BillNo,  PatientName, Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill
								,0 Pathology
								,0 Hormone
								,0 COLONOSCOPY
								,0 BMD
								,0 CTSCAN
								,0 ECG
								,0 ECHO
								,0 EEG
								,0 ENDOSCOPY
								,0 ENT
								,0 ETT
								,0 ULTRASOUND
								,0 XRAY
								,0 MRI
								,0 Vacutainer
								,Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 '' commission
					  INTO #tempMain
					FROM (

					SELECT   i.InvoiceNo BillNo, i.FullName PatientName,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN iil.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,


							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=2 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,
							0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id Media

							FROM  Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
							JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.RefdDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')
														) T
														
							GROUP BY   BillNo,  PatientName



							--------- TEST WITH BILL NO---
							SELECT InvoiceNo,ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) AS Rate, TestGroupName ,GROUPID
							INTO #TempTESTWITHBILL
							FROM (
							SELECT ii.InvoiceNo,iid.Rate,tg.Name AS GroupName,tg.Id AS GROUPID,
							CASE
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'EE33EAE8-C1B6-43B3-822D-163DB4AD3026','87C5A431-365E-4798-3D7C-08DD0177C72A',
							'9A9798F6-CD9E-451F-A39F-306250EDDFCE','7FD12769-E9B3-4427-A56C-5DDDB64A19E9','3458C1F6-6EC2-44DC-918A-761022C6F07D',
							'B0F6E0F2-E828-490A-A38E-9D5D1EFA7323', '65253E1C-F02B-4F80-9E05-A0A7C51DA5C3','CEB5267B-CD4A-4428-8635-C00CF8C29C9E',
							'C14160D4-807D-42BD-94C2-D61F7AE66930','0BCC4AC0-F20D-4188-AF19-EA24486BD888','BB4902DB-0B2C-40AD-B29F-EE2C8FF74E3E' ) 
							THEN 'Pathology'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '58CCB71A-5646-4D3E-9DC0-356D5AA32E2A') THEN 'Hormone'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'BCF90C47-FCB2-4697-9876-C38B13894F75') THEN 'COLONOSCOPY'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') THEN 'BMD'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'ECC5A498-9B58-40BB-874C-39896DD47AB3','FC5F72A6-2A10-4D06-BE8E-DF10C5C2D043') THEN 'CTSCAN'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'B2EA7054-B415-42ED-8151-015D56891B77','79D79A31-00CE-443C-833B-D5EC201087B9') THEN 'ECG'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'B3F4448E-7F85-4CED-938C-3B3552E0999A','DF7FD28F-F6F9-420E-AFEA-D87B7D3F7925','97BE2C28-D3CE-4146-8BC1-E7F247F3AA09') THEN 'ECHO'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'D19A3F41-ACA5-4B67-B9CB-BF52AB5F06E5') THEN 'EEG'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '7DE727FC-3480-44F0-B312-E6F5036C962B') THEN 'ENDOSCOPY'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') THEN 'ENT'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '5C27382D-97C9-4C90-B650-DAE3AE0A4B54') THEN 'ETT'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '3D5235DE-F4D5-4551-8FAD-F2628013BAA1') THEN 'ULTRASOUND'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( 'B26790ED-F23A-4AD5-95C0-56DC2D91A815','F40DC710-7532-49F3-825B-EB2C6E140C4F','A139A424-CDEA-4DA7-B0F9-FA6C654D85E1') THEN 'XRAY'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '8BB94C2F-0FEC-48A4-B338-48D226FC42DF') THEN 'MRI'
							WHEN tg.Id IN ( '24269BFC-372B-41C8-A127-913C1FC0D9DA') THEN 'Vacutainer'

								ELSE ''
							END TestGroupName

							FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii
							JOIN diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails iid  ON ii.Id=iid.InvestigationInvoiceId
							INNER JOIN diag.TestItems ti ON ti.id=iid.TestItemId
							INNER JOIN diag.TestGroups tg ON tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ii.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ii.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							)T
							GROUP BY
							T.InvoiceNo,TestGroupName,GROUPID

							--SELECT * FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL
							----WHERE InvoiceNo=230920150
							--return

							UPDATE #tempMain SET Pathology= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='Pathology')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET Hormone= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='Hormone' )
							UPDATE #tempMain SET COLONOSCOPY= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='COLONOSCOPY') 
							UPDATE #tempMain SET BMD= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='BMD')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET CTSCAN= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='CTSCAN' )
							UPDATE #tempMain SET ECG= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='ECG')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET ECHO= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='ECHO')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET EEG= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='EEG')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET ENDOSCOPY= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='ENDOSCOPY' )
							UPDATE #tempMain SET ENT= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='ENT')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET ETT= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='ETT') 
							UPDATE #tempMain SET ULTRASOUND= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='ULTRASOUND' )
							UPDATE #tempMain SET XRAY= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='XRAY')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET MRI= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='MRI')
							UPDATE #tempMain SET Vacutainer= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #TempTESTWITHBILL WHERE #TempTESTWITHBILL.InvoiceNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND #TempTESTWITHBILL.TestGroupName='Vacutainer')

			select(
			select * from(

				SELECT * FROM #tempMain
			
			) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDoctorsContributionDatails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetDoctorsContributionDatails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'





	DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@ConsultantId uniqueidentifier



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ConsultantId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserID




	select(
	select * from(

	SELECT 
	*,
	0 NetAmount,
	0 AmountPaid,
	0 [DueAmount]
	FROM 
	(
	select 
	v.InvoiceNo [InvoiceNo],
	convert(date,V.EntryDate) [InvoiceDate],
	v.UHID,
	v.FullName [Patientname],
	M.Name [RefBy],
	I.Name [InvName],
	d.Total [Amount],
	[Diag].[Get_Discount_BaseOn_TestID_PatientID](v.id,I.ID,d.Total) [Discount]
	


	from 
	diag.InvestigationInvoices v
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceDetails d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = v.Id
	join [Diag].[TestItems] I on I.Id = d.TestItemId
	join [Diag].[TestGroups] G on G.Id = I.TestGroupId
	join VWDoctors M on M.Id = V.RefdDoctorId
	where CONVERT(DATE,v.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and CONVERT(DATE,v.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
	and (m.Id = @ConsultantId or @ConsultantId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T

	) tbl  
	
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


	--



END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDoctorWiseTestSummary] 
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetDoctorWiseTestSummary] '2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'




	DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@ConsultantID Uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(Uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserID

	select(
	select * from(

	SELECT 
	RefBy--, InvName
	,sum(TestQty) TestQty,sum(GrossAmount) GrossAmount,sum(NetAmount) NetAmount, sum(CashDiscount)CashDiscount,
	sum(NetAmount) -sum(CashDiscount) [TotalNetAmount],

	GroupName
	
					FROM 
					(
					select 
					--v.UHID,
					--v.InvoiceNo [BillNo],
					--V.EntryDate [BillDate],
					--v.FullName [Patientname],
					M.Name [RefBy],
					I.Name [InvName],
					d.Qty TestQty,
					d.Total [GrossAmount],
					--0 [CorDiscount],
					d.Total - 0 [NetAmount],
					[Diag].[Get_Discount_BaseOn_TestID_PatientID](v.id,I.ID,d.Total) [CashDiscount],
				G.Name [GroupName]
					from 
					diag.InvestigationInvoices v
					join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceDetails d on d.InvestigationInvoiceId = v.Id
					join [Diag].[TestItems] I on I.Id = d.TestItemId
					join [Diag].[TestGroups] G on G.Id = I.TestGroupId
					join VWDoctors M on M.Id = V.RefdDoctorId
					where CONVERT(DATE,v.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
					and CONVERT(DATE,v.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
					)T
					group by RefBy--,InvName
					,GroupName
					

	) tbl  
	ORDER BY GroupName
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


	----



END

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDueCollectionStatement]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	
	--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10. ConsultantID
--11.@OutletId 12.@SupplierId 13.@FormationId 14.@ProductName 15.@BrandExtensionsId 16. LoyalMemberID
--exec [Diag].[SpGetDueCollectionStatement] '05/10/2025 12:00:00 AM,05/19/2025 12:00:00 AM',2022,11,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,3'
  
  --exec 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	Declare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDate date
	

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select(
	select * from(
select i.InvoiceNo as BillNo,i.FullName as PatientName,il.Remarks as Remarks,il.Credit as DueCollAmount,FORMAT(il.TranDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS CollectionDate,u.UserName as UserName
from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on il.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.id
join [Identity].Users u on u.id=il.UserId
where  CONVERT(DATE,il.TranDate) > i.EntryDate and il.TransactionType = 2 
and CONVERT(DATE,il.TranDate) >= @FilterStartDate and CONVERT(DATE,il.TranDate)<= @FilterEndDate)tbl  FOR JSON AUTO) AS Data

End

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetDueStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetDueStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-07-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

					SELECT ii.InvoiceNo,SUM(iil.Debit) - SUM(iil.Credit) [DueAmount]
					INTO #TempSpGetDueAmount
					FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii
					JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON iil.InvestigationInvoiceId=ii.Id
					JOIN [Identity].Users u ON u.id=ii.UserId
					WHERE convert(DATE,iil.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND 
							convert(DATE,iil.TranDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							GROUP BY ii.InvoiceNo

					select(
			select EntryDate,BillNo,PatientName,SUM(TotalSale)  TotalSale,SUM(TotalDiscount) TotalDiscount ,isnull(DueAmount,0) as DueAmount,Remarks,UserName  from(


						SELECT 
							CONVERT(DATE,ii.EntryDate) AS EntryDate,
							ii.InvoiceNo AS BillNo, ii.FullName AS PatientName,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN SUM(iil.Debit) ELSE 0 END TotalSale,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN SUM(iil.Credit) ELSE 0 END TotalDiscount,
							--SUM(iil.Debit)-SUM(iil.Credit) DueAmount,
							ISNULL(ii.Remarks,'') AS Remarks,
							U.UserName AS UserName

							FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii
					JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON iil.InvestigationInvoiceId=ii.Id
					JOIN [Identity].Users u ON u.id=ii.UserId
					
					WHERE convert(DATE,iil.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND 
							convert(DATE,iil.TranDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							GROUP BY ii.EntryDate, ii.InvoiceNo,ii.FullName,iil.TransactionType,ii.Remarks,u.UserName

	
		) tbl  
		JOIN #TempSpGetDueAmount tt ON tt.InvoiceNo = tbl.BillNo
		GROUP by EntryDate,BillNo,PatientName,Remarks,UserName,tt.DueAmount
		HAVING SUM(tt.DueAmount)> 0


		FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END
GO

--- exec [Diag].[SpGetFinancialChartData] 0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetFinancialChartData]
@TenatnId int
AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
	DECLARE @year int = YEAR(getdate())
	DECLARE @month int = MONTH(getdate())
	DECLARE @CalCulationDate date

	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')

	CREATE Table #TempAllDate
	(
		Autoid int identity(1,1),
		CalCulationDate date
	)

	set @CalCulationDate = @FirstDayofthisMonth
	

	while(@CalCulationDate <= convert(date,getdate()))
	BEGIN
		insert into #TempAllDate (CalCulationDate) values(@CalCulationDate)
		set @CalCulationDate = DATEADD(Day,1,@CalCulationDate)
		
	END
	
		

			select t.Id TenantID,t.Name TenantName,convert(date,i.EntryDate) [Tdate],i.Id  InvestigationInvoiceId
			into #TempInvestigationInvoicesFinancialChart  
			from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
			join admin.Tenants t on t.Id=i.TenantId
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.Id
			where t.id=@TenatnId or @TenatnId=0
				and i.EntryDate >= @FirstDayofthisMonth
				and isnull(id.IsCancelApproved,0)<>1
			group by t.Id,t.Name, convert(date,i.EntryDate),i.id


			IF @TenatnId <> 0 
			BEGIN

			
			select  
			isnull(
				TenantID,
					(
					case when @TenatnId =0 then 0 else (select distinct ttt.ID from admin.Tenants ttt 
					where  ttt.id = @TenatnId) end 
					)
				) TenantID,
				isnull(
				TenantName,
					(
					case when @TenatnId =0 then 'All Tenant' else (select distinct ttt.name from admin.Tenants ttt 
					where  ttt.id = @TenatnId) end 
					)
				) TenantName,
			CONVERT(Nvarchar(50), ad.CalCulationDate) as Tdate
			,
			Round(isnull(sum(Debit),0),0) [Amount]
			from #TempAllDate ad
			left join #TempInvestigationInvoicesFinancialChart i on ad.CalCulationDate =i.Tdate
			left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on i.InvestigationInvoiceId = il.InvestigationInvoiceId
			and il.TransactionType =0
			 
			group by TenantID,TenantName,ad.CalCulationDate

			order by TenantID,TenantName,ad.CalCulationDate

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
					CREATE TABLE #TempFinalValue
					(
						AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
						TenantID int,
						TenantName nvarchar(max),
						[CalCulationDate] date,
						[Amount] float

					)

					DECLARE @MaxTenantID int
					DECLARE @CalculateTenantID int =1
					select @MaxTenantID = max(ID) from admin.Tenants
					while (@CalculateTenantID <=@MaxTenantID)
					BEGIN
							
							insert into #TempFinalValue
							(TenantID,TenantName,[CalCulationDate],[Amount])

													select  
									 @CalculateTenantID TenantID,
										(select name from admin.Tenants where id = @CalculateTenantID)
										TenantName,
											
									ad.CalCulationDate
									,
									Round(isnull(sum(Debit),0),0) [Amount]
									from #TempAllDate ad
									left join #TempInvestigationInvoicesFinancialChart i on ad.CalCulationDate =i.Tdate
									left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on i.InvestigationInvoiceId = il.InvestigationInvoiceId
									and il.TransactionType =0
									and i.TenantID = @CalculateTenantID
									and @CalculateTenantID <> 0
			 
									group by TenantID,TenantName,ad.CalCulationDate

									order by TenantID,TenantName,ad.CalCulationDate

									select @CalculateTenantID = min(id) from admin.Tenants where id > @CalculateTenantID

					END

					

					select TenantID,TenantName,CONVERT(Nvarchar(50), CalCulationDate) as Tdate,sum(Amount) Amount from #TempFinalValue
					group by TenantID,TenantName,CalCulationDate
			END

END
GO

-- exec [Diag].[SpGetFinancialChartDataCompareProjection] 1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetFinancialChartDataCompareProjection]
@TenatnId int
AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
	DECLARE @year int = YEAR(getdate())
	DECLARE @month int = MONTH(getdate())
	DECLARE @CalCulationDate date

	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
	--set @FirstDayofthisMonth  = DATEADD(month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)

	CREATE Table #TempAllDate
	(
		Autoid int identity(1,1),
		CalCulationDate date,
		CalCulationDateText nvarchar(max)
	)

	set @CalCulationDate = @FirstDayofthisMonth
	

	while(@CalCulationDate <= convert(date,getdate()))
	BEGIN
		insert into #TempAllDate (CalCulationDate,CalCulationDateText) values(@CalCulationDate,
		convert(nvarchar(10),Month(@CalCulationDate))+','+convert(nvarchar(10),Year(@CalCulationDate)))
		set @CalCulationDate = DATEADD(Day,1,@CalCulationDate)
		
	END
	
		

			select t.Id TenantID,t.ShortName,convert(date,i.EntryDate) [Tdate],i.Id  InvestigationInvoiceId,
			convert(nvarchar(10),Month(convert(date,i.EntryDate)))+','+convert(nvarchar(10),Year(
			convert(date,i.EntryDate)))
			CalCulationDateText
			into #TempInvestigationInvoicesFinancialChart  
			from Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
			join admin.Tenants t on t.Id=i.TenantId
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=i.Id
			where (t.id=@TenatnId or @TenatnId=0)
				and i.EntryDate >= @FirstDayofthisMonth
				and isnull(id.IsCancelApproved,0)<>1
			group by t.Id,t.ShortName, convert(date,i.EntryDate),i.id


			IF @TenatnId <> 0 
			BEGIN


			select TenantID,TenantName,[MonthYear] as TDate,
				isnull((
						select sum(GST.TargetAmount) from [Marketing].[GrossSalesTargets] GST
						where GST.TenantId= @TenatnId
						and MonthText = DateName( month , DateAdd( month , GST.Month , -1 ) )
						and YearText = GST.Year
					),0)

			 Projection,sum([Amount]) [Actual]
			
			from (
			select  
			(
					select distinct ttt.ID from admin.Tenants ttt 
					where  ttt.id = @TenatnId  
					)
				TenantID,
				
					(
					 select distinct ttt.ShortName from admin.Tenants ttt 
					where  ttt.id = @TenatnId 
					)
				 TenantName,
			--ad.CalCulationDate
			convert(nvarchar(10),DATENAME(Month,(convert(date,ad.CalCulationDate))))+','+convert(nvarchar(10),Year(
			convert(date,ad.CalCulationDate))) [MonthYear],
		0 Projection,

					
			
			Round(isnull(sum(Debit),0),0) [Amount]
			,
			DATENAME(Month,(convert(date,ad.CalCulationDate)))  MonthText,
					Year(convert(date,ad.CalCulationDate)) YearText
			from #TempAllDate ad
			left join #TempInvestigationInvoicesFinancialChart i on ad.CalCulationDate =i.Tdate
			left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on i.InvestigationInvoiceId = il.InvestigationInvoiceId
			and il.TransactionType =0
			 
			group by TenantID,ShortName,ad.CalCulationDate
			)tt
			group by TenantID,TenantName,[MonthYear],MonthText,YearText

			order by TenantID,TenantName,MonthText--,ad.CalCulationDate

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
					CREATE TABLE #TempFinalValue
					(
						AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
						TenantID int,
						TenantName nvarchar(max),
						[CalCulationDate] date,
						[Amount] float,
						[CalCulationDateText] nvarchar(max),

						[Projection] float
					)

					DECLARE @MaxTenantID int
					DECLARE @CalculateTenantID int =1
					select @MaxTenantID = max(ID) from admin.Tenants
					while (@CalculateTenantID <=@MaxTenantID)
					BEGIN
							
							insert into #TempFinalValue
							(TenantID,TenantName,[CalCulationDate],[Amount])

													select  
									 @CalculateTenantID TenantID,
										(select ShortName from admin.Tenants where id = @CalculateTenantID)
										TenantName,
											
									ad.CalCulationDate
									,
									Round(isnull(sum(Debit),0),0) [Amount]
									
									from #TempAllDate ad
									left join #TempInvestigationInvoicesFinancialChart i on ad.CalCulationDate =i.Tdate
									left join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers il on i.InvestigationInvoiceId = il.InvestigationInvoiceId
									and il.TransactionType =0
									and i.TenantID = @CalculateTenantID
									and @CalculateTenantID <> 0
			 
									group by TenantID,ShortName,ad.CalCulationDate

									order by TenantID,ShortName,ad.CalCulationDate

									select @CalculateTenantID = min(id) from admin.Tenants where id > @CalculateTenantID

									
									
					END

				
					 --update #TempFinalValue set
						--			 [Projection]=
						--			 isnull((
						--				select sum(GST.TargetAmount) from [Marketing].[GrossSalesTargets] GST
						--				where GST.TenantId= #TempFinalValue.TenantID
						--				and MONTH(#TempFinalValue.CalCulationDate) = GST.Month
						--				and Year(#TempFinalValue.CalCulationDate) = GST.Year
						--			 ),0)

					select TenantID,TenantName,CONVERT(Nvarchar(50), 
				
					convert(nvarchar(10),DATENAME(Month,(convert(date,CalCulationDate))))+','+convert(nvarchar(10),Year(
			convert(date,CalCulationDate)))

					) as Tdate,
					
					isnull((
						select sum(GST.TargetAmount) from [Marketing].[GrossSalesTargets] GST
						where GST.TenantId= #TempFinalValue.TenantID
						and DATENAME(Month,(convert(date,CalCulationDate))) = DateName( month , DateAdd( month , GST.Month , -1 ) )
						and Year(convert(date,CalCulationDate)) = GST.Year
					),0)
					[Projection], 
					
					sum(Amount) Actual from #TempFinalValue
					group by TenantID,TenantName,
					DATENAME(Month,(convert(date,CalCulationDate))),
					Year(convert(date,CalCulationDate))
					--convert(nvarchar(10),DATENAME(Month,(convert(date,CalCulationDate))))+','+convert(nvarchar(10),Year(
			--convert(date,CalCulationDate)))
			END
			

END
