--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId 23. DiagPatientId 24. DiagGroupId

--exec [Diag].[SpGetFinancialDashboard] 0



CREATE PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetFinancialDashboard]
@TenantId int=2
AS
BEGIN




	--DECLARE 
	--@TenantId int

	DECLARE @TodayDate date =getdate()
	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
	DECLARE @FirstDayofLastMonth date
	DECLARE @FirstDayofYear date
	DECLARE @FirstDayofLastYear date
	DECLARE @YTDstatusDivided int =100000
	
	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),Year(@TodayDate))+'-'+convert(varchar(2),Month(@TodayDate))+'-01')
	select @FirstDayofLastMonth = DATEADD(Month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
	select @FirstDayofYear  = DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, 0, @TodayDate), 0)
	select @FirstDayofLastYear = DATEADD(YEAR,-1,@FirstDayofYear)

	--select @FirstDayofthisMonth,@FirstDayofLastMonth

--select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
--SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
--SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

--select @TotalCurentMonthDayCount= day(@LastDayofCurrentMonth)


	--Select @TenantId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=22
	
	Create Table #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	(
		Autoid int,
		[Tenantsname] nvarchar(max),
		[ReportType] nvarchar(max),
		DescriptionDetails nvarchar(max),
		TodayStatus float,
		MTDStatus float,
		MTDTargetStatus float,
		MTDPYstatus float,
		YTDstatus float,
		YIDTarget float,
		YTDPY float,
		Variance float
	)

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 1, TenantsName,'REGISTRATIONS','Volume (Figure in Number)',count([TodayStatus]) [TodayStatus],
	count([MTDStatus]) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	count([MTDPYstatus]) [MTDPYstatus],
	count(YTDstatus) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	count(YTDPY) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select 
	t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,r.RegDate) = @TodayDate then r.id else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,r.RegDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,r.RegDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then r.Id else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,r.RegDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,r.RegDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then r.Id else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,r.RegDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,r.RegDate) <= @TodayDate  then r.Id else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,r.RegDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,r.RegDate) < @FirstDayofYear then r.Id else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Hospital.RegRecords r
	join [diag].InvestigationInvoices i on i.UHID = r.UHID
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = i.TenantId
	where (i.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)


	)T
	group by TenantsName


	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 2,TenantsName,'INVOICE COUNT','Volume (Figure in Number)',count([TodayStatus]) [TodayStatus],
	count([MTDStatus]) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	count([MTDPYstatus]) [MTDPYstatus],
	count(YTDstatus) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	count(YTDPY) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select  t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) = @TodayDate then r.id else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then r.Id else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,r.EntryDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then r.Id else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <= @TodayDate  then r.Id else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,r.EntryDate) < @FirstDayofYear then r.Id else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from [Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)

	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 3,TenantsName,'CANCEL INVOICE COUNT','Volume (Figure in Number)',count([TodayStatus]) [TodayStatus],
	count([MTDStatus]) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	count([MTDPYstatus]) [MTDPYstatus],
	count(YTDstatus) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	count(YTDPY) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) = @TodayDate then r.id else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then r.Id else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,r.EntryDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then r.Id else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <= @TodayDate  then r.Id else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,r.EntryDate) < @FirstDayofYear then r.Id else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from [Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =1
	
	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)

	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 4,TenantsName,'REVENUE (TILL DATE)','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	sum(isnull(TodayStatus,0)) TodayStatus,
	sum(isnull([MTDStatus],0)) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	sum(isnull([MTDPYstatus],0)) [MTDPYstatus],
	sum(isnull(YTDstatus,0)) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	sum(isnull(YTDPY,0)) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 and 
	l.TransactionType =0

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)

	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 5,TenantsName,'COLLECTION','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	ROUND(sum(isnull(TodayStatus,0)),2) TodayStatus,
	ROUND(sum(isnull([MTDStatus],0)),2) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	sum(isnull([MTDPYstatus],0)) [MTDPYstatus],
	sum(isnull(YTDstatus,0)) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	sum(isnull(YTDPY,0)) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 and 
	l.TransactionType =2

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 6,TenantsName,'ACCOUNT RECEIVABLE','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	ROUND(sum(isnull(TodayStatus,0)),2) TodayStatus,
	ROUND(sum(isnull([MTDStatus],0)),2) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	sum(isnull([MTDPYstatus],0)) [MTDPYstatus],
	sum(isnull(YTDstatus,0)) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	sum(isnull(YTDPY,0)) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit -l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit - l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit - l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit -l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit - l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 
	
	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	)T
	group by TenantsName


	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 7,TenantsName,'REFUND','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	isnull(ROUND(sum(TodayStatus),0),2) TodayStatus,
	isnull(ROUND(sum([MTDStatus]),0),2) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDPYstatus]),0) [MTDPYstatus],
	isnull(sum(YTDstatus),0) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	isnull(sum(YTDPY),0) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 and 
	l.TransactionType =5

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 8,TenantsName,'CASH DISCOUNT','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	isnull(sum(TodayStatus),0) TodayStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDStatus]),0) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDPYstatus]),0) [MTDPYstatus],
	isnull(sum(YTDstatus),0) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	isnull(sum(YTDPY),0) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 and 
	l.TransactionType < 0

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 9,TenantsName,'CORPORATE DISC','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	isnull(sum(TodayStatus),0) TodayStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDStatus]),0) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDPYstatus]),0) [MTDPYstatus],
	--round(isnull(sum(YTDstatus),0) /@YTDstatusDivided,2)  YTDstatus,

	isnull(sum(YTDstatus),0) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	isnull(sum(YTDPY),0) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 and 
	l.TransactionType =1 and r.CorporateClientId <> 0

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	)T
	group by TenantsName

	insert into #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard
	select 10,TenantsName,'TOTAL DISCOUNT','Financial (Figure in Lacs) Mid-Night',
	isnull(sum(TodayStatus),0) TodayStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDStatus]),0) [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	isnull(sum([MTDPYstatus]),0) [MTDPYstatus],
	isnull(sum(YTDstatus),0) YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	isnull(sum(YTDPY),0) YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	(
	select t.name TenantsName,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) = @TodayDate then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [TodayStatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofthisMonth 
	and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate 
	then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastMonth and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofLastMonth then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end [MTDPYstatus],
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) <= @TodayDate  then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	case when convert(date,l.TranDate) >= @FirstDayofLastYear and convert(date,l.TranDate) < @FirstDayofYear then l.Debit+l.Credit else null end YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from 
	[Diag].InvestigationInvoices r 
	join [Diag].InvestigationInvoiceLedgers l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId = r.Id
	join  Admin.Tenants t on t.Id = r.TenantId
	where (r.TenantId =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	and isnull(r.IsCancelApproved,0) =0 and 
	l.TransactionType < 0

	union all
	
	select t.name TenantsName, null [TodayStatus],
	null [MTDStatus],
	0 MTDTargetStatus,
	null [MTDPYstatus],
	null YTDstatus,
	0 YIDTarget,
	null YTDPY,
	0 Variance
	from Admin.Tenants t
	where (t.Id =@TenantId or @TenantId =0)
	)T
	group by TenantsName

	  --select(
	select * from(
		select 

		 Autoid ,
		[Tenantsname] ,
		[ReportType] ,
		DescriptionDetails ,
		TodayStatus ,
		MTDStatus ,
		MTDTargetStatus ,
		MTDPYstatus ,
		YTDstatus YTDstatusTotal,
		round(YTDstatus /@YTDstatusDivided,2) YTDstatus,
		YIDTarget ,
		YTDPY ,
		Variance 

		
		--round(isnull(sum(YTDstatus),0) /@YTDstatusDivided,2)  YTDstatus

		from #TempSpGetFinancialDashboard ) T 
		order by T.DescriptionDetails,T.Tenantsname, T.Autoid --FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	
END

-- exec [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationIndentTestItemWithPatientIdByDeptAndFloor] 'c3d1376b-7032-4fea-8df0-110151d2d46b,6e954fe4-f513-4207-a1fe-115095aa2d89,a42a9555-a14a-4b6e-91fc-1df61a5cb14f,c96a2d19-c5ee-40bd-94cc-41f77aff0c2d,553232ec-8c75-4576-aae0-4e625a537fc2,7be35050-0c6c-4106-a495-4e99d1c540d0,fde2d233-57b7-43a7-97a5-5660516bcbfa,93a9a958-dcaf-422a-8a7e-79350881a3b1,cad9a047-9c7a-41ed-a8fb-81974b519e51,4811e820-4391-465f-bb71-bae8a48c84a2,33743292-93b5-4efb-9564-bbda09a01c35,49bfdb28-594e-400f-948f-bf9eb60bc3fb,80b7f631-7d86-43c5-bc13-c3110dae0c55,8df81468-864b-45f9-81e2-c9bacd864566,4ca995b3-c979-4164-8cba-f1ab5e3e601c,1d873b6b-bb69-42cc-a265-f5fb2354db93,d4efe254-13c7-4041-9489-f8025e99e24d,9bb1e5fe-2f5a-44ae-81e1-fd3de484ec14','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0,'63e15e78-cc8a-4997-51e8-08dd0b8541c9'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationIndentTestItemWithPatientIdByDeptAndFloor]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DeptIds VARCHAR(1000)
	,@FloorId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	,@IsPatientVisibleByFloor INT
	,@IPDPatientId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT ini.Id PatientId
		,pd.FullName
		,pd.CabinNo
		,pd.CabinType
		,pd.CabinId
		,pd.CabinTypeId
		,isnull(ii.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') IndentId
		,isnull(ii.IndentNo, 0) IndentNo
		,ii.IndentDateTime
		,isnull(iid.Qty, 0) Qty
		,iid.Remarks
		,iid.STATUS
		,isnull(iid.TestItemId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') TestItemId
		,ti.Name TestName
		,ini.Id InvestigationInvoiceId
		,tg.ParentGroupId
	FROM [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd
	LEFT JOIN [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndents] ii ON pd.Id = ii.IPDPatientId
	LEFT JOIN [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndentDetails] iid ON ii.Id = iid.IPDInvestigationIndentId
	LEFT JOIN [Diag].[TestItems] ti ON iid.TestItemId = ti.Id
	LEFT JOIN [Diag].[TestGroups] tg ON ti.TestGroupId = tg.Id
	INNER JOIN [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ini ON ii.Id = ini.InvestigationIndentId
	WHERE (
			(
				@IsPatientVisibleByFloor = 1
				AND pd.FloorId = @FloorId
				)
			OR (
				@IsPatientVisibleByFloor = 0
				AND pd.HDepartmentId IN (
					SELECT *
					FROM STRING_SPLIT(@DeptIds, ',')
					)
				)
			AND tg.Id != 'be4f7f25-cf4a-4ce3-b49e-974a4b252617'
			AND @IPDPatientId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			)
		OR (
			@IPDPatientId != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			AND pd.Id = @IPDPatientId
			)
	ORDER BY pd.Id
		,ii.Id
		,ti.TestCode
		,ti.DisplayOrder
END
GO

--exec [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceByDates] '2025-07-01','2025-07-01',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceByDates]
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime ,
	@DueFlag as int
as begin 
	select tbl.*,bal.Balance as DueAmount from
		(select i.Id,i.InvoicePrefix,i.InvoiceNo,i.UHID,i.RxId,i.EntryDate,i.EntryTime,i.FullName,i.AgeYear,i.AgeMonth,i.AgeDay,i.MobileNo,i.Gender,i.RefdDoctorId,i.StaffRecordId,i.IPDPatientRecordId
		  ,i.OPDEmergencyPatientId,i.IsCancelApproved,i.CancelApprovedBy,i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId,i.UserId,i.TenantId,i.CabinNo,i.CorporateClientId,i.ServiceBenificiery,d.Name RefDoctorName,(0) SampleCollectStatus,i.Remarks,u.UserName,i.InvestigationIndentId
		 from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] i left join
			  [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on i.RefdDoctorId=d.Id left join
			  [Identity].[Users] u on i.UserId=u.Id
		where CONVERT(DATE, i.EntryDate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate)
		) tbl left join
		  (
		  select (sum(il.Debit) - sum(il.Credit)) Balance,il.InvestigationInvoiceId --and bal.Balance=0
			from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceLedgers] il
				 group by il.InvestigationInvoiceId
		  ) bal on tbl.Id=bal.InvestigationInvoiceId
		where (@DueFlag=1 and bal.Balance>0) or (@DueFlag=2 and bal.Balance=0) or @DueFlag=0
end 
GO

--Exec [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailsByDate] '01/01/2022','03/03/2023'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailsByDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select ii.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.TestCode,ti.Name as TestName,ti.Rate,id.LabNoPrefix,id.Qty,id.Total,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount,id.IsCancelApproved, id.IsDeleted,
	id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus,id.IsAllSampleCarried,id.IsAllSampleCollected,id.IsAllSampleReceived
	,ii.EntryDate,ii.EntryTime,ii.FullName PatientName,id.IsUrgent
	,tg.Name GroupName,ti.TestGroupId,tg.MovementRoomNo,id.ImagingReportStatus,ss.Name ImagingReportStatusTxt
	,(ii.AgeYear + 'Y ' + ii.AgeMonth + 'M ' + ii.AgeDay + 'D') Age, ii.Gender
	from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ii left join
		 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on ii.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId left join
		 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
		 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] rdu on id.ReportDeliveryBy=rdu.Id left join
		 [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
	where cast(ii.EntryDate as date) >= cast(@FromDate as date) and cast(ii.EntryDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date)
	order by ti.DisplayOrder,ti.Name


END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- =============================================
-- vacutainer test group Id 32
--Exec [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailsByInvoiceId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0,0
CREATE PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailsByInvoiceId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier ,
	@ParentGroupId uniqueidentifier,
	@IsCancelApproved int,
	@GetLabNo int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF(@IsCancelApproved=1)
BEGIN
	select ii.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.TestCode,ti.Name as TestName,ti.Rate,id.LabNoPrefix,id.Qty,id.Total,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount,id.IsCancelApproved, id.IsDeleted,
	id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus
	, rdu.UserName ReportDeliveryUserName,ii.EntryDate,ii.EntryTime,ii.FullName PatientName,id.IsAllSampleCarried,id.IsAllSampleCollected,id.IsAllSampleReceived
	,tg.Name GroupName,ti.TestGroupId ,id.IsUrgent,tg.MovementRoomNo,id.ImagingReportStatus,ss.Name ImagingReportStatusTxt
	,(ii.AgeYear + 'Y ' + ii.AgeMonth + 'M ' + ii.AgeDay + 'D') Age, ii.Gender
	from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ii left join
		 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on ii.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId left join
		 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
		 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] rdu on id.ReportDeliveryBy=rdu.Id left join
		 [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
	where id.IsCancelApproved=1 and id.IsDeleted=0 and id.InvestigationInvoiceId=@InvoiceId and tg.Id!='24269bfc-372b-41c8-a127-913c1fc0d9da'
	order by ti.TestCode, ti.DisplayOrder
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	if(@GetLabNo=0)
	begin
		select ii.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.TestCode,ti.Name as TestName,id.Rate,id.LabNoPrefix,id.Qty,id.Total,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount,id.IsCancelApproved,id.IsDeleted,
		id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus
		, rdu.UserName ReportDeliveryUserName,ii.EntryDate,ii.EntryTime,ii.FullName PatientName,id.IsAllSampleCarried,id.IsAllSampleCollected,id.IsAllSampleReceived
		,tg.Name GroupName,ti.TestGroupId,id.IsUrgent,tg.MovementRoomNo,id.ImagingReportStatus,ss.Name ImagingReportStatusTxt
		,(ii.AgeYear + 'Y ' + ii.AgeMonth + 'M ' + ii.AgeDay + 'D') Age, ii.Gender--, IsDiscountAllow--,sr.LabNo
		from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ii left join
			 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on ii.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId left join
			 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
			 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.id left join
			 [Identity].[Users] rdu on id.ReportDeliveryBy=rdu.Id left join
			 [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
		where id.InvestigationInvoiceId=@InvoiceId and ((tg.ParentGroupId=@ParentGroupId and tg.Id!= 'B1AE57E9-840B-4505-880A-89E1482EAF00') or @ParentGroupId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		order by id.IsDeleted,  ti.DisplayOrder
	end
	else
	begin
		select ii.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,ti.TestCode,ti.Name as TestName,id.Rate,id.LabNoPrefix,id.Qty,id.Total,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount,id.IsCancelApproved,id.IsDeleted,
		id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus
		, rdu.UserName ReportDeliveryUserName,ii.EntryDate,ii.EntryTime,ii.FullName PatientName,id.IsAllSampleCarried,id.IsAllSampleCollected,id.IsAllSampleReceived
		,tg.Name GroupName,ti.TestGroupId,id.IsUrgent,tg.MovementRoomNo,id.ImagingReportStatus,ss.Name ImagingReportStatusTxt
		,(ii.AgeYear + 'Y ' + ii.AgeMonth + 'M ' + ii.AgeDay + 'D') Age, ii.Gender--, IsDiscountAllow,sr.LabNo
		from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ii left join
			 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on ii.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId left join
			 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
			 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.id left join
			 [Identity].[Users] rdu on id.ReportDeliveryBy=rdu.Id left join
			 [Diag].[TestSamples] ts on id.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId left join
			 [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sr on ts.Id=sr.TestSampleId and sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId=id.Id left join
			 [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on id.ImagingReportStatus=ss.Id
		where id.InvestigationInvoiceId=@InvoiceId and ((tg.ParentGroupId=@ParentGroupId and tg.Id!= 'B1AE57E9-840B-4505-880A-89E1482EAF00') or @ParentGroupId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		order by id.IsDeleted,  ti.DisplayOrder
	end
END
END
GO

-- Exec [Diag].[spGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailsByPatientIdAndGroupType] '85c6ba1d-b69b-473c-bb6d-08dcb504d893', 0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[spGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailsByPatientIdAndGroupType]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@GroupType int
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SELECT ii.EntryDate,ii.EntryTime,ii.InvoiceNo,ii.InvoicePrefix,ti.TestCode,ti.Name TestName,iid.Rate,iid.Qty,iid.Total, u.UserName,iid.Discount,iid.Id,iid.InvestigationInvoiceId,
		   iid.TestItemId,LabNoPrefix,iid.AccessionNumber,iid.SOPInstanceUID,iid.DiscountInPercent,iid.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,iid.ReportDeliveryBy,iid.ProcedureStep,
		   iid.LisReportStatus,iid.IsCancelApproved,iid.IsAllSampleCollected,iid.IsAllSampleCarried,iid.IsAllSampleReceived,iid.IsUrgent
	FROM [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] hpd INNER JOIN
		 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ii ON hpd.Id=ii.IPDPatientRecordId INNER JOIN
		 [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] iid ON ii.Id=iid.InvestigationInvoiceId INNER JOIN 
		 [Diag].[TestItems] ti ON iid.TestItemId=ti.Id INNER JOIN
		 [Diag].[TestGroups] tg ON ti.TestGroupId=tg.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u ON ii.UserId=u.Id 
	WHERE hpd.Id=@PatientId and ((@GroupType= 0 and tg.ParentGroupId in (SELECT id FROM Diag.ParentGroup where name = 'Pathology')) or (@GroupType= 1 and tg.ParentGroupId in (SELECT id FROM Diag.ParentGroup where name = 'RADIOLOGY & IMAGING'))) and iid.IsDeleted!=1
	ORDER BY ii.EntryDate,ii.InvoiceNo, ti.DisplayOrder,ti.Name
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-- vacutainer test group Id 32
--Exec [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailWithTestSampleStatusByInvoiceId] '591ba681-fcb8-4ecd-5c73-08dd0960f9bc','2024-11-01','2050-11-21'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetInvestigationInvoiceDetailWithTestSampleStatusByInvoiceId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier,
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select ii.InvoiceNo,ii.EntryDate,ii.EntryTime,ii.FullName PatientName,id.Id,id.InvestigationInvoiceId,id.TestItemId,id.LabNoPrefix,id.AccessionNumber,id.SOPInstanceUID,id.Rate,id.Qty,id.Total,id.DiscountInPercent,id.Discount
			,id.ProbableReportDeliveryDateTime,id.ReportDeliveryBy,id.ProcedureStep,id.LisReportStatus,id.IsCancelApproved,IsAllSampleCarried,id.IsAllSampleCollected,id.IsAllSampleReceived
			,ts.LabelText,isnull(sr.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') SampleCollectionRecordId,isnull(sr.InvoiceId,id.InvestigationInvoiceId) InvoiceId,isnull(sr.TestSampleId,ts.Id) TestSampleId,isnull(sr.SampleCollectionBy,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') SampleCollectionBy,sr.SampleCollectionDateTime,isnull(sr.SampleCarriedBy,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') SampleCarriedBy,sr.SampleCarriedDateTime
			,isnull(sr.SampleReceiveByAtLab,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') SampleReceiveByAtLab,sr.SampleReceiveDateTime,ti.Name TestItemName,ti1.Name AS VacutainerName
			,scu.UserName SampleCollectedByUserName,ssu.EmployeeName SampleCarriedByUserName, sru.UserName SampleReceiveByUserName,tg.Id TestGroupId, tg.Name TestGroupName,ss.Name SampleStatusTxt,isnull(sr.LabNo,0) LabNo,isnull(sr.SampleStatus,0) SampleStatus,id.IsUrgent
			,sr.RejectRemarks,
			cast(case when sr.SampleCollectionDateTime is not null then DATEDIFF_BIG(MINUTE, sr.SampleCollectionDateTime, GETDATE()) else 0 end as int) TimeFromCollected
	  from [Diag].[InvestigationInvoices] ii inner join
		   [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on ii.Id=id.InvestigationInvoiceId inner join
		   [Diag].[TestItems] ti on id.TestItemId=ti.Id inner join
		   [Diag].[TestGroups] tg on ti.TestGroupId=tg.id inner join
		   [Diag].[TestSamples] ts on id.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId left join
		   [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords] sr on ts.Id=sr.TestSampleId and sr.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId=id.Id inner join
		   [Diag].[SampleStatuses] ss on sr.SampleStatus=ss.id left join
		   [Identity].[Users] scu on scu.Id=sr.SampleCollectionBy left join
		   [HR].[StaffRecords] ssu on ssu.Id=sr.SampleCarriedBy left join
		   [Identity].[Users] sru on sru.Id=sr.SampleReceiveByAtLab LEFT JOIN
		   [TestItems] ti1 on ti.DefaultVacutainerId=ti1.Id
	 where id.IsDeleted=0 
	 and ti.TestGroupId!='24269BFC-372B-41C8-A127-913C1FC0D9DA' and tg.ParentGroupId!='b736ab64-5fc4-4867-9826-9551a3a6099d' and ((id.InvestigationInvoiceId=@InvoiceId) or (@InvoiceId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and (cast(ii.EntryDate as date) >= cast(@FromDate as date) and cast(ii.EntryDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date))))
	 order by ti.DisplayOrder,tg.Id
END

--exec [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentDetailByPatientId] '46edb4fd-7c93-4b63-9167-08db093d9d1a','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentDetailByPatientId]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@Indentid uniqueidentifier
as begin 
	select iid.Id,iid.IPDInvestigationIndentId,iid.TestItemId,iid.Qty,iid.Rate,iid.PackageRate,iid.Status,iid.Remarks,ti.Name TestName,ti.Rate TestRate,ii.IndentNo,ii.IndentDateTime,st.Name StatusTxt,ii.SpecialInstruction,iid.TestDate,iid.TestTime,iid.IsPerformed
	from [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndents] ii inner join
		 [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndentDetails] iid on ii.Id=iid.IPDInvestigationIndentId inner join
		 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on iid.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
		 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on iid.Status=st.Id
	where ((@Indentid='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and ii.IPDPatientId=@PatientId) or (@PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and ii.Id=@Indentid
	order by ti.DisplayOrder,ti.Name
end

--exec [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentDetailForDashboard] 
create PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentDetailForDashboard]
	@DeptIds varchar(200),
	@FloorId uniqueidentifier,
	@IsPatientVisibleByFloor int
as begin 
	select iid.Id,ti.Name TestName,iid.TestDate,iid.TestTime,pd.FullName,pd.CabinNo,pd.Id PatientId
	from [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndents] ii inner join
		 [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndentDetails] iid on ii.Id=iid.IPDInvestigationIndentId inner join
		 [Diag].[TestItems] ti on iid.TestItemId=ti.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on ii.IPDPatientId=pd.Id
    where (@IsPatientVisibleByFloor=1 and pd.FloorId=@FloorId) or (@IsPatientVisibleByFloor=0 and pd.HDepartmentId in (select * from STRING_SPLIT(@DeptIds, ','))) and iid.IsPerformed=0
	order by pd.Id
end

--exec [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentRecordByDateOrId] '2023-02-07','46edb4fd-7c93-4b63-9167-08db093d9d1a',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentRecordByDateOrId]
	@EntryDate datetime,
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@IsPackageService int
as begin 
	if(@IsPackageService=0)
	begin
		select ii.Id,ii.IndentNo,ii.IPDPatientId,ii.CabinNo,ii.CabinType,ii.IndentDateTime,ii.UserId,ii.Priority,ii.SpecialInstruction,pd.FullName PatientName,
		CAST(case when ii.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
				  when ii.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
				  when ii.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
				  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,ii.Status,st.Name StatusTxt,
		u.UserName,pd.AssignedDoctorName AssignedDoctor,ii.AttentionOf,pd.InvoiceNo,pd.UHID,
		pd.Age,
		ii.DoctorId
		from [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndents] ii inner join
			 [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on ii.IPDPatientId=pd.Id inner join
			 [Identity].[Users] u on ii.UserId=u.Id inner join
			 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on ii.Status=st.Id
		where (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and CONVERT(date, ii.IndentDateTime)=CONVERT(date, @EntryDate)) or ii.Id=@Id
	end
	else
	begin
		select ii.Id,ii.IndentNo,ii.IPDPatientId,ii.CabinNo,ii.CabinType,ii.IndentDateTime,ii.UserId,ii.Priority,ii.SpecialInstruction,pd.FullName PatientName,
		CAST(case when ii.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
				  when ii.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
				  when ii.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
				  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,ii.Status,st.Name StatusTxt,
		u.UserName,pd.AssignedDoctorName AssignedDoctor,ii.AttentionOf,pd.InvoiceNo,pd.UHID, pd.Age, ii.DoctorId
		from [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndents] ii inner join
			 [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on ii.IPDPatientId=pd.Id inner join
			 [Identity].[Users] u on ii.UserId=u.Id inner join
			 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on ii.Status=st.Id
		where (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and CONVERT(date, ii.IndentDateTime)=CONVERT(date, @EntryDate) and pd.PackageId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or ii.Id=@Id
	end
end 
GO

--exec [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentRecordByDates] '2023-02-07','2023-05-01'
CREATE PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetIPDInvestigationIndentRecordByDates]
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime 
as begin 
	select ii.Id,ii.IndentNo,ii.IPDPatientId,ii.CabinNo,ii.CabinType,ii.IndentDateTime,ii.UserId,ii.Priority,ii.SpecialInstruction,pd.FullName PatientName,
	CAST(case when ii.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when ii.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when ii.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  else 'Others' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,
	u.UserName,pd.AssignedDoctorName AssignedDoctor,ii.AttentionOf,pd.InvoiceNo,ii.DoctorId
	from [Diag].[IPDInvestigationIndents] ii inner join
		 [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on ii.IPDPatientId=pd.Id inner join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on ii.UserId=u.Id
	where CONVERT(DATE, ii.IndentDateTime)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate)
end 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Diag].[SpGetLabLISResult]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- exec [Diag].[SpGetLabLISResult] 'c6b35775-f923-4e9f-2eb2-08dd5579fa88',0


CREATE   PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetLabLISResult]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@LabNo int
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		Id,  
		PathologyReportId,
		TestItemId, 
		ReportParameterId,
		TestTitle,
		case when isnull(RResult,'') <> '' then RResult else MResult  end RResult ,
		ResultUnit, 
		NormalResult,
		DefaultValue,
		InputType,
		ValueOptions,
		TestName,
		TestGroupId,
		TestGroupName,
		isGroupTitle,
		IsReportInTableFormat,
		NoOfColumn,
		TestMethodName,
		TestSampleId,
		SampleCollectionRecordId, 
		LabNo,
		MResult,
		LabelText,
		Specimen,
		InvestigationInvoiceDetailId,
		SampleCollectionBy,
		SampleCollectionDateTime,
		SampleCarriedBy,
		SampleCarriedDateTime,
		SampleReceiveByAtLab,
		SampleReceiveDateTime,
		SampleStatus,
		DisplayOrder,
		IsThisOnePrinted
	 from (
	
	select  
		'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' Id,  
		'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' PathologyReportId,
		ti.Id TestItemId, 
		rp.Id ReportParameterId,
		rp.Name TestTitle,
		'' RResult,

		isnull((
			select distinct ls.unit from  Diag.LISResultRecord ls 
			join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId and p.LabNo = s.LabNo 
			where  ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id
		   ),rp.unit) ResultUnit, 
		   
		rp.Normavalue NormalResult,
		rp.DefaultValue,
		rp.InputType,
		rp.ValueOptions,
		ti.Name TestName,
		tg.Id TestGroupId,
		tg.Name TestGroupName
		,rp.isGroupTitle,ti.IsReportInTableFormat,ti.NoOfColumn
		,tm.Name TestMethodName,
		ts.Id TestSampleId,
		s.Id as SampleCollectionRecordId, 
		s.LabNo,

		(select distinct ls.Value from  Diag.LISResultRecord ls 
			join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId and p.LabNo = s.LabNo
			where  ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id) MResult,

		ts.LabelText LabelText,
		ts.Specimen,
		s.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId,
		s.SampleCollectionBy,
		s.SampleCollectionDateTime,
		s.SampleCarriedBy,
		s.SampleCarriedDateTime,
		s.SampleReceiveByAtLab,
		s.SampleReceiveDateTime,
		s.SampleStatus,
		rp.DisplayOrder DisplayOrder,
		1 IsThisOnePrinted
	from Diag.SampleCollectionRecords s
	join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails iid on s.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId=iid.Id
		join Diag.TestSamples ts on ts.Id=s.TestSampleId
		join Diag.ReportParameters rp on rp.TestSampleId=ts.Id
		left join Diag.TestItems ti on ti.Id=ts.TestItemId
		left join Diag.TestMethods tm on rp.TestMethodId=tm.Id
		left join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
		--left join Diag.LISResultRecord ls on ls.PatientRecordId= p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id 
		--left join [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on s.InvoiceId=pr.PatientId and s.LabNo=pr.LabNo 
		--left join [Diag].[PathologyReportDetails] prd on pr.Id=prd.PathologyReportId and prd.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId and prd.ReportParameterId=rp.Id
	where s.InvoiceId=@PatientId
	and (s.LabNo=@LabNo or @LabNo=0) and s.SampleStatus < 5 and s.SampleStatus != 9 and s.SampleStatus > 3 and iid.IsDeleted=0

	
	union all
	

	select 
		prd.Id, 
		prd.PathologyReportId, 
		ti.Id TestItemId
	    ,rp.Id ReportParameterId
		,prd.TestTitle 
		,prd.TestResult RResult 
		,prd.ResultUnit
		,prd.NormalResult
		,rp.DefaultValue
		,rp.InputType
		,rp.ValueOptions
		,ti.Name TestName
		,tg.Id TestGroupId
		,tg.Name TestGroupName
		,rp.isGroupTitle
		,ti.IsReportInTableFormat
		,ti.NoOfColumn
		,tm.Name TestMethodName
		,ts.Id TestSampleId
		,s.Id as SampleCollectionRecordId
		,s.LabNo,
		(select distinct ls.Value from  Diag.LISResultRecord ls 
			join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId and p.LabNo = s.LabNo
			where  ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id) MResult,
		ts.LabelText LabelText,
		ts.Specimen,
		s.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId
		,s.SampleCollectionBy
		,s.SampleCollectionDateTime
		,s.SampleCarriedBy
		,s.SampleCarriedDateTime
		,s.SampleReceiveByAtLab
		,s.SampleReceiveDateTime
		,s.SampleStatus
		,prd.DisplayOrder
		,prd.IsThisOnePrinted

		from Diag.SampleCollectionRecords s
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails iid on s.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId=iid.Id
			join Diag.TestSamples ts on ts.Id=s.TestSampleId
			join Diag.ReportParameters rp on rp.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId
			join Diag.TestItems ti on ti.Id=ts.TestItemId
			left join Diag.TestMethods tm on rp.TestMethodId=tm.Id
			join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
			join [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on s.InvoiceId=pr.PatientId and s.LabNo=pr.LabNo 
			left join [Diag].[PathologyReportDetails] prd on pr.Id=prd.PathologyReportId and prd.TestItemId = ts.TestItemId and prd.ReportParameterId = rp.Id

	where s.InvoiceId=@PatientId
	and (s.LabNo=@LabNo or @LabNo=0) and s.SampleStatus >= 5 and s.SampleStatus != 9 and iid.IsDeleted=0
	
	) t Order by DisplayOrder
	
END


GO

-- exec [Diag].[SpGetLabLISResultPrac] 'A5C2766F-67EB-4F66-1B32-08DDB3B51BEB',0,'3115af73-d888-43ac-b804-08ddb3abba87'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetLabLISResultPrac]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@LabNo int,
	@ReportTitleId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
 	select 
	distinct	t.Id,  
		t.PathologyReportId,
		t.TestItemId, 
		ReportParameterId,
		TestTitle,
		case when isnull(MResult,'') <> '' then MResult else RResult end RResult ,
		ResultUnit, 
		NormalResult,
		DefaultValue,
		InputType,
		ValueOptions,
		TestName,
		TestGroupId,
		TestGroupName,
		t.ReportTitleName,
		isGroupTitle,
		IsReportInTableFormat,
		NoOfColumn,
		TestMethodName,
		TestSampleId,
		SampleCollectionRecordId, 
		LabNo,
		MResult,
		LabelText,
		Specimen,
		InvestigationInvoiceDetailId,
		SampleCollectionBy,
		SampleCollectionDateTime,
		SampleCarriedBy,
		SampleCarriedDateTime,
		SampleReceiveByAtLab,
		SampleReceiveDateTime,
		SampleStatus,
		DisplayOrder,
		t.TestOrder,
		TestDisplayOrder,
		IsThisOnePrinted,
		IsCancelApproved
	
	 from (
	
	select  
		'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' Id,  
		'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' PathologyReportId,
		ti.Id TestItemId, 
		rp.Id ReportParameterId,
		rp.Name TestTitle,
		'' RResult,

		isnull((
			select distinct ls.unit from  Diag.LISResultRecord ls 
			join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId --and p.LabNo = s.LabNo 
			where  ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id
		   ),rp.unit) ResultUnit, 
		   
		rp.Normavalue NormalResult,
		rp.DefaultValue,
		rp.InputType,
		rp.ValueOptions,
		ti.Name TestName,
		tg.Id TestGroupId,
		tg.Name TestGroupName
		,r.Id ReportTitleId
		,r.name ReportTitleName
		,rp.isGroupTitle,ti.IsReportInTableFormat,ti.NoOfColumn
		,tm.Name TestMethodName,
		ts.Id TestSampleId,
		s.Id as SampleCollectionRecordId, 
		0 LabNo,

		(select distinct ls.Value from  Diag.LISResultRecord ls 
			join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId --and p.LabNo = s.LabNo
			where  ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id) MResult,

		ts.LabelText LabelText,
		ts.Specimen,
		s.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId,
		s.SampleCollectionBy,
		s.SampleCollectionDateTime,
		s.SampleCarriedBy,
		s.SampleCarriedDateTime,
		s.SampleReceiveByAtLab,
		s.SampleReceiveDateTime,
		s.SampleStatus,
		rp.DisplayOrder DisplayOrder,rt.TestOrder,
		ti.DisplayOrder TestDisplayOrder,
		1 IsThisOnePrinted
		, (select  isnull(	invd.IsCancelApproved, 0) from  Diag.InvestigationInvoices as inv JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails as invd On invd.InvestigationInvoiceId = inv.Id  
				where inv.Id = @PatientId and ti.Id = invd.TestItemId
		
		) as IsCancelApproved
	from [Diag].ReportTitles r
		inner join Diag.ReportTitleSettings rt on r.Id=rt.ReportTitleId
		inner join [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on rt.TestItemId=id.TestItemId 
	    --inner join Diag.SampleCollectionRecords s on s.InvoiceId=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
		join Diag.TestSamples ts on ts.TestItemId=rt.TestItemId
		join Diag.ReportParameters rp on rp.TestSampleId=ts.Id
		left join Diag.TestItems ti on ti.Id=ts.TestItemId
		left join Diag.TestMethods tm on rp.TestMethodId=tm.Id
		left join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
					LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT
			Id
			,InvoiceId
			,max(SampleCollectionDateTime) SampleCollectionDateTime
			,max(SampleCarriedDateTime) SampleCarriedDateTime
			,max(SampleReceiveDateTime) SampleReceiveDateTime
			,SampleStatus
			,SampleCarriedBy
			,SampleReceiveByAtLab
			,SampleCollectionBy
			,InvestigationInvoiceDetailId
		FROM [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords]
		GROUP BY 		Id,InvoiceId,SampleStatus
			,SampleCarriedBy
			,SampleReceiveByAtLab
			,SampleCollectionBy
			,InvestigationInvoiceDetailId) s on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=s.InvoiceId

		--left join Diag.LISResultRecord ls on ls.PatientRecordId= p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id 
		--left join [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on s.InvoiceId=pr.PatientId and s.LabNo=pr.LabNo 
		--left join [Diag].[PathologyReportDetails] prd on pr.Id=prd.PathologyReportId and prd.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId and prd.ReportParameterId=rp.Id
	where id.InvestigationInvoiceId=@PatientId and r.Id=@ReportTitleId
	 and s.SampleStatus < 5 and s.SampleStatus != 9 and s.SampleStatus > 3  and id.IsDeleted = 0

	
	union all
	

	select 
		prd.Id, 
		prd.PathologyReportId, 
		ti.Id TestItemId
	    ,rp.Id ReportParameterId
		,prd.TestTitle 
		,prd.TestResult RResult 
		,prd.ResultUnit
		,prd.NormalResult
		,rp.DefaultValue
		,rp.InputType
		,rp.ValueOptions
		,ti.Name TestName
		,tg.Id TestGroupId
		,tg.Name TestGroupName
		,r.Id ReportTitleId
		,r.name ReportTitleName
		,rp.isGroupTitle
		,ti.IsReportInTableFormat
		,ti.NoOfColumn
		,tm.Name TestMethodName
		,ts.Id TestSampleId
		,s.Id as SampleCollectionRecordId
		,0 LabNo,
		(select distinct ls.Value from  Diag.LISResultRecord ls 
			join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId --and p.LabNo = s.LabNo
			where  ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id) MResult,
		ts.LabelText LabelText,
		ts.Specimen,
		s.InvestigationInvoiceDetailId
		,s.SampleCollectionBy
		,s.SampleCollectionDateTime
		,s.SampleCarriedBy
		,s.SampleCarriedDateTime
		,s.SampleReceiveByAtLab
		,s.SampleReceiveDateTime
		,s.SampleStatus
		,prd.DisplayOrder,rt.TestOrder
		,ti.DisplayOrder TestDisplayOrder
		,prd.IsThisOnePrinted
		, (select isnull( 	invd.IsCancelApproved, 0) from  Diag.InvestigationInvoices as inv JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails as invd On invd.InvestigationInvoiceId = inv.Id  
				where inv.Id = @PatientId and ti.Id = invd.TestItemId
		
		) as IsCancelApproved
		from [Diag].ReportTitles r
		inner join Diag.ReportTitleSettings rt on r.Id=rt.ReportTitleId
		inner join [Diag].[InvestigationInvoiceDetails] id on rt.TestItemId=id.TestItemId 
	    --inner join Diag.SampleCollectionRecords s on s.InvoiceId=id.InvestigationInvoiceId
			join Diag.TestSamples ts on ts.TestItemId=rt.TestItemId
			join Diag.ReportParameters rp on rp.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId
			join Diag.TestItems ti on ti.Id=ts.TestItemId
			left join Diag.TestMethods tm on rp.TestMethodId=tm.Id
			join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
			join [Diag].[PathologyReports] pr on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=pr.PatientId --and s.LabNo=pr.LabNo 
			join [Diag].[PathologyReportDetails] prd on pr.Id=prd.PathologyReportId and prd.TestItemId = ts.TestItemId and prd.ReportParameterId = rp.Id
								inner JOIN (
		SELECT
			Id
			,InvoiceId
			,max(SampleCollectionDateTime) SampleCollectionDateTime
			,max(SampleCarriedDateTime) SampleCarriedDateTime
			,max(SampleReceiveDateTime) SampleReceiveDateTime
			,SampleStatus
			,SampleCarriedBy
			,SampleReceiveByAtLab
			,SampleCollectionBy
			,InvestigationInvoiceDetailId
		FROM [Diag].[SampleCollectionRecords]
		GROUP BY 		Id,InvoiceId,SampleStatus
			,SampleCarriedBy
			,SampleReceiveByAtLab
			,SampleCollectionBy
			,InvestigationInvoiceDetailId) s on id.InvestigationInvoiceId=s.InvoiceId
			
	where id.InvestigationInvoiceId=@PatientId and r.Id=@ReportTitleId
	 and s.SampleStatus >= 5 and s.SampleStatus != 9 and id.IsDeleted = 0
	
	) t
	where t.IsCancelApproved = 0 and t.ReportTitleId=@ReportTitleId

	Order by t.TestOrder, TestDisplayOrder,DisplayOrder
	
END


GO

--------------exec [Diag].[SpGetLabReportPrint] 'BEDE69DD-5D16-4441-AEC5-08DB40C65DAB',0


CREATE PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetLabReportPrint]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@LabNo int
AS
BEGIN
	select  s.InvoiceId PatientId,  tg.Name GroupName,tg.Id GroupId, ti.Name TestName, ti.Id TestId,rp.Name ReportParameterName, rp.Id ReportParameterId,
	ls.Value RResult, ls.Value MResult,ls.Unit Unit, rp.Normavalue NormalValue,ts.Id TestSampleId, ts.LabelText LabelText
	--select s.*
	from Diag.SampleCollectionRecords s 
	left join Diag.LISPatientRecord p on p.PatientId=s.InvoiceId and p.LabNo = s.LabNo
	
	join Diag.TestSamples ts on ts.Id=s.TestSampleId
	join Diag.ReportParameters rp on rp.TestItemId=ts.TestItemId
	join Diag.TestItems ti on ti.Id=ts.TestItemId
	join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id=ti.TestGroupId
	left join Diag.LISResultRecord ls on ls.PatientRecordId=p.Id and ls.ParameterId = rp.Id

	where s.InvoiceId=@PatientId
	and (s.LabNo=@LabNo or @LabNo=0)
	--group by ti.Name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetMachineGroupAndTestMappingById]

	@MappingId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT ma.Id, ma.PathologicalMachineGroupId,ma.TenantId,ma.TestSampleId,mg.Name MachineGroupName,ts.LabelText,ts.Specimen,ti.Name TestName, isnull(ti.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') TestItemId

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SPGetMACommissionStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SPGetMACommissionStatement]
  @paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	declare 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	  @FilterEndDate date,
	  @MarketingJOfficerId uniqueidentifier
	  Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	Create table #TempTestGroupSpecialGroupName
	(
		MainGroupID bigint,
		DisplayGroupName nvarchar(max)
	)
	
	INSERT INTO #TempTestGroupSpecialGroupName
	SELECT 1,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 2,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 3,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 4,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 5,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 6,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 7,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 8,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 9,'Pathology'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 11,'Pathology'

	UNION ALL
	SELECT 14,'CBCT'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 24,'CBCT'

	UNION ALL
	SELECT 17,'ECHO'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 31,'ECHO'

	UNION ALL
	SELECT 29,'ECG'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 30,'ECG'


	DECLARE @TestGroupName nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE @TempQuery    nvarchar(4000)
	DECLARE @CountPatientNumbr int
	
	DECLARE @PatientID UniqueIdentifier
	DECLARE @TestCost float
	DECLARE @InvoiceNo   nvarchar(100)
	DECLARE @EDate date
	DECLARE @FullName nvarchar(100) 
	DECLARE @AllColumne nvarchar(max)

	DECLARE	 @MediaFullName nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE  @MediaCodeNo nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE	 @MarketingAgentsFullName nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE  @MarketingAgentsCodeNo nvarchar(max)

	


	set @TempQuery = 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS TempSPGetMACommissionStatement '
	exec(@TempQuery) 

	set @AllColumne =''
	set @TempQuery ='
	create table TempSPGetMACommissionStatement
	(
	   ReportType nvarchar(max),
	   MAID UniqueIdentifier,
	   MediaFullName nvarchar(max),
	   MediaCodeNo nvarchar(max),
	   MarketingAgentsFullName nvarchar(max),
	   MarketingAgentsCodeNo nvarchar(max),
	   invoiceNumber      bigint,
	   PatientID UniqueIdentifier,
	   EDate Date,
	   FullName   nvarchar(100),
	   TotalSales float
	   '

	declare @testGroup nvarchar(max);
	DECLARE cursor_Test_Group
	CURSOR FOR
		select  isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,T.Name) Name
		from 
		Diag.TestGroups  T
		LEFT JOIN #TempTestGroupSpecialGroupName d on d.MainGroupID = T.Id
		where T.id not in (32,37,12)
		group by isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,T.Name)
	Open cursor_Test_Group
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Test_Group  INTO @TestGroupName
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
	BEGIN
			set @TempQuery = @TempQuery +' , ['+@TestGroupName+'] float default 0'
			set @testGroup = REPLACE (@TestGroupName, ' ', '_')
			set @testGroup = REPLACE (@TestGroupName, '-', '_')

			set @AllColumne = @AllColumne +' ,'+ '['+@TestGroupName+']' + ' ['+@testGroup+']'
			--print @TestGroupName
			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Test_Group  INTO @TestGroupName
	END
	CLOSE cursor_Test_Group;  
	DEALLOCATE cursor_Test_Group;
	

	--set @TempQuery = @TempQuery +',Discount float,Due float,Refund float,Paid float)'
	set @TempQuery = @TempQuery +')'
	
	exec(@TempQuery)

	

	DECLARE cursor_temp_MA_payment
	CURSOR FOR
	select 
	P.id PatientId,isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,TG.Name) TestGroupName, Sum(TC.Total) TestCost, P.InvoiceNo,P.EntryDate,p.FullName,
	B.Name [MediaFullName],
	B.CodeNo MarketingCodeNo,
	mm.Name,
	mm.MarketingCodeNo
	from
		DIAG.InvestigationInvoices p
	join 
		Marketing.Medias   B
			ON p.MediaId = B.Id
	join Marketing.MarketingAgents mm 
		ON mm.Id=b.MarketingAgentId		
	Join 
		Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails TC
			On TC.InvestigationInvoiceId = P.Id
	Join 
		diag.TestItems  TI
			on TI.Id = TC.TestItemId
	Join
		diag.TestGroups  TG
			on TI.TestGroupId = TG.Id
	LEFT JOIN #TempTestGroupSpecialGroupName d on d.MainGroupID = TG.Id
	
	Where 
		(mm.Id=@MarketingJOfficerId or @MarketingJOfficerId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	AND
		Convert(date,P.EntryDate) >= @FilterStartDate
	AND
		Convert(date,P.EntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate
	AND  TG.id not in (32,37,12)
	Group BY
		B.id,P.id,P.InvoiceNo,P.EntryDate,p.FullName,isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,TG.Name),
		B.Name,B.CodeNo,mm.Name,mm.MarketingCodeNo		 
    
	Open cursor_temp_MA_payment
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_temp_MA_payment  INTO @PatientID,@TestGroupName,@TestCost,@InvoiceNo,@EDate,@FullName, 
	@MediaFullName,@MediaCodeNo,@MarketingAgentsFullName,@MarketingAgentsCodeNo
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
	BEGIN

		SELECT @CountPatientNumbr = isnull(count(*),0) 
			from TempSPGetMACommissionStatement TDP
		WHERE 
			TDP.MAID = @MarketingJOfficerId
		AND 
			TDP.PatientID = @PatientID

		IF 	@CountPatientNumbr = 0
		BEGIN
			insert into TempSPGetMACommissionStatement (ReportType,maid,invoiceNumber,PatientID,EDate,FullName,TotalSales,MediaFullName,MediaCodeNo,MarketingAgentsFullName,MarketingAgentsCodeNo)
			values('Patient Amount ',@MarketingJOfficerId,@InvoiceNo,@PatientID, @EDate, @FullName,@TestCost,@MediaFullName,@MediaCodeNo,@MarketingAgentsFullName,@MarketingAgentsCodeNo)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN

			Update  TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
			TotalSales = TotalSales + @TestCost
			where PatientID =@PatientID and maid = @MarketingJOfficerId
		END


		set @TempQuery ='
		Update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
		['+@TestGroupName+'] = '+ Convert(nvarchar(50),@TestCost)+'
		where 
			MAID ='''+ convert(nvarchar(50), @MarketingJOfficerId) +'''
		AND 
			PatientID ='''+ convert(nvarchar(50), @PatientID) +''''

       EXEC(@TempQuery)
	   --print @TempQuery

       
		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_temp_MA_payment  INTO @PatientID,@TestGroupName,@TestCost,@InvoiceNo,@EDate,@FullName,
		@MediaFullName,@MediaCodeNo,@MarketingAgentsFullName,@MarketingAgentsCodeNo
	END
	CLOSE cursor_temp_MA_payment;  
	DEALLOCATE cursor_temp_MA_payment;


	--update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
	--Discount =
	--(
	--	select 
	--	isnull(sum(credit),0)
	--	from 
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers PL
	--	JOIN
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoices P
	--			ON PL.InvestigationInvoiceId = P.id
	--	where P.id = TempSPGetMACommissionStatement.PatientID 
	--	and PL.TransactionType in (1)
	--)

	--update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
	--DUE =
	--(
	--	select isnull(sum(pl.Debit-pl.credit),0)
	--	from 
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers PL
	--	JOIN
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoices P
	--			ON PL.InvestigationInvoiceId = P.id
	--	where P.id = TempSPGetMACommissionStatement.PatientID 
			
	--)


	--update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
	--Paid =(
	--	select 
	--	isnull( sum(credit),0)
	--	from 
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers PL
	--	JOIN
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoices P
	--			ON PL.InvestigationInvoiceId = P.id
	--	where P.id = TempSPGetMACommissionStatement.PatientID 
	--	and PL.TransactionType in (2)
	--)

	
	--update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
	--Refund =
	--(
	--	select 
	--	isnull( sum(credit),0)
	--	from 
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers PL
	--	JOIN
	--		diag.InvestigationInvoices P
	--			ON PL.InvestigationInvoiceId = P.id
	--	where P.id = TempSPGetMACommissionStatement.PatientID 
	--	and PL.TransactionType in (5)
	--)

	
	--select * from Marketing.CommissionGroup
	----------insert into TempSPGetMACommissionStatement (ReportType,MAID,invoiceNumber,PatientID,EDate,FullName,TotalSales,Discount,Due,Refund,paid)
	----------values('Referral Percentage','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','','',0,0,0,0,0)


	----------insert into TempSPGetMACommissionStatement (ReportType,MAID,invoiceNumber,PatientID,EDate,FullName,TotalSales,Discount,Due,Refund,paid)
	----------values('Total Amount','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','','',0,0,0,0,0)

	----------insert into TempSPGetMACommissionStatement (ReportType,MAID,invoiceNumber,PatientID,EDate,FullName,TotalSales,Discount,Due,Refund,paid)
	----------values('Referral Payable','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','','',0,0,0,0,0)

	
	DECLARE cursor_Test_Group
	CURSOR FOR
		select  isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,T.Name) Name
		from 
		Diag.TestGroups  T
		LEFT JOIN #TempTestGroupSpecialGroupName d on d.MainGroupID = T.Id
		where T.id not in (32,37,12)
		group by isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,T.Name)
	Open cursor_Test_Group
	FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Test_Group  INTO @TestGroupName
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
	BEGIN
			
			set @TempQuery ='
			update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
			['+@TestGroupName+'] =
			isnull((
					select convert(nvarchar(50),c.CommissionInPercent )
						from Marketing.CommissionSetups c
						join Diag.TestItems TI on Ti.Id = c.TestItemId
						Join Diag.TestGroups TG on TG.Id = TI.TestGroupId
						LEFT JOIN #TempTestGroupSpecialGroupName d on d.MainGroupID = TG.Id
						join Marketing.CommissionGroups g on g.Id = c.CommissionGroupId
						where g.id =1 and '''+@TestGroupName+''' =isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,TG.Name)
						group by isnull(d.DisplayGroupName,TG.Name),c.CommissionInPercent
			),0) 
			where ReportType=''Referral Percentage''
			
			'
			exec(@TempQuery)
			--print @TempQuery

			set @TempQuery ='
			update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
			['+@TestGroupName+'] =
			isnull((
				select sum(['+@TestGroupName+']) from TempSPGetMACommissionStatement tt where tt.ReportType <> ''Referral Percentage''
			),0)
			
			where ReportType=''Total Amount  ''
			
			'
			exec(@TempQuery)
			--print @TempQuery

			set @TempQuery ='
			update TempSPGetMACommissionStatement set
			['+@TestGroupName+'] =
			(
			(
				isnull((
					select sum(['+@TestGroupName+']) from TempSPGetMACommissionStatement tt where tt.ReportType = ''Referral Percentage''
				),0) 

			)
			*
			(
				isnull((
					select sum(['+@TestGroupName+']) from TempSPGetMACommissionStatement tt where tt.ReportType = ''Total Amount''
				),0) 

			)
			)/100

			where ReportType=''Referral Payable  ''
			
			'
			exec(@TempQuery)

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_Test_Group  INTO @TestGroupName
	END
	CLOSE cursor_Test_Group;  
	DEALLOCATE cursor_Test_Group;


	


	

	

	--set @TempQuery = 'select (select * from TempSPGetMACommissionStatement FOR JSON AUTO) as Data'
	
	set @TempQuery = 'select (
	select tbl.* from(
	select  
	
	 t.MAID [FilterMarketingAgentsSystemID] ,
	t.MediaFullName,t.MediaCodeNo,t.MarketingAgentsFullName,t.MarketingAgentsCodeNo,
	   t.invoiceNumber      ,
	   t.PatientID ,
	   t.EDate ,
	   t.FullName,
	   t.TotalSales,
	   v.Name [RefDoctorName]
	   
	   
	   '+@AllColumne +'

	from TempSPGetMACommissionStatement t 
	join diag.InvestigationInvoices i on i.id  = t.PatientID
	join VWDoctors v on v.id = i.RefdDoctorId) tbl
	----order by t.MediaCodeNo,t.MarketingAgentsCodeNo
	FOR JSON AUTO)as Data'

	exec(@TempQuery) 
	drop table dbo.TempSPGetMACommissionStatement
	

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Diag].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeDiagnostic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7. ConsultantId[Guid], 8.@HoDId[Guid] 9.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] 
--10.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid], 11.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 12.MarketingMediaId[Guid] 13.CorporateClientID int, 14. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 15. GroupId int, 16. PatientID (Guid)
--For 11 and 12 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Diag].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeDiagnostic] '2024-5-1,2024-5-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

		DECLARE @Vacutainers uniqueIdentifier ='24269BFC-372B-41C8-A127-913C1FC0D9DA'
		DECLARE @ParamGroupID1 uniqueIdentifier ='93D52C58-8961-4636-B57C-6C543CB20A32'
		DECLARE @ParamGroupID2 uniqueIdentifier ='B736AB64-5FC4-4867-9826-9551A3A6099D'


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14

					

							SELECT * INTO #tempMain FROM(
	SELECT Tbl.Id, Tbl.BillNo, Tbl.EntryDate,Tbl.FullName, 
	SUM(Tbl.TotalBill)TotalBill, 0 PathologyAmount, 0 RadioloyAmount, 0 VacutainerAmount,
	SUM(Discount) Discount,
	SUM(Tbl.Received)Received ,
	SUM(Tbl.TotalBill)-SUM(Discount)-SUM(Tbl.Received) Due ,0 Commission 
	,RefdDoctorId
	,MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
	FROM (
	SELECT
	 i.Id,i.InvoiceNo AS BillNo, i.EntryDate,i.FullName,
	   CASE
			WHEN iil.TransactionType = 0 THEN iil.Debit
			ELSE 0
		END TotalBill
	   ,CASE
			WHEN iil.TransactionType = 1 THEN iil.Credit
			ELSE 0
		END Discount
   ,CASE
		WHEN iil.TransactionType = 2 THEN iil.Credit
		ELSE 0
	END Received
	   ,0 Due
   ,'' Commission
   ,i.RefdDoctorId
   ,MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
 JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil
ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate

) Tbl
GROUP BY Tbl.Id,Tbl.BillNo,Tbl.EntryDate,Tbl.FullName,Tbl.RefdDoctorId,MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
) Base



SELECT * INTO #tempTestGroupWithBill  FROM (
			SELECT 
			--m.Id,m.BillNo,m.EntryDate,m.FullName,m.RefdDoctorId,MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId ,tg.ParentGroupId,iid.Rate,hd.Name,ti.TestGroupId,tg.Name AS TestName 
			m.BillNo,iid.Rate,ti.TestGroupId,tg.Name AS TestName ,tg.ParentGroupId,mjom.Id AS Media,mjom1.Id AS JMO
			FROM #tempMain m
			JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails iid
			ON iid.InvestigationInvoiceId = m.Id
			JOIN Diag.TestItems ti
				ON ti.Id = iid.TestItemId
			JOIN Diag.TestGroups tg
				ON tg.Id = ti.TestGroupId
			JOIN VWDoctors v
				ON v.Id = m.RefdDoctorId
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom
				ON mjom.Id = m.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			 AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1
				ON mjom1.Id = m.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo
				ON mo.Id = mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm
				ON mm.Id = mo.MarketingManagerId
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd
				ON hd.Id = mm.HoDId
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
				ON D.id = v.id
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
				ON dt.typename = d.type
			Where
				 (v.id=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				) T2 

				
				UPDATE #tempMain SET PathologyAmount= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #tempTestGroupWithBill tgb
				WHERE ParentGroupId=@ParamGroupID1 AND tgb.BillNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND TestGroupId<>@Vacutainers)

				UPDATE #tempMain SET RadioloyAmount= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #tempTestGroupWithBill tgb 
				WHERE ParentGroupId=@ParamGroupID2 AND tgb.BillNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND TestGroupId<>@Vacutainers)

				UPDATE #tempMain SET VacutainerAmount= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #tempTestGroupWithBill tgb
				WHERE  tgb.BillNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND TestGroupId=@Vacutainers)
				


					select(
							select * from(
						SELECT BillNo, FullName As  PateintName,TotalBill As  TotalSales,PathologyAmount, RadioloyAmount, VacutainerAmount,
						Discount, Received , Due, Commission
						FROM #tempMain m
						JOIN VWDoctors v
						ON v.Id = m.RefdDoctorId
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom
						ON mjom.Id = m.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1
						ON mjom1.Id = m.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo
						ON mo.Id = mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm
						ON mm.Id = mo.MarketingManagerId
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd
						ON hd.Id = mm.HoDId
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
				ON D.id = v.id
			LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
				ON dt.typename = d.type
						Where
						(v.id=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND (mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
						AND (mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
						AND (mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND (mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND (hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


								) T  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO
