		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) dueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers aa on aa.FinalBillId = a.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.CabinNo

	----------------------------------End Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	
	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

	--	select(
	--select * from(
	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		DueAmount,
		NetPayble 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	--		) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE[Hospital].[BillinigUserwiseCollectionStatementDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[BillinigUserwiseCollectionStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	
	
	--return 
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserId

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID int
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'Advance',1
	--union all
	--select 'OPD',2
	--union all
	--select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY',5
	--union all
	--select 'DIALYSIS',3
	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		DueAmount float,
		NetPayble float

	)

	-- select * from Hospital.AdvancePayments

	----------------------------   Advance Start --------------------------------------------------- 
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueAmount,NetPayble)

	select 'Advance from Admitted Patient' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0,
	0 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueAmount,NetPayble)

	select 'Advance Return from Admitted Patient' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0,
	0 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	a.AdvanceReturnAmount *-1 RegularCash,
	0 RegularCard,
	0 RegularMobileNagad,
	0 RegularMopbileBkash,
	0 DueCollectionCash,
	0 DueCollectionCard,
	0 DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	0 DueCollectionMopbileBkash
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and a.AdvanceReturnAmount <> 0
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo

	----------------------------   Advance End --------------------------------------------------- 


	----------------------------------Start Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'Discharged Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers aa on aa.FinalBillId = a.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.CabinNo




	----------------------------------End Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	
	----------------------------------Start Discharged Free Bed 0 Amount Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'Discharged Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			 0  RegularCash,
			 0  RegularCard,
			 0  RegularMobileNagad,
			 0  RegularMopbileBkash,
			 0  DueCollectionCash,
			 0  DueCollectionCard,
			 0  DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			 0  DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = op.DischargeByUserId

			where  convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime )>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and a.Id not in 
			(
				select ll.FinalBillId from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll
			)
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.CabinNo




	----------------------------------End Discharged Free Bed 0 Amount Patient----------------------------------
	

	------------------------------------OPD Patient ----------------
	----------------------------------Start Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'OPD Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,
	'' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  opp 
			--join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  fbl on fbl.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName
			--,c.CabinNo
			,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  op 
			--join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			--join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  aa on aa.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName
	--,t.CabinNo
	-------------------------------------------End OPD patient--------------------------------------
	
	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

		select(
	select * from(
	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		DueAmount,
		NetPayble 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport 
		
		) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END
GO

--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[BillinigUserwiseCollectionStatementDynamicBackup]'2024-12-28,2024-12-28,2023,4,b588e631-9ee8-4678-9987-6b4fdd71c33d,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN

	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	
	
	--return 
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserId

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID int
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'Advance',1
	--union all
	--select 'OPD',2
	--union all
	--select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY',5
	--union all
	--select 'DIALYSIS',3
	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		DueAmount float,
		NetPayble float

	)

	-- select * from Hospital.AdvancePayments

	----------------------------   Advance Start --------------------------------------------------- 
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueAmount,NetPayble)

	select 'Advance from Admitted Patient' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,

	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0,
	0 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueAmount,NetPayble)

	select 'Advance Return from Admitted Patient' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0,
	0 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	a.AdvanceReturnAmount *-1 RegularCash,
	0 RegularCard,
	0 RegularMobileNagad,
	0 RegularMopbileBkash,
	0 DueCollectionCash,
	0 DueCollectionCard,
	0 DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	0 DueCollectionMopbileBkash
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and a.AdvanceReturnAmount <> 0
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo

	----------------------------   Advance End --------------------------------------------------- 


	----------------------------------Start Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'Discharged Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers aa on aa.FinalBillId = a.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.CabinNo




	----------------------------------End Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	
	----------------------------------Start Discharged Free Bed 0 Amount Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'Discharged Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			 0  RegularCash,
			 0  RegularCard,
			 0  RegularMobileNagad,
			 0  RegularMopbileBkash,
			 0  DueCollectionCash,
			 0  DueCollectionCard,
			 0  DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			 0  DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = op.DischargeByUserId

			where  convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime )>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and a.Id not in 
			(
				select ll.FinalBillId from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll
			)
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.CabinNo




	----------------------------------End Discharged Free Bed 0 Amount Patient----------------------------------
	

	------------------------------------OPD Patient ----------------
	----------------------------------Start Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'OPD Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,
	'' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  opp 
			--join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  fbl on fbl.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName
			--,c.CabinNo
			,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  op 
			--join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			--join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  aa on aa.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName
	--,t.CabinNo
	-------------------------------------------End OPD patient--------------------------------------
	
	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

	--	select(
	--select * from(
	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		DueAmount,
		NetPayble 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport 
		
	--	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO







--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[DischargedPatientlistCounter]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE[Hospital].[DischargedPatientlistCounter]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@ConsultantID uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ConsultantId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

		select(
	select * from(


	select 'Discharged Patient' ReportType, p.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo, p.FullName PatientName, p.DischargedDateTime AdmissionDateTime, '' DischargeDateTime,
	
	[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](p.InvoiceNo) CabinNo,
	p.AgeYear Age,'' ReleasedBy,u.UserName AdmittedBy, d.Name ConsName
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=p.AdmittedCabinId
	join VWDoctors d on d.Id=p.AssignedDoctorId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.Id=p.DischargeByUserId
	where convert(date,@FilterStartDate)<=convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) and
			convert(date,@FilterEndDate) >=convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime)and
			(p.AssignedDoctorId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


			
		) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[GetAdmittedIPDPatient]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- Exec [Hospital].GetAdmittedIPDPatient '9e64c85a-b5e9-4351-863f-08dd8d5eed12'

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetAdmittedIPDPatient]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	select 
	  d.Id, 
	  d.Name + case when len(
		isnull(ProfessionalIdentity1, '')
	  )> 1 then ' , ' + ProfessionalIdentity1 else '' end + case when len(
		isnull(ProfessionalIdentity2, '')
	  )> 1 then ' , ' + ProfessionalIdentity2 else '' end + case when len(
		isnull(ProfessionalIdentity3, '')
	  )> 1 then ' , ' + ProfessionalIdentity3 else '' end + case when len(
		isnull(ProfessionalIdentity4, '')
	  )> 1 then ' , ' + ProfessionalIdentity4 else '' end + case when len(
		isnull(ProfessionalIdentity5, '')
	  )> 1 then ' , ' + ProfessionalIdentity5 else '' end + case when len(
		isnull(ProfessionalIdentity6, '')
	  )> 1 then ' , ' + ProfessionalIdentity6 else '' end [DoctorWithIdentity] into #TempDoctorIdentity
	from 
	  Marketing.Doctors d 
	SELECT 
	  p.Id, 
	  p.InvoicePrefix, 
	  p.InvoiceNo, 
	  p.UHID, 
	  p.FullName, 
	  rr.PatientAddress AS Address, 
	  rr.MobileNo, 
	  rr.Cpmobile, 
	  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
	  rr.Sex, 
	  rr.MembershipType, 
	  rr.MaritalStatus, 
	  rr.Profession, 
	  rr.NationalId, 
	  p.AdmissionDateTime, 
	  p.DischargedDateTime, 
	  p.AssignedDoctorId, 
	  p.RefdDoctorId, 
	  d.[DoctorWithIdentity] AS AssignedDoctorName, 
	  p.ChiefConsultantId, 
	  isnull(cc.DoctorWithIdentity, '') AS ChiefConsultantName, 
	  d2.[DoctorWithIdentity] AS RefDoctorName, 
	  p.Status, 
	  rr.FatherName, 
	  rr.MotherName, 
	  rr.PatientAddress, 
	  rr.Cpname, 
	  rr.Cpaddress, 
	  p.AgeYear, 
	  p.AgeMonth, 
	  p.AgeDay, 
	  rr.CareOf, 
	  rr.RelationWithPatient, 
	  rr.BloodGroup, 
	  rr.CpnationalId, 
	  rr.SpouseName, 
	  ca.Id AS AllotId, 
	  ca.CabinId, 
	  ca.AllotType, 
	  c.FloorId, 
	  ca.Status AS CabinStatus, 
	  Hospital.GetCabinNumber(p.Id) AS CabinNo, 
	  ct.CabinType, 
	  dept.Name AS DeptName, 
	  c.HDepartmentId, 
	  p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
	  rr.Title, 
	  p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
	  p.AdmissionFee, 
	  p.AdmissionByUserId, 
	  c.CabinTypeId, 
	  u.UserName,
	  sp.Name PackageName
	FROM 
	  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID 
	  INNER JOIN --Marketing.Doctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
	  #TempDoctorIdentity AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
	  INNER JOIN --Marketing.Doctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id INNER JOIN
	  #TempDoctorIdentity AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id left JOIN
	  #TempDoctorIdentity AS cc ON p.ChiefConsultantId = cc.Id LEFT JOIN
	  Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id 
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id 
	  left join [Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] pkg on pkg.IPDPatientRecordId = p.Id
	  left join [Hospital].[ServicePackages] sp on sp.Id = pkg.PackageId
	WHERE 
	  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
	  and p.Id = @PatientId

END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[GetDischargedDuePatient]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



--exec [Hospital].[GetDischargedDuePatient] 

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetDischargedDuePatient]
	
AS
begin
select tbl.*,pay.Total
  from 
  (
		SELECT p.Id, p.InvoicePrefix, p.InvoiceNo, p.UHID, p.FullName, rr.PatientAddress AS Address, rr.MobileNo, rr.Cpmobile, 
						  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
						  rr.Sex, rr.MembershipType, rr.MaritalStatus, rr.Profession, rr.NationalId, p.AdmissionDateTime, p.DischargedDateTime, p.AssignedDoctorId, p.RefdDoctorId, d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, p.Status, 
						  rr.FatherName, rr.MotherName, rr.PatientAddress, rr.Cpname, rr.Cpaddress, p.AgeYear, p.AgeMonth, p.AgeDay, rr.CareOf, rr.RelationWithPatient, rr.BloodGroup, rr.CpnationalId, rr.SpouseName, ca.Id AS AllotId, ca.CabinId, ca.AllotType, 
						  c.FloorId, ca.Status AS CabinStatus, c.CabinNo, ct.CabinType, dept.Name AS DeptName, c.HDepartmentId, p.BillingMode, p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, rr.Title, p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
						  p.AdmissionByUserId, c.CabinTypeId, u.UserName, p.IsClearedForDischarge, p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, p.IsClearedFromDoD, p.IsCCHold, p.IsNotified, ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName,ma.Code,rr.Religion,p.IsManualCabinDayCount
						  ,p.Remarks,p.AdditionalDoctorIds,
						  isnull(ap.PackageId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') PackageId
		FROM     Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p INNER JOIN
						  Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID INNER JOIN
						  dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id INNER JOIN
						  dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id INNER JOIN
						  Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
						  Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id INNER JOIN
						  Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id INNER JOIN
						  Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId left join
					     [Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] ap on p.Id=ap.IPDPatientRecordId
		WHERE  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) and p.DischargedDateTime >= p.AdmissionDateTime and p.DischargeByUserId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'and (ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient=1)
  ) tbl left join
  (
  select fledger.IPDPatientRecordId,(fledger.TotalDue-advance.TotalAdvance) Total from
		(
		(select (sum(fbl.Debit)-sum(fbl.Credit)) TotalDue, fb.IPDPatientRecordId
		  from [Hospital].[FinalBills] fb inner join
			   [Hospital].[FinalBillLedgers] fbl on fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId
		group by fb.IPDPatientRecordId) fledger inner join
		(select (sum(ap.Amount)-sum(ap.AdvanceReturnAmount)) TotalAdvance,ap.IPDPatientId
		  from [Hospital].[AdvancePayments] ap
		 group by ap.IPDPatientId) advance on fledger.IPDPatientRecordId=advance.IPDPatientId
		)
  ) pay on tbl.Id=pay.IPDPatientRecordId
--where pay.Total>1 or pay.Total<-1
end


------------------========================================

GO

--exec [Hospital].[GetDischargedPatientByDateRange] '2024-11-01','2024-11-09'

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetDischargedPatientByDateRange]
	@FromDate Date ,
	@ToDate Date
AS
begin
SELECT p.Id, p.InvoicePrefix, vdd.Name as ChiefConsultantName, p.ChiefConsultantId As ChiefConsultantId, p.InvoiceNo, p.UHID, p.FullName, rr.PatientAddress AS Address, rr.MobileNo, rr.Cpmobile, 
                  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
                  rr.Sex, rr.MembershipType, rr.MaritalStatus, rr.Profession, rr.NationalId, p.AdmissionDateTime, p.DischargedDateTime, p.AssignedDoctorId, p.RefdDoctorId, d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, p.Status, 
                  rr.FatherName, rr.MotherName, rr.PatientAddress, rr.Cpname, rr.Cpaddress, p.AgeYear, p.AgeMonth, p.AgeDay, rr.CareOf, rr.RelationWithPatient, rr.BloodGroup, rr.CpnationalId, rr.SpouseName, ca.Id AS AllotId, ca.CabinId, ca.AllotType, 
                  c.FloorId, ca.Status AS CabinStatus, c.CabinNo, ct.CabinType, dept.Name AS DeptName, c.HDepartmentId, p.BillingMode, p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, rr.Title, p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
                  p.AdmissionByUserId, c.CabinTypeId, u.UserName, p.IsClearedForDischarge, p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, p.IsClearedFromDoD, p.IsCCHold, p.IsNotified, ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName,ma.Code,rr.Religion,p.IsManualCabinDayCount
				  ,p.Remarks,p.AdditionalDoctorIds,
				  isnull(ap.PackageId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') PackageId
FROM     Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID INNER JOIN
                  dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id INNER JOIN
				  
                  dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
                  [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
                  Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
				  left Join VWDoctors as vdd on vdd.id=p.ChiefConsultantId left join
				  [Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] ap on p.Id=ap.IPDPatientRecordId
WHERE  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) and p.DischargedDateTime >= p.AdmissionDateTime and p.DischargeByUserId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
	    and (Convert(Date,p.DischargedDateTime)>=@FromDate and Convert(Date,p.DischargedDateTime)<=@ToDate) and (ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient=1)
end

--exec [Hospital].[GetDischargedPatientById] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0,24030913169,''

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetDischargedPatientById]
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@UHID bigint,
	@MobileNo varchar(max)
AS
begin

	Declare @date Date = DATEADD(Day,-15, GETDATE());
	if(@InvoiceNo > 0 or @UHID >0 or LEN(@MobileNo) > 0)
	begin
		set @date = DATEADD(YEAR,-15, GETDATE());
	end
	

	SELECT p.Id, p.InvoicePrefix, vdd.Name as ChiefConsultantName, p.ChiefConsultantId As ChiefConsultantId, p.InvoiceNo, p.UHID, p.FullName, rr.PatientAddress AS Address, rr.MobileNo, rr.Cpmobile, 
			CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
			rr.Sex, rr.MembershipType, rr.MaritalStatus, rr.Profession, rr.NationalId, p.AdmissionDateTime, p.DischargedDateTime, p.AssignedDoctorId, p.RefdDoctorId, d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, p.Status, 
			rr.FatherName, rr.MotherName, rr.PatientAddress, rr.Cpname, rr.Cpaddress, p.AgeYear, p.AgeMonth, p.AgeDay, rr.CareOf, rr.RelationWithPatient, rr.BloodGroup, rr.CpnationalId, rr.SpouseName, ca.Id AS AllotId, ca.CabinId, ca.AllotType, 
			c.FloorId, ca.Status AS CabinStatus, c.CabinNo, ct.CabinType, dept.Name AS DeptName, c.HDepartmentId, p.BillingMode, p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, rr.Title, p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
			p.AdmissionByUserId, c.CabinTypeId, u.UserName, p.IsClearedForDischarge, p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, p.IsClearedFromDoD, p.IsCCHold, p.IsNotified, ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName,ma.Code,rr.Religion,p.IsManualCabinDayCount
			,p.Remarks,p.AdditionalDoctorIds,
			isnull(ap.PackageId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') PackageId
	FROM     Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p INNER JOIN
			Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID INNER JOIN
			dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id INNER JOIN
				  
			dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id INNER JOIN
			Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
			Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id INNER JOIN
			Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id INNER JOIN
			Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
			[Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
			Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
			left Join VWDoctors as vdd on vdd.id=p.ChiefConsultantId left join
			[Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] ap on p.Id=ap.IPDPatientRecordId
	WHERE  p.DischargedDateTime between @date and GETDATE() 
		and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
		and p.DischargedDateTime >= p.AdmissionDateTime 
		and p.DischargeByUserId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		and (p.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
		and (p.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0) 
		and (p.UHID=@UHID or @UHID=0) 
		and (rr.MobileNo=@MobileNo or @MobileNo='')
		and (ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient=1)
end

--exec [Hospital].[GetDischargedPatientByInvoiceNo] 24031064

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetDischargedPatientByInvoiceNo]
	@InvoiceNo bigint
AS
begin
SELECT p.Id, p.InvoicePrefix, p.InvoiceNo, p.UHID, p.FullName, rr.PatientAddress AS Address, rr.MobileNo, rr.Cpmobile, 
                  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
                  rr.Sex, rr.MembershipType, rr.MaritalStatus, rr.Profession, rr.NationalId, p.AdmissionDateTime, p.DischargedDateTime, p.AssignedDoctorId, p.RefdDoctorId, d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, p.Status, 
                  rr.FatherName, rr.MotherName, rr.PatientAddress, rr.Cpname, rr.Cpaddress, p.AgeYear, p.AgeMonth, p.AgeDay, rr.CareOf, rr.RelationWithPatient, rr.BloodGroup, rr.CpnationalId, rr.SpouseName, ca.Id AS AllotId, ca.CabinId, ca.AllotType, 
                  c.FloorId, ca.Status AS CabinStatus, c.CabinNo AS CabinNo, ct.CabinType, dept.Name AS DeptName, c.HDepartmentId, p.BillingMode, p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, rr.Title, p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
                  p.AdmissionByUserId, c.CabinTypeId, u.UserName, p.IsClearedForDischarge, p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, p.IsClearedFromDoD, p.IsCCHold, p.IsNotified, ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName,rr.Religion
				  ,p.Remarks,isnull(ap.PackageId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') PackageId
FROM     Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID INNER JOIN
                  dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id INNER JOIN
                  dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id INNER JOIN
                  Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
                  [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id LEFT OUTER JOIN
                  Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId left join
				  Hospital.AdmittedPackages ap on p.Id=ap.IPDPatientRecordId
WHERE  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) and p.DischargedDateTime >= p.AdmissionDateTime and p.DischargeByUserId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and p.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo 
	   and (ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient=1)
end

-- Execute [Hospital].[GetFilteredDischargedPatientInfos]  ''
CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetFilteredDischargedPatientInfos] @filerstring NVARCHAR(50) 
AS 
BEGIN 

SET 
  NOCOUNT ON;

	IF (
	  @filerstring = '' 
	  OR @filerstring IS NULL
	) BEGIN 
	SELECT 
	  top(50) tbl.* 
	FROM 
	  (
		SELECT 
		  p.Id, 
		  p.InvoicePrefix, 
		  vdd.Name as ChiefConsultantName, 
		  p.ChiefConsultantId As ChiefConsultantId, 
		  p.InvoiceNo, 
		  p.UHID, 
		  p.FullName, 
		  rr.PatientAddress AS Address, 
		  rr.MobileNo, 
		  rr.Cpmobile, 
		  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
		  rr.Sex, 
		  rr.MembershipType, 
		  rr.MaritalStatus, 
		  rr.Profession, 
		  rr.NationalId, 
		  p.AdmissionDateTime, 
		  p.DischargedDateTime, 
		  p.AssignedDoctorId, 
		  p.RefdDoctorId, 
		  d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, 
		  d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, 
		  p.Status, 
		  rr.FatherName, 
		  rr.MotherName, 
		  rr.PatientAddress, 
		  rr.Cpname, 
		  rr.Cpaddress, 
		  p.AgeYear, 
		  p.AgeMonth, 
		  p.AgeDay, 
		  rr.CareOf, 
		  rr.RelationWithPatient, 
		  rr.BloodGroup, 
		  rr.CpnationalId, 
		  rr.SpouseName, 
		  ca.Id AS AllotId, 
		  ca.CabinId, 
		  ca.AllotType, 
		  c.FloorId, 
		  ca.Status AS CabinStatus, 
		  c.CabinNo, 
		  ct.CabinType, 
		  dept.Name AS DeptName, 
		  c.HDepartmentId, 
		  p.BillingMode, 
		  p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		  rr.Title, 
		  p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		  p.AdmissionByUserId, 
		  c.CabinTypeId, 
		  u.UserName, 
		  p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		  p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		  p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		  p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		  p.IsCCHold, 
		  p.IsNotified, 
		  ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName, 
		  ma.Code, 
		  rr.Religion, 
		  p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		  p.Remarks, 
		  p.AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		  isnull(
			ap.PackageId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		  ) PackageId 
		FROM 
		  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID 
		  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
		  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id 
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id 
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId 
		  left Join VWDoctors as vdd on vdd.id = p.ChiefConsultantId 
		  left join [Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] ap on p.Id = ap.IPDPatientRecordId 
		WHERE 
		  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
		  and p.DischargedDateTime >= p.AdmissionDateTime 
		  and p.DischargeByUserId != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		  and (
			ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null 
			or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1
		  )
	  ) tbl END ELSE BEGIN 
	SELECT 
	  tbl.* 
	FROM 
	  (
		SELECT 
		  p.Id, 
		  p.InvoicePrefix, 
		  vdd.Name as ChiefConsultantName, 
		  p.ChiefConsultantId As ChiefConsultantId, 
		  p.InvoiceNo, 
		  p.UHID, 
		  p.FullName, 
		  rr.PatientAddress AS Address, 
		  rr.MobileNo, 
		  rr.Cpmobile, 
		  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
		  rr.Sex, 
		  rr.MembershipType, 
		  rr.MaritalStatus, 
		  rr.Profession, 
		  rr.NationalId, 
		  p.AdmissionDateTime, 
		  p.DischargedDateTime, 
		  p.AssignedDoctorId, 
		  p.RefdDoctorId, 
		  d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, 
		  d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, 
		  p.Status, 
		  rr.FatherName, 
		  rr.MotherName, 
		  rr.PatientAddress, 
		  rr.Cpname, 
		  rr.Cpaddress, 
		  p.AgeYear, 
		  p.AgeMonth, 
		  p.AgeDay, 
		  rr.CareOf, 
		  rr.RelationWithPatient, 
		  rr.BloodGroup, 
		  rr.CpnationalId, 
		  rr.SpouseName, 
		  ca.Id AS AllotId, 
		  ca.CabinId, 
		  ca.AllotType, 
		  c.FloorId, 
		  ca.Status AS CabinStatus, 
		  c.CabinNo, 
		  ct.CabinType, 
		  dept.Name AS DeptName, 
		  c.HDepartmentId, 
		  p.BillingMode, 
		  p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		  rr.Title, 
		  p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		  p.AdmissionByUserId, 
		  c.CabinTypeId, 
		  u.UserName, 
		  p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		  p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		  p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		  p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		  p.IsCCHold, 
		  p.IsNotified, 
		  ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName, 
		  ma.Code, 
		  rr.Religion, 
		  p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		  p.Remarks, 
		  p.AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		  isnull(
			ap.PackageId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		  ) PackageId 
		FROM 
		  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID 
		  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
		  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id 
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id 
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId 
		  left Join VWDoctors as vdd on vdd.id = p.ChiefConsultantId 
		  left join [Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] ap on p.Id = ap.IPDPatientRecordId 
		WHERE 
		  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
		  and p.DischargedDateTime >= p.AdmissionDateTime 
		  and p.DischargeByUserId != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
		  and (
			ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null 
			or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1
		  )
	  ) tbl 
	WHERE 
	  tbl.FullName LIKE '%' + @filerstring + '%' 
	  or tbl.CabinNo LIKE '%' + @filerstring + '%' 
	  or tbl.InvoiceNo LIKE '%' + @filerstring + '%' 
  END 
  END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetFilteredIPDPatientInfos]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@filerstring NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF (
			@filerstring = ''
			OR @filerstring IS NULL

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[GetIPDDischargedPatientByDate]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
------------------------------------


-- exec [Hospital].[GetIPDDischargedPatientByDate] '2024-11-01','2024-11-09'

CREATE        PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetIPDDischargedPatientByDate]
	@FromDate Date ,
	@ToDate Date
AS
begin

SELECT
	ipd.Id
   ,ipd.UHID
   ,ipd.InvoicePrefix
   ,ipd.InvoiceNo
   ,ipd.FullName
   ,ipd.AgeYear
   ,ipd.AgeMonth
   ,ipd.AgeDay
   ,ipd.AdmissionDateTime
   ,ipd.RefdDoctorId
   ,ipd.AssignedDoctorId
   ,ipd.AdmittedCabinId
   ,ipd.Status
   ,ipd.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
   ,ipd.ProbableDischargeDateTime
   ,ipd.DischargedDateTime
   ,ipd.IsCCCHold
   ,ipd.IsPharmacyClaimCleared
   ,ipd.StaffRecordId
   ,ipd.TenantId
   ,ipd.AdmissionByUserId
   ,ipd.DischargeByUserId
   ,ipd.IsClearedForDischarge
   ,ipd.IsClearedFromPharmacy
   ,ipd.IsClearedFromNurseStation
   ,ipd.IsClearedFromDoD
   ,ipd.IsCCHold
   ,ipd.IsNotified
   ,ipd.Remarks
   ,ipd.MediaId
   ,ipd.CreatedBy
   ,ipd.CreatedOn
   ,ipd.LastModifiedBy
   ,ipd.LastModifiedOn
   ,ipd.IsDeleted
   ,ipd.IsSynced
   ,ipd.IsManualCabinDayCount
   ,ipd.CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType
   ,ipd.AdditionalDoctorIds
   ,ipd.AdmissionFee
   ,ipd.ChiefConsultantId
   ,ipd.DeptId
   ,ipd.CorporateClientId
   ,ipd.IsEMRLoaded
   ,ipd.IsTransferredFromOrigin
   ,(SELECT TOP 1
			CabinNo
		FROM [Hospital].[IPDCabinAllocationRecords] r
		INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins c
			ON r.CabinId = c.Id
			AND ipd.Id = r.[PatientId]
		ORDER BY r.CreatedOn DESC)
	CabinNo
FROM [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] ipd
WHERE [DischargeByUserId] IS NOT NULL
AND [DischargeByUserId] != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AND CAST([DischargedDateTime] AS DATE) >= @FromDate
AND CAST([DischargedDateTime] AS DATE) <= @ToDate;
end

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Exec [Hospital].[GetIPDRegRecordDataByInvoiceIdOrNo]  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',24031025

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetIPDRegRecordDataByInvoiceIdOrNo] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@InvoiceNo bigint
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	With cteInvoice as (
	Select * from [Hospital].IPDPatientRecords where (Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and (InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0))

   SELECT inv.Id,inv.InvoicePrefix, inv.InvoiceNo,
    inv.InvoicePrefix,inv.FullName,inv.AgeYear,inv.AgeMonth,inv.AgeDay,inv.AdmissionDateTime,inv.RefdDoctorId,
	inv.AssignedDoctorId,inv.ChiefConsultantId,inv.AdmittedCabinId,inv.Status,inv.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId,
	inv.ProbableDischargeDateTime,inv.DischargedDateTime,inv.CorporateClientId,inv.IsCCHold,inv.IsPharmacyClaimCleared,
	inv.StaffRecordId,inv.DeptId,inv.TenantId,inv.AdmissionByUserId,inv.DischargeByUserId,
	inv.BillingMode,inv.IsClearedForDischarge,inv.IsClearedFromPharmacy,inv.IsClearedFromNurseStation,
	inv.IsClearedFromDoD,inv.IsNotified,inv.Remarks,inv.AdmissionFee,inv.CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType,
	inv.IsManualCabinDayCount,inv.MediaId,inv.AdditionalDoctorIds,
     rr.UHID, rr.Dob,rr.ArearOrThana,rr.LocalGurdianUpazilaOrAreaId,rr.PatientAddress,
	rr.UpazilaOrAreaId,rr.BloodGroup,CareOf,rr.CompanyId,rr.Cpaddress, rr.CparearOrThana, rr.Cpdistrict,rr.CphouseNo,
	rr.Cpmobile, rr.Cpname, rr.Sex, rr.CpnationalId, rr.Cppo,rr.CproadNo,rr.Cpvillage,rr.DesignationId, rr.District,
	rr.RefdId, rr.RegDate, rr.Email, rr.FatherName, rr.GivenName, rr.FullName, rr.HouseNo, rr.IsRegisterd,
	rr.Surname, rr.MaritalStatus, rr.MembershipType, rr.MobileNo, rr.MotherName, rr.NationalId,
	rr.NoOfDaughters, rr.NoOfSons, rr.Others, rr.Po, rr.Profession, rr.UHIDPrefix, rr.RelationWithPatient,
	rr.RoadNo,rr.SpouseName, rr.Status, rr.Title, rr.UnionId, rr.Village,rr.EmployeeId, rr.Religion, rr.Password,rr.OTPCode,
	rr.IsOTPVerified,rr.IDType,rr.IDNo, mp.ProfileImage as ImageData,mp.Id as ImageId from [Hospital].RegRecords rr Left join [Hospital].MemberPictures mp
	on mp.UHID=rr.UHID  join  cteInvoice inv on inv.UHID=rr.UHID

  
END

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetIPDServiceRecordByPatientAndBillingHead]
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@HeadId uniqueidentifier,
	@GetByRow int
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @emtyId VARCHAR(100) = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	DECLARE @spacialCareIDs VARCHAR(MAX) = '';
	DECLARE @spacialCares VARCHAR(MAX) = 'IPD CARE, ICU CARE, CCU CARE, CTU CARE, HDU CARE, NICU CARE, IPD CARE';
	SELECT @spacialCareIDs = STRING_AGG(CAST(ID AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ',') FROM Hospital.ServiceSubGroups where CHARINDEX([Name], @spacialCares) > 0;

	Declare @medicineGroupId uniqueidentifier = (select id from Hospital.ServiceSubGroups where [Name] = '') 
	Declare @investigationBillId uniqueidentifier = (select id from Hospital.ServiceSubGroups where [Name] = 'Investigation Bill (Test)') 

	if((CHARINDEX(CAST(@headId as nvarchar(100)), @spacialCareIDs) > 0) or @HeadId = @investigationBillId)
		if(@GetByRow=0)
		begin
			if(@HeadId!=@investigationBillId)
			begin
				select  seh.HeadName as ServiceName, sr.Rate,sum( sr.Qty) Qty, sum(sr.Amount) Amount, sum(sr.Discount) Discount --, sr.ServiceDatetime
				from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on sr.ServiceId=seh.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct on sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id 
				where sr.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and (ct.ServiceHeadId=@HeadId or @HeadId=@emtyId) and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId!=@investigationBillId --ignore investigation bill service sub group -- and seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId!=85
				Group By   seh.HeadName, sr.Rate --, sr.ServiceDatetime
			end
			else
			begin
				select  seh.HeadName as ServiceName, sr.Rate,sum( sr.Qty) Qty, sum(sr.Amount) Amount, sum(sr.Discount) Discount --, sr.ServiceDatetime
				from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on sr.ServiceId=seh.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct on sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id 
				where sr.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId=@investigationBillId
				Group By   seh.HeadName, sr.Rate --, sr.ServiceDatetime
			end
		end
		else
		begin
		if(@HeadId!=@investigationBillId)
		begin
			select  sr.Id, sr.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,sr.ServiceDatetime, sr.Rate, sr.Qty, sr.Discount, sr.ServiceCharge, sr.Amount, sr.ServiceId,sr.DeliverySectionId,sr.IsExtraService,ct.ServiceHeadId BillingHeadId,ct.IPDServicesBillingHeadName,sr.IsDeleted,sr.UserId,sr.IsPostedToAccount,sr.StartDateTime,sr.EndDateTime,u.UserName
				from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on sr.ServiceId=seh.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct on sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id  left join
					 [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=sr.UserId
				where sr.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and (ct.ServiceHeadId=@HeadId or @HeadId=@emtyId) and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId!=@investigationBillId --ignore investigation bill service sub group -- and seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId!=85
				--Group By   seh.HeadName, sr.Rate --, sr.ServiceDatetime
			end
			else
			begin
				select  sr.Id, sr.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,sr.ServiceDatetime, sr.Rate, sr.Qty, sr.Discount, sr.ServiceCharge, sr.Amount, sr.ServiceId,sr.DeliverySectionId,sr.IsExtraService,ct.ServiceHeadId BillingHeadId,ct.IPDServicesBillingHeadName,sr.IsDeleted,sr.UserId,sr.IsPostedToAccount,sr.StartDateTime,sr.EndDateTime,u.UserName
				from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on sr.ServiceId=seh.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct on sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id inner join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id left join
					 [Identity].[Users] u on sr.UserId=u.Id
				where sr.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId=@investigationBillId 
				--Group By   seh.HeadName, sr.Rate --, sr.ServiceDatetime
			end
		end		
	else
	BEGIN
		select *
		 from (
		   select sr.Id, sr.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,sr.ServiceDatetime, sr.Rate, sr.Qty, sr.Discount, sr.ServiceCharge, sr.Amount, sr.ServiceId,sr.DeliverySectionId,sr.IsExtraService,ct.ServiceHeadId BillingHeadId,ct.IPDServicesBillingHeadName,sr.IsDeleted,sr.UserId,sr.IsPostedToAccount,sr.StartDateTime,sr.EndDateTime,u.UserName
			from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
				 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on sr.ServiceId=seh.Id inner join
				 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct on sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id inner join
				 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id left join
				 [Identity].[Users] u on sr.UserId=u.Id
			where sr.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and (ct.ServiceHeadId=@HeadId or @HeadId=@emtyId) and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId!=@investigationBillId --ignore investigation bill and seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId!=85

			union all

			select sr.Id, sr.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,sr.ServiceDatetime, sr.Rate, sr.Qty, sr.Discount, sr.ServiceCharge, sr.Amount, sr.ServiceId,sr.DeliverySectionId,sr.IsExtraService,ssg.ServiceSubGroupId BillingHeadId,sg.Name IPDServicesBillingHeadName,sr.IsDeleted,sr.UserId,sr.IsPostedToAccount,sr.StartDateTime,sr.EndDateTime,u.UserName
			from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
				 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on sr.ServiceId=seh.Id inner join
				 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct on sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id inner join
				 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id inner join
				 [Hospital].[ServiceSubGroups] sg on ssg.ServiceSubGroupId=sg.Id left join
				 [Identity].[Users] u on sr.UserId=u.Id
			where sr.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId=@investigationBillId
		
		 ) tbl
		 order by BillingHeadId, ServiceDatetime

	END
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetMedicineReturnIndentDetailsByIndentId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@MedicineReturnIndentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	select mri.Id,mri.MedicineRetirnIndentId,mri.BrandExtensionId,bd.ProductName,mri.Qty,mri.Status,ISNULL(mri.Remarks,'') as Remarks,mri.LotRecordId,bd.PurchasePrice,bd.SalePrice,st.Name StatusTxt
	from [Hospital].[MedicineReturnIndentDetails] mri
	left join [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on bd.ProductId=mri.BrandExtensionId
	left join [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on mri.Status=st.Id
	where mri.MedicineRetirnIndentId=@MedicineReturnIndentId 
END

-- Exec [Hospital].[GetOTServiceDetailsByPatientId] '82675dde-4e4b-4199-4409-08dcc957fd02','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetOTServiceDetailsByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@ServiceSubSubGroupId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@UnIncludeExtra int
AS
BEGIN
	
	select os.Id,os.IPDPatientId,os.ChiefSurgeonId,os.AnaesthesiaTypeId,os.OTTypeId,os.IncisionType,os.StartDateTime,os.EndDateTime,os.OTNameId,
		   os.UserId,os.IndicationOfSurgery,cd.Name ChiefSurgeonDoctor,ant.Name AnaesthesiaTypeName,ott.Name OTTypeName,otn.Name OTName,
		   osd.ServiceHeadId,osd.DoctorId,osd.Rate,osd.Qty,osd.ServiceCharge,osd.Amount,osd.Discount,seh.HeadName,osd.Id DetailId,d.Name DoctorName,osd.IsExtraService,os.IsDeleted,os.UserId,u.UserName,osd.IsPostedToAccount
	from [Hospital].[OTServices] os left join
		 [Marketing].[Doctors] cd on os.ChiefSurgeonId=cd.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[AnaesthesiaTypes] ant on os.AnaesthesiaTypeId=ant.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[OTTypes] ott on os.OTTypeId=ott.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[OTNames] otn on os.OTNameId=otn.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[OTServiceDetails] osd on os.Id=osd.OTServiceId left join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on osd.ServiceHeadId=seh.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on os.UserId=u.Id left join
		 [Marketing].[Doctors] d on osd.DoctorId=d.Id 
	where os.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and (seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=@ServiceSubSubGroupId or @ServiceSubSubGroupId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
	and (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or osd.IsExtraService=0) and osd.IsDeleted=0
END

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[GetRegRecordData] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@UHID bigint,
	@MobileNo varchar(200)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT rr.Id, rr.UHID, rr.Dob, rr.AgeDay,rr.AgeMonth,rr.AgeYear,rr.ArearOrThana,rr.LocalGurdianUpazilaOrAreaId,rr.PatientAddress,
	rr.UpazilaOrAreaId,rr.BloodGroup,CareOf,rr.CompanyId,rr.Cpaddress, rr.CparearOrThana, rr.Cpdistrict,rr.CphouseNo,
	rr.Cpmobile, rr.Cpname, rr.Sex, rr.CpnationalId, rr.Cppo,rr.CproadNo,rr.Cpvillage,rr.DesignationId, rr.District,
	rr.RefdId, rr.RegDate, rr.Email, rr.FatherName, rr.GivenName, rr.FullName, rr.HouseNo, rr.IsRegisterd,
	rr.Surname, rr.MaritalStatus, rr.MembershipType, rr.MobileNo, rr.MotherName, rr.NationalId,
	rr.NoOfDaughters, rr.NoOfSons, rr.Others, rr.Po, rr.Profession, rr.UHIDPrefix, rr.RelationWithPatient,
	rr.RoadNo,rr.SpouseName, rr.Status, rr.Title, rr.UnionId, rr.Village,rr.EmployeeId, rr.Religion, rr.Password,rr.OTPCode,
	rr.IsOTPVerified,rr.IDType,rr.IDNo, mp.ProfileImage as ImageData,mp.Id as ImageId from [Hospital].RegRecords rr Left join [Hospital].MemberPictures mp
	on mp.UHID=rr.UHID
	where  (rr.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and (rr.UHID=@UHID or @UHID=0) and (rr.MobileNo=@MobileNo or @MobileNo='')

	 


END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[IPDInvestigationProfileIndivisualTest]
		@IPDPatientID uniqueidentifier,
		@TestId uniqueidentifier,
		@ReportType int =0

AS
BEGIN
--exec [Hospital].[IPDInvestigationProfileIndivisualTest] '3CCA1D81-12EE-42CC-5584-08DC2547C2AF','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
Create table #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
(
AutoID int identity(1,1),
PNname Nvarchar(max)
)

insert into #TempIPDInvestigationProfile (PNname)
select isnull(p.ShortName,p.Name) [Pname]
from Diag.PathologyReportDetails  d
 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
 join Diag.PathologyReports  r on r.id = d.PathologyReportId
 JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii ON ii.id=r.PatientId
 join Diag.IPDInvestigationIndents i on i.Id = ii.InvestigationIndentId
 join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ipr on ipr.Id = i.IPDPatientId
 where 
 (i.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientID)
 and 
 (t.id=@TestId or @TestId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
 --and p.Name <> t.Name
  and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
 group by p.Name,t.Name,p.DisplayOrder,p.ShortName
 order by p.DisplayOrder

 delete from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile where AutoID not in 
 (
  select max(AutoID) from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t
 group by t.PNname
 )


DECLARE 
    @columns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', 
    @sql     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';

-- select the category names
 select 
 
--r.ReportDate,t.Name,p.Name,d.Value,p.Unit
 @columns+=QUOTENAME( PNname) + ','
 from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
 group by PNname,AutoID
 order by AutoID
 
 ;

-- remove the last comma
SET @columns = LEFT(@columns, LEN(@columns) - 1);

print @columns




IF @ReportType =0
BEGIN

-- construct dynamic SQL
SET @sql ='
select ReportDate,TName,'+@columns+' --,Unit 
from 
(
SELECT * FROM   
(
	 select 
 
	r.ReportDate,t.Name TName ,isnull(p.ShortName,p.Name) PName,convert(varchar(50),d.TestResult)+convert(varchar(50),isnull(p.unit,'''')) OutputValue,i.id --,p.Unit,i.id

	from Diag.PathologyReportDetails  d
 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
 join Diag.PathologyReports  r on r.id = d.PathologyReportId
 JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii ON ii.id=r.PatientId
 join Diag.IPDInvestigationIndents i on i.Id = ii.InvestigationIndentId
 join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ipr on ipr.Id = i.IPDPatientId
	 where 
	 (i.IPDPatientId='''+convert(varchar(400),@IPDPatientID)+''')
	and (t.Id='''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+''' or '''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+'''=''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'')
	 and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
	 group by r.ReportDate,t.Name  ,p.Name ,d.testresult,i.id,p.unit,p.shortname --,p.Unit,i.id
) t 
PIVOT(
    max(OutputValue)
    FOR PName IN ('+ @columns +')
) AS pivot_table

)T
order by TName,ReportDate
';


print @sql

-- execute the dynamic SQL
EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql;

END
ELSE
BEGIN

-- construct dynamic SQL
SET @sql ='
select(
	select * from(
	
select ReportDate,TName,'+@columns+' --,Unit 
from 
(
SELECT * FROM   
(
	 select 
 
	r.ReportDate,t.Name TName ,isnull(p.ShortName,p.Name) PName,convert(varchar(50),d.TestResult)+convert(varchar(50),isnull(p.unit,'''')) OutputValue,i.id --,p.Unit,i.id

	from Diag.PathologyReportDetails  d
 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
 join Diag.PathologyReports  r on r.id = d.PathologyReportId
 JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii ON ii.id=r.PatientId
 join Diag.IPDInvestigationIndents i on i.Id = ii.InvestigationIndentId
 join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ipr on ipr.Id = i.IPDPatientId
	 where 
	 (i.IPDPatientId='''+convert(varchar(400),@IPDPatientID)+''')
	and (t.Id='''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+''' or '''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+'''=''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'')
	 and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
	 group by r.ReportDate,t.Name  ,p.Name ,d.testresult,i.id,p.unit,p.shortname --,p.Unit,i.id
) t 
PIVOT(
    max(OutputValue)
    FOR PName IN ('+ @columns +')
) AS pivot_table

)T



) tbl  
order by ReportDate,TName
FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
';


print @sql

-- execute the dynamic SQL
EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql;


END


END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[IPDInvestigationProfileIndivisualTestTableScript]
		@IPDPatientID uniqueidentifier,
		@TestId uniqueidentifier,

Create table #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
(
AutoID int identity(1,1),
PNname Nvarchar(max)
)

insert into #TempIPDInvestigationProfile (PNname)
select  REPLACE(p.Name,',','') [Pname]
from Diag.PathologyReportDetails d
 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
 join Diag.PathologyReports r on r.id = d.PathologyReportId
 join Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii on ii.id = r.PatientId
 join Diag.IPDInvestigationIndents i on i.id = ii.InvestigationIndentId
 join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ipr on ipr.Id = i.IPDPatientId
 where 
 (i.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientID)
 and 
 (t.id=@TestId or @TestId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
  and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
 group by p.Name,t.Name,p.DisplayOrder
 order by p.DisplayOrder

 delete from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile where AutoID not in 
 (
  select max(AutoID) from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t
 group by t.PNname
 )

 @columns+=QUOTENAME( PNname) + ','
 from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile

END
IF @QueryType =1

							--SET @QueryOutput ='CREATE TABLE #TempIPDInvestigationProfile ( ReportDate nvarchar(max),TName nvarchar(max) '

							DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
							FOR 
									select Value from (
									SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(
									@columns
									) ) T
						
							OPEN cursor_product;

							FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
								@Outout_ColumnName;

							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								BEGIN
									--PRINT @Outout_ColumnName

									--print @QueryOutput
									exec( @QueryOutput)

									FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
										@Outout_ColumnName;
								END;

							CLOSE cursor_product;

							DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

							--exec( @QueryOutput+' ) ')


--	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempIPDInvestigationProfileForAllTestColumnName
	
--	Create table #TempIPDInvestigationProfileForAllTestColumnName
--						(
--							AutoID int identity(1,1),
--							AllColumnName Nvarchar(max)
--						)

--Insert into #TempIPDInvestigationProfileForAllTestColumnName
--						exec [Hospital].[IPDInvestigationProfileIndivisualTestTableScript] @IPDPatientID,@MaxTID

--						select @paramas = AllColumnName from #TempIPDInvestigationProfileForAllTestColumnName
						
						print @Outout_ColumnName

END

return


-- construct dynamic SQL
SET @sql ='
select ReportDate,TName,'+@columns+' --,Unit 
from 
(
SELECT * FROM   
(
	 select 
 
	r.ReportDate,t.Name TName ,p.Name PName,convert(varchar(50),d.Value)+convert(varchar(50),p.unit) OutputValue,i.id --,p.Unit,i.id

	 from Diag.PathologialReportDetails d
	 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
	 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
	 join Diag.PathologialReports r on r.id = d.PathologialReportId
	 join Diag.IPDInvestigationIndents i on i.Id = r.IndentId
	 join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ipr on ipr.Id = i.IPDPatientId
	 where 
	 (i.IPDPatientId='''+convert(varchar(400),@IPDPatientID)+''')
	and (t.Id='''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+''' or '''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+'''=''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'')
	 and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
	 group by r.ReportDate,t.Name  ,p.Name ,d.Value,i.id,p.unit --,p.Unit,i.id
) t 
PIVOT(
    max(OutputValue)
    FOR PName IN ('+ @columns +')
) AS pivot_table

)T
order by TName,ReportDate
';

print @sql
-- execute the dynamic SQL
EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql;
END
