CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[OPDAllCollectionStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[OPDAllCollectionStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	

	--select @UserId
	 
	
	--return 
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserId

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID int
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'OPD EMERGENCY',1
	union all

	select 'OPD FREE BED',57
	union all
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY',3
	union all
	select 'DIALYSIS',2

	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		DueAmount float,
		NetPayble float

	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'OPD' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	(
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices opp 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	) dueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  para.ReportType, op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.ReportType,  T.BillNo,T.FullName

	-------New start

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'CONSULTANCY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'Consultancy' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	(
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  
		from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees opp 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	)DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select   op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees op 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by  T.BillNo,T.FullName

	
	-----------New End

	/*
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select 'DIALYSIS' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'DIALYSIS' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =3 or op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =3
			and		(op.UserId = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName
	

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'PHYSIOTHERAPY' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =5 or op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =5
			and		(op.UserId = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName
	*/

	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

		select(
	select * from(
	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		DueAmount,
		NetPayble 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
			) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[OPDAllCollectionStatementDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[OPDAllCollectionStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	

	--select @UserId
	 
	
	--return 
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserId

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID int
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'OPD EMERGENCY',1
	union all

	select 'OPD FREE BED',57
	union all
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY',3
	union all
	select 'DIALYSIS',2

	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		DueAmount float,
		NetPayble float

	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'OPD' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	(
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices opp 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	) dueAmount
	From 
	(
			select  para.ReportType, op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.ReportType,  T.BillNo,T.FullName

	-------New start

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount)
	
	select 'CONSULTANCY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'Consultancy' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	(
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  
		from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees opp 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	)DueAmount
	From 
	(
			select   op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees op 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by  T.BillNo,T.FullName

	
	-----------New End

	/*
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select 'DIALYSIS' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'DIALYSIS' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =3 or op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =3
			and		(op.UserId = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName
	

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'PHYSIOTHERAPY' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =5 or op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =5
			and		(op.UserId = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName
	*/

	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

		select(
	select * from(
	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName,
		(RegularCash+RegularCard+RegularMobileNagad+RegularMopbileBkash) TotalAmount,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		DueAmount,
		NetPayble 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
			) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[spGetAdmittedPatientList]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- exec Hospital.spGetAdmittedPatientList 1

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetAdmittedPatientList]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@TenantId int=1
AS
BEGIN
	WITH CteSubLedger AS (
	  SELECT 
		DISTINCT Id AS SubLedgerId, 
		InvoiceId, 
		InvoiceNo 
	  FROM 
		Account.SubLedgers
	), 
	CteIPDPatient AS (
	  SELECT 
		Id, 
		UHID, 
		InvoicePrefix, 
		InvoiceNo, 
		FullName, 
		AgeYear, 
		AgeMonth, 
		AgeDay, 
		AdmissionDateTime, 
		RefdDoctorId, 
		AssignedDoctorId, 
		AdmittedCabinId, 
		Status, 
		MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
		ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		DischargedDateTime, 
		CorporateClientId, 
		DeptId, 
		IsCCCHold, 
		IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		StaffRecordId, 
		TenantId, 
		AdmissionByUserId, 
		DischargeByUserId, 
		IsClearedForDischarge, 
		IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		IsClearedFromDoD, 
		IsCCHold, 
		IsNotified, 
		Remarks, 
		MediaId, 
		CreatedBy, 
		CreatedOn, 
		LastModifiedBy, 
		LastModifiedOn, 
		IsDeleted, 
		IsSynced, 
		IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType, 
		AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		BillingMode, 
		IsEMRLoaded, 
		IsTransferredFromOrigin 
	  FROM 
		Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p 
	  WHERE 
		(
		  DischargedDateTime < AdmissionDateTime
		) 
		AND (
		  DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		)
	), 
	CtePateintDemographic AS (
	  SELECT 
		p.Id, 
		p.UHID, 
		p.InvoicePrefix, 
		p.InvoiceNo, 
		p.FullName, 
		p.AgeYear, 
		p.AgeMonth, 
		p.AgeDay, 
		p.AdmissionDateTime, 
		p.RefdDoctorId, 
		p.AssignedDoctorId, 
		p.AdmittedCabinId, 
		p.Status, 
		p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
		p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		p.DischargedDateTime, 
		p.CorporateClientId, 
		p.DeptId, 
		p.IsCCCHold, 
		p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		p.StaffRecordId, 
		p.TenantId, 
		p.AdmissionByUserId, 
		p.DischargeByUserId, 
		p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		p.IsCCHold, 
		p.IsNotified, 
		p.Remarks, 
		p.MediaId, 
		p.CreatedBy, 
		p.CreatedOn, 
		p.LastModifiedBy, 
		p.LastModifiedOn, 
		p.IsDeleted, 
		p.IsSynced, 
		p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		p.CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType, 
		p.AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		p.BillingMode, 
		ISNULL(rr.PatientAddress, '') AS Address, 
		ISNULL(rr.MobileNo, '') AS MobileNo, 
		ISNULL(rr.Cpmobile, '') AS Cpmobile, 
		ISNULL(rr.Sex, '') AS Sex, 
		ISNULL(rr.MembershipType, '') AS MembershipType, 
		ISNULL(rr.MaritalStatus, '') AS MaritalStatus, 
		ISNULL(rr.Profession, '') AS Profession, 
		ISNULL(rr.NationalId, '') AS NationalId, 
		ISNULL(rr.FatherName, '') AS FatherName, 
		ISNULL(rr.MotherName, '') AS MotherName, 
		ISNULL(rr.PatientAddress, '') AS PatientAddress, 
		ISNULL(rr.Cpname, '') AS Cpname, 
		ISNULL(rr.Cpaddress, '') AS Cpaddress, 
		ISNULL(rr.CareOf, '') AS CareOf, 
		ISNULL(rr.RelationWithPatient, '') AS RelationWithPatient, 
		ISNULL(rr.BloodGroup, '') AS BloodGroup, 
		ISNULL(rr.CpnationalId, '') AS CpnationalId, 
		ISNULL(rr.SpouseName, '') AS SpouseName, 
		ISNULL(rr.Title, '') AS Title, 
		ISNULL(rr.Religion, '') AS Religion, 
		p.IsEMRLoaded, 
		p.IsTransferredFromOrigin 
	  FROM 
		CteIPDPatient AS p 
		INNER JOIN Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID 
		and rr.IsDeleted = 0
	), 
	CtePateintDemographicWithSubLedger AS (
	  SELECT 
		p.Id, 
		p.UHID, 
		p.InvoicePrefix, 
		p.InvoiceNo, 
		p.FullName, 
		p.AgeYear, 
		p.AgeMonth, 
		p.AgeDay, 
		p.AdmissionDateTime, 
		p.RefdDoctorId, 
		p.AssignedDoctorId, 
		p.AdmittedCabinId, 
		p.Status, 
		p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
		p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		p.DischargedDateTime, 
		p.CorporateClientId, 
		p.DeptId, 
		p.IsCCCHold, 
		p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		p.StaffRecordId, 
		p.TenantId, 
		p.AdmissionByUserId, 
		p.DischargeByUserId, 
		p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		p.IsCCHold, 
		p.IsNotified, 
		p.Remarks, 
		p.MediaId, 
		p.CreatedBy, 
		p.CreatedOn, 
		p.LastModifiedBy, 
		p.LastModifiedOn, 
		p.IsDeleted, 
		p.IsSynced, 
		p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		p.CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType, 
		p.AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		p.BillingMode, 
		p.Address, 
		p.MobileNo, 
		p.Cpmobile, 
		p.Sex, 
		p.MembershipType, 
		p.MaritalStatus, 
		p.Profession, 
		p.NationalId, 
		p.FatherName, 
		p.MotherName, 
		p.PatientAddress, 
		p.Cpname, 
		p.Cpaddress, 
		p.CareOf, 
		p.RelationWithPatient, 
		p.BloodGroup, 
		p.CpnationalId, 
		p.SpouseName, 
		p.Title, 
		p.Religion, 
		l.SubLedgerId, 
		p.IsEMRLoaded, 
		p.IsTransferredFromOrigin 
	  FROM 
		CtePateintDemographic AS p 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN CteSubLedger AS l ON p.Id = l.InvoiceId
	), 
	CtePateintDemographicWithSubLedgerAndAllocationRecords AS (
	  SELECT 
		p.Id, 
		p.UHID, 
		p.InvoicePrefix, 
		p.InvoiceNo, 
		p.FullName, 
		p.AgeYear, 
		p.AgeMonth, 
		p.AgeDay, 
		p.AdmissionDateTime, 
		p.RefdDoctorId, 
		p.AssignedDoctorId, 
		p.AdmittedCabinId, 
		p.Status, 
		p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
		p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		p.DischargedDateTime, 
		p.CorporateClientId, 
		p.DeptId, 
		p.IsCCCHold, 
		p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		p.StaffRecordId, 
		p.AdmissionByUserId, 
		p.DischargeByUserId, 
		p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		p.IsCCHold, 
		p.IsNotified, 
		p.Remarks, 
		p.MediaId, 
		p.CreatedBy, 
		p.CreatedOn, 
		p.LastModifiedBy, 
		p.LastModifiedOn, 
		p.IsDeleted, 
		p.IsSynced, 
		p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		p.CabinChargeCalculationGracePeriodType, 
		p.AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		p.BillingMode, 
		p.Address, 
		p.MobileNo, 
		p.Cpmobile, 
		p.Sex, 
		p.MembershipType, 
		p.MaritalStatus, 
		p.Profession, 
		p.NationalId, 
		p.FatherName, 
		p.MotherName, 
		p.PatientAddress, 
		p.Cpname, 
		p.Cpaddress, 
		p.CareOf, 
		p.RelationWithPatient, 
		p.BloodGroup, 
		p.CpnationalId, 
		p.SpouseName, 
		p.Title, 
		p.Religion, 
		p.SubLedgerId, 
		p.TenantId AS Expr1, 
		ca.Id AS AllotId, 
		ca.CabinId, 
		ca.AllotType, 
		ISNULL(ca.Status, '') AS CabinStatus, 
		p.DeptId AS CurrentDeptId, 
		p.TenantId, 
		p.IsEMRLoaded, 
		p.IsTransferredFromOrigin 
	  FROM 
		CtePateintDemographicWithSubLedger AS p 
		INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
	  WHERE 
		(ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
		AND (ca.AllotType = 'PAB')
	) 
	SELECT top (100) percent
	  p.Id, 
	  ISNULL(p.InvoicePrefix, '') AS InvoicePrefix, 
	  p.InvoiceNo, 
	  p.UHID, 
	  p.FullName, 
	  p.Address, 
	  p.MobileNo, 
	  p.Cpmobile, 
	  ISNULL(
		CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END, 
		''
	  ) AS Age, 
	  p.Sex, 
	  p.MembershipType, 
	  p.MaritalStatus, 
	  p.Profession, 
	  p.NationalId, 
	  p.AdmissionDateTime, 
	  p.DischargedDateTime, 
	  p.AssignedDoctorId, 
	  p.RefdDoctorId, 
	  ISNULL(d.Name, '') AS AssignedDoctorName, 
	  ISNULL(d2.Name, '') AS RefDoctorName, 
	  ISNULL(p.Status, '') AS Status, 
	  p.FatherName, 
	  p.MotherName, 
	  p.PatientAddress, 
	  p.Cpname, 
	  p.Cpaddress, 
	  ISNULL(p.AgeYear, '') AS AgeYear, 
	  ISNULL(p.AgeMonth, '') AS AgeMonth, 
	  ISNULL(p.AgeDay, '') AS AgeDay, 
	  p.CareOf, 
	  p.RelationWithPatient, 
	  p.BloodGroup, 
	  p.CpnationalId, 
	  p.SpouseName, 
	  p.AllotId, 
	  p.CabinId, 
	  p.AllotType, 
	  c.FloorId, 
	  p.CabinStatus, 
	  c.CabinNo,
	  --ISNULL(
	  --  Hospital.GetCabinNumber(p.Id), 
	  --  ''
	  --) AS CabinNo, 
	  ISNULL(ct.CabinType, '') AS CabinType, 
	  ISNULL(dept.Name, '') AS DeptName, 
	  dept.Id AS HDepartmentId, 
	  p.BillingMode, 
	  p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
	  p.Title, 
	  p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
	  p.AdmissionByUserId, 
	  c.CabinTypeId, 
	  ISNULL(u.UserName, '') AS UserName, 
	  p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
	  p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
	  p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
	  p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
	  p.IsCCHold, 
	  p.IsNotified, 
	  ISNULL(ma.Name, '') AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName, 
	  p.Religion, 
	  p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
	  p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
	  p.Remarks, 
	  c.DisplayOrder, 
	  ISNULL(
		p.SubLedgerId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	  ) AS SubLedgerId, 
	  p.TenantId, 
	  p.IsEMRLoaded, 
	  p.IsTransferredFromOrigin, 
	  isnull(
		ap.PackageId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	  ) PackageId 
	FROM 
	  CtePateintDemographicWithSubLedgerAndAllocationRecords AS p 
	  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
	  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON p.CabinId = c.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON p.CurrentDeptId = dept.Id 
	  INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id 
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id 
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId 
	  left join Hospital.AdmittedPackages ap on p.Id = ap.IPDPatientRecordId 
	where 
	  ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null 
	  or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1 
	ORDER BY 
	  p.InvoiceNo
END
GO

-- exec Hospital.spGetAdmittedPatientsForFinalBill

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetAdmittedPatientsForFinalBill]
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		p.Id,
		p.UHID,
		p.InvoiceNo,
		p.FullName,
		d.Name + ' ' + d.ProfessionalIdentity1 as AssignedDoctorName,
		p.IsNotified, 
		p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		rr.MobileNo,
		c.CabinNo,
		c.CabinTypeId,
		ct.CabinType,
		ca.Id AllotId,
		ca.CabinId
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
		join Hospital.RegRecords rr on p.UHID = rr.UHID
		join Marketing.Doctors d on d.Id = p.AssignedDoctorId
		JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		join Hospital.CabinTypes ct on ct.Id = c.CabinTypeId
		
	where p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and rr.IsDeleted = 0
		and ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1 AND ca.AllotType = 'PAB' 
END
GO

-- =============================================

--Exec [Hospital].[spGetAdvancePaymentByPatientId] '6be4e645-b5d9-48c4-9699-08dc6134a0ab'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetAdvancePaymentByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Advance;

	SELECT ap.IPDPatientId,ap.PayDate,ap.PayTime,ap.PaymentChannelId,isnull(ap.Remarks,'') Remarks, ap.PosTerminalId,ap.UserId,SUM(ap.Amount) Amount, SUM(ap.AdvanceReturnAmount) AdvanceReturnAmount INTO #Advance
	FROM [Hospital].[AdvancePayments] ap 
	WHERE ap.IPDPatientId=@PatientId
	GROUP BY ap.IPDPatientId,ap.PayDate,ap.PayTime,ap.PaymentChannelId,ap.Remarks, ap.PosTerminalId,ap.UserId
	ORDER BY ap.PayDate

	SELECT a.*, u.UserName,isnull(pm.Name,'') PayModeName,pc.Name PayChannelName
	FROM #Advance a LEFT JOIN 
		 [Admin].[PaymentChannels] pc on a.PaymentChannelId=pc.Id left join
		 [Admin].[PaymentModes] pm on pc.PaymentModeId=pm.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on a.UserId=u.Id
  
END
GO

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetAdvancePaymentWithPatientByDate] '2024-12-27','2050-12-29'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetAdvancePaymentWithPatientByDate]
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	select pr.Id IPDPatientId,pr.UHID,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName PatientName, 
		isnull(ap.PayDate, pr.AdmissionDateTime) PayDate,  
		isnull(ap.PayTime, FORMAT(pr.AdmissionDateTime, 'hh:mm tt')) PayTime, 
		isnull(sum(ap.Amount), 0) Amount, 
		isnull(sum(ap.AdvanceReturnAmount),0) ReturnAdvanceReturnAmount
	from  
	--[Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] 
	 Hospital.IPDPatientRecords  pr 
	  left join [Hospital].[AdvancePayments] ap on ap.IPDPatientId=pr.Id 
	where cast(ap.PayDate as date) >= cast(@FromDate as date) AND
	cast(ap.PayDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date) AND ap.TransactionType<>0
  group by pr.AdmissionDateTime , pr.AdmissionDateTime, ap.PayDate, pr.FullName, ap.PayTime, pr.Id,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.UHID
END

   insert into #TempSPGetAllDepartmentCollectionSheetMaster

		when t.ReportType ='OPD EMERGENCY' then 'Outdoor Service (OPD)'
		when t.ReportType ='OPD FREE BED' then 'Outdoor Service (Free Bed))'
		when t.ReportType ='PHYSIOTHERAPY' then 'Physiotherapy'
		when t.ReportType ='DIALYSIS' then 'Dialysis'
		when t.ReportType ='CONSULTANCY' then 'CONSULTANCY'

		'[Hospital].[OPDAllCollectionStatement]',
		isnull(sum(RegularCash ),0.00)RegularCash,
		isnull(sum(RegularCard ),0.00)RegularCard,
		isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad ),0.00)RegularMobileNagad,
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash ),0.00)RegularMopbileBkash,
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash ),0.00)DueCollectionCash,
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard ),0.00)DueCollectionCard,
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad ),0.00)DueCollectionMobileNagad,
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileBkash ),0.00)DueCollectionMobileBkash,
		isnull(sum(NetPayble ),0.00)NetPayble

  from #TempSPGetAllDepartmentCollectionSheetDetailsOPD t
  where isnull(t.ReportType,'') <> ''
  group by t.ReportType

  delete from #TempSPGetAllDepartmentCollectionSheetDetails

  --====================== ENd [Hospital].[OPDAllCollectionStatement]  =============================================--

  select * from #TempSPGetAllDepartmentCollectionSheetMaster

END

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetOTScheduleById] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','2020-01-01','2025-01-01','50C5B5-0894-4512-AABE-73C4269F835D,059DF903-E34A-4493-B068-0BEC97A15304,6F2F241E-079F-4FE9-8993-FD708232183E,074B22BD-2CCC-4E3B-B89D-C90349FC8D91,2CBDBA41-6C5F-4029-B59D-22C4061CAFF8,459B62D1-BCD6-4B0F-AF7D-F38C023D3135','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0,1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetAllIncompleteOTScheduleByAcessPermission]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@DeptIds varchar(1000),
	@FloorId uniqueidentifier,
	@IsPatientVisitbleByFloor int,
	@DateTimeFlag int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select os.Id,os.IPDPatientRecordId,os.SurgeonId,os.AnaesthesiologistId,os.OTTypeId,os.OTNameId,
	isnull(os.OTDateTime,GETDATE()) OTDateTime,isnull(os.Status,'') Status,isnull(os.UserId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') UserId,
	isnull(pd.FullName,'') FullName, rr.Sex,
	pd.InvoiceNo,isnull(c.CabinNo,'') CabinNo,isnull(d.Name,'') SurgeonName,isnull(dd.Name,'') AnaesthesiologistName,isnull(ot.Name,'') OTTypeName,
	isnull(otn.Name,'') OTNameName,
	isnull(u.UserName,'') UserName,os.IsCompleted,os.IsDeleted,isnull(os.Floor,'') Floor,
	isnull(os.OTRoom,'') OTRoom,isnull(os.AnesthesiaType,'') AnesthesiaType,pd.DeptId,ISNULL(CASE WHEN pd.AgeYear <> '' THEN pd.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE pd.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeMonth <> '' THEN pd.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE pd.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeDay <> '' THEN pd.AgeDay + 'D'
                          ELSE pd.AgeDay END, '') AS Age,os.IndicationOfSurgery,os.Others,ad.Name AssignedDoctor
	from [Hospital].[OTSchedules] os inner join
		[Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd on os.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id left join
		Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON pd.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
        Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id left JOIN
		[dbo].[VWDoctors] ad on pd.AssignedDoctorId=ad.Id left join
		[dbo].[VWDoctors] d on os.SurgeonId=d.Id left join
		[dbo].[VWDoctors] dd on os.AnaesthesiologistId=dd.Id left join
		[Hospital].[OTTypes] ot on os.OTTypeId=ot.Id left join
		[Hospital].[OTNames] otn on os.OTNameId=otn.Id left join
		[Identity].[Users] u on os.UserId=u.Id left join
		[Hospital].RegRecords rr on pd.UHID = rr.UHID 
	where ((os.Id=@Id and @Id!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or 
	  (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and (@DateTimeFlag=0 or @DateTimeFlag=1 )
	  and ((@IsPatientVisitbleByFloor=1 and c.FloorId=@FloorId) or (@IsPatientVisitbleByFloor=0 and ca.DeptId in (select * from STRING_SPLIT(@DeptIds, ','))))))
	  and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) AND (ca.AllotType = 'PAB') and pd.InvoiceNo is not null
	  and os.IsCompleted='False'
END

CREATE     procedure [Hospital].[spGetCabinAllocationRecords]
	@patientId uniqueidentifier
as
begin
	select 
		ca.Id,
		ca.PatientId,
		ca.CabinId,
		ca.DeptId,
		ca.AllocationDateTime,
		ca.AllotType,
		ca.Status,
		ca.IsOccupiedByPatient,
		ca.SoftwareGeneratedRemaks,
		ca.UserRemaks,
		ca.UserId,
		c.CabinNo,
		u.FullName as UserName
	from Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ca
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = ca.Cabinid
	join [Identity].Users u on u.Id = ca.UserId
	where ca.PatientId = @patientId
	order by ca.AllocationDateTime
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[spGetCabinOccupancyListByPatientId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ spGetCabinOccupancyListByPatientId ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetCabinOccupancyListByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@GetAllotType int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tbl;
	SELECT pd.Id as PatientId,cr.AllocationOrder, pd.FullName,c.CabinNo as CurrentCabinNo,c.Id as CabinId,c.CabinTypeId, Case when (cr.AllotType in ('RAT') 
	and ct.CabinType in 
		('CTU', 'ICU', 'HDU', 'NICU', 'Neuro ICU', 'Neuro HDU')
		-- (2,3,4,10,23,24)
	) Then 'True' Else 'False' End as IsTransferFromICU, c.CabinNo, cr.SitRent Rent, cr.AllotType,cr.AllocationDateTime,
			CASE WHEN cr.ReleaseDateTime='0001-01-01' THEN GETDATE() ELSE cr.ReleaseDateTime END as ReleaseDateTime INTO #Tbl
	FROM [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd LEFT JOIN
		[Hospital].[IPDCabinAllocationRecords] cr on pd.Id=cr.PatientId INNER JOIN
		[Hospital].[Cabins] c on cr.CabinId=c.Id
		inner join Hospital.CabinTypes ct on ct.Id = c.CabinTypeId
	WHERE pd.Id=@PatientId and (((cr.AllotType='EC' or cr.AllotType='RAT' or cr.AllotType='PAB' or cr.AllotType='RAD') and @GetAllotType=0) or((cr.AllotType='Extra' or cr.AllotType='RAE') and @GetAllotType=1))

	;WITH cte AS (
		SELECT AllocationOrder, CabinId,CabinNo,Rent,AllotType,AllocationDateTime,ReleaseDateTime,CabinTypeId,IsTransferFromICU
		FROM #Tbl
		UNION ALL
		SELECT AllocationOrder,CabinId,CabinNo,Rent,AllotType,DATEADD(day, 1, AllocationDateTime),ReleaseDateTime,CabinTypeId,IsTransferFromICU
		FROM cte
		
		WHERE DATEADD(dd,0, DATEDIFF(dd, 0,AllocationDateTime)) < DATEADD(dd,0, DATEDIFF(dd, 0,ReleaseDateTime))
	)
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AllocationOrder,AllocationDateTime) AS RowOrder, cte.* FROM cte ORDER BY  AllocationOrder,AllocationDateTime ASC OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);
END

GO

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetConservativeTreatmentByPatientId] 'e27fa8aa-474b-448c-f6b6-08db02aa31ac'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetConservativeTreatmentByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId,tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration,tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,
		   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime,tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,bd.ProductName BrandName,tbl.DoctorId
	  FROM (
		SELECT rit1.*
		  FROM [Hospital].[ConservativeTreatments] rit1 LEFT JOIN
			   [Hospital].[ConservativeTreatments] rit2 ON rit1.BrandExtentionId=rit2.BrandExtentionId AND rit1.Id < rit2.Id
		 where rit2.Id IS NULL AND rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
	  ) tbl INNER JOIN 
		  [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on tbl.BrandExtentionId=bd.ProductId
	ORDER BY (
		 case tbl.Status 
		 when 'Running' then 0 
		 when 'Stop' then 1
		 when 'Hold' then 2
		 end
	), tbl.StartDate
  
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE  [Hospital].[SpGetConsultantSummary]
@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
     ---exec [Hospital].[SpGetConsultantSummary] '64395697-8138-4BCE-511E-08DC5497421E'
 
		--select os.Id,os.IPDPatientId,os.ChiefSurgeonId,os.AnaesthesiaTypeId,os.OTTypeId,os.IncisionType,os.StartDateTime,os.EndDateTime,os.OTNameId,
		--   os.UserId,os.IndicationOfSurgery,cd.Name ChiefSurgeonDoctor,ant.Name AnaesthesiaTypeName,ott.Name OTTypeName,otn.Name OTName,
		--   osd.ServiceHeadId,osd.DoctorId,osd.Rate,osd.Qty,osd.ServiceCharge,osd.Amount,osd.Discount,seh.HeadName,osd.Id DetailId,
		--   d.Name DoctorName,osd.IsExtraService,os.IsDeleted,os.UserId,u.UserName

		Declare @ReportType int =1 --1 Summery 0 Details 

	Select * 
	into #TempSpGetConsultantSummary
	from 
	(
				select 'OTServiceDetails' SourceType,seh.HeadName +'( '+d.Name  +')' DoctorName,osd.Rate,osd.Qty,osd.Rate* osd.Qty Amount,osd.Discount,'' Remarks
				from [Hospital].[OTServices] os left join
					 [Marketing].[Doctors] cd on os.ChiefSurgeonId=cd.Id left join
					 [Hospital].[AnaesthesiaTypes] ant on os.AnaesthesiaTypeId=ant.Id left join
					 [Hospital].[OTTypes] ott on os.OTTypeId=ott.Id left join
					 [Hospital].[OTNames] otn on os.OTNameId=otn.Id left join
					 [Hospital].[OTServiceDetails] osd on os.Id=osd.OTServiceId left join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on osd.ServiceHeadId=seh.Id left join
					 [Identity].[Users] u on os.UserId=u.Id left join
					 [Marketing].[Doctors] d on osd.DoctorId=d.Id 
				where os.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId  and osd.IsDeleted=0

				union all

				--select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId,cs.ServiceId,cs.ConsultantId,cs.DeliverySectionId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName, d.Name as DoctorName,cs.ServiceDate,cs.EntryDate, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.ScheduleType, cs.CabinNo, cs.CabinType,cs.IsExtraService,d.ExtraAmount,cs.IsDeleted,cs.Remarks,cs.UserId,u.UserName
				select 'IPDConsultancyDetail',seh.HeadName +'( '+d.Name  +')' DoctorName, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Rate *  cs.Qty,cs.Discount,isnull(cs.Remarks,'')
				from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cs left join 
					 [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on cs.ConsultantId=d.Id left join
					 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id left join
					 [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
				where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId  and cs.IsDeleted=0
	)T

	IF @ReportType =0 
	Begin
		select * from #TempSpGetConsultantSummary t
		order by t.DoctorName
	END 
	Else IF @ReportType =1
	Begin

		select 
		t.DoctorName,
		t.Rate,
		sum(t.Qty) Qty,
		sum(t.Amount) Amount,
		sum(t.Discount) Discount,
		max(t.Remarks) Remarks
		from #TempSpGetConsultantSummary t
		group by t.DoctorName,t.Rate

	End 
end

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetConsultantWisePatientList]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@productname 16.@BrandExtensionsId 17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
--23.@HoD 24.@MManager 25.@MOfficer 26.MediaID 27.CCID

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetConsultantWisePatientList]
	@Paramas NVARCHAR(max)
AS
BEGIN
	Declare
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11

						select(
						select * from(


							SELECT ir.InvoiceNo AS BillNo, CONVERT(DATE,ir.AdmissionDateTime) AS AdmissionDate,
									ir.FullName AS PatientName, ISNULL(rr.FatherName,'') AS FathersName, ir.AgeYear AS Age,
									[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](ir.InvoiceNo) BedNo, CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DischargeDate,
									v.Name AS ConsultantName,
									U.UserName AS DischargeBy

									FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
									JOIN Hospital.RegRecords rr ON rr.UHID=ir.UHID
									JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
									JOIN [Identity].Users u ON u.Id=ir.DischargeByUserId
									WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate
									AND convert(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
									AND (@ConsultantID=ir.AssignedDoctorId OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


				) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

CREATE         PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetCorporateIncomeDetails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetCorporateIncomeDetails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@CorporateClientID int


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @CorporateClientID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14
	
										select(
							select * from(

						select CONVERT(DATE,EDate)EDate
						,ClientName,BillNo,PatientName,
						Department,
						case when Department = 'Diagonistic' then 
						[Diag].[GetAllTestNameByPatientID](id) else  [Hospital].[GetAllServiceNameByAdmissionID](id) end TestOrServiceName,
						isnull(sum(Totalcost),0) Totalcost,
						isnull(sum (Discount),0) Discount,
						isnull(sum(Totalcost),0) -isnull(sum (Discount),0)   PayableAmount,
						isnull(sum(AdvanceCollection),0) AdvanceCollection,
						isnull(sum (PaidAmount),0) PaidAmount,
						isnull (sum (DueCollection),0) DueCollection,
						isnull(sum (PaidAmount),0) + isnull(sum (DueCollection),0)+isnull(sum(AdvanceCollection),0) NetCollection,
						isnull(due,0) DUE
						--isnull(sum(Totalcost),0) - isnull(sum (Discount),0) + 
						from 
	(
			select distinct 'Diagonistic' Department, p.EntryDate EDate, c.Name ClientName,p.InvoiceNo Billno, 
			p.FullName PatientName,p.id,
			case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end Totalcost,
			case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end Discount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			case when l.TransactionType =3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,
			0 AdvanceCollection,
			(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers ll where ll.InvestigationInvoiceId = p.id) due

			from Diag.InvestigationInvoices  p
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails  t on t.InvestigationInvoiceId = p.id
			--join TestItems i on i.TestId = t.TestId
			join Marketing.CorporateClients  c on c.Id = p.CorporateClientId
			join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers  l on l.InvestigationInvoiceId=t.InvestigationInvoiceId
			--join RegRecords rg on rg.RegNo= p.RegNo
			where CONVERT(DATE,p.EntryDate) >=@filterstartDate and CONVERT(DATE,p.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (c.id = @CorporateClientID or @CorporateClientID=0)



			union all

			select distinct 'Hospital', p.DischargedDateTime EDate, c.Name ClientName,p.InvoiceNo Billno, 
			p.FullName PatientName,p.id,
			case when l.TransactionType = 0 then (Debit) else 0 end Totalcost,
			case when l.TransactionType = 1 then (Credit) end Discount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 2 then (Credit) end PaidAmount,
			case when l.TransactionType = 3 then (Credit) end DueCollection,		
			case when l.TransactionType = 10 then (Credit) end AdvanceCollection,
			(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll where ll.FinalBillId =  hb.id) due
			from 
			Hospital.IPDPatientRecords  p
			--join RegRecords rg on rg.RegNo = p.RegNo
			join Marketing.CorporateClients  c on c.id = p.CorporationId
			join Hospital.FinalBills   hb on hb.IPDPatientRecordId = p.id
			--join HospitalBillDetails hd on hd.HospitalBillId  = hb.HospitalBillId
			--join ServiceHeads s on s.ServiceHeadId = hd.ServiceHeadId
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers  l on l.FinalBillId = hb.Id

			where CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@filterstartDate and CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (c.id = @CorporateClientID or @CorporateClientID=0)

			)T
			GROUP BY t.id,EDate,ClientName,BillNo,PatientName,
						Department,t.due
								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

CREATE           PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDepartmentWiseIVCannulaReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column
----- 17. ServiceGroupID [GUID] , 18. ServiceSubGroupId [GUID] , 19. ServiceSubSubGroupID [GUID], 20. ServiceHeadID [GUID], 21. DepartmentID [GUID] 

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDepartmentWiseIVCannulaReport]'2025-01-01,2025-01-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@ServiceGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceSubGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceSubSubGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceHeadID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@DepartmentID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ServiceGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=17
	Select @ServiceSubGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=18
	Select @ServiceSubSubGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=19
	Select @ServiceHeadID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=20
	Select @DepartmentID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=21

---------------------NICU----------------------


		select(
	select * from(

SELECT ir.InvoiceNo AS InvoiceNo, ir.FullName AS PatientName,CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DisDate, 
convert(DATE,ir1.ServiceDatetime) AS ServiceDate, seh.HeadName AS ServiceName, ir1.Rate AS Rate, ir1.Qty, ir1.Amount AS TotalAmount,
ct.CabinType AS BedType
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.id=ir.AdmittedCabinId
JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.id=c.CabinTypeId
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId=ir.id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir1.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceGroups sg ON sg.id=ssg.ServiceGroupId
WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
	AND (@ServiceGroupID=sg.id OR @ServiceGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubGroupID=ssg.id OR @ServiceSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubSubGroupID=sssg.id OR @ServiceSubSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceHeadID=seh.id OR @ServiceHeadID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (ir.DeptId=@DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
AND		seh.id IN (
'9E0630B1-751F-4F72-BB6E-035776D0FE4F','380CEC2C-EC0B-415A-774C-08DC509CF0BE','1F72ECA0-C9BE-4629-A8EE-564AF3D41647','76D270C4-3B50-4B4A-804B-5AC5D7FF326F',
'F373E412-AAAE-40D5-B39B-89410D0E289C','AE570486-BD98-4CA7-BBAB-9702BE55C257','26CD3A89-8DC2-4209-9BA4-D297381D7E1D','49CB72FB-011C-48DA-9086-F69DF513294B','D8B9C6EC-12C5-42D4-97CC-F6B0FD1ED7DE')
AND c.CabinTypeId='1724E9CC-E8A8-48B4-9D42-32CB9AC9BA03'

UNION ALL


---------------------All ICU-----------------

SELECT ir.InvoiceNo AS InvoiceNo, ir.FullName AS PatientName,CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DisDate, 
convert(DATE,ir1.ServiceDatetime) AS ServiceDate, seh.HeadName AS ServiceName, ir1.Rate AS Rate, ir1.Qty, ir1.Amount AS TotalAmount,
ct.CabinType AS BedType
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.id=ir.AdmittedCabinId
JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.id=c.CabinTypeId
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId=ir.id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir1.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceGroups sg ON sg.id=ssg.ServiceGroupId
WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
	AND (@ServiceGroupID=sg.id OR @ServiceGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubGroupID=ssg.id OR @ServiceSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubSubGroupID=sssg.id OR @ServiceSubSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceHeadID=seh.id OR @ServiceHeadID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
AND seh.id IN (
'9E0630B1-751F-4F72-BB6E-035776D0FE4F','380CEC2C-EC0B-415A-774C-08DC509CF0BE','1F72ECA0-C9BE-4629-A8EE-564AF3D41647','76D270C4-3B50-4B4A-804B-5AC5D7FF326F',
'F373E412-AAAE-40D5-B39B-89410D0E289C','AE570486-BD98-4CA7-BBAB-9702BE55C257','26CD3A89-8DC2-4209-9BA4-D297381D7E1D','49CB72FB-011C-48DA-9086-F69DF513294B','D8B9C6EC-12C5-42D4-97CC-F6B0FD1ED7DE') 
AND c.CabinTypeId IN ('874830F8-4182-4CDB-8F82-38FA68117D7D','817BD720-F10A-4C2A-AF9F-80014FE703A0',
'788BC7FF-DF3D-4CB6-BC58-A11C8E12FA40','1C953DEB-F8AF-4B18-9EB0-ED8DCBEE6EF7','59B3DBCF-FFAE-4D2A-8B65-D42D470071BF')

----ORDER BY BedType

	) tbl  
	ORDER BY tbl.BedType
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					
					

					SELECT i.InvoiceNo,i.FullName,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime,
					0 TotalBill,0	CabinWardBill,
					0 ICUBill, 0 HDUBill, 	0 CCUBill,	0 NICUBill,	0 DialysisBill,	0 OTBill,	0 CathlabBill,	0 ConsultationBill,
					0 ServiceCharge,	0 Discount,	0 Received,	0 Due,0 Comission,i.Id

					INTO #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital
							
							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
							
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
								ON D.id = v.id
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
								ON dt.typename = d.type
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')

							

							UPDATE #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital SET
							TotalBill =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit+fbl.Credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.ID
									AND fbl.TransactionType =0
							),0)

							UPDATE #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital SET
							Due =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit)-SUM(credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.ID
   						  ),0)

						  UPDATE #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital SET
							Discount =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit+fbl.Credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.ID
									AND fbl.TransactionType =1
   						  ),0)

						  UPDATE #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital SET
							Received =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit+fbl.Credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.ID
									AND fbl.TransactionType =2
   						  ),0)

INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',20);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',21);

DECLARE @ReportType NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	SELECT 	DISTINCT ReportType	FROM #TempCabinDetails
	--where ReportType ='CabinWardBill'

	----SELECT ''
	----UNION
	----SELECT ''
	--SELECT DISTINCT FROM Hospital.CabinStayingCharges csc
	--JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.Id = csc.CabinId
	--JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.Id = c.CabinTypeId
	--JOIN #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital i ON i.id = csc.IPDPatientRecordId


OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ReportType;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        
		SET @Query =' Update #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital set ['+@ReportType+']=
		(
			SELECT  isnull(sum(Amount),0)
			FROM Hospital.IPDServiceRecords csc
			JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.Id = csc.DeliverySectionId
			join #TempCabinDetails t on t.CabinTypeID = ct.ID
			where  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.id = csc.IPDPatientId
			and t.ReportType ='''+@ReportType+'''
		)
		'
		EXEC (@Query)
		--PRINT @Query;

		SET @Query =' Update #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital set ['+@ReportType+']= isnull(['+@ReportType+'],0) + 
		isnull((
			SELECT  isnull(sum(TotalAmount),0)
			FROM Hospital.CabinStayingCharges csc
			JOIN Hospital.Cabins c on c.id = csc.cabinid
			JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.Id = c.cabintypeid
			join #TempCabinDetails t on t.CabinTypeID = ct.ID
			where  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.id = csc.IPDPatientRecordId
			and t.ReportType ='''+@ReportType+'''
		),0)
		'
		EXEC (@Query)
		--PRINT @Query;

		----------SET @Query =' Update #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital set ['+@ReportType+']= isnull(['+@ReportType+'],0) + 
		----------isnull((
		----------	SELECT  isnull(sum(csc.rate * csc.qty),0)
		----------	FROM Hospital.IPDConsultantServices csc
		----------	JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.Id = csc.DeliverySectionId
		----------	join #TempCabinDetails t on t.CabinTypeID = ct.ID
		----------	where  #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.id = csc.IPDPatientId
		----------	and t.ReportType ='''+@ReportType+'''
		----------),0)
		----------'
		----------EXEC (@Query)
		----------PRINT @Query;


        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
            @ReportType;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

							

							update #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital  set
							ConsultationBill =
							(
								select  isnull(sum(csc.rate * csc.qty),0)
								from Hospital.IPDConsultantServices csc
								where csc.IPDPatientId = #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.Id
							)
							
							update #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital  set
							ConsultationBill = isnull(ConsultationBill,0) + 
							(
								select  isnull(sum(csc.rate * csc.qty),0)
								from Hospital.OTServiceDetails csc
									 join Hospital.OTServices o on o.Id=csc.OTServiceId
								where o.IPDPatientId = #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.Id
							)

							update #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital  set
							ServiceCharge = 
							(
								select  isnull(sum(s.ServiceCharge),0)
								from Hospital.FinalBillSummarys s
									 join Hospital.FinalBills o on s.FinalBillId = o.Id
								where o.IPDPatientRecordId = #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital.Id
							)


							select(
							select * from(

							SELECT 
					
							InvoiceNo
							,FullName
							,AdmissionDateTime
							,DischargedDateTime
							,TotalBill
							,CabinWardBill
							,ICUBill
							,HDUBill
							,CCUBill
							,NICUBill
							,DialysisBill
							,OTBill
							,CathlabBill
							,ConsultationBill
							,ServiceCharge
							,Discount
							,Received
							,Due
							,Comission
							FROM #TempSpGetDepartmentWiseRefByHospital
							

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetDischargedPatientDueCollectionByDate] '1990-01-01','2050-01-01'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDischargedPatientDueCollectionByDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
		select pr.Id,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName,pr.AdmissionDateTime,pr.DischargedDateTime,fbl.TranDateTime,
		--sum(fbl.Debit-fbl.Credit) Amount
		ABS(sum(fbl.Debit-fbl.Credit)) Amount
		from [Hospital].[FinalBills] fb inner join
		[Hospital].[FinalBillLedgers] fbl on fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId inner join
		[Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=pr.Id
		where CONVERT(DATE, fbl.TranDateTime)>=CONVERT(Date, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, fbl.TranDateTime)<=CONVERT(Date, @ToDate)
		AND fbl.TransactionType<>0
		group by pr.Id,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName,pr.AdmissionDateTime,pr.DischargedDateTime,fbl.TranDateTime
		order by fbl.TranDateTime
END
GO

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDischargedPatientsStatement]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDischargedPatientsStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5;


	with PLeadger as
	(
		select p.InvoiceNo,count(fl.Id) TotalCount,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then isnull(isnull(sum(fl.Debit),0) + isnull(sum(fl.Credit),0.00),0.00) else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and  pc.Id =2 and pm.Id =2 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit )+ sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileBkash
		from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
		join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
		join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fb.id=fl.FinalBillId
		join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id=fl.PaymentChannelId
		join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id=pc.PaymentModeId
		group by p.InvoiceNo,fl.TransactionType,pm.Id,pc.Id
		)

	select(
	select * from(


	select 
	T.UHID,
	T.AdmissionNo ,
	T.PatientName ,
	T.AssignDoctor AssignDoctor,
	[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) CabinNo,
	T.MobileNo MobileNo,
	convert(date,T.AdmissionDate) AdmissionDate,
	convert(date,T.DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
	
	isnull(sum([HpBill]),0.00) [HpBill],
	isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) [MedicineBill],
	isnull(sum([InvBill]),0.00) [InvBill],
	isnull(sum([FoodBill]),0.00) [FoodBill],
	isnull(sum([ConsBill]),0.00) [ConsBill],
	isnull(sum([SCharge]),0.00) [SCharge],

	isnull(sum([HpBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([InvBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([FoodBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([ConsBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([SCharge]),0.00) [TotalBill],

	isnull(sum([Advance]),0.00) [Advance],


	isnull((
		select sum(debit+Credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers l where  l.FinalBillId = T.ID
		and  l.TransactionType =1
	),0.00) [RegularDiscount],


	isnull((
		select sum(debit+Credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers l where  l.FinalBillId = T.ID
		and  l.TransactionType =2
	),0.00) [FinalPayment],

isnull((RegularCash),0.00) RegularCash,
	isnull((RegularCard),0.00) RegularCard,
	isnull(RegularMobileNagad,0.00) RegularMobileNagad,
	isnull(RegularMopbileBkash,0.00) RegularMopbileBkash,
	isnull((DueCollectionCash),0.00) DueCollectionCash,
	isnull((DueCollectionCard),0.00) DueCollectionCard,
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileNagad),0.00) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileBkash),0.00) DueCollectionMobileBkash,
	
	isnull(
	isnull(RegularCash,0.00)+
	isnull(RegularCard,0.00)+
	isnull(RegularMobileNagad,0.00)+
	isnull(RegularMopbileBkash,0.00)+
	isnull(DueCollectionCash,0.00)+
	isnull((DueCollectionCard),0.00)+
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileNagad),0.00)+
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileBkash),0.00)
	,0.00)[NetPayble],

	T.DischargeBy
	--sum(isnull((TotalCount),0))TotalCount
	
	from
	(
			select fb.id, p.UHID,
			p.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo,
			P.FullName  PatientName,
			d.Name AssignDoctor,
			'' CabinNo,
			r.MobileNo MobileNo, 
			p.AdmissionDateTime AdmissionDate,
			p.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
			u.UserName DischargeBy,
			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 100  or fs.SummaryHeadId =80 or fs.SummaryHeadId =81 or fs.SummaryHeadId =82 or fs.SummaryHeadId =83
			or fs.SummaryHeadId =84 or fs.SummaryHeadId =85 or fs.SummaryHeadId =86 or fs.SummaryHeadId =87
			then 
			Amount end [HpBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 91  or fs.SummaryHeadId =91 then 
			Amount end [MedicineBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 1000  or fs.SummaryHeadId =1000 then 
			Amount end [InvBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 79  or fs.SummaryHeadId =79 then 
			Amount end [FoodBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 3  or fs.SummaryHeadId =3 then 
			Amount end [ConsBill],

			--case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 1  or fs.SummaryHeadId =1 then 
			ServiceCharge  [SCharge],--,

			(select sum(pp.Amount) from Hospital.AdvancePayments pp where pp.IPDPatientId = p.Id)		[Advance]	
			--pl.TotalCount,
			--pl.RegularCash,
			--pl.RegularCard,
			--pl.DueCollectionCash

			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
			join Hospital.RegRecords r on r.UHID=p.UHID
			join Marketing.Doctors d on d.Id=p.AssignedDoctorId
			--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ac on ac.PatientId=p.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fs on fs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
			--join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fs.FinalBillId
			join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=p.DischargeByUserId
			
			where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
				(u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	left join PLeadger pl on pl.InvoiceNo = T.AdmissionNo

		group by 
		T.id,
	T.UHID,
	T.AdmissionNo ,
	T.PatientName,
	T.AssignDoctor,
	T.MobileNo,
	T.AdmissionDate,
	T.DischargeDate,
	T.DischargeBy,
	pl.RegularCash,
	pl.RegularCard,
	pl.RegularMobileNagad,
	pl.RegularMopbileBkash,
	pl.DueCollectionCash,
	pl.DueCollectionCard,
	pl.DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	pl.DueCollectionMobileBkash

	--d.Name ,
	--r.MobileNo , 
	--p.AdmissionDateTime ,
	--p.DischargedDateTime ,
	----fs.SummaryHeadId,
	--fb.FullName

	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
