-- =============================================
-- Author:		Alamin Kibria
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDischargedPatientsStatementDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDischargedPatientsStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5;

select p.InvoiceNo,sum(c.discount) ConsultantServicesdiscount  
into #TempConsultantServicesdiscount
from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices c on c.[IPDPatientId] = p.id
where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
group by p.InvoiceNo


	SELECT TempP.InvoiceNo,SUM(ir1.Amount) FoodServiceBill
		INTO #TempFoodServiceBill
		from
		  (Select * from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate) TempP
		join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=TempP.DischargeByUserId
		JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1  ON TempP.Id=ir1.IPDPatientId 
		Join 
		 (
	        Select ttt.Id, ttt.ServiceSubSubGroupId, ttt.HeadName 
              from( 
			 Select * from(
			                Select sssg.Id as ServiceGroupId,sssg.ServiceSubGroupId,sssg.Name from  Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg where sssg.id='1980386E-4AD9-4915-9034-4639A1CFE638') tt --79
			  JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh on tt.ServiceGroupId=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId) ttt 
         ) seh
        
		  ON  seh.Id = ir1.ServiceId
		
		and 
	    (u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		
		GROUP BY TempP.InvoiceNo;



	
	With Dischargedpatients as (
	
	    Select * from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
		where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
	
	),
	
    PLeadger as
	(
			select InvoiceNo,sum(TotalCount) TotalCount,
			sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
			sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
			sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
			sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
			sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
			sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
			sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			sum(DueCollectionMobileBkash) DueCollectionMobileBkash
			from
			(
			
			select p.InvoiceNo,count(fl.Id) TotalCount,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then isnull(isnull(sum(fl.Debit),0) + isnull(sum(fl.Credit),0.00),0.00) else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and  pc.Id =2 and pm.Id =2 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit )+ sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileBkash
			from Dischargedpatients p
			join Hospital.FinalBills fb on p.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fb.id=fl.FinalBillId
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id=fl.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id=pc.PaymentModeId
			group by p.InvoiceNo,fl.TransactionType,pm.Id,pc.Id
			 
			)T
		group by T.InvoiceNo
		)


		--select  * from PLeadger
		--return  

	select(
	select * from(


	select 
	T.UHID,
	T.AdmissionNo ,
	T.PatientName ,
	T.AssignDoctor AssignDoctor,
	[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) CabinNo,
	T.MobileNo MobileNo,
	convert(date,T.AdmissionDate) AdmissionDate,
	convert(date,T.DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
	
	isnull(sum([HpBill]),0.00) + isnull(sum([SCharge]),0)+isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) +isnull(sum([FoodBill]),0.00)
	
	[HpBill],
	isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) [MedicineBill],
	isnull(sum([InvBill]),0.00) [InvBill],
	--ISNULL((SELECT SUM(FoodServiceBill) FROM #TempFoodServiceBill tfsb WHERE tfsb.InvoiceNo = T.AdmissionNo),0) [FoodServiceBill], 

	isnull(sum([FoodBill]),0.00) 
	+	ISNULL((SELECT SUM(FoodServiceBill) FROM #TempFoodServiceBill tfsb WHERE tfsb.InvoiceNo = T.AdmissionNo),0) [FoodBill],
	isnull(sum([ConsBill]),0.00)
	-
	isnull((
		select sum(ttt.ConsultantServicesdiscount) from #TempConsultantServicesdiscount ttt where ttt.InvoiceNo =   AdmissionNo
	),0)
	
	 [ConsBill],
	isnull(sum([SCharge]),0.00) [SCharge],

	isnull(sum([HpBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([InvBill]),0.00) +
		--ISNULL((SELECT SUM(FoodServiceBill) FROM #TempFoodServiceBill tfsb WHERE tfsb.InvoiceNo = T.AdmissionNo),0)+
	isnull(sum([FoodBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([ConsBill]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([SCharge]),0.00) 
		-
	isnull((
		select sum(ttt.ConsultantServicesdiscount) from #TempConsultantServicesdiscount ttt where ttt.InvoiceNo =   AdmissionNo
	),0)
	[TotalBill],

	isnull(([Advance]),0.00) [Advance],


	isnull((
		select sum(debit+Credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers l where  l.FinalBillId = T.ID
		and  l.TransactionType =1
	),0.00) [RegularDiscount],


	isnull((
		select sum(debit+Credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers l where  l.FinalBillId = T.ID
		and  l.TransactionType =2
	),0.00) [FinalPayment],

	isnull((RegularCash),0.00) RegularCash,
	isnull((RegularCard),0.00) RegularCard,
	isnull(RegularMobileNagad,0.00) RegularMobileNagad,
	isnull(RegularMopbileBkash,0.00) RegularMopbileBkash,
	isnull((DueCollectionCash),0.00) DueCollectionCash,
	isnull((DueCollectionCard),0.00) DueCollectionCard,
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileNagad),0.00) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileBkash),0.00) DueCollectionMobileBkash,
	
	isnull(
	isnull(RegularCash,0.00)+
	isnull(RegularCard,0.00)+
	isnull(RegularMobileNagad,0.00)+
	isnull(RegularMopbileBkash,0.00)+
	isnull(DueCollectionCash,0.00)+
	isnull((DueCollectionCard),0.00)+
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileNagad),0.00)+
	isnull(( DueCollectionMobileBkash),0.00)
	,0.00)[NetPayble],
	T.DischargeBy,
	0 ExtraDiscount
	--sum(isnull((TotalCount),0))TotalCount
	
	from
	(
			select fb.id, p.UHID,
			p.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo,
			P.FullName  PatientName,
			d.Name AssignDoctor,
			'' CabinNo,
			r.MobileNo MobileNo, 
			p.AdmissionDateTime AdmissionDate,
			p.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
			u.UserName DischargeBy,
			case when  fs.SummaryHeadId ='BA1B319E-FEA4-4452-8B22-FC20B44DBE1D' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='41DE5100-678D-4231-B22A-F76E96282846' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='07CBB7DA-5E71-4718-9CAF-E69623449496' --or fs.SummaryHeadId =83 or fs.SummaryHeadId =87
			or fs.SummaryHeadId ='FF9473BC-D411-466C-99A1-3E492371AD53' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='104E7387-8FAA-4516-ADA2-229251EC6111'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='27FE64EF-BB15-4749-8958-E3570DDE3285' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='A26636D5-E9BE-47DA-912F-B644678EAEE6'
			or fs.SummaryHeadId = '23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0'  OR fs.SummaryHeadId ='20F1BC87-2E06-4EE6-9507-7F1598F9FC1F' --80,81,82,83,84,85,86,87,89,90,100,1002
			then 
			Amount end [HpBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = '4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4' then --91,91
			Amount end [MedicineBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 'F8D6B657-E027-4417-AF73-14B8A1466EB5'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then ---0,104
			Amount end [InvBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 'E260CBA5-56D9-460C-AE8F-092BF172E961'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='44EC6533-C4AA-4378-AD54-0F2CBAF1D66F' then --79,1000
			Amount end [FoodBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = '86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D' then  --3
			Amount end [ConsBill],

			--case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 1  or fs.SummaryHeadId =1 then 
			ServiceCharge  [SCharge],--,

			(select distinct sum(pp.Amount) from Hospital.AdvancePayments pp where pp.IPDPatientId = p.Id
			)		[Advance]	
			--pl.TotalCount,
			--pl.RegularCash,
			--pl.RegularCard,
			--pl.DueCollectionCash

			from Dischargedpatients p
			join Hospital.RegRecords r on p.UHID = r.UHID
			join VWDoctors d on p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id
			--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ac on ac.PatientId=p.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBills fb on  p.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
			join Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fs on fs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
			--join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fs.FinalBillId
			join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=p.DischargeByUserId
			
			where (u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	left join PLeadger pl on pl.InvoiceNo = T.AdmissionNo

		group by 
		T.id,
	T.UHID,
	T.AdmissionNo ,
	T.PatientName,
	T.AssignDoctor,
	T.MobileNo,
	t.Advance,
	T.AdmissionDate,
	T.DischargeDate,
	T.DischargeBy,
	pl.RegularCash,
	pl.RegularCard,
	pl.RegularMobileNagad,
	pl.RegularMopbileBkash,
	pl.DueCollectionCash,
	pl.DueCollectionCard,
	pl.DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	pl.DueCollectionMobileBkash


	union all


	select 
	 
	 UHID,
	BillNo AdmissionNo ,
	FullName PatientName ,
	'' AssignDoctor,
	'OPD Patient' CabinNo,
	MobileNo MobileNo,
	CONVERT(DATE,EntryDate) AdmissionDate,
	'' DischargeDate,
	0 [HpBill],
	0 [MedicineBill],
	0 [InvBill],
	0 [FoodBill],
	0 [ConsBill],
	0 [SCharge],
		isnull(
	isnull(sum(RegularCash),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(RegularCard),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0.00)+
	isnull((sum(DueCollectionCard)),0.00)+
	isnull(( sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad)),0.00)+
	isnull(( sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)),0.00)
	,0.00)
	[TotalBill],
	0 [Advance],
	0	 [RegularDiscount],
	0 [FinalPayment],

	isnull((sum(RegularCash)),0.00) RegularCash,
	isnull((sum(RegularCard)),0.00) RegularCard,
	isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0.00) RegularMobileNagad,
	isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0.00) RegularMopbileBkash,
	isnull((sum(DueCollectionCash)),0.00) DueCollectionCash,
	isnull((sum(DueCollectionCard)),0.00) DueCollectionCard,
	isnull(( sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad)),0.00) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	isnull(( sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)),0.00) DueCollectionMobileBkash,
	
	isnull(
	isnull(sum(RegularCash),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(RegularCard),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0.00)+
	isnull((sum(DueCollectionCard)),0.00)+
	isnull(( sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad)),0.00)+
	isnull(( sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)),0.00)
	,0.00)[NetPayble],
	DischargeBy DischargeBy,
	0 ExtraDiscount

	--sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	--sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	--sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	--sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	--sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	--sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	--sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	--sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,op.UHID,OP.EntryDate,OP.MobileNo,u.UserName DischargeBy,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  op 
			--join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			--join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  aa on aa.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
    T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.UHID,T.EntryDate,T.MobileNo,T.DischargeBy


	--d.Name ,
	--r.MobileNo , 
	--p.AdmissionDateTime ,
	--p.DischargedDateTime ,
	----fs.SummaryHeadId,
	--fb.FullName

	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDistinctTestListByUHID]
	@UHID NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
		SELECT --ii.InvoiceNo AS InvoiceNo , 
		DISTINCT ti.Id, ti.Name  , tg.ParentGroupId
		FROM Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii
		JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails iid ON iid.InvestigationInvoiceId=ii.id
		JOIN Diag.TestItems ti ON ti.id=iid.TestItemId
		join Diag.TestGroups tg on tg.Id = ti.TestGroupId
		WHERE ii.UHID=@UHID
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorbasedSummryReport]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''




--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorbasedSummryReport]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					

					Select * INTO #tempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary from(

					SELECT   ReportType,--billNo,
					      Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 '' commission,JmoName,DoctorName,
							 count(distinct PatientID) PatientIDCount
					FROM (

					SELECT 'Diagnostic' AS ReportType, --i.InvoiceNo BillNo,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN iil.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=2 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,
							0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID,v.Name DoctorName, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id MediaId,
							isnull(mjom1.Name,'') JmoName,
							i.Id PatientID
							

							FROM  Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
							JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.RefdDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
								ON D.id = v.id
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
								ON dt.typename = d.type

							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')

							UNION ALL
							SELECT 'Hospital' AS ReportType, --ir.InvoiceNo BillNo,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=2 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID,v.Name DoctorName, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id MediaId,
							isnull(mjom1.Name,'') JmoName,
							ir.Id PatientID

							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir 
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb  ON ir.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl  ON fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
								ON D.id = v.id
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
								ON dt.typename = d.type

							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
						    AND (ir.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')
							) T
							GROUP BY  ReportType, JmoName,DoctorName--,BillNo
							)TT

					select(
							select * from(

							select 
							ReportType,
							DoctorName,
							PatientIDCount NoofPatient,
					         Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 commission,JmoName
							 
							from #tempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary
							Group by ReportType,commission,JmoName,DoctorName,PatientIDCount

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

-----exec [Hospital].[SPGetDoctorPayment] '2022-01-01','2024-01-01','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetDoctorPayment]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@ConsultantId uniqueidentifier,
	@InvoiceNo bigint
	
AS
BEGIN

		select 
		BillNo, PatientName, DoctorName, ServiceName, ServiceDate, convert(float,ServiceRate) ServiceRate, Discount,
		convert(float, ServiceRate - Discount) Payable, convert(float, ServiceRate - Discount) Paid, ServiceType, ServiceRecordId
		
		from 
				(
				select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						isnull(convert(date,ic.ServiceDate),'') ServiceDate, ic.Rate ServiceRate, ic.Discount Discount,
						ic.IsConsultancyPaId Paid, 'Consultancy' ServiceType,ic.Id ServiceRecordId
				from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
				join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on ic.IPDPatientId=i.Id
				join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
				join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
				where convert(date,ic.ServiceDate) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,ic.ServiceDate) <= @FilterEndDate and
						(ic.ConsultantId=@ConsultantId or @ConsultantId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and 
						(i.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0)

				Union All
						select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						isnull(convert(date,s.ServiceEntryDate),'') ServiceDate, od.Rate ServiceRate, od.Discount Discount,
						od.IsConsultancyPaId paid, 'OT' ServiceType, od.Id ServiceRecordId
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
					join Hospital.OTServices s on s.IPDPatientId=i.Id
					join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on od.OTServiceId=s.Id
					join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
					join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
					where convert(date,s.ServiceEntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,s.ServiceEntryDate) <= @FilterEndDate and
						(od.DoctorId=@ConsultantId or @ConsultantId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and 
						(i.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo or @InvoiceNo=0)
					)T

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorPaymentSheet]
	
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorPaymentSheet]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@ConsultantID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

	--select(
	--select * from(


	select 
	* ,
	round(((TotalAmount*5)/100),0) Tax,

	TotalAmount - round(((TotalAmount*5)/100),0) NetPayable
	from 
	(
					select 
					AdmNo,
					PatientName,
					[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmNo) BedName,
					convert(date,AdmDate) AdmDate,
					Convert(date,DiscDate) DiscDate,
					HeadName,
					sum(Rate) Rate,
					Sum(Qty) Qty,
					Rate * Sum(Qty) TotalAmount,
					ConsultantName
					

					from
					(
							select 
							p.InvoiceNo AdmNo, P.FullName PatientName, p.AdmissionDateTime AdmDate, P.DischargedDateTime DiscDate, '' BedName, sh.HeadName,
							 ic.Rate Rate,ic.Qty Qty, d.Name ConsultantName
							from 
							Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
							join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords i on i.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on ic.IPDPatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
							join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
							where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(@ConsultantID=ic.ConsultantId or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
									--group by p.InvoiceNo
				Union All
							select 
							p.InvoiceNo AdmNo, P.FullName PatientName, p.AdmissionDateTime AdmDate, P.DischargedDateTime DiscDate, '' BedName, sh.HeadName,
							 od.Rate Rate,od.Qty Qty, d.Name ConsultantName 
							from 
							Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
							join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords i on i.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.OTServices os on os.IPDPatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on od.OTServiceId=os.Id
							join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
							join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
							where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(@ConsultantID=od.DoctorId or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')	
									--group by p.InvoiceNo
						)T
						Group by T.AdmNo, T.PatientName,T.AdmDate,T.DiscDate,t.HeadName,T.Rate,T.ConsultantName
				)TT

				
	--) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorPaymentSheetDynamic]

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorPaymentSheetDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@ConsultantID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

	select(
	select * from(


	select 
	* ,
	round(((TotalAmount*5)/100),0) Tax,

	TotalAmount - round(((TotalAmount*5)/100),0) NetPayable
	from 
	(
					select 
					AdmNo,
					PatientName,
					[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmNo) BedName,
					convert(date,AdmDate) AdmDate,
					Convert(date,DiscDate) DiscDate,
					HeadName,
					sum(Rate) Rate,
					Sum(Qty) Qty,
					Rate * Sum(Qty) TotalAmount,
					ConsultantName,
					MainDoctor
					

					from
					(
							select 
							p.InvoiceNo AdmNo, P.FullName PatientName, p.AdmissionDateTime AdmDate, P.DischargedDateTime DiscDate, '' BedName, sh.HeadName,
							 ic.Rate Rate,ic.Qty Qty, d.Name ConsultantName, dd.Name AS MainDoctor
							from 
							Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
							--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords i on i.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on ic.IPDPatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
							join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
							JOIN VWDoctors dd ON dd.id=p.AssignedDoctorId
							where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(@ConsultantID=ic.ConsultantId or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
									--group by p.InvoiceNo
				Union All
							select 
							p.InvoiceNo AdmNo, P.FullName PatientName, p.AdmissionDateTime AdmDate, P.DischargedDateTime DiscDate, '' BedName, sh.HeadName,
							 od.Rate Rate,od.Qty Qty, d.Name ConsultantName, dd.Name AS MainDoctor
							from 
							Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
							--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords i on i.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.OTServices os on os.IPDPatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on od.OTServiceId=os.Id
							join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
							join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
							JOIN VWDoctors dd ON dd.id=p.AssignedDoctorId
							where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(@ConsultantID=od.DoctorId or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')	
									--group by p.InvoiceNo
						)T
						Group by T.AdmNo, T.PatientName,T.AdmDate,T.DiscDate,t.HeadName,T.Rate,T.ConsultantName,T.MainDoctor
				)TT

				
	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorPaymentSheetInvoiceWise]
	
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetDoctorPaymentSheetInvoiceWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@ConsultantID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

	select(
	select * from(


	select 
	* ,
	round(((Amount*5)/100),0) Tax,

	Amount - round(((Amount*5)/100),0) NetPayable
	from 
	(
					select 
					AdmissionDate,
					DischargeDate,
					AdmissionNo,
					[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) BedName,
					PatientName,
					LeadingDoctor,
					ServiceDoctor,
					HeadName AS Particulars,
					sum(Rate) Rate,
					Sum(Qty) Qty,
					Rate * Sum(Qty) Amount
					from
					(
							select 
							CONVERT(DATE,p.AdmissionDateTime) AS AdmissionDate, CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) AS DischargeDate,
							p.InvoiceNo AS AdmissionNo,'' AS  BedName,p.FullName AS PatientName, dd.Name AS LeadingDoctor,
							d.Name AS ServiceDoctor, sh.HeadName,

							 ic.Rate Rate,ic.Qty Qty
							from 
							Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
							--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords i on i.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on ic.IPDPatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
							join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
							JOIN VWDoctors dd ON dd.id=p.AssignedDoctorId
							where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(@ConsultantID=ic.ConsultantId or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
									--group by p.InvoiceNo
				Union All
							select 
							CONVERT(DATE,p.AdmissionDateTime) AS AdmissionDate, CONVERT(DATE,p.DischargedDateTime) AS DischargeDate,
							p.InvoiceNo AS AdmissionNo,'' AS  BedName,p.FullName AS PatientName, dd.Name AS LeadingDoctor,
							d.Name AS ServiceDoctor, sh.HeadName,

							 od.Rate Rate,od.Qty Qt
							from 
							Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
							--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords i on i.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.OTServices os on os.IPDPatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on od.OTServiceId=os.Id
							join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
							join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
							JOIN VWDoctors dd ON dd.id=p.AssignedDoctorId
							where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(@ConsultantID=od.DoctorId or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')	
									--group by p.InvoiceNo
						)T
						Group by T.AdmissionNo, T.PatientName,T.AdmissionDate,T.DischargeDate,t.HeadName,
						T.Rate,T.LeadingDoctor,T.ServiceDoctor
						
				)TT
				--ORDER BY TT.AdmissionNo
				
	) tbl  
	ORDER BY tbl.AdmissionNo
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SPGetDoctorWiseCashCollection]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetDoctorWiseCashCollection]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
		declare
			@FilterStartDate date,
			@FilterEndDate date,
			@ConsultantId uniqueidentifier,
			@ReportType int =0
		Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
		Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		Select @ConsultantId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
		select 
		BillNo, PatientName,AdmissionDateTime,DischargedDateTime, DoctorName, ServiceName, ServiceDate, convert(float,ServiceRate) ServiceRate, 
		--Discount,
		--convert(float, ServiceRate - Discount) Payable, 
		--convert(float,Paid)		Paid, 
		ServiceType, ServiceRecordId, [ReferDoctor],
		Qty,rate,TotalAmount, 'Admin' userName
		into #TempSPGetDoctorWiseCashCollection
		from 
				(
				select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						isnull(convert(date,ic.ServiceDate),'') ServiceDate, ic.Rate ServiceRate, ic.Discount Discount,
						ic.IsConsultancyPaId Paid, 'Consultancy' ServiceType,ic.Id ServiceRecordId,doc.Name [ReferDoctor],
						 ic.Qty, ic.Rate,ic.Qty*ic.Rate [TotalAmount]
						
				from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
				join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on ic.IPDPatientId=i.Id
				join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
				join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
				join VWDoctors doc on doc.id = i.RefdDoctorId
				join Hospital.Cabins c on i.AdmittedCabinId=c.Id
				where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate and
						(ic.ConsultantId=@ConsultantId or @ConsultantId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
						--and i.Status=
						

				Union All
						select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						isnull(convert(date,s.ServiceEntryDate),'') ServiceDate, od.Rate ServiceRate, od.Discount Discount,
						od.IsConsultancyPaId paid, 'OT' ServiceType, od.Id ServiceRecordId,doc.Name [ReferDoctor],
						 od.Qty, od.Rate,od.Qty*od.Rate [TotalAmount]
						
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
					join Hospital.OTServices s on s.IPDPatientId=i.Id
					join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on od.OTServiceId=s.Id
					join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
					join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
					join VWDoctors doc on doc.id = i.RefdDoctorId
					where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate and
						(od.DoctorId=@ConsultantId or @ConsultantId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 
						
					)T



					IF @ReportType = 0
					BEGIN
							 select (
							  select * from (
							  select * from #TempSPGetDoctorWiseCashCollection

												) tbl
							  order by tbl.BillNo 
							  FOR JSON AUTO
							  ) as Data
					END
					ELSE IF @ReportType = 1
					BEGIN
							select * from #TempSPGetDoctorWiseCashCollection
					END 

END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetDoDPatientAccessesByUserId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDoDPatientAccessesByUserId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UserId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tbl
	SELECT * INTO #Tbl
	FROM [Hospital].[DoDPatientAccesses]
	CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](DeptIds, ','); 

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp
	SELECT ifpa.Id, ifpa.UserId, ifpa.FloorId,ifpa.DeptIds, ifpa.item, ifpa.IsPatientVisibleByFloor, u.UserName, ISNULL(u.FullName, '') as FullName, ISNULL(f.Name, '') as FloorName,ISNULL(d.Name, '') DepartmentName into #Tmp
	FROM #Tbl ifpa INNER JOIN
		[Identity].[Users] u ON ifpa.UserId = u.Id LEFT JOIN
		[Hospital].[Floors] f ON ifpa.FloorId = f.Id INNER JOIN
		[Hospital].[HDepartments] d ON ifpa.item = d.Id
	WHERE @UserId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR ifpa.UserId=@UserId


	SELECT a.Id, a.UserId, a.FloorId, a.DeptIds, a.IsPatientVisibleByFloor,a.UserName,a.FullName,a.FloorName ,STRING_AGG(a.DepartmentName, ',') as DepartmentNames
	FROM #Tmp a
	GROUP BY a.Id, a.UserId, a.FloorId, a.DeptIds, a.IsPatientVisibleByFloor,a.UserName,a.FullName,a.FloorName
END
GO

-- exec [Hospital].[SpGetDynamicFormDeptWiseDetailForDischargeCertificate] '35d582a3-f97b-4e69-0f19-08dd4f8a47da','b216e71d-6952-4cfd-9add-4447e3c31721'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetDynamicFormDeptWiseDetailForDischargeCertificate]
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@DynamicFormId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN
	select 
	  ct.LabelText, 
	  ct.CType, 
	  tbl.CheckUpDate, 
	  tbl.DynamicFormId, 
	  dwd.ControltypeId, 
	  dwd.BindValue, 
	  dwd.BindDropDownValue, 
	  ct.WillDisplayOnDischargeCertificate, 
	  dwd.Id, 
	  dwd.MasterId 
	from 
	  (
		select 
		  top 1 dw.Id, 
		  dw.DynamicFormId, 
		  dw.PatientId, 
		  dw.CheckUpDate 
		from 
		  [Hospital].[PatientDynamicFormDatas] dw 
		where 
		  dw.DynamicFormId = @DynamicFormId 
		  and dw.PatientId = @IPDPatientId 
		order by 
		  dw.CheckUpDate desc
	  ) tbl 
	  inner join [Hospital].[PatientDynamicFormDataDetails] dwd on tbl.Id = dwd.MasterId 
	  inner join [Hospital].[DynamicInputControls] ct on dwd.ControltypeId = ct.Id 
	where 
	  tbl.DynamicFormId = @DynamicFormId 
	  and tbl.PatientId = @IPDPatientId
	  order by dwd.CreatedOn
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetExtraServiceAmountDetails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetExtraServiceAmountDetails]'2024-06-15,2024-06-15,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

	select(
	select * from(


	select 
	InvoiceNo, PatientName, BedNo, Admdate, DischargeDate, ServiceName, TotalBillAmount,
	IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra [TotalExtraAmount],
	case when TotalDiscount <(IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then TotalDiscount else  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) end [TotalExtraDiscount],
	case when TotalDiscount < (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra)- TotalDiscount else 0 end [PoorFundAmount],
	DischargeBy
	
	from 
	(
	Select 
	InvoiceNo,
	PatientName,
	[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.InvoiceNo) BedNo,
	convert(date,Admdate) Admdate,
	convert(date,DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
	ServiceName,
	sum(isnull((TotalBillAmount),0.00)) TotalBillAmount,
	(isnull((TotalDiscount),0.00)) TotalDiscount,
	DischargeBy,

	isnull((

	select sum(isr.Amount ) Amount
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.IPDServiceRecords isr on isr.IPDPatientId=p.Id
	where isr.IsExtraService=1 and p.InvoiceNo=t.InvoiceNo

	),0.00) IPDExtra,

	isnull((
	select sum(Amount)
	from 
			(
					select d.ExtraAmount * isr.Qty Amount 
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
					join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices isr on isr.IPDPatientId=p.Id
					join Marketing.Doctors d on d.Id=isr.ConsultantId
					where 
					--isr.IsExtraService=1 and 
					p.InvoiceNo=t.InvoiceNo
			)TTT
			
			--group by d.ExtraAmount,p.InvoiceNo,d.id
	),0.00) ConsExtra,
	

	isnull((
				select sum(Amount)
				FROM
				(
						select isd.Rate * isd.Qty Amount 
						from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
						join Hospital.OTSchedules isr on isr.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
						join Hospital.OTServiceDetails isd on isd.OTServiceId=isr.Id
						where isd.IsExtraService=1 and p.InvoiceNo=t.InvoiceNo
				)TTTT
				--group by isd.Rate
	),0.00) OTExtra
	--,
	--sum(IPDExtra) + sum(ConsExtra)+sum(OTExtra) TotalExtraAmount



	from
	(
	select 
	i.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,i.fullname PatientName, '' BedNo, i.AdmissionDateTime Admdate, i.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,'' ServiceName,
	case when fl.TransactionType=0 then (Debit) else 0 end [TotalBillAmount],
	case when fl.TransactionType=1 then (Credit) else 0 end [TotalDiscount],
	u.UserName as DischargeBy
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
	join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords al on al.PatientId=i.Id
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=al.CabinId
	join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
	join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=i.DischargeByUserId

	where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
			convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
				(u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--group by i.InvoiceNo,i.FullName,c.CabinNo,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime,fl.TransactionType,
	--fl.Debit
	)T
	where t.TotalDiscount<>0
	Group by T.InvoiceNo,T.PatientName,T.BedNo,T.Admdate,T.DischargeDate,ServiceName,TotalDiscount,DischargeBy
	
	)TT

	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO

--Exec [Hospital].[spGetExtraServiceRecordByPatientId] '7EE48CB7-4527-4ACD-667A-08DC585FDCE8'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetExtraServiceRecordByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	drop table if exists #TmpTbl1;
	create table #TmpTbl1
	  (
		[ServiceId] uniqueidentifier,
		[ServiceName] nvarchar(max),
		[Amount]  float,
		[Discount]  float,
		[ServiceCharge] float,
		[ServiceType] nvarchar(max)
	  )
	  insert into #TmpTbl1
	  select sh.Id [ServiceId],sh.HeadName [ServiceName],sr.Amount, sr.Discount,sr.ServiceCharge,'IPDService' [ServiceType]
		from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr inner join
			 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] sh on sr.ServiceId=sh.Id 
	   where sr.IsExtraService=1 and sr.IPDPatientId=@PatientId
  
	  insert into #TmpTbl1
	  select sh.Id [ServiceId],sh.HeadName [ServiceName],(cs.Rate * cs.Qty) [Amount], cs.Discount,cs.ServiceCharge,'Consultantation' [ServiceType]
		from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cs inner join
			 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] sh on cs.ServiceId=sh.Id
	   where cs.IsExtraService=1 and cs.IPDPatientId=@PatientId
  
	  insert into #TmpTbl1
	  select sh.Id [ServiceId],sh.HeadName [ServiceName],cs.Amount,cs.Discount,cs.ServiceCharge,'Consultantation' [ServiceType]
		from [Hospital].[OTServiceDetails] cs inner join
			 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] sh on cs.ServiceHeadId=sh.Id inner join 
			 [Hospital].[OTServices] ot on cs.OTServiceId=ot.Id
	   where cs.IsExtraService=1 and ot.IPDPatientId=@PatientId
	   
	   select * from #TmpTbl1
END

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetFinalBillLedgerByPatientId] 'AA9D28A0-E857-4D5C-91F7-08DAFC786D6B'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetFinalBillLedgerByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select fbl.Id,fbl.FinalBillId,fbl.TranDateTime,fbl.Description,fbl.Debit,fbl.Credit,fbl.Balance,fbl.TransactionType,fbl.UserId,fbl.PaymentChannelId,fbl.PosTerminalId,pc.Name PayChannelName,u.UserName
	from [Hospital].[FinalBills] fb inner join
		 [Hospital].[FinalBillLedgers] fbl on fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId left join
		 [Admin].[PaymentChannels] pc on fbl.PaymentChannelId=pc.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on fbl.UserId=u.Id
	where fb.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
  
END

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetFinancialStatementofBillCollection]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SPGetFinancialStatementofBillCollection]'2025-01-24,2025-01-24,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN




	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	
	
	--return 
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserId

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID int
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'Advance',1
	--union all
	--select 'OPD',2
	--union all
	--select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY',5
	--union all
	--select 'DIALYSIS',3
	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		--BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		HospitalAmount float,
		DoctorAmount float,
		TestAmount float,
		TotalAmount float,
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		DueAmount float,
		NetPayble float,
		UserName nvarchar(max),
		TestDiscount float,
		HospitalDiscount float

	)

select p.InvoiceNo,sum(c.discount) ConsultantServicesdiscount  
into #TempConsultantServicesdiscount
from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices c on c.[IPDPatientId] = p.id
where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
group by p.InvoiceNo


	select 
	T.InvoiceNo,
	T.PatientName ,
	--convert(date,T.AdmissionDate) AdmissionDate,
	--convert(date,T.DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
	
	isnull(sum([HpBill]),0.00) + isnull(sum([SCharge]),0)+isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) +isnull(sum([FoodBill]),0.00)
	
	[HpBill],
	isnull(sum([MedicineBill]),0.00) [MedicineBill],
	isnull(sum([InvBill]),0.00) [InvBill],
	isnull(sum([ConsBill]),0.00)
	-
	isnull((
		select sum(ttt.ConsultantServicesdiscount) from #TempConsultantServicesdiscount ttt where ttt.InvoiceNo =   AdmissionNo
	),0)
	
	 [ConsBill],
	isnull(sum(([Advance])),0.00) [Advance],

	isnull((
		select sum(debit+Credit) from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers l where  l.FinalBillId = T.ID
		and  l.TransactionType =1
	),0.00) [RegularDiscount],
	username
	into #TempSPGetFinancialStatementofBillCollectionDischarAmount

	from
	(
			select
			r.InvoiceNo,
			fb.id,
			r.FullName  PatientName,
			r.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo,
			(select distinct sum(pp.Amount) from Hospital.AdvancePayments pp where pp.IPDPatientId = r.id
			)		[Advance],	
			u.UserName DischargeBy,
			case when  fs.SummaryHeadId ='BA1B319E-FEA4-4452-8B22-FC20B44DBE1D' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='41DE5100-678D-4231-B22A-F76E96282846' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='07CBB7DA-5E71-4718-9CAF-E69623449496' --or fs.SummaryHeadId =83 or fs.SummaryHeadId =87
			or fs.SummaryHeadId ='FF9473BC-D411-466C-99A1-3E492371AD53' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='104E7387-8FAA-4516-ADA2-229251EC6111'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='27FE64EF-BB15-4749-8958-E3570DDE3285' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='A26636D5-E9BE-47DA-912F-B644678EAEE6'
			or fs.SummaryHeadId = '23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0'  OR fs.SummaryHeadId ='20F1BC87-2E06-4EE6-9507-7F1598F9FC1F' --80,81,82,83,84,85,86,87,89,90,100,1002
			then 
			Amount end [HpBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = '4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4' then --91,91
			Amount end [MedicineBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 'F8D6B657-E027-4417-AF73-14B8A1466EB5'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then ---0,104
			Amount
			------------discount 
			end [InvBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 'E260CBA5-56D9-460C-AE8F-092BF172E961'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='44EC6533-C4AA-4378-AD54-0F2CBAF1D66F' then --79,1000
			Amount end [FoodBill],

			case when fs.SummaryHeadId = '86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D' then  --3
			Amount end [ConsBill],
			ServiceCharge  [SCharge],
			u.username
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords r 
			join Hospital.FinalBills fb on  r.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
			join Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fs on fs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
			--join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fs.FinalBillId
			join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id= r.DischargeByUserId
			
			where (u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and convert(date,r.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,r.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
	)T
	group by InvoiceNo,PatientName,AdmissionNo,Id,username
	
	--select * from #TempSPGetFinancialStatementofBillCollectionDischarAmount 
	--where  InvoiceNo ='2501230200012' or InvoiceNo ='2501190200012' return 
	 
	
	-- select * from Hospital.AdvancePayments

	----------------------------   Advance Start --------------------------------------------------- 
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,HospitalAmount,DoctorAmount,TestAmount, RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueAmount,NetPayble,userName)

	select 'Advance from Admitted Patient' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,--CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	HospitalAmount, 0 DoctorAmount,0 TestAmount,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0,
	0,
	T.userName 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,--c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	u.userName
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.userName

	
	
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,HospitalAmount,DoctorAmount,TestAmount,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueAmount,NetPayble,UserName)

	select 'Advance Return from Admitted Patient' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	HospitalAmount, 0 DoctorAmount,0 TestAmount,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0,
	0,
	UserName 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	a.AdvanceReturnAmount *-1 RegularCash,
	0 RegularCard,
	0 RegularMobileNagad,
	0 RegularMopbileBkash,
	0 DueCollectionCash,
	0 DueCollectionCard,
	0 DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	0 DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	UserName
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and a.AdvanceReturnAmount <> 0
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.UserName

	----------------------------   Advance End --------------------------------------------------- 

	-----------select * from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport return
	

	----------------------------------Start Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,HospitalAmount,DoctorAmount,TestAmount,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount,UserName)
	
	select 'Discharged Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	HospitalAmount, 0 DoctorAmount,0 TestAmount,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount,
	UserName
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			,UserName
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers aa on aa.FinalBillId = a.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where 
			convert(date,aa.TranDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate
			and		convert(date,aa.TranDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate
			and		convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.UserName
	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	TestAmount =
	isnull((
		select [InvBill] from #TempSPGetFinancialStatementofBillCollectionDischarAmount tt where tt.InvoiceNo =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.BillNo
	),0),
	DoctorAmount =
	isnull((
		select ConsBill from #TempSPGetFinancialStatementofBillCollectionDischarAmount tt where tt.InvoiceNo =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.BillNo
	),0)
	where ReportType ='Discharged Patients'

	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	totalAmount=
	isnull((
	select
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport tt where tt.BillNo =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.BillNo
	),0)
	where ReportType ='Discharged Patients'

	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	HospitalAmount = TotalAmount - TestAmount -DoctorAmount
	
	where ReportType ='Discharged Patients'

	----------------------------------End Discharged Patient----------------------------------


	----------------------------------Start Due Collection Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,HospitalAmount,DoctorAmount,TestAmount,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount,UserName)
	
	select 'Due Collection'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	HospitalAmount, 0 DoctorAmount,0 TestAmount,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount,
	UserName
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			,UserName
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers aa on aa.FinalBillId = a.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where 
			convert(date,aa.TranDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate
			and		convert(date,aa.TranDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and 
			(
					convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime)<@FilterStartDate
					or		
					convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime) >@FilterEndDate
			)
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.UserName


	
	
	----------------------------------Start Discharged Free Bed 0 Amount Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,HospitalAmount,DoctorAmount,TestAmount,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount,userName)
	
	select 'Discharged Patients Free Bed'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,--CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	HospitalAmount, 0 DoctorAmount,0 TestAmount,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords opp 
			join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount,
	UserName
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,c.CabinNo,
			 0  RegularCash,
			 0  RegularCard,
			 0  RegularMobileNagad,
			 0  RegularMopbileBkash,
			 0  DueCollectionCash,
			 0  DueCollectionCard,
			 0  DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			 0  DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			 u.UserName
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords op 
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = op.DischargeByUserId

			where  convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime )>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,op.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and a.Id not in 
			(
				select ll.FinalBillId from Hospital.FinalBillLedgers ll
			)
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,t.userName




	----------------------------------End Discharged Free Bed 0 Amount Patient----------------------------------
	
	
	------------------------------------OPD Patient ----------------
	----------------------------------Start Discharged Patient----------------------------------
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,HospitalAmount,DoctorAmount,TestAmount, RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetPayble,DueAmount,UserName)
	
	select 'OPD Patients'ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,
	sum(RegularCash) + sum(RegularCard) +sum(RegularMobileNagad) +sum(RegularMopbileBkash) 
	+sum(DueCollectionCash) + sum(DueCollectionCard) +sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) +sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash)
	HospitalAmount, 0 DoctorAmount,0 TestAmount,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  opp 
			--join Hospital.FinalBills aa on aa.IPDPatientRecordId = opp.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  fbl on fbl.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0.00) DueAmount,
	UserName
	From 
	(
			select  
			--para.ReportType, 
			op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName
			--,c.CabinNo
			,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =2 and  pm.Id =2 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when aa.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then aa.Debit + aa.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			,UserName
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices  op 
			--join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = op.AdmittedCabinId
			--join Hospital.FinalBills a on a.IPDPatientRecordId = op.Id
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger  aa on aa.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = aa.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = aa.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,aa.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,aa.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by 
	--T.ReportType,
	T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.UserName
	--,t.CabinNo
	-------------------------------------------End OPD patient--------------------------------------
	
	--update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	--SLNO =
	--(
	--		select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
	--		where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
	--		and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	--),
	--NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
	--				+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

	

		--select(

-------------------- SLNo added  --------------------------------------------
DECLARE 
    @UserName VARCHAR(MAX), 
	@ReportType VARCHAR(MAX),
	@SLNO int,
	@TempSLNO int,
    @BillNo   bigint;

DECLARE cursor_SlNo_Set CURSOR
FOR SELECT 
        UserName, 
		ReportType,
        BillNo
    FROM 
        #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport;

OPEN cursor_SlNo_Set;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_SlNo_Set INTO 
    @UserName,
	@ReportType, 
    @BillNo;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

	select @SLNO = isnull(max(slno),0) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
	where t.UserName =@UserName
	and   t.ReportType =@ReportType
	--and	  t.BillNo =@BillNo 	

	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	slno = @SLNO +1
	where UserName =@UserName
	and   ReportType =@ReportType
	and	  BillNo =@BillNo	  	
       
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_SlNo_Set INTO 
    @UserName, 
	@ReportType,
    @BillNo;;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_SlNo_Set;

DEALLOCATE cursor_SlNo_Set;



SELECT p.InvoiceNo,sum(ir.Discount) TestDiscount 
into  #TempFinancialStatementofBillCollectionTestDiscount
FROM 
Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir ON ir.IPDPatientId=p.Id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
JOIN #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t on t.billno = p.InvoiceNo
WHERE sssg.id='54DF1D4F-AF32-4D76-8346-EF7238FF6234'
group by p.InvoiceNo

SELECT p.InvoiceNo,sum(ir.Discount) HospitalDiscount 
into  #TempFinancialStatementofBillCollectionHospitalDiscount
FROM 
Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir ON ir.IPDPatientId=p.Id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
JOIN #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t on t.billno = p.InvoiceNo
WHERE sssg.id<>'54DF1D4F-AF32-4D76-8346-EF7238FF6234'
group by p.InvoiceNo

--------------------DoctorDiscount Start---------------



----------------Doctor Discount End -----------------



update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
TestDiscount =0,
HospitalDiscount=0

update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
TestDiscount =
isnull((
select TestDiscount from #TempFinancialStatementofBillCollectionTestDiscount tt where tt.InvoiceNo = #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.billno
--and tt.ReportType ='Discharged Patients'
),0)
where ReportType ='Discharged Patients'

update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
HospitalDiscount =
isnull((
select HospitalDiscount from #TempFinancialStatementofBillCollectionHospitalDiscount tt where tt.InvoiceNo = #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.billno
--and tt.ReportType ='Discharged Patients'
),0)
where ReportType ='Discharged Patients'



---------------------- SLNO added done --------------------------------------------
select (
	select * from(
	select 
		ReportType AS [Status],
		SLNO ,
		UserName,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		HospitalAmount-HospitalDiscount + TestDiscount HospitalAmount,
		DoctorAmount DoctorAmount,
		TestAmount-TestDiscount TestAmount,
		HospitalAmount + DoctorAmount + TestAmount  -HospitalDiscount   TotalAmount,
		--BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash + DueCollectionCash CashAmount ,
		RegularCard  + DueCollectionCard CardAmount,
		RegularMopbileBkash + DueCollectionMopbileBkash BkashAmount, 
		RegularMobileNagad  + DueCollectionMobileNagad  NagadAmount, 
		0 RocketAmount,
		DueAmount,
		TestDiscount,
		HospitalDiscount,
		0 DoctorDiscount
		 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport 
		--where HospitalDiscount <>0 
		--or testDiscount <>0
		
		) tbl  
		order by tbl.Status---,tbl.Status ,tbl.slno
		FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END

create   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetFollowUpDataDetailsByUHID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UHID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @patientid uniqueidentifier;
	select @patientid =  (Select top 1 Id from [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] where UHID=@UHID order by CreatedOn desc )
	--select @patientid
	select * from [Hospital].[FollowUpDataDetails] fudd inner join Hospital.FollowUpDatas fud on fudd.MasterId=fud.Id where fud.PatientId=@patientid
  
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetHDepartmentById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier 
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select d.Id,isnull(d.Name,'') Name,isnull(d.Description,'') Description,d.AdmissionFee,d.DischargeTemplateId,isnull(dt.Name,'') DischargeTemplateName,isnull(dt.ClassName,'') DischargeTemplateClassName
	  from [Hospital].[HDepartments] d left join

	 where d.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
