CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalCollectionSheet]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalCollectionSheet]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID uniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5


	Create table #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetAdvance
	(	
		InvoiceNo bigint,
		FullName nvarchar(max),
		CabinNo nvarchar(max),
		DoctorName nvarchar(max),
		AdvanceAmount float,
		AdvanceReturn float,
		userID uniqueIdentifier,
		UserName nvarchar(max),

	)
	
	insert into #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetAdvance
	select p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](p.InvoiceNo) CabinNo,
	d.Name DoctorName,av.Amount,av.AdvanceReturnAmount,u.Id,u.UserName
		
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments av on av.IPDPatientId=p.Id
	join VWDoctors d on d.Id = p.AssignedDoctorId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.Id = av.UserId
	where convert(date,av.PayDate) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,av.PayDate) <= @FilterEndDate
	and (av.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--and p.InvoiceNo='2309021'
	--select * from #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetAdvance
	--return 



	Create table #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetpayment
	(	
		InvoiceNo bigint,
		FullName nvarchar(max),
		CabinNo nvarchar(max),
		DoctorName nvarchar(max),
		TransactionType int,
		PaymentAmount float,
		userID uniqueIdentifier,
		UserName nvarchar(max),

	)
	insert into #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetpayment
	select p.InvoiceNo,p.FullName,[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](p.InvoiceNo) CabinNo,
	d.Name DoctorName,fbl.TransactionType ,fbl.Debit+ fbl.Credit,u.Id,u.UserName
		
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords a on a.PatientId=p.Id
	--join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=a.CabinId
	join Hospital.FinalBills av on av.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
	join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId = av.Id
	join VWDoctors d on d.Id = p.AssignedDoctorId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.Id = fbl.UserId
	where convert(date,fbl.TranDateTime) >= @FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,fbl.TranDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
	and (fbl.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and fbl.TransactionType=2
	
	select (select * from (
	select InvoiceNo,FullName,CabinNo,DoctorName,'Advance Collection' PaymentType,AdvanceAmount Amount ,UserName
	from #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetAdvance t where t.AdvanceAmount<> 0
	union all
	select InvoiceNo,FullName,CabinNo,DoctorName,'Advance Return' PaymentType,AdvanceReturn , UserName
	from #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetAdvance t where t.AdvanceReturn<> 0
	union all
	select InvoiceNo,FullName,CabinNo,DoctorName,'Payment' PaymentType,PaymentAmount , UserName
	from #TempSpGetHospitalCollectionSheetpayment t where t.PaymentAmount<> 0

	--order by InvoiceNo

		) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @SummaryHeadId int =100
DECLARE @MediaIdBill int =91
DECLARE @FBCHARGE int =79
DECLARE @FBCHARGERoomService int =1000
DECLARE @Consultaion int =3
DECLARE @OTCharge int =85

CREATE TABLE #TempCabinDetails
(
ReportType NVARCHAR(MAX),
CabinTypeID int
)

INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',1);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',5);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',6);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',7);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',8);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',9);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',11);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',16);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',17);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',18);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',19);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',20);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',21);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('CabinWardBill',22);



INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('ICUBill',2);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('ICUBill',3);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('HDUBill',4);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('NICUBill',10);
--INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('DialysisBill',15);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('ICUBill',23);
INSERT INTO #TempCabinDetails VALUES('HDUBill',24);


DECLARE
			@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					
					

					SELECT i.id, i.InvoiceNo,i.FullName,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime,
					0 Admissionfee, 0 CabinWardBill,
					0 ICUBill, 0 HDUBill, 	0 CCUBill,	0 NICUBill,
					0 BedSideService, 0 Consultation, 0 PAC,
					0 OTMedicine, 0 OTCharge,
					0 SurgeonFee, 0 Anaesthesia, 0 Assistant,
					0 POW, 0 Investigation, 0 DayCareService,
					0 Medicine,	0 Food,	0 ServiceCharge,
					0 TotalBill, 0 	Discount,0	Received,0 	Due,
					u.UserName DischargeBy


				
					INTO #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue
							
							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
							
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
								ON D.id = v.id
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
								ON dt.typename = d.type
							LEFT JOIN [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=i.DischargeByUserId
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')


							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Admissionfee =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId = fb.Id
									and fbs.SummaryHeadId =@SummaryHeadId
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									
							),0)


							DECLARE @ReportType NVARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	SELECT 	DISTINCT ReportType	FROM #TempCabinDetails
	

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ReportType;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        
		SET @Query =' Update #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue set ['+@ReportType+']=
		(
			SELECT  isnull(sum(Amount),0)
			FROM Hospital.IPDServiceRecords csc
			JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.Id = csc.DeliverySectionId
			join #TempCabinDetails t on t.CabinTypeID = ct.ID
			where  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.id = csc.IPDPatientId
			and t.ReportType ='''+@ReportType+'''
		)
		'
		--EXEC (@Query)
		PRINT @Query;

		SET @Query =' Update #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue set ['+@ReportType+']= isnull(['+@ReportType+'],0) + 
		isnull((
			SELECT  isnull(sum(TotalAmount),0)
			FROM Hospital.CabinStayingCharges csc
			JOIN Hospital.Cabins c on c.id = csc.cabinid
			JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.Id = c.cabintypeid
			join #TempCabinDetails t on t.CabinTypeID = ct.ID
			where  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.id = csc.IPDPatientRecordId
			and t.ReportType ='''+@ReportType+'''
		),0)
		'
		--`EXEC (@Query)
		


        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
            @ReportType;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;


					UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Consultation =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId = fb.Id
									and (fbs.SummaryHeadId =@Consultaion 
											)
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									),0)

							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Consultation =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId = fb.Id
									and (fbs.SummaryHeadId =@Consultaion 
											)
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									),0)

							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							OTCharge =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(r.Amount) 
									FROM 
									Hospital.IPDServiceRecords r
									join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on r.ServiceId = h.Id
									join Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups s on s.Id = h.ServiceSubSubGroupId
									WHERE r.IPDPatientId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
							),0)

							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Medicine =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId = fb.Id
									and fbs.SummaryHeadId =@MediaIdBill
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
							),0)



							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Food =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId = fb.Id
									and (fbs.SummaryHeadId =@FBCHARGE 
											or fbs.SummaryHeadId =@FBCHARGERoomService)
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									
							),0)


							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							TotalBill =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit+fbl.Credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  
									#TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									AND fbl.TransactionType =0
							),0)

							UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Due =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit)-SUM(credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
   						  ),0)

						   UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Due = Due -
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.AdvancePayments ap								
									WHERE ap.IPDPatientId =  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									
   						  ),0)

						  UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Discount =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit+fbl.Credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									AND fbl.TransactionType =1
   						  ),0)

						  UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Received =
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(debit+fbl.Credit) FROM 
									Hospital.FinalBills fb
									JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId = fb.Id									
									WHERE fb.IPDPatientRecordId =  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									AND fbl.TransactionType =2
   						  ),0)

						  UPDATE #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue SET
							Received = Received + 
							ISNULL((
									SELECT sum(Amount) FROM 
									Hospital.AdvancePayments ap								
									WHERE ap.IPDPatientId =  #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue.ID
									
   						  ),0)

								select(
							select * from(

					SELECT id,InvoiceNo,FullName PatientName,AdmissionDateTime AdmissionDate,
					DischargedDateTime DischargedDate,
					 Admissionfee,  CabinWardBill,
					 ICUBill,  HDUBill, 	 CCUBill,	 NICUBill,
					 BedSideService, Consultation,  PAC,
					 OTMedicine,  OTCharge,
					 SurgeonFee,  Anaesthesia,  Assistant,
					 POW,  Investigation,  DayCareService,
					 Medicine,	 Food,	 ServiceCharge,
					 TotalBill, 	Discount,	Received, 	Due,
					 DischargeBy

							FROM #TempSpGetHospitalDepartmentWiseRevenue
							

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data

							return 

							
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDiscountStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDiscountStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

	--select(
	--select * from(


	select 
	*,IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra [TotalExtraAmount],
	case when TotalDiscount <(IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then TotalDiscount else  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) end [TotalExtraDiscount],
	case when TotalDiscount > (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then  TotalDiscount -  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) else 0 end [TotalRegularDiscount],
	case when TotalDiscount < (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra)- TotalDiscount else 0 end [PoorFundAmount]
	
	from 
	(
	Select 
	AdmissionNo,
	PatientName,
	[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) BedNo,
	convert(date,Admdate) Admdate,
	convert(date,DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
	sum(isnull((TotalAmount),0.00)) TotalAmount,
	sum(isnull((TotalDiscount),0.00)) TotalDiscount,

	isnull((

	select sum(isr.Amount ) Amount
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.IPDServiceRecords isr on isr.IPDPatientId=p.Id
	where isr.IsExtraService=1 and p.InvoiceNo=t.AdmissionNo

	),0.00) IPDExtra,

	isnull((
	select sum(Amount)
	from 
			(
					select d.ExtraAmount * isr.Qty Amount 
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
					join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices isr on isr.IPDPatientId=p.Id
					join Marketing.Doctors d on d.Id=isr.ConsultantId
					where 
					--isr.IsExtraService=1 and 
					p.InvoiceNo=t.AdmissionNo
			)TTT
			
			--group by d.ExtraAmount,p.InvoiceNo,d.id
	),0.00) ConsExtra,
	

	isnull((
				select sum(Amount)
				FROM
				(
						select isd.Rate * isd.Qty Amount 
						from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
						join Hospital.OTSchedules isr on isr.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
						join Hospital.OTServiceDetails isd on isd.OTServiceId=isr.Id
						where isd.IsExtraService=1 and p.InvoiceNo=t.AdmissionNo
				)TTTT
				--group by isd.Rate
	),0.00) OTExtra
	--,
	--sum(IPDExtra) + sum(ConsExtra)+sum(OTExtra) TotalExtraAmount



	from
	(
	select 
	i.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo,i.fullname PatientName, '' BedNo, i.AdmissionDateTime Admdate, i.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
	case when fl.TransactionType=0 then (Debit) else 0 end [TotalAmount],
	case when fl.TransactionType=1 then (Credit) else 0 end [TotalDiscount]
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
	join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords al on al.PatientId=i.Id
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=al.CabinId
	join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
	join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=i.DischargeByUserId

	where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
			convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
				(u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--group by i.InvoiceNo,i.FullName,c.CabinNo,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime,fl.TransactionType,
	--fl.Debit
	)T
	Group by T.AdmissionNo,T.PatientName,T.BedNo,T.Admdate,T.DischargeDate
	)TT

	--) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data
END
GO

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDiscountStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (

	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

	select(
	select * from(


	select 
	*,IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra [TotalExtraAmount],
	case when TotalDiscount <(IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then TotalDiscount else  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) end [TotalExtraDiscount],
	case when TotalDiscount > (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then  TotalDiscount -  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) else 0 end [TotalRegularDiscount],
	case when TotalDiscount < (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra) then  (IPDExtra +  ConsExtra + OTExtra)- TotalDiscount else 0 end [PoorFundAmount]
	
	from 
	(
	Select 
	AdmissionNo,
	PatientName,
	[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) BedNo,
	convert(date,Admdate) Admdate,
	convert(date,DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
	sum(isnull((TotalAmount),0.00)) TotalAmount,
	(isnull((TotalDiscount),0.00)) TotalDiscount,

	isnull((

	select sum(isr.Amount ) Amount
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.IPDServiceRecords isr on isr.IPDPatientId=p.Id
	where isr.IsExtraService=1 and p.InvoiceNo=t.AdmissionNo

	),0.00) IPDExtra,

	isnull((
	select sum(Amount)
	from 
			(
					select d.ExtraAmount * isr.Qty Amount 
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
					join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices isr on isr.IPDPatientId=p.Id

					where 
					--isr.IsExtraService=1 and 
					p.InvoiceNo=t.AdmissionNo
			)TTT
			
			--group by d.ExtraAmount,p.InvoiceNo,d.id
	),0.00) ConsExtra,
	

	isnull((
				select sum(Amount)
				FROM
				(
						select isd.Rate * isd.Qty Amount 
						from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
						join Hospital.OTSchedules isr on isr.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
						join Hospital.OTServiceDetails isd on isd.OTServiceId=isr.Id
						where isd.IsExtraService=1 and p.InvoiceNo=t.AdmissionNo
				)TTTT
				--group by isd.Rate
	),0.00) OTExtra
	--,
	--sum(IPDExtra) + sum(ConsExtra)+sum(OTExtra) TotalExtraAmount



	from
	(
	select 
	i.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo,i.fullname PatientName, '' BedNo, i.AdmissionDateTime Admdate, i.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
	case when fl.TransactionType=0 then (Debit) else 0 end [TotalAmount],
	case when fl.TransactionType=1 then (Credit) else 0 end [TotalDiscount]
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
	join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords al on al.PatientId=i.Id
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=al.CabinId
	join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
	join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=i.DischargeByUserId

	where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
			convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
				(u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--group by i.InvoiceNo,i.FullName,c.CabinNo,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime,fl.TransactionType,
	--fl.Debit
	)T
	where t.TotalDiscount<>0
	Group by T.AdmissionNo,T.PatientName,T.BedNo,T.Admdate,T.DischargeDate,TotalDiscount
	
	)TT

	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDueStatement]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDueStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalDueStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID uniqueidentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

	--select(
	select * from (


		select 
					AdmissionNo,
					PatientName,
					[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) BedNo,
					MobileNO,
					convert(date,Admdate) Admdate,
					convert(date,DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
					(
					
						select isnull( sum(AmountValue),0) from 
						(
							select 
							case when fl.TransactionType=0 then sum(Debit) else 0 end AmountValue
							from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
							join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
							join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
							where i.InvoiceNo=T.AdmissionNo
							group By fl.TransactionType
						)TSum 
					)
					[TotalAmount]
					,
					sum([TotalDiscount])[TotalDiscount],
						(
							select isnull( sum(AmountValue),0) from 
							(
								select 
								case when fl.TransactionType=2 then sum(Credit) else 0 end AmountValue
								from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
								join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
								join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
								where i.InvoiceNo=T.AdmissionNo
								group By fl.TransactionType

							
							)TSum
						)
							[TotalPaid],

					isnull((
					select sum(fl.Debit) - sum(Credit) 
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
					join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
					join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
					where i.InvoiceNo=T.AdmissionNo

					),0) DueAmount,
					DischargeBy,
					'' Remarks


		from
		(

								select 
								i.InvoiceNo AdmissionNo,i.fullname PatientName, '' BedNo, r.MobileNo MobileNO, i.AdmissionDateTime Admdate, 
								i.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
								--case when fl.TransactionType=0 then (Debit) else 0 end [TotalAmount],
								case when fl.TransactionType=1 then (Credit) else 0 end [TotalDiscount],
								--case when fl.TransactionType=2 then (Credit) else 0 end [TotalPaid],
								u.UserName DischargeBy
								--Sum(fl.Debit) - Sum(fl.Credit) [DueAmount]

								from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
								join Hospital.RegRecords r on r.UHID=i.UHID
								join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords al on al.PatientId=i.Id
								join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=al.CabinId
								join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
								join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
								join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=i.DischargeByUserId

								where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
										convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate and 
											(u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
								--group by i.InvoiceNo,i.FullName,r.MobileNo,i.AdmissionDateTime,i.DischargedDateTime, fl.TransactionType
					)T

					

					group by T.AdmissionNo,T.PatientName,T.MobileNO,T.Admdate,T.DischargeDate,T.DischargeBy
		

	) tbl  
	where tbl.DueAmount >0
	--FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalInconeByDates]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


---------EXEC [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalInconeByDates] '2024-03-01','2024-06-30'
CREATE    Procedure [Hospital].[SpGetHospitalInconeByDates]
	
	@DateFrom as datetime,
	@DateTo as datetime
as begin 

	SELECT
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Final.Particulars) AS SerialNo
   ,Final.Particulars
	, CASE
	WHEN Final.Department = 'IPD' THEN Final.TotalService
	ELSE 0
	END AS Indoor
	, CASE
	WHEN Final.Department = 'OPD' THEN Final.TotalService
	ELSE 0
	END AS Outdoor
   --,Final.Department
   ,Final.TotalService
FROM (SELECT
		tbl1.SummaryHeadName AS Particulars
	   ,'IPD' AS Department
	   ,SUM(tbl1.Amount) TotalService
	FROM (SELECT
			CASE
				WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId = 80 THEN 'Bed and Cabins'
				WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId = 1002 THEN 'Nursing Care'
				ELSE fbs.SummaryHeadName
			END AS SummaryHeadName
		   ,fbs.SummaryHeadId
		   ,fbs.Amount
		FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
		JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb
			ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId = ir.id
		JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs
			ON fbs.FinalBillId = fb.id
		WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ir.DischargedDateTime) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date)
		AND fbs.SummaryHeadId IN (100, 80, 1002)) tbl1
	GROUP BY tbl1.SummaryHeadName

	UNION ALL

	SELECT
		sssg.Name AS Particulars
	   ,'IPD' AS Department
	   ,SUM(ir1.Amount) AS TotalService
	FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
	JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1
		ON ir1.IPDPatientId = ir.id
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh
		ON seh.id = ir1.ServiceId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg
		ON sssg.id = seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ir.DischargedDateTime) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date)AND sssg.Id NOT IN (89)
	GROUP BY sssg.Name

	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		sssg.Name AS Particulars
	   ,'OPD' AS Department
	   ,SUM(sd.TotalAmount) AS TotalService
	FROM OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices pro
	JOIN OPD.ServiceDetails sd
		ON sd.PatientId = pro.Id
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh
		ON seh.id = sd.ServiceId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg
		ON sssg.id = seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE, pro.EntryDate) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date) AND sssg.Id NOT IN (89)
	GROUP BY sssg.Name
	-----------Pharmacy----------
	UNION ALL

		SELECT 'Pharmacy'  AS Particulars, 'OPD' AS Department, ROUND(SUM(i.TotalAmount),0) AS TotalService
	FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.Invdate) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date) AND [IPDPatientRecordId]='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	AND i.ServeTypeId IN (8,15)

	UNION ALL

		SELECT 'Pharmacy'  AS Particulars, 'IPD' AS Department, ROUND(SUM(i.TotalAmount),0) AS TotalService
	FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.Invdate) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date) AND [IPDPatientRecordId]<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		AND i.ServeTypeId IN (7,14)
	UNION ALL
	--------Canteen--------------
		SELECT 'Canteen'  AS Particulars, 'OPD' AS Department,ROUND(SUM(si.GrandTK),0) AS TotalService
	FROM Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date) AND  [IPDPatientRecordId]='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	
		UNION ALL
	
	SELECT 'Canteen'  AS Particulars, 'IPD' AS Department,ROUND(SUM(si.GrandTK),0)AS TotalService
	FROM Canteen.SaleInvoices si
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,si.Invdate) BETWEEN cast(@DateFrom as date) AND cast(@DateTo as date) AND  [IPDPatientRecordId]<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	
	) Final
	
ORDER BY Final.Particulars, Final.Department

end
GO

create procedure [Hospital].[spGetInvestigationIndentDetails]
	@indentId uniqueidentifier
as 
begin
	select 
	d.*,
	isnull(ti.Name, d.ManualTestName) TestName,
	isnull(ti.Rate, 0) TestRate
	from  Diag.IPDInvestigationIndentDetails d

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






----exec [Hospital].[SpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID] '24020111627','285F9D70-2343-4CDC-F7C2-08DADFE7EDC4'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID]
		@UHID NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@TestId uniqueidentifier,
		@ParameterType int=0
AS
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON



	DECLARE @columnsList nvarchar(max) =' '
		DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max) =' '
	
	


	DECLARE @IPDPatientID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	DECLARE @PNname Nvarchar(max) 
	DECLARE @TID UniqueIdentifier 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
		Create table #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
		(
			AutoID int identity(1,1),
			PNname Nvarchar(max),
			tID uniqueidentifier
		)

		insert into #TempIPDInvestigationProfile (PNname,tID)
		select isnull(p.ShortName,p.Name) [Pname],t.Id
		from Diag.PathologyReportDetails d
		 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
		 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
		 join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.TestItemId = t.Id
		 join Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii on ii.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId
		 and ii.UHID = @UHID
		 where (t.id=@TestId or @TestId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
		  
		  group by p.Name,t.Name, p.DisplayOrder,p.ShortName,t.Id
		  order by p.DisplayOrder
		    


		select *  into #TempIPDInvestigationProfileSummery  from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
		 

		 delete from #TempIPDInvestigationProfileSummery where AutoID not in 
		 (
			select max(AutoID) from #TempIPDInvestigationProfileSummery t
			group by t.PNname
		 )

		 DECLARE @TopTextInfo UniqueIdentifier

		 select Top 1 @TopTextInfo = tID from 
								(
									select tID,count(*) TotalCount 
									from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t
									group by tID
								) T
								order by T.TotalCount desc



		
		

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempSpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID
		CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID ( ReportDate nvarchar(max),TName nvarchar(max))

		
		 

		
		DECLARE @TID1stOrder uniqueidentifier

								select @TID1stOrder = tID from 
								(
									select tID,count(*) TotalCount 
									from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t
									group by tID
								) T
								--where t.tID <>'285F9D70-2343-4CDC-F7C2-08DADFE7EDC4'
								order by T.TotalCount,T.tID desc





				DECLARE @PNameFor1stTest VARCHAR(MAX)
				DECLARE @MaxPNameCount int =0

				DECLARE cursor_PNameFor1stTest CURSOR
				FOR
						

						select t.PNname from #TempIPDInvestigationProfileSummery t
						where t.tID = @TID1stOrder
						order by t.AutoID

					

				OPEN cursor_PNameFor1stTest;

				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_PNameFor1stTest INTO 
					@PNameFor1stTest;

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						set @MaxPNameCount = @MaxPNameCount +1
						exec ('
								ALTER TABLE #TempSpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID 
								add ['+@PNameFor1stTest +'] nvarchar(max)
							 ')

						FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_PNameFor1stTest INTO 
							@PNameFor1stTest;
					END;

				CLOSE cursor_PNameFor1stTest;

				DEALLOCATE cursor_PNameFor1stTest;

				 
				  
				   


					DECLARE @TotalDistinctTestCount int =0
					DECLARE @CurrentPNameCount int =0

					DECLARE cursor_PNname CURSOR
					FOR 
			    

								select tID from 
								(
									select tID,count(*) TotalCount 
									from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t
									group by tID
								) T
								--where t.tID <>'285F9D70-2343-4CDC-F7C2-08DADFE7EDC4'
								order by T.TotalCount desc
								--order by AutoID

					OPEN cursor_PNname;

					FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_PNname INTO 
						@TID;

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
								set @TotalDistinctTestCount = @TotalDistinctTestCount +1
								 DECLARE 
									@columns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', 
									@sql     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
									@InsertyExecRowQuary NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';


								 select @columns+=QUOTENAME(PNname) + ','
								 from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t
								 where t.tID = @TID
								 group by PNname
								  ;


								 SET @columns = LEFT(@columns, LEN(@columns) - 1);

								
								 SET @sql ='
										--select(
										--	select * from(



										insert into #TempSpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID
	
										select ReportDate,
										TName,'+@columns+' --,Unit 
										'
										IF @TotalDistinctTestCount <> 1
										BEGIN
												set @CurrentPNameCount  =1
												select @CurrentPNameCount = count(distinct t.PNname)  from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t where t.tID =@TID
												while @MaxPNameCount>@CurrentPNameCount
												BEGIN
														set @sql = @sql + ' ,'''' '
														set @CurrentPNameCount = @CurrentPNameCount +1
												END
										END

										set @sql = @sql + '
										
										from 
										(
										SELECT * FROM   
										(
											 select 
 
												CONVERT(DATETIME,r.ReportDate) ReportDate,
												t.Name TName ,isnull(p.ShortName,p.Name) PName,convert(varchar(50),d.Testresult)+convert(varchar(50),isnull(p.unit,'''')) OutputValue--,i.id ,p.Unit,i.id
												from Diag.PathologyReportDetails d
											 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
											 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
											 left join Diag.PathologyReports r on r.id = d.PathologyReportId
											 join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.TestItemId = t.Id
											 join Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii on ii.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId
											 and r.PatientId = ii.id
											 and ii.UHID = '''+convert(varchar(MAX),@UHID)+''' 
											 where 
													(t.Id='''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+''' or '''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+'''=''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'')
													and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
													and t.id ='''+ convert(nvarchar(max), @TID) +'''
													group by CONVERT(DATETIME, r.ReportDate),
													t.Name  ,p.Name ,d.Testresult,p.unit,p.shortname,ii.id --,p.Unit,i.id
										) t 
										PIVOT(
											max(OutputValue)
											FOR PName IN ('+ @columns +')
										) AS pivot_table

										)T



										--) tbl  
										--order by ReportDate,TName
										--FOR JSON AUTO
										--	) as Data
										';



										IF @TotalDistinctTestCount <> 1
										BEGIN
												
												set @CurrentPNameCount  =1

												select @CurrentPNameCount = count(distinct t.PNname)  from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile t where t.tID =@TID

												set @InsertyExecRowQuary ='insert into #TempSpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID values(''ReportDate'',''TName'''
												
												set @InsertyExecRowQuary = @InsertyExecRowQuary + @columns
												set @InsertyExecRowQuary = REPLACE (@InsertyExecRowQuary,'[',',''')
												set @InsertyExecRowQuary = REPLACE (@InsertyExecRowQuary,'],','''')
												set @InsertyExecRowQuary = REPLACE (@InsertyExecRowQuary,']','''')
												

												while @MaxPNameCount>@CurrentPNameCount
												BEGIN
														set @InsertyExecRowQuary = @InsertyExecRowQuary + ' ,'''' '
														set @CurrentPNameCount = @CurrentPNameCount +1
												END
												set @InsertyExecRowQuary = @InsertyExecRowQuary +')'
												print @InsertyExecRowQuary
												print @columns
												exec (@InsertyExecRowQuary)
										END
										
										exec (@sql)

										--PRINT @sql

										print '##########################'



									FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_PNname INTO 
								@TID;
						END;

					CLOSE cursor_PNname;

					DEALLOCATE cursor_PNname;

					select(
					select * from #TempSpGetInvestigationProfileByUHID 
					for json auto) as Data
					
					return 



		 --DECLARE 
			--@columns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '', 
			--@sql     NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';


		 select @columns+=QUOTENAME( PNname) + ','
		 from #TempIPDInvestigationProfile
		 group by PNname,AutoID
		 order by AutoID ;

		 SET @columns = LEFT(@columns, LEN(@columns) - 1);

		


		

		SET @sql ='
				--select(
				--	select * from(
	
				select ReportDate,
				TName,'+@columns+' --,Unit 
				from 
				(
				SELECT * FROM   
				(
					 select 
 
						CONVERT(DATE,r.ReportDate) ReportDate,
						t.Name TName ,isnull(p.ShortName,p.Name) PName,convert(varchar(50),d.Testresult)+convert(varchar(50),isnull(p.unit,'''')) OutputValue--,i.id ,p.Unit,i.id

					  		 from Diag.PathologyReportDetails d
											 join Diag.ReportParameters p on p.Id = d.ReportParameterId
											 join Diag.TestItems t on t.Id = p.TestItemId
											 left join Diag.PathologyReports r on r.id = d.PathologyReportId
											 join Diag.InvestigationInvoiceDetails id on id.TestItemId = t.Id
											 join Diag.InvestigationInvoices ii on ii.Id = id.InvestigationInvoiceId
					 and ii.UHID = '''+convert(varchar(MAX),@UHID)+''' 
					 where 
					        (t.Id='''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+''' or '''+convert(varchar(50),@TestId)+'''=''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'')
							and isnull(p.isGroupTitle,0) <> 1
							group by CONVERT(DATE, r.ReportDate),
							t.Name  ,p.Name ,d.Testresult,p.unit,p.shortname --,p.Unit,i.id
				) t 
				PIVOT(
					max(OutputValue)
					FOR PName IN ('+ @columns +')
				) AS pivot_table

				)T



				--) tbl  
				--order by ReportDate,TName
				--FOR JSON AUTO
				--	) as Data
				';


				exec (@sql)

				PRINT @sql

				RETURN 



	

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SpGetIPDConsultancyDetail]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDConsultancyDetail]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,  
	@ServiceDate DateTime,
	@GetType int,   -- '0' or '1'  0-> by datetime, 1->all of the consultancy
	@UnIncludeExtra int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
if(@GetType=0)
BEGIN
	select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId,cs.ServiceId,cs.ConsultantId,cs.DeliverySectionId,seh.HeadName as ServiceName, d.Name as DoctorName,cs.ServiceDate,cs.EntryDate, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.ScheduleType, cs.CabinNo, cs.CabinType,cs.IsExtraService,d.ExtraAmount,cs.IsDeleted,cs.Remarks,cs.UserId,u.UserName,cs.IsPostedToAccount
	from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cs left join 
		 [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on cs.ConsultantId=d.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId 
	and cast(cs.EntryDate as date) =(select top(1) cast (cc.EntryDate as date) from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cc order by cc.EntryDate desc)  
	--and (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or cs.IsExtraService=0) 
	and cs.IsDeleted=0
	order by cs.EntryDate

	


END 
ELSE
BEGIN
	select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId,cs.ServiceId,cs.ConsultantId,cs.DeliverySectionId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName, d.Name as DoctorName,cs.ServiceDate,cs.EntryDate, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.ScheduleType, cs.CabinNo, cs.CabinType,cs.IsExtraService,d.ExtraAmount,cs.IsDeleted,cs.Remarks,cs.UserId,u.UserName,cs.IsPostedToAccount
	from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cs left join 
		 [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on cs.ConsultantId=d.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId --and (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or cs.IsExtraService=0) 
	and cs.IsDeleted=0
	order by cs.EntryDate
END
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDConsultancyDetailTemp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,  
	@ServiceDate DateTime,
	@GetType int,   -- '0' or '1'  0-> by datetime, 1->all of the consultancy
	@UnIncludeExtra int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
if(@GetType=0)
BEGIN
	select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId,cs.ServiceId,cs.ConsultantId,cs.DeliverySectionId,seh.HeadName as ServiceName, d.Name as DoctorName,cs.ServiceDate,cs.EntryDate, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.ScheduleType, cs.CabinNo, cs.CabinType,cs.IsExtraService,d.ExtraAmount,cs.IsDeleted,cs.Remarks
	from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cs inner join 
		 [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on cs.ConsultantId=d.Id inner join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and cs.EntryDate=(select top(1)cc.EntryDate from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cc order by cc.EntryDate desc) and (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or cs.IsExtraService=0) and cs.IsDeleted=0
	
	UNION ALL

		select cs.Id, o.IPDPatientId,cs.ServiceHeadId ServiceId,o.ChiefSurgeonId ConsultantId,
	'' DeliverySectionId,seh.HeadName as ServiceName, 
d.Name as DoctorName,o.ServiceEntryDate ServiceDate,o.CreatedOn EntryDate, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, 
'' ScheduleType, '' CabinNo, '' CabinType,cs.IsExtraService,0 ExtraAmount,cs.IsDeleted,cs.Remarks
	from Hospital.OTServices o
join Hospital.OTServiceDetails cs on cs.OTServiceId=o.id
 join [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceHeadId=seh.Id
 join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on o.ChiefSurgeonId=d.Id
 where  (0=0 or cs.IsExtraService=0) and cs.IsDeleted=0
 and o.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and o.ServiceEntryDate =(select top(1)cc.ServiceEntryDate from [Hospital].[OTServices] cc order by cc.ServiceEntryDate desc)

	order by EntryDate

	


END 
ELSE
BEGIN
	select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId,cs.ServiceId,cs.ConsultantId,cs.DeliverySectionId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName, d.Name as DoctorName,cs.ServiceDate,cs.EntryDate, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.ScheduleType, cs.CabinNo, cs.CabinType,cs.IsExtraService,d.ExtraAmount,cs.IsDeleted,cs.Remarks
	from [Hospital].[IPDConsultantServices] cs inner join 
		 [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on cs.ConsultantId=d.Id inner join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or cs.IsExtraService=0) and cs.IsDeleted=0
	order by cs.EntryDate
END
END

-- =============================================

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetIPDIndentForwardAndPatientAccessesByUserId] '8a9fffa0-a8da-472e-8209-f5e266322700'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDIndentForwardAndPatientAccessesByUserId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UserId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tbl
	SELECT * INTO #Tbl FROM  [Hospital].[IPDIndentForwardAndPatientAccesses] CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](DeptIds, ',');

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp

	SELECT 
	  ifpa.Id, 
	  ifpa.UserId, 
	  ifpa.FloorId, 
	  ifpa.DeptIds, 
	  ifpa.item, 
	  ifpa.CanteenOutletId, 
	  ifpa.IndentForwardToOutlet, 
	  ifpa.IsPatientVisibleByFloor, 
	  ifpa.TenantId, 
	  u.UserName, 
	  ISNULL(u.FullName, '') as FullName, 
	  ISNULL(f.Name, '') as FloorName, 
	  ISNULL(mo.Name, '') as MedicineOutletName, 
	  ISNULL(mo.Name, '') as CanteenOutletName, 
	  ISNULL(d.Name, '') DepartmentName, 
	  isnull(tt.Name, '') TenantName into #Tmp
	FROM 
	  #Tbl ifpa INNER JOIN
	  [Identity].[Users] u ON ifpa.UserId = u.Id 
	  INNER JOIN [Pharmacy].[MedicineOutlets] mo ON ifpa.IndentForwardToOutlet = mo.Id 
	  INNER JOIN [Hospital].[HDepartments] d ON ifpa.item = d.Id 
	  inner join [Admin].[Tenants] tt on tt.Id = ifpa.TenantId 
	  LEFT JOIN [Hospital].[Floors] f ON ifpa.FloorId = f.Id 
	  LEFT JOIN Canteen.CanteenOutlets co ON ifpa.CanteenOutletId = co.Id 
	WHERE 
	  @UserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
	  OR ifpa.UserId = @UserId 
	SELECT 
	  a.Id, 
	  a.UserId, 
	  a.FloorId, 
	  a.DeptIds, 
	  a.IndentForwardToOutlet, 
	  a.IsPatientVisibleByFloor, 
	  a.UserName, 
	  a.FullName, 
	  a.FloorName, 
	  a.MedicineOutletName, 
	  STRING_AGG(a.DepartmentName, ',') as DepartmentNames, 
	  a.TenantId, 
	  a.TenantName 
	FROM 
	  #Tmp a
	GROUP BY 
	  a.Id, 
	  a.UserId, 
	  a.FloorId, 
	  a.DeptIds, 
	  a.IndentForwardToOutlet, 
	  a.IsPatientVisibleByFloor, 
	  a.UserName, 
	  a.FullName, 
	  a.MedicineOutletName, 
	  a.FloorName, 
	  a.TenantId, 
	  a.TenantName

END

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetIPDInvoicePatientDetails]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	 with patients as (select 
			p.Id,
			p.InvoiceNo,
			p.FullName,
			p.IsNotified, 
			p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
			p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
			p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
			p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
			rr.MobileNo,
			c.CabinNo
		from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
		join Hospital.RegRecords rr on p.UHID = rr.UHID
		JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		where p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1)
	 ),

	 bills as (
		 select 
			t.Id PatientId,
			sum(TotalSale) TotalAmount, 
			abs(Sum(TotalReturn)) TotalReturn,
			0 PaidAmount, 
			0 TotalDiscount
		from (select 
				 p.Id,
				 Case When inv.ServeTypeId = 7 Then ROUND(isnull(SUM(d.TotalAmount),0),2) Else 0 End TotalSale,
				 Case When inv.ServeTypeId = 14 Then ROUND(isnull(SUM(d.TotalAmount),0),2) Else 0 End TotalReturn,
				 0 PaidAmount, 
				 0 TotalDiscount
			 from Pharmacy.Invoices inv
				 join patients p on p.Id = inv.IPDPatientRecordId
				 join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = inv.Id 
			 group by p.Id, p.InvoiceNo, p.CabinNo, p.FullName, p.MobileNo, inv.ServeTypeId) t
		group by t.Id
	 )

	 select p.*, b.* from patients p join bills b on b.PatientId = p.Id

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDNonMedicationOrderDetailsByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier 
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	SELECT ISNULL(inmo.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') Id,ISNULL(inmo.IPDPatientRecordId,@PatientId) IPDPatientId,nmo.Id OrderId,nmo.[Order],isnull(inmo.Dose,'') Dose,isnull(inmo.Instruction,'') Instruction
	FROM [Hospital].[NonMedicationOrders] nmo LEFT JOIN
		 (
			SELECT a.Id,a.IPDPatientRecordId,a.NonMedicationOrderId,a.Dose,a.Instruction
			  FROM [Hospital].[IPDNonMedicationOrders] a
			 WHERE a.IPDPatientRecordId = @PatientId
		 ) inmo ON nmo.Id=inmo.NonMedicationOrderId LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd ON inmo.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



-- Exec [Hospital].[SpGetIPDPatientInfoByPatientId] 'F398F510-AF7D-4698-EDEF-08DD3138EDAA'

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDPatientInfoByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select 
  tbl.*, 
  ap.PackageId 
from 
  (
		SELECT 
		  p.Id, 
		  p.InvoicePrefix, 
		  p.InvoiceNo, 
		  p.AdditionalDoctorIds, 
		  p.UHID, 
		  ISNULL(rr.Title, '')+ ' ' + p.FullName AS FullName, 
		  rr.PatientAddress AS Address, 
		  rr.MobileNo, 
		  rr.Cpmobile, 
		  CASE WHEN p.AgeYear <> '' THEN p.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth <> '' THEN p.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN p.AgeDay <> '' THEN p.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, 
		  rr.Sex, 
		  rr.MembershipType, 
		  rr.MaritalStatus, 
		  rr.Profession, 
		  isnull(rr.NationalId, rr.IDNo) NationalId,
		  p.AdmissionDateTime, 
		  p.DischargedDateTime, 
		  p.AssignedDoctorId, 
		  p.ChiefConsultantId, 
		  p.RefdDoctorId, 
		  d.Name AS AssignedDoctorName, 
		  isnull(cc.Name, '') ChiefConsultantName, 
		  d2.Name AS RefDoctorName, 
		  p.Status, 
		  rr.FatherName, 
		  rr.MotherName, 
		  rr.PatientAddress, 
		  rr.Cpname, 
		  rr.Cpaddress, 
		  p.AgeYear, 
		  p.AgeMonth, 
		  p.AgeDay, 
		  p.AdmissionFee, 
		  rr.CareOf, 
		  rr.RelationWithPatient, 
		  rr.BloodGroup, 
		  rr.CpnationalId, 
		  rr.SpouseName, 
		  ca.Id AS AllotId, 
		  ca.CabinId, 
		  ca.AllotType, 
		  c.FloorId, 
		  ca.Status AS CabinStatus, 
		  cast(
			case when p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then Hospital.GetCabinNumber(p.Id) else dbo.GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge(p.InvoiceNo) end as nvarchar
		  ) as CabinNo, 
		  ct.CabinType, 
		  dept.Name AS DeptName, 
		  c.HDepartmentId, 
		  p.BillingMode, 
		  p.ProbableDischargeDateTime, 
		  rr.Title, 
		  p.IsPharmacyClaimCleared, 
		  p.AdmissionByUserId, 
		  c.CabinTypeId, 
		  u.UserName, 
		  p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
		  p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
		  p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
		  p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
		  p.IsCCHold, 
		  p.IsNotified, 
		  ma.Name AS MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName, 
		  ma.Code Code, 
		  rr.Religion, 
		  p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId, 
		  p.IsManualCabinDayCount, 
		  du.UserName Dischargeby, 
		  p.Remarks 
		FROM 
		  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords AS p 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON p.UHID = rr.UHID 
		  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d ON p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id 
		  INNER JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS d2 ON p.RefdDoctorId = d2.Id 
		  LEFT JOIN dbo.VWDoctors AS cc ON p.ChiefConsultantId = cc.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.HDepartments AS dept ON c.HDepartmentId = dept.Id 
		  INNER JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes AS ct ON c.CabinTypeId = ct.Id 
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users AS u ON p.AdmissionByUserId = u.Id 
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN [Identity].Users du on p.DischargeByUserId = du.Id 
		  left outer join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias AS ma ON ma.Id = p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId 
		WHERE 
		  (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1) 
		  and p.Id = @PatientId
	  ) tbl 
	  left join [Hospital].[AdmittedPackages] ap on tbl.Id = ap.IPDPatientRecordId 
	where 
	  (
		ap.IsOccupiedByPatient is null 
		or ap.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1
	  )

END

GO

-- exec [Hospital].SpGetIPDServiceRecordBilllingGridWithPatientId '0400157a-3f21-41d5-dd04-08dcdc730712', 0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDServiceRecordBilllingGridWithPatientId] 

	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@UnIncludeExtra int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
BEGIN
	DECLARE @emptyId VARCHAR(100) = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	Declare @OTSubSupGroupId uniqueidentifier = (select id from Hospital.ServiceSubGroups where [Name] = 'OT CHARGE ') 
	Declare @investigationBillId uniqueidentifier = (select id from Hospital.ServiceSubGroups where [Name] = 'Investigation Bill (Test)') 

   SELECT CAST(ct.ServiceHeadId AS uniqueidentifier) HeadId,ct.IPDServicesBillingHeadName ItemName, SUM(sr.Amount) ItemPrice,SUM(sr.Discount) Discount, SUM(sr.ServiceCharge) ServiceCharge
          ,convert(uniqueidentifier, @emptyId) FinalBillId, convert(uniqueidentifier, @emptyId) Id,(SUM(sr.Amount - sr.Discount)) GrandTotal, (SUM(sr.Amount - sr.Discount)) Due
	FROM [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr INNER JOIN
		 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd ON sr.IPDPatientId=pd.Id INNER JOIN
		 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct ON sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id INNER JOIN 
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh ON sr.ServiceId = seh.Id inner join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id 
	WHERE ct.ServiceHeadId != @emptyId AND pd.Id=@IPDPatientId AND seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId != @OTSubSupGroupId AND (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or sr.IsExtraService=0) and sr.IsDeleted=0 and ssg.ServiceSubGroupId!=@investigationBillId --ignore investigation bill service subgroup.
	GROUP BY ct.ServiceHeadId, ct.IPDServicesBillingHeadName

	UNION ALL

	SELECT ssg.ServiceSubGroupId HeadId,sg.Name ItemName, SUM(sr.Amount) ItemPrice,SUM(sr.Discount) Discount, SUM(sr.ServiceCharge) ServiceCharge
          ,convert(uniqueidentifier, @emptyId) FinalBillId, convert(uniqueidentifier, @emptyId) Id,(SUM(sr.Amount - sr.Discount)) GrandTotal, (SUM(sr.Amount - sr.Discount)) Due
	FROM [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] sr INNER JOIN
		 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd ON sr.IPDPatientId=pd.Id INNER JOIN
		 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct ON sr.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id INNER JOIN 
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh ON sr.ServiceId = seh.Id inner join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] ssg on seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=ssg.Id inner join
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubGroups] sg on sg.Id=ssg.ServiceSubGroupId
	WHERE ssg.ServiceSubGroupId=@investigationBillId AND pd.Id=@IPDPatientId AND (@UnIncludeExtra=0 or sr.IsExtraService=0) and sr.IsDeleted=0
	group by ssg.ServiceSubGroupId,sg.Name
	
END
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetIPDServiceRecordWithPatientId] 
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier,  
	@ServiceDate DateTime,
	@GetType int,   
	@ServiceSubSubGroupId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	 declare @emtyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	 declare @OTSubGoupId uniqueidentifier;

	 set @OTSubGoupId = (select top 1 Id from Hospital.ServiceSubGroups where [Name] = 'OT CHARGE')

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF(@GetType=0)
BEGIN
   select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,cs.ServiceDatetime,cs.CreatedOn, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.Amount, cs.ServiceId,cs.CreatedBy,cs.IsDeleted,cs.DeliverySectionId,cs.IsExtraService,cs.UserId,u.UserName,cs.IsPostedToAccount,cs.StartDateTime,cs.EndDateTime
	from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] cs left join 
		
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId and cs.EntryDateTime=(select top(1)cc.EntryDateTime from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] cc order by cc.EntryDateTime desc) and (seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=@ServiceSubSubGroupId or @ServiceSubSubGroupId = @emtyId) and cs.IsDeleted=0
	order by cs.ServiceDatetime
END
ELSE if(@ServiceSubSubGroupId = @OTSubGoupId)
BEGIN
	select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,cs.ServiceDatetime,cs.CreatedOn, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.Amount, cs.ServiceId,cs.CreatedBy,cs.IsDeleted,cs.DeliverySectionId,cs.IsExtraService,cs.UserId,u.UserName,cs.IsPostedToAccount,cs.StartDateTime,cs.EndDateTime
	from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] cs left join 
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct ON cs.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId 
	and seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId = @OTSubGoupId
	and (ct.ServiceHeadId=@ServiceSubSubGroupId or @ServiceSubSubGroupId=@emtyId) and cs.IsDeleted=0
	order by cs.ServiceDatetime
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	select cs.Id, cs.IPDPatientId, seh.HeadName as ServiceName,cs.ServiceDatetime,cs.CreatedOn, cs.Rate, cs.Qty, cs.Discount, cs.ServiceCharge, cs.Amount, cs.ServiceId,cs.CreatedBy,cs.IsDeleted,cs.DeliverySectionId,cs.IsExtraService,cs.UserId,u.UserName,cs.IsPostedToAccount,cs.StartDateTime,cs.EndDateTime
	from [Hospital].[IPDServiceRecords] cs left join 
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] seh on cs.ServiceId=seh.Id left join
		 [Hospital].[CabinTypes] ct ON cs.DeliverySectionId=ct.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
	where cs.IPDPatientId=@IPDPatientId 
	and (ct.ServiceHeadId=@ServiceSubSubGroupId or @ServiceSubSubGroupId=@emtyId) and cs.IsDeleted=0
	order by cs.ServiceDatetime
END

END

			select(
	select * from(


	SELECT * FROM 
				(
				SELECT ir.InvoiceNo AS BillNo, ir.FullName AS PatientName, CONVERT(DATE,ir.AdmissionDateTime) AS AdmDate, 
				CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DisDate,
				[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](ir.InvoiceNo) AS BedNo,
				v.Name AS AssignDoc, v1.Name AS ServiceDoc, seh.HeadName AS ServiceName,
				SUM(ir1.Qty) AS Qty, ir1.Rate AS Rate, SUM(ir1.Qty) * ir1.Rate AS TotalAmount
				FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
				JOIN hospital.IPDConsultantServices ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
				JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
				JOIN VWDoctors v1 ON v1.id=ir1.ConsultantId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir1.ServiceId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceGroups sg ON sg.id=ssg.ServiceGroupId
				JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.id=ir.AdmittedCabinId
				JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.id=c.CabinTypeId

				WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>= @FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
				AND (ir1.ConsultantId= @ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceGroupID=sg.id OR @ServiceGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceSubGroupID=ssg.id OR @ServiceSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceSubSubGroupID=sssg.id OR @ServiceSubSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceHeadID=seh.id OR @ServiceHeadID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (ir.DeptId=@DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (ct.id=@CabinTypeID OR @CabinTypeID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				GROUP BY ir.invoiceno, ir.FullName,ir.AdmissionDateTime,ir.DischargedDateTime,v.Name,seh.HeadName,ir1.Rate, v1.Name

				UNION all

				SELECT ir.InvoiceNo AS BillNo, ir.FullName AS PatientName, CONVERT(DATE,ir.AdmissionDateTime) AS AdmDate, 
				CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DisDate,
				[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](ir.InvoiceNo) AS BedNo,
				v.Name AS AssignDoc, '' AS ServiceDoc, seh.HeadName AS ServiceName,
				SUM(ir1.Qty) AS Qty, ir1.Rate AS Rate, SUM(ir1.Qty) * ir1.Rate AS TotalAmount
				FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
				JOIN hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
				JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir1.ServiceId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
				JOIN Hospital.ServiceGroups sg ON sg.id=ssg.ServiceGroupId
				JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.id=ir.AdmittedCabinId
				JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.id=c.CabinTypeId

				WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>= @FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
				AND (ir.AssignedDoctorId= @ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceGroupID=sg.id OR @ServiceGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceSubGroupID=ssg.id OR @ServiceSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceSubSubGroupID=sssg.id OR @ServiceSubSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (@ServiceHeadID=seh.id OR @ServiceHeadID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (ir.DeptId=@DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				AND (ct.id=@CabinTypeID OR @CabinTypeID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				GROUP BY ir.invoiceno, ir.FullName,ir.AdmissionDateTime,ir.DischargedDateTime,v.Name,seh.HeadName,ir1.Rate
				)T


					) tbl  
				ORDER BY tbl.BillNo
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data


END
GO

-- Exec [Hospital].[SpGetLatestRxIpdTreatmentLogsByUHID] 241122202

create     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetLatestRxIpdTreatmentLogsByUHID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UHID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @patientid uniqueidentifier;
	select @patientid =  (Select top 1 Id from [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] where UHID=@UHID order by CreatedOn desc )
	--select @patientid
	select ritl.* from [Hospital].RxIpdTreatmentLogs ritl inner join Hospital.RxIpdTreatments rit on ritl.TreatmentId=rit.Id where rit.IPDPatientRecordId=@patientid
  
END

-- Author:		Alamin Kibria

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingAchieveReportDetails]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingAchieveReportDetails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @AdmissionFee uniqueidentifier ='23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0'
DECLARE @MediaIdBill uniqueidentifier ='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'
DECLARE @FBCHARGE uniqueidentifier ='E260CBA5-56D9-460C-AE8F-092BF172E961'
DECLARE @FBCHARGERoomService uniqueidentifier ='44EC6533-C4AA-4378-AD54-0F2CBAF1D66F'
DECLARE @Consultaion uniqueidentifier ='86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D'
--DECLARE @OTCharge uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'

DECLARE @IPDCare uniqueidentifier ='41DE5100-678D-4231-B22A-F76E96282846'
DECLARE @ICUCare uniqueidentifier ='07CBB7DA-5E71-4718-9CAF-E69623449496'
DECLARE @CTUCare uniqueidentifier ='FF9473BC-D411-466C-99A1-3E492371AD53'
DECLARE @HDUCare uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'
DECLARE @OTCharge uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'
DECLARE @NICUCare uniqueidentifier ='104E7387-8FAA-4516-ADA2-229251EC6111'
DECLARE @Medicine uniqueidentifier='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'
DECLARE @INVESTIGATIONBILL uniqueidentifier='F8D6B657-E027-4417-AF73-14B8A1466EB5'
DECLARE @BedandCabins uniqueidentifier='BA1B319E-FEA4-4452-8B22-FC20B44DBE1D'



	DECLARE		
	@MarketingJOfficerId uniqueidentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12;

	select(
	select * from(

		Select 
		AdmissionNO,
		PatientName,
		[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](T.AdmissionNo) BedNo,
		convert(date,AdmissionDate) AdmissionDate,
		convert(date,DischargeDate) DischargeDate,
		sum(isnull([HpBill],0)) [HpBill],
		sum(isnull([InvBill],0)) [InvBill],
		sum(isnull([HpBill],0)) + sum(isnull([InvBill],0)) SubTotal,
		sum(isnull([MedicineBill],0)) [MedicineBill],
		sum(isnull([HpBill],0)) + sum(isnull([InvBill],0))+sum(isnull([MedicineBill],0)) GrandTotal,
		BDAName,
		'' Designation,

		'' Remarks


		from
		(

					select 
						p.InvoiceNo AdmissionNO,
						p.FullName PatientName,
						'' BedNo,
						p.AdmissionDateTime AdmissionDate,
						p.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
						ma.Name BDAName,
						'' Designation ,
						case when fs.SummaryHeadId = @AdmissionFee 
						 or fs.SummaryHeadId =@ICUCare or fs.SummaryHeadId =@IPDCare or fs.SummaryHeadId =@CTUCare
						or fs.SummaryHeadId =@HDUCare or fs.SummaryHeadId =@OTCharge or fs.SummaryHeadId =@NICUCare 
						or fs.SummaryHeadId =  @BedandCabins
						then 
						Amount end [HpBill],

						--case when fs.SummaryHeadId = @INVESTIGATIONBILL  or fs.SummaryHeadId =0 then 
						--Amount end [InvBill],
						
						case when fs.SummaryHeadId = @INVESTIGATIONBILL   then 
						Amount end [InvBill],

						case when fs.SummaryHeadId = @Medicine  or fs.SummaryHeadId =@Medicine then 
						Amount end [MedicineBill]
		
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
					join Hospital.RegRecords r on r.UHID=p.UHID
					join Hospital.FinalBills fb on fb.IPDPatientRecordId=p.Id
					join Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fs on fs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
					 join Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias  MA on Ma.Id=p.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId

						where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate 
						and 
						(MA.Id=@MarketingJOfficerId or @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

			)T
			group by T.AdmissionNO,T.PatientName,T.AdmissionDate,T.DischargeDate,T.BDAName,T.Designation

	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Alamin Kibria
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingDetailsBreakdownReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingDetailsBreakdownReport]'2025-01-01,2025-01-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@MarketingJOfficerId uniqueidentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12;

DECLARE @AdmissionFee uniqueidentifier ='23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0' 
DECLARE @IPDCare uniqueidentifier ='41DE5100-678D-4231-B22A-F76E96282846'
DECLARE @ICUCare uniqueidentifier ='07CBB7DA-5E71-4718-9CAF-E69623449496'
DECLARE @CTUCare uniqueidentifier ='FF9473BC-D411-466C-99A1-3E492371AD53'
DECLARE @HDUCare uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'
DECLARE @OTCharge uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'
DECLARE @NICUCare uniqueidentifier ='104E7387-8FAA-4516-ADA2-229251EC6111'
DECLARE @Medicine uniqueidentifier='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'
DECLARE @INVESTIGATIONBILL uniqueidentifier='F8D6B657-E027-4417-AF73-14B8A1466EB5'
DECLARE @BedandCabins uniqueidentifier='BA1B319E-FEA4-4452-8B22-FC20B44DBE1D' 
DECLARE @Consultaion  uniqueidentifier='86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D' 
DECLARE @OXYGENSubSubGroup  uniqueidentifier ='1C392E0C-4AF0-46B4-A430-98447E39407C'


--DROP TABLE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails
SELECT DISTINCT ir.FullName AS PatientName,ir.InvoiceNo AS REG, CONVERT(DATE,ir.AdmissionDateTime) AS DateOfAdmission,
convert(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DateOfDischarge,
0 TotalBillValue,
0 BedRent,
0 Oxygen,
0 Discount,
0 ConsDiscount,
0 Consultation,
0 Medicine,
0 Investigation,
mjom.Name BDAName
INTO #TempMarketingIncomeDetails
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.id
--JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
left JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
WHERE convert(date,ir.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,ir.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate 
						and 
						(mjom.Id=@MarketingJOfficerId or @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
TotalBillValue =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(TotalBillValue) FROM 
(
SELECT CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBillValue
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG

)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
BedRent =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(BedRent)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@BedandCabins then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END BedRent
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Oxygen =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Oxygen)  FROM 
(
SELECT ir1.Amount  Oxygen
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId= ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id = ir1.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG 
AND sssg.id=@OXYGENSubSubGroup
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Discount =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Discount) FROM 
(
SELECT CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Consultation =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Consultation)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@Consultaion then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END ConsulTation
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Medicine =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Medicine)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@Medicine then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END Medicine
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

----------Investigation start------------
UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Investigation =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Investigation)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@INVESTIGATIONBILL then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END Investigation
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

----------Investigation end------------

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
ConsDiscount =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(ConsDiscount)  FROM 
(
SELECT ir1.Discount  ConsDiscount
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId= ir.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG 
)T
),0)

		select(
	select * from(


SELECT PatientName
	  ,REG
	  ,DateOfAdmission
	  ,DateOfDischarge
	  ,TotalBillValue
	  ,BedRent
	  ,Oxygen
	  ,Discount
	  ,ConsDiscount
	  ,ISNULL(Discount,0) - ISNULL(ConsDiscount,0) AS HospitalDiscount
	  ,Consultation
	  ,Medicine 
	  ,ISNULL(TotalBillValue,0)-ISNULL(Consultation,0)-ISNULL(Medicine,0) NetTotalBill
	  ,0 HospitalBillAndOthers
	  ,0 TotalHospitalBill
	  ,Investigation
	  ,0 NetPayable
	  ,isnull(BDAName,'')BDAName

	  FROM #TempMarketingIncomeDetails
--ORDER BY DateOfDischarge

	) tbl  
	ORDER BY tbl.BDAName
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END
GO
