CREATE       PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingDetailsBreakdownReportBasedOnAdmissionDate]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingDetailsBreakdownReportBasedOnAdmissionDate]'2025-01-01,2025-01-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@MarketingJOfficerId uniqueidentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12;

DECLARE @AdmissionFee uniqueidentifier ='23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0' 
DECLARE @IPDCare uniqueidentifier ='41DE5100-678D-4231-B22A-F76E96282846'
DECLARE @ICUCare uniqueidentifier ='07CBB7DA-5E71-4718-9CAF-E69623449496'
DECLARE @CTUCare uniqueidentifier ='FF9473BC-D411-466C-99A1-3E492371AD53'
DECLARE @HDUCare uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'
DECLARE @OTCharge uniqueidentifier ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E'
DECLARE @NICUCare uniqueidentifier ='104E7387-8FAA-4516-ADA2-229251EC6111'
DECLARE @Medicine uniqueidentifier='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'
DECLARE @INVESTIGATIONBILL uniqueidentifier='F8D6B657-E027-4417-AF73-14B8A1466EB5'
DECLARE @BedandCabins uniqueidentifier='BA1B319E-FEA4-4452-8B22-FC20B44DBE1D' 
DECLARE @Consultaion  uniqueidentifier='86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D' 
DECLARE @OXYGENSubSubGroup  uniqueidentifier ='1C392E0C-4AF0-46B4-A430-98447E39407C'


--DROP TABLE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails
SELECT DISTINCT ir.FullName AS PatientName,ir.InvoiceNo AS REG, CONVERT(DATE,ir.AdmissionDateTime) AS DateOfAdmission,
convert(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) AS DateOfDischarge,
0 TotalBillValue,
0 BedRent,
0 Oxygen,
0 Discount,
0 ConsDiscount,
0 Consultation,
0 Medicine,
0 Investigation,
mjom.Name BDAName
INTO #TempMarketingIncomeDetails
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
left JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
left JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.id
--JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
JOIN Marketing.MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
WHERE convert(date,ir.AdmissionDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,ir.AdmissionDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate 
						and 
						(mjom.Id=@MarketingJOfficerId or @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
TotalBillValue =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(TotalBillValue) FROM 
(
SELECT CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBillValue
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG

)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
BedRent =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(BedRent)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@BedandCabins then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END BedRent
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Oxygen =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Oxygen)  FROM 
(
SELECT ir1.Amount  Oxygen
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId= ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id = ir1.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG 
AND sssg.id=@OXYGENSubSubGroup
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Discount =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Discount) FROM 
(
SELECT CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl ON fbl.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Consultation =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Consultation)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@Consultaion then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END ConsulTation
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Medicine =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Medicine)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@Medicine then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END Medicine
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

----------Investigation start------------
UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
Investigation =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(Investigation)  FROM 
(
SELECT  CASE WHEN fbs.SummaryHeadId=@INVESTIGATIONBILL then fbs.Amount ELSE 0 END Investigation
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb ON fb.IPDPatientRecordId=ir.Id
JOIN Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs ON fbs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG
)T
),0)

----------Investigation end------------

UPDATE #TempMarketingIncomeDetails SET
ConsDiscount =
ISNULL((
SELECT SUM(ConsDiscount)  FROM 
(
SELECT ir1.Discount  ConsDiscount
FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId= ir.Id
WHERE ir.InvoiceNo = #TempMarketingIncomeDetails.REG 
)T
),0)

		select(
	select * from(


SELECT PatientName
	  ,REG
	  ,DateOfAdmission
	  ,DateOfDischarge
	  ,TotalBillValue
	  ,BedRent
	  ,Oxygen
	  ,Discount
	  ,ConsDiscount
	  ,ISNULL(Discount,0) - ISNULL(ConsDiscount,0) AS HospitalDiscount
	  ,Consultation
	  ,Medicine 
	  ,ISNULL(TotalBillValue,0)-ISNULL(Consultation,0)-ISNULL(Medicine,0) NetTotalBill
	  ,0 HospitalBillAndOthers
	  ,0 TotalHospitalBill
	  ,Investigation
	  ,0 NetPayable
	  ,isnull(BDAName,'')BDAName

	  FROM #TempMarketingIncomeDetails
--ORDER BY DateOfDischarge

	) tbl  
	ORDER BY tbl.BDAName
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeDetails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeDetails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					select(
							select * from(




					SELECT   ReportType, TranactionDate ,  BillNo,  PatientName, Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 '' commission
					
					FROM (

					SELECT 'Diagnostic' AS ReportType, CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate) TranactionDate , i.InvoiceNo BillNo, i.FullName PatientName,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN iil.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=2 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,
							0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id Media

							FROM  Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
							JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.RefdDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							left JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							left JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							left JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type

							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

							UNION ALL
					SELECT 'Hospital' AS ReportType, CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) TranactionDate , ir.InvoiceNo BillNo, ir.FullName PatientName,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=2 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id Media

							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir 
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb  ON ir.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl  ON fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type

							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
						    AND (ir.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							) T
							GROUP BY  ReportType, TranactionDate ,  BillNo,  PatientName

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					
					

					select i.InvoiceNo BillNo, i.FullName PatientName, convert(date,i.AdmissionDateTime) AdmissionDate, convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) DishargeDate,
					fbl.TransactionType,debit,Credit
					--case when fbl.TransactionType =0 then sum(debit+Credit) end TotalBill,
					--case when fbl.TransactionType =1 then sum(debit+Credit) end Discount,
					--case when fbl.TransactionType =2 then sum(debit+Credit) end PaidAmount,
					--0 Due,
					
					,i.AssignedDoctorId,i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
					,0 TotalDue,
					b.id FinalBillID
					into #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital
					FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
							join Hospital.FinalBills b on b.IPDPatientRecordId=i.Id
							--join Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fbs on fbs.FinalBillId=b.Id
							join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl on fbl.FinalBillId=b.Id 


				 Update 	#TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital set
				 TotalDue =
				 (
						select sum(debit)-sum(credit) from #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital t
						where t.BillNo = #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital.BillNo
				 )
					
						--WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate

						--group by i.InvoiceNo , i.FullName , convert(date,i.AdmissionDateTime) , convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) ,fbl.TransactionType,
						--i.AssignedDoctorId,i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId,fbl.TransactionType


						--select * from #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital
						--return 


					--select(
					--		select * from(




					--SELECT   ReportType, TranactionDate ,  BillNo,  PatientName, Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
					--		 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
					--		 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
					--		 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
					--		 '' commission
					
					--FROM (

					select 		BillNo,PatientName,AdmissionDate,DishargeDate,sum(TotalBill) TotalBill,
					0 HospitalBill,0 MedicineBiil,	0 ConsultationBill,0 InvestigationBill,0	ServiceCharge,
					sum(Discount) Discount,sum(Paid) Paid,[TotalDue], 0 Comission,FinalBillID
				
					into #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary
					from (
							SELECT t. BillNo, t. PatientName, t. AdmissionDate, t. DishargeDate,
							case when t.TransactionType =0 then (Debit +Credit)  else 0 end TotalBill,
							0 HospitalBill,0 MedicineBiil,0 InvestigationBill,0	ServiceCharge,
							case when t.TransactionType =1 then (Debit +Credit)  else 0  end Discount,
							case when t.TransactionType =2 then (Debit +Credit)  else 0  end Paid,
							TotalDue [TotalDue],
							0 Comission,FinalBillID
							FROM  #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospital t
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=t.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=t.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=t.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type
							WHERE (T.AssignedDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')
							)T
							group by t. BillNo, t. PatientName, t. AdmissionDate, t. DishargeDate,TotalDue,FinalBillID

							
							

							create table #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead
							(
								BillHead nvarchar(max),
								SummeryHeadID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
							)
							print 1;
							insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('HospitalBill','23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0')
							--insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('HospitalBill',80)
							insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('HospitalBill','E260CBA5-56D9-460C-AE8F-092BF172E961')
							insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('HospitalBill','44EC6533-C4AA-4378-AD54-0F2CBAF1D66F')
							--insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('HospitalBill',81)
							insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('HospitalBill','20F1BC87-2E06-4EE6-9507-7F1598F9FC1F')

							--insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('ConsultationBill',3)
							--insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('MedicineBill',91)

							--insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('InvestigationBill',89)
							--insert into #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead values('InvestigationBill',90)
							
				
				           -----------HospitalBill-----------
							update #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary set
							HospitalBill =
							(
									select ISNULL(sum(t.Amount),0) from Hospital.FinalBillSummarys t
									join #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead s on s.SummeryHeadID = t.SummaryHeadId
									where t.FinalBillId = #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary.FinalBillID AND BillHead='HospitalBill'
							)
							-----------MedicineBill-----------
							update #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary set
							MedicineBiil =
							(
									select ISNULL(sum(t.Amount),0) from Hospital.FinalBillSummarys t
									join #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead s on s.SummeryHeadID = t.SummaryHeadId
									where t.FinalBillId = #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary.FinalBillID AND BillHead='MedicineBill'
							)

							-----------ConsultationBill-----------
							update #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary set
							ConsultationBill =
							(
									select ISNULL(sum(t.Amount),0) from Hospital.FinalBillSummarys t
									join #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead s on s.SummeryHeadID = t.SummaryHeadId
									where t.FinalBillId = #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary.FinalBillID AND BillHead='ConsultationBill'
							)

								-----------InvestigationBill-----------
							update #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary set
							InvestigationBill =
							(
									select ISNULL(sum(t.Amount),0) from Hospital.FinalBillSummarys t
									join #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead s on s.SummeryHeadID = t.SummaryHeadId
									where t.FinalBillId = #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary.FinalBillID AND BillHead='InvestigationBill'
							)

										-----------ServiceCharge-----------
							update #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary set
							ServiceCharge =
							(
									select ISNULL(sum(t.ServiceCharge),0) from Hospital.FinalBillSummarys t
									--join #TempFinalBillSummeryReportHead s on s.SummeryHeadID = t.SummaryHeadId
									where t.FinalBillId = #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary.FinalBillID
									--AND BillHead='InvestigationBill'
							)

							
							select(
							select * from(

							select BillNo,PatientName,AdmissionDate,DishargeDate, TotalBill,
							HospitalBill, MedicineBiil,	 ConsultationBill, InvestigationBill,	ServiceCharge,
							Discount, Paid,TotalDue,  Comission
							from #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary

							) T  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
							--UPDATE #TempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeHospitalSummary SET PathologyAmount= (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Rate),0) FROM #tempTestGroupWithBill tgb WHERE ParentGroupId=1 AND tgb.BillNo=#tempMain.BillNo AND TestGroupId<>32)

							--create Table #TempFinalBillSummery

END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBy]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBy]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					
					select(
							select * from(




					SELECT   ReportType, TranactionDate ,  BillNo,  PatientName, Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 '' commission,JmoName,DoctorName
					FROM (

					SELECT 'Diagnostic' AS ReportType, CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate) TranactionDate , i.InvoiceNo BillNo, i.FullName PatientName,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN iil.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=2 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,
							0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID,v.Name DoctorName, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id MediaId,
							isnull(mjom1.Name,'') JmoName
							

							FROM  Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
							JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.RefdDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
								ON D.id = v.id
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
								ON dt.typename = d.type
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')

							UNION ALL
					SELECT 'Hospital' AS ReportType, CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) TranactionDate , ir.InvoiceNo BillNo, ir.FullName PatientName,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=2 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID,v.Name DoctorName, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id MediaId,
							isnull(mjom1.Name,'') JmoName

							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir 
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb  ON ir.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl  ON fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
										LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
							ON D.id = v.id
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
							ON dt.typename = d.type
										WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
						    AND (ir.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='')
							) T
							GROUP BY  ReportType, TranactionDate ,  BillNo,  PatientName,JmoName,DoctorName

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MarketingJOfficerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MediaId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MOfficer UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@MManager UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@HoD UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		@DoctorType NVARCHAR(MAX)


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
					Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
					Select @MediaId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
					Select @MOfficer=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
					Select @MManager=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
					Select @HoD=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
					Select @DoctorType=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
					
					 
					Select * INTO #tempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary from(

					SELECT   ReportType,--billNo,
					      Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 '' commission,JmoName,DoctorName
					FROM (

					SELECT 'Diagnostic' AS ReportType, --i.InvoiceNo BillNo,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN iil.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=2 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,
							0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID,v.Name DoctorName, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id MediaId,
							isnull(mjom1.Name,'') JmoName
							

							FROM  Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
							JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=i.RefdDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
						LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type
									WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							
							UNION ALL
					SELECT 'Hospital' AS ReportType, --ir.InvoiceNo BillNo,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=2 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,0 Due,
							'' commission,v.Id doctorID,v.Name DoctorName, mjom1.Id MA,mjom.id MediaId,
							isnull(mjom1.Name,'') JmoName

							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir 
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb  ON ir.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl  ON fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId
							JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=ir.AssignedDoctorId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						    --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=ir.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							LEFT JOIN Marketing.Doctors d 
					ON D.id = v.id
				LEFT JOIN Marketing.DoctorServiceTypes dt
					ON dt.typename = d.type
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
						    AND (ir.RefdDoctorId=@ConsultantID OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom1.id=@MarketingJOfficerId OR @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							AND 
							(mjom.id=@MediaId OR @MediaId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(mo.Id=@MOfficer OR @MOfficer= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')AND
							(mm.id=@MManager OR @MManager='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND
							(hd.id=@HoD OR @HoD='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') AND 
							(dt.typename=@DoctorType OR @DoctorType='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							) T
							GROUP BY  ReportType, JmoName,DoctorName--,BillNo
							)TT

					select(
							select * from(

							select 
							ReportType,
							DoctorName,
					         Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 commission,JmoName
							from #tempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary
							Group by ReportType,commission,JmoName,DoctorName

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END

	insert into #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble,UserFullName)

	select 'Advance During Admission Date' ReportType,BillNo SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0,
	UserFullName 
	
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	u.UserName UserFullName

	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	and convert(date,a.PayDate)=convert(date,p.AdmissionDateTime)
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on p.AssignedDoctorId=d.Id
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo,UserFullName


	insert into #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble,UserFullName)

	select 'Advance After Admission Date' ReportType,BillNo SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0,
	UserFullName 
	
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	u.UserName UserFullName

	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	and convert(date,a.PayDate)> convert(date,p.AdmissionDateTime)
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on p.AssignedDoctorId=d.Id
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo,UserFullName
	
	insert into #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble,DueAmount,Refund, UserFullName)
	
	select ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'OPD' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices opp 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0) dueAmount,
	SUM(Refund)Refund,
	UserFullName
	From 
	(
			select  para.ReportType, op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =0 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
			case when a.TransactionType =5 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit else 0 end Refund,
			u.UserName UserFullName
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			left join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			left join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			join #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.ReportType,  T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.UserFullName

	-------New start

	insert into #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble,DueAmount,Refund, UserFullName)
	
	select 'CONSULTANCY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'Consultancy' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  
		from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees opp 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0)DueAmount
	,SUM(Refund) Refund,
	 UserFullName
	From 
	(
			select   op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,

			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =0 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
			case when a.TransactionType =5 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =5 then a.Debit else 0 end Refund,
			u.UserName UserFullName
			from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees op 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			left join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			left join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by  T.BillNo,T.FullName, UserFullName

	update #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash +	#TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileRocket - ISNULL(#TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.Refund,0)  
					)

select p.InvoiceNo,sum(c.discount) ConsultantServicesdiscount  
into #TempConsultantServicesdiscount
from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices c on c.[IPDPatientId] = p.id
where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
group by p.InvoiceNo


	SELECT TempP.InvoiceNo,SUM(ir1.Amount) FoodServiceBill
		INTO #TempFoodServiceBill
		from
		  (Select * from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate) TempP
		join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=TempP.DischargeByUserId
		JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1  ON TempP.Id=ir1.IPDPatientId 
		Join 
		 (
	        Select ttt.Id, ttt.ServiceSubSubGroupId, ttt.HeadName 
              from( 
			 Select * from(
			                Select sssg.Id as ServiceGroupId,sssg.ServiceSubGroupId,sssg.Name from  Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg where sssg.id='1980386E-4AD9-4915-9034-4639A1CFE638') tt --79
			  JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh on tt.ServiceGroupId=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId) ttt 
         ) seh
        
		  ON  seh.Id = ir1.ServiceId
		
		and 
	    (u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		
		GROUP BY TempP.InvoiceNo;



	
	
	    Select * into #Tem_MISDailyCollectionDischargedpatients from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
		where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate
	
			select InvoiceNo,sum(TotalCount) TotalCount,
			sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
			sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
			sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
			sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
			sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
			sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
			sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			sum(DueCollectionMobileBkash) DueCollectionMobileBkash,
			0 RegularMopbileRocket,
			0 DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			0 DueCollectionMopbileRocket
			into #Tem_MISDailyCollectionPlLeadger
			from
			(
			
			select p.invoiceNo,count(fl.Id) TotalCount,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then isnull(isnull(sum(fl.Debit),0) + isnull(sum(fl.Credit),0.00),0.00) else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and  pc.Id =2 and pm.Id =2 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit )+ sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileBkash
			from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionDischargedpatients p
			join Hospital.FinalBills fb on p.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fb.id=fl.FinalBillId
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id=fl.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id=pc.PaymentModeId
			where convert(date,fl.trandatetime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,fl.trandatetime) <=@FilterEndDate
			group by p.InvoiceNo,fl.TransactionType,pm.Id,pc.Id,p.uhid
			 
			)T
		group by T.InvoiceNo
		
	 
	

		--select  * from PLeadger where InvoiceNo  ='2501170200005'
		--return  

	--select(

							p.DischargedDateTime DischargeDate,
							u.UserName DischargeBy,
							case when  fs.SummaryHeadId ='BA1B319E-FEA4-4452-8B22-FC20B44DBE1D' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='41DE5100-678D-4231-B22A-F76E96282846' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='07CBB7DA-5E71-4718-9CAF-E69623449496' --or fs.SummaryHeadId =83 or fs.SummaryHeadId =87
							or fs.SummaryHeadId ='FF9473BC-D411-466C-99A1-3E492371AD53' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='654EC205-C405-4A10-95F7-72496C55F73E' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='104E7387-8FAA-4516-ADA2-229251EC6111'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='27FE64EF-BB15-4749-8958-E3570DDE3285' or fs.SummaryHeadId ='A26636D5-E9BE-47DA-912F-B644678EAEE6'
							or fs.SummaryHeadId = '23CAB83E-3166-4B7C-892C-008AB3A23EB0'  OR fs.SummaryHeadId ='20F1BC87-2E06-4EE6-9507-7F1598F9FC1F' --80,81,82,83,84,85,86,87,89,90,100,1002
							then 
							Amount end [HpBill],

							case when fs.SummaryHeadId = '4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='4D93651D-56B7-4267-9313-A6B9D07B8DF4' then --91,91
							Amount end [MedicineBill],

							case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 'F8D6B657-E027-4417-AF73-14B8A1466EB5'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' then ---0,104
							Amount end [InvBill],

							case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 'E260CBA5-56D9-460C-AE8F-092BF172E961'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='44EC6533-C4AA-4378-AD54-0F2CBAF1D66F' then --79,1000
							Amount end [FoodBill],

							case when fs.SummaryHeadId = '86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D'  or fs.SummaryHeadId ='86E710A0-AB2F-4CCD-AB1E-3246F5AA5F7D' then  --3
							Amount end [ConsBill],

							--case when fs.SummaryHeadId = 1  or fs.SummaryHeadId =1 then 
							ServiceCharge  [SCharge],--,

							(select distinct sum(pp.Amount) from Hospital.AdvancePayments pp where pp.IPDPatientId = p.Id
							)		[Advance],
							0 AdvanceReturn 
			
							from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionDischargedpatients p
							join Hospital.RegRecords r on p.UHID = r.UHID
							join VWDoctors d on p.AssignedDoctorId = d.Id
							--join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords ac on ac.PatientId=p.Id
							join Hospital.FinalBills fb on  p.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
							join Hospital.FinalBillSummarys fs on fs.FinalBillId=fb.Id
							--join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fl.FinalBillId=fs.FinalBillId
							join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=p.DischargeByUserId
							where (u.Id=@UserID or @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			
			

					)T
	--left join PLeadger pl on pl.InvoiceNo = T.AdmissionNo
	

		group by 
		T.id,
	
	T.invoiceNo,
	T.AdmissionNo ,
	T.PatientName,
	T.AssignDoctor,
	T.MobileNo,
	t.Advance,
	T.AdmissionDate,
	T.DischargeDate,
	T.DischargeBy
	) tbl  
	


	update #SpGetMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic set
	TotalAmount = isnull(TotalAmount,0) +  (select 
		isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket ),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularCash ),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash ),0) 
	 from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionPlLeadger  l where l.InvoiceNo = #SpGetMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.InvoiceNo ),
	 	CardChequeCollection =(select 
		isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket ),0) 
		
	 from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionPlLeadger  l where l.InvoiceNo = #SpGetMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.InvoiceNo ),
	 	CashCollection =isnull(CashCollection,0) + (select 
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0) 
		
	 from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionPlLeadger  l where l.InvoiceNo = #SpGetMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.InvoiceNo
	 
	  )

	 --,
	--CardChequeCollection = (select isnull(sum(RegularCash),0.00)from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionPlLeadger where InvoiceNo = #SpGetMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.InvoiceNo ),
	--CashCollection = (select isnull(sum(RegularCash),0.00)from #Tem_MISDailyCollectionPlLeadger where InvoiceNo = #SpGetMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.InvoiceNo )
	
------JSON Start

	
	--select(

	select * from(

	1 Report_TypeID,

	CONVERT(DATE,AdmissionDate) AdmissionDate,

	isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +
		
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0)  Advance1,
	0 Advance2,
	0 Physio,
	0 Inve,
	0 [InvBill],
	0 [MedicineBill],
	0 [FoodServiceBill], 
	0 OtherCharge,
	0 DisInfe,

		isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +

		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0) 
		
		 TotalAmount,
		
		isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +
		
		
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard),0) 
		
		 CardChequeCollection,

		isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad),0) +

		MobileBankCollection,	
	
	isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0) 
	 CashCollection,

	 from(

		isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +

		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +
		
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0)+
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0) 
		 TotalAmount,
		
		isnull(sum(RegularCard),0) +
		
		
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionCard),0) +
		
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0)

		 CardChequeCollection,
		 isnull(sum(RegularMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(RegularMopbileRocket),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash),0) +
		isnull(sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket),0) 
		MobileBankCollection,
	
		isnull(sum(RegularCash),0) +  isnull(sum(DueCollectionCash),0) 
	 CashCollection,
	 UserFullName

			from
			(
			
			select p.invoiceNo BillNo ,count(fl.Id) TotalCount,p.fullName PatientName,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then isnull(isnull(sum(fl.Debit),0) + isnull(sum(fl.Credit),0.00),0.00) else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and  pc.Id =2 and pm.Id =2 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then sum(fl.Debit )+ sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit )else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when fl.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then sum(fl.Debit) + sum(fl.Credit) else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			0 DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
			0 RegularMopbileRocket,
			u.UserName UserFullName
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
			join Hospital.FinalBills fb on p.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
			join Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl on fb.id=fl.FinalBillId
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id=fl.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id=pc.PaymentModeId
			join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id = fl.CreatedBy
			where convert(date,fl.trandatetime) >=@FilterStartDate and
				convert(date,fl.trandatetime) <=@FilterEndDate
				and p.DischargedDateTime < @FilterStartDate
			group by p.InvoiceNo,fl.TransactionType,pm.Id,pc.Id,p.fullName,u.UserName 
			 
			)T
		group by T.billNo,T.PatientName,T.UserFullName

	-----------------------------  Test Discount and Hospital Discount start  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	Alter table #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic 
	add TestDiscount float

	Alter table #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic 
	add HospitalDiscount float

SELECT p.InvoiceNo,sum(ir.Discount) TestDiscount 
into  #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamicTestDiscount
FROM 
Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir ON ir.IPDPatientId=p.Id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
JOIN #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic t on t.billno = p.InvoiceNo
WHERE sssg.id='54DF1D4F-AF32-4D76-8346-EF7238FF6234'
group by p.InvoiceNo


SELECT p.InvoiceNo,sum(ir.Discount) HospitalDiscount 
into  #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamicHospitalDiscount
FROM 
Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir ON ir.IPDPatientId=p.Id
JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir.ServiceId
JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
JOIN #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic t on t.billno = p.InvoiceNo
WHERE sssg.id<>'54DF1D4F-AF32-4D76-8346-EF7238FF6234'
group by p.InvoiceNo


update #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic set
TestDiscount =0,
HospitalDiscount=0

update #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic set
TestDiscount =
isnull((
select TestDiscount from #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamicTestDiscount tt where tt.InvoiceNo = #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.billno
--and tt.ReportType ='Discharged Patients'
),0)
where ReportType ='Discharged Patient'


update #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic set
HospitalDiscount =
isnull((
select HospitalDiscount from #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamicHospitalDiscount tt where tt.InvoiceNo = #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic.billno
--and tt.ReportType ='Discharged Patients'
),0)
where ReportType ='Discharged Patient'
 
-----------------------------  Test Discount and Hospital Discount end  ---------------------------------------------------------------------


	select (
	select * from(
		select 
		Report_TypeID,
		ReportType,
		BillNO,
		PatientName,
		AdmissionDate,
		AssignDoctor,
		CabinNo,
		DischargeDate,
		Advance1,
		Advance2,
		Physio,
		Inve,
		[InvBill]  -  TestDiscount  [InvBill] ,
		[MedicineBill] ,
		[FoodServiceBill],
		OtherCharge,
		DisInfe,
		Nursing,
		Discount,
		Dialysis,
		DueCollection,
		TotalAmount - TestDiscount  TotalAmount,
		CardChequeCollection,
		MobileBankCollection,	
		CashCollection,
		UserName ,
		TestDiscount,
		HospitalDiscount

		 
		from #TempMISDailyCollectionStatementDynamic 
		--where HospitalDiscount <>0 
		--or testDiscount <>0
		
		) tbl  
		order by tbl.UserName---,tbl.Status ,tbl.slno
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempMISDailyCollectionOPDUserWiseCollectionReport


-------------  [Hospital].[AdvanceAdmittedPatientDynamic]  start ----------------------------------------

END

-- =============================================
CREATE             PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetMonthlyRevenueReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column
----- 17. ServiceGroupID [GUID] , 18. ServiceSubGroupId [GUID] , 19. ServiceSubSubGroupID [GUID], 20. ServiceHeadID [GUID], 21. DepartmentID [GUID], 22. CabinTypeID [GUID] 

---exec [Hospital].[SpGetMonthlyRevenueReport]'2025-01-01,2025-01-05,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@ServiceGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceSubGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceSubSubGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceHeadID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@DepartmentID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@CabinTypeID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ServiceGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=17
	Select @ServiceSubGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=18
	Select @ServiceSubSubGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=19
	Select @ServiceHeadID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=20
	Select @DepartmentID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=21
	Select @CabinTypeID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=22

------SELECT @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@ServiceGroupID,@ServiceSubGroupID,@ServiceSubSubGroupID,@ServiceHeadID,@DepartmentID,@paramas



	SELECT FORMAT(ir.DischargedDateTime, 'MMMM yy') NameOfMonth ,FORMAT(ir.DischargedDateTime, 'yyyy-MM')  YearIDMonthID, 
	seh.HeadName AS IncomeHeadName,
	--sssg.Name IncomeHeadGroupName, 
	SUM(ir1.Amount) AS TotalAmount 
	INTO #TempSpGetMonthlyRevenueReport
	FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
	JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir1.ServiceId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceGroups sg ON sg.id=ssg.ServiceGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.id=ir.AdmittedCabinId
	JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.id=c.CabinTypeId

	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>= @FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
	AND (@ServiceGroupID=sg.id OR @ServiceGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubGroupID=ssg.id OR @ServiceSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubSubGroupID=sssg.id OR @ServiceSubSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceHeadID=seh.id OR @ServiceHeadID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (ir.DeptId=@DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (ct.id=@CabinTypeID OR @CabinTypeID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--GROUP BY seh.HeadName, sssg.Name,FORMAT(ir.DischargedDateTime, 'MMMM yy'),FORMAT(ir.DischargedDateTime, 'yyyy-MM')
	GROUP BY seh.HeadName, FORMAT(ir.DischargedDateTime, 'MMMM yy'),FORMAT(ir.DischargedDateTime, 'yyyy-MM')


	
		select(
	select * from(


						SELECT
						NameOfMonth,
						IncomeHeadName,
						--IncomeHeadGroupName,
						TotalAmount,
						YearIDMonthID

						FROM #TempSpGetMonthlyRevenueReport

						
	) tbl  
ORDER BY YearIDMonthID,IncomeHeadName
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll] '2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId

AS
BEGIN
				DECLARE 
					@FilterStartDate date,
					@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

		CREATE TABLE #TeampSpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll
		(
			AutoID int identity(1,1),
			BillNo bigint, OTDate datetime ,AdmDate datetime,PatientName nvarchar(max),Age int,
		CabinNo nvarchar(max),AssignDoctor nvarchar(max), OTName nvarchar(max), OTAmount float,
		DoctorName nvarchar(max),IndividualDoctorAmount float, TotalAmount float

		)


		insert into #TeampSpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll
		(
			BillNo, OTDate,AdmDate,PatientName,Age,
		CabinNo,AssignDoctor, OTName, OTAmount,
		DoctorName,IndividualDoctorAmount,TotalAmount
		)

	

		select 
		BillNo, OTDate,AdmDate,PatientName,Age,
		CabinNo,AssignDoctor, OTName, OTAmount,
		DoctorName,IndividualDoctorAmount,0 TotalAmount
		from
		(
			select i.InvoiceNo BillNo, convert(date,ass.OTDate) OTDate, convert(date,i.AdmissionDateTime) AdmDate,i.FullName PatientName,
					i.AgeYear Age, [dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](i.InvoiceNo) CabinNo, d.Name AssignDoctor, ass.OTName OTName, 
					ass.SurgeonFee OTAmount,asddoc.Name DoctorName,asd.Amount IndividualDoctorAmount
					--,asd.Id asdid
			from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
			join Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords alr on alr.PatientId=i.Id
			join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id=alr.CabinId
			join VWDoctors d on d.Id=i.AssignedDoctorId
			join opd.OTAssistantPayments ass on ass.IPDPatientId=i.Id
			join opd.OTAssistantPaymentDetails asd on asd.RecordId=ass.Id
		    left join VWDoctors asddoc on asddoc.Id=asd.DoctorId
			
		)T

		
		update #TeampSpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll set
		TotalAmount =0

		update #TeampSpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll set
		TotalAmount =OTAmount
		where AutoID in 
		(
			select min(autoid) from #TeampSpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll
			group by BillNo
		)
		
		
				select(
	select * from(
		select 
		BillNo, OTDate,AdmDate,PatientName,Age,
		CabinNo,AssignDoctor, OTName, TotalAmount OTAmount ,
		DoctorName,IndividualDoctorAmount
		from #TeampSpGetOTAssistantPaymentDetailsForAll
		
	) tbl
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetOTNoteByIdOrPatientId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetOTNoteByIdOrPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select ot.Id,ot.IPDPatientRecordId,ot.OTScheduleId,ot.NoteDateTime,ot.OTNameId,ot.Indication,ot.Incision,ot.Findings,ot.HPR,ot.UserId
		   ,ot.DoctorAssistantName, pd.FullName,Hospital.GetCabinNumber(pd.Id) AS CabinNo,rr.Sex,
	CASE WHEN pd.AgeYear <> '' THEN pd.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE pd.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeMonth <> '' THEN pd.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE pd.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeDay <> '' THEN pd.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE pd.AgeDay END AS Age, 
	pd.InvoiceNo,u.UserName,one.Name OTNameName,'' ProcedureTitle,'' ProcedureDescription,sugetion.Name NameOfSurgeon,ates.Name NameOfAnesthetist,ot.AnesthesiaName NameOfAnesthesia,ot.AnesthetistId,ot.SurgeonId,ot.[Procedure]
	,ad.Name AssignedDoctor
	  from [Hospital].[OTNotes] ot left join
		   [Hospital].[OTSchedules] ots on ot.OTScheduleId=ots.Id left join
		   [dbo].[VWDoctors] sugetion on ot.SurgeonId=sugetion.Id left join
		   [dbo].[VWDoctors] ates on ot.AnesthetistId=ates.Id left join
		   [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd on ot.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id inner join
		   Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON pd.UHID = rr.UHID INNER JOIN
		   Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON pd.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
           Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id left JOIN
		   [dbo].[VWDoctors] ad on pd.AssignedDoctorId=ad.Id left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on ot.UserId=u.Id left join
		   [Hospital].[OTNames] one on one.Id=ot.OTNameId --left join
		   --[Hospital].[SurgeryProcedures] sp on sp.Id=ot.SurgeryProcedureId
	 where ((@PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and ot.Id=@Id) or (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and ot.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId)) and ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetOTScheduleById]
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime,
	@DeptIds varchar(2000),
	@FloorId uniqueidentifier,
	@IsPatientVisitbleByFloor int,
	@DateTimeFlag int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT 
		  os.id, 
		  os.ipdpatientrecordid, 
		  os.surgeonid, 
		  os.anaesthesiologistid, 
		  os.ottypeid, 
		  os.otnameid, 
		  Isnull(
			os.otdatetime, 
			Getdate()
		  ) OTDateTime, 
		  Isnull(os.status, '') Status, 
		  Isnull(
			os.userid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		  ) UserId, 
		  Isnull(pd.fullname, '') FullName, 
		  rr.sex, 
		  pd.invoiceno, 
		  Isnull(c.cabinno, '') CabinNo, 
		  Isnull(d.NAME, '') SurgeonName, 
		  Isnull(dd.NAME, '') AnaesthesiologistName, 
		  Isnull(ot.NAME, '') OTTypeName, 
		  Isnull(otn.NAME, '') OTNameName, 
		  os.iscompleted, 
		  Isnull(u.username, '') UserName, 
		  os.iscompleted, 
		  os.isdeleted, 
		  Isnull(os.floor, '') Floor, 
		  Isnull(os.otroom, '') OTRoom, 
		  Isnull(os.anesthesiatype, '') AnesthesiaType, 
		  pd.deptid, 
		  Isnull(
			CASE WHEN pd.ageyear <> '' THEN pd.ageyear + 'Y ' ELSE pd.ageyear END + CASE WHEN pd.agemonth <> '' THEN pd.agemonth + 'M ' ELSE pd.agemonth END + CASE WHEN pd.ageday <> '' THEN pd.ageday + 'D' ELSE pd.ageday END, 
			''
		  ) AS Age, 
		  os.indicationofsurgery, 
		  os.others, 
		  ad.NAME AssignedDoctor 
		FROM 
		  [Hospital].[otschedules] os 
		  INNER JOIN [Hospital].[ipdpatientrecords] pd ON os.ipdpatientrecordid = pd.id 
		  LEFT JOIN hospital.ipdcabinallocationrecords AS ca ON pd.id = ca.patientid 
		  INNER JOIN hospital.cabins AS c ON ca.cabinid = c.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[vwdoctors] ad ON pd.assigneddoctorid = ad.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[vwdoctors] d ON os.surgeonid = d.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[vwdoctors] dd ON os.anaesthesiologistid = dd.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [Hospital].[ottypes] ot ON os.ottypeid = ot.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [Hospital].[otnames] otn ON os.otnameid = otn.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [Identity].[users] u ON os.userid = u.id 
		  LEFT JOIN [Hospital].regrecords rr ON pd.uhid = rr.uhid 
		WHERE 
		  (
			(
			  os.id = @Id 
			  AND @Id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
			) 
			OR (
			  @Id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' 
			  AND (
				@DateTimeFlag = 0 
				OR (
				  @DateTimeFlag = 1 
				  AND (
					CONVERT(DATE, os.otdatetime) >= CONVERT(DATE, @DateFrom) 
					AND CONVERT(DATE, os.otdatetime) <= CONVERT(DATE, @DateTo)
				  )
				)
			  ) 
			  AND (
				(
				  @IsPatientVisitbleByFloor = 1 
				  AND c.floorid = @FloorId
				) 
				OR (
				  @IsPatientVisitbleByFloor = 0 
				  AND ca.deptid IN (
					SELECT 
					  * 
					FROM 
					  String_split(@DeptIds, ',')
				  )
				)
			  )
			)
		  ) 
		  AND (ca.isoccupiedbypatient = 1) 
		  AND (ca.allottype = 'PAB') 
		  AND pd.invoiceno IS NOT NULL
		  order by Isnull(os.otdatetime, Getdate())
END
GO
