--EXEC [Hospital].[SpGetPatientDashboardforBillingDepartment]
CREATE   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetPatientDashboardforBillingDepartment]

	---------exec [Hospital].[SpGetPatientDashboardforBillingDepartment]
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PatientDashboardforBillingDepartment;

SELECT 

ir.Id,(ir.InvoiceNo) AdmissionNo

,CONVERT (DATE,ir.AdmissionDateTime ) AdmissionDate
,ir.FullName PatientName
,ISNULL(rr.PatientAddress,'N/A') ADDRESS
,ISNULL(rr.MobileNo,0) MobileNo
,ISNULL(rr.BloodGroup,'N/A') BloodGroup
,[dbo].[GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge](ir.InvoiceNo)BedNo --CabinNo ------- Last Bed No
, COALESCE( 
        (SELECT TOP 1 d1.Name 
         FROM Hospital.AssignedDoctorRecords adr  
         JOIN VWDoctors d1 ON adr.AssignedDoctorId = d1.Id  
         WHERE adr.IPDPatientRecordId = ir.Id AND adr.IsUnderHim = 1  
         ORDER BY adr.CreatedOn DESC),
        d.Name -- If no record is found, fallback to the assigned doctor from IPDPatientRecords
    ) AS AssignDoc  
  
,0 TotalAmount
,0 ServiceCharge
,0 Advance
,0 DueAmount
INTO #PatientDashboardforBillingDepartment
FROM 
Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
JOIN Hospital.RegRecords rr ON ir.UHID=rr.UHID
JOIN VWDoctors d ON ir.AssignedDoctorId=d.Id
WHERE ir.DischargeByUserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



SELECT 
* FROM  #PatientDashboardforBillingDepartment
END

GO

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetPostOperativeNoteByIdOrPatientId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','8bfde979-6750-4864-10e6-08dc409ed89c'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetPostOperativeNoteByIdOrPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select pn.Id,pn.IPDPatientRecordId,pn.OTScheduleId,pn.Note,pn.UserId,pd.FullName,Hospital.GetCabinNumber(pd.Id) AS CabinNo,rr.Sex,
	CASE WHEN pd.AgeYear <> '' THEN pd.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE pd.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeMonth <> '' THEN pd.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE pd.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeDay <> '' THEN pd.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE pd.AgeDay END AS Age, 
	pd.InvoiceNo,u.UserName
	  from [Hospital].[PostOperativeNotes] pn left join
		   [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd on pn.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id left join
		   Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON pd.UHID = rr.UHID left JOIN
		   Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON pd.Id = ca.PatientId left JOIN
           Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id left JOIN
		   [Identity].[Users] u on pn.UserId=u.Id
	 where ((@PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and pn.Id=@Id) or (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and pn.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId))
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetPreoperativeNoteByIdOrPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select pn.Id,pn.IPDPatientRecordId,pn.OTScheduleId,pn.Note,pn.UserId,pd.FullName,Hospital.GetCabinNumber(pd.Id) AS CabinNo,rr.Sex,
	CASE WHEN pd.AgeYear <> '' THEN pd.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE pd.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeMonth <> '' THEN pd.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE pd.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeDay <> '' THEN pd.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE pd.AgeDay END AS Age,

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetRunningRxIpdTreatmentByUHID] 23122010527,1

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetRunningRxIpdTreatmentByUHID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UHID bigint,
	@NotRunning int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select *
	from
	(
    SELECT tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId,tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration,tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,tbl.DoseStatus,
		   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime,tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,bd.ProductName BrandName,tbl.DoctorId,tbl.ConsultantId,
		   d.Name ConsultantName,tbl.IsManualBrand,tbl.ManualBrand,tbl.RouteOfAdministration,tbl.DisplayOrder
	  FROM (
		SELECT rit1.*
		  FROM (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsDischargeCertificate=0 and IsManualBrand=0) rit1 LEFT JOIN
			   (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsDischargeCertificate=0 and IsManualBrand=0) rit2 ON rit1.BrandExtentionId=rit2.BrandExtentionId and rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=rit2.IPDPatientRecordId AND rit1.Id < rit2.Id
		 where rit2.Id IS NULL and ((rit1.Status='Running' and @NotRunning=0) or (@NotRunning=1 and rit1.Status!='Running'))
	  ) tbl INNER JOIN 
	      [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on pd.Id=tbl.IPDPatientRecordId and UHID=@UHID INNER JOIN
		  [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on tbl.BrandExtentionId=bd.ProductId left join
		  [Marketing].[Doctors] d on tbl.ConsultantId=d.Id
	union
    SELECT tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId,tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration,tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,tbl.DoseStatus,
		   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime,tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,tbl.ManualBrand BrandName,tbl.DoctorId,tbl.ConsultantId,
		   d.Name ConsultantName,tbl.IsManualBrand,tbl.ManualBrand,tbl.RouteOfAdministration,tbl.DisplayOrder
	  FROM (
		SELECT rit1.*
		  FROM (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsDischargeCertificate=0 and IsManualBrand=1) rit1 LEFT JOIN
			   (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsDischargeCertificate=0 and IsManualBrand=1) rit2 ON rit1.ManualBrand=rit2.ManualBrand and rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=rit2.IPDPatientRecordId AND rit1.Id < rit2.Id
		 where rit2.Id IS NULL and ((rit1.Status='Running' and @NotRunning=0) or (@NotRunning=1 and rit1.Status!='Running'))
	  ) tbl INNER JOIN 
	      [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on pd.Id=tbl.IPDPatientRecordId and UHID=@UHID left JOIN
		  [Marketing].[Doctors] d on tbl.ConsultantId=d.Id
	)tbl1
	ORDER BY tbl1.DisplayOrder,tbl1.StartDate
  
END
GO

-- exec [Hospital].[SpGetRxIpdTreatmentByPatientId] 'BFE62434-E5FA-4836-DC4D-08DCFA4EA642', 0

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetRxIpdTreatmentByPatientId]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,
	@DischargeFlag int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	if(@DischargeFlag=0)
	begin
	    select tbl1.*
		from
		(
		SELECT tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId, tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration,tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,tbl.DoseStatus,
			   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime, tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,bd.ProductName BrandName,tbl.DoctorId,tbl.ConsultantId,
			   d.Name ConsultantName,tbl.ManualBrand,tbl.IsManualBrand,tbl.RouteOfAdministration,tbl.IsDischargeCertificate,tbl.DisplayOrder, tbl.CreatedOn
		  FROM (
			SELECT rit1.*
			  FROM (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsManualBrand=0) rit1 LEFT JOIN
				   (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsManualBrand=0) rit2 ON rit1.BrandExtentionId=rit2.BrandExtentionId and rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=rit2.IPDPatientRecordId AND rit1.Id < rit2.Id
			 where rit2.Id IS NULL AND rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
		  ) tbl LEFT JOIN 
			  [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on tbl.BrandExtentionId=bd.ProductId left join
			  [Marketing].[Doctors] d on tbl.ConsultantId=d.Id
		
		UNION
		  
		SELECT tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId, tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration,tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,tbl.DoseStatus,
			   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime,tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,tbl.ManualBrand BrandName,tbl.DoctorId,tbl.ConsultantId,
			   d.Name ConsultantName,tbl.ManualBrand,tbl.IsManualBrand,tbl.RouteOfAdministration,tbl.IsDischargeCertificate,tbl.DisplayOrder, tbl.CreatedOn
		  FROM (
			SELECT rit1.*
			  FROM (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsDischargeCertificate=0 and IsManualBrand=1) rit1 LEFT JOIN
				   (select * from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] where IsDischargeCertificate=0 and IsManualBrand=1) rit2 ON rit1.ManualBrand=rit2.ManualBrand and rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=rit2.IPDPatientRecordId AND rit1.Id < rit2.Id
			 where rit2.Id IS NULL AND rit1.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
		  ) tbl left JOIN 
			  [Marketing].[Doctors] d on tbl.ConsultantId=d.Id
	    ) tbl1
		ORDER BY (
			 case tbl1.Status 
			 when 'Running' then 0 
			 when 'Stopped' then 1
			 when 'Hold' then 2
			 end
		),tbl1.DisplayOrder, tbl1.CreatedOn desc
	end
	else
	begin
		select tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId,tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration, tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,tbl.DoseStatus,
			   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime,tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,bd.ProductName BrandName,tbl.DoctorId,tbl.ConsultantId,
			   d.Name ConsultantName,tbl.ManualBrand,tbl.IsManualBrand,tbl.RouteOfAdministration,tbl.IsDischargeCertificate,tbl.DisplayOrder
		  from [Hospital].[RxIpdTreatments] tbl left join
		       [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on tbl.BrandExtentionId=bd.ProductId left join
			   [Marketing].[Doctors] d on tbl.ConsultantId=d.Id
		  where tbl.IsDischargeCertificate=1 and tbl.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
		  order by tbl.DisplayOrder, tbl.CreatedOn desc
	end
  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[spGetRxTreatmentLogs]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- exec Hospital.spGetRxTreatmentLogs '35645403-561A-4E5D-B41B-08DCFB1CE437'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetRxTreatmentLogs]
	@treatmentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	WITH EventsCTE AS (
		SELECT
			TreatmentId,
			UserId,
			EventName,
			CreatedAt,
			LEAD(EventName) OVER (PARTITION BY TreatmentId, UserId ORDER BY CreatedAt) AS NextEvent,
			LEAD(CreatedAt) OVER (PARTITION BY TreatmentId, UserId ORDER BY CreatedAt) AS NextEventDate
		FROM Hospital.RxIpdTreatmentLogs
	)
	SELECT
		TreatmentId,
		UserId,
		EventName,
		CreatedAt AS StartedAt,
		isnull(NextEventDate, getdate()) AS EndedAt
	FROM EventsCTE
	WHERE TreatmentId = @treatmentId;
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetSaveConsultancyPaymentRecord]

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SPGetSaveConsultancyPaymentRecordDetailByRecordId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-----exec [Hospital].[SPGetSaveConsultancyPaymentRecordDetailByRecordId] 'dbce7047-f541-49a5-18c1-08db8d27867a'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetSaveConsultancyPaymentRecordDetailByRecordId]
	@RecordId uniqueidentifier
	
AS
BEGIN

		select 
		BillNo, PatientName, DoctorName, ServiceName, ServiceDate, convert(float,ServiceRate) ServiceRate, Discount,
		convert(float, ServiceRate - Discount) Payable, Paid, ServiceType, ServiceRecordId
		
		from 
				(
				select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						convert(date,ic.ServiceDate) ServiceDate, ic.Rate ServiceRate, ic.Discount Discount, rd.ServicePayableAmount Paid, rd.ServiceType,rd.ServiceRecordId
				from [Hospital].[SaveConsultancyPaymentRecordDetails] rd 
				join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on rd.ServiceType='Consultancy' and rd.ServiceRecordId=ic.Id
				join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i on ic.IPDPatientId=i.Id
				join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
				join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
				where rd.RecordId=@RecordId

				Union All
						select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						convert(date,od.CreatedOn) ServiceDate, od.Rate ServiceRate, od.Discount Discount, 0 paid, rd.ServiceType, s.Id ServiceRecordId
					from [Hospital].[SaveConsultancyPaymentRecordDetails] rd
					join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on rd.ServiceType='OT' and rd.ServiceRecordId=od.Id
					join Hospital.OTServices s on od.OTServiceId=s.Id
					join Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i on s.IPDPatientId=i.Id
					join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
					join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
					where rd.RecordId=@RecordId
					)T

END
GO

-- Exec [Hospital].[spGetServiceExecutingHeadByServicetype]  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',1,1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[spGetServiceExecutingHeadByServicetype]
	@ServiceType uniqueidentifier,
	@TenantId int,
	@IsActive int
AS
BEGIN
	declare @emtyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT sh.Id,isnull(sh.HeadName,'') HeadName,isnull(hr.Rate,cast(0 as real)) Rate,hr.VAT,hr.IsServiceChargeApplicable,hr.DocVisit,hr.OpdShow,sh.ServiceSubSubGroupId,sssg.Name ServiceSubSubGroup,hr.ConsultantCommInPercent,hr.HospitalCommInPercent,isnull(hr.ProcedureWeight,'')ProcedureWeight,isnull(sh.ServiceCode,'')ServiceCode,hr.ServiceChargeInPercent,hr.PoorFund,isnull(sh.ServiceType,'')ServiceType,hr.IsActive
	FROM [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] sh LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] sssg ON sh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=sssg.Id LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubGroups] ssg ON sssg.ServiceSubGroupId=ssg.Id LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceGroups] sg ON sg.Id = ssg.ServiceGroupId LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeadRates] hr on sh.Id=hr.ServiceExecutingHeadId --and hr.TenantId = @TenantId
	WHERE 
	(@ServiceType = @emtyId or sg.Id=@ServiceType) 
	and (hr.IsActive=(@IsActive+1) or @IsActive=1)

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SpGetServiceHeadWiseIncomeReport]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- =============================================
CREATE         PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetServiceHeadWiseIncomeReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column
----- 17. ServiceGroupID [GUID] , 18. ServiceSubGroupId [GUID] , 19. ServiceSubSubGroupID [GUID], 20. ServiceHeadID [GUID], 21. DepartmentID [GUID], 22. CabinTypeID [GUID] 

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetServiceHeadWiseIncomeReport]'2025-01-01,2025-01-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN



	DECLARE		
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@ServiceGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceSubGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceSubSubGroupID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ServiceHeadID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@DepartmentID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@CabinTypeID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ServiceGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=17
	Select @ServiceSubGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=18
	Select @ServiceSubSubGroupID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=19
	Select @ServiceHeadID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=20
	Select @DepartmentID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=21
	Select @CabinTypeID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=22

------SELECT @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@ServiceGroupID,@ServiceSubGroupID,@ServiceSubSubGroupID,@ServiceHeadID,@DepartmentID,@paramas



	SELECT seh.id,seh.HeadName AS IncomeHeadName, SUM(ir1.Amount) AS TotalAmount 
	INTO #TempSpGetServiceHeadWiseIncomeReport
	FROM Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir
	JOIN Hospital.IPDServiceRecords ir1 ON ir1.IPDPatientId=ir.Id
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=ir1.ServiceId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=seh.ServiceSubSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceGroups sg ON sg.id=ssg.ServiceGroupId
	JOIN Hospital.Cabins c ON c.id=ir.AdmittedCabinId
	JOIN Hospital.CabinTypes ct ON ct.id=c.CabinTypeId

	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>= @FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate
	AND (@ServiceGroupID=sg.id OR @ServiceGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubGroupID=ssg.id OR @ServiceSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceSubSubGroupID=sssg.id OR @ServiceSubSubGroupID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ServiceHeadID=seh.id OR @ServiceHeadID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (ir.DeptId=@DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID= '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (ct.id=@CabinTypeID OR @CabinTypeID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	GROUP BY seh.id,seh.HeadName




		select(
	select * from(


						SELECT
						IncomeHeadName,
						TotalAmount

						FROM #TempSpGetServiceHeadWiseIncomeReport

						-----ORDER BY IncomeHeadName
	) tbl  
	ORDER BY tbl.IncomeHeadName
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END
GO

-- Exec [Hospital].[SpGetServiceIncomeShare]  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',1

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetServiceIncomeShare]
	@ServiceType uniqueidentifier,
	@TenantId int
AS
BEGIN
	declare @emtyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT sh.Id ExecutingServiceHeadId,isnull(sh.HeadName,'') HeadName,isnull(hr.Rate,cast(0 as real)) Rate,sh.ServiceSubSubGroupId,sssg.Name ServiceSubSubGroup,isnull(sh.ServiceCode,'')ServiceCode,isnull(sh.ServiceType,'')ServiceType,hr.IsActive,
		   isnull(sih.Id, @emtyId) Id,sih.HospitalShareInPercent,sih.HospitalShareInTk,sih.DoctorShareInPercent,sih.DoctorShareInTk,sih.DoctorDutyType,isnull(sih.DoctorId,@emtyId) DoctorId
	FROM [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] sh LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubSubGroups] sssg ON sh.ServiceSubSubGroupId=sssg.Id LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceSubGroups] ssg ON sssg.ServiceSubGroupId=ssg.Id LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceGroups] sg ON sg.Id = ssg.ServiceGroupId LEFT JOIN
		 [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeadRates] hr on sh.Id=hr.ServiceExecutingHeadId LEFT JOIN --and hr.TenantId = @TenantId 
		 [Hospital].[ServiceIncomeShares] sih on sh.Id=sih.ExecutingServiceHeadId
	WHERE 
	(@ServiceType = @emtyId or sg.Id=@ServiceType) 

END

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetTotalCorporateIncome]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[SpGetTotalCorporateIncome]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@CorporateClientID int


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @CorporateClientID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14
	
					

					Select * INTO #tempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary from(

					SELECT   ReportType,--billNo,
					      Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due,
							 CCName,
							 count(distinct patientID) patientIDCount
					FROM (

					SELECT 'Diagnostic' AS ReportType, --i.InvoiceNo BillNo,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=0 THEN iil.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=1 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN iil.TransactionType=2 THEN iil.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,
							0 Due,
							c.Name CCName,
							i.Id patientID
							

							FROM  Diag.InvestigationInvoices i
							JOIN Diag.InvestigationInvoiceLedgers iil ON i.Id = iil.InvestigationInvoiceId
							JOIN Marketing.CorporateClients c on c.Id = i.CorporateClientId
							--LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom ON mjom.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
						 --   --AND mjom.RoleType='Media'
							--LEFT JOIN Marketing. MarketingJOfficerOrMedias mjom1 ON mjom1.id=i.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId
							--AND mjom1.RoleType='JMO'
							--LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingOfficers mo ON mo.id=mjom1.MarketingOfficerId
							--LEFT JOIN Marketing.MarketingManagers mm ON mm.id=mo.MarketingManagerId
							--LEFT JOIN Marketing.HoDs hd ON hd.id=mm.HoDId
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
							AND (i.CorporateClientId=@CorporateClientID OR @CorporateClientID=0)
					

							UNION ALL
							SELECT 'Hospital' AS ReportType, --ir.InvoiceNo BillNo,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=0 THEN fbl.Debit ELSE 0 END TotalBill,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=1 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Discount,
							CASE WHEN fbl.TransactionType=2 THEN fbl.Credit ELSE 0 END Received,0 Due,
							c.Name ,
							ir.Id

							FROM  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords ir 
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBills fb  ON ir.Id = fb.IPDPatientRecordId
							JOIN Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fbl  ON fb.Id=fbl.FinalBillId
							JOin Marketing.CorporateClients c on c.id = ir.CorporationId
							WHERE CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,ir.DischargedDateTime)<=@FilterEndDate
						    AND (ir.CorporationId=@CorporateClientID OR @CorporateClientID=0)

							) T
							GROUP BY  ReportType,CCName
							)TT


							 
					select(
							select * from(

							select 
							ReportType,
							CCName,
							patientIDCount NoofPatient,
					         Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0) TotalBill,
							 Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)Discount,
							 Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) Received,
							 Isnull(Sum(TotalBill),0)-Isnull(Sum(Discount) ,0)-Isnull(Sum(Received) ,0) AS Due
							
							 
							from #tempSpGetMarketingOfficerBasedIncomeRefDoctorBySummary
							Group by ReportType,CCName,patientIDCount

								) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

--Exec [Hospital].[SpGetTransferNoteByIdOrPatientId] '16B5BF9B-3CDA-4D36-A8C3-08DB166B95E8','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetTransferNoteByIdOrPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select tn.Id,tn.IPDPatientRecordId,tn.OTScheduleId,tn.NoteDateTime,tn.Note,tn.UserId
		   ,pd.FullName,Hospital.GetCabinNumber(pd.Id) AS CabinNo,rr.Sex,
	CASE WHEN pd.AgeYear <> '' THEN pd.AgeYear + 'Y ' ELSE pd.AgeYear END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeMonth <> '' THEN pd.AgeMonth + 'M ' ELSE pd.AgeMonth END + CASE WHEN pd.AgeDay <> '' THEN pd.AgeDay + 'D' ELSE pd.AgeDay END AS Age, 
	pd.InvoiceNo,u.UserName
	  from [Hospital].[TransferNotes] tn left join
		   [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd on tn.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id inner join
		   Hospital.RegRecords AS rr ON pd.UHID = rr.UHID INNER JOIN
		   Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON pd.Id = ca.PatientId INNER JOIN
           Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id left JOIN
		   [Identity].[Users] u on tn.UserId=u.Id 
	 where ((@PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and tn.Id=@Id) or (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and tn.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId)) and ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SpGetTreatmentOnDischargeByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select tbl.Id,tbl.IPDPatientRecordId, tbl.UpToDate, tbl.BrandExtentionId,tbl.Dosage,tbl.Duration,tbl.Note,tbl.Status,tbl.StartDate,tbl.StartTime,tbl.DoseStatus,
			   tbl.StopDate,tbl.StopTime,tbl.StoppingNote,tbl.HoldDate,tbl.HoldingTime,tbl.HoldingNote,tbl.DoseId,tbl.UserId,isnull(bd.ProductName,tbl.ManualBrand) BrandName,tbl.DoctorId,tbl.ConsultantId,
			   d.Name ConsultantName,tbl.ManualBrand,tbl.IsManualBrand,tbl.RouteOfAdministration,tbl.IsDischargeCertificate,tbl.DisplayOrder,bd.Generic
		  from [EMR].[TreatmentOnDischarges] tbl left join

		  where tbl.IsDischargeCertificate=1 and tbl.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
		  order by tbl.DisplayOrder
END

 --     exec Hospital.SPGetVitalSignWithUHID    2412080000702
CREATE   PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetVitalSignWithUHID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UHID bigint
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	select h.UHID, h.FullName, h.AgeYear,h.AgeMonth,h.AgeDay, h.Dob,
	h.Sex As Gender,
	v.Id as VitalSingId, h.MobileNo, h.FatherName, h.MotherName,h.UHID , d.Name as DoctorName from Hospital.VitalSignRecords as v
	Join Hospital.RegRecords as h  ON v.UHID = h.UHID  
	left join VWDoctors as  D   ON  D.Id = h.RefdId
	where v.UHID = @UHID
	select vr.CheckUpDate, vr.Id, vrd.BindDropDownValue, vrd.BindValue, vrd.DynamicFormDId, dic.LabelText As InputFiled from Hospital.VitalSignRecords as vr 
	join Hospital.VitalSignRecordDetails as vrd ON vrd.MasterId = vr.Id
	join Hospital.DynamicInputControls as dic On dic.Id = vrd.ControltypeId  where vr.UHID = @UHID
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPGetVitalSignWithVitalNo]
	@VitalNo bigint
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select 
	  h.UHID, 
	  h.FullName, 
	  h.AgeYear, 
	  h.AgeMonth, 
	  h.AgeDay, 
	  h.Dob, 
	  h.Sex As Gender, 
	  v.Id as VitalSingId, 
	  h.MobileNo, 
	  h.FatherName, 
	  h.MotherName, 
	  h.UHID, 
	  d.Name as DoctorName,
	  v.VitalNo,
	  v.CreatedOn EntryTime

	from 
	  Hospital.VitalSignRecords as v 
	  Join Hospital.RegRecords as h ON v.UHID = h.UHID 
	  left join VWDoctors as D ON D.Id = h.RefdId 
	where 
	  v.VitalNo = @VitalNo 

	select 
	  vr.CheckUpDate, 
	  vr.Id, 
	  vrd.BindDropDownValue, 
	  vrd.BindValue, 
	  vrd.DynamicFormDId, 
	  dic.LabelText As InputFiled 
	from 
	  Hospital.VitalSignRecords as vr 
	  join Hospital.VitalSignRecordDetails as vrd ON vrd.MasterId = vr.Id 
	  join Hospital.DynamicInputControls as dic On dic.Id = vrd.ControltypeId 
	where 
	  vr.VitalNo = @VitalNo

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Hospital].[SPIPDDoctorPaymentByDueFlag]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-----exec [Hospital].[SPIPDDoctorPaymentByDueFlag] '2022-01-01','2024-01-01',1
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[SPIPDDoctorPaymentByDueFlag]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@DueFlag int
	
AS
BEGIN

		select 
		BillNo, PatientName, DoctorName, ServiceName, ServiceDate, convert(float,ServiceRate) ServiceRate, Discount,
		convert(float, ServiceRate - Discount) Payable, convert(float,ServiceRate - Discount) Paid, ServiceType, ServiceRecordId
		
		from 
				(
				select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						convert(date,ic.ServiceDate) ServiceDate, ic.Rate ServiceRate, ic.Discount Discount, 0 Paid, 'Consultancy' ServiceType,ic.Id ServiceRecordId
				from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
				join Hospital.IPDConsultantServices ic on ic.IPDPatientId=i.Id
				join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=ic.ServiceId
				join VWDoctors d on d.Id=ic.ConsultantId
				where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate and ic.IsConsultancyPaId=@DueFlag

				Union All
						select i.InvoiceNo BillNo,i.FullName PatientName, d.Name DoctorName, sh.HeadName ServiceName,
						convert(date,od.CreatedOn) ServiceDate, od.Rate ServiceRate, od.Discount Discount, 0 paid, 'OT' ServiceType, od.Id ServiceRecordId
					from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords i
					join Hospital.OTServices s on s.IPDPatientId=i.Id
					join Hospital.OTServiceDetails od on od.OTServiceId=s.Id
					join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads sh on sh.Id=od.ServiceHeadId
					join VWDoctors d on d.Id=od.DoctorId
					where convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,i.DischargedDateTime) <= @FilterEndDate and od.IsConsultancyPaId=@DueFlag
					)T

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[UserWiseCollectionSummary]
	@paramas nvarchar (max)
--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[UserWiseCollectionSummary]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE		
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@cols as NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @colName as NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @sql as NVARCHAR(MAX)

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5


		SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'#TempUserWiseCollectionSummary') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsTable') = 1)
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	END

	--SET @cols='[Department],[Particulars],[CashCollection],[CardCollection],[MobileCollection],[RefundAmount],[Total],[ReceiverName]'
 
 --SET @colName=REPLACE(@cols,']','] NVARCHAR(MAX)')
 
 --SET @sql = 'create table #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary('+@colName+')'
 --execute(@sql)

 create table #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
 (
	[Department] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[Particulars] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[CashCollection] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[CardCollection] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[MobileCollectionBKS] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[MobileCollectionNogod] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[Cheque] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[RefundAmount] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[Total] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[ReceiverName] NVARCHAR(MAX)
 )
 -----------------------------Start Hospital-----------------------------
	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpCash ',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=1 and pm.Id=1)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpCard ',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=2 or pc.Id=3 or pc.Id=4  and pm.Id=2)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

		INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpMobileBkash ',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=5 and pm.Id=3)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpMobileNagad ',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=7 and pm.Id=3)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpCheque ',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=0 and pm.Id=4)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpReturn',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(fl.AdvanceReturnAmount),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.AdvancePayments fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId

	and convert(date,PayDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId

 WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=2 or pc.Id=3 or pc.Id=4  and pm.Id=2)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName


	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  SELECT   'OPD','OPDMobileBkash',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName

  select  [ReceiverName],
  isnull(HpCash,0) HpCash, isnull(HpCard,0) HpCard, isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) HpMobileBkash,isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) HpMobileNagad,isnull(hpcheque,0)HpCheque,isnull(HpReturn,0)HpReturn,
   isnull(HpCash,0) + isnull(HpCard,0) + isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) + isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) + isnull(hpcheque,0) - isnull(HpReturn,0) HpSubTotal,

  isnull(OPDCash,0) OPDCash,isnull(OPDCard,0) OPDCard,isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) OPDMobileBkash,isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) OPDMobileNagad,isnull(OPDCheque,0) OPDCheque,isnull(OPDReturn,0) OPDReturn,
  isnull(OPDCash,0) + isnull(OPDCard,0) + isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) + isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) + isnull(OPDCheque,0) - isnull(OPDReturn,0) OPDSubTotal,

  isnull(PhCash,0) PhCash,isnull(PhCard,0) PhCard,isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) PhMobileBikash,isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) PhMobileNagad,isnull(PhCheque,0) PhCheque,isnull(PhReturn,0) PhReturn,
  isnull(PhCash,0) + isnull(PhCard,0) + isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) + isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) + isnull(PhCheque,0) - isnull(PhReturn,0) PhSubTotal,

    isnull(CanteenCash,0) CanteenCash,isnull(CanteenCard,0) CanteenCard,isnull(CanteenBikash,0) CanteenBikash,isnull(CanteenNagad,0) CanteenNagad,isnull(CanteenCheque,0) CanteenCheque,isnull(CanteenReturn,0) CanteenReturn,
  isnull(CanteenCash,0) + isnull(CanteenCard,0) + isnull(CanteenBikash,0) + isnull(CanteenNagad,0) + isnull(CanteenCheque,0) - isnull(CanteenReturn,0) CanteenSubTotal,

  isnull(HpCash,0) + isnull(HpCard,0) + isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) + isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) + isnull(hpcheque,0) - isnull(HpReturn,0)+
  isnull(OPDCash,0) + isnull(OPDCard,0) + isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) + isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) + isnull(OPDCheque,0) - isnull(OPDReturn,0)+
  isnull(PhCash,0) + isnull(PhCard,0) + isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) + isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) + isnull(PhCheque,0) - isnull(PhReturn,0)+
  isnull(CanteenCash,0) + isnull(CanteenCard,0) + isnull(CanteenBikash,0) + isnull(CanteenNagad,0) + isnull(CanteenCheque,0) - isnull(CanteenReturn,0)
  [NetCollection]

  from 
  (
  select Particulars,
  isnull( Convert(float,IsNull(Total,0)),0) Total,
	[ReceiverName]
 from #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
 --where Department='Diagnostic'
 ) as s
 PIVOT
 (
		sum([Total]) 
		For Particulars in (HpCash,HpCard,HpMobileBkash,HpMobileNagad,HpCheque,HpReturn,
		OPDCash,OPDCard,OPDMobileBkash,OPDMobileNagad,OPDCheque,OPDReturn,
		PhCash,PhCard,PhMobileBikash,PhMobileNagad, PhCheque,PhReturn,
		CanteenCash,CanteenCard,CanteenBikash, CanteenNagad,CanteenCheque,CanteenReturn
		)
	)
  As PVT
  group by [ReceiverName],HpCash,HpCard,HpMobileBkash,HpMobileNagad,HpCheque,HpReturn,
	OPDCash,OPDCard,OPDMobileBkash,OPDMobileNagad,OPDCheque,OPDReturn,
	PhCash,PhCard,PhMobileBikash,PhMobileNagad, PhCheque,PhReturn,
	CanteenCash,CanteenCard,CanteenBikash, CanteenNagad,CanteenCheque,CanteenReturn
  order by [ReceiverName]
  

	
END

  --select * from #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  select (
  select * from (
  select  [ReceiverName],
  isnull(HpCash,0) HpCash, isnull(HpCard,0) HpCard, isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) HpMobileBkash,isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) HpMobileNagad,isnull(hpcheque,0)HpCheque,isnull(HpReturn,0)HpReturn,
   isnull(HpCash,0) + isnull(HpCard,0) + isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) + isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) + isnull(hpcheque,0) - isnull(HpReturn,0) HpSubTotal,

  isnull(OPDCash,0) OPDCash,isnull(OPDCard,0) OPDCard,isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) OPDMobileBkash,isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) OPDMobileNagad,isnull(OPDCheque,0) OPDCheque,isnull(OPDReturn,0) OPDReturn,

  isnull(PhCash,0) + isnull(PhCard,0) + isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) + isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) + isnull(PhCheque,0) - isnull(PhReturn,0) PhSubTotal,

    isnull(CanteenCash,0) CanteenCash,isnull(CanteenCard,0) CanteenCard,isnull(CanteenBikash,0) CanteenBikash,isnull(CanteenNagad,0) CanteenNagad,isnull(CanteenCheque,0) CanteenCheque,isnull(CanteenReturn,0) CanteenReturn,
  isnull(CanteenCash,0) + isnull(CanteenCard,0) + isnull(CanteenBikash,0) + isnull(CanteenNagad,0) + isnull(CanteenCheque,0) - isnull(CanteenReturn,0) CanteenSubTotal,

  isnull(HpCash,0) + isnull(HpCard,0) + isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) + isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) + isnull(hpcheque,0) - isnull(HpReturn,0)+
  isnull(OPDCash,0) + isnull(OPDCard,0) + isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) + isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) + isnull(OPDCheque,0) - isnull(OPDReturn,0)+
  isnull(PhCash,0) + isnull(PhCard,0) + isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) + isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) + isnull(PhCheque,0) - isnull(PhReturn,0)+
  isnull(CanteenCash,0) + isnull(CanteenCard,0) + isnull(CanteenBikash,0) + isnull(CanteenNagad,0) + isnull(CanteenCheque,0) - isnull(CanteenReturn,0)
  [NetCollection]

  from 
  (
  select Particulars,
  isnull( Convert(float,IsNull(Total,0)),0) Total,
	[ReceiverName]
 from #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
 --where Department='Diagnostic'
 ) as s
 PIVOT
 (
		sum([Total]) 
		For Particulars in (HpCash,HpCard,HpMobileBkash,HpMobileNagad,HpCheque,HpReturn,
		OPDCash,OPDCard,OPDMobileBkash,OPDMobileNagad,OPDCheque,OPDReturn,
		PhCash,PhCard,PhMobileBikash,PhMobileNagad, PhCheque,PhReturn,
		CanteenCash,CanteenCard,CanteenBikash, CanteenNagad,CanteenCheque,CanteenReturn
		)
	)
  As PVT
  group by [ReceiverName],HpCash,HpCard,HpMobileBkash,HpMobileNagad,HpCheque,HpReturn,
	OPDCash,OPDCard,OPDMobileBkash,OPDMobileNagad,OPDCheque,OPDReturn,
	PhCash,PhCard,PhMobileBikash,PhMobileNagad, PhCheque,PhReturn,
	CanteenCash,CanteenCard,CanteenBikash, CanteenNagad,CanteenCheque,CanteenReturn
	) tbl
  order by tbl.[ReceiverName] 
  FOR JSON AUTO
  ) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Hospital].[UserWiseCollectionSummaryDynamicBSOH]
	@paramas nvarchar (max)

--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Hospital].[UserWiseCollectionSummaryDynamicBSOH]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE		
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@cols as NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @colName as NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @sql as NVARCHAR(MAX)

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5


		SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'#TempUserWiseCollectionSummary') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsTable') = 1)
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	END

	--SET @cols='[Department],[Particulars],[CashCollection],[CardCollection],[MobileCollection],[RefundAmount],[Total],[ReceiverName]'
 
 --SET @colName=REPLACE(@cols,']','] NVARCHAR(MAX)')
 
 --SET @sql = 'create table #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary('+@colName+')'
 --execute(@sql)

 create table #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
 (
	[Department] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[Particulars] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[CashCollection] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[CardCollection] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[MobileCollectionBKS] NVARCHAR(MAX),

	[RefundAmount] NVARCHAR(MAX),
	[Total] NVARCHAR(MAX),

 )
 -----------------------------Start Hospital-----------------------------
	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
	SELECT   'Hospital','HpCash ',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
	FROM            Hospital.FinalBillLedgers fl
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=1 and pm.Id=1)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

	and convert(date,PayDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate

	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
	WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=2 or pc.Id=3 or pc.Id=4  and pm.Id=2)
	and convert(date,TranDateTime) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

	---------------advance

 FROM            Canteen.SaleLedgers fl
 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
 WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=1 and pm.Id=1)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName

				INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  SELECT   'Pharmacy','CanteenCard',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
 FROM            Canteen.SaleLedgers fl
 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
 WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=2 or pc.Id=3 or pc.Id=4  and pm.Id=2)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName


				INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  SELECT   'Pharmacy','CanteenBikash',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
 FROM            Canteen.SaleLedgers fl
 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
 WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=5 and pm.Id=3)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName


				INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  SELECT   'Pharmacy','CanteenNagad',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
 FROM            Canteen.SaleLedgers fl
 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
 WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=7 and pm.Id=3)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName


	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  SELECT   'Pharmacy','CanteenCheque',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
 FROM            Canteen.SaleLedgers fl
 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
 WHERE        (TransactionType =2 and pc.Id=0 and pm.Id=4)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName


	INSERT INTO #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  SELECT   'Pharmacy','CanteenReturn',0,0,0,0,0,0,SUM(Credit - Debit),u.UserName
 FROM            Canteen.SaleLedgers fl
 join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.id=fl.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.id=pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=fl.UserId
 WHERE        (TransactionType =0)
	and convert(date,TranDate) between  @FilterStartDate   and  @FilterEndDate
	and (UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by UserName


	 




-----------------------------End Canteen-----------------------------

  --select * from #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
  select (
  select * from (
  select  [ReceiverName],
  isnull(HpCash,0) HpCash, isnull(HpCard,0) HpCard, isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) HpMobileBkash,isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) HpMobileNagad,isnull(hpcheque,0)HpCheque,isnull(HpReturn,0)HpReturn,
   isnull(HpCash,0) + isnull(HpCard,0) + isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) + isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) + isnull(hpcheque,0) - isnull(HpReturn,0) HpSubTotal,

  isnull(DiagCash,0) DiagCash,isnull(DiagCard,0) DiagCard,isnull(DiagMobileBkash,0) DiagMobileBkash,isnull(DiagMobileNagad,0) DiagMobileNagad,isnull(DiagCheque,0) DiagCheque,isnull(DiagReturn,0) DiagReturn,
  isnull(DiagCash,0) + isnull(DiagCard,0) + isnull(DiagMobileBkash,0) + isnull(DiagMobileNagad,0) + isnull(DiagCheque,0) - isnull(DiagReturn,0) DiagSubTotal,

  isnull(OPDCash,0) OPDCash,isnull(OPDCard,0) OPDCard,isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) OPDMobileBkash,isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) OPDMobileNagad,isnull(OPDCheque,0) OPDCheque,isnull(OPDReturn,0) OPDReturn,
  isnull(OPDCash,0) + isnull(OPDCard,0) + isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) + isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) + isnull(OPDCheque,0) - isnull(OPDReturn,0) OPDSubTotal,

  isnull(PhCash,0) PhCash,isnull(PhCard,0) PhCard,isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) PhMobileBikash,isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) PhMobileNagad,isnull(PhCheque,0) PhCheque,isnull(PhReturn,0) PhReturn,
  isnull(PhCash,0) + isnull(PhCard,0) + isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) + isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) + isnull(PhCheque,0) - isnull(PhReturn,0) PhSubTotal,

  isnull(CanteenCash,0) CanteenCash,isnull(CanteenCard,0) CanteenCard,isnull(CanteenBikash,0) CanteenBikash,isnull(CanteenNagad,0) CanteenNagad,isnull(CanteenCheque,0) CanteenCheque,isnull(CanteenReturn,0) CanteenReturn,
  isnull(CanteenCash,0) + isnull(CanteenCard,0) + isnull(CanteenBikash,0) + isnull(CanteenNagad,0) + isnull(CanteenCheque,0) - isnull(CanteenReturn,0) CanteenSubTotal,

  isnull(HpCash,0) + isnull(HpCard,0) + isnull(HpMobileBkash,0) + isnull(HpMobileNagad,0) + isnull(hpcheque,0) - isnull(HpReturn,0)+
  isnull(OPDCash,0) + isnull(OPDCard,0) + isnull(OPDMobileBkash,0) + isnull(OPDMobileNagad,0) + isnull(OPDCheque,0) - isnull(OPDReturn,0)+
  isnull(PhCash,0) + isnull(PhCard,0) + isnull(PhMobileBikash,0) + isnull(PhMobileNagad,0) + isnull(PhCheque,0) - isnull(PhReturn,0)+
  isnull(CanteenCash,0) + isnull(CanteenCard,0) + isnull(CanteenBikash,0) + isnull(CanteenNagad,0) + isnull(CanteenCheque,0) - isnull(CanteenReturn,0)
  [NetCollection]

  from 
  (
  select Particulars,
  isnull( Convert(float,IsNull(Total,0)),0) Total,
	[ReceiverName]
 from #TempUserWiseCollectionSummary
 --where Department='Diagnostic'
 ) as s
 PIVOT
 (
		sum([Total]) 
		For Particulars in (HpCash,HpCard,HpMobileBkash,HpMobileNagad,HpCheque,HpReturn,
		DiagCash,DiagCard,DiagMobileBkash,DiagMobileNagad,DiagCheque,DiagReturn,

		OPDCash,OPDCard,OPDMobileBkash,OPDMobileNagad,OPDCheque,OPDReturn,
		PhCash,PhCard,PhMobileBikash,PhMobileNagad, PhCheque,PhReturn,
		CanteenCash,CanteenCard,CanteenBikash, CanteenNagad,CanteenCheque,CanteenReturn
		)
	)
  As PVT
  group by [ReceiverName],HpCash,HpCard,HpMobileBkash,HpMobileNagad,HpCheque,HpReturn,
		DiagCash,DiagCard,DiagMobileBkash,DiagMobileNagad,DiagCheque,DiagReturn,
	OPDCash,OPDCard,OPDMobileBkash,OPDMobileNagad,OPDCheque,OPDReturn,
	PhCash,PhCard,PhMobileBikash,PhMobileNagad, PhCheque,PhReturn,
	CanteenCash,CanteenCard,CanteenBikash, CanteenNagad,CanteenCheque,CanteenReturn
	) tbl
  order by tbl.[ReceiverName] 
  FOR JSON AUTO
  ) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[GetApplicationPermissionById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	select ap.Id,ap.StaffRecordId,ap.DeptId,ap.ApplicationForStaffRecordId,sr.EmployeeName StaffRecordName,sr1.EmployeeName ApplicationForStaffName,d.Name DeptName
	  from [HR].[ApplicationPermissions] ap inner join
		   [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on ap.StaffRecordId=sr.Id left join
		   [HR].[StaffRecords] sr1 on ap.ApplicationForStaffRecordId=sr1.Id left join
		   [HR].[Departments] d on ap.DeptId=d.Id
	 where ap.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
END

-- Exec [HR].[NewEmployeeList] '2022-10-01', '2022-10-25',1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[NewEmployeeList]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@filterEndDate date,
	@DepartmentId int=0
AS
BEGIN
	select s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EmpName, dg.Name Designation, d.Name Department, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
	s.ServiceNature JoiningStatus,isnull(sl.TotalSalary,0) TotalSalary

	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.id
	where convert(date,s.JoiningDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,s.JoiningDate)<=@filterEndDate
	and (d.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
END

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]
--11. EmployeeNo [nvarchar]

--exec [HR].[NewEmployeeListDynamic]'2025-01-01,2025-01-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'


CREATE       PROCEDURE [HR].[NewEmployeeListDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	--@FilterStartDate date,
	--@filterEndDate date,
	--@DepartmentId int=0
AS
BEGIN
Declare
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@filterEndDate date,
	@DepartmentId int=0

		SELECT @FilterStartDate=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @filterEndDate=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
Select @DepartmentId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

		select(
	select * from(

	select s.EmployeeNo , s.EmployeeName , dg.Name Designation, d.Name DepartmentName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
	s.ServiceNature JoiningStatus,isnull(sl.TotalSalary,0) TotalSalary, ISNULL(s.BankAccountNo,0) AS BankAccountNo

	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.id
	where convert(date,s.JoiningDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,s.JoiningDate)<=@filterEndDate
	and (d.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)

		) tbl order by tbl.EmployeeNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGet_EmployeeWise_LeaveStatement]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmpId uniqueidentifier,
	@DeptId int
AS
BEGIN

  create table #TempSpGet_EmployeeWise_LeaveStatement
  (
	[DptName] nvarchar(max),
	EmployeeNo float,
	EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
	JoiningDate date,
	[Designation]  nvarchar(max),
	LeaveApprovedfrom date,
	LeaveApprovedto date,
	CalDate date ,
	vacationtype nvarchar(max),
	[Purpose] nvarchar(max),
	ApplicationId bigint

  )

	Declare @CalDate date
	set @CalDate = @FilterStartDate

	set @CalDate = @FilterStartDate
	while ( @CalDate<=@FilterEndDate)
	begin
		print  @CalDate
				insert into #TempSpGet_EmployeeWise_LeaveStatement
				select  dp.Name [DptName],e.EmployeeNo, e.EmployeeName,e.JoiningDate,dg.Name [Designation],
				d.LeaveApprovedfrom ,d.LeaveApprovedto,@CalDate,l.vacationtype,
				a.AppSubject,a.Id
				from 

				 hr.LeaveApplicationDetails d 
				join hr.LeaveApplications a on a.Id = d.ApplicationId
				join hr.LeaveTypes l on l.Id = d.LeaveTypeId
				join 	hr.StaffRecords e on e.Id=a.StaffRecordId
				join hr.Departments dp on dp.Id=e.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id = e.DesignationId
				where d.LeaveApprovedfrom <= @CalDate
				and  @CalDate <= d.LeaveApprovedto
				and (e.Id = @EmpId or @EmpId=null)
				and (dp.Id = @DeptId or @DeptId=0)
				--order by dp.Name,e.EmployeeNo,d.ApplicationId

		select @CalDate = DATEADD(Day,1,@CalDate)
	end
	select * from #TempSpGet_EmployeeWise_LeaveStatement
	order by [DptName],EmployeeNo,ApplicationId

	--select *
	--from 

	-- LeaveApplicationDetails d 
	--join LeaveApplications a on a.ApplicationId = d.ApplicationId
	--join LeaveTypes l on l.LeavetypeId = d.LeavetypeId
	--join 	EmployeeInfoes e on e.EmployeeId=a.EmployeeId
	--join EmpDepartments dp on dp.DeptId=e.DeptId
	-------where
	------d.LeaveApprovedfrom >= @FilterStartDate
	------and  d.LeaveApprovedfrom <= @FilterEndDate
	------and  d.LeaveApprovedto <= @LastDayofthisMOnth
	------and  l.LeavetypeId = @LeaveType
	------and  e.EmployeeId = @EmployeedId

END

-- Exec [HR].[spGetActiveEmployeeList]

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetActiveEmployeeList]
	@DepartmentId int=0

AS
BEGIN
	SELECT        hr.StaffRecords.EmployeeNo, hr.StaffRecords.EmployeeName, hr.StaffRecords.InActiveReasons,
	hr.StaffRecords.ResignationDate, hr.StaffRecords.JoiningDate, hr.Departments.Name as DepartmentName, 
                         hr.Designations.Name AS Designation

FROM            hr.StaffRecords INNER JOIN
                         hr.Departments ON hr.StaffRecords.DeptId =hr.Departments.Id INNER JOIN
                         hr.Designations ON hr.StaffRecords.DesignationId =   hr.Designations.Id
						 Where (hr.StaffRecords.IsInActive='False')
						 and
						 (hr.Departments.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
END

--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7. StaffrecordId,8. HrDeptId,9. HrSubDeptId, 10. FestivalId  

--exec [HR].[spGetActiveEmployeeListDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetActiveEmployeeListDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	--@DepartmentId int=0

AS
BEGIN

Declare @DepartmentId int

Select @DepartmentId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #tmpTbl


SELECT        hr.StaffRecords.EmployeeNo, hr.StaffRecords.EmployeeName, hr.StaffRecords.InActiveReasons,
	hr.StaffRecords.ResignationDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), hr.StaffRecords.JoiningDate, 101) JoiningDate, hr.Departments.Name as DepartmentName, 
    hr.Designations.Name AS Designation into #tmpTbl

FROM hr.StaffRecords INNER JOIN
	hr.Departments ON hr.StaffRecords.DeptId =hr.Departments.Id INNER JOIN
	hr.Designations ON hr.StaffRecords.DesignationId =   hr.Designations.Id
Where (hr.StaffRecords.IsInActive='False') and
      (hr.Departments.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
SELECT (
	SELECT * FROM #tmpTbl FOR JSON AUTO 
) AS Data
END

-- exec  HR.spGetAllResignedEmployees

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetAllResignedEmployees]
AS
BEGIN
	select r.Id,
		r.EmployeeName,
		r.JoiningDate,
		d.Name Department,
		dn.Name Designation,
		r.EmployeeNo,
		r.ResignationDate
	from  HR.StaffRecords r
	join HR.Departments d on r.DeptId = d.Id
	join HR.Designations dn on r.DesignationId = dn.Id
	where ResignationDate > '2010-01-01'
END

-- Exec [HR].[spGetAttendanceReport] '2022-12-01','2022-12-31','',0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetAttendanceReport]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@datetimefrom varchar(50),
	@datetimeto varchar(50),
	@EmpNo nvarchar(max),
	@DeptId int=0

AS
BEGIN
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail

	Create table #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise
	(
		Autoid int identity(1,1),
		EmployeeNo nvarchar(max),
		EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
		[Shift] nvarchar(50),
		BDate date,
		InTime time,
		OutTime time,
		FirsttHalf nvarchar(50),
		SecondHalf nvarchar(50),
		LateIn  nvarchar(50),
		EarlyOut  nvarchar(50) ,
		OverTime nvarchar(50) ,
		WorkHours  nvarchar(50) ,
		Reason nvarchar(max),
		TargetInTime time,
		TargetOutTime time,
		[StaffID] [uniqueidentifier]
	)


	
	CREATE TABLE #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail(
	[Id] [int]  NOT NULL,
	[ShiftName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
	[StartTime] [datetime2](7) NULL,
	[EndTime] [datetime2](7) NULL,
	[DutyRoasterCalenderId] [int] NULL,
	[EmployeeId] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
	[ShifTypeid] [int] NOT NULL,
	[CreatedBy] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
	[CreatedOn] [datetime2](7) NOT NULL,
	[LastModifiedBy] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
	[LastModifiedOn] [datetime2](7) NULL,
	[IsDeleted] [bit] NOT NULL,
	item [nvarchar](max) NULL
	)
	
	insert into  #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail
	(
	[Id] ,
	[ShiftName] ,
	[StartTime] ,
	[EndTime] ,
	[DutyRoasterCalenderId] ,
	
	 EmployeeId ,
	[ShifTypeid],
	[CreatedBy] ,
	[CreatedOn] ,
	[LastModifiedBy] ,
	[LastModifiedOn] ,
	[IsDeleted] ,
	item 
	
	)
	select 
		[Id] ,
	[ShiftName] ,
	[StartTime] ,
	[EndTime] ,
	[DutyRoasterCalenderId] ,
	
	EmployeeIds EmployeeId ,
	[ShifTypeid],
	[CreatedBy] ,
	[CreatedOn] ,
	[LastModifiedBy] ,
	[LastModifiedOn] ,
	[IsDeleted] ,
	item 
	
	FROM HR.DutyRoasterCalenderDetail  
	CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](EmployeeIds, ',')


	

	insert into #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise
	(
		
		EmployeeNo ,
		EmployeeName ,
		[Shift] ,
		BDate ,
		InTime ,
		OutTime ,
		FirsttHalf ,
		SecondHalf ,
		LateIn ,
		EarlyOut ,
		OverTime ,
		WorkHours ,
		Reason ,
		StaffID
	)
	


	select 
	--len(SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(s.EmployeeNo)),3,100)),
	 s.EmployeeNo,
	--convert(bigint,SUBSTRING(ltrim(s.EmployeeNo),3,100)),
	s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,
	'' [Shift] ,
		b.BDate BDate ,
		null InTime ,
		null OutTime ,
		'' FirsttHalf ,
		'' SecondHalf ,

	on convert(int,SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(s.EmployeeNo)),3,100)) = b.IndRegID
	where 
	convert(date,b.bdate)>=@datetimefrom
	and
	convert(date,b.bdate)<=@datetimeto
	and
	(@EmpNo ='' or s.EmployeeNo =@EmpNo)
	AND
	(s.DeptId = @DeptId or @DeptId =0)

	union 

	select 
	 s.EmployeeNo,
	s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,
	'' [Shift] ,
		b.BDateTime BDate ,
		null InTime ,
		null OutTime ,
		'' FirsttHalf ,
		'' SecondHalf ,
		0 LateIn ,
		0 EarlyOut ,
		0 OverTime ,
		0 WorkHours ,
		'' Reason,
		s.Id
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join [HR].[ManualAttendanceDetails] b

	on s.Id = b.StaffRecordId
	where 
	convert(date,b.BDateTime)>=@datetimefrom
	and
	convert(date,b.BDateTime)<=@datetimeto
	and
	(@EmpNo ='' or s.EmployeeNo =@EmpNo)

					join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = DD.item

					and convert(date,#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate)  = convert(date, DD.StartTime)
			)
	),'')

	

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	TargetInTime =
	isnull((
		select distinct convert(time,drcd.StartTime) from #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail drcd

		 where drcd.Id =
			(
				select min(dd.Id) from hr.RoasterType ry
					join #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail DD on dd.ShifTypeid = ry.Id
					join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = DD.item
					where SR.EmployeeNo = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo
					and convert(date,#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate)  = convert(date, DD.StartTime)
			)
	),'')

	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	TargetOutTime =
	isnull((
		select distinct convert(time,drcd.endtime) from #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail drcd 
		 join hr.RoasterType rtt on rtt.Id = drcd.ShifTypeid
		 where drcd.Id =
			(
				select min(dd.Id) from hr.RoasterType ry
					join #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail DD on dd.ShifTypeid = ry.Id
					join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = DD.item
					where SR.EmployeeNo = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo
					and convert(date,#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate)  = convert(date, DD.StartTime)
			)
	),'')
	--update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	--LateIn=TargetInTime - InTime  

	

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	LateIn = format(cast(InTime as datetime) - cast(TargetInTime as datetime), 'HH:mm')
	where TargetInTime < InTime

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	EarlyOut = format(cast(TargetOutTime as datetime) - cast(OutTime as datetime), 'HH:mm')
	where OutTime < TargetOutTime
	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	WorkHours = format(cast(OutTime as datetime) - cast(InTime as datetime), 'HH:mm')
	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	OverTime = (select CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(S, DATEDIFF(S, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime), '1900-1-1'), 8) AS 'hh:mm:ss')
	where #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime <#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime

	--select * from #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail
	select  * from #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise t
	--where Intime  <> '00:00:00.0000000'
	
	order by t.EmployeeNo desc 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail

END

	convert(date,b.bdate)<=@datetimeto
	and
	(@EmpNo ='' or s.EmployeeNo =@EmpNo)
	AND
	(s.DeptId = @DeptId or @DeptId =0)

	union 

	select 
	 s.EmployeeNo,
	s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,
	'' [Shift] ,
		b.BDateTime BDate ,
		null InTime ,
		null OutTime ,
		'' FirsttHalf ,
		'' SecondHalf ,
		0 LateIn ,
		0 LateInNum,
		0 EarlyOut ,
		0 OverTime ,
		0 OverTimeNum,
		0 WorkHours ,
		'' Reason,
		s.Id
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join [HR].[ManualAttendanceDetails] b
	--on convert(int,SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(s.EmployeeNo)),3,100)) = b.StaffRecordId
	on s.Id = b.StaffRecordId
	where 
	convert(date,b.BDateTime)>=@datetimefrom
	and
	convert(date,b.BDateTime)<=@datetimeto
	and
	(@EmpNo ='' or s.EmployeeNo =@EmpNo)
	AND
	(s.DeptId = @DeptId or @DeptId =0)
	

	--select * from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] b
	--join #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise t

	
	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	InTime =
	isnull((
		select bbb.intime from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] bbb
		where bbb.id in 
		(
			select min(b.id) from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] b
			where convert(int,SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo)),3,100)) = b.IndRegID
			and convert(date,b.bdate) = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate
		)
	),'')

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	OutTime =
	(
		select bbb.outtime from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] bbb
		where bbb.id in 
		(
			select max(b.id) from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] b
			where convert(int,SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo)),3,100)) = b.IndRegID
			and convert(date,b.bdate) = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate
			and b.outtime is not null
		)
	)

	
	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	InTime =
	isnull((
		select bbb.intime from [HR].[ManualAttendanceDetails] bbb
		where bbb.id in 
		(
			select min(b.id) from [HR].[ManualAttendanceDetails] b
			where #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.StaffID = b.StaffRecordId
			and convert(date,b.BDateTime) = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate
		)
	),'')
	where InTime is null or Intime  = '00:00:00.0000000'


	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	OutTime =
	isnull((
		select bbb.outtime from [HR].[ManualAttendanceDetails] bbb
		where bbb.id in 
		(
			select max(b.id) from [HR].[ManualAttendanceDetails] b
			where #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.StaffID = b.StaffRecordId
			and convert(date,b.BDateTime) = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate
			and b.outtime is not null
		)
	),'')
	where OutTime is null or Outtime  = '00:00:00.0000000'
	

	--update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	--InSortableDateTime =
	--(
	--	select convert(datetime,bbb.InSortableDateTime) from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] bbb
	--	where bbb.id in 
	--	(
	--		select min(b.id) from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] b
	--		where convert(int,SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo)),3,100)) = b.IndRegID
	--		and convert(date,b.bdate) = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate
	--	)
	--)

	--update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	--OUTSortableDateTime =
	--(
	--	select bbb.OUTSortableDateTime from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] bbb
	--	where bbb.id in 
	--	(
	--		select max(b.id) from [BioMetricDevice].[dbo].[TimedAttendanceLogs] b
	--		where convert(int,SUBSTRING(rtrim(ltrim(#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo)),3,100)) = b.IndRegID
	--		and convert(date,b.bdate) = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate
	--		and b.outtime is not null
	--	)
	--)
	
	--select * from #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise
	


	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	[Shift] =
	isnull((
		 select distinct rtt.Name from #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail drcd 
		 join hr.RoasterType rtt on rtt.Id = drcd.ShifTypeid
		 where drcd.Id =
			(
			
				select min(dd.Id) from hr.RoasterType ry
					join #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail DD on  dd.ShifTypeid = ry.Id 
				join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = DD.item
				--	join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = 'B59DC248-EE02-443D-8716-003DD1E89D8C' --convert(uniqueidentifier, DD.item)
					where 
					SR.Id = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.StaffID
					and 
					convert(date,#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate)  = convert(date, DD.StartTime)
			)
	),'')


	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	TargetInTime =
	isnull((
		select distinct convert(time,drcd.StartTime) from #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail drcd 
		 --join hr.RoasterType rtt on rtt.Id = drcd.ShifTypeid
		 where drcd.Id =
			(
				select min(dd.Id) from hr.RoasterType ry
					join #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail DD on dd.ShifTypeid = ry.Id
					join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = DD.item
					where SR.Id = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.StaffID
					and convert(date,#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate)  = convert(date, DD.StartTime)
			)
	),'')

	

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	TargetOutTime =
	isnull((
		select distinct convert(time,drcd.endtime) from #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail drcd 
		 join hr.RoasterType rtt on rtt.Id = drcd.ShifTypeid
		 where drcd.Id =
			(
				select min(dd.Id) from hr.RoasterType ry
					join #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail DD on dd.ShifTypeid = ry.Id
					join HR.StaffRecords SR on SR.Id = DD.item
					where SR.Id = #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.StaffID
					and convert(date,#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.BDate)  = convert(date, DD.StartTime)
			)
	),'')
	--update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	--LateIn=TargetInTime - InTime  

	

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	LateIn = format(cast(InTime as datetime) - cast(TargetInTime as datetime), 'HH:mm')
	where TargetInTime < InTime

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	LateInNum = format(cast(InTime as datetime) - cast(TargetInTime as datetime), 'HH') * 60 + format(cast(InTime as datetime) - cast(TargetInTime as datetime), 'mm')
	where TargetInTime < InTime

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	EarlyOut = format(cast(TargetOutTime  as datetime) - cast(OutTime as datetime), 'HH:mm')
	where OutTime < TargetOutTime

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	EarlyOutNum = format(cast(TargetOutTime  as datetime) - cast(OutTime as datetime), 'HH') *60 + format(cast(TargetOutTime  as datetime) - cast(OutTime as datetime), 'mm')
		where OutTime < TargetOutTime


	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	WorkHours = format(cast(OutTime as datetime) - cast(InTime as datetime), 'HH:mm')
	
	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	OverTime = (select CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), DATEADD(S, DATEDIFF(S, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime), '1900-1-1'), 8) AS 'hh:mm')
	where #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime <#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime

	update #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise set
	OverTimeNum = format(cast(DATEADD(S, DATEDIFF(S, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime), '1900-1-1') as datetime),'HH') * 60 + format(cast(DATEADD(S, DATEDIFF(S, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime, #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime), '1900-1-1') as datetime),'mm')
	where #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.TargetOutTime <#TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise.OutTime
	
	
	UPDATE #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise SET
	SystemNote = 'EarlyIn '
	WHERE LateInNum >120


	UPDATE #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise SET
	SystemNote =isnull(SystemNote,'') + 'EarlyOut '
	WHERE EarlyOutNum >120

	UPDATE #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise  SET
	STATUS  ='Absent'
	WHERE LEN(ISNULL(ltrim(ltrim(SystemNote)),''))<>0

	UPDATE #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise  SET
	STATUS  ='Present'
	WHERE LEN(ISNULL(ltrim(ltrim(SystemNote)),''))=0


	
	if(@Type=0)
	begin
		select  * from #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise t
		where t.LateInNum>0
	
		order by t.EmployeeNo desc 
	end
	else
	begin
		select  * from #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise t
		--where t.OverTimeNum>0
	
		order by t.EmployeeNo desc 
	end
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempAttendanceReportEmployeeWise
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempAttendanceReportDutyRoasterCalenderDetail

END
GO

-- Exec [HR].[spGetDepartmentWiseEmployeeList] 0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetDepartmentWiseEmployeeList]
@departmentId int
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT        hr.StaffRecords.EmployeeNo, hr.StaffRecords.EmployeeName, hr.StaffRecords.InActiveReasons,
	hr.StaffRecords.ResignationDate, hr.StaffRecords.JoiningDate, hr.Departments.Name as DepartmentName, 
                         hr.Designations.Name AS Designation
FROM            hr.StaffRecords INNER JOIN
                        hr.Departments ON hr.StaffRecords.DeptId = hr.Departments.Id INNER JOIN
                         hr.Designations ON hr.StaffRecords.DesignationId = hr.Designations.Id
						 Where hr.StaffRecords.IsInActive='False' and (hr.StaffRecords.DeptId=@departmentId or @departmentId=0)
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [HR].[spGetDeptMonthWiseHrRoasterCalenderList]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetDeptMonthWiseHrRoasterCalenderList]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@SubDepartmentID as int =0,
	@DepartmentID as int =0,
	@Week as varchar(100)='October 2022'
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Date1 DATETIME;
	DECLARE @Date2 DATETIME;

	SET @Date1 = CAST(@Week as date)
	SET @Date2 = EOMONTH(CAST(@Week as date))

	SELECT * into #Tbl
		FROM HR.DutyRoasterCalenderDetail  
		CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](EmployeeIds, ','); 

	select (
		SELECT 
		  STUFF((
			SELECT ', ' + CAST([Date] AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 
			FROM (
				SELECT DATENAME(day, DATEADD(DAY,number,CAST(startTime AS DATE))) [Date], (1) [samerow] 
					FROM master..spt_values
					WHERE type = 'P'
					AND DATEADD(DAY,number,CAST(startTime AS DATETIME)) <= CAST(endTime AS DATETIME) 
			) tmpTbl
			FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE).value('(./text())[1]','VARCHAR(MAX)')
		  ,1,2,'') AS NameValues
		FROM (
		SELECT DATENAME(day, DATEADD(DAY,number,startTime)) [Date], (1) [samerow] 
				FROM master..spt_values
				WHERE type = 'P'
				AND DATEADD(DAY,number,startTime) <= startTime 
		) Results
		GROUP BY samerow
	) day, dt.StartTime, EndTime, s.EmployeeName,dt.ShiftName as Name,s.Id as EmployeeId,s.EmployeeNo,d.Name as Designation,MobileNo,sd.Name as SubDeptName,dpt.Name as DeptName into #Tab from HR.DutyRoasterCalender c
	inner join HR.#Tbl dt on c.Id=dt.DutyRoasterCalenderId
	inner join hr.StaffRecords s on dt.item in (s.Id)
	inner join [HR].[Designations]  d on s.DesignationId=d.Id
	inner join HR.SubDepartments sd on c.SubDepartmentId=sd.Id
	inner join HR.Departments dpt on c.DepartmentId=dpt.Id
	where  c.Week=@Week  and (@SubDepartmentID =0 or c.SubDepartmentId=@SubDepartmentID) and (@DepartmentID=0 or c.DepartmentId=@DepartmentID)

	SELECT * into #Tab1
		FROM #Tab  
		CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](day, ','); 
	
	DECLARE @sqlCommand varchar(8000)
	DECLARE @DateColumn varchar(1000)
	DECLARE @DayColumn varchar(1000)
	set @DateColumn = (
		SELECT 
		  STUFF((
			SELECT ', isnull([' + CAST([Date] + '], ''OFF'')[day' + [Date] + ']' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 
			FROM (
				SELECT DATENAME(day, DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1)) [Date], (1) [samerow] 
					FROM master..spt_values
					WHERE type = 'P'
					AND DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1) <= @Date2 
			) tmpTbl
			FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE).value('(./text())[1]','VARCHAR(MAX)')
		  ,1,2,'') AS NameValues
		FROM (
		SELECT DATENAME(day, DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1)) [Date], (1) [samerow] 
				FROM master..spt_values
				WHERE type = 'P'
				AND DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1) <= @Date2 
		) Results
		GROUP BY samerow)

		set @DayColumn = (
		SELECT 
		  STUFF((
			SELECT ', [' + CAST([Date] + ']' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 
			FROM (
				SELECT DATENAME(day, DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1)) [Date], (1) [samerow] 
					FROM master..spt_values
					WHERE type = 'P'
					AND DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1) <= @Date2 
			) tmpTbl
			FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE).value('(./text())[1]','VARCHAR(MAX)')
		  ,1,2,'') AS NameValues
		FROM (
		SELECT DATENAME(day, DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1)) [Date], (1) [samerow] 
				FROM master..spt_values
				WHERE type = 'P'
				AND DATEADD(DAY,number,@Date1) <= @Date2 
		) Results
		GROUP BY samerow)

	set @sqlCommand = 'SELECT EmployeeId,EmployeeName,SubDeptName,DeptName,Designation,EmployeeNo,MobileNo,' + @DateColumn + ','''' as FileContents FROM (SELECT EmployeeId,item, isnull(Name,''Off'')Name,EmployeeName,Designation,SubDeptName,DeptName,EmployeeNo,MobileNo FROM #Tab1 ) AS source PIVOT (MIN( Name) FOR item IN(' + @DayColumn +') ) as pvt'
	exec (@sqlCommand)
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE  [HR].[spGetDeptWiseHrRoasterCalenderList]
@SubDepartmentID as int =0,
@DepartmentID as int =0,
@Week as varchar(100)=''
as begin 





SELECT * into #Tbl
FROM HR.DutyRoasterCalenderDetail  
CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](EmployeeIds, ','); 








select DATENAME(weekday,startTime) day,s.EmployeeName,dt.ShiftName as Name,s.Id as EmployeeId,s.EmployeeNo,d.Name as Designation,MobileNo,sd.Name as SubDeptName,dpt.Name as DeptName into #Tab from HR.DutyRoasterCalender c
inner join HR.#Tbl dt on c.Id=dt.DutyRoasterCalenderId
inner join hr.StaffRecords s on dt.item in (s.Id)
inner join [HR].[Designations]  d on s.DesignationId=d.Id
inner join HR.SubDepartments sd on c.SubDepartmentId=sd.Id
inner join HR.Departments dpt on c.DepartmentId=dpt.Id
where  c.Week=@Week  and (@SubDepartmentID =0 or c.SubDepartmentId=@SubDepartmentID) and (@DepartmentID=0 or c.DepartmentId=@DepartmentID)
-- startTime >= dateadd(day, 1-datepart(dw, getdate()), CONVERT(date,getdate())) 
--AND startTime <  dateadd(day, 8-datepart(dw, getdate()), CONVERT(date,getdate()))

;
  
-------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT EmployeeId,EmployeeName,SubDeptName,DeptName,Designation,EmployeeNo

---,Designation,'' as DeptName ,'' as SubDeptName

,MobileNo, isnull([Sunday],'OFF')[Sunday],isnull([Monday],'OFF')[Monday],isnull([Tuesday],'OFF')[Tuesday],isnull([Wednesday],'OFF')[Wednesday],isnull([Thursday],'OFF')[Thursday],isnull([Friday],'OFF')[Friday],isnull([Saturday],'OFF')[Saturday],''as FileContents
FROM
(SELECT EmployeeId, day, isnull(Name,'Off')Name,EmployeeName,Designation,SubDeptName,DeptName,EmployeeNo,MobileNo FROM #Tab ) AS source
PIVOT
(
 MIN( Name)
 FOR day IN ([Sunday],[Monday],[Tuesday],[Wednesday],[Thursday],[Friday],[Saturday])
) as pvt


 
end

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetDutyExchangeRecordById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT lr.Id,lr.StaffId,lr.Year,lr.Datefrom,lr.DateTo,lr.TotalDays,sr.EmployeeName,sr.EmployeeNo,lr.ExchangeWithStaffId,ss.EmployeeNo ExchangeStaffNo,ss.EmployeeName ExchangeStaffName
	FROM [HR].[DutyExchangeRecords] lr INNER JOIN
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] sr ON lr.StaffId=sr.Id left join
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] ss on lr.ExchangeWithStaffId=ss.Id
