SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]
--11. EmployeeNo [nvarchar]

--exec [HR].[SpGetDutyExchangeStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,' 
CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetDutyExchangeStatement]
		@Paramas NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
				DECLARE
				@year INT,
				@StaffrecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
				@HrDeptId INT,
				@HrSubDeptId int

				Select @year= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3

				Select @StaffrecordId= Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

				Select @HrDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

				Select @HrSubDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9

				select(select * from(

			SELECT sr.EmployeeNo AS  ExchangeWithEmployeeNo,sr.EmployeeName AS ExchangeWithEmployeeName,
			sr2.EmployeeNo AS ExchangeremployeeNo, sr2.EmployeeName AS ExchangerEmployeeName, 
			d1.Name Designation, d.Name Department,
			CONVERT(DATE,mlr.Datefrom) AS ExchangeStartDate,
			CONVERT(DATE,mlr.DateTo) AS ExchangeEndDate, mlr.TotalDays AS NoOfDays
			FROM hr.DutyExchangeRecords  mlr 
			JOIN hr.StaffRecords sr ON sr.id=mlr.StaffId
			--JOIN hr.DutyExchangeRecords der ON der.ExchangeWithStaffId=sr.id
			JOIN hr.StaffRecords sr2 ON sr2.id=mlr.ExchangeWithStaffId
			JOIN hr.Departments d ON D.id=sr.DeptId
			JOIN HR.Designations d1 ON d1.id=sr.DesignationId
			JOIN hr.SubDepartments sd ON sd.id=sr.SubDeptId
			WHERE mlr.Year=@year
			AND (sr.id=@StaffrecordId OR @StaffrecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			AND (d.id=@HrDeptId OR @HrDeptId=0)
			AND (sd.id=@HrSubDeptId OR @HrSubDeptId=0)

				) tbl order BY tbl.ExchangeWithEmployeeNo
			FOR JSON AUTO
		) as Data

END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
--exec spGetEmployeeLeaveApplicationList 2021,62
CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetEmployeeLeaveApplicationList]
@deptid int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT lapp.Id, lapp.StaffRecordId, lapp.AppDate,lapp.AppSubject, 
                        lapp.LeaveApprovalStatus,lapp.ProxyStaffRecordId, lapp.ApplicationInPdf, 
                         lapp.ApplicationInWord, e1.EmployeeName, e2.EmployeeName AS ProxyName, d.Name as DeptName, dg.Name as Designation,
						 min(ld.Leavefrom)Leavefrom,max(ld.Leaveto)Leaveto
						
                         FROM hr.LeaveApplications lapp INNER JOIN
						 hr.LeaveApplicationDetails ld on lapp.Id=ld.ApplicationId
						 inner join
                         hr.StaffRecords  AS e1 ON lapp.StaffRecordId = e1.Id INNER JOIN
                         hr.StaffRecords e2 ON lapp.ProxyStaffRecordId = e2.Id INNER JOIN 
						 hr.Departments d on e1.DeptId = d.Id Join hr.Designations dg on e1.DesignationId=dg.Id
						  where e1.DeptId=@deptid and lapp.LeaveApprovalStatus<>'Approved'
						  group by lapp.Id, lapp.StaffRecordId, lapp.AppDate,lapp.AppSubject, 
                        lapp.LeaveApprovalStatus,lapp.ProxyStaffRecordId, lapp.ApplicationInPdf, 
                         lapp.ApplicationInWord, e1.EmployeeName, e2.EmployeeName, d.Name, dg.Name
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SPGetEmployeeListactiveInactive]
	--@month int,
	--@year int,
	@DeptId int
	--@Isactive bit
AS
BEGIN
	select e.EmployeeNo ,e.EmployeeName EmpName,dg.Name Designation,d.Name DeptName,
	convert(date,e.JoiningDate) JoinDate
	from hr.StaffRecords e
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=e.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=e.DesignationId
	where (d.Id=@DeptId or @DeptId=0)

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [HR].[SPGetEmployeeMasterStatement]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






-- =============================================

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]

--exec [HR].[SPGetEmployeeMasterStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE       PROCEDURE [HR].[SPGetEmployeeMasterStatement]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

	select( select * from(

	select s.EmployeeNo AS IDNumber, s.EmployeeName AS [Name], dg.name AS Designation, D.Name AS Department, CONVERT(DATE,s.JoiningDate) AS JoinDate,
		s.MobileNo AS MobileNo, ISNULL(s.BankAccountNo,0) AS BankAccountNo, s.Sex AS Gender, s.Religion AS Religion, s.FatherName as FatherName,
		s.MotherName AS MotherName, s.BloodGroup AS BloodGroup, convert(DATE,s.DateofBirth) AS DateOfBirth, s.NationIdorPpno AS NIDorPassNo
		from
		 hr.StaffRecords s
		join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
		join hr.Departments d on d.id=s.DeptId
		where 
		s.IsInActive=0
		---ORDER BY s.EmployeeNo

	)tbl 
	
	order by tbl.IDNumber

	for json auto)as Data
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
--------------exec [HR].[spGetInActiveEmployeeList] '2022-10-01','2022-10-31',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetInActiveEmployeeList]
	@FilterStartdate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@DepartmentId int=0
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT       s.EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName,convert(date,isnull(s.DateofBirth,'')) DateofBirth,
				convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate, d.Name as DepartmentName, 
				 dg.Name AS Designation,isnull(s.MobileNo,0) MobileNo,isnull(ind.TotalSalary,0) TotalSalary,
				isnull(max(eq.NameOfExam ),'') Qualification,
				'' InterviewDate,
				convert(date,isnull(s.ResignationDate,'')) ResignationDate,
				isnull(s.InActiveReasons,'')InActiveReasons, '' Remarks
	
FROM            hr.StaffRecords s INNER JOIN
                         hr.Departments d ON d.Id =s.DeptId INNER JOIN
                         hr.Designations dg ON dg.Id =   s.DesignationId
						left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries ind on ind.EmployeeId=s.Id
						left join hr.EducationalQualifications eq on eq.StaffRecordId=s.Id
						 Where (s.IsInActive='True') and
						 convert(date,s.ResignationDate) >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,s.ResignationDate)<=@filterEndDate
						 and (s.DeptId=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
						 group by s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.DateofBirth,s.JoiningDate,s.MobileNo,ind.TotalSalary,d.Name,dg.Name,
						 s.ResignationDate,s.InActiveReasons
END
GO

--------------exec [HR].[NewEmployeeListDynamic]'2025-01-01,2025-01-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'
CREATE       PROCEDURE [HR].[spGetInActiveEmployeeListDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	--@FilterStartDate date,
	--@filterEndDate date,
	--@DepartmentId int=0
AS
BEGIN
Declare
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@filterEndDate date,
	@DepartmentId int=0

		SELECT @FilterStartDate=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @filterEndDate=  Convert(NVARCHAR(MAX),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
Select @DepartmentId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

		select(
	select * from(
	SELECT       s.EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName,convert(date,isnull(s.DateofBirth,'')) DateofBirth,
				convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate, d.Name as DepartmentName, 
				 dg.Name AS Designation,isnull(s.MobileNo,0) MobileNo,isnull(ind.TotalSalary,0) TotalSalary,
				isnull(max(eq.NameOfExam ),'') Qualification,
				'' InterviewDate,
				convert(date,isnull(s.ResignationDate,'')) ResignationDate,
				isnull(s.InActiveReasons,'')InActiveReasons, '' Remarks
				, ISNULL(s.BankAccountNo,0) AS BankAccountNo
				,s.ServiceNature JoiningStatus
	
FROM            hr.StaffRecords s INNER JOIN
                         hr.Departments d ON d.Id =s.DeptId INNER JOIN
                         hr.Designations dg ON dg.Id =   s.DesignationId
						left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries ind on ind.EmployeeId=s.Id
						left join hr.EducationalQualifications eq on eq.StaffRecordId=s.Id
						 Where (s.IsInActive='True') and
						 convert(date,s.ResignationDate) >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,s.ResignationDate)<=@filterEndDate
						 and (s.DeptId=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
						 group by s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.DateofBirth,s.JoiningDate,s.MobileNo,ind.TotalSalary,d.Name,dg.Name,
						 s.ResignationDate,s.InActiveReasons,s.BankAccountNo,s.ServiceNature
						 	) tbl order by tbl.EmployeeNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetLeaveApplicationsById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StaffId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT la.Id,la.StaffRecordId,la.AppSubject,la.LeaveApprovalStatus,la.SubstituteStaffId,la.ApplicationInPdf,la.ApplicationInWord,la.SentTo,la.ApplicationDate,la.StartDate,la.EndDate,la.ExtraStartDate,la.ExtraStartDate
		   ,sr.EmployeeName EmployeeName, sr1.EmployeeName SubstituteStaffName,u.UserName,la.TotalLeaveQTY,la.LeaveTypeNames
	FROM [HR].[LeaveApplications] la inner join
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on la.StaffRecordId=sr.Id left join
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] sr1 on la.SubstituteStaffId = sr1.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=la.UserId
	WHERE @StaffId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' or (sr.DeptId in (select DeptId from [HR].[ApplicationPermissions] ap where ap.StaffRecordId=@StaffId))
END

--Exec [HR].[SpGetLeaveApplicationsByStaffAndDates] 'D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71','2022-01-01','2025-01-01'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetLeaveApplicationsByStaffAndDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StaffId uniqueidentifier,
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT la.Id,la.StaffRecordId,la.AppSubject,la.LeaveApprovalStatus,la.SubstituteStaffId,la.ApplicationInPdf,la.ApplicationInWord,la.SentTo,la.ApplicationDate,la.StartDate,la.EndDate,la.ExtraStartDate,la.ExtraStartDate
		   ,sr.EmployeeName EmployeeName, sr1.EmployeeName SubstituteStaffName,u.UserName,la.TotalLeaveQTY,la.LeaveTypeNames
	FROM [HR].[LeaveApplications] la inner join
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on la.StaffRecordId=sr.Id left join
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] sr1 on la.SubstituteStaffId = sr1.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=la.UserId
	WHERE (sr.DeptId in (select DeptId from [HR].[ApplicationPermissions] ap where ap.StaffRecordId=@StaffId)) and convert(date, la.ApplicationDate) between convert(date, @DateFrom) and convert(date, @DateTo)
		  and (la.LeaveApprovalStatus='Approved' or la.LeaveApprovalStatus='Rejected')
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [HR].[SpGetLeaveApplicationsByStaffId] '3DC13F8B-3CCF-4597-8EFA-05CB2906CEAE'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetLeaveApplicationsByStaffId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StaffId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	SELECT la.Id,la.StaffRecordId,la.AppSubject,la.LeaveApprovalStatus,la.SubstituteStaffId,la.ApplicationInPdf,la.ApplicationInWord,la.SentTo,la.ApplicationDate,isnull(dl.ApprovedStartDate,la.StartDate) StartDate,isnull(dl.ApprovedEndDate,la.EndDate) EndDate,la.ExtraStartDate,la.ExtraStartDate
			,sr.EmployeeName EmployeeName, sr1.EmployeeName SubstituteStaffName,u.UserName,isnull(dl.DayCount,la.TotalLeaveQTY) TotalLeaveQTY,sr.EmployeeNo,tbl.IsThisTheHighestLevelApproval,la.LeaveTypeNames
	FROM [HR].[LeaveApplications] la inner join
			[HR].[StaffRecords] sr on la.StaffRecordId=sr.Id left join
			[HR].[StaffRecords] sr1 on la.SubstituteStaffId = sr1.Id left join
			[Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=la.UserId inner join
			(select las.ApprovLevel,las.DeptId,las.LevelOrder,las.IsThisTheHighestLevelApproval,
					case when las.LevelTagKey='Level1' then 'Pending'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level2' then 'Level1'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level3' then 'Level2'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level4' then 'Level3'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level5' then 'Level4'
						end as TagKey,las.LevelTagKey
				from [HR].[LeaveApprovalSettings] las 
				where las.LevelApprovebyStaffRecordId=@StaffId) tbl on la.LeaveApprovalStatus=tbl.TagKey left join
			[HR].[LeaveApproveOnDifferentLevels] dl on tbl.LevelTagKey=dl.LevelTagKey and dl.LeaveApplicationsId=la.Id
END
GO

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT lr.Id,lr.StaffId,lr.Year,lr.Datefrom,lr.DateTo,lr.LeavePurpose,lr.TotalDays,sr.EmployeeName,sr.EmployeeNo

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetLeaveRecordById]

BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF(@Id=0)
BEGIN
	SELECT lr.Id,lr.StaffId,lr.Year,lr.Datefrom,lr.DateTo,lr.TotalDays,lr.LeavePurpose,sr.EmployeeName,sr.EmployeeNo
	FROM [HR].[LeaveRecords] lr INNER JOIN

	SELECT lr.Id,lr.StaffId,lr.Year,lr.Datefrom,lr.DateTo,lr.TotalDays,sr.EmployeeName,sr.EmployeeNo
	FROM [HR].[LeaveRecords] lr INNER JOIN
		 [HR].[StaffRecords] sr ON lr.StaffId=sr.Id
	WHERE lr.Id=@Id
END
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetLeaveRecordSummary]
@paramas NVARCHAR(MAX)
	--------EXEC Hr.SpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation123 'PH02701',2023
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
@year INT,
@StaffrecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
@HrDeptId INT,
@HrSubDeptId int

Select @year= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3

Select @StaffrecordId= Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

Select @HrDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

Select @HrSubDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9

	 DECLARE @FirstdayofYear date
	 DECLARE @CurrentMonth int =1
	 DECLARE @TotalYearlyLeave int =24

	 select @FirstdayofYear = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-12-31')
	 select @CurrentMonth = MONTH(getdate())

	 select @TotalYearlyLeave = TotalYearlyLeave from hr.LeavePolicies 

	 --SELECT * FROM hr.SubDepartments

	 select r.id,r.EmployeeNo,Dept.Name [Department] ,de.Name [Degignation],
	 CONVERT(DATE,r.JoiningDate)JoiningDate,r.EmployeeName
		[FullName]	 ,
		DATEDIFF(MONTH,r.JoiningDate,@FirstdayofYear)+1 [JoiningMonth],
		case
		when year(JoiningDate) = @Year and day(JoiningDate)>25 then 4    -- status 4
		when year(JoiningDate) = @Year and day(JoiningDate)<=25 and  day(JoiningDate)>=16 then 3  -- status 3
		when year(JoiningDate) = @Year and day(JoiningDate)<=15  then 2   -- status 2
		when year(JoiningDate) <> @Year then 1
		else 0 end [SameYearAbove7th]
		
		into #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation
	from 
		Hr.StaffRecords r
	 join Hr.Designations  de on r.DesignationId = de.id
	 join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = r.DeptId
	-- LEFT JOIN hr.SubDepartments sd ON sd.DeptId=dept.id AND r.SubDeptId=sd.Id
	LEFT JOIN hr.SubDepartments sd ON sd.id=r.SubDeptId

	 WHERE (@StaffrecordId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR R.id=@StaffrecordId) AND 
	 (@HrDeptId=Dept.Id OR @HrDeptId=0) 
	 AND
		(@HrSubDeptId=sd.id OR @HrSubDeptId=0)
		AND r.IsInActive='False' 

	 ORDER BY JoiningDate DESC
	

	 select t.Id StaffId,isnull(sum(r.TotalDays),0) TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear
	 into #TempSpGetRamainingTotalLeaveCalculation
	 from #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation t 
	 left join hr.LeaveRecords r on r.StaffId = t.Id
	 and r.Year = @Year
	 group by t.Id

	

	  SELECT * INTO #TempFinalSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation  FROM (
	 select 
	 EmployeeNo,
	 [FullName] EmployeeName,
	 JoiningDate,
	 [Degignation] AS Designation,
	 [Department],

	 case 
	  when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=4 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) -2
	  when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=3 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) -1
	  when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=2 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) 
	 when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=0 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) -0
	 when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=1 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) 
	 when SameYearAbove7th=0 then 
	 @TotalYearlyLeave-2
	 else 
	 @TotalYearlyLeave end AnnualLeave,

	 TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear TotalSpentDays,


	 case 
	 when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=4 then 
	  ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth])-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear-2
	  when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=3 then 
	  ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth])-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear-1
	  when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=2 then 
	  ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth])-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear-0
	 when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=0 then 
	  ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth])-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear-2
	  when [JoiningMonth] <12 and SameYearAbove7th=1 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth])-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear
	 when SameYearAbove7th=0 then  @TotalYearlyLeave-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear -2
	 else @TotalYearlyLeave-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear 
	 end [RemainingLeave]

	 from #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation t
	 left join #TempSpGetRamainingTotalLeaveCalculation r on r.StaffId = t.Id
	-- order by JoiningDate DESC
	 ) T 
	 WHERE AnnualLeave>0


	 --join  [HR].[LeavePolicies]

select(select * from(
	 SELECT * FROM #TempFinalSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation
	 --ORDER BY EmployeeNo
	 			) tbl order by tbl.EmployeeNo
			FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data







END
GO

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-- Exec [HR].[SpGetLeaveReportDynamic] ''

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetLeaveReportDynamic]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom, 2.dateto, 3.year, 4.month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7. StaffrecordId,8. HrDeptId,9. HrSubDeptId, 10. FestivalId  

--exec [HR].[SpGetLeaveReportDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

Declare @FilterStartDate date
Declare @FilterEndDate date
DECLARE @StaffrecordId uniqueIdentifier
DECLARE @HrDeptId int

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

Select @StaffrecordId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
Select @HrDeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@StaffrecordId,@HrDeptId



Select(
	select * from(
		Select dept.Name as Department,  s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate,d.Name as Designation,
		ISNULL((Select TotalYearlyLeave from [HR].LeavePolicies ),0) as TotalLeave,lr.Datefrom as LeaveStartingDate, lr.DateTo as LeaveEndingDate,lr.TotalDays as AvailedLeave,
		--ISNULL((Select TotalYearlyLeave from [HR].LeavePolicies )-lr.TotalDays,0) as DueLeave,'' as Remarks
		ISNULL((Select TotalYearlyLeave from [HR].LeavePolicies ) -
		(
			Select sum(TotalDays) from [HR].LeaveRecords lrlr where lrlr.id <=lr.Id
			and lrlr.StaffId = lr.StaffId
			and convert(date,lr.Datefrom)>=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,lr.DateTo)<=@FilterEndDate
		) ,0) as DueLeave,'' as Remarks

		from [HR].LeaveRecords lr join [HR].StaffRecords s on lr.StaffId=s.Id
		join [HR].Designations d on s.DesignationId=d.Id  Join [HR].Departments dept on s.DeptId=dept.Id
		where convert(date,lr.Datefrom)>=@FilterStartDate and convert(date,lr.DateTo)<=@FilterEndDate
		and (lr.StaffId=@StaffrecordId or @StaffrecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (s.DeptId=@HrDeptId or @HrDeptId=0)
	) tbl FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data

END

--exec [HR].[SpGetMaternityLeaveStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetMaternityLeaveStatement]
		@Paramas NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
				DECLARE
				@year INT,
				@StaffrecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
				@HrDeptId INT,
				@HrSubDeptId int

				Select @year= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3

				Select @StaffrecordId= Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

				Select @HrDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

				Select @HrSubDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9

				select(select * from(

			SELECT sr.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo, sr.EmployeeName EmployeeName, CONVERT(DATE,sr.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
			d1.Name Designation, D.Name Department, convert(DATE,mlr.Datefrom) LeaveStartDate, convert(DATE,mlr.DateTo) LeaveEndDate,
			mlr.TotalDays TotalDays
			FROM hr.MaternityLeaveRecords mlr 
			JOIN hr.StaffRecords sr ON sr.id=mlr.StaffId
			JOIN hr.Departments d ON D.id=sr.DeptId
			JOIN HR.Designations d1 ON d1.id=sr.DesignationId
			JOIN hr.SubDepartments sd ON sd.id=sr.SubDeptId
			WHERE mlr.Year=@year
			AND (sr.id=@StaffrecordId OR @StaffrecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			AND (d.id=@HrDeptId OR @HrDeptId=0)
			AND (sd.id=@HrSubDeptId OR @HrSubDeptId=0)

				) tbl order by tbl.EmployeeNo
			FOR JSON AUTO
		) as Data

END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetOverManageStatement]
		@Paramas NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
				DECLARE
				@year INT,
				@StaffrecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
				@HrDeptId INT,
				@HrSubDeptId int

				Select @year= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3

				Select @StaffrecordId= Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

				Select @HrDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

				Select @HrSubDeptId= Convert(INT,T.Value) from (
				SELECT * FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9

				select(select * from(

			SELECT sr.EmployeeNo AS EmployeeNo, sr.EmployeeName AS EmployeeName, CONVERT(DATE,sr.JoiningDate) AS JoiningDate,
			d1.Name AS Designation,D.Name AS Department , CONVERT(DATE,mlr.DutyDatefrom) AS DutyStartDate,
			CONVERT(DATE,mlr.DutyDateTo) AS DutyEndDate, CONVERT(DATE,mlr.LeaveDatefrom) AS DutyManageStartDate,
			CONVERT(DATE,mlr.LeaveDateTo) AS DutyManageEndDate, mlr.TotalDays AS NoOfDays
			FROM hr.OverManageDutyRecords   mlr 
			JOIN hr.StaffRecords sr ON sr.id=mlr.StaffId
			--JOIN hr.DutyExchangeRecords der ON der.ExchangeWithStaffId=sr.id
			--JOIN hr.StaffRecords sr2 ON sr2.id=mlr.ExchangeWithStaffId
			JOIN hr.Departments d ON D.id=sr.DeptId
			JOIN HR.Designations d1 ON d1.id=sr.DesignationId
			JOIN hr.SubDepartments sd ON sd.id=sr.SubDeptId
			WHERE mlr.Year=@year
			AND (sr.id=@StaffrecordId OR @StaffrecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			AND (d.id=@HrDeptId OR @HrDeptId=0)
			AND (sd.id=@HrSubDeptId OR @HrSubDeptId=0)

				) tbl order BY tbl.EmployeeNo
			FOR JSON AUTO

-- =============================================

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]

--exec [HR].[SPGetPFCertificateGivenList]'2025-04-01,2025-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE       PROCEDURE [HR].[SPGetPFCertificateGivenList]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate DATE,
	@StaffRecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(DATE,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(DATE,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @StaffRecordId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

select( select * from(

						SELECT sr.EmployeeNo AS EmployeeNo, sr.EmployeeName AS EmployeeName, CONVERT(DATE,sr.JoiningDate) AS JoiningDate,
						convert(DATE,sr.ResignationDate) AS ResignationDate,D.Name AS Designation, d1.Name AS Departmentname, convert(DATE,P.CreatedOn) AS CertificateGivenDate,
						P.Reference AS ReferenceNo, U.UserName AS CreatedBy
						FROM hr.StaffRecords sr
						JOIN hr.PFSettlements p ON p.StaffRecordId=sr.Id
						JOIN hr.Designations d ON d.id=sr.DesignationId
						JOIN hr.Departments d1 ON d1.id=sr.DeptId
						JOIN [Identity].Users u ON u.id=p.CreatedBy
						WHERE CONVERT(DATE,p.CreatedOn) >=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,p.CreatedOn)<=@FilterEndDate
						AND (sr.id=@StaffRecordId OR @StaffRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


	)tbl 
	
	order by EmployeeNo

	for json auto)as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation]
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)='',
	@Year int =0

	--------EXEC Hr.SpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation 'PH02701',2023
AS
BEGIN
	 DECLARE @FirstdayofYear date
	 DECLARE @CurrentMonth int =1
	 DECLARE @TotalYearlyLeave int =24

	 select @FirstdayofYear = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-12-31')
	 select @CurrentMonth = MONTH(getdate())

	 select @TotalYearlyLeave = TotalYearlyLeave from hr.LeavePolicies 


	 select r.id,r.EmployeeNo,Dept.Name [Department] ,de.Name [Degignation],
	 CONVERT(DATE,r.JoiningDate)JoiningDate,r.EmployeeName
		[FullName]	 ,
		DATEDIFF(MONTH,r.JoiningDate,@FirstdayofYear)+1 [JoiningMonth]

		into #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation
	from 
		Hr.StaffRecords r
	 join Hr.Designations  de on r.DesignationId = de.id
	 join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = r.DeptId

	 WHERE (@EmployeeNo ='' OR R.EmployeeNo=@EmployeeNo)
	 ORDER BY JoiningDate DESC

	


	 select t.Id StaffId,isnull(sum(r.TotalDays),0) TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear
	 into #TempSpGetRamainingTotalLeaveCalculation
	 from #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation t 
	 left join hr.LeaveRecords r on r.StaffId = t.Id
	 and r.Year = @Year
	 group by t.Id

	 --select * from #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation
	 --select * from  #TempSpGetRamainingTotalLeaveCalculation
	 --return 

	 select 
	 t.Id, 
	 EmployeeNo,
	 [Department],
	 [Degignation],
	 JoiningDate,
	 [FullName],
	 [JoiningMonth],
	 TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear,
	 case when [JoiningMonth] <12 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) else 
	 @TotalYearlyLeave end TotalYearlyLeave,
	 case when [JoiningMonth] <12 then 
	 ((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth])-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear
	 
	 else @TotalYearlyLeave-TotalDaysLeaveTakingYear end [TotalLeaveRemaning]

	 from #TempSpGetRamainingLeaveCalculation t
	 left join #TempSpGetRamainingTotalLeaveCalculation r on r.StaffId = t.Id
	 order by JoiningDate DESC
	 --join  [HR].[LeavePolicies]

END
GO

-------exec [HR].[SpGetRemainingLeaveCalculation] 2024, 'D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71'
CREATE PROCEDURE [HR].[SpGetRemainingLeaveCalculation]
	@Year INT,
	@StaffRecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT		sr.id AS StaffRecordId, sr.EmployeeNo AS EmpNo, sr.EmployeeName AS EmpName,convert(DATE,sr.JoiningDate) AS JoinDate,d1.Name AS Designation,
				d.Name AS Department,ielp.year AS LeaveYear,ielp.Cl AS CLRemain,
				ielp.MedicalLeave AS MLRemain,ielp.AnnualLeave AS AnnualRemain,ielp.FestivalLeave AS FestRemain, ielp.GovtLeave AS GovtRemain,
				0 AS SpecialRemain, ielp.Ml AS MaternityRemain
				FROM hr.StaffRecords sr
				JOIN hr.IndividualEmployeeLeavePolices ielp ON ielp.StaffRecordId=sr.id
				JOIN HR.Departments d ON d.id=sr.DeptId
				JOIN HR.Designations d1 ON d1.Id=sr.DesignationId
				WHERE @Year=ielp.Year
				AND (@StaffRecordId=ielp.StaffRecordId)
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Identity].[GetFilteredUser]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- Execute [Identity].[GetFilteredUser]  ''
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Identity].[GetFilteredUser]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@filerstring NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF (
			@filerstring = ''
			OR @filerstring IS NULL
			)
	BEGIN
		SELECT top(50) tbl.*
		FROM
		(
			SELECT u.Id,isnull(u.FullName,'NA')FullName,u.UserName,u.Email,isnull( u.PhoneNumber,'NA')PhoneNumber,u.DoctorId,isnull(sr.EmployeeNo,'') EmployeeNo, isnull(sr.EmployeeName,'') EmployeeName
				, CAST(u.DoctorId as varchar(36)) as GuidStringDoctorId
				, u.TechnologistId
				,u.TenantId,
	
				u.StaffRecordId
				, CAST(u.StaffRecordId as varchar(36)) as GuidStringStaffId
				,u.IsActive,
				ur.RoleId,r.Name as RoleName  from  [Identity].[Users] u join [Identity].[UserRoles] ur 
				on u.Id = ur.UserId join  [Identity].[Roles] r on ur.RoleId=r.Id left join [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on sr.Id=u.StaffRecordId
		) tbl
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT tbl.*
		FROM
		(
			SELECT u.Id,isnull(u.FullName,'NA')FullName,u.UserName,u.Email,isnull( u.PhoneNumber,'NA')PhoneNumber,u.DoctorId,isnull(sr.EmployeeNo,'') EmployeeNo, isnull(sr.EmployeeName,'') EmployeeName
				, CAST(u.DoctorId as varchar(36)) as GuidStringDoctorId
				, u.TechnologistId
				,u.TenantId,
	
				u.StaffRecordId
				, CAST(u.StaffRecordId as varchar(36)) as GuidStringStaffId
				,u.IsActive,
				ur.RoleId,r.Name as RoleName  from  [Identity].[Users] u join [Identity].[UserRoles] ur 
				on u.Id = ur.UserId join  [Identity].[Roles] r on ur.RoleId=r.Id left join [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on sr.Id=u.StaffRecordId
		) tbl
		WHERE tbl.UserName LIKE '%' + @filerstring + '%' or tbl.Email LIKE '%' + @filerstring + '%'
	END
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Identity].[UpdateUserModuleAndExpireDate]
    @BaseModule NVARCHAR(255),

AS

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Marketing].[GetDoctorById]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@UnGetIsActive int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	select d.Id,d.DoctorFieldOfSpecialityId,isnull(d.Name,'')Name,isnull(d.DoctorCodeNo,'')DoctorCodeNo,isnull(d.PhoneFax,'')PhoneFax,isnull(d.ProfessionalIdentity1,'')ProfessionalIdentity1,isnull(d.ProfessionalIdentity2,'')ProfessionalIdentity2,isnull(d.ProfessionalIdentity3,'')ProfessionalIdentity3,isnull(d.ProfessionalIdentity4,'')ProfessionalIdentity4,isnull(d.ProfessionalIdentity5,'')ProfessionalIdentity5,
		   isnull(d.ProfessionalIdentity6,'')ProfessionalIdentity6,isnull(d.CurrentWorkPlace,'')CurrentWorkPlace,isnull(d.PastWorkplace,'')PastWorkplace,d.OPDChamberReportConsultancyFee,d.OPDChamberVisitFeeMaiden,d.OPDChamberVisitFeeNew,d.OPDChamberVisitFeeOld,d.SelfChamberReportConsultancyFee,
		   d.SelfChamberVisitFeeMaiden,d.SelfChamberVisitFeeNew,d.SelfChamberVisitFeeOld,d.IPDWordVisitFee,d.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId,ma.Name MarketingJOfficerOrMediaName,
		   d.ExtraAmount,d.IsPathologyReporter,d.IsImagingReporter,isnull(ds.Name,'') SpecialName,'' as StringDoctorFieldOfSpecialityId, d.RxDepartmentId, '' as StringId,'' as StringMarketingAgentId,d.IsChamberPractitioner,d.Type,d.IsActive

	from [Marketing].[Doctors] d left join
		   [Marketing].[MarketingJOfficerOrMedias] ma on d.MarketingJOfficerOrMediaId=ma.Id left join
		   [Marketing].[DoctorFieldOfSpecialities] ds on d.DoctorFieldOfSpecialityId=ds.Id
	 where (d.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and (d.IsActive=1 or @UnGetIsActive=1)
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Marketing].[SpGetMarketingCommissionReport]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	--Order: 1. datefrom [date], 2. dateto [date], 3. year [int], 4. month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId, 7.TypeId (0 or 1) , 8. ConsultantId[Guid] , 9.@HoDId[Guid], 10.@MarketingManagerId[Guid],11.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid],
--12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid],  13. MarketingMediaId[Guid], 14.CorporateClientID int ,  15. DoctorType 'OPD or IPD' , 16. PatientID (Guid)  // For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [Marketing].[SpGetMarketingCommissionReport]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
		DECLARE		
	@MarketingJOfficerId uniqueidentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @MarketingJOfficerId=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=20;

	
	--select(
	--select * from(
	
	select P.*
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
					join Hospital.RegRecords r on r.UHID=p.UHID
					 join Marketing.MarketingAgents MA on Ma.Id=p.MarketingAgentId
					where convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) >=@FilterStartDate and
						convert(date,p.DischargedDateTime) <=@FilterEndDate 
						and 
						(MA.Id=@MarketingJOfficerId or @MarketingJOfficerId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


	--) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data
	
END
GO

-- Exec [Nutrition].[SpGetFoodDeliverableByIndentId] '473ee661-c92b-4e59-6128-08ddbe21ff0b','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Nutrition].[SpGetFoodDeliverableByIndentId]
	@IndentId uniqueidentifier,
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT fd.Id,fd.IPDFoodIndentId, 
		iif(Day(fd.CreatedOn) != Day(GETDATE()) and fd.Status = 'Pending', 'Expired', fd.Status) [Status], 
		fd.MealTypeId,
		fd.FoodPatternGroupId,
		fd.Remarks,
		mt.Name MealType,
		fd.ReviewedByUserId,u.UserName ReviewedByUserName,mt.OrderValue,fd.CreatedOn, fd.IsChanged
	FROM [Nutrition].[FoodDeliverables] fd inner join
		 [Nutrition].[MealTypes] mt on fd.MealTypeId=mt.Id left join
		 [Identity].[Users] u on fd.ReviewedByUserId=u.Id
	WHERE (fd.IPDFoodIndentId=@IndentId and @IndentId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or (fd.Id=@Id and @Id != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
END
GO

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Nutrition].[SpGetFoodDeliverableDetailByDeliverableId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT fd.Id,fd.FoodDeliverableId,fd.ItemId,fd.Qty,i.Name ItemName, isnull(cc.Stock, 0) As Stock
	FROM [Nutrition].[FoodDeliverableDetails] fd 
		join [Nutrition].[FoodDeliverables] d on d.Id = fd.FoodDeliverableId
		join Canteen.IPDFoodIndents ind on ind.Id = d.IPDFoodIndentId
		left join [Canteen].[Items] i on fd.ItemId=i.Id 
		left join [Canteen].[CurrentStockCalculation] cc on i.Id=cc.ItemId and ind.CanteenOutLetId = cc.CanteenOutletId
	WHERE fd.FoodDeliverableId=@Id
END

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec [Nutrition].SpGetPreviousIndentDeliverables '30a73131-21bd-4206-7973-08ddb3b99df9'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Nutrition].[SpGetPreviousIndentDeliverables]
	@IndentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	WITH RankedRecords AS (
		SELECT Id,
			   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC) AS rn
		FROM Canteen.IPDFoodIndents where IPDPatientId = (select IPDPatientId from Canteen.IPDFoodIndents where Id = @IndentId)
	)
	SELECT 
		fd.*
	FROM RankedRecords r
	join Nutrition.FoodDeliverables fd on fd.IPDFoodIndentId = r.Id
	WHERE rn = 2;
END



GO

-- =============================================

-- Exec [OPD].GetDashBoardData  '2022-01-01','2022-10-11',0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[GetDashBoardData] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StartDate date,
	@EndDate date,
	@CalledFrom int -- 0 for Emergency and 1-> Consultancy
AS
BEGIN

	if(@CalledFrom=0)
BEGIN
	Select p.Id,p.UHID, p.InvoicePrefix+Convert(nvarchar(50),p.InvoiceNo) BillNo,p.EntryDate,p.EntryTime,
	p.FullName,p.Gender,CASE WHEN p.AgeYear<>'' THEN p.AgeYear+'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END 
+ CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeMonth)+'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END 
+ CASE WHEN p.AgeDay<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeDay)+'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, p.MobileNo, u.UserName, d.Name as RefdBy from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] p 
    Join [Marketing].[Doctors] d on p.RefdDoctorId=d.Id
	Left Join [Identity].[Users] u on p.UserId=u.Id
    where p.EntryDate>=@StartDate and p.EntryDate<=@EndDate
END
ELSE 
   BEGIN

     Select p.Id,p.UHID, p.InvoicePrefix+Convert(nvarchar(50),p.InvoiceNo) BillNo,p.EntryDate,p.EntryTime,
	p.FullName,p.Gender,CASE WHEN p.AgeYear<>'' THEN p.AgeYear+'Y ' ELSE p.AgeYear END 
+ CASE WHEN p.AgeMonth<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeMonth)+'M ' ELSE p.AgeMonth END 
+ CASE WHEN p.AgeDay<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeDay)+'D' ELSE p.AgeDay END AS Age, p.MobileNo,u.UserName, d.Name as RefdBy from  [OPD].[PatientRecordConsultancyFees] p 
	 Join [Marketing].[Doctors] d on p.RefdDoctorId=d.Id
	 Left Join [Identity].[Users] u on p.UserId=u.Id
	 where  p.EntryDate>=@StartDate and p.EntryDate<=@EndDate

   END
END

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO


-- Exec [OPD].GetOPDInvoiceHeaderAndBody 'bdba5512-02db-4cb0-e2ef-08dd6137dd18',0

-- Exec [OPD].GetOPDInvoiceHeaderAndBody '9e6fb3db-5ce6-42f9-a56c-08dd5fbb2867',1 

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[GetOPDInvoiceHeaderAndBody]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,  -- Id from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] or [OPD].[PatientRecordConsultancyFees]
	@invoicetype int   -- '0' or '1'  0-> Emergency, 1->Consultancy
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	
if(@invoicetype=0)
BEGIN
	Select p.Id,p.UHID, p.InvoicePrefix+Convert(nvarchar(50),p.InvoiceNo) InvoiceNo, 
	Convert(nvarchar(50), isnull(ps.indentno, 0)) IndentNo, 
	isnull(ps.IndentBy, '') IndentBy, 
	isnull(ps.CreatedOn, '') IndentAt, 
	p.EntryDate,p.EntryTime,p.Remarks,p.SerialNo,
	p.FullName,p.Gender,CASE WHEN IsNull(p.AgeYear,'')<>'' THEN p.AgeYear+'Y ' ELSE IsNull(p.AgeYear,'') END 
+ CASE WHEN IsNull(p.AgeMonth,'')<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeMonth)+'M ' ELSE IsNull(p.AgeMonth,'') END 
+ CASE WHEN IsNull(p.AgeDay,'')<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeDay)+'D' ELSE IsNull(p.AgeDay,'') END AS Age, p.MobileNo,d.Name as RefdBy,s.ServiceId as EmergencyServiceId, Convert(uniqueidentifier, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') as ConsultancyServiceId,h.HeadName as ServiceName,
	h.ServiceCode,
	s.Rate,s.Qty,s.TotalAmount,s.IsDeleted,d2.Name ServiceBy,u.UserName
	from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] p 
	Join [OPD].[ServiceDetails] s on p.Id=s.PatientId 
	Join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on p.RefdDoctorId=d.Id
	Join [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] h on s.ServiceId=h.Id 
	left join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d2 on s.ServiceByDoctorId=d2.Id
	left join [Identity].[Users] u on p.UserId=u.Id
	left join [Rx].[OPDProdureSuggessions] ps on p.IndentNo = ps.IndentNo and p.IndentNo != 0 and h.Id = ProcedureId
	where p.Id=@PatientId
	

END
ELSE 
   BEGIN

     Select p.Id,p.UHID, p.InvoicePrefix+Convert(nvarchar(50),p.InvoiceNo) InvoiceNo,p.EntryDate,p.EntryTime,p.Remarks,
	p.FullName,p.Gender,CASE WHEN IsNull(p.AgeYear,'')<>'' THEN p.AgeYear+'Y ' ELSE IsNull(p.AgeYear,'') END 
+ CASE WHEN IsNull(p.AgeMonth,'')<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeMonth)+'M ' ELSE IsNull(p.AgeMonth,'') END 
+ CASE WHEN IsNull(p.AgeDay,'')<>'' THEN RTRIM(p.AgeDay)+'D' ELSE IsNull(p.AgeDay,'') END AS Age, p.MobileNo,d.Name as RefdBy,Convert(uniqueidentifier, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') as EmergencyServiceId, s.ServiceId as ConsultancyServiceId, d2.Name as ServiceName, 
'' ServiceCode,
	s.Rate,s.Qty,s.TotalAmount,s.IsDeleted,d2.Name ServiceBy,u.UserName
	from  [OPD].[PatientRecordConsultancyFees] p 
	Join [OPD].[ConsultancyDetails] s on p.Id=s.PatientId 
	left Join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on p.RefdDoctorId=d.Id
	left Join [dbo].[VWDoctors] d2 on s.ServiceId=d2.Id 
	left join [Identity].[Users] u on p.UserId=u.Id
	where p.Id=@PatientId
	

   END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>

-- =============================================

--Exec [OPD].GetOPDInvoiceTransactionsPart '25d1d268-9061-4687-a02e-08daab943483',0
--Exec [OPD].GetOPDInvoiceTransactionsPart '7f3cb3e1-6287-4f62-d543-08daaedfc61d',1 

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[GetOPDInvoiceTransactionsPart]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier,  -- Id from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] or [OPD].[PatientRecordConsultancyFees]
	@invoicetype int   -- '0' or '1'  0-> Emergency, 1->Consultancy
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	
if(@invoicetype=0)
BEGIN
	
	select p.Id, sum(case when pl.TransactionType=0 then Debit else 0 end)as TotalAmount,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=1 then credit else 0  end)as Discount,
sum(case when (pl.TransactionType=5) then credit else 0  end) as DiscountOnDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=5 then Debit else 0 end) as Refund,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType = 6 then Debit else 0 end) as discountrefund,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId=1 then Credit else 0 end)as CashPayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (2,3,4) then Credit else 0 end)as CardPayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (5,6,7) then Credit else 0 end)as MobilePayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=4 then Credit else 0 end)as ServiceCancelled,
sum(Debit-Credit) as Due,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId=1 then Credit else 0 end)as CashDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (2,3,4) then Credit else 0 end)as CardDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (5,6,7) then Credit else 0 end)as MobileDueCollection
from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] p join [OPD].[OPDServiceLedger] pl on p.Id=pl.PatientId 
Left join [Identity].[Users] u on pl.UserId=u.Id
 where p.Id=@PatientId
group by p.Id

END
ELSE 
   BEGIN

   
	select p.Id, sum(case when pl.TransactionType=0 then Debit else 0 end)as TotalAmount,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=1 then credit else 0  end)as Discount,
sum(case when (pl.TransactionType=5) then credit else 0  end) as DiscountOnDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=5 then Debit else 0 end) as Refund,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType = 7 then Debit else 0 end) as discountrefund,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId=1 then Credit else 0 end)as CashPayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (2,3,4) then Credit else 0 end)as CardPayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (5,6,7) then Credit else 0 end)as MobilePayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=4 then Credit else 0 end)as ServiceCancelled,
sum(Debit-Credit) as Due,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId=1 then Credit else 0 end)as CashDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (2,3,4) then Credit else 0 end)as CardDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (5,6,7) then Credit else 0 end)as MobileDueCollection
from  [OPD].[PatientRecordConsultancyFees] p join [OPD].[OPDConsultancyLedger] pl on p.Id=pl.PatientId 
Left join [Identity].[Users] u on pl.UserId=u.Id
 where p.Id=@PatientId
group by p.Id

   END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[OPDConsultancyStatementDynamic]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[OPDConsultancyStatementDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[OPDConsultancyStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'



AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@DoctorId uniqueidentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @DoctorId =  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
	
	select( select * from (
	select pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName,(pr.AgeYear + 'Y') Age,pr.MobileNo,pt.Name VisitType,pc.VisitFee,pc.VisitDate,pc.Status,d.Name DoctorName
	  from [OPD].[CPFeeCollectionRecords] pc inner join
		   [OPD].[CPPatientRecords] pr on pc.CPPatientRecordId=pr.Id left join
		   [OPD].[PatientVisitTypes] pt on pc.VisitTypeId=pt.Id left join
		   [Marketing].[Doctors] d on pc.CPId=d.Id
	 where (pc.CPId=@DoctorId or @DoctorId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and convert(date, pc.VisitDate) >= convert(date, @FilterStartDate) and convert(date, pc.VisitDate) <= convert(date, @FilterEndDate)
	)tbl for json auto
	)as Data
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[SpGetEmergencyReportServiceWise]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



	CREATE     PROCEDURE[OPD].[SpGetEmergencyReportServiceWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[SpGetEmergencyReportServiceWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'


	AS
	BEGIN
	DECLARE
			@FilterStartDate date,
			@FilterEndDate DATE,
			@UserID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
			@ConsultantID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER


						Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
						SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
						Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
						SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
						Select @UserID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
						SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
						Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
						SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10


						select(
							select * from(

	SELECT pro.InvoiceNo AS BillNo,pro.UHID as REGNO, pro.FullName AS PatientName, CONVERT(DATE,pro.EntryDate) AS ServiceDate,seh.HeadName AS ServiceName,
	sd.Qty AS Qty, sd.Rate AS Rate, sd.TotalAmount AS TAmount,ISNULL(v.Name,'') AS ServiceBy
	FROM opd.PatientRecordOPDServices pro
	JOIN opd.ServiceDetails sd ON sd.PatientId=pro.Id
	JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads seh ON seh.id=sd.ServiceId
	LEFT JOIN VWDoctors v ON v.id=sd.ServiceByDoctorId
	WHERE CONVERT(DATE,pro.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,pro.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
	AND (@UserID=pro.UserId OR @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	AND (@ConsultantID=sd.ServiceByDoctorId OR @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	--order by EntryDate



									) tbl  
									ORDER BY tbl.ServiceDate
									FOR JSON AUTO
										
								) as Data
	END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- =============================================
--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[spGetEmergencyServiceChargesDynamic]'2024-11-04,2024-11-14,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'



CREATE PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetEmergencyServiceChargesDynamic]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

	Declare @HospitalShareInPercent int
	Declare @DepartemntShareInPercent int
	Declare @DoctorShareFromDeptInPercent int
	Declare @NurseShareFromDeptInPercent int
	Declare @TenantId int

	Select @TenantId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=6

	Select @HospitalShareInPercent=  HospitalShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	Select @DepartemntShareInPercent=  DepartmnetShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	Select @DoctorShareFromDeptInPercent=  DoctorShareFromDepartmentInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	Select @NurseShareFromDeptInPercent=  NurseShareFromDepartmentInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings
	
SELECT(
    SELECT * FROM (
		Select h.HeadName as [Procedure], '' as ProcedureWeight, ISNULL(hr.Rate, 0) as Fee, (ISNULL(hr.Rate, convert(real,0))* ISNULL(@HospitalShareInPercent, 0))/100 as Hospital,
		(ISNULL(hr.Rate, convert(real,0))*ISNULL(@HospitalShareInPercent, 0))/100 as [Emergency], '60%' HospitalPercent, '40%' EmergencyPercent, (((ISNULL(hr.Rate, convert(real,0))*ISNULL(@HospitalShareInPercent,0))/100) * ISNULL(@DoctorShareFromDeptInPercent,0))/100 as Doctor,(((ISNULL(hr.Rate, convert(real,0))*ISNULL(@HospitalShareInPercent,0))/100) * ISNULL(@NurseShareFromDeptInPercent,0))/100 as Nurse  
		 FROM  Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h
		 JOIN Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeadRates hr ON hr.ServiceExecutingHeadId=h.id and h.TenantId=@TenantId
		 JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sssg ON sssg.id=h.ServiceSubSubGroupId
		 JOIN Hospital.ServiceSubGroups ssg  ON ssg.id=sssg.ServiceSubGroupId
		 JOIN [Hospital].ServiceGroups sg on sg.Id=ssg.ServiceGroupId 
		where sg.Id='956C4D9D-8F9B-466C-A2E0-5389BD524880' and h.TenantId=@TenantId
	) #TmpTbl FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data
END

-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[spGetEmergencyServiceFeeCollectionDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'



CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetEmergencyServiceFeeCollectionDynamic]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

	
	
	With OPDCollection as 
(Select PatientId, Sum(Debit) as TotalTk from [OPD].[OPDServiceLedger] l where l.TransactionType=0 group by l.PatientId   )

SELECT (
	SELECT * FROM (
	Select p.Id,p.InvoiceNo,p.EntryDate, ISNULL(p.FullName, '') FullName, l.TotalTk, 
	(l.TotalTk*(Select HospitalShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings))/100 as Hospital,
	(l.TotalTk*(Select DepartmnetShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings))/100 as Emergency,
	((l.TotalTk*(Select DepartmnetShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings))/100)*(Select DoctorShareFromDepartmentInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings)/100 as Doctor,
	((l.TotalTk*(Select DepartmnetShareInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings))/100)*(Select NurseShareFromDepartmentInPercent from [OPD].OPDIncomeSharings)/100 as Nurse,
	'' as Remarks
	   from [OPD].PatientRecordOPDServices p Join OPDCollection l on p.Id=l.PatientId 
	) tbl FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data

END

--Exec [OPD].[SpGetInitialDataForOPDAdmissionByDates] '2022-11-11','2023-05-11'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetInitialDataForOPDAdmissionByDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime 
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select id.RxInitDDate,id.AssignedDoctorId,vh.VisitNo,vh.VisitDate,vh.OPDInvoiceNo,vh.IPDInvoiceNo,pm.UHID,rr.FullName
	  from [Rx].[InitialDatas] id inner join
		   [Rx].[VisitHistories] vh on id.RxVisitId=vh.Id inner join
		   [Rx].[PatientMasterDatas] pm on vh.PatientMasterDataId=pm.Id inner join
		   [Hospital].[RegRecords] rr on pm.UHID=rr.UHID inner join
		   [dbo].[VWDoctors] d on id.AssignedDoctorId=d.Id
	 where CONVERT(DATE, id.RxInitDDate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate)
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[SpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheet]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[SpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheet]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheet]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

	Declare @FromDate date
    Declare @ToDate date
	Declare @ConsultantID uniqueidentifier

		Select @FromDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1;

		Select @ToDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2;

	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10;
	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount
	(
		VisitType nvarchar(max),
		TotalVisitAmount float,
		DoctorAmount float,
		HospitalAmount float
	)


	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDNew',300,200,100)
	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDOld',200,130,70)
	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDNew',50,50,0)
	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDOld',50,50,0)

	Declare @NewVisitDoctor float=200 
	Declare @NewVisitHospital float=100
	
	Declare @OldVisitDoctor float=130 
	Declare @OldVisitHospital float=70
	
	DEclare @DoctorPercent float =60
	Declare @HospitalPercent float =40
	select(
	select * from(

	select  DoctorName,sum(Nocast) [TotalQty],sum([Total]) [TotalAmount],isnull(sum([DoctorAmount]),0) [NetPayble], '' Remarks
	from(
		
		select  
		md.name DoctorName,'1st Visit' as OPDServiceName,sum(d.qty) Nocast,d.rate, 
	
		sum(d.Qty) * d.rate [Total],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.DoctorAmount [DoctorAmount],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.HospitalAmount [HospitalAmount],
		'Part - A' PartGroup
		--sum(d.qty) * d.rate [Total],sum(d.qty)*@NewVisitDoctor [DoctorAmount] ,sum(d.qty)*@NewVisitHospital [HospitalAmount], 'Part - A' PartGroup
		--v.name,d.qty,d.rate ,d.*
		from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
		join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id 
		join  VWDoctors md on md.Id = d.ServiceId
		left join  #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount t on t.TotalVisitAmount = d.Rate
		and t.VisitType='OPDNew'
		where v.name ='OPDNew'
		and isnull(convert(date,p.EntryDate),'') >=@FromDate
	and isnull(convert(date,p.EntryDate),'') <=@ToDate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		group by v.name,d.rate,md.Name, t.HospitalAmount,t.DoctorAmount
	
		UNION ALL


		select  
		md.name,'2nd Visit' as OPDServiceName,sum(d.qty) Nocast,d.rate, sum(d.qty) * d.rate [Total],
		--sum(d.qty)*@OldVisitDoctor [DoctorAmount] ,sum(d.qty)*@OldVisitHospital [HospitalAmount], 'Part - A' PartGroup
		--v.name,d.qty,d.rate ,d.*
		sum(d.Qty) * t.DoctorAmount [DoctorAmount],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.HospitalAmount [HospitalAmount],
		'Part - A' PartGroup
		from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
		join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id 
		join  VWDoctors md on md.Id = d.ServiceId
		left join  #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount t on t.TotalVisitAmount = d.Rate
		and t.VisitType='OPDOld'
		where v.name ='OPDOld'
			and isnull(convert(date,p.EntryDate),'') >=@FromDate
	and isnull(convert(date,p.EntryDate),'') <=@ToDate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		group by v.name,d.rate,md.name,t.HospitalAmount,t.DoctorAmount

		UNION ALL

		select *,([Total]*@DoctorPercent)/100 [DoctorAmount]
		,([Total]*@HospitalPercent)/100 [HospitalAmount],'Part - B' PartGroup
		from 
		(
			select md.name,h.headname as OPDServiceName ,sum(o.qty) Nocast,o.rate,sum(o.qty) *o.Rate [Total]
			from hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg --on s.id = sg.servicesubgroupid
			join hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.servicesubsubgroupid =sg.id
			join opd.ServiceDetails o on o.serviceid = h.id
			join opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op on op.Id=o.PatientId
			join  VWDoctors md on md.Id = o.ServiceByDoctorId
			where sg.id ='B3BAC528-8569-49A2-852F-B9AE528B345C'---57
			and isnull(convert(date,op.EntryDate),'') >=@FromDate
		and isnull(convert(date,op.EntryDate),'') <=@ToDate
		and (o.ServiceByDoctorId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			group by h.headname,o.rate,md.Name
		)T
		
		) GroupTable
		group by GroupTable.DoctorName

		) tbl FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO

-- exec OPD.spGetOPDPRescription '8b484eec-abf9-4dd4-f613-08dd9b58b677'

CREATE     Procedure [OPD].[spGetOPDPRescription]
	@VitalId uniqueidentifier
as 
begin
	select 
		pr.Id,
		pr.PrescriptionType,
		pr.IsInformed,
		pr.TreatmentGivenInEmergency,
		pr.VisitId,
		pr.VisitDate,
		pr.CreatedOn,
		pr.OPDRxNo,
		pr.AdmissionUnderDepartmentId,
		isnull(dp.Name, '') DepartmentName,
		pr.AdmissionUnderDoctorId,
		isnull(d.name, '') DoctorName,
		pr.OPDRxNo
	from OPD.OPDPrescriptions pr
	left join Marketing.Doctors d on d.Id = pr.AdmissionUnderDoctorId
	left join Hospital.HDepartments dp on dp.Id = pr.AdmissionUnderDepartmentId
	where pr.VitalId = @VitalId
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[spGetOPDServiceIncome]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-- Exec [OPD].[spGetOPDServiceIncome] '2022-01-01', '2023-11-01', null
CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetOPDServiceIncome]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@dtfrm date, 
	@dtTo date, 
	@UserId uniqueidentifier =null 
AS
BEGIN
select T.Id,T.UserName,T.FullName ,p.EntryDate,  p.InvoicePrefix+Convert(nvarchar(50),p.InvoiceNo) as InvoiceNo,'' as PatientName, 
T.TotalAmount,T.Discount , DiscountOnDueCollection,Refund,
discountrefund,CashPayment,CardPayment,MobilePayment,ServiceCancelled,Due,CashDueCollection,CardDueCollection,MobileDueCollection

 from
(
select p.Id,IsNull(u.UserName,'N/A') UserName, IsNull(u.FullName,'N/A') FullName, sum(case when pl.TransactionType=0 then Debit else 0 end)as TotalAmount,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=1 then credit else 0  end)as Discount,
sum(case when (p.EntryDate>=@dtfrm and p.EntryDate<=@dtTo and pl.TransactionType=5) then credit else 0  end) as DiscountOnDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=6 then Debit else 0 end) as Refund,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType = 7 OR pl.TransactionType = 8 then Debit else 0 end) as discountrefund,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId=1 then Credit else 0 end)as CashPayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (2,3,4) then Credit else 0 end)as CardPayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=2 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (5,6,7) then Credit else 0 end)as MobilePayment,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=9 then Credit else 0 end)as ServiceCancelled,
sum(case when (p.EntryDate>=@dtfrm and p.EntryDate<=@dtTo)then (Debit-Credit) else 0 end)as Due,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId=1 then Credit else 0 end)as CashDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (2,3,4) then Credit else 0 end)as CardDueCollection,
sum(case when pl.TransactionType=3 and pl.PaymentChannelId in (5,6,7) then Credit else 0 end)as MobileDueCollection
from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] p join [OPD].[OPDServiceLedger] pl on p.Id=pl.PatientId 
Left join [Identity].[Users] u on pl.UserId=u.Id
where (pl.TranDate>=@dtfrm and pl.TranDate<=@dtTo)
group by p.Id,u.UserName,u.FullName

 )T join PatientRecordOPDServices p on T.Id=p.Id


	
END



GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetOPDServicesByUHID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UHID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select pr.EntryDate,sh.HeadName,d.Name DoctorName,pr.Remarks
	 from [OPD].[PatientRecordOPDServices] pr inner join
		  [OPD].[ServiceDetails] sd on pr.Id=sd.PatientId inner join
		  [Hospital].[ServiceExecutingHeads] sh on sd.ServiceId=sh.Id left join
		  [Marketing].[Doctors] d on sd.ServiceByDoctorId=d.Id
	where pr.UHID=@UHID
	order by pr.EntryDate desc
  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[SPGetOPDServiceSharingDataDynamic]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[SPGetOPDServiceSharingDataDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[SPGetOPDServiceSharingDataDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

   Declare @FromDate date
    Declare @ToDate date
	Declare @ConsultantID uniqueidentifier

		Select @FromDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1;

		Select @ToDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2;

	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10;

		CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount
	(
		VisitType nvarchar(max),
		TotalVisitAmount float,
		DoctorAmount float,
		HospitalAmount float
	)
insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDNew',300,200,100)
	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDOld',200,130,70)
	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDNew',50,50,50)
	insert into #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount values
	('OPDOld',50,50,50)


	Declare @NewVisitDoctor float=200 
	Declare @NewVisitHospital float=100
	
	Declare @OldVisitDoctor float=130 
	Declare @OldVisitHospital float=70
	
	DEclare @DoctorPercent float =60
	Declare @HospitalPercent float =40

	select( 
	select * from(

		select  
		'1st Visit' as OPDServiceName,sum(d.qty) Nocast,d.rate, sum(d.qty) * d.rate [Total],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.DoctorAmount [DoctorAmount],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.HospitalAmount [HospitalAmount], 'Part - A' PartGroup
		--v.name,d.qty,d.rate ,d.*
		from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
		join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id
		left join  #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount t on t.TotalVisitAmount = d.Rate
		and t.VisitType='OPDNew'
		where v.name ='OPDNew'
		and convert(date,p.EntryDate) >=@FromDate
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) <=@ToDate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		group by v.name,d.rate, t.HospitalAmount,t.DoctorAmount
	
		UNION ALL


		select  
		'2nd Visit' as OPDServiceName,sum(d.qty) Nocast,d.rate, 
		sum(d.qty) * d.rate [Total],
		--case when d.rate = 0 then 0
		--when d.rate <>  0 then sum(d.qty)*@OldVisitDoctor end [DoctorAmount] ,
		--case when d.rate = 0 then 0
		--when d.rate <>  0 then sum(d.qty)*@OldVisitHospital end [HospitalAmount],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.DoctorAmount [DoctorAmount],
		sum(d.Qty) * t.HospitalAmount [HospitalAmount],
		'Part - A' PartGroup
		--v.name,d.qty,d.rate ,d.*
		from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
		join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id 
		left join  #TempSpGetOPDFreeBedTopSheetVisitAmount t on t.TotalVisitAmount = d.Rate
		and t.VisitType='OPDOld'
		where v.name ='OPDOld'
			and convert(date,p.EntryDate) >=@FromDate
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) <=@ToDate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		group by v.name,d.rate, t.HospitalAmount,t.DoctorAmount

		UNION ALL

		select *,([Total]*@DoctorPercent)/100 [DoctorAmount]
		,([Total]*@HospitalPercent)/100 [HospitalAmount],'Part - B' PartGroup
		from 
		(
			select h.headname as OPDServiceName ,sum(o.qty) Nocast,o.rate,sum(o.qty) *o.Rate [Total]
			from hospital.ServiceSubSubGroups sg --on s.id = sg.servicesubgroupid
			join hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads h on h.servicesubsubgroupid =sg.id
			join opd.ServiceDetails o on o.serviceid = h.id
			join opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op on op.Id=o.PatientId
			where sg.id ='B3BAC528-8569-49A2-852F-B9AE528B345C'--57
			and convert(date,op.EntryDate) >=@FromDate
		and convert(date,op.EntryDate) <=@ToDate
		and (o.ServiceByDoctorId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			group by h.headname,o.rate
		)T
		) tbl FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[SpGetOutdoorConsultantFee]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[SpGetOutdoorConsultantFee]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetOutdoorConsultantFee]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
As 
Begin 


	Declare @FromDate date
    Declare @ToDate date
	Declare @ConsultantID uniqueidentifier

		Select @FromDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1;

		Select @ToDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2;

	Select @ConsultantID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10;

	--select @FromDate,@ToDate,@ConsultantID

	SELECT (
	SELECT * FROM (

	select name,FullName,InvoiceNo, sum([TotalSalesFromLedger]) [TotalSalesFromLedger],
	sum([TotalDiscount]) [TotalDiscount],
	sum([Paid]) [Paid],
	sum([Refund]) [Refund],
	sum([Cancel]) [Cancel],
	sum([DiscountAdjustment]) [DiscountAdjustment],
	UserName,
	[DoctorName]
	from 
	(

	select v.name, p.FullName,p.InvoiceNo,
	--sum(d.qty) * d.rate [ToalSales],
	case when l.TransactionType = 0 then sum(debit + credit) else 0 end [TotalSalesFromLedger],
	case when l.TransactionType = 1 then sum(debit + credit) else 0 end [TotalDiscount],
	case when l.TransactionType = 2  or l.TransactionType = 3 then sum(debit + credit) else 0 end [Paid],
	case when l.TransactionType = 5 then sum(debit + credit) else 0 end [Refund],
	case when l.TransactionType = 4 then sum(debit + credit) else 0 end [Cancel],
	case when l.TransactionType = 6 then sum(debit + credit) else 0 end [DiscountAdjustment],
	sum(debit + credit)  [Due],
	u.UserName,do.Name [DoctorName]
	from opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		
		join  opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p on p.id = d.patientid
		join  opd.PatientVisitTypes v on p.VisitTypeId = v.Id 
		join  OPD.OPDConsultancyLedger  l on l.PatientId = d.PatientId
		join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id = l.UserId
        join VWDoctors do on d.ServiceId = do.Id	
		where 
		--v.name ='OPDNew'
		--and 
		convert(date,p.EntryDate) >=@FromDate
	and convert(date,p.EntryDate) <=@ToDate
	and (d.ServiceId=@ConsultantID or @ConsultantID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and l.TransactionType in (0,1,2,3,4,5,6)
	--and p.InvoiceNo =2304191509
	group by v.name,d.rate,p.FullName,p.InvoiceNo,
	l.TransactionType,
	u.UserName,do.Name,do.Id
	)T
	group by T.DoctorName,T.Name,T.FullName,T.InvoiceNo,T.UserName

	) tbl 
	Order by tbl.DoctorName
	FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data

	


End
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [OPD].[spGetPatientAppointmetById]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

---------------


CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetPatientAppointmetById]
	@appointmentId uniqueidentifier
AS 
BEGIN 
	Select
		ap.Id,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (select 1)) SrlNo, 
		ap.UHID, 
		ap.VisitTypeId, 
		vt.Name VisitType,
		ap.Id, 
		ap.Fee, 
		ap.Status, 
		ap.RxInitDDate, 
		ap.FullName, 
		ap.MobileNo, 
		ap.AgeYear, 
		ap.AgeDay, 
		ap.AgeMonth, 
		ap.Sex, 
		ap.AppointmentDate, 
		cpCol.VisitDate As BillingTime, 
		ap.AppointmentTime, 
		ap.Remarks as Remarks, 
		ap.SerialNo, 
		ap.UserId, 
		u.UserName, 
		ap.DoctorId, 
		d.Name DoctorName,
		isnull(rd.Name,'') RefdDoctorName,
		ap.ClinicalFindings,
		ap.ClinicalImpression,
		ISNULL(rxd.Name, '') DepartmentName,
		ISNULL(rxd.FeatureKey, '') DeptFeatureKey
	from OPD.DoctorAppointments ap
		join Marketing.Doctors d on ap.DoctorId = d.Id 
		Join [Identity].Users u on ap.UserId = u.Id 
		join OPD.PatientVisitTypes vt on vt.Id = ap.VisitTypeId
		left join Marketing.Doctors rd on ap.RefdDoctorId = rd.Id 
		Left join OPD.CPPatientRecords as cpR On cpR.DoctorAppointmentId = ap.Id 
		Left join OPD.CPFeeCollectionRecords as cpCol On cpCol.CPPatientRecordId = cpR.Id
		Left join Rx.RxDepartments as rxd On ap.RxDepartmentId = rxd.Id

	where  ap.Id = @appointmentId
END

GO

 --------------------
 
-- Exec [OPD].[spGetPatientAppointmetsByDoctor] '2025-01-16', '2025-01-16', 'c0bae00e-d3a6-4485-9e63-08da8939fcc2', 0;

CREATE    PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetPatientAppointmetsByDoctor]
	@datefrom date, 
	@dateto date, 
	@DoctorId uniqueidentifier, 
	@GetType int 
AS 
BEGIN 
	Select
		ap.Id,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (select 1)) SrlNo, 
		ap.UHID, 
		isnull(v.RxNo, 0) as RxNo, 
		ap.VisitTypeId, 
		vt.Name VisitType,
		ap.Id, 
		ap.Fee, 
		ap.Status, 
		ap.RxInitDDate, 
		ap.FullName, 
		ap.MobileNo, 
		isnull(ap.AgeYear, isnull(rr.AgeYear, '')) AgeYear,
		isnull(ap.AgeMonth, isnull(rr.AgeMonth, '')) AgeMonth,
		isnull(ap.AgeDay, isnull(rr.AgeDay, '')) AgeDay,
		isnull(ap.Sex, isnull(rr.Sex, '')) Sex, 
		ap.AppointmentDate, 
		cpCol.VisitDate As BillingTime, 
		ap.AppointmentTime, 
		ap.Remarks as Remarks, 
		ap.SerialNo, 
		ap.UserId, 
		u.UserName, 
		ap.DoctorId, 
		d.Name DoctorName,
		isnull(rd.Name,'') RefdDoctorName,
		ap.ClinicalFindings,
		ap.ClinicalImpression,
		ap.RxDepartmentId,
		ap.MedicineServeStatus,
		ISNULL(rxd.Name, '') DepartmentName,
		ISNULL(rxd.FeatureKey, '') DeptFeatureKey,
		isnull((select COUNT(dg.Id) from Rx.Drugs dg where dg.RxVisitId = v.Id),0) MedicineCount
	from OPD.DoctorAppointments ap
		left join Hospital.RegRecords rr on ap.UHID = rr.UHID 
		join Marketing.Doctors d on ap.DoctorId = d.Id 
		Join [Identity].Users u on ap.UserId = u.Id 
		join OPD.PatientVisitTypes vt on vt.Id = ap.VisitTypeId
		LEFT join rx.VisitHistories v on v.AppointmentId = ap.Id
		left join Marketing.Doctors rd on ap.RefdDoctorId = rd.Id 
		Left join OPD.CPPatientRecords as cpR On cpR.DoctorAppointmentId = ap.Id 
		Left join OPD.CPFeeCollectionRecords as cpCol On cpCol.CPPatientRecordId = cpR.Id
		Left join Rx.RxDepartments as rxd On ap.RxDepartmentId = rxd.Id

	where  (ap.DoctorId = @DoctorId or @DoctorId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (cast(ap.AppointmentDate as Date) between @datefrom and @dateto)
END


GO

-- exec [OPD].[spGetPatientInfoForServiceCancel] 24103046010, 0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetPatientInfoForServiceCancel]
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@Type int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    declare @patientId uniqueidentifier;

	if(@Type = 0)
	begin
		select @patientId = Id from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices where InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
		select 
			@PatientId PatientId,
			InvoiceNo,
			(select sum(Debit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 0) TotalSale,
			(select sum(Credit - Debit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 1) Discount,
			(select sum(Credit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 2) Paid,
			(select sum(Debit - Credit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id) Due
		from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices p
		where Id = @patientId

		
	end
	else 
	begin

		select @patientId = Id from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees where InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
		select 
			@PatientId PatientId,
			InvoiceNo,
			(select sum(Debit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 0) TotalSale,
			(select sum(Credit - Debit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 1) Discount,
			(select sum(Credit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 2) Paid,
			(select sum(Debit - Credit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id) Due
		from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p
		where Id = @patientId

		
	end
END
