-- exec [OPD].[spGetServiceDetailsForCancel] 24103046010, 0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[spGetServiceDetailsForCancel]
	@InvoiceNo bigint,
	@Type int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    declare @patientId uniqueidentifier;

	if(@Type = 0)
	begin
		select @patientId = Id from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices where InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
		select 
			@PatientId PatientId,
			InvoiceNo,
			(select sum(Debit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 0) TotalSale,
			(select sum(Credit - Debit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 1) Discount,
			(select sum(Credit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 2) Paid,
			(select sum(Debit - Credit) from Opd.OPDServiceLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id) Due
		from OPD.PatientRecordOPDServices p
		where Id = @patientId

		select * from(select 
			d.Id,
			d.ServiceId,
			s.HeadName ServiceName,
			d.Qty,
			convert(float, d.Rate) Rate,
			d.IsDeleted
		from Opd.ServiceDetails d
		join Hospital.ServiceExecutingHeads s on s.Id = d.ServiceId
		where PatientId = @patientId and IsCancelApproved = 1 and d.IsDeleted = 0) as Items
	end
	else 
	begin

		select @patientId = Id from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees where InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
		select 
			@PatientId PatientId,
			InvoiceNo,
			(select sum(Debit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 0) TotalSale,
			(select sum(Credit - Debit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 1) Discount,
			(select sum(Credit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id and sl.TransactionType = 2) Paid,
			(select sum(Debit - Credit) from Opd.OPDConsultancyLedger sl where sl.PatientId = p.Id) Due
		from OPD.PatientRecordConsultancyFees p
		where Id = @patientId

		select * from(select 
			d.Id,
			d.ServiceId,
			s.Name ServiceName,
			d.Qty,
			convert(float, d.Rate) Rate,
			d.IsDeleted
		from Opd.ConsultancyDetails d
		join Marketing.Doctors s on s.Id = d.ServiceId
		where PatientId = @patientId and IsCancelApproved = 1 and d.IsDeleted = 0) as Items
	end
END

--  exec [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordByDate] '2025-06-19','2025-06-19'

CREATE PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordByDate]
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
as 

begin 
	declare @emptyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'; 
	select vs.Id, 
	isnull(vh.Id, @emptyId) VisitHistoryId, 
	vs.UHID,vs.InvoiceNo, 
	isnull( vs.IndentStatus, 'pending') IndentStatus, 
	iif( pr.Id is null, 0, 1) IsPrescribed, 
	rg.FullName,vs.CheckUpDate, 
	isnull((select top 1 Remarks from [Rx].[OPDProdureSuggessions] ps where ps.RxVisitId =  vh.Id ), '') Remarks,
	IsNull( rg.AgeYear, 0) Age, rg.Sex as Gender, v.Name As RefDoctor, rg.MobileNo,
	vs.VitalNo
	from [Hospital].[VitalSignRecords] vs 
	  left join Rx.VisitHistories vh on vh.VitalSignRecordId = vs.Id
	  left join OPD.OPDPrescriptions pr on pr.VitalId = vs.Id
	  left join [Hospital].[RegRecords] rg on vs.UHID=rg.UHID
	  Left Join VWDoctors as v On v.Id = rg.RefdId
	where --vs.HasValue = 1 and 
	cast(vs.CheckUpDate as date) >= cast(@FromDate as date) and 
	cast(vs.CheckUpDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date)
end 

GO

-- exec [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordByUHId] 2501290000402

CREATE   PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordByUHId]
	@UHId bigint
as 

begin 
	select vs.Id, 
		vh.Id VisitHistoryId, 
		vs.UHID,vs.InvoiceNo,
		rg.FullName,
		rg.AgeYear + 'Y ' + rg.AgeMonth + 'M ' + rg.AgeDay + 'D' Age,
		rg.Sex as Gender,
		rg.MobileNo,
		isnull(d.Name,'') as RefDoctor,
		vs.CheckUpDate
		, vh.CreatedOn 
	  from [Hospital].[VitalSignRecords] vs 
	  join Rx.PatientMasterDatas p on p.UHID = vs.UHID
	  join Rx.VisitHistories vh on vh.PatientMasterDataId = p.Id
	  left join VWDoctors d on d.Id = vh.DoctorId
	  left join [Hospital].[RegRecords] rg on vs.UHID=rg.UHID
	 where p.UHID = @UHId
	 ORDER BY vh.CreatedOn DESC,vs.CreatedOn DESC
end

--  exec [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordForOPDDoctorByDate] '2025-07-02','2025-07-02'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordForOPDDoctorByDate]
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
as 

begin 
	declare @emptyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'; 
	select vs.Id, 
	isnull(vh.Id, @emptyId) VisitHistoryId, 
	vs.UHID,vs.InvoiceNo, 
	isnull( vs.IndentStatus, 'pending') IndentStatus, 
	iif( pr.Id is null, 0, 1) IsPrescribed, 
	rg.FullName,vs.CheckUpDate, 
	isnull((select top 1 Remarks from [Rx].[OPDProdureSuggessions] ps where ps.RxVisitId =  vh.Id ), '') Remarks,
	IsNull( rg.AgeYear, 0) Age, rg.Sex as Gender, v.Name As RefDoctor, rg.MobileNo,
	vs.VitalNo,
	isnull(pr.OPDRxNo, 0) OPDRxNo
	from [Hospital].[VitalSignRecords] vs 
	   join [Hospital].[RegRecords] rg on vs.UHID=rg.UHID
	   LEFT join Rx.VisitHistories vh on vh.VitalSignRecordId = vs.Id
	   LEFT join OPD.OPDPrescriptions pr on pr.VitalId = vs.Id
	   LEFT Join VWDoctors as v On v.Id = rg.RefdId
	where vs.HasValue = 1 and cast(vs.CheckUpDate as date) 
	>= cast(@FromDate as date) and cast(vs.CheckUpDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date)
	-- AND (PR.CreatedOn IS NULL OR  (pr.CreatedOn = (SELECT MAX(px.CreatedOn) FROM OPD.OPDPrescriptions px WHERE px.VisitId = vh.Id )))
end

--  exec [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordForOPDDoctorByDate_TestPurpose] '2025-06-19','2025-06-19'

create     PROCEDURE [OPD].[SpGetVitalSignRecordForOPDDoctorByDate_TestPurpose]
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
as 

begin 
	declare @emptyId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'; 
	select vs.Id, 
	isnull(vh.Id, @emptyId) VisitHistoryId, 
	vs.UHID,vs.InvoiceNo, 
	isnull( vs.IndentStatus, 'pending') IndentStatus, 
	iif( pr.Id is null, 0, 1) IsPrescribed, 
	rg.FullName,vs.CheckUpDate, 
	isnull((select top 1 Remarks from [Rx].[OPDProdureSuggessions] ps where ps.RxVisitId =  vh.Id ), '') Remarks,
	IsNull( rg.AgeYear, 0) Age, rg.Sex as Gender, v.Name As RefDoctor, rg.MobileNo
	from [Hospital].[VitalSignRecords] vs 
	   join [Hospital].[RegRecords] rg on vs.UHID=rg.UHID
	   LEFT join Rx.VisitHistories vh on vh.VitalSignRecordId = vs.Id
	   LEFT join OPD.OPDPrescriptions pr on pr.VisitId = vh.Id
	   LEFT Join VWDoctors as v On v.Id = rg.RefdId
	where vs.HasValue = 1 and cast(vs.CheckUpDate as date) 
	>= cast(@FromDate as date) and cast(vs.CheckUpDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date)
	AND (PR.CreatedOn IS NULL OR  (pr.CreatedOn = (SELECT MAX(px.CreatedOn) FROM OPD.OPDPrescriptions px WHERE px.VisitId = vh.Id )))
	AND (vh.VisitDate IS NULL OR (vh.VisitDate = (SELECT MAX(vhx.VisitDate) FROM rx.VisitHistories vhx  WHERE vhx.VitalSignRecordId = vs.Id )))
end

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[UserWiseCollectionReport]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

--exec [OPD].[UserWiseCollectionReport]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,0'


AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@StaffID uniqueIdentifier,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @StaffID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@StaffID

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID int
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'OPD',1
	union all
	select 'OPD',2
	union all
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY',5
	union all
	select 'DIALYSIS',3
	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		NetCollection float

	)

	-- select * from Hospital.AdvancePayments

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)

	select 'Advance from Admission' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @StaffID or @StaffID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo


	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'OPD' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  para.ReportType, op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(op.UserId = @StaffID or @StaffID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.ReportType,  T.BillNo,T.FullName

	/*
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select 'DIALYSIS' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'DIALYSIS' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =3 or op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =3
			and		(op.UserId = @StaffID or @StaffID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName
	

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,NetCollection)
	
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'PHYSIOTHERAPY' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	0 
	From 
	(
			select  op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =5 or op.ServiceSubSubGroupId =5
			and		(op.UserId = @StaffID or @StaffID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName
	*/

	update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetCollection =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash )
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

	--	select(
	--select * from(
	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		NetCollection 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
		--	) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [OPD].[UserWiseCollectionReportDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7.OPDServiceGroupId [int], 8.OPDServiceHeadId [Guid], 9.typeid (0 or 1), 
--10. ConsultantID [Guid], 11.@HoD [Guid], 12.@MarketingManagerId[Guid] , 13.@MarketingOfficerId[Guid] ,14.12.MarketingJOfficerId[Guid], 15.MarketingMediaId[Guid], 16.DoctorType 'OPD or IPD', 17.CorporateClientID int
--For 12 and 13 Value will come from same table MarketingJOfficerOrMedias based on RoleType column

-- exec [OPD].[UserWiseCollectionReportDynamic]'2024-11-04,2024-11-14,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @UserID=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	

	--select @UserId
	 
	
	--return 
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@UserId

	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter
	(
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		ServiceID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	)

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter 
	select 'OPD EMERGENCY','5007CBE8-ADE6-4438-8E04-9A5F542650A5'--1
	union all
	select 'OPD BLOOD BANK','BA1C82FC-3983-452E-AA14-2A3D24E1ECE2'--55
	union all
	select 'OPD VACCINE','A0FC28C7-A2AC-4809-AF5B-22CFFCA118DE'--56
	union all
	select 'DAY CARE CHEMOTHERAPY','0205467F-670F-447D-8026-79FAA728C9EB'--58
	union all
	select 'OPD M & Z AMBULANCE','80544C33-3E12-4013-8C3A-99204E5B14EA'--74
	union all
	select 'OPD AMBULANCE PMCH','6A1D203D-CC05-4F90-AE02-DD4B6C2E19E8'--76
	union all
	select 'OPD FREE BED','B3BAC528-8569-49A2-852F-B9AE528B345C'--57
	union all
	select 'PHYSIOTHERAPY','E9A6597C-6977-46CC-A175-9585F33057E3'--3
	union all
	select 'DIALYSIS','E0632E00-DA26-4C22-AF06-DA231F3B70A9'--2

	union all
	select 'SKIN OPD','B127CEF0-52CD-4947-AFFB-EB93D5B99046'--99

	
	create table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		ReportType nvarchar(max),
		SLNO bigint,
		BillNo   nvarchar(max),
		PatientName nvarchar(max),
		BedCabinName	nvarchar(max),
		RegularCash float,
		RegularCard float,
		RegularMobileNagad float,
		RegularMopbileBkash float,
		RegularMopbileRocket float,
		DueCollectionCash float,
		DueCollectionCard float,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad float,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash float,
		DueCollectionMopbileRocket float,
		Refund FLOAT,
		DueAmount float,
		NetPayble float

	)

	-- select * from Hospital.AdvancePayments

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble)

	select 'Advance from Admission' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0 
	
	From 
	(
	select  p.InvoiceNo BillNo ,p.FullName,c.CabinNo ,
	case when pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCash,
	case when  pm.Id =2 then a.amount else 0 end RegularCard,
	case when pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.amount else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	case when pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.amount else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket
	from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = p.AdmittedCabinId
	join Hospital.AdvancePayments a on a.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
	join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
	join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
	where  convert(date,a.PayDate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and    convert(date,a.PayDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	and		(u.Id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.BillNo,T.FullName,T.CabinNo

	
	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble,DueAmount,Refund)
	
	select ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'OPD' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices opp 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0) dueAmount,
	SUM(Refund)Refund
	From 
	(
			select  para.ReportType, op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =0 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
			case when a.TransactionType =5 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit else 0 end Refund
			from opd.PatientRecordOPDServices op 
			join opd.OPDServiceLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			left join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			left join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
				join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by T.ReportType,  T.BillNo,T.FullName

	-------New start

	insert into #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
	(ReportType,SLNO,BillNo,PatientName,BedCabinName,RegularCash,RegularCard,RegularMobileNagad,RegularMopbileBkash,RegularMopbileRocket,
	DueCollectionCash,DueCollectionCard,DueCollectionMobileNagad,DueCollectionMopbileBkash,DueCollectionMopbileRocket,NetPayble,DueAmount,Refund)
	
	select 'CONSULTANCY' ReportType,0 SLNO,BillNo,FullName,'Consultancy' CabinNo,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileNagad) RegularMobileNagad,
	sum(RegularMopbileBkash) RegularMopbileBkash,
	sum(RegularMopbileRocket) RegularMopbileRocket,
	sum(DueCollectionCash) DueCollectionCash,
	sum(DueCollectionCard) DueCollectionCard,
	sum(DueCollectionMobileNagad) DueCollectionMobileNagad,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileBkash) DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
	sum(DueCollectionMopbileRocket) DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
	0 ,
	isnull((
		select sum(debit)- sum(Credit)  
		from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees opp 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger aa on aa.PatientId = opp.Id
			and opp.InvoiceNo = T.BillNo
	),0)DueAmount
	,SUM(Refund) Refund
	From 
	(
			select   op.InvoiceNo BillNo ,op.FullName,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =1 and pm.Id =1 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and  pm.Id =2 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =7 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =2 and pc.Id =6 and pm.Id =3 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end RegularMopbileRocket,

			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCash,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionCard,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMobileNagad,
			case when a.TransactionType =3 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileBkash,
			case when a.TransactionType =0 and pc.Id =0 and pm.Id =0 then a.Debit + a.Credit else 0 end DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
			case when a.TransactionType =5 and pc.Id =5 and pm.Id =5 then a.Debit else 0 end Refund
			from opd.PatientRecordConsultancyFees op 
			join opd.OPDConsultancyLedger a on a.PatientId = op.Id
			left join Admin.PaymentChannels pc on pc.Id = a.PaymentChannelId
			left join Admin.PaymentModes pm on pm.Id = pc.PaymentModeId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = a.UserId
			--join #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReportParameter para on para.ServiceID = op.ServiceSubSubGroupId
			where  convert(date,a.TranDate)>=@FilterStartDate
			and    convert(date,a.TranDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and		(u.id = @UserId or @UserId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by  T.BillNo,T.FullName

		update #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport set
	SLNO =
	(
			select count(t.Autoid) from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport t
			where t.AutoID <=#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.AutoID
			and t.ReportType =#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.ReportType
	),
	NetPayble =	(	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCash + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularCard + #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMobileNagad 
					+	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileBkash +	#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.RegularMopbileRocket - ISNULL(#TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport.Refund,0)  
					)
	--where ReportType ='Advance from Admission'

		select(
	select * from(

	select ReportType ,
		SLNO ,
		BillNo   ,
		PatientName ,
		BedCabinName	,
		RegularCash ,
		RegularCard ,
		RegularMobileNagad ,
		RegularMopbileBkash ,
		RegularMopbileRocket,
		DueCollectionCash ,
		DueCollectionCard ,
		DueCollectionMobileNagad ,
		DueCollectionMopbileBkash ,
		DueCollectionMopbileRocket,
		isnull(DueAmount,0) DueAmount,
		isnull(Refund,0) Refund,
		ISNULL(NetPayble,0) NetPayble 
		from #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
			) tbl  
			order by tbl.BillNo
			FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempOPDUserWiseCollectionReport
END
GO

-- =============================================

------------exec [Payroll].FestivalBonus 2023,04,4,'2022-10-14'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[FestivalBonus]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Year int,
	@Month int,
	@TypeId int,
	@BeforeJoiningDate date
AS
BEGIN

	--SELECT 'PH0001' as EmployeeNo, 'XYZ' as EmployeeName, '2020-01-01' as JoiningDate,
	--'xyz' as Designation, 'ddd' as Department, 0 as TotalSalary, 0 as BasicSalary,0 as BonusAmount,
	--'Cash' as PaymentMode, 0 as BonusYear, 0 as BonusMonth, 0 as FestId
	declare @FirstDayofthisMonth date
	declare @LastDayofPreviousMonth date

	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
	select @LastDayofPreviousMonth = DATEADD(Month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth) --------for previous month salary


	----SET @LastDayofPreviousMonth =@FirstDayofthisMonth --------------for running month salary
	
	select r.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,r.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,r.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,dg.Name Designation,dept.Name  Department,
	s.GTotal TotalSalary,s.Basic BasicSalary ,round((f.BonusPercentOfBasic*s.Basic)/100,0) BonusAmount,
	r.PaymentMode PaymentMode,isnull(r.BankAccountNo,0) as BankAccountNo,
	f.Year  BonusYear, f.Month BonusMonth, f.FestivalId FestId, fs.FestivalName  FestivalName, convert(bit,1) IsCommit, r.Id StaffRecordId,convert(uniqueidentifier, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') Id
	from hr.StaffRecords r
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets s
		on r.id = s.StaffRecordId
		and s.SalaryYear = year(@FirstDayofthisMonth)
		and s.SalaryMonth = month(@LastDayofPreviousMonth)
	join Payroll.FestivalBonuses f 
	join hr.Festivals fs on fs.Id=f.FestivalId
		on f.FestivalId = @TypeId
		and f.Year = year(@FirstDayofthisMonth)
		and f.Month = month(@FirstDayofthisMonth)
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id = r.DesignationId
	join hr.Departments dept on dept.Id = r.DeptId
	where convert(date,r.JoiningDate)<= @BeforeJoiningDate
	and r.IsInActive=0
	----and dept.id<>11
	order by PaymentMode, JoiningDate
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[FestivalBonusBankStatementDynamic]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@FestivalId int,
	@year int,
	@month int;
	declare @TenantId int;

	Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
	Select @FestivalId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10
	Select @TenantId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=6;

	select * into #TempFestivalBonusBankStatementDynamic from hr.Departments d
where 
(
(@TenantId = 4 and d.id in (11))
or 
(@TenantId = 2 and d.id not in  (11))
or @TenantId =0
)
	
	select( select * from(

	--SELECT 'PH0001' as EmployeeNo, 'XYZ' as EmployeeName, '2020-01-01' as JoiningDate,
	--'xyz' as Designation, 'ddd' as Department, 0 as TotalSalary, 0 as BasicSalary,0 as BonusAmount, 'x01' as BankAccNo
	select distinct s.EmployeeNo as EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName as EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) as   JoiningDate, dg.Name as Designation,
			d.Name as Department, ab.TotalSalary as TotalSalary, ab.BasicAmount as BasicSalary, ab.BonusAmount as BonusAmount,s.BankAccountNo as BankAccNo
			from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ab 
			join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a on a.StaffRecordId=ab.StaffRecordId
		join hr.StaffRecords s on s.Id=ab.StaffRecordId
		join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
		--join hr.Departments d on d.id=s.DeptId
		join #TempFestivalBonusBankStatementDynamic d on d.id=s.DeptId 
		where @year=ab.BonusYear and @month=ab.BonusMonth 
		and @FestivalId=ab.FestvalId
		and s.PaymentMode='Bank'

	)tbl 
	
	order by EmployeeNo

	for json auto)as Data
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-- exec [Payroll].[IncrementStatementEmployeeWise] 2022, 11,0, ''
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[IncrementStatementEmployeeWise]
	@year int,
	@month int,
	@DepartmentId int,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @LastMonth date
	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date

	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')

	select @LastMonth = DATEADD(Month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)

	select distinct   s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EmpName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) joiningDate, dg.Name Designation, 
	d.Name Department,
	--ap.GTotal PreviousSalary, ap.Basic PreviousBasic,
	isnull((
		select  ap.GTotal from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=ind.EmployeeId
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0)PreviousSalary,
	isnull((
		select  ap.Basic from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=ind.EmployeeId
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0)PreviousBasic,

	round(inc.TotalInrementedAmount,0) IncrementAmount,round(inc.Arrear,0) ArrearAmount,
	--ind.BasicAmount*inc.GeneralIncrementInPercent /100 IncrementAmount, 
	round(ind.TotalSalary,0) PresentSalary,'' Remarks
	
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.IncrementRecords inc on inc.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries ind on ind.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap on ap.StaffRecordId=ind.EmployeeId
	where @Year=inc.Year and @month=inc.Month
	and (s.EmployeeNo=@EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='')
	and (d.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
	and inc.TotalInrementedAmount<>0
	group by s.id, s.EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate, dg.Name, d.Name,
	--ap.GTotal,ap.Basic, 
	inc.TotalInrementedAmount, inc.arrear, ind.TotalSalary,ind.EmployeeId
END
GO

-- =============================================

--exec [Payroll].[IncrementStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2025,02,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

CREATE         PROCEDURE [Payroll].[IncrementStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic]
	--@year int,
	--@month int,
	--@DepartmentId int,
	--@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

Declare @month int
Declare @year int
Declare @DeptId int
Declare @EmployeeNo uniqueidentifier
declare @TenantId int

Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
Select @DeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
Select @EmployeeNo=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
Select @TenantId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=6;

	

		
select * into #TempIncrementStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic from hr.Departments d
where 
(
(@TenantId = 4 and d.id in (11))
or 
(@TenantId = 2 and d.id not in  (11))
or @TenantId =0
)


	DECLARE @LastMonth date
	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date

	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')

	select @LastMonth = DATEADD(Month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)

	 select(
	select * from(

	select distinct  s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EmpName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) joiningDate, dg.Name Designation, 
	d.Name Department,
	--ap.GTotal PreviousSalary, ap.Basic PreviousBasic,
	isnull((
		select  ap.GTotal from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=ind.EmployeeId
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0)PreviousSalary,
	isnull((
		select  ap.Basic from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=ind.EmployeeId
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0)PreviousBasic,

	round(inc.TotalInrementedAmount,0) IncrementAmount,round(inc.Arrear,0) ArrearAmount,
	--ind.BasicAmount*inc.GeneralIncrementInPercent /100 IncrementAmount, 
	round(ind.TotalSalary,0) PresentSalary,'' Remarks
	
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	--join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join #TempIncrementStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.IncrementRecords inc on inc.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries ind on ind.EmployeeId=s.Id
	 where @Year=inc.Year and @month=inc.Month
	and (s.id=@EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and inc.TotalInrementedAmount<>0
	group by s.id, s.EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate, dg.Name, d.Name,
	
	inc.TotalInrementedAmount, inc.arrear, ind.TotalSalary,ind.EmployeeId

	) tbl order by tbl.EmpNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-----exec Payroll.[LeaveIncashment] 2023,12,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[LeaveIncashment] 
	--@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	 @year int,
	 @month int,
	 @EmployeeNo uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN
	
DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofCurrentMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalCurentMonthDayCount int
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
DECLARE @TotalYearlyLeave int =24

DECLARE @FirstDayofYear date
DECLARE @LastDayofYear date



set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

set @FirstDayofYear =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),'01')+'-01')
set @LastDayofYear =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),'12')+'-31')



	select s.Id StaffRecordId, s.EmployeeNo EmpoyeeNo, s.EmployeeName	EmployeeName, Convert(date,s.JoiningDate)	Joiningdate,
	dg.Name Designation,
	d.Name Department,
	A.PaymentMode PaymentMode,
	A.GTotal GrossSalary,	0 TotalLeaveEnjoyed, 
	DATEDIFF(MONTH,s.JoiningDate,@LastDayofYear)+1 [JoiningMonth],
	0 	TotalLeave,
	0 	RemainLeave, 0 	PerdayLeaveAmount,0 	Payableamount,
	s.Id
	into #TempLeaveIncashment
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	JOIN Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a on a.StaffRecordId = s.Id
	where  (s.Id=@EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and a.SalaryYear = @year
	AND A.SalaryMonth = @month
	

	update #TempLeaveIncashment set
	TotalLeaveEnjoyed =
	isnull((
			select sum(h.TotalDays) from hr.LeaveRecords h
			where h.StaffId = #TempLeaveIncashment.Id
			and h.Datefrom >= @FirstDayofYear
			and h.DateTo <= @LastDayofYear
	),0)

	Update #TempLeaveIncashment set
	TotalLeave =
	(
		select 
			case when [JoiningMonth] <12 then 
						((@TotalYearlyLeave /12)  * [JoiningMonth]) 
			else 
			 @TotalYearlyLeave end TotalYearlyLeave
			from #TempLeaveIncashment t 
			where t.id =#TempLeaveIncashment.Id 
	)
	Update #TempLeaveIncashment set
	RemainLeave = TotalLeave -TotalLeaveEnjoyed,
	PerdayLeaveAmount = GrossSalary/30
	
	Update #TempLeaveIncashment set
	Payableamount = (RemainLeave*PerdayLeaveAmount)
	Update #TempLeaveIncashment set
	Payableamount = 0
	where Payableamount <0 
	

	 
	
	select StaffRecordId, EmpoyeeNo as EmployeeNo,	EmployeeName,Joiningdate,
	 Designation,
	Department,
	PaymentMode,
	GrossSalary,
	 TotalLeaveEnjoyed, 
	-- [JoiningMonth],
	--0 	TotalLeave,
		RemainLeave, 	PerdayLeaveAmount, 	Payableamount
	
	from #TempLeaveIncashment
	where  RemainLeave>0
	order by EmpoyeeNo




END
GO

-- Exec [Payroll].[LWPStatementEmlpoyeeWise]  08, 2024, ''

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[LWPStatementEmlpoyeeWise]
	@month int,
	@year int,
	@EmpNo nvarchar(max)
AS
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofCurrentMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalCurentMonthDayCount int

set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))
select @TotalCurentMonthDayCount= day(@LastDayofCurrentMonth)



select @TotalMonthDay = DAY(@LastDayofthisMOnth)

BEGIN
	select EmpNo,EMpName,Designnation,Department,LWPQty,
	case when OthersDeducation > 0 then convert(decimal(18,2),OthersDeducation )
	else convert(decimal(18,2),TotalLWPAmount) end 
	TotalLWPAmount
	from 
	(

	select s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EMpName, dg.Name Designnation, d.Name Department, isnull(sd.Lwp,0) LWPQty,
	 --isnull(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0) TotalLWPAmount
	  isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount,
	  isnull((
		select sum(ppp.OthersDeducation) from Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions ppp
		--join hr.StaffRecords ss on ss.Id=ppp.StaffRecordId
		where	ppp.month = @month
		and		ppp.year  = @year
		and		s.Id=ppp.StaffRecordId
	  ),0) OthersDeducation
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id= s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions sd on sd.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where (sd.month=@month)  and
	 (sd.year=@year) and
	 (s.EmployeeNo=@EmpNo or @EmpNo='')
	 )T
	 ---- isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount,
END
GO

AS

select * into #TempLWPStatementEmlpoyeeWiseDynamic from hr.Departments d

DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date

DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2

set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))
select @TotalCurentMonthDayCount= day(@LastDayofCurrentMonth)



select @TotalMonthDay = DAY(@LastDayofthisMOnth)

BEGIN

select(
select * from (
	select s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EMpName, dg.Name Designnation, d.Name Department, isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2), (sd.Lwp)),0),0) LWPQty,
	 --isnull(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0) TotalLWPAmount
	  isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	--join hr.Departments d on d.Id= s.DeptId
	join #TempLWPStatementEmlpoyeeWiseDynamic d on d.Id= s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions sd on sd.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where (sd.month=@month)  and
	 (sd.year=@year) and
	 (s.Id=@EmpId or @EmpId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
) tbl FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data
	 ---- isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount,

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[OvertimeStatement]

	@month int,
	@DepartmentId int,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
	
AS
BEGIN
	
--	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
--	DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
--	DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
--	DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
--	DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
--	DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2

--	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
--SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

--select @TotalMonthDay = DATEDIFF(day,@FirstDayofthisMonth,@LastDayofthisMOnth)
	
--	Select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EmpName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) joiningDate, dg.Name Designation, d.Name Department,
--	isnull(ind.TotalSalary,0) TotalSalary,o.Hours OvertimeHour,
--	case when sum(Hours) > 1 then
--	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(convert(decimal(12,2),(max(ind.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours)),0),0)/isnull(sum(Hours),1)) end  PerhourAmount,
	
--	isnull(round(convert(decimal(12,2),(max(ind.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours)),0),0) OvertimeAmount

DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofCurrentMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalCurentMonthDayCount int
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date


set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

select @TotalCurentMonthDayCount= day(@LastDayofCurrentMonth)


select @TotalMonthDay = DAY(@LastDayofthisMOnth)
	Select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EmpName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) joiningDate, dg.Name Designation, d.Name Department,
isnull(ind.TotalSalary,0) TotalSalary,o.Hours OvertimeHour,
case when sum(Hours) > 1 then
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(convert(decimal(12,2),(max(ind.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours)),0),0)/isnull(sum(Hours),1)) 
else 0.00
end  PerhourAmount,
	
isnull(round(convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(((max(ind.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours)),0.00) + isnull(sum(o.TotalAmount),0)),0),0) OvertimeAmount

	
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on o.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries ind on ind.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where (@Year=o.PayYear and @month=o.PayMonth)
	and (s.EmployeeNo=@EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='')
	and (d.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
	and ((o.Hours<>0) or o.TotalAmount <> 0 )
	
	group by s.Id,s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate,dg.Name,d.Name,ind.TotalSalary,o.Hours
	 order by s.EmployeeNo

END

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[PFSettlementReportEmployeeWise]
			@EmployeeNo nvarchar(Max),
			@TotalInterest float =0

			-- exec [Payroll].[PFSettlementReportEmployeeWise] 'PH00010'
AS
BEGIN

--with DateYearMonthName AS
--(

select * into #DateYearMonthName from 
(
SELECT 1 MonthID , 'January' MonthName
UNION ALL SELECT 2 , 'February'
UNION ALL SELECT 3 , 'March'
UNION ALL SELECT 4 , 'April'
UNION ALL SELECT 5 , 'May'
UNION ALL SELECT 6 , 'June'
UNION ALL SELECT 7 , 'July'
UNION ALL SELECT 8 , 'August'
UNION ALL SELECT 9 , 'September'
UNION ALL SELECT 10 , 'October'
UNION ALL SELECT 11 , 'November'
UNION ALL SELECT 12 , 'December'
)T
--)


select s.EmployeeNo,
s.EmployeeName,
dg.Name [Designation],
dept.Name [Department],
s.JoiningDate,s.id
into #EmployeeDetails
from hr.StaffRecords s
join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId
where s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo

--select * from #EmployeeDetails
--return


select EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],JoiningDate,YearName, PRYear,
cast(isnull(sum(January),0) as float) January,cast(isnull(sum(February),0) as float) February,cast(isnull(sum(March),0) as float) March,
cast(isnull(sum(April),0) as float) April,cast(isnull(sum(May),0) as float) May,cast(isnull(sum(June),0) as float) June,cast(isnull(sum(July),0) as float) July,
cast(isnull(sum(August),0) as float) August,
cast(isnull(sum(September),0) as float) September,cast(isnull(sum(October),0) as float) October,cast(isnull(sum(November),0) as float) November,cast(isnull(sum(December),0) as float) December,
cast((isnull(sum(January),0) + isnull(sum(February),0) + isnull(sum(March),0) + isnull(sum(April),0) +  isnull(sum(May),0) + isnull(sum(June),0) 
+isnull(sum(July),0) +  isnull(sum(August),0) + isnull(sum(September),0) + isnull(sum(October),0) + isnull(sum(November),0) + 
isnull(sum(December),0)) as float)  
Yearlytotal
into #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
from 
(
			select *
			from 
			(
			select  s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.[Designation] [Designation],
			s.[Department] [Department],
			s.JoiningDate,
			YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) YearName,
			'Year - '+convert(varchar(4),YEAR(vm.VoucherDate)) PRYear,
			#DateYearMonthName.MonthName [FullMonthNameDisplay],
			#DateYearMonthName.MonthName [FullMonthName],
			case when YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) <2022 then
			round(vd.Credit/12,0) 
			when YEAR(vm.VoucherDate)  =2022 and #DateYearMonthName.MonthID <10 then round(vd.Credit/10,0) 
			else 0 end MonthWiseAmount,0 Yearlytotal
			from PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers  g
			join #EmployeeDetails s --on s.EmployeeNo = SUBSTRING(g.Name,0, CHARINDEX('-',g.Name))
			on g.StaffRecordId = s.Id
			--join hr.StaffRecords s on s.EmployeeNo = SUBSTRING(g.Name,0, CHARINDEX('-',g.Name))
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasterDetails vd on vd.DTLID = g.Id
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasters vm on vd.VMID=vm.VMID
			--join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
			--join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId

			cross join #DateYearMonthName
			where --g.id='4A212AD4-57B8-4592-A2D6-0104323B615D'
			--and DTLID='4A212AD4-57B8-4592-A2D6-0104323B615D'
			s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo
			)T
			PIVOT(
				SUM(MonthWiseAmount) 
				FOR FullMonthNameDisplay IN (January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December)
			) AS pivot_table

			union all

			select * from 
			(
			select s.EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.Designation [Designation],
			s.Department [Department],
			s.JoiningDate,
			a.SalaryYear,
			'Year - '+convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear) PRYear,
			DATENAME (Month,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),a.SalaryMonth)+'-1')) FullMonthNameDisplay,
			DATENAME (Month,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),a.SalaryMonth)+'-1')) [FullMonthName],
			a.PF MonthWiseAmount, 0 Yearlytotal
			
			from 
			Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a
			--join hr.StaffRecords s on s.Id = a.StaffRecordId
			--join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
			--join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId
			join #EmployeeDetails s on s.Id = a.StaffRecordId
			)T
			PIVOT(
				SUM(MonthWiseAmount) 
				FOR FullMonthNameDisplay IN (January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December)
			) AS pivot_table
			where EmployeeNo =@EmployeeNo
)TT
group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],JoiningDate,YearName, PRYear

DECLARE @TotalPF float

select @TotalPF=sum(Yearlytotal) from #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
select EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],JoiningDate,YearName, PRYear,@TotalPF [TotalOwnPF],@TotalPF 

[TotalCompanyPF],@TotalInterest TotalInterest ,

January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December,Yearlytotal

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
----------exec Payroll.[PunishmentStatement] 2022,9,0,''

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[PunishmentStatement]
	@Year int,
	@month int,
	@DepartmentId int,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
	
AS
BEGIN

	Select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName EmpName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) joiningDate, dg.Name Designation, d.Name Department,
	isnull(o.PunishmentAmount,0) PunishmentAmount
	
	
	
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.SalaryPunishments o on o.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	--left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries ind on ind.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where @Year=o.SalaryYear and @month=o.SalaryMonth
	and (s.EmployeeNo=@EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='')
	and (d.Id=@DepartmentId or @DepartmentId=0)
	
	group by s.Id,s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate,dg.Name,d.Name,o.PunishmentAmount


END
GO

-- =============================================

--exec [Payroll].spGetAprovedFestivalBonusByYearMonthFestival 2023,04,1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetAprovedFestivalBonusByYearMonthFestival]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Year int,
	@Month int,
	@FestivalId int
AS
BEGIN

	select sr.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,sr.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,sr.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,dg.Name Designation,dept.Name  Department,
	afb.TotalSalary TotalSalary,afb.BasicAmount BasicSalary ,afb.BonusAmount BonusAmount,
	sr.PaymentMode PaymentMode,afb.BonusYear BonusYear, afb.BonusMonth BonusMonth, afb.FestvalId FestId, f.FestivalName  FestivalName,afb.IsCommit,sr.Id StaffRecordId,afb.Id
	from [Payroll].[AprovedFestivalBonuses] afb left join
	     [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on afb.StaffRecordId=sr.Id left join
		 [HR].[Festivals] f on afb.FestvalId=f.Id left join
		 [HR].[Designations] dg on dg.Id=sr.DesignationId left join
		 [HR].[Departments] dept on dept.Id=sr.DeptId
   where afb.FestvalId=@FestivalId and afb.BonusYear=@Year and afb.BonusMonth=@Month
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetBanksalaryStatement]

AS
BEGIN



DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempSpGetBanksalaryStatement

(

EmpName nvarchar(max),

Designation nvarchar(max),

)
insert into #tempSpGetBanksalaryStatement
(

join hr.Departments d on d.Id=e.DeptId
join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=e.DesignationId

order by e.EmployeeNo
select * from #tempSpGetBanksalaryStatement
drop table #tempSpGetBanksalaryStatement
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetBanksalaryStatement2]

order by e.EmployeeNo
select * from #tempSpGetBanksalaryStatement2
drop table #tempSpGetBanksalaryStatement2

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetDeptWiseHrSalarySummary]
@month varchar(20),
@year int,
@DepartmentID int=0
AS
BEGIN

print ''

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
--OthersAllowance decimal(10,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary] decimal(12,2),
[Total Deduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2)
)

insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[Total Deduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
)
exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,@DepartmentID,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

select
DeptName,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,

isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([Total Deduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,
isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount ,
isnull(sum(OtherAllowance),0.00) OtherAllowance
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
group by DeptName
End

	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (

Select @DepartmentID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),

[Basic] decimal(12,2),

MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),

 --OthersAllowance decimal(10,2),

GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[Total Deduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2)
)

insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[Total Deduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
)
exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,@DepartmentID,null

select(
	select 
	DeptName,
	isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
	isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
	isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
	isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
	isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
	isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
	isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
	isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
	isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
	--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
	isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,

	isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
	isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
	isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
	isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
	isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
	isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
	isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
	isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
	isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
	isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
	isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
	isnull(sum([Total Deduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,
	isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
	isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount ,
	isnull(sum(OtherAllowance),0.00) OthersALLAllowance 
	from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
	group by DeptName FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data
End

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[spGetEligibleEmployeeListForIncrement]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
------------exec Payroll.spGetEligibleEmployeeListForIncrement 11,2022
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetEligibleEmployeeListForIncrement]
	@Month int,
	@Year int
AS
BEGIN

		DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
		DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
		DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth date
		
		set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
		SELECT @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = Dateadd(Month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
		SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
		
		
		DECLARE @DayCount int = DAY(@LastDayofthisMOnth)


	
	
	select reportType,StaffRecordId,EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,JoiningDate,Designation,Department,LastIncrementdate,GrossSalary GrossSalaryTotal,
	
	case when IsNull(IncrementType,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*GrossSalary)/100))))
	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),IncrementAmountFixed) end 	IncrementAmount,

	--IncrementType,
	--@DayCount,
	--MonthDayDiff,

	case when IsNull(IncrementType,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*GrossSalary)/100)/@DayCount)*MonthDayDiff))
	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),((((IncrementAmountFixed))/@DayCount)*MonthDayDiff)) end 	IncrementArrear,

	IncrementInPercent+IncrementAmountFixed as Increment,IncrementType,EvaluationDuration,

	
	BasicAmount,
	/*
	case when IsNull(IncrementType,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*HouseRentInPercentOfBasic)/100))))
	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),HouseRentInPercentOfBasic) end 	HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,

	case when IsNull(IncrementType,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic)/100))))
	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic) end 	MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
	
	case when IsNull(IncrementType,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*Conveyance)/100))))
	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),Conveyance) end 	Conveyance, 
	*/
	 HouseRentInPercentOfBasic ,
	MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
	Conveyance ,
	OtherAllowance,
	IsPFDeductionOn

	
	
	from 
	(
		select 1 reportType,s.Id StaffRecordId, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
		DateDiff(Day,s.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(s.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, s.JoiningDate)))+1 MonthDayDiff,
		dg.Name Designation,d.Name Department,
		isnull(convert(date,max(ee.Incrementdate)),'')  LastIncrementdate,
		 --convert(decimal(18,2),(isnull(isd.TotalSalary,0))) GrossSalary,
		 convert(decimal(18,2),(isnull(isd.BasicAmount + isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic + isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,0))) GrossSalary,
		case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Percentage(%)' then 10 else 0 end IncrementInPercent,
		case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Fixed' then IsNull(isd.FixedAmount,0) else 0 end IncrementAmountFixed,
		IsNull(ic.Name,'') as IncrementType,
		IsNull(ed.Name,'') as EvaluationDuration, 
		isd.BasicAmount,
		isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,
		isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
		isd.Conveyance,
		isd.OtherAllowance,
		isd.IsPFDeductionOn
	 
		from hr.StaffRecords s
		join hr.Departments d on d.id=s.DeptId
		join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
		left join [Payroll].[IncrementRecords] ee
		on ee.StaffRecordId = s.Id and ee.StaffRecordId is null
		left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries isd on isd.EmployeeId=s.id
		left join Payroll.IncrementTypes ic on isd.IncermentTypeId=ic.Id
		left join Payroll.SalaryEvaluationDurations ed on isd.SalaryEvaluationDurationId=ed.Id
		where 
			(
		--datediff(Month,s.joiningdate,@FirstDayofthisMonth) = 14
		 (MONTH(s.JoiningDate) = ( @Month -1) and year(s.joiningdate) <>  @Year and @Month <> 1)
		 or
		  (MONTH(s.JoiningDate) = 12 and year(s.joiningdate) <>  (@Year-1) and @Month = 1)
		  )
		--and ee.StaffRecordId is null
		and s.IsInActive='False'
		and s.EmployeeNo not in ('PH01610', 'PH00004')
		---, 'PH00972'
	
		group by s.Id,s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate,dg.Name,d.Name,isd.TotalSalary,isd.BasicAmount,isd.FixedAmount,ic.Name,ed.Name,isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,isd.Conveyance,
		isd.OtherAllowance,
		isd.IsPFDeductionOn
	)T
	
	union all
	
	
	select 2 ReportType,s.Id EmployeeID, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo, s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
	dg.Name Designation,d.Name Department,
	isnull(convert(date,max(ee.Incrementdate)),'') LastIncrementdate,
	--isnull(isd.TotalSalary,0) GrossSalaryTotal,
	isnull(isd.BasicAmount + isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic + isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,0) GrossSalaryTotal,

	

	--------0 IncermentAmount,
	--------isnull(isd.TotalSalary,0) IncrementArrear,

	--case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	--convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*isd.TotalSalary)/100))))
	--else 	convert(decimal(18,2),isd.FixedAmount) end 	IncrementAmount,
	--case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	--convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*isd.TotalSalary)/100)/@DayCount)* (DateDiff(Day,s.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(s.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, s.JoiningDate)))+1)))
	--else 	convert(decimal(18,2),isd.FixedAmount) end 	IncrementArrear,




	--10 as IncrementInPercent, 
	--IsNull(isd.FixedAmount,0) as IncrementAmountFixed, IsNull(ic.Name,'') as IncrementType,
	
	case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	---convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*isd.TotalSalary)/100))))
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*(isd.BasicAmount + isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic + isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic))/100))))
	

	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),isd.FixedAmount) end 	IncrementAmount,

	--'0',0,0,

	--isnull(isd.TotalSalary,0) IncrementAmount,
	case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Percentage(%)' then
	--convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*isd.TotalSalary)/100))))
	convert(decimal(18,2),((((10*(isd.BasicAmount + isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic + isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic))/100))))
	

	else 	convert(decimal(18,2),isd.FixedAmount)  end 	IncrementArrear,


	(case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Percentage(%)' then 10 else 0 end  +
	case when IsNull(ic.Name,'') ='Fixed' then IsNull(isd.FixedAmount,0) else 0 end) as Increment ,
	IsNull(ic.Name,'') as IncrementType,
	IsNull(ed.Name,'') as EvaluationDuration,

	isd.BasicAmount,isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,isd.Conveyance,
	OtherAllowance,
	isd.IsPFDeductionOn

	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	left join [Payroll].[IncrementRecords]  ee
	on ee.StaffRecordId = s.Id and ee.StaffRecordId is null
	left join Payroll.IndividualSalaries isd on isd.EmployeeId=s.id
	left join Payroll.IncrementTypes ic on isd.IncermentTypeId=ic.Id
	left join Payroll.SalaryEvaluationDurations ed on isd.SalaryEvaluationDurationId=ed.Id
	where 
	datediff(Month,ee.Incrementdate,@FirstDayofthisMonth) = 13
	and s.IsInActive='False'
	and s.EmployeeNo not in ('PH01610', 'PH00004')
	----, 'PH00972'
	group by s.Id,s.EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName,s.JoiningDate,dg.Name,d.Name,isd.TotalSalary,isd.FixedAmount,ic.Name,ed.Name,isd.BasicAmount,isd.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic,isd.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,isd.Conveyance,
	isd.OtherAllowance,
	isd.IsPFDeductionOn
	order by reportType,joiningdate


END
GO

--exec [SPGet_EmployeeWise_Bonus_Statement] 8,2022,0,0
CREATE PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SPGetEmployeeWiseBonusStatement]
	@month int,
	@year int,
	@EmpId uniqueidentifier,
	@deptId int
AS
BEGIN
	Select e.EmployeeNo EmpCode, e.EmployeeName EmpName, e.JoiningDate JoinDate, e.ServiceNature Duration, dg.Name Designation,d.Name DeptName,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),s.BasicAmount),0.00) BasicAmount, isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),s.BasicAmount/2),0.00) NetPayble
	from hr.StaffRecords e
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=e.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=e.DesignationId
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries s on s.EmployeeId=e.Id
	join hr.StaffFestivalMappings fe on fe.StaffRecordId=e.Id
	join hr.Festivals f on f.Id=fe.Festivald
	where (e.Id=@EmpId or @EmpId is null)
	and (d.Id=@deptId or @deptId=0)
	and f.Year=@year and f.month=@month
   
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatement]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-- Exec [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatement] 01,2023,0,''
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatement]
	@month int,
	@year int,
	@departmentID int,
	@EmpNo nvarchar(max) ,
	@SubDeptId int=0
AS
BEGIN
select 
	EmpNo,
	Empname,
	convert(date,JoiningDate)JoiningDate,
	Designation,
	Department,
	SubDeptName,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Basic),0)) Basic,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(HouseRent),0)) HouseRent,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(Medical),0)) Medical,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Conveyence),0)) Conveyence,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (otherAllowance),0)) otherAllowance,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Basic),0))+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(HouseRent),0))+
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(Medical),0))
	+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Conveyence),0))+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (otherAllowance),0)) GrossSalary
	from 
(
	select s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName Empname,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate, dg.Name Designation,
	d.Name Department,sd.Name SubDeptName,
	ass.Basic Basic, ass.HouseRent HouseRent, ass.MedAllowance Medical,ass.Conveyence,ass.otherAllowance
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join hr.SubDepartments sd on sd.Id=s.SubDeptId
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where ass.SalaryMonth=@month and ass.SalaryYear=@year and
	(d.Id=@departmentID or @departmentID=0) and
	(s.EmployeeNo=@EmpNo or @EmpNo='') and
	(sd.Id=@SubDeptId or @SubDeptId=0) 
	--and
	--(IsInActive='false')

	)T

	group by t.EmpNo, t.Empname,t.JoiningDate,t.Designation,t.Department,t.SubDeptName
	order by t.EmpNo

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatementDetails]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
