--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]
--11. EmployeeNo [nvarchar]

--exec [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatementDetails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'

CREATE     PROCEDURE[Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatementDetails]
	--@month int,
	--@year int,
	--@departmentID int,
	--@EmpNo nvarchar(max) ,
	--@SubDeptId int=0,
	@paramas nvarchar(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN

	declare @year int;
	declare @departmentID int;
	declare @EmpID  uniqueidentifier;
	declare @SubDeptId int=0;
	declare @month int;


	 	Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3;

		Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4;

			Select @departmentID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8;

			Select @EmpID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7;


		Select @SubDeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9;

select(


select 
	EmployeeCode,
	EmployeeName,
	convert(date,DateOfJoining)DateOfJoining,
	Designation,
	Department,
	SubDeptName,
	isnull(TINNo,'') TINNo,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Basic),0)) Basic,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(HR),0)) HR,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(MA),0)) MA,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (CA),0)) CA,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Spa),0)) Spa,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (OT),0)) OT,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (OtherAllow),0)) OtherAllow,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Arrear),0)) Arrear,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Gross),0)) Gross,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (IT),0)) IT,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (PF),0)) PF,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (OtherDeduction),0)) OtherDeduction,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (TotalDeduction),0)) TotalDeduction,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (NetPay),0)) NetPay

	from 
(


	select s.EmployeeNo EmployeeCode, s.EmployeeName  EmployeeName, dg.Name Designation,d.name Department,
	convert(date,s.JoiningDate) DateOfJoining,sd.Name SubDeptName,s.TINNo TINNo,
	a.Basic Basic, a.HouseRent HR, a.Conveyence CA,a.MedAllowance MA, 
	
	a.Allowance Spa,a.Overtime OT,a.OtherAllowance OtherAllow,a.Arrear Arrear,
	a.GTotal Gross,a.IncomeTax IT,a.PF PF,ISNULL(a.LWP,0)+ISNULL(a.OthersDeduction,0) OtherDeduction,
	a.IncomeTax+a.PF+a.LWP TotalDeduction,
	a.NetPayable NetPay
--,
--a.SalaryMonth SalaryMonth
--,a.SalaryYear SalaryYear 
from hr.StaffRecords s
join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
left join hr.SubDepartments sd on sd.Id=s.SubDeptId
join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a on a.StaffRecordId=s.Id


	where a.SalaryMonth=@month and a.SalaryYear=@year and
	(d.Id=@departmentID or @departmentID=0) and
	(s.id=@EmpID or @EmpID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and
	(sd.Id=@SubDeptId or @SubDeptId=0)
	)T
	group by t.EmployeeCode, t.EmployeeName,t.DateOfJoining,t.Designation,t.Department,t.SubDeptName,t.TINNo
	FOR JSON AUTO) As Data  

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatementDynamic]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]
--11. EmployeeNo [nvarchar]

--exec [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetGrossSalaryStatementDynamic]
	--@month int,
	--@year int,
	--@departmentID int,
	--@EmpNo nvarchar(max) ,
	--@SubDeptId int=0,
	@paramas nvarchar(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN

	declare @year int;
	declare @departmentID int;
	declare @EmpNo  nvarchar(MAX);
	declare @SubDeptId int=0;
	declare @month int;


	 	Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3;

		Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4;

			Select @departmentID=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8;

			Select @EmpNo=  Convert(nvarchar(MAX),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11;


		Select @SubDeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9;

select(


select 
	EmpNo,
	Empname,
	convert(date,JoiningDate)JoiningDate,
	Designation,
	Department,
	SubDeptName,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Basic),0)) Basic,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(HouseRent),0)) HouseRent,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(Medical),0)) Medical,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Conveyence),0)) Conveyence,
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Basic),0))+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(HouseRent),0))+
	convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum(Medical),0))
	+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(sum (Conveyence),0)) GrossSalary
	from 
(
	select s.EmployeeNo EmpNo, s.EmployeeName Empname,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate, dg.Name Designation, d.Name Department,sd.Name SubDeptName,
	ass.Basic Basic, ass.HouseRent HouseRent, ass.MedAllowance Medical,ass.Conveyence
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join hr.SubDepartments sd on sd.Id=s.SubDeptId
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where ass.SalaryMonth=@month and ass.SalaryYear=@year and
	(d.Id=@departmentID or @departmentID=0) and
	(s.EmployeeNo=@EmpNo or @EmpNo='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and
	(sd.Id=@SubDeptId or @SubDeptId=0)
	)T
	group by t.EmpNo, t.Empname,t.JoiningDate,t.Designation,t.Department,t.SubDeptName
	FOR JSON AUTO) As Data  

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- =============================================
-- Author: <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: <Description,,>
-- =============================================
-- exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 9,2023,0,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE  PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet]
@month int,
@year int,
@DepartmentID int=0,
@EmployeeID uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempspGetHrSalarySheet

--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 3,'2023',0,'98DA1A69-DD9F-4AE2-B207-0184D833C583'
--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 3,'2023',0,null
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
--DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
--set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
--SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(10,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[TotalDeduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2)
)

DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofCurrentMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalCurentMonthDayCount int


set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

select @TotalCurentMonthDayCount= day(@LastDayofCurrentMonth)


select @TotalMonthDay = DAY(@LastDayofthisMOnth)

SET NOCOUNT ON;
with cte as(
select e.EmployeeName as[Name],e.Id as StaffRecordId,e.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo, ed.Name as DeptName,de.Name as Designation,e.JoiningDate as DateOfJoining,
e.ServiceNature,e.PaymentMode,
po.BasicAmount as  [Basic],
po.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic HouseRent,

po.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
po.Others,
po.Conveyance Conveyance,
po.TotalSalary TotalSalary,
0 as OthersAllowance,
case 
--when datediff(MONTH,e.JoiningDate,@FirstDayofthisMonth) <7 then 0
when po.IsPFDeductionOn =1 then po.PF 
when po.IsPFDeductionOn =0 then 0 end PF,
Po.OtherAllowance
from HR.StaffRecords e
join HR.Departments ed on e.DeptId=ed.Id
join HR.Designations de on e.DesignationId=de.Id
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId 
where 
(
e.IsInActive='False'
and IsSeparated='False'
)
and (@DepartmentID=0 or ed.Id=@DepartmentID)
and (@EmployeeID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  or CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, @EmployeeID)= e.Id)
),

--punishment

cte2 as(

select e.Id as StaffRecordId,sum(p.PunishmentAmount) PunishmentAmount

from HR.StaffRecords e
    join [Payroll].[SalaryPunishments] p on e.Id=p.StaffRecordId
where p.SalaryYear=@year and p.SalaryMonth=@month
group by e.Id

),

--overtime
cte3 as(
-- select e.Id as StaffRecordId
--,sum((po.TotalSalary)/(DAY(EOMONTH(o.EntryDate))))as overtime

--from HR.StaffRecords e
--join  Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
--join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
--where year(o.EntryDate)=@year and MONTH(o.EntryDate)=@month
--group by e.Id

select e.Id as StaffRecordId,
convert(decimal(12,2),(max(po.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours) + isnull(sum(o.TotalAmount),0) ) 
 
overtime
from HR.StaffRecords e
join  Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
where o.PayYear=@year and o.PayMonth=@month
group by e.Id 
),

cte4 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId, (po.BasicAmount)/2 FestivalBonus

from HR.StaffRecords e
join [HR].[StaffFestivalMappings]  o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
join  [HR].[Festivals] f on o.Festivald=f.Id
join [Payroll].FestivalBonuses fb on fb.FestivalId=f.Id
join [Payroll].[IndividualSalaries] po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
where fb.Year=@year and fb.Month=@month
group by e.Id,po.BasicAmount
),

cte5 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId, sum (d.Lwp) Lwp, isnull(sum(isnull(d.OthersDeducation,0)),0) OthersDeducationAmount

from HR.StaffRecords e
join [Payroll].[StaffSalaryDeductions] d on d.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where d.Year=@year and d.month=@month
group by e.Id
),

cte6 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.SalaryPaid) PaidAmount,sum (em.AdvancePaid) AdvancePaid

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.Year=@year and em.month=@month
group by e.Id
),
cte7 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.OtherAllowance) OthersAllowance,sum (em.SpecialAllowance) SpecialAllowance

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.AllowancePayments em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.PayYear=@year and em.PayMonth=@month
group by e.Id
),
cte8 as(

select  StaffRecordId ,sum(ArrearSalary)  ArrearSalary
from (
	select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.Amount) ArrearSalary
	from HR.StaffRecords e
	join Payroll.ArrearRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
	where em.PayableYear=@year and em.PayableMonth=@month
	group by e.Id
	union all
	select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.Arrear) ArrearSalary
	from HR.StaffRecords e
	join Payroll.IncrementRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
	where em.[Year]=@year and em.[Month]=@month
	group by e.Id
)T
group by StaffRecordId

)

--select getdate()

insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
)

select 

IsNull(StaffRecordId,'') StaffRecordId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining,
ServiceNature,
PaymentMode,
[Basic],
HouseRent,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary,
overtime,
FestivalBonus,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal,
PF,
[TotalDeductCount],
[TotalMonthlyHour],
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount,
PunishmentAmount,
AdvancePaid,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
case  
	when (ArrearSalary + [NetPayble]) >= 0 then (ArrearSalary + [NetPayble])
	when (ArrearSalary + [NetPayble]) < 0 then 0
	end [NetPayble] ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
 
from
(
select 
IsNull(StaffRecordId,'') StaffRecordId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining,
isnull(ServiceNature,'') ServiceNature,
PaymentMode,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) [Basic],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) HouseRent,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) Conveyance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0)) OthersAllowance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0)) SpecialAllowance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalSalary,0.00),0)) TotalSalary,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0)) overtime,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0)) FestivalBonus,
--0 as OthersAllowance,
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) IncomeTax,
--convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSalary+isnull(overtime,0.00)+0+isnull(FestivalBonus,0.00)- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)-isnull(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00)) GrossTotal,
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) IncomeTax,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) +
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) +
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OtherAllowance,0.00),0))  GrossTotal,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0)) PF,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([TotalDeductCount],0.00),0)) [TotalDeductCount],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([TotalMonthlyHour],0.00),0)) [TotalMonthlyHour],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Lwp,0.00),0)) Lwp,
--convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))+
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0)) OthersTotalDeduc,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0)) TotalLWPAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0)) PunishmentAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(AdvancePaid,0.00),0)) AdvancePaid,
case when DateOfJoining <= @FirstDayofthisMonth then 
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0)) 
	when DateOfJoining > @FirstDayofthisMonth then
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
	+
	round(convert(decimal(12,2),(
		(
		
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) +
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) +
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) +
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OtherAllowance,0.00),0))
		
	
		)/DAY(@LastDayofCurrentMOnth)
	)* (DATEDIFF(Day,@FirstDayofthisMonth,DateOfJoining)) *-1),0)
	end ArrearSalary,

	--12345678

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([OtherAllowance],0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) [TotalPayableSalary],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0))+
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))+
--convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0))
+ 
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) --IncomeTax
--+ isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) 
[TotalDeduction],

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([OtherAllowance],0.00),0))
--+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 )

-- convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00),0))
-convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))
-convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0))
- convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0))
-
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0)
-- convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) ,isnull(round(IncomeTax,0.00),0)
--- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
[NetPayble],

--convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSalary+isnull(overtime,0.00)+0+isnull(FestivalBonus,0.00)-isnull(PF,0.00)- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)-isnull(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00)) NetPayble,

--isnull(AdvancePaid,0)-isnull(PaidAmount,0) NetPayble,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PaidAmount,0.00),0)) PaidAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OtherAllowance,0.00),0)) OtherAllowance


--[TotalLWPAmount],
--convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) [Total LWP Amount],
--case when [TotalDeductCount] > 0 then
--(Salary/TotalMonthlyHour) * [TotalDeductCount]
--else 0 end
--[lateDeduction],

--isnull(AdvancePaid,0) AdvancePaid ,

from
(
select cte.StaffRecordId,cte.EmployeeNo
,cte.Name as EmployeeName
,cte.DeptName,
cte.Designation,
cte.DateOfJoining, 
cte.ServiceNature,
cte.PaymentMode,
cte.Basic,
cte.HouseRent,
cte.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic, 
cte.Conveyance,cte.TotalSalary,
isnull(round(cte3.overtime,0),0)overtime, 
isnull(round(cte4.FestivalBonus,0),0) FestivalBonus,
cte.PF

--(cte.Basic +cte.HouseRent+cte.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic)Salary

,isnull(round(Payroll.fnGetTotalDiductionDay(@month,@year, cte.StaffRecordId),0),0) as [TotalDeductCount]
,isnull(round(Payroll.fnGetTotalMonthHour(@month,@year,cte.StaffRecordId),0),0) as [TotalMonthlyHour], 
isnull(cte5.Lwp,0) Lwp
, 
--isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0)+
isnull(round(cte2.PunishmentAmount,0),0)  OthersTotalDeduc
, isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount,
--  123456
isnull(round(cte2.PunishmentAmount,0),0)+ isnull(cte5.OthersDeducationAmount,0)PunishmentAmount,
isnull(round(cte6.AdvancePaid,0),0) AdvancePaid, 
Isnull(round(cte6.PaidAmount,0),0) PaidAmount,
isnull(round(cte7.OthersAllowance,0),0)OthersAllowance,
isnull(round(cte7.SpecialAllowance,0),0) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(round(cte8.ArrearSalary,0),0) ArrearSalary,
isnull(round(cte.OtherAllowance,0),0) OtherAllowance

--(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) TotalLWPAmount

from cte
left join cte2 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte2.StaffRecordId
left join cte3 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte3.StaffRecordId
left join cte4 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte4.StaffRecordId
left join cte6 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte6.StaffRecordId
left join cte5 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte5.StaffRecordId
left join cte7 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte7.StaffRecordId
left join cte8 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte8.StaffRecordId
)T
)TT
order by TT.StaffRecordId
End

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheetDynamic]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



-- =============================================
-- Author: <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: <Description,,>
-- =============================================
--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]
--11. EmployeeNo [nvarchar]

--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheetDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheetDynamic]

 @paramas nvarchar(max)=''	
--@month varchar(20),
--@year int,
--@DepartmentID int=0,
--@EmployeeID uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempspGetHrSalarySheet

--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 3,'2023',0,'98DA1A69-DD9F-4AE2-B207-0184D833C583'
--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 3,'2023',0,null

Declare @month int
Declare @year int
Declare @DepartmentID int
Declare @EmployeeID uniqueidentifier


Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4

Select @EmployeeID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier, T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

Select @DepartmentID=  Convert(int, T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8


Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(10,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[TotalDeduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2)
)

DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2

set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

select @TotalMonthDay = DATEDIFF(day,@FirstDayofthisMonth,@LastDayofthisMOnth)

SET NOCOUNT ON;
with cte as(
select e.EmployeeName as[Name],e.Id as StaffRecordId,e.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo, ed.Name as DeptName,de.Name as Designation,e.JoiningDate as DateOfJoining,
e.ServiceNature,e.PaymentMode,
po.BasicAmount as  [Basic],
po.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic HouseRent,

po.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
po.Others,
po.Conveyance Conveyance,
po.TotalSalary TotalSalary,
0 as OthersAllowance,
case 
when po.IsPFDeductionOn =1 then po.PF 
when po.IsPFDeductionOn =0 then 0 end PF
from HR.StaffRecords e
join HR.Departments ed on e.DeptId=ed.Id
join HR.Designations de on e.DesignationId=de.Id
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId 
where 
(
e.IsInActive='False'
and IsSeparated='False'
)
and (@DepartmentID=0 or ed.Id=@DepartmentID)
and (@EmployeeID = CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, @EmployeeID)= e.Id)
),

--punishment

cte2 as(

select e.Id as StaffRecordId,sum(p.PunishmentAmount) PunishmentAmount

from HR.StaffRecords e
    join [Payroll].[SalaryPunishments] p on e.Id=p.StaffRecordId
where p.SalaryYear=@year and p.SalaryMonth=@month
group by e.Id

),

--overtime
cte3 as(
-- select e.Id as StaffRecordId
--,sum((po.TotalSalary)/(DAY(EOMONTH(o.EntryDate))))as overtime

--from HR.StaffRecords e
--join  Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
--join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
--where year(o.EntryDate)=@year and MONTH(o.EntryDate)=@month
--group by e.Id

select e.Id as StaffRecordId,
convert(decimal(12,2),(max(po.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours))  overtime
from HR.StaffRecords e
join  Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
where o.PayYear=@year and o.PayMonth=@month
group by e.Id 
),

cte4 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId, (po.BasicAmount)/2 FestivalBonus

from HR.StaffRecords e
join [HR].[StaffFestivalMappings]  o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
join  [HR].[Festivals] f on o.Festivald=f.Id
join [Payroll].FestivalBonuses fb on fb.FestivalId=f.Id
join [Payroll].[IndividualSalaries] po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
where fb.Year=@year and fb.Month=@month
group by e.Id,po.BasicAmount
),

cte5 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId, sum (d.Lwp) Lwp

from HR.StaffRecords e
join [Payroll].[StaffSalaryDeductions] d on d.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where d.Year=@year and d.month=@month
group by e.Id
),

cte6 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.SalaryPaid) PaidAmount,sum (em.AdvancePaid) AdvancePaid

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.Year=@year and em.month=@month
group by e.Id
),
cte7 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.OtherAllowance) OthersAllowance,sum (em.SpecialAllowance) SpecialAllowance

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.AllowancePayments em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.PayYear=@year and em.PayMonth=@month
group by e.Id
),
cte8 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.Amount) ArrearSalary

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.ArrearRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.PayableYear=@year and em.PayableMonth=@month
group by e.Id
)

--select getdate()

insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount
)

select 
IsNull(StaffRecordId,'') StaffRecordId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining,
isnull(ServiceNature,'') ServiceNature,
PaymentMode,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) [Basic],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) HouseRent,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) Conveyance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0)) OthersAllowance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0)) SpecialAllowance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalSalary,0.00),0)) TotalSalary,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0)) overtime,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0)) FestivalBonus,
--0 as OthersAllowance,
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) IncomeTax,
--convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSalary+isnull(overtime,0.00)+0+isnull(FestivalBonus,0.00)- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)-isnull(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00)) GrossTotal,
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) IncomeTax,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) +
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) +
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) GrossTotal,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0)) PF,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([TotalDeductCount],0.00),0)) [TotalDeductCount],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([TotalMonthlyHour],0.00),0)) [TotalMonthlyHour],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Lwp,0.00),0)) Lwp,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0)) OthersTotalDeduc,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0)) TotalLWPAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0)) PunishmentAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(AdvancePaid,0.00),0)) AdvancePaid,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0)) ArrearSalary,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) [TotalPayableSalary],

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0))
+ 
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) --IncomeTax
--+ isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) 
[TotalDeduction],

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 )

- convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00),0))
- convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0))
-
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0)
-- convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) ,isnull(round(IncomeTax,0.00),0)
--- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
[NetPayble],

--convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSalary+isnull(overtime,0.00)+0+isnull(FestivalBonus,0.00)-isnull(PF,0.00)- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)-isnull(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00)) NetPayble,

--isnull(AdvancePaid,0)-isnull(PaidAmount,0) NetPayble,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PaidAmount,0.00),0)) PaidAmount
--[TotalLWPAmount],
--convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) [Total LWP Amount],
--case when [TotalDeductCount] > 0 then
--(Salary/TotalMonthlyHour) * [TotalDeductCount]
--else 0 end
--[lateDeduction],

--isnull(AdvancePaid,0) AdvancePaid ,

from
(
select cte.StaffRecordId,cte.EmployeeNo
,cte.Name as EmployeeName
,cte.DeptName,
cte.Designation,
cte.DateOfJoining, 
cte.ServiceNature,
cte.PaymentMode,
cte.Basic,
cte.HouseRent,
cte.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic, 
cte.Conveyance,cte.TotalSalary,
isnull(round(cte3.overtime,0),0)overtime, 
isnull(round(cte4.FestivalBonus,0),0) FestivalBonus,
cte.PF

--(cte.Basic +cte.HouseRent+cte.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic)Salary

,isnull(round(Payroll.fnGetTotalDiductionDay(@month,@year, cte.StaffRecordId),0),0) as [TotalDeductCount]
,isnull(round(Payroll.fnGetTotalMonthHour(@month,@year,cte.StaffRecordId),0),0) as [TotalMonthlyHour], 
isnull(cte5.Lwp,0) Lwp
, isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)),0),0)+ isnull(round(cte2.PunishmentAmount,0),0) OthersTotalDeduc
, isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount,
isnull(round(cte2.PunishmentAmount,0),0)PunishmentAmount,
isnull(round(cte6.AdvancePaid,0),0) AdvancePaid, 
Isnull(round(cte6.PaidAmount,0),0) PaidAmount,
isnull(round(cte7.OthersAllowance,0),0)OthersAllowance,
isnull(round(cte7.SpecialAllowance,0),0) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(round(cte8.ArrearSalary,0),0) ArrearSalary
--(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) TotalLWPAmount

from cte
left join cte2 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte2.StaffRecordId
left join cte3 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte3.StaffRecordId
left join cte4 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte4.StaffRecordId
left join cte6 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte6.StaffRecordId
left join cte5 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte5.StaffRecordId
left join cte7 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte7.StaffRecordId
left join cte8 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte8.StaffRecordId
)T
order by T.StaffRecordId
End


select(
select 
EmployeeId ,
IsNull(EmployeeNo,'') EmployeeNo,
IsNull(EmployeeName,'') EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,

EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
TotalDeduction,
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
--order by DeptName
order by Autoid  FOR JSON AUTO) as Data

-- exec [Payroll].[spGetInActiveHrSalarySheet] 11,2023,0,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
CREATE  PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetInActiveHrSalarySheet]
@month int,
@year int,
@DepartmentID int=0,
@EmployeeID uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempspGetHrSalarySheet

--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 3,'2023',0,'98DA1A69-DD9F-4AE2-B207-0184D833C583'
--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 3,'2023',0,null
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date
--DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
--set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
--SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(10,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[TotalDeduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2)
)

DECLARE @LastDayofthisMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalMonthDay int
DECLARE @PerDayHour int =8
DECLARE @MonthlyOnedaySalaryDeductionForLateInDays int
DECLARE @RoundNumberDisplay int =2
DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth date
DECLARE @LastDayofCurrentMOnth date
DECLARE @TotalCurentMonthDayCount int


set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
select @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)
SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonthLastMonth))
SELECT @LastDayofCurrentMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

select @TotalCurentMonthDayCount= day(@LastDayofCurrentMonth)


select @TotalMonthDay = DAY(@LastDayofthisMOnth)

SET NOCOUNT ON;
with cte as(
select e.EmployeeName as[Name],e.Id as StaffRecordId,e.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo, ed.Name as DeptName,de.Name as Designation,e.JoiningDate as DateOfJoining,
e.ServiceNature,e.PaymentMode,
po.BasicAmount as  [Basic],
po.HouseRentInPercentOfBasic HouseRent,

po.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
po.Others,
po.Conveyance Conveyance,
po.TotalSalary TotalSalary,
0 as OthersAllowance,
case 
--when datediff(MONTH,e.JoiningDate,@FirstDayofthisMonth) <7 then 0
when po.IsPFDeductionOn =1 then po.PF 
when po.IsPFDeductionOn =0 then 0 end PF,
Po.OtherAllowance
from HR.StaffRecords e
join HR.Departments ed on e.DeptId=ed.Id
join HR.Designations de on e.DesignationId=de.Id
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId 
where 
(
e.IsInActive='true'
and IsSeparated='true'
)
and (@DepartmentID=0 or ed.Id=@DepartmentID)
and (@EmployeeID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  or CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, @EmployeeID)= e.Id)
),

--punishment

cte2 as(

select e.Id as StaffRecordId,sum(p.PunishmentAmount) PunishmentAmount

from HR.StaffRecords e
    join [Payroll].[SalaryPunishments] p on e.Id=p.StaffRecordId
where p.SalaryYear=@year and p.SalaryMonth=@month
group by e.Id

),

--overtime
cte3 as(
-- select e.Id as StaffRecordId
--,sum((po.TotalSalary)/(DAY(EOMONTH(o.EntryDate))))as overtime

--from HR.StaffRecords e
--join  Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
--join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
--where year(o.EntryDate)=@year and MONTH(o.EntryDate)=@month
--group by e.Id

select e.Id as StaffRecordId,
convert(decimal(12,2),(max(po.TotalSalary)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) * sum(Hours) + isnull(sum(o.TotalAmount),0) ) 
 
overtime
from HR.StaffRecords e
join  Payroll.StaffOvertimes o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
where o.PayYear=@year and o.PayMonth=@month
group by e.Id 
),

cte4 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId, (po.BasicAmount)/2 FestivalBonus

from HR.StaffRecords e
join [HR].[StaffFestivalMappings]  o on e.Id=o.StaffRecordId
join  [HR].[Festivals] f on o.Festivald=f.Id
join [Payroll].FestivalBonuses fb on fb.FestivalId=f.Id
join [Payroll].[IndividualSalaries] po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId
where fb.Year=@year and fb.Month=@month
group by e.Id,po.BasicAmount
),

cte5 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId, sum (d.Lwp) Lwp, isnull(sum(isnull(d.OthersDeducation,0)),0) OthersDeducationAmount

from HR.StaffRecords e
join [Payroll].[StaffSalaryDeductions] d on d.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where d.Year=@year and d.month=@month
group by e.Id
),

cte6 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.SalaryPaid) PaidAmount,sum (em.AdvancePaid) AdvancePaid

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.Year=@year and em.month=@month
group by e.Id
),
cte7 as(
 select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.OtherAllowance) OthersAllowance,sum (em.SpecialAllowance) SpecialAllowance

from HR.StaffRecords e
join Payroll.AllowancePayments em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
where em.PayYear=@year and em.PayMonth=@month
group by e.Id
),
cte8 as(

select  StaffRecordId ,sum(ArrearSalary)  ArrearSalary
from (
	select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.Amount) ArrearSalary
	from HR.StaffRecords e
	join Payroll.ArrearRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
	where em.PayableYear=@year and em.PayableMonth=@month
	group by e.Id
	union all
	select e.Id as StaffRecordId,  sum(em.Arrear) ArrearSalary
	from HR.StaffRecords e
	join Payroll.IncrementRecords em on em.StaffRecordId=e.Id
	where em.[Year]=@year and em.[Month]=@month
	group by e.Id
)T
group by StaffRecordId

)

--select getdate()

insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
)

select 

IsNull(StaffRecordId,'') StaffRecordId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining,
ServiceNature,
PaymentMode,
[Basic],
HouseRent,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary,
overtime,
FestivalBonus,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal,
PF,
[TotalDeductCount],
[TotalMonthlyHour],
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount,
PunishmentAmount,
AdvancePaid,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
case  
	when (ArrearSalary + [NetPayble]) >= 0 then (ArrearSalary + [NetPayble])
	when (ArrearSalary + [NetPayble]) < 0 then 0
	end [NetPayble] ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
 
from
(
select 
IsNull(StaffRecordId,'') StaffRecordId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining,
isnull(ServiceNature,'') ServiceNature,
PaymentMode,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) [Basic],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) HouseRent,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) Conveyance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0)) OthersAllowance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0)) SpecialAllowance,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalSalary,0.00),0)) TotalSalary,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0)) overtime,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0)) FestivalBonus,
--0 as OthersAllowance,
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) IncomeTax,
--convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSalary+isnull(overtime,0.00)+0+isnull(FestivalBonus,0.00)- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)-isnull(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00)) GrossTotal,
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) IncomeTax,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) +
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) +
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OtherAllowance,0.00),0))  GrossTotal,

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0)) PF,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([TotalDeductCount],0.00),0)) [TotalDeductCount],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([TotalMonthlyHour],0.00),0)) [TotalMonthlyHour],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Lwp,0.00),0)) Lwp,
--convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))+
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0)) OthersTotalDeduc,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0)) TotalLWPAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0)) PunishmentAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(AdvancePaid,0.00),0)) AdvancePaid,
case when DateOfJoining <= @FirstDayofthisMonth then 
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0)) 
	when DateOfJoining > @FirstDayofthisMonth then
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
	+
	round(convert(decimal(12,2),(
		(
		
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) + convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) +
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) +
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0)) +
		convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OtherAllowance,0.00),0))
		
	
		)/DAY(@LastDayofCurrentMOnth)
	)* (DATEDIFF(Day,@FirstDayofthisMonth,DateOfJoining)) *-1),0)
	end ArrearSalary,

	--12345678

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([OtherAllowance],0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) [TotalPayableSalary],
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0))+
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))+
--convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0))
+ 
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) --IncomeTax
--+ isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) 
[TotalDeduction],

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([OtherAllowance],0.00),0))
--+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(ArrearSalary,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 )

-- convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00),0))
-convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(TotalLWPAmount,0.00),0))
-convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PunishmentAmount,0.00),0))
- convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PF,0.00),0))
-
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0)
-- convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) ,isnull(round(IncomeTax,0.00),0)
--- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
[NetPayble],

--convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSalary+isnull(overtime,0.00)+0+isnull(FestivalBonus,0.00)-isnull(PF,0.00)- isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)-isnull(OthersTotalDeduc,0.00)) NetPayble,

--isnull(AdvancePaid,0)-isnull(PaidAmount,0) NetPayble,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(PaidAmount,0.00),0)) PaidAmount,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(OtherAllowance,0.00),0)) OtherAllowance


--[TotalLWPAmount],
--convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) [Total LWP Amount],
--case when [TotalDeductCount] > 0 then
--(Salary/TotalMonthlyHour) * [TotalDeductCount]
--else 0 end
--[lateDeduction],

--isnull(AdvancePaid,0) AdvancePaid ,

from
(
select cte.StaffRecordId,cte.EmployeeNo
,cte.Name as EmployeeName
,cte.DeptName,
cte.Designation,
cte.DateOfJoining, 
cte.ServiceNature,
cte.PaymentMode,
cte.Basic,
cte.HouseRent,
cte.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic, 
cte.Conveyance,cte.TotalSalary,
isnull(round(cte3.overtime,0),0)overtime, 
isnull(round(cte4.FestivalBonus,0),0) FestivalBonus,
cte.PF

--(cte.Basic +cte.HouseRent+cte.MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic)Salary

,isnull(round(Payroll.fnGetTotalDiductionDay(@month,@year, cte.StaffRecordId),0),0) as [TotalDeductCount]
,isnull(round(Payroll.fnGetTotalMonthHour(@month,@year,cte.StaffRecordId),0),0) as [TotalMonthlyHour], 
isnull(cte5.Lwp,0) Lwp
, 
--isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0)+
isnull(round(cte2.PunishmentAmount,0),0)  OthersTotalDeduc
, isnull(round(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalCurentMonthDayCount*@PerDayHour)),0),0) TotalLWPAmount,
--  123456
isnull(round(cte2.PunishmentAmount,0),0)+ isnull(cte5.OthersDeducationAmount,0)PunishmentAmount,
isnull(round(cte6.AdvancePaid,0),0) AdvancePaid, 
Isnull(round(cte6.PaidAmount,0),0) PaidAmount,
isnull(round(cte7.OthersAllowance,0),0)OthersAllowance,
isnull(round(cte7.SpecialAllowance,0),0) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(round(cte8.ArrearSalary,0),0) ArrearSalary,
isnull(round(cte.OtherAllowance,0),0) OtherAllowance

--(convert(decimal(10,2),(TotalSalary*Lwp*@PerDayHour)/(@TotalMonthDay*@PerDayHour)) TotalLWPAmount

from cte
left join cte2 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte2.StaffRecordId
left join cte3 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte3.StaffRecordId
left join cte4 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte4.StaffRecordId
left join cte6 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte6.StaffRecordId
left join cte5 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte5.StaffRecordId
left join cte7 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte7.StaffRecordId
left join cte8 on cte.StaffRecordId=cte8.StaffRecordId
)T
)TT
order by TT.StaffRecordId
End

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetIncrementReportDetailsEmployeeWise]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetIncrementReportDetailsEmployeeWise]'2000-01-01,2025-02-28,2025,01,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,98DA1A69-DD9F-4AE2-B207-0184D833C583,0,0,0'

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetIncrementReportDetailsEmployeeWise]

	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

Declare @FilterStartDate date
Declare @FilterEndDate date

Declare @DeptId int
Declare @EmployeeNo uniqueidentifier
declare @TenantId int

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2


Select @EmployeeNo=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

	

	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@EmployeeNo


	select a.StaffRecordId,convert(date,a.ApprovalDate) ApprovalDate,GTotal,convert(date,a.ApprovalDate) MinApprovalDate,
	 convert(date,a.ApprovalDate) MaxApprovalDate,
	 a.SalaryMonth,a.SalaryYear,a.Basic BasicAmount,a.HouseRent,a.MedAllowance
	into #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets 
	from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a
	where (a.StaffRecordId = @EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	group by a.StaffRecordId,convert(date,a.ApprovalDate),
	a.SalaryMonth,a.SalaryYear,a.Basic ,a.HouseRent,a.MedAllowance,a.GTotal 

	
	update #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets set
	MinApprovalDate =
	(
		select min(ApprovalDate) from #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets tt
		where tt.StaffRecordId = #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets.StaffRecordId
	)
	update #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets set
	MaxApprovalDate =
	(
		select max(ApprovalDate) from #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets tt
		where tt.StaffRecordId = #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets.StaffRecordId
	)

	



	select t.*,dateadd(month,-1, DATEFROMPARTS(t.year,t.month,1) ) [PreviousEffectMonth],gsalary.Gtotal
		into #TempPayrollIncrementRecords
	from Payroll.IncrementRecords t
	left join #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets gsalary
	on gsalary.StaffRecordId = t.StaffRecordId
	and t.[Year] = gsalary.SalaryYear
	and t.[Month] = gsalary.SalaryMonth
	where (t.StaffRecordId = @EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

	--select * from #TempPayrollIncrementRecords
	
	

	 select(
	select * from(

	select 
	s.EmployeeNo AS EmpolyeeID,
	s.EmployeeName,
	s.Id,
	dg.Name [Designation],
	dept.Name [Department],
	convert(DATETIME,s.JoiningDate) [DateOfJoining],
	convert(DATETIME,getdate()) [ReportDate] ,
	dg.Name JoiningDesignation,
	dept.Name JoiningDepartment,
	(
		select tt.GTotal from #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets tt
		where	tt.StaffRecordId = s.id
		and		convert(date,tt.ApprovalDate) = tt.MinApprovalDate
		
	) [JoiningSalary],
	(
		select tt.GTotal from #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets tt
		where	tt.StaffRecordId = s.id
		and		convert(date,tt.ApprovalDate) = tt.MaxApprovalDate
		
	) [PresentSalary], -- Last Salary
	convert(DATETIME,inc.Incrementdate) [EffectiveDate],
	ss.BasicAmount AS BasicSalary,
	ss.HouseRent,
	ss.MedAllowance MedicateAllowance, 
	case when inc.Increment <100 then inc.Increment else 0 end [IncermentPercentage],
	--case when inc.Increment >100 then inc.Increment else 0 end [IncrementAmount],
	 inc.TotalInrementedAmount  [IncrementAmount],
	
	inc.Gtotal  GrossSalary,
	--ss.GTotal AS GrossSalary,
	case when inc.Increment <100 then 'Yearly Increment' else 'Special Increment' end [Remark]
	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Designations dg 
		on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join hr.Departments dept 
		on dept.Id = s.DeptId
	--join Payroll.IncrementRecords inc 
		--on inc.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	join #TempPayrollIncrementRecords inc
		on inc.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	join #TempIncReportDetailsEmployeeWiseAppSalarySheets ss 
		on ss.StaffRecordId = s.Id 
		and Year(inc.[PreviousEffectMonth]) = ss.SalaryYear
		and Month(inc.[PreviousEffectMonth]) = ss.SalaryMonth
	where 
	(s.id=@EmployeeNo or @EmployeeNo='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and convert(date,inc.Incrementdate) >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,inc.Incrementdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	group by 
	s.EmployeeNo,
	s.Id,
	dg.Name,
	dept.Name,
	convert(DATETIME,s.JoiningDate),
	convert(DATETIME,inc.Incrementdate),
	inc.Id,
	ss.BasicAmount,
	ss.HouseRent,
	ss.MedAllowance,
	ss.GTotal,
	inc.Increment,
	inc.TotalInrementedAmount,
	s.EmployeeName,
	inc.[Month],
	inc.[Year],
	inc.Gtotal


	) tbl order by tbl.[EffectiveDate]
	 FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data


END
GO

CREATE  PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTax]
	@TaxYearFilter int,

AS
BEGIN


DECLARE @PendingMonthBefore2024 int

DECLARE @FeMaleTotalSalaryRebateLimit int =46000


IF @TaxYearFilter=2024 and @TaxMonthFilter<7
BEGIN 
	set @PendingMonthBefore2024 = 7-@TaxMonthFilter
END
else

	set @PendingMonthBefore2024 =0

if(@EmployeeId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') Set @EmployeeId=null

IF @TaxMonthFilter > 6

		select @FilterTaxYearFirstDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@TaxYearFilter) +'-'+convert(varchar(4),7) +'-01')
		

		select @FilterTaxYearLastDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@TaxYearFilter+1) +'-'+convert(varchar(4),6) +'-30')
		
END 
ELSE
BEGIN
		
		select @FilterTaxYearFirstDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@TaxYearFilter-1) +'-'+convert(varchar(4),7) +'-01')
		

		select @FilterTaxYearLastDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@TaxYearFilter) +'-'+convert(varchar(4),6) +'-30')
		

END
select @FilterSpecificDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@TaxYearFilter) +'-'+convert(varchar(4),@TaxMonthFilter) +'-01')

EmployeeName nvarchar(max),

	[GroupName] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Particulars] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Amount] [float] NULL,
	[Column4] [nvarchar](50) NULL,

	[IsSynced] [bit]
	)
insert into #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo ,
EmployeeName ,
TaxYear ,
TaxMonth ,
NetTaxPayablePerMonth,
FourceMinimumTax 
)

select distinct  s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,@TaxYearFilter,@TaxMonthFilter,0,0
from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join [Payroll].SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab slab 
				on slab.taxyear in 
				(
					select max(Taxyear) from  [Payroll].SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab 
				)
				where (s.id = @EmployeeId or @EmployeeId is null)

			
			------------generated error so that disable the code-------start---
			--update #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate set
			--FourceMinimumTax =
			--isnull((
			--	select tt.FourceMinimumTax from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFourceMinimumTax tt
			--	where tt.StaffRecordId = #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate.EmployeeId
			--),0)

						------------generated error so that disable the code------End----
			
			DECLARE @MaxAutoID bigint
			DECLARE @MinAutoID bigint
			DECLARE @CurrentAutoID bigint
			DECLARE @CurrentEmployeID [uniqueidentifier]
			DECLARE @NetTaxPayablePerMonth float
			


				select @MaxAutoID = max(AutoID),@MinAutoID= min(Autoid) from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate
				set @CurrentAutoID =@MinAutoID

			
					
				while @CurrentAutoID <= @MaxAutoID
				BEgin
						--print @CurrentAutoID
						DECLARE @CurrentEmployeNo NVARCHAR(MAX)
						select @CurrentEmployeID= EmployeeId from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate where autoid = @CurrentAutoID
						select @CurrentEmployeNo= EmployeeNo from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate where autoid = @CurrentAutoID
						
						print '--Found'
						INSERT INTO #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate
						
						------------Exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax] '2022-07-01','2023-06-30',@CurrentEmployeID,'',1,1
						------------------Exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax] @FilterTaxYearFirstDate,@FilterTaxYearLastDate,@CurrentEmployeID,'',1,1
						Exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormulaRunningYear] @FilterTaxYearFirstDate,@FilterTaxYearLastDate,@CurrentEmployeNo ,1
						

						
						--select @NetTaxPayablePerMonth =Column5 from #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate where [GroupName]='D.Net Tax' 
						--select @FilterTaxYearFirstDate,@FilterTaxYearLastDate,@CurrentEmployeID,@NetTaxPayablePerMonth
						--select @NetTaxPayablePerMonth
						--if @NetTaxPayablePerMonth <0 or @NetTaxPayablePerMonth is null
						--begin
						--	set @NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0
						--end

						--update #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate set
						--NetTaxPayablePerMonth = @NetTaxPayablePerMonth/12
						--where EmployeeId = @CurrentEmployeID

						--delete from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax where EmployeeId  =@CurrentEmployeID and TaxYear = @TaxYearFilter and TaxMonth = @TaxMonthFilter
						--insert into Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax values
						--(@CurrentEmployeID,@TaxYearFilter,@NetTaxPayablePerMonth,@NetTaxPayablePerMonth/12,getdate(),@TaxMonthFilter)

						--select *  from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i





						

						--delete from #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate

						set @CurrentAutoID = @CurrentAutoID +1
						
				END
			
				print 'Done '
				delete from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax
				where TaxYear = @TaxYearFilter and TaxMonth = @TaxMonthFilter
				and EmployeeId in 
				(
					select EmployeeId from #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate
				)

				--insert into Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax 
				--(@CurrentEmployeID,@TaxYearFilter,@NetTaxPayablePerMonth,@NetTaxPayablePerMonth/12,getdate(),@TaxMonthFilter)

				--select EmployeeId,@TaxYearFilter,convert(float,Column5),
				--case when convert(float,Column5) <=0.00 then 0.00
				--else convert(float,Column5)/12 end 
				--,getdate(),@TaxMonthFilter 
				--from #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate



				--select * from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate 
				
				insert into Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax
				select 
				EmployeeId,
				@TaxYearFilter,
				case 
				when m.EMPNO is not null then m.Payable else Column5 end Column5,
				case 
				--when m.EMPNO is not null then m.Payable
				--when FourceMinimumTax <> 0 then FourceMinimumTax
				when T.Sex ='Male' and T.TotalSalary >=@MaleTotalSalaryRebateLimit and T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0 then 417
				when T.Sex ='Female' and T.TotalSalary >=@FeMaleTotalSalaryRebateLimit  and T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0 then 417
				when T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth < 417 and  T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth  > 0 then 417
				else convert(decimal(12,2),NetTaxPayablePerMonth) end NetTaxPayablePerMonth
				,getdate(),@TaxMonthFilter,[IsSynced]
				from 
				(
					select 
					t.AutoID ,
					t.EmployeeId ,
					t.EmployeeNo ,
					t.EmployeeName ,
					t.TaxYear ,
					t.TaxMonth ,
					Column5,
 					case 
					when @PendingMonthBefore2024 <> 0 then convert(float,Column4)/@PendingMonthBefore2024
					when convert(float,Column5) <=0.00 then 0.00
					else convert(float,Column5)/12 end NetTaxPayablePerMonth,
					h.Sex,
					s.TotalSalary,
					c.[IsSynced],
					FourceMinimumTax
					from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate t
					join #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate c on c.EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId
					join Hr.StaffRecords h on h.Id = c.EmployeeId
					join Payroll.IndividualSalaries s on s.EmployeeId = h.Id
				)T
				left join [Payroll.TaxAdjustmentListOfMay] m on m.EMPNO = t.EmployeeNo

				select 
				AutoID ,
				EmployeeId,
				EmployeeNo ,
				EmployeeName ,
				TaxYear ,
				TaxMonth ,
				--T.Sex,
				--NetTaxPayablePerMonth,
				--TotalSalary,

				case 
				--when m.EMPNO is not null then m.Payable
				--when FourceMinimumTax <> 0 then FourceMinimumTax 
				when T.Sex ='Male' and T.TotalSalary >=@MaleTotalSalaryRebateLimit and T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0 then 417
				when T.Sex ='Female' and T.TotalSalary >=@FeMaleTotalSalaryRebateLimit  and T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth =0 then 417
				when T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth < 417 and  T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth  > 0 then 417
				else convert(decimal(12,2),NetTaxPayablePerMonth) end NetTaxPayablePerMonth
				
				from 
				(
					select 
					t.AutoID ,
					t.EmployeeId ,
					t.EmployeeNo ,
					t.EmployeeName ,
					t.TaxYear ,
					t.TaxMonth ,
 					case 
					when @PendingMonthBefore2024 <> 0 then convert(float,Column4)/@PendingMonthBefore2024
					when convert(float,Column5) <=0.00 then 0.00
					else convert(float,Column5)/12 end NetTaxPayablePerMonth,
					h.Sex,
					s.TotalSalary,
					t.FourceMinimumTax
					from #TempSpGetIndividualSalariesForIncomeTaxFromTaxCertificate t
					join #TempPayrollincometaxcertificate c on c.EmployeeId=t.EmployeeId
					join Hr.StaffRecords h on h.Id = c.EmployeeId
					join Payroll.IndividualSalaries s on s.EmployeeId = h.Id
				)T
				left join [Payroll.TaxAdjustmentListOfMay] m on m.EMPNO = t.EmployeeNo
				--where T.NetTaxPayablePerMonth <> 0
				--where T.EmployeeId ='63416319-7BEA-4CEA-DFD6-08DAB57ABF87'
				return 

	



END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO






-- =============================================

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]

--exec [Payroll].[SPGetMonthlyAllowanceReport]'2025-04-01,2025-05-31,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE         PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SPGetMonthlyAllowanceReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@Year int,
	@Month int,
	@StaffRecordId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@DeptId int

	Select @Year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
	Select @Month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
	Select @StaffRecordId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	Select @DeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

select( select * from(

						SELECT sr.EmployeeNo AS EmployeeNo, sr.EmployeeName AS EmployeeName, CONVERT(DATE,sr.JoiningDate) AS JoiningDate,
						D.Name AS Designation, d1.Name AS Departmentname,P.PayYear AS AllowanceYear, P.PayMonth AS AllowanceMonth,
						SUM(P.SpecialAllowance) AS SpecialAllowance , SUM(P.OtherAllowance) AS OtherAllowance,
						SUM(P.SpecialAllowance) + SUM(P.OtherAllowance) AS TotalAllowance
						FROM hr.StaffRecords sr
						JOIN Payroll.AllowancePayments  p ON p.StaffRecordId=sr.Id
						JOIN hr.Designations d ON d.id=sr.DesignationId
						JOIN hr.Departments d1 ON d1.id=sr.DeptId

						WHERE p.PayYear=@Year AND p.PayMonth=@Month
						AND (sr.id=@StaffRecordId OR @StaffRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						AND (d1.id=@DeptId OR @DeptId=0)
						GROUP BY sr.EmployeeNo,sr.EmployeeName,sr.JoiningDate,d.Name,d1.Name,p.PayYear,p.PayMonth



	)tbl 
	
	order by EmployeeNo

	for json auto)as Data
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
-------------exec [Payroll].[SpGetPFMonthlyStatement] 2023,06,0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetPFMonthlyStatement]
	@Year int,
	@Month int,
	@DeptId int
AS
BEGIN
Select 'PF Deduction' Head,s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
dg.Name Designation, round(app.PF,0) Amount, app.SalaryMonth Salarymonth
 from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	 join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where 
	app.SalaryYear=@Year
	and 
	app.SalaryMonth=@Month
	and (d.Id=@DeptId or @DeptId=0)
	and app.PF<>0
	--and s.IsInActive='False'
	---and d.id=11
	order by s.EmployeeNo
	
END
GO

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetPFMonthlyStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetPFMonthlyStatementDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--	@Year int,
--	@Month int,
--	@DeptId int
AS
BEGIN
Declare @month int
Declare @year int
Declare @DeptId int
declare @TenantId int

Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
Select @month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
Select @DeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
Select @TenantId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=6;

select * into #TempPFMonthlyStatementDynamic from hr.Departments d
where 
(
(@TenantId = 4 and d.id in (11))
or 
(@TenantId = 2 and d.id not in  (11))
or @TenantId =0
)

	select(
	select * from(

		Select 'PF Deduction' Head,s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, CONVERT(DATETIME,s.JoiningDate) AS JoiningDate,
		dg.Name Designation, round(app.PF,0) Amount, app.SalaryMonth Salarymonth
		 from hr.StaffRecords s
			--join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
			join #TempPFMonthlyStatementDynamic d on d.Id=s.DeptId
			join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
			 join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
			where 
			app.SalaryYear=@Year
			and 
			app.SalaryMonth=@Month
			and (d.Id=@DeptId or @DeptId=0)
			and app.PF<>0
			--and d.id<>11
			----ORDER BY  s.EmployeeNo

		) tbl order by tbl.EmpCode FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetPFYearlyStatementEmployeeWise]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
---------exec [Payroll].[SpGetPFYearlyStatementEmployeeWise] '2022-07-01','2023-07-01','ph01147'
		
		--set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
		--SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

		select @FilterStartDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),year(@FilterStartDate))+'-'+convert(varchar(2),month(@FilterStartDate))+'-01')

Select 'PSHL' Unit, 'PF Deduction' Head, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
s.EmployeeName EmpName,Convert(varchar(10),  DATENAME(month, DATEADD( month , app.SalaryMonth, -1 ))) 
+ ',' +convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear) PFMonth
 ,round(app.PF,0) Amount
 --,app.id
 --,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01')

 from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where 
		convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
	and (s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo)

	order by app.SalaryMonth
	--app.SalaryYear >= YEAR(@FilterStartDate)
	--and app.SalaryYear >= YEAR(@FilterEndDate)
	
	
END

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetPFYearlyStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,'



CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetPFYearlyStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--	@FilterStartDate date,
--	@FilterEndDate date,
--	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN

Declare @FilterStartDate date
Declare @FilterEndDate date
Declare @EmployeeId uniqueidentifier
		

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
Select @EmployeeId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7


select @FilterStartDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),year(@FilterStartDate))+'-'+convert(varchar(2),month(@FilterStartDate))+'-01')

drop table if exists #Tbl1
Select 'PSHL' Unit, 'PF Deduction' Head, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode,  convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
s.EmployeeName EmpName,Convert(varchar(10),  DATENAME(month, DATEADD( month , app.SalaryMonth, -1 ))) 
+ ',' +convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear) PFMonth
	,round(app.PF,0) Amount into #Tbl1

	from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where 
		convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
	and (s.Id = @EmployeeId) order by app.SalaryMonth
select ( select * from #Tbl1 FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data
	
END

-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificate] 01 ,2023, 'D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificate]
	@Month int,
	@year int,
	@EmpId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	print ''

	
		DECLARE @LastMonth date

select 
StaffRecordId EmployeeId ,
e.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,
e.EmployeeName EmployeeName ,
ed.Name DeptName ,
de.Name Designation ,
e.JoiningDate DateOfJoining  ,
e.ServiceNature ServiceNature ,
t.PaymentMode PaymentMode,
round(t.[Basic],0)[Basic] ,
round(t.HouseRent,0)HouseRent ,
round(t.MedAllowance,0)MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
round(t.Conveyence,0)Conveyance ,
t.Allowance OthersAllowance,
t.SpecialAllowance SpecialAllowance,
t.GTotal GTotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GTotal GrossTotal ,
t.PF ,
0 TotalDeductCount ,
0 TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp ,
--t.OthersDeduction OthersTotalDeduc ,
--convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.LWP,0.00),0))+
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Punishment,0.00),0)) OthersTotalDeduc,
t.Lwp TotalLWPAmount ,
t.Punishment PunishmentAmount ,
t.Advance AdvancePaid , 
t.Arrear  ArrearSalary,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.[Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.MedAllowance,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Conveyence,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.OtherAllowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Allowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Arrear,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) 
[TotalPayableSalary],

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.LWP,0.00),0))+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Punishment,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.PF,0.00),0))
+ 
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) --IncomeTax
--+ isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) 
[TotalDeduction],

t.NetPayable NetPayble ,
 0 PaidAmount,
 (
 
 select distinct DateDiff(Day,e.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(e.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, e.JoiningDate)))+1
from hr.StaffRecords sss
left join [Payroll].[IncrementRecords] eee
		on eee.StaffRecordId = sss.Id
	where 
	---123456


		--datediff(Month,s.joiningdate,@FirstDayofthisMonth) = 14
		------------------MONTH(sss.JoiningDate) = ( @Month -1) and year(sss.joiningdate) <>  @Year
		--and eee.StaffRecordId is null
		--and sss.IsInActive='False'
		MONTH(sss.JoiningDate) =Month ( @LastMonth) and year(sss.joiningdate) <>  Year ( @LastMonth)
		and sss.Id =e.Id

 ),
 --DateDiff(Day,e.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(e.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, e.JoiningDate)))+1,
  isnull((
 select sum(d.Lwp) as LwpDayCount
 from Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions d 
 where d.StaffRecordId=@EmpId 
 and
 d.year=@year and
 d.month=@Month
 ),0),
 isnull((
 select sum(i.TotalInrementedAmount) from Payroll.IncrementRecords i 
	where i.StaffRecordId = e.Id
	and i.Month = @Month
	and i.Year = @year
 ),0.00) LastIncrementAmount,

 	isnull((
		select  ap.GTotal from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=e.Id
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0.00)GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem,

	round(t.OtherAllowance,0) OtherAllowance

from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets t
join HR.StaffRecords e on e.id = t.StaffRecordId
join HR.Departments ed on e.DeptId=ed.Id
join HR.Designations de on e.DesignationId=de.Id
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId 

where 
	t.SalaryMonth = @month
and t.SalaryYear = @year
and t.StaffRecordId= @EmpId

select 
EmployeeId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature ,
PaymentMode,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,
isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([Total Deduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,

isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount,
isnull(ArrearDayCount,0) ArrearDayCount,
isnull(LwpDayCount,0) LwpDayCount,
isnull(sum(LastIncrementAmount),0.00) LastIncermentAmount,
isnull(sum(GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem),0)GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem,
isnull(sum(OtherAllowance),0)OtherAllowance
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
group by DeptName,EmployeeId,EmployeeName,Designation,EmployeeNo,DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature,PaymentMode,ArrearDayCount,LwpDayCount
order by DeptName desc

END
