	[TaxYearDisplay] [int] NULL,
	[ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount] int
) 

DECLARE @CalCurrentMonth date 

if @ProcessForIncomeTax = 1
begin
	set @CalCurrentMonth = @FilterEndDate
end
else 
begin
	set @CalCurrentMonth = @FilterEndDate
end
	

	--print @CalCurrentMonth

	while @CalCurrentMonth <= @FilterEndDate
	BEGIN

	insert into #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
			(
			EmpID ,
			EmpCode ,
			EmpName ,
			EmpNature ,
			JoinDate ,
			DptName ,
			DesigName ,

			TaxYear ,
			CurrentStatus , -- 1 means last ; 2 -- means previous or cancel
			TotalTaxCalculation ,
			Userid ,
			calculationdate ,
			calculationsource, -- report load; New UI where tax calculation request generate ; Auto database schudle ; Process call from UI,
			slabAutoid,
			IsFirstSlabthisYear,
			Slab,
			SlabAmount,
			SlabRate,
			SlabTax,
			SlabRangeMin,
			SlabRangeMax,
			[SlabExemptionHouseRent],
			[SlabExemptionMedicalAllow],
			[SlabExemptionConvAllow],
			TaxMonth,
			TaxYearDisplay,
			ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount
			)

			select  distinct s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,s.ServiceNature EmpNature , s.JoiningDate JoinDate, d.Name DptName, dg.Name DesigName
				,year(@CalCurrentMonth),1,0,1,getdate(),@Source,
				slab.autoid,
				slab.IsFirstSlabthisYear,
				slab.SlabDisplay,
				slab.SlabAmount,
				slab.SlabRateDisplay,
				slab.SlabTax,
				slab.SlabRangeMin,
				slab.SlabRangeMax,
				[ExemptionHouseRent],
				[ExemptionMedicalAllow],
				[ExemptionConvAllow],
				month(@CalCurrentMonth),
				slab.taxyear,
				0
				from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				left join SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab slab on @CalCurrentMonth between slab.slabstartdate and slab.slabenddate
				--join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets sl on sl.StaffRecordId=s.Id 
				--and sl.SalaryYear = year(@CalCurrentMonth)
				--and sl.SalaryMonth = Month(@CalCurrentMonth)
				where (s.id = @EmployeeId or @EmployeeId is null)
				order by slab.autoid

				
				--==================  Basic Calculation ========================--
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				BasicAmount = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p


					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount =
				isnull(round((
					select count(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId =  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0),0)
				 

				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				BasicAmount = isnull(BasicAmount,0.00) + 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount = isnull(ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount,0) +
				isnull(round((
					select count(basic) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0),0)

			


				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				BasicAmount =
				isnull(round(BasicAmount,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(BasicAmount)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0)

	
				--==================  House Rent Calculation ========================--

				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				HouseRent = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(HouseRent) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				MedicalAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(MedAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								ConvAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Conveyence) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								PFContrib = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OthersAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Allowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OverTimeAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Overtime) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				SpecialAllow = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(SpecialAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
					ActualInvestment = 
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF)*2 from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0)


				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				HouseRent = isnull(HouseRent,0.00) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(HouseRent) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				MedicalAllow = isnull(round(MedicalAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(MedAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								ConvAllow = isnull(round(ConvAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Conveyence) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								PFContrib = isnull(round(PFContrib,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OthersAllow = isnull(round(OthersAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Allowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OverTimeAllow = isnull(round(OverTimeAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(Overtime) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				SpecialAllow = isnull(round(SpecialAllow,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(SpecialAllowance) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ActualInvestment = isnull(round(ActualInvestment,0.00),0) +
				isnull(round((
					select sum(PF)*2 from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
					where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
					and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0)




				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				HouseRent =
				isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(HouseRentInPercentOfBasic)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								MedicalAllow =
				isnull(round(MedicalAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								ConvAllow =
				isnull(round(ConvAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Conveyance)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								PFContrib =
				isnull(round(PFContrib,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Pf)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
								OthersAllow =
				isnull(round(OthersAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Others)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				SpecialAllow =
				isnull(round(SpecialAllow,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(SpecialAllowance)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount )  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0),
				ActualInvestment =
				isnull(round(ActualInvestment,0.00),0) + isnull(round((
					select sum(Pf)* (12 - #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedSalarySheetsMonthCount ) *2  from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0)



			--==================  MedAllowance Calculation ========================--
				

				
				
			--==================  Conveyence Calculation ========================--
			

				
			--==================  Festival Calculation ========================--

			
			--update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			--	FestBonus = isnull(FestBonus,0.00) +
			--	isnull((
			--		select sum(FestivalBonus) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
			--		where p.SalaryMonth > 6 and p.SalaryYear =@TaxStartYear
			--		and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
			--	),0.00)

			--		select sum(FestivalBonus) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] p
			--		where p.SalaryMonth < 7  and p.SalaryYear =@TaxEndYear
			--		and p.StaffRecordId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
			--	),0.00)

				

			
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				FestBonus =
				 isnull(round((
					select sum(BasicAmount)* 2   from Payroll.IndividualSalaries p
					where p.EmployeeId = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
				),0.00),0)

				
				--==================  PF Calculation ========================--
				
			

		--------			--==================  OthersAllow Calculation ========================--
			
			


				
						--==================  OverTimeAllow Calculation ========================--
			
				
							--==================  SpecialAllow Calculation ========================--
		
		
	

		--==================  Basic Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		ExemptionBasicAmount =0,
		ExemptionFestBonus =0,
			ExemptionPFContrib =0,
			ExemptionOverTimeAllow =0,
			ExemptionSpecialAllow =0,
			ExemptionOthersAllow =0
	
		--==================  House Rent Exemtion Taxable ========================--
		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		ExemptionHouseRent =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.HouseRent
		where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.HouseRent < #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionHouseRent

		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		ExemptionHouseRent =   #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionHouseRent
		where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.HouseRent >= #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionHouseRent

		--==================  Medical Exemtion Taxable ========================--
				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				ExemptionMedicalAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MedicalAllow
				where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MedicalAllow < #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionMedicalAllow

				update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
				ExemptionMedicalAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionMedicalAllow 
				where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MedicalAllow >= #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionMedicalAllow
				
			--==================  ExemptionConvAllow  Taxable ========================--
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			ExemptionConvAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ConvAllow
			where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ConvAllow < #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionConvAllow

			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			ExemptionConvAllow =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionConvAllow --- #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ConvAllow
			where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ConvAllow >= #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SlabExemptionConvAllow

			--==================  ExemptionFestBonus Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
			
					
			--==================  ExemptionPFContrib Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
			


			--==================  ExemptionOverTimeAllow Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
			

			--==================  ExemptionSpecialAllow Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
			
						--==================  Exemption other ExemptionOthersAllow  Calculation Exemtion Taxable ========================--
			

					
			
			--==================  ActualInvestment Calculation ========================--
			--update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			--ActualInvestment =
			--(
			--	select isnull(sum(sl.PF)  ,0) * 2
			--	from hr.StaffRecords s 
			--		join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets sl on sl.StaffRecordId=s.Id
			--				where s.id = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
			--			and 
			--				sl.SalaryYear=#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.TaxYear
			--			and 
			--				sl.SalaryMonth=#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.TaxMonth
			--)


		

			--====================== Total  taxable  =========================


		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		TaxableBasicAmount =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.BasicAmount,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionBasicAmount,0.00),0),
		TaxableHouseRent =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.HouseRent,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionHouseRent,0.00),0),
		TaxableMedicalAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MedicalAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionMedicalAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableConvAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ConvAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionConvAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableFestBonus =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.FestBonus,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionFestBonus,0.00),0),
		TaxablePFContrib =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.PFContrib,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionPFContrib,0.00),0),
		TaxableOthersAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.OthersAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionOthersAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableOverTimeAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.OverTimeAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionOverTimeAllow,0.00),0),
		TaxableSpecialAllow =isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.SpecialAllow,0.00),0) -isnull(round(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ExemptionSpecialAllow,0.00),0)


			--======================  taxable  =========================



			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			TotalAmount = BasicAmount + HouseRent + MedicalAllow +ConvAllow+FestBonus+PFContrib+OthersAllow+OverTimeAllow+SpecialAllow,
			TotalExemption = ExemptionBasicAmount + ExemptionHouseRent + ExemptionMedicalAllow + ExemptionConvAllow+ExemptionFestBonus+ExemptionPFContrib+ExemptionOthersAllow+ExemptionOverTimeAllow+ExemptionSpecialAllow,
			TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise = TaxableBasicAmount + TaxableHouseRent + TaxableMedicalAllow + TaxableConvAllow+TaxableFestBonus+TaxablePFContrib+TaxableOthersAllow+TaxableOverTimeAllow+TaxableSpecialAllow

			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			TotalTaxableIncome =
			isnull(round((
				select sum(TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise)
				from 
				(
					select max(TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise) TotalTaxableIncomeMonthWise 
					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax  tt
					where tt.EmpID =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
					and tt.TaxYearDisplay = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.TaxYearDisplay
					group by tt.EmpID,tt.TaxYearDisplay,tt.TaxMonth
				)T
			),0.00),0)
					

			--==========================  SlabAmount  Start =========================================--

			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			SlabAmount =   SlabRangemax - SlabRangeMin+1,
			SlabTax    =  (slabrate * (SlabRangemax - SlabRangeMin+1))/100
			where TotalTaxableIncome > SlabRangeMin and TotalTaxableIncome >  SlabRangemax


			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			SlabAmount =   TotalTaxableIncome - SlabRangeMin +1,
			SlabTax    =  (slabrate * (  TotalTaxableIncome -SlabRangeMin+1))/100
			where  TotalTaxableIncome > SlabRangeMin and TotalTaxableIncome <  SlabRangemax

			
			--==========================  SlabAmount  Start =========================================--
		

	DECLARE @TaxYear int,
			@MaximumLimit decimal(18,2),
			@YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome decimal(18,2),
			@Remarks nvarchar(max),
			@AllowableRebatePrecentage int

	select 
	@TaxYear = max(TaxYear),
	@MaximumLimit = max(MaximumLimit),
	@YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome = max(YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome),
	@AllowableRebatePrecentage = max(AllowableRebatePrecentage)
	from 
	SalaryCertificateTaxCalculationSlab
	where TaxYear = year(@CalCurrentMonth)
		

	
	update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		[TaxableIncome]= 
		round((
			select sum(SlabTax) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax tt
			where tt.EmpID =  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID
			and tt.TaxYear = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.TaxYear
			and tt.TaxMonth =#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.TaxMonth
		),0)
		
		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		[MaximumLimit] = @MaximumLimit ,
		[YearWiseTaxableIncomePrecentage] = @YearWiseSlabTaxableIncome,
		[ApprovalAmount] =[ActualInvestment],
		[AllowableForRebate] =@AllowableRebatePrecentage,
		AllowforRebateAmount =(@AllowableRebatePrecentage*[ActualInvestment])/100,
		[NetTaxPayable] = 0.00
		
		update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
		[NetTaxPayable] = [TaxableIncome] -AllowforRebateAmount
		


			select @CalCurrentMonth = DATEADD(Month,1,@CalCurrentMonth)
			print @CalCurrentMonth
	END

           ,[Particulars]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[Column4]
           ,[Column5]) 
		   values('A.Salary & Allowance','Special Allowance',(select max(SpecialAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(ExemptionSpecialAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(TaxableSpecialAllow) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax))

	--select * from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
	--drop table #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
	--return
	INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
           ([GroupName]
           ,[Particulars]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[Column4]
           ,[Column5]) 

	select  distinct  'B.Tax Calculation',slab,0,0,0 from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax --where isFirstSlabthisYear=1
	--order by SlabRangeMin

	
		

	update [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] set
	amount =
	(
		select distinct SlabAmount from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where slab =[Particulars]
	)
	where [GroupName]= 'B.Tax Calculation'


	update [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] set
	Column4 =
	(
		select distinct SlabRate from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where slab =[Particulars]
	)
	where [GroupName]= 'B.Tax Calculation'
	
	


	update [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] set
	Column5 =
	(
		select distinct SlabTax from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where slab =[Particulars]
	)
	where [GroupName]= 'B.Tax Calculation'

	


	INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
           ([GroupName]
           ,[Particulars]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[Column4]
           ,[Column5]) 
		   values('C.Tax Rebate',(select convert(varchar(20),max(MaximumLimit)) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(TaxableIncome) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(ActualInvestment) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(ApprovalAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax)
	)
end 
		INSERT INTO [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
           ([GroupName]
           ,[Particulars]
           ,[Amount]
           ,[Column4]
           ,[Column5]) 
		   values('D.Net Tax','',
	(select max(AllowableForRebate) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(AllowforRebateAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax),
	(select max(NetTaxPayable) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax)
	)
	
	--select * from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax

if @ProcessForIncomeTax =0
begin
	select * from [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate]
end
else if @ProcessForIncomeTax =1
begin
	select @EmployeeId,* from [Payroll].[incometaxcertificate] where [GroupName] ='D.Net Tax'
end

drop table #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax

END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxCalculation]
	@CountingYear int,
	@EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
	@Source nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN



create table #TempSpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxCalculation
(
EmpID uniqueidentifier,
EmpCode nvarchar (max),
EmpName nvarchar(max),
EmpNature nvarchar(max),
JoinDate date,
DptName nvarchar(max),
DesigName nvarchar(max),

BasicAmount float,
HouseRent float,
MedicalAllow float,
ConvAllow float,
FestBonus float,
PFContrib float,
OthersAllow float ,
OverTimeAllow float ,
SpecialAllow float ,

ExemptionBasicAmount float,
ExemptionHouseRent float,
ExemptionMedicalAllow float,
ExemptionConvAllow float ,
ExemptionFestBonus float ,
ExemptionPFContrib float ,
ExemptionOthersAllow float ,
ExemptionOverTimeAllow float ,
ExemptionSpecialAllow float ,

TaxableBasicAmount float ,
TaxableHouseRent float ,
TaxableMedicalAllow float ,
TaxableConvAllow float ,
TaxableFestBonus float ,
TaxablePFContrib float ,
TaxableOthersAllow float ,
TaxableOverTimeAllow float ,
TaxableSpecialAllow float ,

TaxYear int,
CurrentStatus int, -- 1 means last ; 2 -- means previous or cancel
TotalTaxCalculation int,
Userid int,
calculationdate datetime,
calculationsource nvarchar(max)  -- report load; New UI where tax calculation request generate ; Auto database schudle ; Process call from UI
)


update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
CurrentStatus =2
where TaxYear = @CountingYear and @EmployeeId is null 

update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
CurrentStatus =2
where TaxYear = @CountingYear and @EmployeeId is not null and @EmployeeId = empid



insert into Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
(
EmpID ,
EmpCode ,
EmpName ,
EmpNature ,
JoinDate ,
DptName ,
DesigName ,

TaxYear ,
CurrentStatus , -- 1 means last ; 2 -- means previous or cancel
TotalTaxCalculation ,
Userid ,
calculationdate ,
calculationsource -- report load; New UI where tax calculation request generate ; Auto database schudle ; Process call from UI
)

select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,s.ServiceNature EmpNature , s.JoiningDate JoinDate, d.Name DptName, dg.Name DesigName
	,@CountingYear,1,0,1,getdate(),@Source
	from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId

	where (s.id = @EmployeeId or @EmployeeId is null)

	--==================  Basic Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
BasicAmount =
(
select sl.Basic  
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets sl on sl.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	and sl.SalaryYear=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

		--==================  House Rent Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
HouseRent =
(
select sl.HouseRent  
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets sl on sl.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	and sl.SalaryYear=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

			--==================  MedicalAllow Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
MedicalAllow =
(
select sl.MedAllowance  
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets sl on sl.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	and sl.SalaryYear=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

	
			--==================  ConvAllow Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
ConvAllow =
(
select sl.Conveyance  
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	--and sr.Year=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

				--==================  FestBonus Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
FestBonus =
(
select 0 FestBonus 
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	--and sr.Year=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

					--==================  PFContrib Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
PFContrib =
(
select sl.Pf 
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	--and sr.Year=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null 
	)

	
					--==================  OthersAllow Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
OthersAllow =
(
select 0 OthersAllow
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	--and sr.Year=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

		
					--==================  OverTimeAllow Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
OverTimeAllow =
(
select 0 OverTimeAllow
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	--and sr.Year=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

			
					--==================  SpecialAllow Calculation ========================--
update Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
SpecialAllow =
(
select 0 SpecialAllow
from hr.StaffRecords s 
	join Payroll.IndividualSalaries sl on sl.EmployeeId=s.Id
	--join Payroll.StaffMonthlySalaryRecords sr on sr.StaffRecordId=s.Id
	where s.id = Payroll.SalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.empid
	--and sr.Year=@CountingYear
)
where Currentstatus =1
and TaxYear = @CountingYear 
and 
	(	
		(@EmployeeId = empid and @EmployeeId is not null)
		or
		@EmployeeId is null
	)

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormula]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--------- exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormula] '2023-07-01','2024-06-30','ph00142'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormula]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @SlabStartEndDate nvarchar(max)

IF @FilterEndDate <'2025-7-1'
BEGIN 
	set @SlabStartEndDate ='2024-2025'
END
else
BEGIN
	set @SlabStartEndDate ='2025-2026'
END 



	CREATE TABLE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax 
	(
			[AutoID] [bigint] identity(1,1),
			[EmpID] [uniqueidentifier] NULL,
			[EmpNo] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[EmpName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[EmpNature] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[JoinDate] [date] NULL,
			[DptName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[DesigName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[Sex] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[ApprovedMonthCount] INT,
			[ApprovedBonusCount] INT,
			[BasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[HouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[MedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[OthersAllow] [float] NULL,

			[MaxBasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[MaxHouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[MaxMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[MaxConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[MaxOthersAllow] [float] NULL,

			[ToBeBasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeHouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeOthersAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeBonusAmount] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF] [float] NULL,


			[OverTimeAllow] [float] NULL,
			[SpecialAllow] [float] NULL,
			[Arrear] [float] NULL,
			[LeaveIncashment] [float] NULL,
			[FestBonus] [float] NULL,
			[PFContrib] [float] NULL,
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] [float],
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] [float],
			[FixedExemptedAmount] [float],
			[LowerExemptedAmount] [float],
			[YearTaxableIncome] [float],
			
			[IncomeSlab] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[TaxableSlabAmount] [float],
			[DisplayTaxableSlabAmount] [float],
			[Rate] [float],
			[TaxAmount] [float],
			[TempTaxableAmount] [float],
			[GrossTaxAmount] [float],
			
			[SelfandEmployerPF]  [float],
			[WPPF]  [float] ,
			[GroupInsurence]  [float] ,
			[TotalPFWPPFInsurence] [float] ,
			[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage] [float],
			[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage] [float],

			[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] [float] ,
			[TaxRebateonInvestment] [float] ,
			[RebateFixedLower]  [float] ,
			[TotalLowerRebateAmount] [float] ,
			[NetTaxPayable] [float] ,
			[TotalPaidTax] [float] ,
			[TaxPaidToBRTA] [float] ,
			[NetTaxToBePaid] [float] 
			
			
			
	) 

	select 
	s.Id [EmpID] ,
			s.EmployeeNo [EmpNo] ,
			s.EmployeeName [EmpName] ,
			s.ServiceNature [EmpNature] ,
			s.JoiningDate [JoinDate],
			d.Name [DptName],
		 	dg.Name [DesigName],
			case when s.sex='Male' then 'M' else 'F' end sex,
			ass.*
			, 0 [ApprovedMonthCount]
			,0 [MaxBasicAmount] 
			,0 [MaxHouseRent] 
			,0 [MaxMedicalAllow] 
			,0 [MaxConvAllow] 
			,0 [MaxOthersAllow] 
			,0 MaxRowIDStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets
			,0 ApprovedBonusCount
			,0 ToBeBonusAmount
			into #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets

	from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
				
	where (s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo or  @EmployeeNo ='')
	and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate

	
	
		
	UPDATE #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets SET
	[ApprovedMonthCount] =
	(
			SELECT COUNT(*) 
			from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
				
				where (s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo or  @EmployeeNo ='')
				and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
				and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
				AND #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets.EmpID= s.Id
	)
	
	UPDATE #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets SET
	[ApprovedBonusCount] =
	ISNULL((
			select count(ass.BonusAmount) 
			from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ass
			JOIN hr.Festivals f ON f.Id = ass.FestvalId
				where       convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
						and #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
						AND f.Id IN (1,2)
	),0)

	UPDATE #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets SET
	[ApprovedBonusCount] = ISNULL([ApprovedBonusCount],0)+ 
	ISNULL((
			select count(ass.BonusAmount) /2
			from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ass
			JOIN hr.Festivals f ON f.Id = ass.FestvalId
				where       convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
						and #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
						AND f.Id IN (4)
	),0)

	


	
	insert into #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
	(
			[EmpID] ,
			[EmpNo] ,
			[EmpName],
			[EmpNature] ,
			[JoinDate],
			[DptName] ,
			[DesigName] ,
			[Sex] ,
			[BasicAmount] ,
			[HouseRent] ,
			[MedicalAllow] ,
			[ConvAllow] ,
			[OthersAllow] ,

			[MaxBasicAmount] ,
			[MaxHouseRent],
			[MaxMedicalAllow] ,
			[MaxConvAllow] ,
			[MaxOthersAllow] ,


			[OverTimeAllow] ,
			[SpecialAllow] ,
			[Arrear] ,
			[LeaveIncashment] ,
			[FestBonus] ,
			[PFContrib] ,
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] ,
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
			[FixedExemptedAmount] ,
			[YearTaxableIncome] ,

			[IncomeSlab] ,
			[TaxableSlabAmount] ,
			[Rate] ,
			[TaxAmount],
			[TempTaxableAmount],
			[DisplayTaxableSlabAmount],
			[ApprovedMonthCount],
			[ApprovedBonusCount],
			[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF]
	)
	
	select 
	[EmpID] ,
			[EmpNo] ,
			[EmpName],
			[EmpNature] ,
			[JoinDate],
			[DptName] ,
			[DesigName] ,
			[Sex] ,
			[BasicAmount] ,
			[HouseRent] ,
			[MedicalAllow] ,
			[ConvAllow] ,
			[OthersAllow] ,
			
			[MaxBasicAmount] ,
			[MaxHouseRent],
			[MaxMedicalAllow] ,
			[MaxConvAllow] ,
			[MaxOthersAllow] ,

			[OverTimeAllow] ,
			[SpecialAllow] ,
			[Arrear] ,
			[LeaveIncashment] ,
			[FestBonus] ,
			[PFContrib] ,
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] ,
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
			[FixedExemptedAmount] ,
			[YearTaxExemptedAmount] 
	,
	ts.Name,
	ts.Amount,
	ts.TaxInPercent,
	0 [TaxAmount],
	0 [TempTaxableAmount],
	ts.Amount DisplayTaxableSlabAmount ,
	[ApprovedMonthCount],
	[ApprovedBonusCount],
	[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF]
	from 
	(
			select 
			s.EmpID [EmpID] ,
			s.[EmpNo] ,
			s.[EmpName] ,
			s.[EmpNature] ,
			s.[JoinDate],
			s.DptName,
		 	s.[DesigName],
			s.sex,
			sum([Basic]) [BasicAmount] ,
			sum([HouseRent]) [HouseRent] ,
			sum([MedAllowance] ) [MedicalAllow] ,
			sum([Conveyence]) [ConvAllow] ,
			sum([OtherAllowance]) [OthersAllow] ,

			max([Basic]) [MaxBasicAmount] ,
			max([HouseRent]) [MaxHouseRent] ,
			MAX([MedAllowance] ) [MaxMedicalAllow] ,
			max([Conveyence]) [MaxConvAllow] ,
			max([OtherAllowance]) [MaxOthersAllow] ,

			sum([Overtime]) [OverTimeAllow] ,
			sum([SpecialAllowance]) + sum([Allowance]) [SpecialAllow] ,
			sum([Arrear]) [Arrear] ,
			0 [LeaveIncashment] ,
			0 [FestBonus] ,
			sum([PF]) [PFContrib] ,
			0 [TotalPayAndAllowance],
			0 [OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
			0 [FixedExemptedAmount] ,
			0 [YearTaxExemptedAmount] ,
			[ApprovedMonthCount],
			[ApprovedBonusCount],
			0 ToBeSelfandEmployerPF

	----from hr.StaffRecords s 
	----			join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	----			join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	----			join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
	from #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets s
				
	where (s.[EmpNo] = @EmployeeNo or  @EmployeeNo ='')
	--and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	--and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
	group by 
		s.EmpID  ,
			s.[EmpNo] ,
			s.[EmpName] ,
			s.[EmpNature] ,
			s.[JoinDate],
			s.DptName,
		 	s.[DesigName],
			s.sex,
			[ApprovedMonthCount],
			[ApprovedBonusCount]
	)T
	right join Payroll.TaxSlabs ts on ts.Gender = T.sex
	and ts.SlabStartEndDate =  @SlabStartEndDate
	where T.EmpID is not null
	order by ts.Id
	

		

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeBasicAmount = 
			ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxBasicAmount,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeHouseRent = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxHouseRent,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeMedicalAllow = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxMedicalAllow,0)


			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeConvAllow = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxConvAllow,0)


			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeOthersAllow = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxOthersAllow,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeBonusAmount = ISNULL((2.5-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedBonusCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxBasicAmount,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeSelfandEmployerPF = ISNULL((24-(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount * 2)) * (#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxBasicAmount/10),0)

			
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[FestBonus] = (
				select sum(ass.BonusAmount) from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ass
				where       convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
						and #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
			),
			[FixedExemptedAmount] =
			(
			
				select max(FixedExapmtedIncome) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where [Name] ='Exempted'
				and #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender
			)
			
			
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] =
			(
						isnull([BasicAmount],0) +
						isnull([HouseRent],0) +
						isnull([MedicalAllow],0) +
						isnull([ConvAllow],0) +
						isnull([OthersAllow],0) +
						isnull([OverTimeAllow],0) +
						isnull([SpecialAllow],0) +
						isnull([Arrear],0) +
						isnull([LeaveIncashment],0) +
						isnull([FestBonus],0) +
						isnull([PFContrib],0) +
						isnull([TotalPayAndAllowance],0)+

						isnull([ToBeBasicAmount],0) +
						isnull([ToBeHouseRent],0) +
						isnull([ToBeMedicalAllow],0) +
						isnull([ToBeSelfandEmployerPF]/2,0) +
						isnull([ToBeConvAllow],0) +
						isnull([ToBeOthersAllow],0)  +
						isnull([ToBeBonusAmount],0) 

			)
			
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] = convert(float, [TotalPayAndAllowance])/3
					
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[YearTaxableIncome] =
			(
					select 
						case when [OneThirdGrossAmount] > [FixedExemptedAmount]  then [TotalPayAndAllowance] - [FixedExemptedAmount] 
						else [TotalPayAndAllowance] - [OneThirdGrossAmount]  end 

					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
					where t.AutoID = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.AutoID
			)
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			TempTaxableAmount =  [YearTaxableIncome]

			

			 
			DECLARE 
				@AutoID bigint, 
				@TempTaxableAmount   float,
				@TaxableSlabAmount float,
				@TotalCalculationTaxAmount float=0,
				@YearTaxableIncome float,
				@PreTempTaxableAmount float;

				DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
				FOR select AutoID,TaxableSlabAmount, [TempTaxableAmount],YearTaxableIncome 
				from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax  
				where  IncomeSlab <> 'Exempted'
				order by AutoID;

				OPEN cursor_product;

				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
					@AutoID, 
					@TaxableSlabAmount,
					@TempTaxableAmount,
					@YearTaxableIncome;

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						
						set @TotalCalculationTaxAmount = @TotalCalculationTaxAmount + @TaxableSlabAmount
						update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
						--[TaxableSlabAmount] =99,
						[TaxAmount] =@TotalCalculationTaxAmount
						where AutoID =@AutoID

						declare @tempAmount float
						declare @TaxAmopunt float
						select @tempAmount = (YearTaxableIncome - Taxamount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where AutoID =@AutoID
						IF @tempAmount <0 
						BEGIN
									select @TaxAmopunt = (@PreTempTaxableAmount*rate)/100 from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where AutoID =@AutoID		
									if @TaxAmopunt <0
									Begin 
										set @PreTempTaxableAmount =0
										set @TaxAmopunt =0
									end 

									update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
									DisplayTaxableSlabAmount = @PreTempTaxableAmount,
									[TempTaxableAmount] =@tempAmount,
									TaxAmount =@TaxAmopunt
									where AutoID =@AutoID
									
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								select @TaxAmopunt = (TaxableSlabAmount*rate)/100 from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where AutoID =@AutoID
									update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
									DisplayTaxableSlabAmount = TaxableSlabAmount,
									[TempTaxableAmount] =@tempAmount,
									TaxAmount =@TaxAmopunt
									where AutoID =@AutoID
						END
						set @PreTempTaxableAmount = @tempAmount
						
					

						


						FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
							@AutoID, 
							@TaxableSlabAmount,
							@TempTaxableAmount,
							@YearTaxableIncome;
					END;

				CLOSE cursor_product;

				DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

			

				--select max(FixedExapmtedIncome) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where 
				--#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender


			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[SelfandEmployerPF]=
			(
				select isnull(sum(PF),0) * 2 from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass
				where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
			),
			[GrossTaxAmount] =(select sum(TaxAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t where t.EmpNo = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpNo),
			[WPPF]  =0,
			[GroupInsurence]  =0,
			[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage] = (select sum(t.TaxRebateOnTaxableIncome) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender ),
			[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage] = (select sum(t.TaxRebateOnInvestment) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender )
			
			--123456

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[TotalPFWPPFInsurence] =[SelfandEmployerPF] + [WPPF]+[GroupInsurence]+[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF],
				------Previous start--
			--[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] = ([YearTaxableIncome]*[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage])/100,
		
			---[TaxRebateonInvestment] =(([SelfandEmployerPF] + [WPPF]+[GroupInsurence]+[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF])*[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage])/100,
			-------------Previous end--

			[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] = ( [YearTaxableIncome] * 0.03),

			[TaxRebateonInvestment] = 0.15 * (0.2 * [YearTaxableIncome]),
			[RebateFixedLower]  =1000000

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[TotalLowerRebateAmount] =
			(
					select  case
						when [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] < [TaxRebateonInvestment] and  [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] < [RebateFixedLower] then [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome]
						when [TaxRebateonInvestment] < [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] and  [TaxRebateonInvestment] < [RebateFixedLower] then [TaxRebateonInvestment]
						else [RebateFixedLower] end
					
					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
					where t.AutoID = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.AutoID
			),
			[LowerExemptedAmount]=
			(
					select  case
						when [FixedExemptedAmount] < [OneThirdGrossAmount]  then [FixedExemptedAmount]
						else [OneThirdGrossAmount] end
					
					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
					where t.AutoID = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.AutoID
			)

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[NetTaxPayable] =[GrossTaxAmount] - [TotalLowerRebateAmount],
			[TotalPaidTax] =
			(
					select isnull(sum(IncomeTax),0)
					--* 2 
					from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass
					where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
					and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
					and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
			),
			[TaxPaidToBRTA] =0

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[NetTaxToBePaid] =[NetTaxPayable]-[TotalPaidTax]-[TaxPaidToBRTA]


		
							select 
							[EmpID] ,
							[EmpNo] ,
							[EmpName],
							[EmpNature] ,
							[JoinDate],
							[DptName] ,
							[DesigName] ,
							[Sex] ,
							ISNULL([BasicAmount] + ToBeBasicAmount,0) [BasicAmount] ,
							ISNULL([HouseRent] + ToBeHouseRent,0) [HouseRent],
							ISNULL([MedicalAllow] + ToBeMedicalAllow,0) [MedicalAllow],
							ISNULL([ConvAllow] + tobeConvAllow,0) [ConvAllow] ,
							ISNULL([OthersAllow] + TobeOthersAllow,0) [OthersAllow] ,
							ISNULL([OverTimeAllow],0)[OverTimeAllow] ,
							ISNULL([SpecialAllow],0) [SpecialAllow],
							ISNULL([Arrear],0)[Arrear] ,
							ISNULL([LeaveIncashment] ,0)[LeaveIncashment],
							ISNULL([FestBonus],0) + ISNULL(ToBeBonusAmount,0) [FestBonus] ,
							ISNULL([PFContrib]  + (ToBeSelfandEmployerPF/2),0) [PFContrib],
							ISNULL([TotalPayAndAllowance],0)[TotalPayAndAllowance] ,

							ISNULL(round([OneThirdGrossAmount],2),0)[OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
							isnull([FixedExemptedAmount],0)[FixedExemptedAmount] ,
							ISNULL(round([LowerExemptedAmount],2),0) [LowerExemptedAmount],
							ISNULL(round([YearTaxableIncome],2),0)[YearTaxableIncome] ,
			
							[IncomeSlab] ,
							round([DisplayTaxableSlabAmount],2) [DisplayTaxableSlabAmount],

								[Rate] ,
								ROUND([TaxAmount],2) [TaxAmount],
								0 TotalIncomeinTk,
								ROUND([GrossTaxAmount],2)[GrossTaxAmount],
								[SelfandEmployerPF] + ToBeSelfandEmployerPF  [SelfandEmployerPF],
							ISNULL([WPPF],0)[WPPF]   ,
							ISNULL([GroupInsurence],0)[GroupInsurence]   ,
							ISNULL([TotalPFWPPFInsurence],0) [TotalPFWPPFInsurence] ,

							ISNULL(ROUND([TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage],2),0)[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage],
							ISNULL(ROUND([TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage],2),0)[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage],
							ISNULL(ROUND([TaxRebateofTaxableIncome],2),0)[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome]  ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([TaxRebateonInvestment],2),0)[TaxRebateonInvestment]  ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([RebateFixedLower],2),0) [RebateFixedLower]  ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([TotalLowerRebateAmount],2),0)[TotalLowerRebateAmount]  ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([NetTaxPayable],2),0) [NetTaxPayable] ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([TotalPaidTax],2),0)[TotalPaidTax]  ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([TaxPaidToBRTA],2),0)[TaxPaidToBRTA]  ,
							ISNULL(ROUND([NetTaxToBePaid],2),0)[NetTaxToBePaid]  ,
							ISNULL([ApprovedMonthCount],0) [ApprovedMonthCount],
							ISNULL([MaxBasicAmount],0) [MaxBasicAmount] ,
							ISNULL([MaxHouseRent],0)[MaxHouseRent] ,
							ISNULL([MaxMedicalAllow],0)[MaxMedicalAllow] ,
							ISNULL([MaxConvAllow],0) [MaxConvAllow],
							ISNULL([MaxOthersAllow],0)[MaxOthersAllow],
							ISNULL([ToBeBasicAmount],0) [ToBeBasicAmount],

							ISNULL([ToBeHouseRent],0) [ToBeHouseRent],
							ISNULL([ToBeMedicalAllow],0) [ToBeMedicalAllow],
							ISNULL([ToBeConvAllow],0) [ToBeConvAllow],
							ISNULL([ToBeOthersAllow],0) [ToBeOthersAllow],
							ISNULL([ApprovedBonusCount],0) [ApprovedBonusCount],
							ISNULL([TobebonusAmount],0) [TobebonusAmount],
							ISNULL(ToBeSelfandEmployerPF,0) ToBeSelfandEmployerPF

			
			
							from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where  IncomeSlab <> 'Exempted'
			

	
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormulaRunningYear]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





--------- exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormula] '2023-07-01','2024-06-30','ph00142'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormulaRunningYear]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max),
	@ProcessForIncomeTax int =0
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @SlabStartEndDate nvarchar(max)

IF @FilterEndDate <'2025-7-1'
BEGIN 
	set @SlabStartEndDate ='2024-2025'
END
else
BEGIN
	set @SlabStartEndDate ='2025-2026'
END 




	
	CREATE TABLE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax 
	(
			[AutoID] [bigint] identity(1,1),
			[EmpID] [uniqueidentifier] NULL,
			[EmpNo] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[EmpName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[EmpNature] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[JoinDate] [date] NULL,
			[DptName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[DesigName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[Sex] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[ApprovedMonthCount] INT,
			[ApprovedBonusCount] INT,
			[BasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[HouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[MedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[OthersAllow] [float] NULL,

			[MaxBasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[MaxHouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[MaxMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[MaxConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[MaxOthersAllow] [float] NULL,

			[ToBeBasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeHouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeOthersAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeBonusAmount] [float] NULL,
			[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF] [float] NULL,


			[OverTimeAllow] [float] NULL,
			[SpecialAllow] [float] NULL,
			[Arrear] [float] NULL,
			[LeaveIncashment] [float] NULL,
			[FestBonus] [float] NULL,
			[PFContrib] [float] NULL,
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] [float],
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] [float],
			[FixedExemptedAmount] [float],
			[LowerExemptedAmount] [float],
			[YearTaxableIncome] [float],
			
			[IncomeSlab] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[TaxableSlabAmount] [float],
			[DisplayTaxableSlabAmount] [float],
			[Rate] [float],
			[TaxAmount] [float],
			[TempTaxableAmount] [float],
			[GrossTaxAmount] [float],
			
			[SelfandEmployerPF]  [float],
			[WPPF]  [float] ,
			[GroupInsurence]  [float] ,
			[TotalPFWPPFInsurence] [float] ,
			[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage] [float],
			[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage] [float],

			[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] [float] ,
			[TaxRebateonInvestment] [float] ,
			[RebateFixedLower]  [float] ,
			[TotalLowerRebateAmount] [float] ,
			[NetTaxPayable] [float] ,
			[TotalPaidTax] [float] ,
			[TaxPaidToBRTA] [float] ,
			[NetTaxToBePaid] [float] 
			
			
			
	) 

	select 
	s.Id [EmpID] ,
			s.EmployeeNo [EmpNo] ,
			s.EmployeeName [EmpName] ,
			s.ServiceNature [EmpNature] ,
			s.JoiningDate [JoinDate],
			d.Name [DptName],
		 	dg.Name [DesigName],
			case when s.sex='Male' then 'M' else 'F' end sex,
			ass.*
			, 0 [ApprovedMonthCount]
			,0 [MaxBasicAmount] 
			,0 [MaxHouseRent] 
			,0 [MaxMedicalAllow] 
			,0 [MaxConvAllow] 
			,0 [MaxOthersAllow] 
			,0 MaxRowIDStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets
			,0 ApprovedBonusCount
			,0 ToBeBonusAmount
			into #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets

	from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
				
	where (s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo or  @EmployeeNo ='')
	and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate

	
		
	UPDATE #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets SET
	[ApprovedMonthCount] =
	(
			SELECT COUNT(*) 
			from hr.StaffRecords s 
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
				
				where (s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo or  @EmployeeNo ='')
				and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
				and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
				AND #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets.EmpID= s.Id
	)
	
	UPDATE #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets SET
	[ApprovedBonusCount] =
	ISNULL((
			select count(ass.BonusAmount) 
			from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ass
			JOIN hr.Festivals f ON f.Id = ass.FestvalId
				where       convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
						and #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
						AND f.Id IN (1,2)
	),0)

	UPDATE #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets SET
	[ApprovedBonusCount] = ISNULL([ApprovedBonusCount],0)+ 
	ISNULL((
			select count(ass.BonusAmount) /2
			from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ass
			JOIN hr.Festivals f ON f.Id = ass.FestvalId
				where       convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
						and #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
						AND f.Id IN (4)
	),0)

	
	

	
	insert into #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
	(
			[EmpID] ,
			[EmpNo] ,
			[EmpName],
			[EmpNature] ,
			[JoinDate],
			[DptName] ,
			[DesigName] ,
			[Sex] ,
			[BasicAmount] ,
			[HouseRent] ,
			[MedicalAllow] ,
			[ConvAllow] ,
			[OthersAllow] ,

			[MaxBasicAmount] ,
			[MaxHouseRent],
			[MaxMedicalAllow] ,
			[MaxConvAllow] ,
			[MaxOthersAllow] ,


			[OverTimeAllow] ,
			[SpecialAllow] ,
			[Arrear] ,
			[LeaveIncashment] ,
			[FestBonus] ,
			[PFContrib] ,
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] ,
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
			[FixedExemptedAmount] ,
			[YearTaxableIncome] ,

			[IncomeSlab] ,
			[TaxableSlabAmount] ,
			[Rate] ,
			[TaxAmount],
			[TempTaxableAmount],
			[DisplayTaxableSlabAmount],
			[ApprovedMonthCount],
			[ApprovedBonusCount],
			[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF]
	)
	
	select 
	[EmpID] ,
			[EmpNo] ,
			[EmpName],
			[EmpNature] ,
			[JoinDate],
			[DptName] ,
			[DesigName] ,
			[Sex] ,
			[BasicAmount] ,
			[HouseRent] ,
			[MedicalAllow] ,
			[ConvAllow] ,
			[OthersAllow] ,
			
			[MaxBasicAmount] ,
			[MaxHouseRent],
			[MaxMedicalAllow] ,
			[MaxConvAllow] ,
			[MaxOthersAllow] ,

			[OverTimeAllow] ,
			[SpecialAllow] ,
			[Arrear] ,
			[LeaveIncashment] ,
			[FestBonus] ,
			[PFContrib] ,
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] ,
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
			[FixedExemptedAmount] ,
			[YearTaxExemptedAmount] 
	,
	ts.Name,
	ts.Amount,
	ts.TaxInPercent,
	0 [TaxAmount],
	0 [TempTaxableAmount],
	ts.Amount DisplayTaxableSlabAmount ,
	[ApprovedMonthCount],
	[ApprovedBonusCount],
	[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF]
	from 
	(
			select 
			s.EmpID [EmpID] ,
			s.[EmpNo] ,
			s.[EmpName] ,
			s.[EmpNature] ,
			s.[JoinDate],
			s.DptName,
		 	s.[DesigName],
			s.sex,
			sum([Basic]) [BasicAmount] ,
			sum([HouseRent]) [HouseRent] ,
			sum([MedAllowance] ) [MedicalAllow] ,
			sum([Conveyence]) [ConvAllow] ,
			sum([OtherAllowance]) [OthersAllow] ,

			max([Basic]) [MaxBasicAmount] ,
			max([HouseRent]) [MaxHouseRent] ,
			MAX([MedAllowance] ) [MaxMedicalAllow] ,
			max([Conveyence]) [MaxConvAllow] ,
			max([OtherAllowance]) [MaxOthersAllow] ,

			sum([Overtime]) [OverTimeAllow] ,
			sum([SpecialAllowance]) + sum([Allowance]) [SpecialAllow] ,
			sum([Arrear]) [Arrear] ,
			0 [LeaveIncashment] ,
			0 [FestBonus] ,
			sum([PF]) [PFContrib] ,
			0 [TotalPayAndAllowance],
			0 [OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
			0 [FixedExemptedAmount] ,
			0 [YearTaxExemptedAmount] ,
			[ApprovedMonthCount],
			[ApprovedBonusCount],
			0 ToBeSelfandEmployerPF

	----from hr.StaffRecords s 
	----			join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	----			join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	----			join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
	from #tempStaffRecordsApprovedSalarySheets s
				
	where (s.[EmpNo] = @EmployeeNo or  @EmployeeNo ='')
	--and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4)Payroll.TaxSlabs,ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	--and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
	group by 
		s.EmpID  ,
			s.[EmpNo] ,
			s.[EmpName] ,
			s.[EmpNature] ,
			s.[JoinDate],
			s.DptName,
		 	s.[DesigName],
			s.sex,
			[ApprovedMonthCount],
			[ApprovedBonusCount]
	)T
	right join Payroll.TaxSlabs ts on ts.Gender = T.sex 
	and ts.SlabStartEndDate =  @SlabStartEndDate
	where T.EmpID is not null
	and ts.SlabStartEndDate =  @SlabStartEndDate
	order by ts.Id
	



			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeBasicAmount = 
			ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxBasicAmount,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeHouseRent = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxHouseRent,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeMedicalAllow = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxMedicalAllow,0)


			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeConvAllow = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxConvAllow,0)


			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeOthersAllow = ISNULL((12-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxOthersAllow,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeBonusAmount = ISNULL((2.5-#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedBonusCount) * #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxBasicAmount,0)

			UPDATE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax SET
			ToBeSelfandEmployerPF = ISNULL((24-(#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.ApprovedMonthCount * 2)) * (#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.MaxBasicAmount/10),0)

			
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[FestBonus] = (
				select sum(ass.BonusAmount) from Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses ass
				where       convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.BonusYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.BonusMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
						and #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
			),
			[FixedExemptedAmount] =
			(
			
				select max(FixedExapmtedIncome) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where [Name] ='Exempted'
				and #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender
			)
			
			
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[TotalPayAndAllowance] =
			(
						isnull([BasicAmount],0) +
						isnull([HouseRent],0) +
						isnull([MedicalAllow],0) +
						isnull([ConvAllow],0) +
						isnull([OthersAllow],0) +
						isnull([OverTimeAllow],0) +
						isnull([SpecialAllow],0) +
						isnull([Arrear],0) +
						isnull([LeaveIncashment],0) +
						isnull([FestBonus],0) +
						isnull([PFContrib],0) +
						isnull([TotalPayAndAllowance],0)+

						isnull([ToBeBasicAmount],0) +
						isnull([ToBeHouseRent],0) +
						isnull([ToBeMedicalAllow],0) +
						isnull([ToBeSelfandEmployerPF]/2,0) +
						isnull([ToBeConvAllow],0) +
						isnull([ToBeOthersAllow],0)  +
						isnull([ToBeBonusAmount],0) 

			)
			
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[OneThirdGrossAmount] = convert(float, [TotalPayAndAllowance])/3
					
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[YearTaxableIncome] =
			(
					select 
						case when [OneThirdGrossAmount] > [FixedExemptedAmount]  then [TotalPayAndAllowance] - [FixedExemptedAmount] 
						else [TotalPayAndAllowance] - [OneThirdGrossAmount]  end 

					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
					where t.AutoID = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.AutoID
			)
			update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			TempTaxableAmount =  [YearTaxableIncome]

			

			 
			DECLARE 
				@AutoID bigint, 
				@TempTaxableAmount   float,
				@TaxableSlabAmount float,
				@TotalCalculationTaxAmount float=0,
				@YearTaxableIncome float,
				@PreTempTaxableAmount float;

				DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
				FOR select AutoID,TaxableSlabAmount, [TempTaxableAmount],YearTaxableIncome from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax  
				where  IncomeSlab <> 'Exempted'
				order by AutoID;

				OPEN cursor_product;

				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
					@AutoID, 
					@TaxableSlabAmount,
					@TempTaxableAmount,
					@YearTaxableIncome;

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						
						set @TotalCalculationTaxAmount = @TotalCalculationTaxAmount + @TaxableSlabAmount
						update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
						--[TaxableSlabAmount] =99,
						[TaxAmount] =@TotalCalculationTaxAmount
						where AutoID =@AutoID

						declare @tempAmount float
						declare @TaxAmopunt float
						select @tempAmount = (YearTaxableIncome - Taxamount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where AutoID =@AutoID
						IF @tempAmount <0 
						BEGIN
									select @TaxAmopunt = (@PreTempTaxableAmount*rate)/100 from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where AutoID =@AutoID		
									if @TaxAmopunt <0
									Begin 
										set @PreTempTaxableAmount =0
										set @TaxAmopunt =0
									end 

									update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
									DisplayTaxableSlabAmount = @PreTempTaxableAmount,
									[TempTaxableAmount] =@tempAmount,
									TaxAmount =@TaxAmopunt
									where AutoID =@AutoID
									
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								select @TaxAmopunt = (TaxableSlabAmount*rate)/100 from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where AutoID =@AutoID
									update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
									DisplayTaxableSlabAmount = TaxableSlabAmount,
									[TempTaxableAmount] =@tempAmount,
									TaxAmount =@TaxAmopunt
									where AutoID =@AutoID
						END
						set @PreTempTaxableAmount = @tempAmount
						
					

						


						FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
							@AutoID, 
							@TaxableSlabAmount,
							@TempTaxableAmount,
							@YearTaxableIncome;
					END;

				CLOSE cursor_product;

				DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

			

				--select max(FixedExapmtedIncome) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where 
				--#TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender


			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[SelfandEmployerPF]=
			(
				select isnull(sum(PF),0) * 2 from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass
				where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
			),
			[GrossTaxAmount] =(select sum(TaxAmount) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t where t.EmpNo = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpNo),
			[WPPF]  =0,
			[GroupInsurence]  =0,
			[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage] = (select sum(t.TaxRebateOnTaxableIncome) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender ),
			[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage] = (select sum(t.TaxRebateOnInvestment) from Payroll.TaxSlabs  t where  #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.Sex = t.Gender )
			
			--123456

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[TotalPFWPPFInsurence] =[SelfandEmployerPF] + [WPPF]+[GroupInsurence]+[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF],
				------Previous start--
			--[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] = ([YearTaxableIncome]*[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage])/100,
		
			---[TaxRebateonInvestment] =(([SelfandEmployerPF] + [WPPF]+[GroupInsurence]+[ToBeSelfandEmployerPF])*[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage])/100,
			-------------Previous end--

			[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] = ( [YearTaxableIncome] * 0.03),

			[TaxRebateonInvestment] = 0.15 * (0.2 * [YearTaxableIncome]),
			[RebateFixedLower]  =1000000

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[TotalLowerRebateAmount] =
			(
					select  case
						when [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] < [TaxRebateonInvestment] and  [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] < [RebateFixedLower] then [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome]
						when [TaxRebateonInvestment] < [TaxRebateofTaxableIncome] and  [TaxRebateonInvestment] < [RebateFixedLower] then [TaxRebateonInvestment]
						else [RebateFixedLower] end
					
					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
					where t.AutoID = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.AutoID
			),
			[LowerExemptedAmount]=
			(
					select  case
						when [FixedExemptedAmount] < [OneThirdGrossAmount]  then [FixedExemptedAmount]
						else [OneThirdGrossAmount] end
					
					from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
					where t.AutoID = #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.AutoID
			)

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[NetTaxPayable] =[GrossTaxAmount] - [TotalLowerRebateAmount],
			[TotalPaidTax] =
			(
					select isnull(sum(IncomeTax),0)
					--* 2 
					from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass
					where #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax.EmpID = ass.StaffRecordId
					and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
					and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
			),
			[TaxPaidToBRTA] =0

			Update #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax set
			[NetTaxToBePaid] =[NetTaxPayable]-[TotalPaidTax]-[TaxPaidToBRTA]


			IF @ProcessForIncomeTax=0
			BEGIN
							select 
								[EmpID] ,
							[EmpNo] ,
							[EmpName],
							[EmpNature] ,
							[JoinDate],
							[DptName] ,
							[DesigName] ,
							[Sex] ,
							[BasicAmount] ,
							[HouseRent] ,
							[MedicalAllow] ,
							[ConvAllow] ,
							[OthersAllow] ,
							[OverTimeAllow] ,
							[SpecialAllow] ,
							[Arrear] ,
							[LeaveIncashment] ,
							[FestBonus] ,
							[PFContrib] ,
							[TotalPayAndAllowance] ,
							round([OneThirdGrossAmount],2)[OneThirdGrossAmount] ,
							isnull([FixedExemptedAmount],0)[FixedExemptedAmount] ,
							round([LowerExemptedAmount],2) [LowerExemptedAmount],
							round([YearTaxableIncome],2)[YearTaxableIncome] ,
			
							[IncomeSlab] ,
							round([DisplayTaxableSlabAmount],2) [DisplayTaxableSlabAmount],
								[Rate] ,
								ROUND([TaxAmount],2) [TaxAmount],
								0 TotalIncomeinTk,
								ROUND([GrossTaxAmount],2)[GrossTaxAmount],
								[SelfandEmployerPF]  ,
							[WPPF]   ,
							[GroupInsurence]   ,
							[TotalPFWPPFInsurence]  ,
							ROUND([TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage],2)[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage],
							ROUND([TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage],2)[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage],
							ROUND([TaxRebateofTaxableIncome],2)[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome]  ,
							ROUND([TaxRebateonInvestment],2)[TaxRebateonInvestment]  ,
							ROUND([RebateFixedLower],2) [RebateFixedLower]  ,
							ROUND([TotalLowerRebateAmount],2)[TotalLowerRebateAmount]  ,
							ROUND([NetTaxPayable],2) [NetTaxPayable] ,
							ROUND([TotalPaidTax],2)[TotalPaidTax]  ,
							ROUND([TaxPaidToBRTA],2)[TaxPaidToBRTA]  ,
							ROUND([NetTaxToBePaid],2)[NetTaxToBePaid]  ,
							[ApprovedMonthCount],
							[MaxBasicAmount] ,
							[MaxHouseRent] ,
							[MaxMedicalAllow] ,
							[MaxConvAllow] ,
							[MaxOthersAllow],
							[ToBeBasicAmount],

							[ToBeHouseRent],
							[ToBeMedicalAllow],
							[ToBeConvAllow],
							[ToBeOthersAllow],
							[ApprovedBonusCount],
							[TobebonusAmount],
							ToBeSelfandEmployerPF

			
			
							from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax where  IncomeSlab <> 'Exempted'
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				
				SELECT 
				EmpId [uniqueidentifier],
				t.AutoID [Id],
				'D.Net Tax' [GroupName],
				'' [Particulars] ,
				15 [Amount] ,
				ROUND([NetTaxToBePaid],2) [Column4] ,
				ROUND([NetTaxPayable],2) [Column5] ,
				NULL [IsSynced] 
				
				FROM #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax t
				WHERE t.[AutoID] =
				(
					SELECT MAX([AutoID]) from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTax
				)


			END
						



	--order by convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01')

	
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormulaRunningYearSection108]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


CREATE   PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormulaRunningYearSection108]

--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormulaRunningYearSection108]'2023-07-01,2024-06-30,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	--@FilterStartDate date,
	--@FilterEndDate date
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate DATE

		Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2



	CREATE TABLE #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxSection108 
	(
			--[AutoID] [bigint] identity(1,1),
			[EmpID] [uniqueidentifier] NULL,
			[EmpNo] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[EmpName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[EmpNature] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[JoinDate] [date] NULL,
			[DptName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[DesigName] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[Sex] [nvarchar](max) NULL,
			[BasicAmount] [float] NULL,
			[HouseRent] [float] NULL,
			[MedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
			[ConvAllow] [float] NULL,
			[OthersAllow] [float] NULL,
			[OverTimeAllow] [float] NULL,
							[SpecialAllow] [float] NULL,
							[Arrear] [float] NULL,
							[LeaveIncashment]  [float] NULL,
							[FestBonus]  [float] NULL,
							[PFContrib]  [float] NULL,
							[TotalPayAndAllowance]  [float] NULL,
							[OneThirdGrossAmount]  [float] NULL,
							[FixedExemptedAmount]  [float] NULL,
							[LowerExemptedAmount]  [float] NULL,
							[YearTaxableIncome]  [float] NULL,
							[IncomeSlab]  nvarchar(max) NULL,
							[DisplayTaxableSlabAmount]  [float] NULL,
							[Rate]  [float] NULL,
							[TaxAmount]  [float] NULL,
							TotalIncomeinTk  [float] NULL,
							[GrossTaxAmount] [float] NULL,
							[SelfandEmployerPF] [float] NULL,
							[WPPF]    [float] NULL,
							[GroupInsurence]    [float] NULL,
							[TotalPFWPPFInsurence]  [float] NULL,
							[TaxRebateonTaxableIncomePercentage] [float] NULL,
							[TaxRebateonInvestmentPercentage] [float] NULL,
							[TaxRebateofTaxableIncome]   [float] NULL,
							[TaxRebateonInvestment]   [float] NULL,
							[RebateFixedLower]   [float] NULL,
							[TotalLowerRebateAmount]   [float] NULL,
							[NetTaxPayable]  [float] NULL,
							[TotalPaidTax]   [float] NULL,
							[TaxPaidToBRTA]   [float] NULL,
							[NetTaxToBePaid]   [float] NULL,
							[ApprovedMonthCount]  [float] NULL,
							[MaxBasicAmount]  [float] NULL,
							[MaxHouseRent]  [float] NULL,
							[MaxMedicalAllow]  [float] NULL,
							[MaxConvAllow]  [float] NULL,
							[MaxOthersAllow]  [float] NULL,
							[ToBeBasicAmount] [float] NULL,

							[ToBeHouseRent] [float] NULL,
							[ToBeMedicalAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ToBeConvAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ToBeOthersAllow] [float] NULL,
							[ApprovedBonusCount] [float] NULL,
							[TobebonusAmount] [float] NULL,
							ToBeSelfandEmployerPF [float] NULL

			
	) 
				DECLARE 
				@EmployeeNo VARCHAR(MAX)

			DECLARE cursor_IncomeTaxSection108  CURSOR
			FOR 
					
					select distinct s.EmployeeNo
					from hr.StaffRecords s 
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ass on ass.StaffRecordId = s.Id
								and ass.Incometax <>0.00

				
					where convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
					and convert(date,  convert(varchar(4),ass.salaryYear) + '-' +convert(varchar(2),ass.SalaryMonth) +'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
					--and s.EmployeeNo  ='ph01147'
			
			;

			OPEN cursor_IncomeTaxSection108;

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_IncomeTaxSection108 INTO 
				@EmployeeNo;

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					insert into #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxSection108
					exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxNewFormula] @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@EmployeeNo

					FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_IncomeTaxSection108 INTO 
						@EmployeeNo;
				END;

			CLOSE cursor_IncomeTaxSection108;
			
			DEALLOCATE cursor_IncomeTaxSection108;

END

DECLARE @Query nvarchar(max) =''

  


set @Query ='

select(
	select * from(

select EmpNo,EmpName [NameodEmployee],DesigName [Designation],s.TINNo [TwelveDigitTaxpayersIdentiifcationNumber],BasicAmount,HouseRent,MedicalAllow Medical,ConvAllow ConveyanceAllowance,
FestBonus [Bonus],PFContrib [EmployeeContributionPF],OthersAllow+OverTimeAllow Others,TotalPayAndAllowance [TotalSalary('+Convert(nvarchar(4),Year(@FilterStartdate))+'-'+Convert(nvarchar(4),Year(@FilterEnddate))+')],
YearTaxableIncome TotalAmountLiableToTaxunderSection21,GrossTaxAmount TaxPayableOntheAmountInColumn13,
TotalPFWPPFInsurence EligibleAmount,TotalLowerRebateAmount AmountofTaxCredit,NetTaxPayable NetAmountofTaxPayable,
TotalPaidTax TaxDeducted,TotalPaidTax TaxPaidCredit
from #TempSalaryCertificateForIncomeTaxSection108 t
left join [HR].[StaffRecords] s on s.EmployeeNo = t.EmpNo
 where t.[IncomeSlab] =''First''

	) tbl  
	ORDER BY EmpNo
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

'
 exec(@Query)

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateYearly]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
