-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateYearly] '2023-07-01' ,'2024-06-30', '9C299ABE-3713-4B4F-8911-E39A9756E786'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateYearly]
	--@Month int,
	--@year int,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmpId uniqueidentifier

AS
BEGIN
	
	
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempSpGetSalaryCertificateYearly
Create table #TempSpGetSalaryCertificateYearly
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[TotalDeduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2)
)

DECLARE @CalCurrentDate date
set @CalCurrentDate = @FilterStartDate

 ----------------while @CalCurrentDate <= @FilterEndDate
 ----------------BEGIN
		DECLARE @month int 
		DECLARE @year int
		select @month = MONTH(@CalCurrentDate)
		select @year  = year(@CalCurrentDate)
/*
insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
)

		exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,0,@EmpId

		print @CalCurrentDate
		select @CalCurrentDate = DATEADD(Month,1,@CalCurrentDate)
--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,0,@EmpId
*/
			insert into #TempSpGetSalaryCertificateYearly
				Select 
					Id EmployeeId, EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,'' Dept, Designation, JoiningDate,ServiceNature, '' PymentMode,
					isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
					isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) [HouseRent],
					isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) [Medical],
					isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00) [Conveyance],
					isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00) + ISNULL(SUM(OtherAllowance),0) [OtherAllow],
					isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00) [SpecialAllowance],
					isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) +
					isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00)

					 [TotalSalary],
					 isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00) [OverTime],
					 isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [FestivalBonus],
					 isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00) [IncomeTax],
					  isnull(sum(GrossPay),0.00)  [GrossTotal],
					 isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) [ProvidentFund],
						0 TotalDeductCount ,
						0 TotalMonthlyHour ,
						isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00) [LWP],
						isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00)	OthersTotalDeduc, -- [OtherDeduction],
						0	TotalLWPAmount ,
						0	PunishmentAmount ,
						0	AdvancePaid ,
						isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00) [ArrearSalary],
						0	[TotalPayableSalary],
						isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) + isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00)+isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00)+isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction],
						isnull(sum([NetPayble]),0.00)+isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [NetPayble],
						0	PaidAmount,
						isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00) [OtherAllowance]

					

					
					
					
					
					

					
							from 
					(

								select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								app.Basic Basic, app.HouseRent HouseRent, app.MedAllowance Medical, app.Conveyence Conveyance,
								app.OtherAllowance OtherAllow,
								app.GTotal GrossPay,
								app.Allowance OtherAllowance, app.Overtime OverTime,app.SpecialAllowance SpecialAllowance,
								app.Arrear ArrearSalary,
								app.FestivalBonus FestivalBonus,
								app.PF ProvidentFund, app.IncomeTax IncomeTax, app.LWP LWP, app.OthersDeduction OtherDeduction,
								app.NetPayable NetPayble


						from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
							where 
							convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
							and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
							and (s.Id = @EmpId) 

							union all

								select s.id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
								0 OtherAllow,
								0 GrossPay,
								0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
								0 ArrearSalary,
								app.BonusAmount FestivalBonus,
								0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
								0 NetPay


								from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
				
								where 
								convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
								and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
								and (s.Id = @EmpId)


								union all

								select s.id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
								0 OtherAllow,
								0 GrossPay,
								0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
								0 ArrearSalary,
								(
									select max(basic) from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets aa
									where aa.StaffRecordId = s.Id
									and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),aa.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),aa.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
								) *2.5
								FestivalBonus,
								0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
								0 NetPay


								from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								where 
								@FilterStartDate  > '2023-6-30'
								and (s.Id = @EmpId)



			)T
			Group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,JoiningDate,ServiceNature,Designation,Id
---------End

select 
EmployeeId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature [ServiceNature],
PaymentMode,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,
isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([TotalDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,
isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount 
from #TempSpGetSalaryCertificateYearly
group by DeptName,EmployeeId,EmployeeName,Designation,EmployeeNo,DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,PaymentMode 
order by DeptName desc

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateYearlyEmployeeWise]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO







--Order: 1.datefrom [date], 2.dateto [date], 3.year [int], 4.month [int], 5.UserID [Guid], 6. TenantId [int], 7. StaffrecordId [Guid], 8. HrDeptId [int],9. HrSubDeptId [int] 10. FestivalId [int]

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateYearlyEmployeeWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryCertificateYearlyEmployeeWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--	@Month int,
--	@year int,
--	@EmpId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	print ''

Declare @FilterStartDate date
Declare @FilterEndDate date
Declare @EmployeeId uniqueidentifier
		

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
Select @EmployeeId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

	select(

			Select 
	EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,JoiningDate,ServiceNature,Designation,
	isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
	isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) [HouseRent],
	isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) [Medical],
	isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00) [LwpDayCount],
	isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00) + ISNULL(SUM(OtherAllowance),0) [OtherAllow],

	isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00)
	[GrossPay],

	isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00) [OtherAllowance],
	isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00) [OverTime],
	isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00) [SpecialAllowance],
	isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00) [ArrearSalary],
	isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [FestivalBonus],

	--isnull(sum([GrossPay]),0.00)+
	--isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00)+
	---isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00)+
	--isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance])+
	--isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00)+
	--isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00)
	isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) +
	isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00)+
	isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00)

	 [TotalPayableSalary],

	isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) [ProvidentFund],
	isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00) [IncomeTax],
	isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00) [LWP],
	isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00) [OtherDeduction],
	isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) + isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00)+isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00)+isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction],
	isnull(sum([NetPayble]),0.00)+isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [NetPayble]


			from 
					(

				select s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
				s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
				dg.Name Designation,

				app.Basic Basic, app.HouseRent HouseRent, app.MedAllowance Medical, app.Conveyence Conveyance,
				app.OtherAllowance OtherAllow,
				app.GTotal GrossPay,
				app.Allowance OtherAllowance, app.Overtime OverTime,app.SpecialAllowance SpecialAllowance,
				app.Arrear ArrearSalary,
				app.FestivalBonus FestivalBonus,
				app.PF ProvidentFund, app.IncomeTax IncomeTax, app.LWP LWP, app.OthersDeduction OtherDeduction,
				app.NetPayable NetPayble


		from hr.StaffRecords s
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
			where 
			convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
			and (s.Id = @EmployeeId) 

			union all

			select s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
				s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
				dg.Name Designation,

				0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
				0 OtherAllow,
				0 GrossPay,
				0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
				0 ArrearSalary,
				app.BonusAmount FestivalBonus,
				0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
				0 NetPay


				from hr.StaffRecords s
				join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
				join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
				join Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
				
				where 
				convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
				and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
				and (s.Id = @EmployeeId)



			)T
			Group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,JoiningDate,ServiceNature,Designation

			FOR JSON AUTO) As Data 
		



END

-- Exec  [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryDeductionStatement]  8, 2022, 6, 2023,''

CREATE PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryDeductionStatement]
	@FilterStartMonth int,
	@FilterStartYear int,
	@FilterEndMonth int,
	@FilterEndYear int,

	@EmpName nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN

	--DECLARE @LadDayofMonth date 
	--select @LadDayofMonth =EOMONTH(@LastDayofMonth)
	--print @LastDayofMonth

	DEclare @FilterStartDate date
	Declare @FilterStartDateTemp nvarchar(50)

	DEclare @FilterEndtDate date
	Declare @FilterEndDateTemp nvarchar(50)

	select @FilterStartDateTemp = convert(varchar(20),@FilterStartYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(20),@FilterStartMonth)+'-01'
	select @FilterStartDate = convert(date,@FilterStartDateTemp)

	select @FilterEndDateTemp = convert(varchar(20),@FilterEndYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(20),@FilterEndMonth)+'-01'
	select @FilterEndtDate = EOMONTH(convert(date,@FilterEndDateTemp))

	--select @FilterStartDate FilterStart,@FilterEndtDate FilterEnd

	select 
	IdNo,EmpName,JoinDate,T.Designation,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalMobilebill),0.00) TotalMobilebill,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalOthersBill),0.00) TotalOthersBill,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalFoodBill),0.00) TotalFoodBill,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalAdvanceSalary),0.00) TotalAdvanceSalary,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalLWP),0.00) TotalLWP,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalSM),0.00) TotalSM,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),AIT),0.00) AIT,
	isnull(convert(decimal(12,2),TotalMobilebill+TotalOthersBill+TotalFoodBill+TotalAdvanceSalary+TotalLWP+TotalSM+AIT),0.00) [Total]
	from 
		(
		select e.EmployeeNo IdNo, e.EmployeeName EmpName,e.JoiningDate JoinDate, dg.Name Designation, 
		--ed.MobileBill MobileBill, ed.Others OthersBill,ed.FoodBill FoodBill,ed.AdvanceSalary AdvanceSalary,ed.Lwp LWP,ed.SM SM,
		(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) [TotalMonth],
	
		sum(ed.MobileBill) TotalMobilebill,
		sum(ed.Others) TotalOthersBill,
		sum(ed.FoodBill) TotalFoodBill,
		sum(ed.AdvanceSalary) TotalAdvanceSalary,
		--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.MobileBill TotalMobilebill,
		--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.Others TotalOthersBill,
		--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.FoodBill TotalFoodBill,
		--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.AdvanceSalary TotalAdvanceSalary,
		0 TotalLWP,
		0 TotalSM,
		sum(ed.AIT) AIT
		from hr.StaffRecords e 
		join hr.LeavePolicies h on h.StaffRecordId=e.Id
		join hr.Departments d on d.Id=e.DeptId
		join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=e.DesignationId
		join Payroll.IndividualSalaries s on s.EmployeeId=e.Id
		join Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions ed on ed.StaffRecordId=e.Id
		where 
		--e.JoiningDate>=@FilterStartDate and e.JoiningDate<=@FilterEndtDate
		--and 
		(e.EmployeeName=@EmpName or @EmpName='')
		group by e.EmployeeNo, e.EmployeeName,e.JoiningDate,dg.Name--,s.PF,ed.MobileBill,ed.Others,ed.FoodBill,ed.AdvanceSalary,ed.Lwp,ed.SM
	)T
	--group by IdNo,EmpName,JoinDate,T.Designation
	--return

	--select e.EmployeeNo IdNo, e.EmployeeName EmpName,e.JoiningDate JoinDate, dg.Name Designation, 
	--ed.MobileBill MobileBill, ed.Others OthersBill,ed.FoodBill FoodBill,ed.AdvanceSalary AdvanceSalary,ed.Lwp LWP,ed.SM,
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) [TotalMonth],
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.MobileBill TotalMobilebill,
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.Others TotalOthersBill,
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.FoodBill TotalFoodBill,
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.AdvanceSalary TotalAdvanceSalary,
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.Lwp TotalLWP,
	--(DATEDIFF(M,convert(date,e.JoiningDate),convert(date,getdate()))+1) * ed.SM TotalSM
	--from EmployeeInfoes e 
	--join HRPolicies h on h.EmployeeId=e.EmployeeId
	--join EmpDepartments d on d.DeptId=e.DeptId
	--join EmpDesignations dg on dg.DesignationId=e.DesignationId
	--join HRSalaryPolicy s on s.EmployeeId=e.EmployeeId
	--join EmployeeSalaryDeductions ed on ed.EmployeeId=e.EmployeeId
	----where 
	----e.JoiningDate>=@FilterStartDate and e.JoiningDate<=@LastDayofMonth
	----and 
	----(s.EmployeeId=@EmpId or @EmpId=0)
	--group by e.EmployeeNo, e.EmployeeName,e.JoiningDate,dg.Name,s.PF,ed.MobileBill,ed.Others,ed.FoodBill,ed.AdvanceSalary,ed.Lwp,ed.SM
	END
GO

		and sss.Id =e.Id

 ),
 --DateDiff(Day,e.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(e.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, e.JoiningDate)))+1,
isnull((
 select sum(d.Lwp) as LwpDayCount
 from Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions d 
 where d.StaffRecordId=@EmpId 
 and
 d.year=@year and
 d.month=@Month
 ),0),

 isnull((
 select sum(i.TotalInrementedAmount) from Payroll.IncrementRecords i 
	where i.StaffRecordId = e.Id
	and i.Month = @Month
	and i.Year = @year
 ),0.00) LastIncrementAmount,

 	isnull((
		select  ap.GTotal from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=e.Id
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0.00)GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem,

	round(t.OtherAllowance,0) OtherAllowance


from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets t
join HR.StaffRecords e on e.id = t.StaffRecordId
join HR.Departments ed on e.DeptId=ed.Id
join HR.Designations de on e.DesignationId=de.Id
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId 

where 
	t.SalaryMonth = @month
and t.SalaryYear = @year
and t.StaffRecordId= @EmpId

select 
EmployeeId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature ,
PaymentMode,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,
isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([Total Deduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,

isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount,
isnull(ArrearDayCount,0) ArrearDayCount,
isnull(LwpDayCount,0) LwpDayCount,
isnull(sum(LastIncrementAmount),0.00) LastIncermentAmount,
isnull(sum(GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem),0)GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem,
isnull(sum(OtherAllowance),0)OtherAllowance
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
group by DeptName,EmployeeId,EmployeeName,Designation,EmployeeNo,DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature,PaymentMode,ArrearDayCount,LwpdayCount
order by DeptName desc

END

-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlip] 11 ,2022,'C0E0C5EB-684D-4A40-95E8-9A1241BEC10B'
--Order: datefrom,dateto,year,month,StaffrecordId,HrDeptId,HrSubDeptId,OPDServiceGroupId,OPDServiceHeadId
-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipDynamic] '11/11/2022 12:00:00 AM,11/11/2022 12:00:00 AM,2022,11,C0E0C5EB-684D-4A40-95E8-9A1241BEC10B,0,0,0,0,'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	--@Month int,
	--@year int,
	--@EmpId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	print ''


Declare @Month int
Declare @year int
Declare @EmpId uniqueidentifier

Select @year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
Select @Month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
Select @EmpId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier, T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5


DECLARE @LastMonth date
	DECLARE @FirstDayofthisMonth date

	set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')

	select @LastMonth = DATEADD(Month,-1,@FirstDayofthisMonth)




DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,

PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),

Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),

ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),

PaidAmount decimal(12,2),

LwpDayCount int,
LastIncrementAmount decimal(12,2),
GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem decimal(12,2)
)

insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature ,
PaymentMode,
[Basic] ,
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,

PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp ,
OthersTotalDeduc ,

PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[Total Deduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
ArrearDayCount,
LwpDayCount,
LastIncrementAmount,
GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem

)

--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,0,@EmpId

select 
StaffRecordId EmployeeId ,
e.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,
e.EmployeeName EmployeeName ,
ed.Name DeptName ,
de.Name Designation ,
e.JoiningDate DateOfJoining  ,
e.ServiceNature ServiceNature ,
t.PaymentMode PaymentMode,
round([Basic],0) ,
round(HouseRent,0) ,
round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0) ,
round(Conveyance,0) ,
round(t.Allowance,0) OthersAllowance,
round(t.SpecialAllowance,0) SpecialAllowance,
round(t.GTotal,0) GTotalSalary ,
round(overtime,0) ,
round(FestivalBonus,0),
--OthersAllowance,
round(IncomeTax,0),
round(GTotal,0) GrossTotal ,
round(t.PF,0) ,
0 TotalDeductCount ,
0 TotalMonthlyHour ,
round(Lwp,0) ,
--t.OthersDeduction OthersTotalDeduc ,
--convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.LWP,0.00),0))+
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Punishment,0.00),0)) OthersTotalDeduc,
round(t.Lwp,0) TotalLWPAmount ,
round(t.Punishment,0) PunishmentAmount ,
round(t.Advance,0) AdvancePaid , 
round(t.Arrear,0)  ArrearSalary,
convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round([Basic],0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(HouseRent,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,0.00),0)) 
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(Conveyance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Allowance,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.SpecialAllowance,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Arrear,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.overtime,0.00),0))
+ convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.FestivalBonus,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) 
[TotalPayableSalary],

convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.LWP,0.00),0))+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.Punishment,0.00),0))
+convert(decimal(12,2),isnull(round(t.PF,0.00),0))
+ 
--convert(decimal(12,2),0.00 ) --IncomeTax
--+ isnull([TotalLWPAmount],0.00)
isnull(round((
select case when NetTaxPayablePerMonth >0.00 then  NetTaxPayablePerMonth else 0.00 end 
from Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i
where i.EmployeeId = StaffRecordId
and i.TaxYear = @year
and i.taxMonth = @month
),0.00),0) 
[TotalDeduction],

t.NetPayable NetPayble ,
 0 PaidAmount,
 (
 
 select DateDiff(Day,e.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(e.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, e.JoiningDate)))+1
from hr.StaffRecords sss
left join [Payroll].[IncrementRecords] eee
		on eee.StaffRecordId = sss.Id
	where 
	---123456


		--datediff(Month,s.joiningdate,@FirstDayofthisMonth) = 14
		------------------MONTH(sss.JoiningDate) = ( @Month -1) and year(sss.joiningdate) <>  @Year
		--and eee.StaffRecordId is null
		--and sss.IsInActive='False'
		MONTH(sss.JoiningDate) =Month ( @LastMonth) and year(sss.joiningdate) <>  Year ( @LastMonth)
		and sss.Id =e.Id

 ),
 --DateDiff(Day,e.JoiningDate,DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(e.JoiningDate)), DATEADD(MM, 1, e.JoiningDate)))+1,
isnull((
 select sum(d.Lwp) as LwpDayCount
 from Payroll.StaffSalaryDeductions d 
 where d.StaffRecordId=@EmpId 
 and
 d.year=@year and
 d.month=@Month
 ),0),
 isnull((
 select sum(i.TotalInrementedAmount) from Payroll.IncrementRecords i 
	where i.StaffRecordId = e.Id
	and i.Month = @Month
	and i.Year = @year
 ),0.00) LastIncrementAmount,

 	isnull((
		select  ap.GTotal from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets ap where ap.StaffRecordId=e.Id
		and ap.SalaryYear = Year(@LastMonth) and ap.SalaryMonth = Month(@LastMonth)
	),0.00)GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem


from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets t
join HR.StaffRecords e on e.id = t.StaffRecordId
join HR.Departments ed on e.DeptId=ed.Id
join HR.Designations de on e.DesignationId=de.Id
join Payroll.IndividualSalaries po on e.Id=po.EmployeeId 

where 
	t.SalaryMonth = @month
and t.SalaryYear = @year
and t.StaffRecordId= @EmpId

select(

select 
EmployeeId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature ,
PaymentMode,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,
isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([Total Deduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,

isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount,
isnull(ArrearDayCount,0) ArrearDayCount,
isnull(LwpDayCount,0) LwpDayCount,
isnull(sum(LastIncrementAmount),0.00) LastIncermentAmount,
isnull(sum(GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem),0)GrossSalaryBeforeIncrem
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
group by DeptName,EmployeeId,EmployeeName,Designation,EmployeeNo,DateOfJoining  ,
ServiceNature,PaymentMode,ArrearDayCount,LwpdayCount
order by DeptName desc
FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipForIncomeTax]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipForIncomeTax] '2022-10-01','2024-01-29','D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipForIncomeTax]
	--@Month int,
	--@year int,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmpId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	print ''


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[TotalDeduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2)
)


 DECLARE @CalCurrentDate date
 set @CalCurrentDate = @FilterStartDate

 --while @CalCurrentDate <= @FilterEndDate
 --BEGIN
		DECLARE @month int 
		DECLARE @year int
		select @month = MONTH(@CalCurrentDate)
		select @year  = year(@CalCurrentDate)
		
		insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
		(
		EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance
		)

		Select 
					Id EmployeeId, EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,'' Dept, Designation, JoiningDate,ServiceNature, '' PymentMode,
					isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
					isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) [HouseRent],
					isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) [Medical],
					isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00) [Conveyance],
					isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00) [OtherAllow],
					isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00) [SpecialAllowance],
					isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) +
					isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00)

					 [TotalSalary],
					 isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00) [OverTime],
					 isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [FestivalBonus],
					 isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00) [IncomeTax],
					  isnull(sum(GrossPay),0.00)  [GrossTotal],
					 isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) [ProvidentFund],
						0 TotalDeductCount ,
						0 TotalMonthlyHour ,
						isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00) [LWP],
						isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00)	OthersTotalDeduc, -- [OtherDeduction],
						0	TotalLWPAmount ,
						0	PunishmentAmount ,
						0	AdvancePaid ,
						isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00) [ArrearSalary],
						0	[TotalPayableSalary],
						isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) + isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00)+isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00)+isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction],
						isnull(sum([NetPayble]),0.00)+isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [NetPayble],
						0	PaidAmount,
						isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00) [OtherAllowance]

					

					
					
					
					
					

					
							from 
					(

								select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								app.Basic Basic, app.HouseRent HouseRent, app.MedAllowance Medical, app.Conveyence Conveyance,
								app.OtherAllowance OtherAllow,
								app.GTotal GrossPay,
								app.Allowance OtherAllowance, app.Overtime OverTime,app.SpecialAllowance SpecialAllowance,
								app.Arrear ArrearSalary,
								app.FestivalBonus FestivalBonus,
								app.PF ProvidentFund, app.IncomeTax IncomeTax, app.LWP LWP, app.OthersDeduction OtherDeduction,
								app.NetPayable NetPayble


						from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
							where 
							convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
							and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
							and (s.Id = @EmpId) 

							union all

							select s.id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
								0 OtherAllow,
								0 GrossPay,
								0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
								0 ArrearSalary,
								app.BonusAmount FestivalBonus,
								0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
								0 NetPay


								from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
				
								where 
								convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
								and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
								and (s.Id = @EmpId)

								union all

								select s.id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
								0 OtherAllow,
								0 GrossPay,
								0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
								0 ArrearSalary,
								(
									select max(basic) from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets aa
									where aa.StaffRecordId = s.Id
									and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),aa.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),aa.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
								) *2.5
								FestivalBonus,
								0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
								0 NetPay


								from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								where 
								@FilterStartDate  > '2023-6-30'
								and (s.Id = @EmpId)

			)T
			Group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,JoiningDate,ServiceNature,Designation,Id
		
		--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 1,1,0,'D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71'
		--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,0,@EmpId

		--print @CalCurrentDate
		--select @CalCurrentDate = DATEADD(Month,1,@CalCurrentDate)
		
		--select * from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
-- END

 
		

select 
EmployeeId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature [ServiceNature],
PaymentMode,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,
isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([TotalDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,

isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
group by DeptName,EmployeeId,EmployeeName,Designation,EmployeeNo,DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature,PaymentMode
order by DeptName desc

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipForIncomeTax_108Return]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipForIncomeTax] '2022-10-01','2024-01-29','D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetSalaryPaySlipForIncomeTax_108Return]
	--@Month int,
	--@year int,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmpId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	print ''


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary

Create table #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
(
Autoid bigint identity(1,1),
EmployeeId uniqueidentifier,
EmployeeNo nvarchar(50),
EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
DeptName nvarchar(max),
Designation nvarchar(max),
DateOfJoining date ,
EmployeeNature nvarchar(50),
PaymentMode nvarchar(50),
[Basic] decimal(12,2),
HouseRent decimal(12,2),
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic decimal(12,2),
Conveyance decimal(12,2),
OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
SpecialAllowance decimal(12,2),
TotalSalary decimal(12,2),
overtime decimal(12,2),
FestivalBonus decimal(12,2),
 --OthersAllowance decimal(12,2),
IncomeTax decimal(12,2),
GrossTotal decimal(12,2),
PF decimal(12,2),
TotalDeductCount decimal(12,2),
TotalMonthlyHour decimal(12,2),
Lwp decimal(12,2),
OthersTotalDeduc decimal(12,2),
TotalLWPAmount decimal(12,2),
PunishmentAmount decimal(12,2),
AdvancePaid decimal(12,2),
ArrearSalary decimal(12,2),
[TotalPayableSalary]  decimal(12,2),
[TotalDeduction] decimal(12,2),
NetPayble decimal(12,2),
PaidAmount decimal(12,2),
OtherAllowance decimal(12,2),
TINNO nvarchar(max)
)


 DECLARE @CalCurrentDate date
 set @CalCurrentDate = @FilterStartDate

 --while @CalCurrentDate <= @FilterEndDate
 --BEGIN
		DECLARE @month int 
		DECLARE @year int
		select @month = MONTH(@CalCurrentDate)
		select @year  = year(@CalCurrentDate)
		
		insert into #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
		(
		EmployeeId ,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName ,
DeptName ,
Designation ,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature ,
PaymentMode,

[Basic],
HouseRent ,
MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic,
Conveyance ,
OthersAllowance,
SpecialAllowance,
TotalSalary ,
overtime ,
FestivalBonus,
--OthersAllowance,
IncomeTax,
GrossTotal ,
PF ,
TotalDeductCount ,
TotalMonthlyHour ,
Lwp,
OthersTotalDeduc,
TotalLWPAmount ,
PunishmentAmount ,
AdvancePaid ,
ArrearSalary,
[TotalPayableSalary],
[TotalDeduction],
NetPayble ,
PaidAmount,
OtherAllowance,
TINNO
		)

		Select 
					Id EmployeeId, EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,'' Dept, Designation, JoiningDate,ServiceNature, '' PymentMode,
					isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
					isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) [HouseRent],
					isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) [Medical],
					isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00) [Conveyance],
					isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00) [OtherAllow],
					isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00) [SpecialAllowance],
					isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([Medical]),0.00) +
					isnull(sum([Conveyance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OtherAllow]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([SpecialAllowance]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00)+
					isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00)

					 [TotalSalary],
					 isnull(sum([OverTime]),0.00) [OverTime],
					 isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [FestivalBonus],
					 isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00) [IncomeTax],
					  isnull(sum(GrossPay),0.00)  [GrossTotal],
					 isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) [ProvidentFund],
						0 TotalDeductCount ,
						0 TotalMonthlyHour ,
						isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00) [LWP],
						isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00)	OthersTotalDeduc, -- [OtherDeduction],
						0	TotalLWPAmount ,
						0	PunishmentAmount ,
						0	AdvancePaid ,
						isnull(sum([ArrearSalary]),0.00) [ArrearSalary],
						0	[TotalPayableSalary],
						isnull(sum([ProvidentFund]),0.00) + isnull(sum([IncomeTax]),0.00)+isnull(sum([LWP]),0.00)+isnull(sum([OtherDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction],
						isnull(sum([NetPayble]),0.00)+isnull(sum([FestivalBonus]),0.00) [NetPayble],
						0	PaidAmount,
						isnull(sum([OtherAllowance]),0.00) [OtherAllowance],
						isnull(TINNO,'')TINNO

					

					
					
					
					
					

					
							from 
					(

								select s.Id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								app.Basic Basic, app.HouseRent HouseRent, app.MedAllowance Medical, app.Conveyence Conveyance,
								app.OtherAllowance OtherAllow,
								app.GTotal GrossPay,
								app.Allowance OtherAllowance, app.Overtime OverTime,app.SpecialAllowance SpecialAllowance,
								app.Arrear ArrearSalary,
								app.FestivalBonus FestivalBonus,
								app.PF ProvidentFund, app.IncomeTax IncomeTax, app.LWP LWP, app.OthersDeduction OtherDeduction,
								app.NetPayable NetPayble,
								s.TINNo


						from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
							where 
							convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
							and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
							and (s.Id = @EmpId OR @EmpId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') 

							union all

							select s.id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
								0 OtherAllow,
								0 GrossPay,
								0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
								0 ArrearSalary,
								app.BonusAmount FestivalBonus,
								0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
								0 NetPay, TINNo


								from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								join Payroll.AprovedFestivalBonuses app on app.StaffRecordId=s.Id
				
								where 
								convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
								and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.BonusYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.BonusMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
								and (s.Id = @EmpId OR @EmpId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

								union all

								select s.id, s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo,s.EmployeeName EmployeeName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
								s.ServiceNature ServiceNature,
								dg.Name Designation,

								0 [Basic], 0 HouseRent, 0 Medical, 0 Conveyance,
								0 OtherAllow,
								0 GrossPay,
								0 OtherAllowance, 0 OverTime,0 SpecialAllowance,
								0 ArrearSalary,
								(
									select max(basic) from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets aa
									where aa.StaffRecordId = s.Id
									and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),aa.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),aa.SalaryMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
								) *2.5
								FestivalBonus,
								0 ProvidentFund, 0 IncomeTax, 0 LWP, 0 OtherDeduction,
								0 NetPay,
								TINNO


								from hr.StaffRecords s
								join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
								join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
								where 
								@FilterStartDate  > '2023-6-30'
								and (s.Id = @EmpId OR @EmpId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

			)T
			Group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,JoiningDate,ServiceNature,Designation,Id,TINNO
		
		--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] 1,1,0,'D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71'
		--exec [Payroll].[spGetHrSalarySheet] @month,@year,0,@EmpId

		--print @CalCurrentDate
		--select @CalCurrentDate = DATEADD(Month,1,@CalCurrentDate)
		
		--select * from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
-- END

 
		

select 
EmployeeId,
EmployeeNo,
EmployeeName,
DeptName,
Designation,
DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature [ServiceNature],
PaymentMode,
isnull(sum([Basic]),0.00) [Basic],
isnull(sum(HouseRent),0.00) HouseRent ,
isnull(sum(MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic),0.00) MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic ,
isnull(sum(Conveyance),0.00) Conveyance ,
isnull(sum(OthersAllowance),0.00) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum(SpecialAllowance),0.00) SpecialAllowance,
isnull(sum(TotalSalary),0.00) TotalSalary ,
isnull(sum(overtime),0.00) overtime ,
isnull(sum(FestivalBonus),0.00) FestivalBonus ,
--sum(OthersAllowance) OthersAllowance,
isnull(sum (IncomeTax),0.00)IncomeTax,
isnull(sum(GrossTotal),0.00) GrossTotal ,
isnull(sum(PF),0.00) PF ,
isnull(sum(TotalDeductCount),0.00) TotalDeductCount ,
isnull(sum(TotalMonthlyHour),0.00) TotalMonthlyHour ,
isnull(sum(Lwp),0.00) Lwp ,
isnull(sum(OthersTotalDeduc),0.00) OthersTotalDeduc ,
isnull(sum(TotalLWPAmount),0.00) TotalLWPAmount ,
isnull(sum(PunishmentAmount),0.00) PunishmentAmount ,
isnull(sum(AdvancePaid),0.00) AdvancePaid ,
isnull(sum(ArrearSalary),0.00) ArrearSalary ,
isnull(sum([TotalPayableSalary]),0.00) [TotalPayableSalary] ,
isnull(sum([TotalDeduction]),0.00) [TotalDeduction] ,

isnull(sum(NetPayble),0.00) NetPayble,
isnull(sum(PaidAmount),0.00) PaidAmount,
TINNO
from #TempspGetHrSalarySheet_DeptWise_Summary
group by DeptName,EmployeeId,EmployeeName,Designation,EmployeeNo,DateOfJoining  ,
EmployeeNature,PaymentMode,TINNO
order by DeptName desc

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[spGetSalaryStopEmployee]
	-- exec [Payroll].[spGetSalaryStopEmployee] 6, 2022
	@Month int,
	@year int
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT        e.id, e.EmployeeName, d.Name AS DepartMentName,
	s.SalaryStopMonth, s.SalaryStopYear, 
                         convert(decimal(12,2),i.TotalSalary) TotalSalary
FROM            HR.StaffRecords e
INNER JOIN
                         Payroll.EmployeeSalaryStops s ON s.StaffRecordId = e.Id
						 INNER JOIN
                         hr.Departments d on d.Id = e.DeptId 
						 left JOIN
                        Payroll.IndividualSalaries i ON i.EmployeeId = e.Id

						 where s.SalaryStopMonth=@Month and s.SalaryStopYear=@year
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Payroll].[SpGetStaffGlobalLedgerByDates]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- =============================================

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetStaffGlobalLedgerByDates] '2023-07-07','2023-09-20'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetStaffGlobalLedgerByDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime
AS
BEGIN
	select tbl.StaffRecordId,tbl.ServiceUnitId,tbl.DueAmount,sr.EmployeeNo,sr.EmployeeName,isnull(su.DepartmentId,0) DepartmentId,d.Name DeptName
	 from
	    (
			select gl.StaffRecordId,gl.ServiceUnitId,convert(real,SUM(gl.Debit-gl.Credit)) DueAmount
			from [Payroll].[StaffGlobalLedgers] gl
			where convert(date, gl.CreatedOn)>=convert(date,@DateFrom) and convert(date,gl.CreatedOn)<=convert(date,@DateTo)
			group by gl.StaffRecordId,gl.ServiceUnitId
		) tbl inner join
		[HR].[StaffRecords] sr on tbl.StaffRecordId=sr.Id inner join
		[Admin].[ServiceUnits] su on tbl.ServiceUnitId=su.Id inner join
		[Admin].[Departments] d on su.DepartmentId=d.Id
	order by su.DepartmentId
END
GO

-- =============================================

--exec [Payroll].[SpGetStaffGlobalLedgerDetailByEmpId] 'B59DC248-EE02-443D-8716-003DD1E89D8C','3'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetStaffGlobalLedgerDetailByEmpId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StaffRecordId uniqueidentifier,
	@DeptId int
AS
BEGIN
	
	select i.InvoiceNo,i.Invdate,gl.Particulars,gl.Debit,gl.Credit,gl.Balance
	  from [Payroll].[StaffGlobalLedgers] gl inner join
		   [Admin].[ServiceUnits] su on gl.ServiceUnitId=su.Id inner join
		   [Admin].[Departments] d on su.DepartmentId=d.Id inner join
		   [Pharmacy].[Invoices] i on gl.ReferranceId=i.Id
	 where gl.StaffRecordId=@StaffRecordId and su.DepartmentId=@DeptId
	 order by i.InvoiceNo
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
---------------exec [Payroll].[SpGetTaxMonthlyStatement] 2023,08,0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetTaxMonthlyStatement]
	@Year int,
	@Month int,
	@DeptId int
AS
BEGIN
Select 'TAX Deduction' Head,s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
dg.Name Designation,isnull(s.TINNo,'') TINNo,
round(i.NetTaxPayablePerMonth,0) Amount,i.TaxMonth TaxMonth
 from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	----join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a on a.StaffRecordId=s.id
	 join Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i on i.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where 
	i.TaxYear=@Year
	and 
	i.TaxMonth=@Month
	and (d.Id=@DeptId or @DeptId=0)
	and i.NetTaxPayablePerMonth>0
	and s.IsInActive='False'
	---and s.EmployeeNo <>'PH03612'
	order by s.EmployeeNo
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
---------------exec [Payroll].[SpGetTaxMonthlyStatement] 2022,10,0
-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetTaxMonthlyStatementDynamic] '11/11/2022 12:00:00 AM,11/11/2022 12:00:00 AM,2022,11,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0,'
--Order: datefrom,dateto,year,month,StaffrecordId,HrDeptId,HrSubDeptId,OPDServiceGroupId,OPDServiceHeadId

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetTaxMonthlyStatementDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--	@Year int,
--	@Month int,
--	@DeptId int
AS
BEGIN

Declare @Month int
Declare @Year int
Declare @DeptId int

Select @Year=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
Select @Month=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
Select @DeptId=  Convert(int,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=6

select ( select * from(
	Select 'TAX Deduction' Head,s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmployeeName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate, dg.Name Designation,
	round(i.NetTaxPayablePerMonth,0) Amount,i.TaxMonth TaxMonth
	 from hr.StaffRecords s
		join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
		join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
		-----join Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a on a.StaffRecordId=s.id
		 join Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i on i.EmployeeId=s.Id
		where 
		i.TaxYear=@Year
		and 
		i.TaxMonth=@Month
		and (d.Id=@DeptId or @DeptId=0)
		and i.NetTaxPayablePerMonth<>0
		and s.IsInActive='False' 
		---and s.EmployeeNo <>'PH03612'
		)
		tbl order by tbl.EmpCode FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

----------exec [Payroll].[SpGetTaxYearlyStatementEmployeeWise] '2022-01-01','2022-11-01','ph01147'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetTaxYearlyStatementEmployeeWise]
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN

		
		--set @FirstDayofthisMonth =convert(date,convert(varchar(4),@year)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),@month)+'-01')
		--SELECT @LastDayofthisMOnth = DATEADD(DD,-(DAY(@FirstDayofthisMonth)), DATEADD(MM, 1, @FirstDayofthisMonth))

		select @FilterStartDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),year(@FilterStartDate))+'-'+convert(varchar(2),month(@FilterStartDate))+'-01')

Select 'PSHL' Unit, 'TAX Deduction' Head, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,dg.Name Designation,
Convert(varchar(10),  DATENAME(month, DATEADD( month , i.TaxMonth, -1 ))) 
+ ',' +convert(varchar(4),i.TaxYear) TAXMonth
 ,round(i.NetTaxPayablePerMonth,0) Amount
 --,app.id
 --,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01')

 from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i on i.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where 
		convert(date,convert(varchar(4),i.TaxYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),i.TaxMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),i.TaxYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),i.TaxMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
	and (s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo)

	order by i.TaxMonth


	--app.SalaryYear >= YEAR(@FilterStartDate)
	--and app.SalaryYear >= YEAR(@FilterEndDate)
	
	
END

-- EXEC [Payroll].[SpGetTaxYearlyStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic] '1/1/2022 12:00:00 AM,11/11/2024 12:00:00 AM,2022,11,D1BE27C0-DBE2-4E98-BC08-F6DA88CBCF71,0,0,0,0,'
--Order: datefrom,dateto,year,month,StaffrecordId,HrDeptId,HrSubDeptId,OPDServiceGroupId,OPDServiceHeadId

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpGetTaxYearlyStatementEmployeeWiseDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--	@FilterStartDate date,
--	@FilterEndDate date,
--	@EmployeeNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN

Declare @FilterStartDate date
Declare @FilterEndDate date
Declare @EmployeeId uniqueidentifier

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
Select @EmployeeId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

select @FilterStartDate = convert(date,convert(varchar(4),year(@FilterStartDate))+'-'+convert(varchar(2),month(@FilterStartDate))+'-01')

select(
	select * from(

Select 'PSHL' Unit, 'TAX Deduction' Head, s.EmployeeNo EmpCode, s.EmployeeName EmpName,convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,dg.Name Designation,
Convert(varchar(10),  DATENAME(month, DATEADD( month , i.TaxMonth, -1 ))) 
+ ',' +convert(varchar(4),i.TaxYear) TAXMonth
 ,round(i.NetTaxPayablePerMonth,0) Amount
 --,app.id
 --,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),app.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),app.SalaryMonth)+'-01')

 from hr.StaffRecords s
	join hr.Departments d on d.Id=s.DeptId
	join hr.Designations dg on dg.Id=s.DesignationId
	join Payroll.IndividualSalariesIncomeTax i on i.EmployeeId=s.Id
	where 
		convert(date,convert(varchar(4),i.TaxYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),i.TaxMonth)+'-01') >=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,convert(varchar(4),i.TaxYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),i.TaxMonth)+'-01') <=@FilterEndDate
	and (s.Id = @EmployeeId)

	--order by i.TaxMonth
	) tbl  
	order by tbl.TAXMonth
	FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data



END

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- Exec [Payroll].[SpInsertToApproveSalarySheet] null

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Payroll].[SpInsertToApproveSalarySheet]
@UserID uniqueidentifier -- 'E1CDED7E-5A1C-423C-AD27-00772E41DB36'
AS
BEGIN
			
			DECLARE @CurrentMonth int
			DECLARE @CurrentYear int

			select @CurrentMonth = max(t.SalaryMonth) from [Payroll].[MonthlyHrSalarySheet] t
			select @CurrentYear = max(t.SalaryYear) from [Payroll].[MonthlyHrSalarySheet] t

			DECLARE @ISCommitCount int =0

			select @ISCommitCount= count(a.Id) from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] a
			where 	a.SalaryYear = @CurrentYear
				and a.SalaryMonth = @CurrentMonth
				and a.IsCommit =1
				

				if @ISCommitCount >0
				begin
					select 0
					return
				end
			delete from [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets] 
			where id in 
			(
				SELECT a.Id FROM [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets]  a
				--join [Payroll].[MonthlyHrSalarySheet] m 
				where 	a.SalaryYear = @CurrentYear
				and a.SalaryMonth = @CurrentMonth
				and @ISCommitCount <1 -- required 0 count
				
				--and m.EmployeeId = a.StaffRecordId
			)
	
			INSERT INTO [Payroll].[ApprovedSalarySheets]
           (
		   [StaffRecordId]
           ,[SalaryMonth]
           ,[SalaryYear]
           ,[ApprovalDate]
           
		   ,[Basic]
           ,[HouseRent]
           ,[MedAllowance]
           ,[Conveyence]
           ,[Overtime]
           ,[Allowance]
           ,[SpecialAllowance]
           ,[FestivalBonus]
           ,[GTotal]
          
			,[PF]
			,[OthersDeduction]
			,[LWP]
			,[Punishment]
			,[Advance]
            ,[NetPayable]
           
		   ,[Approvedby]
           ,[PaymentMode]
           ,[CreatedBy]
           ,[CreatedOn]
           ,[LastModifiedBy]
           ,[LastModifiedOn]
    
			,[IsDeleted]
           ,[IncomeTax]
           ,[Arrear]
		   ,[OtherAllowance])

	
  SELECT 
		[EmployeeId]
		,[SalaryMonth]
		,[SalaryYear]
		, getdate()

		,[Basic]
		,[HouseRent]
		,[MedicalAllownceInPercentOfBasic]
		,[Conveyance]
 		,[overtime]
		,[OthersAllowance]
		,[SpecialAllowance]
		,[FestivalBonus]
		,[GrossTotal]
      
	  
		,[PF]
		,[OthersTotalDeduc]
		,[TotalLWPAmount]
		,[PunishmentAmount]
		,[AdvancePaid]
		,[NetPayble]
	
	
		,'admin'
		,m.[PaymentMode]
		,@UserID
		,getdate()
		,@UserID
		,getdate()
      
	  ,0 -- isdeleted
	,[IncomeTax]
	
	,[ArrearSalary]
    , [OtherAllowance]  
     
	FROM [Payroll].[MonthlyHrSalarySheet] m
	join hr.StaffRecords e on e.Id=m.EmployeeId
	where 
	(
	e.IsInActive='False'
	and IsSeparated='False'
	)
	and @ISCommitCount <1 -- required 0 count


  Select Count(EmployeeId) as [Count] from  [Payroll].[MonthlyHrSalarySheet]


END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [PFBook].[GetPfGeneralLedgerById]

AS

	SELECT gl.Id,gl.PFLevel4HeadId,gl.Name,gl.IsSynced,gl.StaffRecordId,sc.Name PfSubCategoryName,c.Name PfNoACategoryName,sr.EmployeeName,sr.EmployeeNo,d.Name DeptName,isnull(sr.IsPFSettled, 0) IsPFSettled,lh.Name PFLevel4HeadName

CREATE     PROCEDURE [PFBook].[GetPFSettlementVoucherDataByDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime
AS
BEGIN

	select vm.Id,sr.Id StaffRecordId,sr.EmployeeNo,sr.EmployeeName,d.Name DeptName
	  from [PFBook].[PFVoucherMasters] vm inner join
		   [PFBook].[PFVoucherMasterDetails] vmd on vm.Id=vmd.VMID inner join
		   [PFBook].[PfGeneralLedgers] gl on vmd.DTLID=gl.Id inner join
		   [HR].[StaffRecords] sr on gl.StaffRecordId=sr.Id left join
		   [HR].[Departments] d on sr.DeptId=d.Id
	 where CONVERT(DATE, vm.VoucherDate) >=CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and  CONVERT(DATE, vm.VoucherDate) <= CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate) and gl.StaffRecordId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and vm.IsPFSettledVoucher=1
END

--exec [PFBook].[GetPFVoucherDataByDate] '2023-04-03','2023-08-05','54C137F5-1A63-4612-C749-08DB356E1E4E'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [PFBook].[GetPFVoucherDataByDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate as datetime ,
	@ToDate as datetime,
	@VMID as uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	select vm.Id VMID,vm.VoucherNo,vm.VoucherDate,vm.VTYPEID,vm.FYearId,vm.REMARKS,vm.PaidTo,vm.TenantId,vm.ServiceUnitId,vm.VoucherMode,vm.RefrenceID
			,vm.IsReversal,sum(vmd.Credit) Credit, sum(vmd.Debit) Debit,vm.ChecqueNo,vm.NameOfBank,vm.SrlNo,vm.IsPFSettledVoucher
	  from [PFBook].[PFVoucherMasters] vm inner join
	       [PFBook].[PFVoucherMasterDetails] vmd on vm.Id=vmd.VMID left join
		   [PFBook].[PfGeneralLedgers] gl on vmd.DTLID=gl.Id
	 where (CONVERT(DATE, vm.VoucherDate)  between  CONVERT(DATE, @FromDate) and CONVERT(DATE, @ToDate) and @VMID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or vm.Id=@VMID
  group by vm.Id,vm.VoucherNo,vm.VoucherDate,vm.VTYPEID,vm.FYearId,vm.REMARKS,vm.PaidTo,vm.TenantId,vm.ServiceUnitId,vm.VoucherMode,vm.RefrenceID,vm.ChecqueNo,vm.NameOfBank,vm.SrlNo,vm.IsPFSettledVoucher
			,vm.IsReversal
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [PFBook].[InsertBankInterestVoucherByInterestAmount] 500000,'1d157541-0bc6-4cc5-b1a6-08db3665327f'

CREATE PROCEDURE [PFBook].[InsertBankInterestVoucherByInterestAmount]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InterestAmount float,
	@MasterId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if(@MasterId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	BEGIN
		return;
	END
	DECLARE @AllStaffPFAmount float
	DECLARE @Toyear int
	select @Toyear = year(getdate())-1
	

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance;

	CREATE TABLE #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance
	(	
		StaffID uniqueidentifier,
		EmployeeNo nvarchar(max),
		EmployeeName nvarchar(max),
		Designation  nvarchar(max),
		Department  nvarchar(max),
		Mobile		nvarchar(max),
		Joiningdate date,
		GrandTotal float
	)
	insert into #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance
	exec [PFBook].[SPGetPFRecordYearWise] '',@Toyear,0,1
	select * from #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance
	
	select @AllStaffPFAmount = sum(t.GrandTotal) from #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance t


	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #StaffPFAmountTbl;
	/*SELECT gl.Id,gl.StaffRecordId,isl.Pf into #StaffPFAmountTbl
	  FROM [PFBook].[PfGeneralLedgers] gl inner join
		   [PFBook].[PFLevel4Heads] lh on gl.PFLevel4HeadId=lh.Id inner join
		   [Payroll].[IndividualSalaries] isl on gl.StaffRecordId=isl.EmployeeId
	 where lh.PfSubCategoryId='94d679f6-5589-4e28-ff30-08db90c060de';
	*/

	



	--declare @InduvidialAmount float;
	--set @InduvidialAmount=(@InterestAmount/(select sum(Pf) from #StaffPFAmountTbl))
	

	declare @AllProductName varchar(max);
	declare @GlId uniqueidentifier;
	declare @PFAmount float;
	DECLARE cursor_emp CURSOR
	FOR
		--select Id,Pf from #StaffPFAmountTbl
		select  gl.Id GlId, (t.GrandTotal * @InterestAmount)/ @AllStaffPFAmount
		from [PFBook].[PfGeneralLedgers] gl
		join #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance t on t.StaffID = gl.StaffRecordId
		group by gl.Id,t.GrandTotal
		OPEN cursor_emp;
		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_emp INTO @GlId,@PFAmount;
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			
			INSERT InTO [PFBook].[PFVoucherMasterDetails] ([Id], [VDID], [DTLID], [SUBDTLID], [Debit], [Credit], [DESCRIPTION], [ServiceUnitId], [SeriveId], [VMID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [LastModifiedBy], [LastModifiedOn], [IsDeleted], [IsSynced]) 
				   --VALUES (NEWID(), N'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', @GlId, 0, 0, round(@InduvidialAmount*@PFAmount, 2), N'Bank Interest distribute to Employee', 0, N'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', @MasterId, NULL, getdate(), NULL, NULL, 0, 0)
				   VALUES (NEWID(), N'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', @GlId, 0, 0, round(@PFAmount, 2), N'Bank Interest distribute to Employee', 0, N'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', @MasterId, NULL, getdate(), NULL, NULL, 0, 0)
			FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_emp INTO @GlId,@PFAmount;
		END

		CLOSE cursor_emp;
		DEALLOCATE cursor_emp;
		select count(StaffID) as [Count] from #TempInsertBankInterestOpeningBalance;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [PFBook].[PFSettlementReportEmployeeWise]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [PFBook].[PFSettlementReportEmployeeWise]
			@EmployeeNo nvarchar(Max),
			@TotalInterest float =0

			-- exec [PFBook].[PFSettlementReportEmployeeWise] 'PH00373'
AS
BEGIN

--with DateYearMonthName AS
--(

select * into #DateYearMonthName from 
(
SELECT 1 MonthID , 'January' MonthName
UNION ALL SELECT 2 , 'February'
UNION ALL SELECT 3 , 'March'
UNION ALL SELECT 4 , 'April'
UNION ALL SELECT 5 , 'May'
UNION ALL SELECT 6 , 'June'
UNION ALL SELECT 7 , 'July'
UNION ALL SELECT 8 , 'August'
UNION ALL SELECT 9 , 'September'
UNION ALL SELECT 10 , 'October'
UNION ALL SELECT 11 , 'November'
UNION ALL SELECT 12 , 'December'
)T
--)


select s.EmployeeNo,
s.EmployeeName,
dg.Name [Designation],
dept.Name [Department],
s.JoiningDate,s.id
into #EmployeeDetails
from hr.StaffRecords s
join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId
where s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo

--select * from #EmployeeDetails
--return


select EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],JoiningDate,YearName, PRYear,
isnull(sum(January),0) January,isnull(sum(February),0) February,isnull(sum(March),0) March,
isnull(sum(April),0) April,isnull(sum(May),0) May,isnull(sum(June),0) June,isnull(sum(July),0) July,
isnull(sum(August),0) August,
isnull(sum(September),0) September,isnull(sum(October),0) October,isnull(sum(November),0) November,isnull(sum(December),0) December,
isnull(sum(January),0) + isnull(sum(February),0) + isnull(sum(March),0) + isnull(sum(April),0) +  isnull(sum(May),0) + isnull(sum(June),0) 
+isnull(sum(July),0) +  isnull(sum(August),0) + isnull(sum(September),0) + isnull(sum(October),0) + isnull(sum(November),0) + 
isnull(sum(December),0)
Yearlytotal
into #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
from 
(
			select *
			from 
			(
			select  s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.[Designation] [Designation],
			s.[Department] [Department],
			s.JoiningDate,
			YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) YearName,
			'Year - '+convert(varchar(4),YEAR(vm.VoucherDate)) PRYear,
			#DateYearMonthName.MonthName [FullMonthNameDisplay],
			#DateYearMonthName.MonthName [FullMonthName],
			case when YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) <2022 then
			CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),(vd.Credit/12))
			when YEAR(vm.VoucherDate)  =2022 and #DateYearMonthName.MonthID <10 then CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),(vd.Credit/09))
			else 0 end MonthWiseAmount,0 Yearlytotal
			from PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers  g
			join #EmployeeDetails s --on s.EmployeeNo = SUBSTRING(g.Name,0, CHARINDEX('-',g.Name))
			on g.StaffRecordId = s.Id
			--join hr.StaffRecords s on s.EmployeeNo = SUBSTRING(g.Name,0, CHARINDEX('-',g.Name))
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasterDetails vd on vd.DTLID = g.Id
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasters vm on (vd.VMID=vm.Id)
			--join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
			--join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId

			cross join #DateYearMonthName
			where --g.id='4A212AD4-57B8-4592-A2D6-0104323B615D'
			--and DTLID='4A212AD4-57B8-4592-A2D6-0104323B615D'
			s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo
			)T
			PIVOT(
				SUM(MonthWiseAmount) 
				FOR FullMonthNameDisplay IN (January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December)
			) AS pivot_table

			union all

			select * from 
			(
			select s.EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.Designation [Designation],
			s.Department [Department],
			s.JoiningDate,
			a.SalaryYear,
			'Year - '+convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear) PRYear,
			DATENAME (Month,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),a.SalaryMonth)+'-1')) FullMonthNameDisplay,
			DATENAME (Month,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),a.SalaryMonth)+'-1')) [FullMonthName],
			a.PF MonthWiseAmount, 0 Yearlytotal
			
			from 
			Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a
			--join hr.StaffRecords s on s.Id = a.StaffRecordId
			--join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
			--join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId
			join #EmployeeDetails s on s.Id = a.StaffRecordId
			)T
			PIVOT(
				SUM(MonthWiseAmount) 
				FOR FullMonthNameDisplay IN (January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December)
			) AS pivot_table
			where EmployeeNo =@EmployeeNo
)TT
group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],JoiningDate,YearName, PRYear

DECLARE @TotalPF float

select @TotalPF=sum(Yearlytotal) from #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
select EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],JoiningDate,YearName, PRYear,@TotalPF [TotalOwnPF],@TotalPF 

[TotalCompanyPF], --@TotalInterest TotalInterest ,
(
round(isnull((
	select sum(v.Credit) from [PFBook].[PFVoucherMasterDetails] v
	join PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers gl on gl.id = v.DTLID
	join hr.StaffRecords ss on ss.id = gl.StaffRecordId
	join [PFBook].[PFLevel4Heads] lh on gl.PFLevel4HeadId=lh.Id
	JOIN [PFBook].PFVoucherMasters VM ON VM.Id = V.VMID
	where ss.EmployeeNo = #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise.EmployeeNo
	and PfSubCategoryId='94d679f6-5589-4e28-ff30-08db90c060de'
	--and year(v.CreatedOn) <= year(getdate())
	and year(v.CreatedOn) <= YearName
	AND  VM.VoucherMode='BI'
 ) ,0),2)

)TotalInterest,
January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December,Yearlytotal

from #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
END
GO

-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [PFBook].[SPGetPFRecordYearWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
			-- exec [PFBook].[SPGetPFRecordYearWise] '2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1'
--Order: 1. datefrom,2. dateto,3. year,4. month,5. StaffrecordId,6. HrDeptId,7. HrSubDeptId,8. OPDServiceGroupId,9. OPDServiceHeadId,10.typeid,11. ConsultantID
--12.@OutletId 13.@SupplierId 14.@FormationId 15.@ProductName 16.@BrandExtensionsId  17.FilterTypeId 18.GenericId 19. UserID 20. MAID 21. FestivalId 22. TenantId
AS
BEGIN
	declare @StaffRecordId uniqueidentifier,
			@FilterYear int,
			@TotalInterest int =0
	select @StaffRecordId=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	select @FilterYear=CONVERT(int, T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=3
		select @TotalInterest=CONVERT(int, T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=4
--with DateYearMonthName AS
--(

--SELECT @StaffRecordId,@FilterYear,@TotalInterest
--RETURN


select * into #DateYearMonthName from 
(
SELECT 1 MonthID , 'January' MonthName
UNION ALL SELECT 2 , 'February'
UNION ALL SELECT 3 , 'March'
UNION ALL SELECT 4 , 'April'
UNION ALL SELECT 5 , 'May'
UNION ALL SELECT 6 , 'June'
UNION ALL SELECT 7 , 'July'
UNION ALL SELECT 8 , 'August'
UNION ALL SELECT 9 , 'September'
UNION ALL SELECT 10 , 'October'
UNION ALL SELECT 11 , 'November'
UNION ALL SELECT 12 , 'December'
)T
--)


select  s.EmployeeNo,
s.EmployeeName,
dg.Name [Designation],
dept.Name [Department],
s.MobileNo,
convert(date,s.JoiningDate)JoiningDate,s.id,
isnull((
select sum(PF) from Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets p where p.StaffRecordId = s.id and p.SalaryYear <@FilterYear
),0) 
+
isnull((
			select sum(round(vd.Credit,0))
			from PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers  g
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasterDetails vd on vd.DTLID = g.Id
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasters vm on vd.VMID=vm.ID
			where g.StaffRecordId = s.Id
			and YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) <2022
			and YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) <@FilterYear
),0)

+
isnull((
			select sum(round(vd.Credit,0))
			from PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers  g
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasterDetails vd on vd.DTLID = g.Id
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasters vm on vd.VMID=vm.ID
			where g.StaffRecordId = s.Id
			and YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) =2022
			and MONTH(vm.VoucherDate) <10
			and YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) <@FilterYear
),0)

OpeningPF
into #EmployeeDetails
from hr.StaffRecords s
join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId
where (s.Id = @StaffRecordId or @StaffRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


select EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],MobileNo,JoiningDate,OpeningPF,--YearName, PRYear,
isnull(sum(January),0) January,isnull(sum(February),0) February,isnull(sum(March),0) March,
isnull(sum(April),0) April,isnull(sum(May),0) May,isnull(sum(June),0) June,isnull(sum(July),0) July,
isnull(sum(August),0) August,
isnull(sum(September),0) September,isnull(sum(October),0) October,isnull(sum(November),0) November,isnull(sum(December),0) December
--isnull(sum(January),0) + isnull(sum(February),0) + isnull(sum(March),0) + isnull(sum(April),0) +  isnull(sum(May),0) + isnull(sum(June),0) 
--+isnull(sum(July),0) +  isnull(sum(August),0) + isnull(sum(September),0) + isnull(sum(October),0) + isnull(sum(November),0) + 
--isnull(sum(December),0)
--Yearlytotal
into #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
from 
(
			select *
			from 
			(

			select  s.EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.Designation [Designation],
			s.Department [Department],
			s.mobileNo mobileNo,
			convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
			
			OpeningPF,
			'' FullMonthNameDisplay,
			'' [FullMonthName],
			0 MonthWiseAmount, 0 Yearlytotal
			from #EmployeeDetails s
		
			union all


			select s.EmployeeNo EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.[Designation] [Designation],
			s.[Department] [Department],
			s.mobileNo mobileNo,
			convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
			
			--YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) YearName,
			--'Year - '+convert(varchar(4),YEAR(vm.VoucherDate)) PRYear,
			OpeningPF,
			#DateYearMonthName.MonthName [FullMonthNameDisplay],
			#DateYearMonthName.MonthName [FullMonthName],
			case when YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) <2022 then
			CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),(vd.Credit/12)/2)
			when YEAR(vm.VoucherDate)  =2022 and #DateYearMonthName.MonthID <10 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),(vd.Credit/09)/2) 
			else 0 end MonthWiseAmount,0 Yearlytotal
			from PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers  g
			join #EmployeeDetails s --on s.EmployeeNo = SUBSTRING(g.Name,0, CHARINDEX('-',g.Name))
			on g.StaffRecordId = s.Id
			--join hr.StaffRecords s on s.EmployeeNo = SUBSTRING(g.Name,0, CHARINDEX('-',g.Name))
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasterDetails vd on vd.DTLID = g.Id
			join PFBook.PFVoucherMasters vm on vd.VMID=vm.ID
			and YEAR(vm.VoucherDate) =@FilterYear
			--join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
			--join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId

			cross join #DateYearMonthName
			--where --g.id='4A212AD4-57B8-4592-A2D6-0104323B615D'
			--and DTLID='4A212AD4-57B8-4592-A2D6-0104323B615D'
			--s.EmployeeNo = @EmployeeNo
			)T
			PIVOT(
				SUM(MonthWiseAmount) 
				FOR FullMonthNameDisplay IN (January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December)
			) AS pivot_table
		
			
			union all

			select * from 
			(
			select  s.EmployeeNo ,
			s.EmployeeName,
			s.Designation [Designation],
			s.Department [Department],
			s.mobileNo mobileNo,
			convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoiningDate,
			--a.SalaryYear,
			--'Year - '+convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear) PRYear,
			OpeningPF,
			DATENAME (Month,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),a.SalaryMonth)+'-1')) FullMonthNameDisplay,
			DATENAME (Month,convert(date,convert(varchar(4),a.SalaryYear)+'-'+convert(varchar(2),a.SalaryMonth)+'-1')) [FullMonthName],
			a.PF MonthWiseAmount, 0 Yearlytotal
			
			from 
			Payroll.ApprovedSalarySheets a
			--join hr.StaffRecords s on s.Id = a.StaffRecordId
			--join HR.Departments dept on dept.Id = s.DeptId
			--join HR.Designations dg on dg.Id = s.DesignationId
			join #EmployeeDetails s on s.Id = a.StaffRecordId
			and a.SalaryYear =@FilterYear
			)T
			PIVOT(
				SUM(MonthWiseAmount) 
				FOR FullMonthNameDisplay IN (January,February,March,April,May,June,July,August,September,October,November,December)
			) AS pivot_table
		
			--where EmployeeNo =@EmployeeNo
)TT
group by EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],MobileNo,JoiningDate,OpeningPF --,YearName, PRYear

DECLARE @TotalPF float

--select @TotalPF=sum(Yearlytotal) from #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
select(
	select EmployeeNo,EmployeeName,[Designation],[Department],MobileNo,JoiningDate,
	OpeningPF,--YearName, PRYear,
	--@TotalPF [TotalOwnPF],
	--@TotalPF [TotalCompanyPF],@TotalInterest TotalInterest ,

	January Won_January, January Com_January ,
	February Won_February,February Com_February,
	March Won_March,March Com_March,
	April Won_April,April Com_April,
	May Won_May,May Com_May,
	June Won_June,June Com_June,
	July Won_July,July Com_July,
	August Won_August,August Com_August,
	September Won_September,September Com_September,
	October Won_October,October Com_October,
	November Won_November,November Com_November,
	December Won_December,December Com_December,
	ROUND
	(
	isnull(January,0) + isnull(January,0)
	+ isnull(February,0) + isnull(February,0)
	+ isnull(March,0) + isnull(March,0)
	+ isnull(April,0) + isnull(April,0)
	+ isnull(May,0) + isnull(May,0)
	+ isnull(June,0) + isnull(June,0)
	+ isnull(July,0) + isnull(July,0)
	+ isnull(August,0) + isnull(August,0)
	+ isnull(September,0) + isnull(September,0)
	+ isnull(October,0) + isnull(October,0)
	+ isnull(November,0) + isnull(November,0)
	+ isnull(December,0) + isnull(December,0)
	,0)
	Yearlytotal,

	ROUND(
	OpeningPF+
	isnull(January,0) + isnull(January,0)
	+ isnull(February,0) + isnull(February,0)
	+ isnull(March,0) + isnull(March,0)
	+ isnull(April,0) + isnull(April,0)
	+ isnull(May,0) + isnull(May,0)
	+ isnull(June,0) + isnull(June,0)
	+ isnull(July,0) + isnull(July,0)
	+ isnull(August,0) + isnull(August,0)
	+ isnull(September,0) + isnull(September,0)
	+ isnull(October,0) + isnull(October,0)
	+ isnull(November,0) + isnull(November,0)
	+ isnull(December,0) + isnull(December,0)
	,0)

	 GrandTotal,
	 0 Interest,
	 0 Payable 
	from #TempPFSettlementReportEmployeeWise
	order by EmployeeNo for json auto) as Data
END

-- =============================================
