-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [PFBook].[SPGetYearlyInterestDashboard]
	@InterestYear int,
	@StaffRecordId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
			select s.EmployeeNo EmpId, s.EmployeeName EmpName, convert(date,s.JoiningDate) JoinDate, d.Name Department,
					dg.Name Designation, isnull(s.MobileNo,0) MobileNo, vd.Credit InterestAmount
				from PFBook.PFVoucherMasters vm 
					join PFBook.PFVoucherMasterDetails vd on vd.VMID=vm.Id
					join PFBook.PfGeneralLedgers pgl on pgl.Id=vd.DTLID
					join hr.StaffRecords s on s.id=pgl.StaffRecordId
					join hr.Departments d on d.id=s.DeptId
					join hr.Designations dg on dg.id=s.DesignationId
					where @InterestYear=vm.ChequeYear
					and vm.VoucherMode='BI'
					and
							(@StaffRecordId=s.id or @StaffRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
END

AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select * from

	) tbl where tbl.CurrentStock<=tbl.ROL
END   
END

-- Execute [Pharmacy].[GetFilteredStockDetails]  '9f2d97f5-0bb1-4d2b-b2e6-1940afb823ec',''
CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetFilteredStockDetails]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	,@filerstring NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF (
			@filerstring = ''
			OR @filerstring IS NULL
			)
	BEGIN
		SELECT *
		FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails]
		WHERE OutLetId = @OutletId
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT *
		FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails]
		WHERE OutLetId = @OutletId
			AND ProductName LIKE '%' + @filerstring + '%'
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
 -- Exec [Pharmacy].[GetInvoiceDetailWithReturned] 'd03fdeb7-a6fc-4a53-fa8c-08dc30e9318e'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetInvoiceDetailWithReturned]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	

BEGIN
	select i.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvoiceId,id.Qty,vb.ProductId,vb.ProductName,vb.BatchNo,vb.ExpireDate,vb.PurchasePrice,vb.SalePrice,vb.PkgUnit,sr.Id as StockRecieveId,IsNull(sd.Qty,0) as ReturnedQty,vb.LotId
		 from [Pharmacy].[InvoiceDetails] id
		 left join [pharmacy].[Invoices] i on i.Id=id.InvoiceId
		 left join [Pharmacy].[StockReceives] sr on i.Id=sr.OPDReturnBillId
		 left join [Pharmacy].[StockReceiveDetails] sd on sr.Id=sd.StockReceiveId and sd.BrandExtensionId=id.BrandExtensionId and sd.LotRecordId=id.LotRecordId
		 left join [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] vb on vb.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId and vb.LotId=id.LotRecordId
		 where id.InvoiceId=@InvoiceId
		 group by i.InvoiceNo,id.Id,id.InvoiceId,id.Qty,vb.ProductId,vb.ProductName,vb.BatchNo,vb.ExpireDate,vb.PurchasePrice,vb.SalePrice,vb.PkgUnit,sr.Id,sd.Qty,vb.LotId
END   
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetIPDMedicineIndentDetailsByIndentId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IPDMedicineIndentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	With CteIndents as
	(
	   Select * from [Pharmacy].[IPDMedicineIndentDetails] mid where  mid.IPDMedicineIndentId=@IPDMedicineIndentId and mid.IsDeleted=0
	)

	
	select distinct mid.Id, mid.BrandExtensionId,mid.IPDMedicineIndentId,bd.ProductName,mid.ServeTypeId,mid.Qty,mid.Remarks,st.Name Status,mid.ServedQty
	from CteIndents mid 
	left join [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on bd.ProductId=mid.BrandExtensionId
	left join [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on mid.ServeTypeId=st.Id
	


END

-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- =============================================
----------- exec [Pharmacy].[GetOutletIndentDetailsByIndentId] '7ccf61e7-a4a0-469f-70aa-08dd1cee4b74'
CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetOutletIndentDetailsByIndentId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IndentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SELECT
	distinct 
	oid.Id,oid.OutletIndentId,oid.BrandExtensionId,bd.ProductName,
	oid.Qty,oid.Status,ISNULL(oid.Remarks,'') as Remarks,oid.ServedQty,oid.LotId,st.Name StatusTxt
	from [Pharmacy].[OutletIndentDetails] oid
	left join [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] bd on bd.ProductId=oid.BrandExtensionId --and bd.LotId=oid.LotId
	left join [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on oid.Status=st.Id
	where oid.OutletIndentId=@IndentId
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyIndentCounts]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ GetPharmacyIndentCounts ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyIndentCounts]
	@Datefrm date,
	@DateTo date,
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @TotalPendingTillDate int
	Declare @TotalPartiallyServedTillDate int
	Declare @TotalPendingWithinDate int
	Declare @TotalPartiallyServedWithinDate int
	Declare @TotalServedWithinDate int

	declare @allOutletId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';

	
	Select @TotalPendingTillDate= Count(Id) from [Pharmacy].IPDMedicineIndents where (IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=@allOutletId) and  ServeTypeId=1
	Select @TotalPartiallyServedTillDate= Count(Id) from [Pharmacy].IPDMedicineIndents where (IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=@allOutletId) and ServeTypeId=2


	Select @TotalPendingWithinDate= Count(Id) from [Pharmacy].IPDMedicineIndents where (IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=@allOutletId) and ServeTypeId=1 and  Convert(date,IndentDateTime)>=@Datefrm and  Convert(date,IndentDateTime)<=@DateTo
	Select @TotalPartiallyServedWithinDate= Count(Id) from [Pharmacy].IPDMedicineIndents where (IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=@allOutletId) and ServeTypeId=2 and  Convert(date,IndentDateTime)>=@Datefrm and  Convert(date,IndentDateTime)<=@DateTo
	Select @TotalServedWithinDate= Count(Id) from [Pharmacy].IPDMedicineIndents where (IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=@allOutletId) and ServeTypeId=3 and  Convert(date,IndentDateTime)>=@Datefrm and  Convert(date,IndentDateTime)<=@DateTo


	Select @TotalPendingTillDate as TotalPendingTillDate, @TotalPartiallyServedTillDate as TotalPartiallyServedTillDate, @TotalPendingWithinDate as TotalPendingWithinDate, @TotalPartiallyServedWithinDate as TotalPartiallyServedWithinDate,
	       @TotalServedWithinDate as TotalServedWithinDate
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyInvoiceByDatesAndServeTypeId]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyInvoiceByDatesAndServeTypeId] '2024-05-01','2024-05-01',0

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyInvoiceByDatesAndServeTypeId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime,
	@ServeTypeId int
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select p.Id,p.UserId As UserId ,p.InvoiceNo,p.InvoicePrefix,m.Name as OutLetName,p.MedicineOutLetId,p.Invdate,p.TotalAmount,p.Discount,p.GrandTotal,p.ReceiveAmount,p.ChangeAmount,p.DueAmount,
		st.Name as InvoiceType, p.ServeTypeId, p.Remarks
		,d.EmployeeName as StaffFirstName, d.LastName as StaffLastName,p.IPDPatientRecordId,p.IPDIndentId,u.UserName,isnull(pr.InvoiceNo,0) AdmissionNo,
		case when (pr.DischargeByUserId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') then Hospital.GetCabinNumber(pr.Id)
		     else dbo.GetCabinNumberAfterDischarge(pr.InvoiceNo)
			 end as CabinNo, pr.FullName PatientName

		from [Pharmacy].[Invoices] p 
		left join [Admin].ServeTypes st on p.ServeTypeId = st.Id
		left Join [HR].[StaffRecords] d on p.StaffRecordId=d.Id
		left join [Pharmacy].[MedicineOutlets] m on p.MedicineOutLetId=m.Id 
		left join [Identity].[Users] u on Convert( uniqueidentifier ,u.Id)=p.UserId
		left join [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on p.IPDPatientRecordId=pr.Id
		--left Join [Hospital].MedicineReturnIndents rr On rr.UserId = u.Id
		where (CONVERT(DATE, p.Invdate) between CONVERT(DATE, @DateFrom) and CONVERT(DATE, @DateTo)) and (p.ServeTypeId=@ServeTypeId or @ServeTypeId=0)
END

--Exec [OPD].GetOPDInvoiceHeaderAndBody 'fcc851ba-4911-423d-17a4-08daab99ba0c',1 

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyInvoiceDetails]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier,  
	@invoicetype int   -- '0' or '1'  0-> Emergency, 1->Consultancy
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
if(@invoicetype=0)
BEGIN
	select  p.Id, 
	p.BrandExtensionId, 
	p.InvoiceId,
	b.ProductName as BrandName,
	p.Qty, p.SaleRate,
	p.PurchaseRate,
	p.TotalAmount,
	p.LotRecordId,
	l.BatchNo,
	l.ExpireDate,
	inVo.IPDIndentId,
	inVo.InvoiceNo,
	u.UserName as UserName
--	us.UserName as  RequisitionName
	from [Pharmacy].[InvoiceDetails] p 
	Join [Pharmacy].[BrandDetailsWithoutSupplierId] b on p.BrandExtensionId=b.ProductId
	join [Pharmacy].[LotRecords] l on p.LotRecordId=l.Id
	 join [Pharmacy].Invoices  AS inVo ON invo.Id = p.InvoiceId
	 Join [Identity].users as u On u.Id = invo.CreatedBy
	--left join [Hospital].MedicineReturnIndents as m On  u.Id  = m.UserId
	--left join [Identity].users as us On us.Id =  m.UserId
	where p.InvoiceId=@InvoiceId
END   
END

--EXEC [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyInvoiceHeaderAndBody]'FBD86214-77DA-42E3-EB8E-08DCBD8B7C80','0'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyInvoiceHeaderAndBody]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@InvoiceId uniqueidentifier,  
	@invoicetype int   -- '0' or '1'  0-> Emergency, 1->Consultancy
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
if(@invoicetype=0)
BEGIN
	select p.Id,p.InvoiceNo,p.InvoicePrefix,m.Name as OutLetName,p.MedicineOutLetId,p.Invdate,p.TotalAmount,p.Discount,p.GrandTotal,p.ReceiveAmount,p.ChangeAmount,p.DueAmount,p.MedicineReturnIndentId,
	st.Name as InvoiceType, p.ServeTypeId, p.Remarks
	,d.EmployeeName as StaffFirstName, d.LastName as StaffLastName,p.IPDPatientRecordId,p.IPDIndentId,u.UserName,isnull(p.CustomerName, pm.Name) as CustomerName ,isnull(p.MobileNo, pm.ContactNo) as MobileNo, isnull(pm.Name , '') as LoyalName, isnull(pm.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') as LoyalMemberId
	from [Pharmacy].[Invoices] p 
	join [Admin].ServeTypes st on p.ServeTypeId = st.Id
	left Join [HR].[StaffRecords] d on p.StaffRecordId=d.Id
	left join [Pharmacy].[MedicineOutlets] m on p.MedicineOutLetId=m.Id 
	left join [Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=p.UserId
	left join [Pharmacy].PLoyalMemberLedgers  as pmld ON pmld.InvoiceId = p.Id
	left join [Pharmacy].PLoyalMembers as pm   ON pm.Id = pmld.PLoyalMemberId
	where p.Id=@InvoiceId
END   
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[GetPharmacyStockReceiveDetailByRecordId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SELECT srd.Id,srd.StockReceiveId,srd.BrandExtensionId,srd.Qty,srd.PurchaseRate,srd.SaleRate,srd.TotalAmount,srd.DisCountInpercent,srd.GrossDiscount,srd.VatInpercent,srd.VatInGrossAmount,
	srd.LotRecordId,bd.ProductName,bd.BatchNo,bd.ExpireDate,srd.RceivePurchOrderId,ro.PONo, bd.PkgUnit as Unit, u.UserName as UserName
	FROM [Pharmacy].[StockReceiveDetails] srd INNER JOIN
		 [Pharmacy].[StockReceives] sr on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id inner join
		 [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] bd ON srd.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId AND srd.LotRecordId=bd.LotId and sr.OutLetId=bd.OutLetId left join
		 [Pharmacy].[RceivePurchOrders] ro on srd.RceivePurchOrderId=ro.Id
		 join [Identity].Users u on u.Id=sr.UserId
	WHERE srd.StockReceiveId=@RecordId
END

GO




-- Exec [Pharmacy].[PGetIPDDueCollectionDueByIPDPatientId] 'c0b6cb52-a330-4b68-662c-08dcfd02c541'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[PGetIPDDueCollectionDueByIPDPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IPDPatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;	
	-- drop table #ReturnAmount
	select inv.Id As invoiceId , isnull( Sum(inv.GrandTotal), 0) As ReturnAmount INTO #ReturnAmounts from [Pharmacy].[Invoices] inv where inv.IPDPatientRecordId = @IPDPatientId  and inv.MedicineReturnIndentId > '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' group by inv.Id
	--select * from  #ReturnAmounts
		SELECT i.IPDPatientRecordId ID, sum(isnull(il.Debit-il.Credit, 0)) + isnull(sum(rr.ReturnAmount), 0) DueAmount
		FROM [Pharmacy].[Invoices] i left JOIN 
			 [Pharmacy].[InvoiceLedgers] il on i.Id=il.InvoiceId
			 left join [Pharmacy]. #ReturnAmounts as rr ON rr.invoiceId = i.Id
		where i.IPDPatientRecordId=@IPDPatientId
		group by i.IPDPatientRecordId--, i.MedicineOutletId 
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[SP_SET_Pharmacy_Opening_Stock]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

----------exec [Pharmacy].[SP_SET_Pharmacy_Opening_Stock] '2024-11-10'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SP_SET_Pharmacy_Opening_Stock]
	@FilterDate date
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
		@ProductId int, 
		@CurrentStock   float,
		@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
		@Char char ='#',
		@EndFilterChar char ='@',
		@EndFilterCharWithVat char ='$',
		@EndFilterCharWithOurtlet char ='*',
		@ProductAvgCost float,
		@ProductAvgCostWithVat float,

		@Id uniqueidentifier,
		@Stock float,
		@PurchaseRate float,
		@OutletID uniqueidentifier

		set @ProductStock =''

		DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
		FOR 
			/*
			SELECT 
				b.[Id]
			  ,sum(v.CurrentStock) [Stock]
			  ,AVG(vd.PurchasePrice) [PurchaseRate]
			  ,v.OutLetId
			 
		  FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join [Pharmacy].ViewBrandAndStockDetails vd 
		  on		vd.ProductId = v.BrandExtensionId
				and vd.OutLetId = v.OutLetId
		  group by b.[Id],v.OutLetId
		  */
		  

		  select [Id],sum([Stock]) [Stock],sum([PurchaseRate]) [PurchaseRate],OutLetId
from 
(
SELECT 
				b.[Id]
			  ,sum(v.CurrentStock) [Stock]
			  --,AVG(vd.PurchasePrice) [PurchaseRate]
			  ,0 [PurchaseRate]
			  ,v.OutLetId
			 
		  FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  --join [Pharmacy].ViewBrandAndStockDetails vd 
		  	--where b.id ='EFF3E987-3BEF-4BE0-96CC-68CF9AFD0E13'
		  group by b.[Id],v.OutLetId,v.BrandExtensionId

		  union all


		  SELECT 
				b.[Id]
			  ,0 [Stock]
			  ,AVG(vd.PurchaseAvgRate) [PurchaseRate]
			  ,v.OutLetId
			 
		  FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join ViewBrandAndStockDetailsWithoutlot vd 
		  on		vd.ProductId = v.BrandExtensionId
				and vd.OutLetId = v.OutLetId
				--where b.id ='EFF3E987-3BEF-4BE0-96CC-68CF9AFD0E13'
		  group by b.[Id],v.OutLetId
		  )T
		  group by  [Id],OutLetId
		  
		  /*
		  select srd.BrandExtensionId [Id] ,sum(srd.Qty) [Stock], 
sum(srd.Qty * srd.PurchaseRate) /sum(srd.Qty)

[PurchaseRate] ,sr.OutLetId 
FROM            Pharmacy.StockReceives AS sr INNER JOIN
                         Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails AS srd ON sr.Id = srd.StockReceiveId
						 where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) <>'2023-09-07'
						 group by srd.BrandExtensionId, sr.OutLetId
		  
		  */

		OPEN cursor_product;

		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
				@Id
			   ,@Stock
			  ,@PurchaseRate
			  ,@OutletID
			 

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
				set @ProductStock = @ProductStock + ','+convert(varchar(max),@Id) +@Char
				+convert(varchar(50),@Stock) +@EndFilterChar
				+ convert(varchar(50),isnull(@PurchaseRate,0)) + @EndFilterCharWithVat
				+ convert(varchar(max),isnull(@OutletID,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')) + @EndFilterCharWithOurtlet

				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
				@Id
			   ,@Stock
			  ,@PurchaseRate
			  ,@OutletID

		END;

CLOSE cursor_product;
DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

set @ProductStock = substring(@ProductStock,2,len(@ProductStock)+1)

print @ProductStock


Declare @RowCount int =0
Declare @RowAutoID int
select  @RowCount = count(*) from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterDate


if  @RowCount =0 
begin 
	insert into [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories]
	(FilterDate,ProductStock)
	values (@FilterDate,@ProductStock)
	print '---Done-'
End


END
GO

-- Exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetAdmittedPatientsMedicineIndentByDates] '2025-02-11', '2025-02-11', '9f2d97f5-0bb1-4d2b-b2e6-1940afb823ec', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetAdmittedPatientsMedicineIndentByDates]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@OutletId  uniqueidentifier,
	@Id uniqueidentifier	
AS
BEGIN
	
	
	with AdmittedPatients as
	(
	   Select * from [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] p where (p.DischargedDateTime < p.AdmissionDateTime) AND (p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

	),
	
    medicineIndents as
	(
	   Select mi.*, isnull(c.FloorId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') FloorId from  [Pharmacy].[IPDMedicineIndents] mi left join Hospital.Cabins c on c.Id = mi.CabinId  where mi.IPDPatientId in (Select Id from AdmittedPatients) and (mi.IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and mi.IsDeleted=0  --and CONVERT(date,mi.IndentDateTime) >= convert(date,@FromDate) and convert(date,mi.IndentDateTime) <= convert(date,@ToDate)
	   --Select mi.* from  [Pharmacy].[IPDMedicineIndents] mi  where mi.IPDPatientId in (Select Id from AdmittedPatients) and (mi.IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and mi.IsDeleted=0  --and CONVERT(date,mi.IndentDateTime) >= convert(date,@FromDate) and convert(date,mi.IndentDateTime) <= convert(date,@ToDate)
	), 

	IndentsWithOutlets as (
	
	   Select mi.*,mo.Name MedicineOutletName from medicineIndents mi join [Pharmacy].[MedicineOutlets] mo on mi.IndentToOutletId=mo.Id
	
	),
	
	phInvoices as 
	(
	   Select i.InvoiceNo,i.IPDIndentId,i.IPDPatientRecordId,i.Invdate from [Pharmacy].[Invoices] i join AdmittedPatients p on p.Id= i.IPDPatientRecordId
	),
	

	
	PendingAndPartial as (
	select mi.Id,mi.IPDPatientId, CabinNo=mi.CabinNo, mi.FloorId, mi.CabinType, mi.IndentDateTime,mi.IndentToOutletId,mi.UserId,mi.IndentNo,mi.Priority,
		CAST(case when mi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when mi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when mi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  when mi.Priority=3 then 'Others'
			  when mi.Priority=4 then 'New Admission'
			  else 'Discharge' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,
			mi.ServeTypeId,mi.OTRoomName,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName PatientName, u.UserName,mi.MedicineOutletName,st.Name Status, 0 SaleInvoiceNo, null ServedDateTime
	  from IndentsWithOutlets mi inner join
	        AdmittedPatients pr on mi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id 
		    left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on mi.UserId=u.Id left join
		    -- phInvoices i on mi.Id=i.IPDIndentId left join
			[Admin].ServeTypes st on mi.ServeTypeId=st.Id
	 where   mi.ServeTypeId in (1,2) and (( @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or (@Id!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and mi.Id=@Id))),
	 --order by mi.IndentDateTime asc


	 
 Served as (
	 select mi.Id,mi.IPDPatientId,CabinNo=mi.CabinNo, mi.FloorId, mi.CabinType,mi.IndentDateTime,mi.IndentToOutletId,mi.UserId,mi.IndentNo,mi.Priority,
		CAST(case when mi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when mi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when mi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  when mi.Priority=3 then 'Others'
			  when mi.Priority=4 then 'New Admission'
			  else 'Discharge' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,
			mi.ServeTypeId,mi.OTRoomName,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName PatientName, u.UserName,mi.MedicineOutletName,st.Name Status,i.InvoiceNo SaleInvoiceNo,i.Invdate ServedDateTime
	  from IndentsWithOutlets mi inner join
	        AdmittedPatients pr on mi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id 
		    left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on mi.UserId=u.Id left join
		    phInvoices i on mi.Id=i.IPDIndentId left join
			[Admin].ServeTypes st on mi.ServeTypeId=st.Id
	 where   mi.ServeTypeId in (3) and CONVERT(date,mi.ServedDateTime)=@ToDate and (( @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or (@Id!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and mi.Id=@Id))

	 ) 
	 
	 
	Select * from PendingAndPartial 
	 Union all 
    Select * from	Served 



	          --and (mi.IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=0) and mi.IsDeleted=0
END

-----------------------------------------------
GO

    medicineIndents as

 Served as (

	 where   mi.ServeTypeId = 3 and CONVERT(date,mi.ServedDateTime)=@ToDate and (( @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or (@Id!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and mi.Id=@Id))

    Select * from	Served

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[spGetAuditDetailsHistory]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- exec Pharmacy.spGetAuditDetailsHistory 'c6c1af87-4f4d-41e5-9fd7-08dc890d4899'

CREATE     procedure [Pharmacy].[spGetAuditDetailsHistory]
	@AuditId uniqueidentifier

as
Begin
	select 
		d.Id, d.AuditId, d.ProductId, p.ProductName, d.ExpireDate, d.PhysicalStock, d.Status,  Round(p.PurchasePrice, 2) PurchasePrice, Round(p.SalePrice,2) SalePrice,
		sum(isnull(d.SoftwareStock,0)) SoftwareStock
	from Pharmacy.StockAuditDetails d
	join Pharmacy.StockAudits a on a.Id = d.AuditId
	join Pharmacy.BrandDetails  p on p.ProductId = d.ProductId
	where a.Id = @AuditId
	group by d.Id, d.AuditId, d.ProductId, p.ProductName, d.ExpireDate, d.PhysicalStock, d.Status, d.PhysicalStock, p.PurchasePrice, p.SalePrice
	order by p.ProductName
end
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[spGetAuditDetailsWithSoftwareStock]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec Pharmacy.spGetAuditDetailsWithSoftwareStock 'c6c1af87-4f4d-41e5-9fd7-08dc890d4899'


CREATE   PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetAuditDetailsWithSoftwareStock]
	@AuditId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @OutletId uniqueidentifier;
	select @OutletId = MedicineOutletId from StockAudits where Id = @AuditId

	-- Temp table to store software stock based on invoices and stock receives
	CREATE TABLE #SoftwareStockTemp (
		BrandExtensionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		SoftwareStock INT,
		[ExpireDate] Date
	);

	-- Insert computed software stock into temp table
	INSERT INTO #SoftwareStockTemp (BrandExtensionId, OutletId, SoftwareStock, ExpireDate)
	SELECT 
		t.BrandExtensionId, 
		@OutletId OutletId, 
		SUM(t.Qty) AS SoftwareStock, 
		TRY_CAST(t.ExpireDate AS DATE) [ExpireDate]
	FROM (
		-- Outgoing stock from invoices
		SELECT 
			id.BrandExtensionId, 
			-1 * SUM(id.Qty) AS Qty, 
			lr.ExpireDate
		FROM Pharmacy.Invoices AS i 
		JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails AS id ON i.Id = id.InvoiceId
		JOIN Pharmacy.LotRecords lr ON id.LotRecordId = lr.Id
		WHERE i.MedicineOutletId = @OutletId and i.ServeTypeId NOT IN (14) and lr.ExpireDate is not null
		GROUP BY id.BrandExtensionId, i.MedicineOutletId, lr.ExpireDate

		UNION ALL

		-- Incoming stock from stock receives
		SELECT 
			srd.BrandExtensionId, 
			SUM(srd.Qty) AS Qty, 
			lr.ExpireDate
		FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives AS sr 
		JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails AS srd ON sr.Id = srd.StockReceiveId
		JOIN Pharmacy.LotRecords lr ON srd.LotRecordId = lr.Id
		WHERE sr.OutletId = @OutletId and sr.OPDReturnBillId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and lr.ExpireDate is not null
		GROUP BY srd.BrandExtensionId, sr.OutletId, lr.ExpireDate
	) t Where t.ExpireDate is not null
	GROUP BY t.BrandExtensionId, t.ExpireDate
	HAVING SUM(t.Qty) != 0;

	--select * from #SoftwareStockTemp where [ExpireDate] is null


	SELECT  
		d.Id, 
		d.AuditId, 
		d.ProductId, 
		p.ProductName, 
		d.ExpireDate, 
		d.PhysicalStock, 
		d.Status,  
		ROUND(p.PurchasePrice, 2) AS PurchasePrice, 
		ROUND(p.SalePrice, 2) AS SalePrice,
		ISNULL(SUM(st.SoftwareStock), 0) AS SoftwareStock,
		1 AS IsAudited
	FROM Pharmacy.StockAuditDetails d
	JOIN Pharmacy.StockAudits a ON a.Id = d.AuditId
	JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails p ON p.ProductId = d.ProductId
	LEFT JOIN #SoftwareStockTemp st 
		ON st.BrandExtensionId = p.ProductId and st.ExpireDate is not null
		AND st.OutletId = a.MedicineOutletId 
		AND CAST(st.ExpireDate AS DATE) = CAST(d.ExpireDate AS DATE)
	WHERE a.Id = @AuditId
	GROUP BY d.Id, d.AuditId, d.ProductId, p.ProductName, d.ExpireDate, d.PhysicalStock, d.Status, p.PurchasePrice, p.SalePrice

	UNION ALL


	SELECT  
		'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS Id, 
		@AuditId AS AuditId, 
		st.BrandExtensionId AS ProductId, 
		p.ProductName, 
		st.ExpireDate, 
		0 AS PhysicalStock, 
		'pending' AS Status, 
		ROUND(p.PurchasePrice, 2) AS PurchasePrice, 
		ROUND(p.SalePrice, 2) AS SalePrice,
		SUM(ISNULL(st.SoftwareStock, 0)) AS SoftwareStock,
		0 AS IsAudited
	FROM #SoftwareStockTemp st
	JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails p ON p.ProductId = st.BrandExtensionId and st.ExpireDate is not null
	WHERE NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 
			FROM Pharmacy.StockAuditDetails d 
			JOIN Pharmacy.StockAudits a ON a.Id = d.AuditId
		WHERE d.ProductId = st.BrandExtensionId
			AND CAST(d.ExpireDate AS DATE) = CAST(st.ExpireDate AS DATE)
			AND a.Id = @AuditId
	)
	GROUP BY st.BrandExtensionId, p.ProductName, st.ExpireDate, p.PurchasePrice, p.SalePrice;

	-- Cleanup
	DROP TABLE #SoftwareStockTemp;
END;
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetAuditedStockByStockAuditId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StockAuditId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;	

	select isnull(ass.StockAuditId,@StockAuditId) StockAuditId,isnull(ass.BrandExtentionId,bd.ProductId) BrandExtentionId,bd.CurrentStock SoftwareStock,isnull(ass.PhysicalStock,0) PhysicalStock,bd.LotId,bd.ProductName,bd.BatchNo,bd.ExpireDate,(isnull(ass.PhysicalStock,0)-bd.CurrentStock) Deviation,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice,isnull(ass.ExpireStock,0) ExpireStock,isnull(ass.ShortDateStock,0) ShortDateStock,0 PStock,0 EStock,0 SStock,ass.IsCountComplete

	  from 
	  (
		select *
		  from [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] bs  
		 where bs.OutLetId=(select sa.MedicineOutLetId from [Pharmacy].[StockAudits] sa where sa.Id=@StockAuditId)
	  ) bd left join
	  (
		select StockAuditId,BrandExtentionId,LotId,sum(PhysicalStock) PhysicalStock, sum(ExpireStock) ExpireStock,sum(ShortDateStock) ShortDateStock,CAST(MAX(CAST(IsCountComplete as INT)) AS BIT) IsCountComplete
		  from [Pharmacy].[AuditedStocks]
		where StockAuditId=@StockAuditId
		group by StockAuditId,BrandExtentionId,LotId
	  ) ass on bd.ProductId=ass.BrandExtentionId and bd.LotId=ass.LotId
	 
END

--EXEC [Pharmacy].[spGetBrandAndStockDetailsByIndent] '5227cbd8-7b0a-4bce-b90c-08dcee7bbf97','f68b4ad4-6158-4455-96ca-c1ca17a280a7'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetBrandAndStockDetailsByIndent]
    @IndentId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @OutLetId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP 250
        ProductId,
        ProductName,
        LotId,
        BatchNo,
        ExpireDate,
        CurrentStock,
        PurchasePrice,
        SalePrice,
        Manufacturer,
        Generic,
        GenericId,
        PkgUnit,
        QtyPerBox,
        ROL,
        OutLetId,
        ManufacturerId
    FROM Pharmacy.IPDMedicineIndentDetails id
    JOIN Pharmacy.ViewBrandAndStockDetails st ON id.BrandExtensionId = st.ProductId
    WHERE id.IPDMedicineIndentId = @IndentId
    AND st.OutLetId = @OutLetId
    AND CurrentStock > 0
    ORDER BY st.ExpireDate DESC;
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetDepartmentWiseProductSaleDetails]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetDepartmentWiseProductSaleDetails]
	@Paramas NVARCHAR(max)
AS
BEGIN
	Declare
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

						select(
							select * from(


	SELECT 'Outdoor' AS Type,
			bd.ProductName AS ProductName,
			bd.SalePrice AS SaleRate,
			SUM(id.Qty) AS SaleQty,
			SUM(id.Qty) * bd.SalePrice [TotalSaleAmount],
			bd.PurchasePrice AS PurchaseRate
			FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
			JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id ON id.InvoiceId=i.Id
			JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd ON bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
			WHERE convert(DATE,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			AND convert(DATE,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			AND (i.IPDPatientRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and i.ServeTypeId<>10
			GROUP BY bd.ProductName,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice

			UNION ALL

	SELECT 'Indoor' AS Type,
			bd.ProductName AS ProductName,
			bd.SalePrice AS SaleRate,
			SUM(id.Qty) AS SaleQty,
			SUM(id.Qty) * bd.SalePrice [TotalSaleAmount],
			bd.PurchasePrice AS PurchaseRate
			FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
			JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id ON id.InvoiceId=i.Id
			JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd ON bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
			WHERE convert(DATE,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			AND convert(DATE,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			AND (i.IPDPatientRecordId <>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and i.ServeTypeId<>10
			GROUP BY bd.ProductName,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice


				) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetExpiredProductStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetExpiredProductStatement]
	@Paramas NVARCHAR(max)
AS
BEGIN
	Declare
		@FilterStartDate date


					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					
					
						select(
							select * from(


	SELECT 
			bd.ProductName AS ProductName,
			bd.SalePrice AS SaleRate,
			bd.PurchasePrice AS PurchaseRate,
			vcs.CurrentStock AS CurrentStock,
			lr.ExpireDate AS ExpireDate,
			s.Name AS SupplierName
			FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
			JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id ON id.InvoiceId=i.Id
			JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd ON bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
			JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd ON srd.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId
			JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceives sr ON sr.id=srd.StockReceiveId
			JOIN [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s ON s.id=sr.SupplierId
			JOIN Pharmacy.LotRecords lr ON lr.id=srd.LotRecordId
			JOIN Pharmacy.ViewCurrentStock vcs ON vcs.BrandExtensionId=srd.BrandExtensionId
			WHERE convert(DATE,lr.ExpireDate) <= convert(DATE,@FilterStartDate)

				--GROUP BY bd.ProductName,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice,s.Name

				) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END
GO

-- Exec [Pharmacy].[spGetIndentData] 'd26dc16d-ea59-421d-b927-08dcee7bbf97','f68b4ad4-6158-4455-96ca-c1ca17a280a7',0

CREATE     PROCEDURE 
[Pharmacy].[spGetIndentData]
 @IndentId uniqueidentifier, 
 @OutletId uniqueidentifier,
 @IndentType int
AS 
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; 

if(@IndentType=0)
BEGIN
	
	With Cte_Indent
	as(
	
	   SELECT [Id]
      ,[IndentNo]
      ,[IPDPatientId]
      ,[CabinNo]
      ,[CabinType]
      ,[IndentDateTime]
      ,[IndentToOutletId]
      ,[UserId]
      ,[Priority]
      ,[CreatedBy]
      ,[CreatedOn]
      ,[LastModifiedBy]
      ,[LastModifiedOn]
      ,[IsDeleted]
      ,[IsSynced]
      ,[OTRoomName]
      ,[ServedDateTime]
       FROM [Pharmacy].[IPDMedicineIndents]  i where i.Id=@IndentId
	
	),
	Cte_Indent_detail
	as (
	
	   Select i.[IndentNo],[IPDPatientId],[CabinNo],[CabinType],[IndentDateTime],[IndentToOutletId],[UserId],[Priority],[OTRoomName],[ServedDateTime],
	        d.Id, d.BrandExtensionId,d.IPDMedicineIndentId,d.Qty,d.Remarks,d.ServedQty,d.ServeTypeId, st.Name AS Status from Cte_Indent i join [Pharmacy].[IPDMedicineIndentDetails] d on i.Id=d.IPDMedicineIndentId
	    left join [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on d.ServeTypeId=st.Id
	)

	
	SELECT d.Id, T.ProductId, T.GenericId,d.Status,
	T.ProductName ,T.PurchasePrice,T.SalePrice, d.Qty [ReqQty],IsNull(T.Stock, 0) [AvailQty], d.ServeTypeId,d.ServedQty,T.FormationId, 
	d.IPDMedicineIndentId, IsNull(d.Remarks, '') as Remarks,  --d.Remarks column will be added on [Pharmacy].[IPDMedcineIndentDetails] for the replacement Remraks
	  CASE WHEN T.Stock>=d.Qty THEN 'False' ELSE 'True' END IsStockShort FROM 

	  ( 
  
		 SELECT TempTable.ProductId,FormationId, TempTable.ProductName,TempTable.GenericId,TempTable.PurchasePrice,TempTable.SalePrice, SUM(TempTable.CurrentStock) AS Stock
		   FROM ( 
	   
					SELECT p.ProductId, p.ProductName, p.GenericId,p.FormationId, p.PurchasePrice,p.SalePrice,Sum(IsNull(PhSt.CurrentStock,0)) CurrentStock
					   FROM [Pharmacy].BrandDetails p LEFT JOIN [Pharmacy].ViewBrandAndStockDetails PhSt 
						   ON P.ProductId = PhSt.ProductId AND PhSt.OutLetId = @OutletId 
							GROUP BY p.ProductId,p.GenericId,p.ProductName,p.PurchasePrice,p.SalePrice,p.FormationId
  
				 ) TempTable GROUP BY TempTable.ProductId, TempTable.ProductName,TempTable.GenericId,TempTable.PurchasePrice,TempTable.SalePrice,CurrentStock,FormationId
			 
	 ) T 
	  JOIN Cte_Indent_detail d on T.ProductId = d.BrandExtensionId

	   --and d.ServeTypeId != 3
END
ELSE
BEGIN

	SELECT d.Id, T.ProductId, T.GenericId,st.Name Status,
	T.ProductName ,T.PurchasePrice,T.SalePrice, d.Qty [ReqQty],IsNull(T.Stock, 0) [AvailQty],d.Status ServeTypeId,d.ServedQty,T.FormationId,
	d.OutletIndentId IPDMedicineIndentId, IsNull(d.Remarks, '') as Remarks,  --d.Remarks column will be added on [Pharmacy].[IPDMedcineIndentDetails] for the replacement Remraks
	  CASE WHEN T.Stock>=d.Qty THEN 'False' ELSE 'True' END IsStockShort FROM 

	  ( 
  
		 SELECT TempTable.ProductId, TempTable.ProductName,TempTable.GenericId,TempTable.PurchasePrice,TempTable.SalePrice, SUM(TempTable.CurrentStock) AS Stock,TempTable.FormationId
		   FROM ( 
	   
					SELECT p.ProductId, p.ProductName, p.GenericId,p.FormationId, p.PurchasePrice,p.SalePrice,Sum(PhSt.CurrentStock) CurrentStock
					   FROM [Pharmacy].BrandDetails p LEFT JOIN [Pharmacy].ViewBrandAndStockDetails PhSt 
						   ON P.ProductId = PhSt.ProductId AND PhSt.OutLetId = @OutletId 
							GROUP BY p.ProductId,p.GenericId,p.ProductName,p.PurchasePrice,p.SalePrice,p.FormationId
  
				 ) TempTable GROUP BY TempTable.ProductId, TempTable.ProductName,TempTable.GenericId,TempTable.PurchasePrice,TempTable.SalePrice,CurrentStock,FormationId
			 
	 ) T 
	  JOIN [Pharmacy].[OutletIndentDetails] d ON T.ProductId= d.BrandExtensionId
	   JOIN [Pharmacy].[OutletIndents] i ON i.Id = d.OutletIndentId
	   left join [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on d.Status=st.Id
	   WHERE i.Id = @IndentId 
	   and d.Status != 3
END
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetIPDInvoiceDetailListByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;	
		SELECT i.Invdate,i.InvoicePrefix,i.InvoiceNo,bd.ProductId,bd.ProductName,bd.PkgUnit,id.Qty,id.SaleRate,id.TotalAmount,id.LotRecordId,ISNULL(u.UserName,'') UserName,i.TotalAmount TotalAmountTotal,i.Discount,i.GrandTotal,i.Id
		FROM [Pharmacy].[Invoices] i INNER JOIN 
			 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd on i.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id INNER JOIN 
			 [Pharmacy].[InvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvoiceId INNER JOIN 
			 [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on id.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId LEFT JOIN
			 [Identity].[Users] u on i.UserId=u.Id
		WHERE i.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
		ORDER BY i.Invdate,i.InvoiceNo, bd.ProductName
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetIPDInvoiceDetailListByPatientIdGroupDateSummary]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;	

		SELECT ProductName,Invdate,AVG(saleRate) saleRate,
		SUM(IssueQty) IssueQty,
		SUM(RETURNQty) RETURNQty,
		SUM(IssueQty) - SUM(RETURNQty) SoldQty,
		CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),(SUM(IssueQty) - SUM(RETURNQty)) *AVG(saleRate)) [TotalAmount]
		FROM 
		(
		SELECT bd.ProductName,id.SaleRate saleRate, 
		CASE WHEN id.Qty> 0 THEN id.Qty ELSE 0 END IssueQty,
		CASE WHEN id.Qty< 0 THEN id.Qty*-1 ELSE 0 END RETURNQty , 0 SoldQty, 0  TotalAmount,i.Invdate
		FROM [Pharmacy].[Invoices] i INNER JOIN 
			 [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pd on i.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id INNER JOIN 
			 [Pharmacy].[InvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvoiceId INNER JOIN 
			 [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on id.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId LEFT JOIN
			 [Identity].[Users] u on i.UserId=u.Id
		WHERE i.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId
		)T
		GROUP BY T.Invdate, T.ProductName
		ORDER BY t.Invdate
END
GO

--	Exec [Pharmacy].[spGetIPDInvoiceDetailWithReturnedListByPatientId] 'fb219fab-709b-49c3-f50c-08ddb15d8b9c'

CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetIPDInvoiceDetailWithReturnedListByPatientId]
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;	
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TmpTbl 
		SELECT bd.ProductId,bd.ProductName,bd.PkgUnit,sum(id.Qty) Qty,avg(id.SaleRate) SaleRate,sum(id.TotalAmount) TotalAmount,id.LotRecordId,'' UserName INTO #TmpTbl 
		FROM  
				[Pharmacy].[Invoices] i INNER JOIN 
				[Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pd on i.IPDPatientRecordId=pd.Id INNER JOIN 
				[Pharmacy].[InvoiceDetails] id on i.Id=id.InvoiceId INNER JOIN 
				[Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on id.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId LEFT JOIN
				[Identity].[Users] u on i.UserId=u.Id
		WHERE i.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId and id.Qty>0
		GROUP BY bd.ProductId,bd.ProductName,bd.PkgUnit,id.LotRecordId
		ORDER BY bd.ProductName
		
		SELECT tb.*,isnull(tbl.Qty,0) ReturnedQty
		 FROM #TmpTbl tb left join
			  (
				SELECT mid.BrandExtensionId,sum(mid.Qty) Qty,mid.LotRecordId
				  FROM [Hospital].[MedicineReturnIndents] mi inner join
					   [Hospital].[MedicineReturnIndentDetails] mid on mi.Id=mid.MedicineRetirnIndentId
				 WHERE mi.IPDPatientId=@PatientId and mid.Status != 4
				 GROUP BY mid.BrandExtensionId,mid.LotRecordId
			  ) tbl on tb.ProductId=tbl.BrandExtensionId and tb.LotRecordId=tbl.LotRecordId
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[spGetIPDMedicineBill]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/

-- exec Pharmacy.spGetIPDMedicineBill

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[spGetIPDMedicineBill]
AS
BEGIN
	with patients as (select 
			p.Id,
			p.InvoiceNo,
			p.FullName,
			p.IsNotified, 
			p.IsClearedForDischarge, 
			p.IsClearedFromPharmacy, 
			p.IsClearedFromNurseStation, 
			p.IsClearedFromDoD, 
			rr.MobileNo,
			c.CabinNo
		from Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p 
		join Hospital.RegRecords rr on p.UHID = rr.UHID
		JOIN Hospital.IPDCabinAllocationRecords AS ca ON p.Id = ca.PatientId 
		JOIN Hospital.Cabins AS c ON ca.CabinId = c.Id 
		where p.DischargeByUserId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
		and (ca.IsOccupiedByPatient = 1)
	 ),

	 bills as (
		 select 
			t.Id PatientId,
			sum(TotalSale) TotalAmount, 
			abs(Sum(TotalReturn)) TotalReturn,
			0 PaidAmount, 
			0 TotalDiscount
		from (select 
				 p.Id,
				 Case When inv.ServeTypeId = 7 Then ROUND(isnull(SUM(d.TotalAmount),0),2) Else 0 End TotalSale,
				 Case When inv.ServeTypeId = 14 Then ROUND(isnull(SUM(d.TotalAmount),0),2) Else 0 End TotalReturn,
				 0 PaidAmount, 
				 0 TotalDiscount
			 from Pharmacy.Invoices inv
				 join patients p on p.Id = inv.IPDPatientRecordId
				 join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = inv.Id 
			 group by p.Id, p.InvoiceNo, p.CabinNo, p.FullName, p.MobileNo, inv.ServeTypeId) t
		group by t.Id
	 )

	 select p.*, b.* from patients p join bills b on b.PatientId = p.Id
END

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SpGetIPDMedicineIndentByDates ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetIPDMedicineIndentByDates]
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier,
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@GetDischargeFlag int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	declare @emtyId uniqueIdentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';

	With medicineIndents as
	(
	   Select * from  [Pharmacy].[IPDMedicineIndents] mi  where CONVERT(date,mi.IndentDateTime) >= convert(date,@FromDate) and convert(date,mi.IndentDateTime) <= convert(date,@ToDate)
	), 

	IndentsWithOutlets as (
	
	   Select mi.*,mo.Name MedicineOutletName from medicineIndents mi join [Pharmacy].[MedicineOutlets] mo on mi.IndentToOutletId=mo.Id
	
	)
	

	
	
	select mi.Id,mi.IPDPatientId,CabinNo=mi.CabinNo,mi.CabinType,mi.IndentDateTime,mi.IndentToOutletId,mi.UserId,mi.IndentNo,mi.Priority,
		CAST(case when mi.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when mi.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when mi.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  when mi.Priority=3 then 'Others'
			  when mi.Priority=4 then 'New Admission'
			  else 'Discharge' end as nvarchar) as PriorityText,
			mi.ServeTypeId,mi.OTRoomName,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.FullName PatientName, u.UserName,mi.MedicineOutletName,st.Name Status,i.InvoiceNo SaleInvoiceNo,i.Invdate ServedDateTime
	  from IndentsWithOutlets mi inner join
	       [Hospital].[IPDPatientRecords] pr on mi.IPDPatientId=pr.Id 
		    left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on mi.UserId=u.Id left join
		   [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on mi.ServeTypeId=st.Id left join
		   [Pharmacy].[Invoices] i on mi.Id=i.IPDIndentId
	 where (( @Id=@emtyId) or (@Id!=@emtyId and mi.Id=@Id))
	       and ((@GetDischargeFlag=0 and pr.DischargeByUserId=@emtyId) or @GetDischargeFlag=1)
		   and (mi.IndentToOutletId=@OutletId or @OutletId=@emtyId) and mi.IsDeleted=0
END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[SpGetIPDMedicineIndentById]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetIPDMedicineIndentById] '38329c6d-1595-4195-86eb-08ddb96be3fb'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetIPDMedicineIndentById]
	 @IndentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN

	Select 
		i.Id,
		i.IndentNo,
		i.IPDPatientId,
		i.CabinNo,
		i.CabinType,
		p.FullName,
		i.IndentDateTime,
		i.UserId,
		ISNULL(u.UserName, '') UserName,
		i.[Priority],
		o.Name MedicineOutletName,
		(case when i.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			when i.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			when i.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			when i.Priority=3 then 'Others'
			when i.Priority=4 then 'New Admission'
			else 'Discharge' end) as PriorityText,
		i.ServeTypeId,
		st.Name [Status],
		i.ServedDateTime,
		i.OTRoomName,
		ISNULL(inv.InvoiceNo, cast(0 as bigint)) SaleInvoiceNo
	from  Hospital.IPDPatientRecords p
	join Pharmacy.IPDMedicineIndents i on i.IPDPatientId = p.Id
	join [Identity].Users u on u.Id = i.UserId
	join [Admin].ServeTypes st on i.ServeTypeId=st.Id
	join Pharmacy.MedicineOutlets o on o.Id = i.IndentToOutletId
	left join Pharmacy.Invoices inv on inv.IPDIndentId = i.Id
	where i.Id = @IndentId
END
GO

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SpGetOutletBrandAndStockByOutletId ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---  exec  [Pharmacy].[SpGetOutletBrandAndStockByOutletId]     '9f2d97f5-0bb1-4d2b-b2e6-1940afb823ec','napa'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetOutletBrandAndStockByOutletId]
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	,@filterString NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF (
			@filterString IS NULL
			OR @filterString = ''
			)
	BEGIN
	
			SELECT isnull(sd.ProductId, bd.ProductId) ProductId
				,isnull(sd.ProductName, bd.ProductName) ProductName
			
				,sum(cast(isnull(sd.CurrentStock, 0.0) AS REAL)) CurrentStock
				,isnull(sd.PurchasePrice, bd.PurchasePrice) PurchasePrice
				,isnull(sd.SalePrice, bd.SalePrice) SalePrice
				,isnull(sd.Manufacturer, bd.Manufacturer) Manufacturer
				,isnull(sd.Generic, bd.Generic) Generic
				,isnull(sd.GenericId, bd.GenericId) GenericId
				,isnull(sd.PkgUnit, bd.PkgUnit) PkgUnit
				,isnull(sd.QtyPerBox, bd.QtyPerBox) QtyPerBox
				,isnull(sd.ROL, 0) ROL
				,isnull(sd.OutLetId, '35B5AF7A-34D6-45C8-A4C9-1156B5A41B90') OutLetId
				,ISNULL(o.Name, '') OutletName
				,isnull(sd.ManufacturerId, bd.ManufacturerId) ManufacturerId
			FROM [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd
			JOIN
				--  [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] sd on bd.ProductId=sd.ProductId and sd.OutLetId ='35B5AF7A-34D6-45C8-A4C9-1156B5A41B90') T where T.ProductName like '%'+ @filterString +'%' 
				[Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] sd ON bd.ProductId = sd.ProductId
				--AND sd.OutLetId = @OutletId
				left join Pharmacy.MedicineOutlets o on sd.OutLetId = o.Id
				group by sd.ProductId, bd.ProductId, sd.ManufacturerId, bd.ManufacturerId, sd.OutLetId, sd.ROL,sd.QtyPerBox, bd.QtyPerBox, 
			sd.QtyPerBox, bd.QtyPerBox,sd.GenericId, bd.GenericId,sd.Generic, bd.Generic,sd.Manufacturer, bd.Manufacturer, sd.SalePrice, bd.SalePrice
			,sd.PurchasePrice, bd.PurchasePrice, sd.ProductName, bd.ProductName, sd.PkgUnit, bd.PkgUnit, o.Name
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT isnull(sd.ProductId, bd.ProductId) ProductId
				,isnull(sd.ProductName, bd.ProductName) ProductName
			
				,sum(cast(isnull(sd.CurrentStock, 0.0) AS REAL)) CurrentStock
				,isnull(sd.PurchasePrice, bd.PurchasePrice) PurchasePrice
				,isnull(sd.SalePrice, bd.SalePrice) SalePrice
				,isnull(sd.Manufacturer, bd.Manufacturer) Manufacturer
				,isnull(sd.Generic, bd.Generic) Generic
				,isnull(sd.GenericId, bd.GenericId) GenericId
				,isnull(sd.PkgUnit, bd.PkgUnit) PkgUnit
				,isnull(sd.QtyPerBox, bd.QtyPerBox) QtyPerBox
				,isnull(sd.ROL, 0) ROL
				,isnull(sd.OutLetId, '35B5AF7A-34D6-45C8-A4C9-1156B5A41B90') OutLetId
				,ISNULL(o.Name, '') OutletName
				,isnull(sd.ManufacturerId, bd.ManufacturerId) ManufacturerId
			FROM [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd
			JOIN [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] sd ON bd.ProductId = sd.ProductId
			left join Pharmacy.MedicineOutlets o on sd.OutLetId = o.Id
			where bd.ProductName LIKE '%' + @filterString + '%'
			group by sd.ProductId, bd.ProductId, sd.ManufacturerId, bd.ManufacturerId, sd.OutLetId, sd.ROL,sd.QtyPerBox, bd.QtyPerBox, 
			 sd.QtyPerBox, bd.QtyPerBox,sd.GenericId, bd.GenericId,sd.Generic, bd.Generic,sd.Manufacturer, bd.Manufacturer, sd.SalePrice, bd.SalePrice
			 ,sd.PurchasePrice, bd.PurchasePrice, sd.ProductName, bd.ProductName, sd.PkgUnit, bd.PkgUnit, o.Name
	END
END
GO

		   ,isnull(sd.Generic,bd.Generic) Generic,isnull(sd.GenericId,bd.GenericId) GenericId,isnull(sd.PkgUnit,bd.PkgUnit) PkgUnit,isnull(sd.QtyPerBox,bd.QtyPerBox) QtyPerBox,isnull(sd.ROL,0) ROL
		   ,isnull(sd.OutLetId,'B3460493-95D4-4A3B-8EAC-47BE93C2ADFA') OutLetId,isnull(sd.ManufacturerId,bd.ManufacturerId) ManufacturerId
	        from [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd left join
		   [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] sd on bd.ProductId=sd.ProductId and sd.OutLetId='B3460493-95D4-4A3B-8EAC-47BE93C2ADFA') T where T.ProductName like '%'+ @filterString +'%'

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetOutletBrandDetailForPurchaseOrder] 'B3460493-95D4-4A3B-8EAC-47BE93C2ADFA'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetOutletBrandDetailForPurchaseOrder]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @OutLetId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT bd.*,ISNULL(stockTbl.CurrentStock, 0) CurrentStock,ISNULL(rolTbl.ROL,0) ROL
	FROM [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd LEFT JOIN
		 (
			SELECT vbsd.ProductId, SUM(vbsd.CurrentStock) AS CurrentStock
			FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] vbsd
			WHERE vbsd.OutLetId=@OutletId
			GROUP BY vbsd.ProductId
		 ) stockTbl ON bd.ProductId=stockTbl.ProductId LEFT JOIN
		 (
			SELECT rr.BrandExtensionId,rr.ROL
			FROM [Pharmacy].[ROLRecords] rr
			WHERE rr.OutletId=@OutletId
		 ) rolTbl ON bd.ProductId=rolTbl.BrandExtensionId   
END

BEGIN

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (

		)

		)

		DECLARE @NextEndDate date

		select @NextEndDate = dateadd(day,1,@FilterEndDate)

		If @RowCountNextEndDate =1

			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate

		else

			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate

			--select * from

DECLARE @ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR

		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost =

				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock

				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)

		select @FilterEndDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

--return

	select( 
select * from (

		select  ProdName,round(sum(PurchasePrice),2) PurchasePrice,round (sum(SalePrice),2) SalePrice,
		sum(OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance, sum(NewPurchase) NewPurchase, sum(ReturnQty) ReturnQty,
		sum(OutletReceive) OutletReceive, sum(CertifiedReceive) CertifiedReceive, sum(SRReceive) SRReceive,

		(
