		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		)
	 ClosingBalance,
	  sum(currentDBStock) currentDBStock,
	 round(sum(OPAmount),2) OPAmount, 
	 case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount),2) else 
		round(
		isnull((
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		),0)
		
		*

	 
	 --sum(ClosingAmount),2) 
	 round(sum(SalePrice),0),2) 
	
	 end ClosingAmount1,
	 --case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(SalePrice),2) else  
	 (
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
	) *
	round(sum(SalePrice),2) 
	ClosingAmount,
	 --isnull((
		--sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		--sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		--)*isnull(sum(ClosingAmount),0),0) ClosingAmount,
	
		 SupplierName
	
		FROM 
		(

		--	ProdName PurchasePrice SalePrice , 
					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					b.SalePrice PurchasePrice, 
					b.PurchasePrice SalePrice,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					from Pharmacy.BrandDetails b

			-- Opening
			UNION ALL
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					case when t.FilterStartDateStock<0 then 0 else t.FilterStartDateStock end   OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					----t.FilterStartDateStock 
					----* t.FilterStartProductAvgCost 
					t.FilterStartDateStock  *
					b.PurchasePrice
					OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				
				and (t.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				--group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
				
		
			-- NewPurchase
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					sum(srd.qty) NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 4 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 16)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId


			-- NewPurchase Avg Amount
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					sum(srd.TotalAmount)/ sum(srd.qty)
					--avg(be.PurchasePrice)
					NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15)
						--and b.ProductName like '%ESOTID MUPS  40 MG%'
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId
					having sum(srd.qty)>=1
					

			-- Return
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					abs(sum(d.Qty))  ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

				
			-- OutletReceive
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					sum(d.Qty) OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ToOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			

			-- IPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					sum(d.Qty) IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 7 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- OPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					sum(d.Qty) OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- sRETURN
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					SUM(D.Qty) SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndents i 
						join Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndentDetails d on d.SupplierReturnIndentId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.RetDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.RetDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (d.Status=9)
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- OutletTransfer
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					sum(d.Qty) Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			UNION ALL

			 
				select 
				be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					be.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					sum(v.CurrentStock) currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId


		  -- Closing

			UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				    avg( t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				group by b.ProductId, b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
	

						UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				     t.FilterStartProductAvgCost ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId <>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and t.OutletID = @OutletId
		
		  -----SupplierName-----
		  Union All
		  		select 
					be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					'' SupplierName,
					--isnull(be.Manufacturer,'') SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = be.ProductId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId

	
					

	)
	T
	--where T.ProdName ='Dpr. - Diaper (Giggle) baby  '		

	--where T.ProductId ='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
	--where T.ProdName ='Srp. - Brodil 100 ml' 
	--T.ProdName ='INJ - ALBUTEIN 25% / 100 ML' 
	--and ( T.OpeningBalance <> 0 ) --or T.ClosingBalance <> 0 or T.NewPurchase <> 0
	Group by SupplierName,ProdName,ProductId
	having sum(T.OpeningBalance) <> 0  or sum(T.ClosingBalance) <> 0 or sum(T.NewPurchase) <> 0 or sum(T.ReturnQty) <> 0 or sum(T.OutletReceive) <> 0 
	or sum(T.CertifiedReceive) <> 0 or sum(T.IPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.OPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.SReturn) <> 0 or sum(T.Outlettransfer) <> 0 
	or sum(T.CertifiedSale) <> 0 or sum(T.DamageTransfer) <> 0
	) tbl
	order by tbl.SupplierName
	FOR JSON AUTO ) as Data
END
----------------


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStock_Test]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStock_Test]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


create       PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStock_Test]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@OutLetId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	DECLARE @FilterStartDate date = getdate()
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date = getdate()
    DECLARE @ProductId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @CurrentStock   float,
	@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
	@ProductStockFilterEndDate nvarchar(max),
	@Char char ='#',
	@AvgCost char ='@',
	@Outlet char ='$',
	@LastChar char ='*'

	
	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
	
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@OutletId,@SupplierId

	--return


	

	

		DECLARE @AvgCost_Vat char ='$'
	
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_ID uniqueidentifier
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_stock float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @OpeningOutletID uniqueidentifier

		


		Create table #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		Create table #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID uniqueidentifier
		)

		Create table #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		Create table #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID uniqueidentifier
		)

		select @ProductStock= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterStartDate
		DECLARE @NextEndDate date
		DECLARE @RowCountNextEndDate int
		select @NextEndDate = dateadd(day,1,@FilterEndDate)

		select @RowCountNextEndDate =count(t.ProductStock) from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t  where t.FilterDate =@NextEndDate
		
		
	
		
		If @RowCountNextEndDate =1
		begin
			
			select @ProductStockFilterEndDate= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @NextEndDate
			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStockFilterEndDate,',')
			

		end
		else
		begin
			select @ProductStockFilterEndDate= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterEndDate
			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStockFilterEndDate,',')
		end

		
		

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStock,',')

			 



			--select * from 

--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

		
		select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterStartDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--==========================================================--



--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStockEndDateWise nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
	
		select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterEndDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate where ProductID ='8B121B0F-2D3D-4860-A997-FD76DCB0BDCF'
--return 


--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
--where t.ProductId='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'

--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
--where t.ProductId='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
--return
--==========================================================--


		
--	select( 
--select * from (

		select  ProdName,round(sum(PurchasePrice),2) PurchasePrice,round (sum(SalePrice),2) SalePrice,
		sum(OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance, sum(NewPurchase) NewPurchase, sum(ReturnQty) ReturnQty,
		sum(OutletReceive) OutletReceive, sum(CertifiedReceive) CertifiedReceive, sum(SRReceive) SRReceive,
		sum(IPDSale) IPDSale,sum(OPDSale) OPDSale,sum(SReturn) SReturn,sum(Outlettransfer) Outlettransfer,
		sum(CertifiedSale) CertifiedSale,sum(DamageTransfer) DamageTransfer,

		(
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		)
	 ClosingBalance,
	  sum(currentDBStock) currentDBStock,
	 round(sum(OPAmount),2) OPAmount, 
	 case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount),2) else 
		round(
		isnull((
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		),0)
		
		*

	 
	 --sum(ClosingAmount),2) 
	 round(sum(SalePrice),0),2) 
	
	 end ClosingAmount1,
	 --case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(SalePrice),2) else  
	 (
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
	) *
	round(sum(SalePrice),2) 
	ClosingAmount,
	 --isnull((
		--sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		--sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		--)*isnull(sum(ClosingAmount),0),0) ClosingAmount,
	
		 SupplierName
	
		FROM 
		(

		--	ProdName PurchasePrice SalePrice , 
					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					b.SalePrice PurchasePrice, 
					b.PurchasePrice SalePrice,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					from Pharmacy.BrandDetails b

			-- Opening
			UNION ALL
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					case when t.FilterStartDateStock<0 then 0 else t.FilterStartDateStock end   OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					----t.FilterStartDateStock 
					----* t.FilterStartProductAvgCost 
					t.FilterStartDateStock  *
					b.PurchasePrice
					OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				
				and (t.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				--group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
				
		
			-- NewPurchase
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					sum(srd.qty) NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 4 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 16)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId


			-- NewPurchase Avg Amount
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					sum(srd.TotalAmount)/ sum(srd.qty)
					--avg(be.PurchasePrice)
					NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15)
						--and b.ProductName like '%ESOTID MUPS  40 MG%'
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId
					having sum(srd.qty)>=1
					

			-- Return
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					abs(sum(d.Qty))  ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

				
			-- OutletReceive
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					sum(d.Qty) OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ToOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			

			-- IPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					sum(d.Qty) IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 7 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- OPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					sum(d.Qty) OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- sRETURN
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					SUM(D.Qty) SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndents i 
						join Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndentDetails d on d.SupplierReturnIndentId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.RetDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.RetDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (d.Status=9)
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- OutletTransfer
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					sum(d.Qty) Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			UNION ALL

			 
				select 
				be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					be.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					sum(v.CurrentStock) currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId


		  -- Closing

			UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				    avg( t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				group by b.ProductId, b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
	

						UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				     t.FilterStartProductAvgCost ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId <>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and t.OutletID = @OutletId
		
		  -----SupplierName-----
		  Union All
		  		select 
					be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					'' SupplierName,
					--isnull(be.Manufacturer,'') SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = be.ProductId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId

	
					

	)
	T
	--where T.ProdName ='Dpr. - Diaper (Giggle) baby  '		

	--where T.ProductId ='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
	--where T.ProdName ='Srp. - Brodil 100 ml' 
	--T.ProdName ='INJ - ALBUTEIN 25% / 100 ML' 
	--and ( T.OpeningBalance <> 0 ) --or T.ClosingBalance <> 0 or T.NewPurchase <> 0
		where ClosingBalance >0
	Group by SupplierName,ProdName,ProductId

	--having sum(T.OpeningBalance) <> 0  or sum(T.ClosingBalance) <> 0 or sum(T.NewPurchase) <> 0 or sum(T.ReturnQty) <> 0 or sum(T.OutletReceive) <> 0 
	--or sum(T.CertifiedReceive) <> 0 or sum(T.IPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.OPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.SReturn) <> 0 or sum(T.Outlettransfer) <> 0 
	--or sum(T.CertifiedSale) <> 0 or sum(T.DamageTransfer) <> 0
	--) tbl
	--order by tbl.SupplierName
	--FOR JSON AUTO ) as Data
END
