--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStockFormationWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStockFormationWise]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@OutLetId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	DECLARE @FilterStartDate date = getdate()
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date = getdate()
    DECLARE @ProductId int, 
    @CurrentStock   float,
	@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
	@ProductStockFilterEndDate nvarchar(max),
	@Char char ='#',
	@AvgCost char ='@',
	@Outlet char ='$',
	@LastChar char ='*'

	
	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
	
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@OutletId,@SupplierId

	--return


	

	

		DECLARE @AvgCost_Vat char ='$'
	
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_ID uniqueidentifier
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_stock float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @OpeningOutletID nvarchar(max)

		Create table #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		Create table #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID int
		)

		Create table #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		Create table #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID int
		)

		select @ProductStock= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterStartDate
		DECLARE @NextEndDate date
		DECLARE @RowCountNextEndDate int
		select @NextEndDate = dateadd(day,1,@FilterEndDate)

		select @RowCountNextEndDate =count(t.ProductStock) from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t  where t.FilterDate =@NextEndDate
		

		
		
		If @RowCountNextEndDate =1
		begin
			
			select @ProductStockFilterEndDate= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @NextEndDate
			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStockFilterEndDate,',')
			

		end
		else
		begin
			select @ProductStockFilterEndDate= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterEndDate
			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStockFilterEndDate,',')
		end

		
		

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStock,',')

			


			--select * from 

--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

		
		select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterStartDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--==========================================================--





--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStockEndDateWise nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
	
		select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterEndDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate where ProductID ='8B121B0F-2D3D-4860-A997-FD76DCB0BDCF'
--return 


--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
--where t.ProductId='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'

--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
--where t.ProductId='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
--return
--==========================================================--


--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
--return



		
	select( 
 select * from (
select  f.Name FormationsName, 
ProdName, 
PurchasePrice, 
SalePrice,
OpeningBalance,  
NewPurchase,  
ReturnQty,
OutletReceive,  
CertifiedReceive,  
SRReceive,
IPDSale,
OPDSale, 
SReturn, 
Outlettransfer,
CertifiedSale,
DamageTransfer,
ClosingBalance,
currentDBStock,
OPAmount, 
ClosingAmount1,
ClosingAmount,
SupplierName

from (

		select  FormationId, ProdName,round(sum(PurchasePrice),2) PurchasePrice,round (sum(SalePrice),2) SalePrice,
		sum(OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance, sum(NewPurchase) NewPurchase, sum(ReturnQty) ReturnQty,
		sum(OutletReceive) OutletReceive, sum(CertifiedReceive) CertifiedReceive, sum(SRReceive) SRReceive,
		sum(IPDSale) IPDSale,sum(OPDSale) OPDSale,sum(SReturn) SReturn,sum(Outlettransfer) Outlettransfer,
		sum(CertifiedSale) CertifiedSale,sum(DamageTransfer) DamageTransfer,

		(
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		)
	 ClosingBalance,
	  sum(currentDBStock) currentDBStock,
	 round(sum(OPAmount),2) OPAmount, 
	 case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount),2) else 
		round(
		isnull((
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		),0)
		
		*

	 
	 --sum(ClosingAmount),2) 
	 round(sum(SalePrice),0),2) 
	
	 end ClosingAmount1,
	 --case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(SalePrice),2) else  
	 (
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
	) *
	round(sum(SalePrice),2) 
	ClosingAmount,
	 --isnull((
		--sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		--sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		--)*isnull(sum(ClosingAmount),0),0) ClosingAmount,
	
		 SupplierName
	
		FROM 
		(

		--	ProdName PurchasePrice SalePrice , 
					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					b.SalePrice PurchasePrice, 
					b.PurchasePrice SalePrice,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
					from Pharmacy.BrandDetails b
			-- Opening
			UNION ALL
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					t.FilterStartDateStock OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					----t.FilterStartDateStock 
					----* t.FilterStartProductAvgCost 
					t.FilterStartDateStock  *
					b.PurchasePrice
					OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				
				and (t.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				--group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
				--/*
			-- NewPurchase
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					sum(srd.qty) NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 4 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 16)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId


			-- NewPurchase Avg Amount
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					sum(srd.TotalAmount)/ sum(srd.qty)
					--avg(be.PurchasePrice)
					NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15)
						--and b.ProductName like '%ESOTID MUPS  40 MG%'
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId
					having sum(srd.qty)>=1
					

			-- Return
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					abs(sum(d.Qty))  ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId

				
			-- OutletReceive
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					sum(d.Qty) OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ToOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId

			

			-- IPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					sum(d.Qty) IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 7 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId

			-- OPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					sum(d.Qty) OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId

			-- sRETURN
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					SUM(D.Qty) SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
						from Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndents i 
						join Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndentDetails d on d.SupplierReturnIndentId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.RetDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.RetDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (d.Status=9)
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId

			-- OutletTransfer
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					sum(d.Qty) Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId,b.FormationId

			UNION ALL

			 
				select 
				be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					be.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					sum(v.CurrentStock) currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId,b.FormationId


		  -- Closing

			UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				    avg( t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId =0
				group by b.ProductId, b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.FormationId
				
						UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				     t.FilterStartProductAvgCost ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId <>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and t.OutletID = @OutletId

		  -----SupplierName-----
		  Union All
		  		select 
					be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					'' SupplierName,
					--isnull(be.Manufacturer,'') SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					,b.FormationId
				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = be.ProductId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId,b.FormationId

					--*/


	)
	T
	--where T.ProdName ='Dpr. - Diaper (Giggle) baby  '		

	--where T.ProductId ='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
	--where T.ProdName ='Srp. - Brodil 100 ml' 
	--T.ProdName ='INJ - ALBUTEIN 25% / 100 ML' 
	--and ( T.OpeningBalance <> 0 ) --or T.ClosingBalance <> 0 or T.NewPurchase <> 0
	Group by SupplierName,ProdName,ProductId,FormationId
	having sum(T.OpeningBalance) <> 0  or sum(T.ClosingBalance) <> 0 or sum(T.NewPurchase) <> 0 or sum(T.ReturnQty) <> 0 or sum(T.OutletReceive) <> 0 
	or sum(T.CertifiedReceive) <> 0 or sum(T.IPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.OPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.SReturn) <> 0 or sum(T.Outlettransfer) <> 0 
	or sum(T.CertifiedSale) <> 0 or sum(T.DamageTransfer) <> 0
	) tbl
	join Pharmacy.Formations f on f.id=tbl.FormationId
	) tb order by tb.SupplierName
	FOR JSON AUTO ) as Data
END


----------

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStockTemp]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStockTemp]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrantStockTemp]
		@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@SupplierId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	DECLARE @FilterStartDate date = getdate()
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate date = getdate()
    DECLARE @ProductId int, 
    @CurrentStock   float,
	@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
	@ProductStockFilterEndDate nvarchar(max),
	@Char char ='#',
	@AvgCost char ='@',
	@Outlet char ='$',
	@LastChar char ='*'

	
	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
	
	--select @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@OutletId,@SupplierId

	--return


	

	

		DECLARE @AvgCost_Vat char ='$'
	
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_ID uniqueidentifier
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_stock float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @OpeningOutletID nvarchar(max)

		Create table #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		Create table #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID int
		)

		Create table #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		Create table #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID int
		)

		select @ProductStock= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterStartDate
		DECLARE @NextEndDate date
		DECLARE @RowCountNextEndDate int
		select @NextEndDate = dateadd(day,1,@FilterEndDate)

		select @RowCountNextEndDate =count(t.ProductStock) from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t  where t.FilterDate =@NextEndDate
		

		
		
		If @RowCountNextEndDate =1
		begin
			
			select @ProductStockFilterEndDate= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @NextEndDate
			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStockFilterEndDate,',')
			

		end
		else
		begin
			select @ProductStockFilterEndDate= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterEndDate
			insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStockFilterEndDate,',')
		end

		
		

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStock,',')

			


			--select * from 

--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

		
		select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterStartDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--==========================================================--





--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStockEndDateWise nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from #tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
	
		select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterEndDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate where ProductID ='8B121B0F-2D3D-4860-A997-FD76DCB0BDCF'
--return 


--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
--where t.ProductId='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'

--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
--where t.ProductId='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
--return
--==========================================================--


--select * from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
--return



		
	--select( 
select * from (

		select  ProdName,round(sum(PurchasePrice),2) PurchasePrice,round (sum(SalePrice),2) SalePrice,
		sum(OpeningBalance) OpeningBalance, sum(NewPurchase) NewPurchase, sum(ReturnQty) ReturnQty,
		sum(OutletReceive) OutletReceive, sum(CertifiedReceive) CertifiedReceive, sum(SRReceive) SRReceive,
		sum(IPDSale) IPDSale,sum(OPDSale) OPDSale,sum(SReturn) SReturn,sum(Outlettransfer) Outlettransfer,
		sum(CertifiedSale) CertifiedSale,sum(DamageTransfer) DamageTransfer,

		(
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		)
	 ClosingBalance,
	  sum(currentDBStock) currentDBStock,
	 round(sum(OPAmount),2) OPAmount, 
	 case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount),2) else 
		round(
		isnull((
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		),0)
		
		*

	 
	 --sum(ClosingAmount),2) 
	 round(sum(SalePrice),0),2) 
	
	 end ClosingAmount1,
	 --case when sum(OpeningBalance) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(SalePrice),2) else  
	 (
		sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
	) *
	round(sum(SalePrice),2) 
	ClosingAmount
	 --isnull((
		--sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
		--sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
		--)*isnull(sum(ClosingAmount),0),0) ClosingAmount,
	
		 
	
		FROM 
		(

		--	ProdName PurchasePrice SalePrice , 
					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					b.SalePrice PurchasePrice, 
					b.PurchasePrice SalePrice,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					from Pharmacy.BrandDetails b
			-- Opening
			UNION ALL
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					t.FilterStartDateStock OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					----t.FilterStartDateStock 
					----* t.FilterStartProductAvgCost 
					t.FilterStartDateStock  *
					b.PurchasePrice
					OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				
				and (t.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
				--group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
				--/*
			-- NewPurchase
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					sum(srd.qty) NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 4 and sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 16)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId


			-- NewPurchase Avg Amount
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					sum(srd.TotalAmount)/ sum(srd.qty)
					--avg(be.PurchasePrice)
					NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
						join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd on srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=srd.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,sr.EntryDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (sr.OutletID = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						and (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15)
						--and b.ProductName like '%ESOTID MUPS  40 MG%'
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId
					having sum(srd.qty)>=1
					

			-- Return
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					abs(sum(d.Qty))  ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

				
			-- OutletReceive
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					sum(d.Qty) OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ToOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			

			-- IPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					sum(d.Qty) IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 7 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- OPDSales
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					sum(d.Qty) OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
						join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.Invdate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.Invdate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
						and (i.MedicineOutLetId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- sRETURN
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					SUM(D.Qty) SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndents i 
						join Pharmacy.SupplierReturnIndentDetails d on d.SupplierReturnIndentId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.RetDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.RetDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (d.Status=9)
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 8 or i.ServeTypeId =0 )
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			-- OutletTransfer
			Union All

					select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					sum(d.Qty) Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					
						from Pharmacy.StockTransfer i 
						join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on d.TransferId = i.Id
						join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be on be.Id=d.BrandExtensionId
						join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = be.Id
						where convert(date,i.TransferDate) > = @FilterStartDate
						and convert(date,i.TransferDate) < = @FilterEndDate
						and (i.FromOutletId  = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
						--and (i.ServeTypeId = 15 or i.ServeTypeId = 14 or i.ServeTypeId =7)
					group by b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer,b.ProductId

			UNION ALL

			 
				select 
				be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					be.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					sum(v.CurrentStock) currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId


		  -- Closing

			UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				    avg( t.FilterStartProductAvgCost) ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
				group by b.ProductId, b.ProductName,b.Manufacturer
				
						UNION ALL
			
				select 
					b.ProductId,
					b.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
				     t.FilterStartProductAvgCost ClosingAmount, 
					b.Manufacturer SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				from #tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistoryEndDate t
				join Pharmacy.BrandDetails b on b.ProductId = t.ProductID
				and   @OutletId <>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and t.OutletID = @OutletId

		  -----SupplierName-----
		  Union All
		  		select 
					be.ProductId,
					be.ProductName ProdName, 
					0 PP, 
					0 SaleP,
					0 OpeningBalance,
					0 NewPurchase,
					0 ReturnQty,
					0 OutletReceive,
					0 CertifiedReceive,
					0 SRReceive,
					0 IPDSale,
					0 OPDSale,
					0 SReturn,
					0 Outlettransfer,
					0 CertifiedSale,
					0 DamageTransfer,
					0 ClosingBalance,
					0 OPAmount,
					0 ClosingAmount, 
					'' SupplierName,
					--isnull(be.Manufacturer,'') SupplierName,
					0 currentDBStock,
					0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount

				
			 
		    FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join Pharmacy.BrandDetails be on be.ProductId = b.Id
		   where 		b.Id = be.ProductId
					and (v.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		  group by be.ProductName,v.OutLetId,be.Manufacturer,be.ProductId

					--*/


	)
	T
	--where T.ProdName ='Dpr. - Diaper (Giggle) baby  '		

	--where T.ProductId ='D7EBAB30-29BD-4039-EE01-08DBA5F72223'
	--where T.ProdName ='Srp. - Brodil 100 ml' 
	--T.ProdName ='INJ - ALBUTEIN 25% / 100 ML' 
	--and ( T.OpeningBalance <> 0 ) --or T.ClosingBalance <> 0 or T.NewPurchase <> 0
	Group by ProdName,ProductId
	--having sum(T.OpeningBalance) <> 0  or sum(T.ClosingBalance) <> 0 or sum(T.NewPurchase) <> 0 or sum(T.ReturnQty) <> 0 or sum(T.OutletReceive) <> 0 
	--or sum(T.CertifiedReceive) <> 0 or sum(T.IPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.OPDSale) <> 0 or sum(T.SReturn) <> 0 or sum(T.Outlettransfer) <> 0 
	--or sum(T.CertifiedSale) <> 0 or sum(T.DamageTransfer) <> 0
	) tbl
	order by tbl.ProdName
	--FOR JSON AUTO ) as Data
END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrentStockAvgPurchesAmount]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrentStockAvgPurchesAmount]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyCurrentStockAvgPurchesAmount] @paramas NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @OutletId INT
		   ,@SupplierId uniqueidentifier

	DECLARE @FilterStartDate DATE = GETDATE()
	DECLARE @FilterEndDate DATE = GETDATE()
	DECLARE @ProductId INT
		   ,@CurrentStock FLOAT
		   ,@ProductStock NVARCHAR(MAX)
		   ,@ProductStockFilterEndDate NVARCHAR(MAX)
		   ,@Char CHAR = '#'
		   ,@AvgCost CHAR = '@'
		   ,@Outlet CHAR = '$'
		   ,@LastChar CHAR = '*'

	DECLARE @ProductName nvarchar(max)


	SELECT
		@FilterStartDate = CONVERT(DATE, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 1
	SELECT
		@FilterEndDate = CONVERT(DATE, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 2
	SELECT
		@OutletId = CONVERT(INT, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 7
	SELECT
		@SupplierId = CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 8


	SELECT
		@ProductName = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), T.Value)
	FROM (SELECT
			*
		FROM dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas)) T
	WHERE T.OrderNo = 10
	
	

	SELECT
(
		SELECT
				*
			FROM (
			
			SELECT
					SupplierName,
					ProductName
				   --,ROUND(SUM(PurchasePrice), 2) PurchasePrice
				   --,ROUND(SUM(SalePrice), 2) SalePrice
				   ,SUM(OpeningBalance) - SUM(OpeningIssueQty) OpeningBalance
				   --,SUM(T.OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount)  OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
				   ,SUM(NewPurchase) NewPurchase
				   --,SUM(NewPurchaseAmount) NewPurchaseAmount
				   
				   ,SUM(OutletReceive) OutletReceive
				   --,SUM(OutletReceiveAmount) OutletReceiveAmount
				   ,SUM(CertifiedReceive) CertifiedReceive
				   ,SUM(SRReceive) SRReceive
				   --,SUM(SRReceiveAmount) SRReceiveAmount
				   ,SUM(ReturnQty) ReturnReceiveQty 
				   --,SUM(ReturnAmount) ReturnAmount
				   
				   
					,(SUM(OpeningBalance) - SUM(OpeningIssueQty) )+ SUM(NewPurchase) 
					+ SUM(OutletReceive) + SUM(CertifiedReceive) +  SUM(SRReceive) + SUM(ReturnQty)
					[Total]
				   
				   ,SUM(IPDSale) IPDSale
				   --,SUM(IPDSaleAmount) IPDSaleAmount
				   ,SUM(OPDSale) OPDSale
				   ,SUM(SReturn) SReturn
				   
				   --,SUM(OPDSaleAmount) OPDSaleAmount
				   				   ,SUM(Outlettransfer) Outlettransfer
								   
				   --,SUM(OutlettransferAmount) OutlettransferAmount
				   
				   ,SUM(CertifiedSale) CertifiedSale
				   --,SUM(CertifiedSaleAmount) CertifiedSaleAmount
				   ,SUM(DamageTransfer) DamageTransfer
				   --,SUM(DamageTransferAmount) DamageTransferAmount
				   ,

					--sum( SReturnAmount) SReturnAmount,


					(
					(SUM(OpeningBalance) - SUM(OpeningIssueQty) )+ SUM(NewPurchase) 
					+ SUM(OutletReceive) + SUM(CertifiedReceive) +  SUM(SRReceive) + SUM(ReturnQty)

					- SUM(IPDSale) -
					SUM(OPDSale) - SUM(SReturn) - SUM(Outlettransfer) - SUM(CertifiedSale) - SUM(DamageTransfer)

					
					)
					ClosingBalance
					--,SUM(T.ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount)  ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount
				 --  ,SUM(currentDBStock) currentDBStock
				   --,ROUND(SUM(OPAmount), 2) OPAmount
				   , Convert(decimal(18,2), (SUM(OpeningBalance) - SUM(OpeningIssueQty)) * SUM(T.OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount)) OPAmount
				   ,
					------case when (sum(OpeningBalance)-SUM(OpeningIssueQty)) =0 and sum(NewPurchase) <> 0  then round(sum(NewPurchase)*sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount),2) else 
					------round(
					------isnull((
					------sum(OpeningBalance)-SUM(OpeningIssueQty) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
					------sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
					------),0)*


					------sum(ClosingAmount),2) end ClosingAmount,
					--isnull((
					--sum(OpeningBalance) + sum(NewPurchase) + sum(ReturnQty)+sum(OutletReceive)+sum(CertifiedReceive)+sum(SRReceive) - sum(IPDSale)-
					--sum(OPDSale)-sum(SReturn)-sum(Outlettransfer)-sum(CertifiedSale)-sum(DamageTransfer)
					--)*isnull(sum(ClosingAmount),0),0) ClosingAmount,

					----ROUND(SUM(OPAmount), 2) +
					----SUM(NewPurchaseAmount) +
					----SUM(ReturnAmount) +
					----SUM(OutletReceiveAmount) +
					----SUM(SRReceiveAmount) -
					----SUM(IPDSaleAmount) -
					----SUM(OPDSaleAmount) +
					----SUM(SReturnAmount) -
					----SUM(OutlettransferAmount) +
					----SUM(CertifiedSaleAmount) -
					----SUM(DamageTransferAmount)
					Convert(decimal(18,2),
					(
					SUM(OpeningBalance) - SUM(OpeningIssueQty) + SUM(NewPurchase) + SUM(ReturnQty) + SUM(OutletReceive) + SUM(CertifiedReceive) + SUM(SRReceive) - SUM(IPDSale) -
					SUM(OPDSale) - SUM(SReturn) - SUM(Outlettransfer) - SUM(CertifiedSale) - SUM(DamageTransfer)
					)
					* SUM(T.ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount))

					ClosingAmount
				   
				--,
				--sum(ClosingAmount),
				--sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount)
				--,
				--sum(NewPurchaseAvgAmount)
				FROM (

					-----================================= opening start====================================================
					
					
					SELECT
						b.ProductId
					   ,b.ProductName ProductName
					   ,b.PurchasePrice PurchasePrice
					   ,b.SalePrice SalePrice
					   ,0 OpeningBalance
					   ,0 OpeningIssueQty
					   ,0 NewPurchase
					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive
					   ,0 CertifiedReceive
					   ,0 SRReceive
					   ,0 IPDSale
					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn
					   ,0 Outlettransfer
					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAmount
					   ,0 ReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutletReceiveAmount
					   ,0 SRReceiveAmount
					   ,0 IPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 SReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutlettransferAmount
					   ,0 CertifiedSaleAmount
					   ,0 DamageTransferAmount
					   ,0 ClosingBalance
					   ,0 OPAmount
					   ,0 ClosingAmount
					   ,b.Manufacturer SupplierName
					   ,0 currentDBStock
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount
					FROM Pharmacy.BrandDetails b

					UNION ALL

					-- Opening Avg Purchse 
					SELECT
						b.ProductId
					   ,b.ProductName ProductName
					   ,0 PP
					   ,0 SaleP
					   ,SUM(srd.Qty) OpeningBalance
					   ,0 OpeningIssueQty
					   ,0 NewPurchase
					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive
					   ,0 CertifiedReceive
					   ,0 SRReceive
					   ,0 IPDSale
					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn
					   ,0 Outlettransfer
					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAmount
					   ,0 ReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutletReceiveAmount
					   ,0 SRReceiveAmount
					   ,0 IPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 SReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutlettransferAmount
					   ,0 CertifiedSaleAmount
					   ,0 DamageTransferAmount
					   ,0 ClosingBalance
					  ,0 OPAmount
					   ,--0 OPAmount,
						0 ClosingAmount
					   ,b.Manufacturer SupplierName
					   ,0 currentDBStock
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,avg(srd.PurchaseRate) OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount
					FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
					JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd
						ON srd.StockReceiveId = sr.Id
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be
						ON be.Id = srd.BrandExtensionId
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails b
						ON b.ProductId = be.Id
					WHERE CONVERT(DATE, sr.EntryDate) < @FilterStartDate
					AND (sr.OutletID = @OutletId
					OR @OutletId = 0)
					AND (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15
					AND sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14)
					GROUP BY b.ProductName
							,b.Manufacturer
							,b.ProductId
							
							

					-- NewPurchase
					UNION ALL

					SELECT
						b.ProductId
					   ,b.ProductName ProductName
					   ,0 PP
					   ,0 SaleP
					   ,0 OpeningBalance
					   ,0 OpeningIssueQty
					   ,0 NewPurchase
					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive
					   ,0 CertifiedReceive
					   ,0 SRReceive
					   ,0 IPDSale
					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn
					   ,0 Outlettransfer
					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAmount
					   ,0 ReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutletReceiveAmount
					   ,0 SRReceiveAmount
					   ,0 IPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 SReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutlettransferAmount
					   ,0 CertifiedSaleAmount
					   ,0 DamageTransferAmount
					   ,0 ClosingBalance
					   ,0 OPAmount
					   ,0 ClosingAmount
					   ,b.Manufacturer SupplierName
					   ,0 currentDBStock
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount

					FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
					JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd
						ON srd.StockReceiveId = sr.Id
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be
						ON be.Id = srd.BrandExtensionId
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails b
						ON b.ProductId = be.Id
					WHERE CONVERT(DATE, sr.EntryDate) < @FilterStartDate
					AND (sr.OutletID = @OutletId
					OR @OutletId = 0)
					AND (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15
					AND sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14)
					GROUP BY b.ProductName
							,b.Manufacturer
							,b.ProductId

			-- NewPurchase Avg Amount
					UNION ALL

					SELECT
						b.ProductId
					   ,b.ProductName ProductName
					   ,0 PP
					   ,0 SaleP
					   ,0 OpeningBalance
					   ,0 OpeningIssueQty
					   ,0 NewPurchase
					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive
					   ,0 CertifiedReceive
					   ,0 SRReceive
					   ,0 IPDSale
					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn
					   ,0 Outlettransfer
					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAmount
					   ,0 ReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutletReceiveAmount
					   ,0 SRReceiveAmount
					   ,0 IPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 SReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutlettransferAmount
					   ,0 CertifiedSaleAmount
					   ,0 DamageTransferAmount
					   ,0 ClosingBalance
					   ,0 OPAmount
					   ,0 ClosingAmount
					   ,b.Manufacturer SupplierName
					   ,0 currentDBStock
					   ,SUM(srd.TotalAmount) / SUM(srd.Qty)
						--avg(be.PurchasePrice)
						NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount

					FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
					JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd
						ON srd.StockReceiveId = sr.Id
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be
						ON be.Id = srd.BrandExtensionId
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails b
						ON b.ProductId = be.Id
					WHERE CONVERT(DATE, sr.EntryDate) < @FilterStartDate
					AND (sr.OutletID = @OutletId
					OR @OutletId = 0)
					AND (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15)
					--and b.ProductName like '%ESOTID MUPS  40 MG%'
					GROUP BY b.ProductName
							,b.Manufacturer
							,b.ProductId
					HAVING SUM(srd.Qty) >= 1


					-- Return
					UNION ALL

					SELECT
						b.ProductId
					   ,b.ProductName ProductName
					   ,0 PP
					   ,0 SaleP
					   ,ABS(SUM(d.Qty)) OpeningBalance
					   ,0 OpeningIssueQty
					   ,0 NewPurchase
					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive
					   ,0 CertifiedReceive
					   ,0 SRReceive
					   ,0 IPDSale
					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn
					   ,0 Outlettransfer
					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAmount
					   ,0 ReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutletReceiveAmount
					   ,0 SRReceiveAmount
					   ,0 IPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 SReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutlettransferAmount
					   ,0 CertifiedSaleAmount
					   ,0 DamageTransferAmount
					   ,0 ClosingBalance
					   ,0 OPAmount
					   ,0 ClosingAmount
					   ,b.Manufacturer SupplierName
					   ,0 currentDBStock
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount

					FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
					JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d
						ON d.InvoiceId = i.Id
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be
						ON be.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails b
						ON b.ProductId = be.Id
					WHERE CONVERT(DATE, i.Invdate) < @FilterStartDate
					AND (i.ServeTypeId = 15
					OR i.ServeTypeId = 14)
					AND (i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId
					OR @OutletId = 0)

					GROUP BY b.ProductName
							,b.Manufacturer
							,b.ProductId


					-- OutletReceive
					UNION ALL

					SELECT

					   ,0 OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount

							,b.ProductId

							,b.Manufacturer
							,b.ProductId

					   ,0 OutletReceive

					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b

					OR @OutletId = 0)

							,v.OutLetId
							,be.Manufacturer
							,be.ProductId
				
				UNION ALL

					-- closing Avg Purchse 
					SELECT
						b.ProductId
					   ,b.ProductName ProductName
					   ,0 PP
					   ,0 SaleP
					   ,0 OpeningBalance
					   ,0 OpeningIssueQty
					   ,0 NewPurchase
					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive
					   ,0 CertifiedReceive
					   ,0 SRReceive
					   ,0 IPDSale
					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn
					   ,0 Outlettransfer
					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAmount
					   ,0 ReturnAmount
					   ,0 OutletReceiveAmount
					   ,0 SRReceiveAmount
					   ,0 IPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount
					   ,0 SReturnAmount

					  ,0 OPAmount
					   ,--0 OPAmount,
						0 ClosingAmount
					   ,b.Manufacturer SupplierName
					   ,0 currentDBStock
					   ,0 NewPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,0 OpeningPurchaseAvgAmount
					   ,avg(srd.PurchaseRate) ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount
					FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives sr
					JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd
						ON srd.StockReceiveId = sr.Id
					JOIN Pharmacy.BrandExtensions be
						ON be.Id = srd.BrandExtensionId

						ON b.ProductId = be.Id

					AND (sr.OutletID = @OutletId
					OR @OutletId = 0)
					AND (sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 15
					AND sr.ReceiveTypeId <> 14)
					GROUP BY b.ProductName
							,b.Manufacturer
							,b.ProductId




					-----SupplierName-----
					UNION ALL
					SELECT
						be.ProductId
					   ,be.ProductName ProductName

					   ,0 ReturnQty
					   ,0 OutletReceive

					   ,0 OPDSale
					   ,0 SReturn

					   ,0 CertifiedSale
					   ,0 DamageTransfer

					   ,0 ReturnAmount

					   ,0 OPDSaleAmount

					   ,0 OPAmount

					   ,0 ClosingPurchaseAvgAmount

						ON be.ProductId = b.Id
					WHERE b.Id = be.ProductId
					AND (v.OutLetId = @OutletId
					OR @OutletId = 0)
					GROUP BY be.ProductName
							,v.OutLetId
							,be.Manufacturer
							,be.ProductId
				-----=================================Transection end=================================================
				----

				) T
				WHERE T.ProductName like '%'+  @ProductName+'%'

				GROUP BY SupplierName
						,ProductName
						,ProductId
				HAVING SUM(T.OpeningBalance) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.ClosingBalance) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.NewPurchase) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.ReturnQty) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.OutletReceive) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.CertifiedReceive) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.IPDSale) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.OPDSale) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.SReturn) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.Outlettransfer) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.CertifiedSale) <> 0
				OR SUM(T.DamageTransfer) <> 0) tbl
			ORDER BY tbl.SupplierName
			FOR JSON AUTO)
		AS Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	--set @OutletId=2
	set @ProductName=''

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	

	Create Table #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport
	(
		AutoID bigint identity(1,1),
		InvDate date,
		InvoiceID uniqueidentifier,
		InvoiceNo nvarchar(max),
		TotalAmount float,	
		InvoiceCostValue float,	
		Vat	 float,
		Discount	float,
		ExchangeAmount float,	
		ReturnAmount float,	
		AdjustAmount float,	
		InvoiceNetAmount float,	
		CashAmount float,	
		CardAmount float,
		MobileBanking float,	
		CostValue float,
		NetAmount float,	
		ProfitTK float,	
		ProfitPrecentage float
	)

	insert into  #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport
	(
		InvDate,InvoiceID,InvoiceNo,TotalAmount,InvoiceCostValue,Vat,Discount,ExchangeAmount,	
		ReturnAmount,AdjustAmount,InvoiceNetAmount,CashAmount,CardAmount,MobileBanking,CostValue,
		NetAmount,ProfitTK,ProfitPrecentage
	)
	select 
	InvDate,  i.ID, InvoiceNo,  0 TotalAmount, 0 InvoiceCostValue, 0 Vat, 0 Discount, 0 ExchangeAmount, 0 	
ReturnAmount, 0 AdjustAmount, 0 InvoiceNetAmount, 0 CashAmount, 0 CardAmount, 0 MobileBanking, 0 CostValue, 0 
NetAmount, 0 ProfitTK, 0 ProfitPrecentage
	from 
	Pharmacy.Invoices i
	join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
	where 
		i.Invdate >=@FilterStartDate
	and i.Invdate <=@FilterEndDate
	AND I.ReturnFromInvoiceId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	group by i.InvoiceNo,i.Invdate,i.Id
	--,i.TotalAmount,i.Discount,i.ChangeAmount,i.Id

	select d.invoiceid,
	case when d.TransactionType = 0 then d.debit else 0 end TotalSales,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then d.Credit else 0 end Discount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 5 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Refund,
			case when d.TransactionType = 4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Cancell,
			case when d.TransactionType = 6 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DiscountAdjustment,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCheque

	into #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger
	from Pharmacy.Invoices i
	join Pharmacy.InvoiceLedgers d on d.InvoiceId = i.Id
	left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
	left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
	where 
		i.Invdate >=@FilterStartDate
	and i.Invdate <=@FilterEndDate

	--select * from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger
	--return

	update #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport set
	TotalAmount =
	(
		select round(sum(t.TotalSales),0) from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	Discount =
	(
		select sum(t.Discount) from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	CashAmount =
	(
		select sum(t.RegularCash)+sum(t.DueCash) from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	CardAmount =
	(
		select sum(t.RegularCard)+sum(t.dueCard) from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	MobileBanking =
	(
		select sum(t.RegularMobileBanking) + sum(t.DueMobileBanking) from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	InvoiceCostValue=
	(
		select round(sum(Qty*PurchaseRate),0) from Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d where d.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	ReturnAmount=
	(
		select sum(t.Refund)  from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	),
	AdjustAmount=
	(
		select sum(t.DiscountAdjustment)  from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryLedger t
		where t.InvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	)

	update #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport set
	InvoiceNetAmount = TotalAmount - Discount,
	NetAmount = CashAmount+CardAmount+MobileBanking

	update #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport set
	ExchangeAmount =
	(
		select sum(ChangeAmount) from Pharmacy.Invoices i
		where i.ReturnFromInvoiceId = #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport.InvoiceID
	)

	update #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport set
	ProfitTK = TotalAmount - InvoiceCostValue
	
	update #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport set
	ProfitPrecentage = round(((TotalAmount - InvoiceCostValue) * 100 )/TotalAmount,2) where TotalAmount>0


	update #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport set
	InvoiceNetAmount = TotalAmount+ CostValue+Vat - Discount
	- ExchangeAmount + ReturnAmount -AdjustAmount


		select(
	select * from(


	select 
	InvDate, InvoiceNo, 
	round(isnull(TotalAmount,0),2) TotalAmount, 
	round(isnull(InvoiceCostValue,0),2) InvoiceCostValue , 
	Vat, 
	round(isnull(Discount,0),2) Discount, 
	round(isnull(ExchangeAmount,0),2) ExchangeAmount, 	
	round(isnull(ReturnAmount,0),2) ReturnAmount, 
	round(isnull(AdjustAmount,0),2) AdjustAmount,
	round(isnull(InvoiceNetAmount,0),2) InvoiceNetAmount, 
	round(isnull(CashAmount,0),2) CashAmount, 
	round(isnull(CardAmount,0),2) CardAmount, 
	round(isnull(MobileBanking,0),2) MobileBanking, 
	round(isnull(CostValue,0),2) CostValue, 
	round(isnull(NetAmount,0),2) NetAmount, 
	round(isnull(ProfitTK,0),2) ProfitTK, 
	round(isnull(ProfitPrecentage,0),2) ProfitPrecentage
	from #TempSpGetPharmacyInvoiceWiseSaleSummeryReport

		) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END

--------------------

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyManualAdjustmentReport]  '2024-07-01,2024-07-10,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0, ,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,4,1,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyManualAdjustmentReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
		DECLARE 
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate date

				Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
			SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
			Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
			SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

				select(
				select * from(
				
		select 'Short' as Short, d.ProductName as ItemName, round(sum(id.Qty),2) as Qty, id.PurchaseRate as PurchaseRate, sum(id.Qty) * id.PurchaseRate Total     
		from Pharmacy.Invoices i
		join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id on id.InvoiceId=i.id
		join BrandDetails d on d.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
		join Pharmacy.PLoyalMemberLedgers l on l.InvoiceId=i.id
		where convert(date,i.Invdate)>= @FilterStartDate and convert(date,i.Invdate)<=@FilterEndDate
		group by d.ProductName,id.PurchaseRate

		union All

		select 'Excess' as Excess, d.ProductName as ItemName, round(sum(id.Qty),2) as Qty, id.PurchaseRate as PurchaseRate, sum(id.Qty) * id.PurchaseRate Total     
		from Pharmacy.StockReceives i
		join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails id on id.StockReceiveId=i.id
		join BrandDetails d on d.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
		join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers l on l.id=i.SupplierId
		where convert(date,i.EntryDate)>= @FilterStartDate and convert(date,i.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
		and l.id in ('CE67EBF5-C7ED-490C-9F51-335A519A45EE','728D8E37-DA0C-425A-B725-89A1B6CA2D65')
		group by d.ProductName,id.PurchaseRate
		) tbl 
		FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyProductWiseSalesProfit]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID


--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyProductWiseSalesProfit]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN

	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10

	
	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	(
		ProductID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER ,
		FullName nvarchar(max),
		SalesRate float,
		SalesQty float,
		SalesAmount float,
		SalesDiscount float,
		COstRate float,
		SalesProfit float,
		SalesProfitPersentage float
		
	)

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	SELECT 
	ProductId,ProductName,sum(SaleRate) SaleRate,sum(Qty) Qty,sum(TotalSaleAmount)TotalSaleAmount,
	sum(TotalDiscount) TotalDiscount,sum(TotalCostAmount) TotalCostAmount,sum(TotalSaleAmount)-sum(TotalDiscount) - sum(TotalCostAmount) [Profit],
	case when sum(TotalCostAmount) =0 then 0 else
	((sum(TotalSaleAmount) -sum(TotalDiscount) -sum(TotalCostAmount))/sum(TotalCostAmount))* 100 end
	FROM 
	(
		
		SELECT  V.ProductId,V.ProductName,AVG(d.SaleRate) SaleRate ,sum(d.Qty) Qty ,AVG(d.SaleRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalSaleAmount,
		--case when i.Discount =0 or i.TotalAmount = 0 then 0 else sum( ((i.Discount) * (d.SaleRate *d.Qty))/i.TotalAmount) end TotalDiscount,
		case when i.Discount =0 or i.TotalAmount = 0 then 0 else (i.Discount * d.SaleRate * d.Qty)/i.TotalAmount end TotalDiscount,
		AVG(d.PurchaseRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalCostAmount
	
		from 
		Pharmacy.BrandDetails V
		join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.ProductId
		join Pharmacy.Invoices i on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
		where ( V.ProductName  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
		and convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and ( i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		group by V.ProductId,V.ProductName,i.TotalAmount,i.Discount,d.SaleRate,d.qty
	)T
	group by ProductId,ProductName
	--	select(
	--select * from(

	select 
	ProductID  ,
		FullName ,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesRate) SalesRate,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesQty) SalesQty,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesAmount) SalesAmount,
		Convert(decimal(18,2),SalesDiscount)SalesDiscount,
		convert(decimal(18,2),COstRate) COstRate,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesProfit) SalesProfit,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesProfitPersentage )SalesProfitPersentage
		
	from
	#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	--	) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

END



--------------------------


GO
