CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyProductWiseSalesProfitDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyProductWiseSalesProfitDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN

	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date

	set @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @ProductName=''

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	
	--Select @OutletId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
--	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
--	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14

	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	(
		ProductID uniqueidentifier ,
		FullName nvarchar(max),
		SalesRate float,
		SalesQty float,
		SalesAmount float,
		SalesDiscount float,
		COstRate float,
		SalesProfit float,
		SalesProfitPersentage float
		
	)

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	SELECT 
	ProductId,ProductName,(SaleRate) SaleRate,sum(Qty) Qty,sum(TotalSaleAmount)TotalSaleAmount,
	sum(TotalDiscount) TotalDiscount,sum(TotalCostAmount) TotalCostAmount,sum(TotalSaleAmount)-sum(TotalDiscount) - sum(TotalCostAmount) [Profit],
	case when sum(TotalSaleAmount) =0 then 0 else
	--((sum(TotalSaleAmount) -sum(TotalDiscount) -sum(TotalCostAmount))/sum(TotalCostAmount))* 100 end
	((sum(TotalSaleAmount)-sum(TotalDiscount) - sum(TotalCostAmount))/sum(TotalSaleAmount))*100 end
	FROM 
	(
		
		SELECT  V.ProductId,V.ProductName,AVG(d.SaleRate) SaleRate ,sum(d.Qty) Qty ,AVG(d.SaleRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalSaleAmount,
		--case when i.Discount =0 or i.TotalAmount = 0 then 0 else sum( ((i.Discount) * (d.SaleRate *d.Qty))/i.TotalAmount) end TotalDiscount,
		case when i.Discount =0 or i.TotalAmount = 0 then 0 else (i.Discount * d.SaleRate * d.Qty)/i.TotalAmount end TotalDiscount,
		AVG(d.PurchaseRate) * sum(d.Qty) TotalCostAmount
	
		from 
		Pharmacy.BrandDetails V
		join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.ProductId
		join Pharmacy.Invoices i on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
		left join Pharmacy.PLoyalMemberLedgers l on l.InvoiceId=i.id
		where ( V.ProductName  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
		and convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and ( i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and i.ServeTypeId not in (10)
			and (isnull(l.PLoyalMemberId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') not in ('B4EDA66F-25F5-474C-9A9B-08DC405107C2','8C2A9F7A-2ABA-487B-18C6-08DC8B5BBA91'))
		group by V.ProductId,V.ProductName,i.TotalAmount,i.Discount,d.SaleRate,d.qty
	)T
	group by ProductId,ProductName,SaleRate
		select(
	select * from(

	select 
	ProductID  ,
		FullName ,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesRate) SalesRate,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesQty) SalesQty,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesAmount) SalesAmount,
		Convert(decimal(18,2),SalesDiscount)SalesDiscount,
		convert(decimal(18,2),COstRate) COstRate,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesProfit) SalesProfit,
		convert(decimal(18,2),SalesProfitPersentage )SalesProfitPersentage
		
	from
	#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
		) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseStatement]

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,

	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10

	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
	Select @StockReceivedID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15
	
	--	select(
	--select * from(

		select 
		i.EntryDate,
		s.Name Supplier,
		i.SupplierInvoiceNo,
		d.Qty,
		d.PurchaseRate,
		d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate GrantTotal,
		d.GrossDiscount,
		d.VatInGrossAmount,
		(d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate) + d.VatInGrossAmount - d.GrossDiscount NetSales

		--V.ProductId,
		--V.ProductName,
		--i.SupplierInvoiceNo,
		--d.StockReceiveId,
		--d.PurchaseRate,
		--d.Qty,
		--d.GrossDiscount,
		--d.VatInGrossAmount,
		--i.EntryDate,
		--i.OutLetId
		from 
		Pharmacy.BrandDetails V
		join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.ProductId
		join Pharmacy.StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s on s.Id=i.SupplierId
		where 
		--( V.ProductName  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
		--and 
		convert(date,i.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and ( i.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (i.SupplierId = @SupplierId or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (i.id = @StockReceivedID or @StockReceivedID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

		--	) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseStatementDynamic]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseStatementDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@SupplierId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@StockReceivedID uniqueidentifier

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	set @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @ProductName=''
	set @SupplierId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @StockReceivedID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

		select(
	select * from(

		select 
		V.ProductName,
		DATEADD(dd, 0, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, i.EntryDate)) EntryDate,
		s.Name Supplier,
		i.SupplierInvoiceNo,
		d.Qty,
		d.PurchaseRate,
		round(d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate,2) GrantTotal,
		round(d.GrossDiscount,2) GrossDiscount,
		round(d.VatInGrossAmount,2) VatInGrossAmount,
		round((d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate) + d.VatInGrossAmount - d.GrossDiscount,2) NetSales

		from 
		Pharmacy.BrandDetails V
		join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.ProductId
		join Pharmacy.StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].Suppliers s on s.Id=i.SupplierId
		where 
		--( V.ProductName  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
		--and 
		convert(date,i.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and ( i.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (i.SupplierId = @SupplierId or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (i.id = @StockReceivedID or @StockReceivedID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and (i.ReceiveTypeId not in (4,14,15,16))
		and s.id not in (
'A0107FAB-3D3B-423F-BF20-6EC4BE566960',
'3AC60892-032B-46A8-9B34-7546AAA84494',
'7A76D41B-CC90-4840-A470-A457CAF0AF22',

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseSummary]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseSummary]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	AS
	BEGIN
	DECLARE 
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate Date,
		@SupplierId uniqueidentifier

		Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
		Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		Select @SupplierId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

				select(
	select * from(

	select 
	SupplierName,
	round (Sum(GrandTotal),2) GrandTotal,
	sum(GrossDiscount) GrossDiscount,
	sum(VatInGrossAmount) VatInGrossAmount,
	round (sum(NetPayble),2) NetPayble
	from
		(
						select
							s.Name SupplierName,
							d.Qty * d.PurchaseRate GrandTotal,
							d.GrossDiscount GrossDiscount,
							d.VatInGrossAmount VatInGrossAmount,
							(d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate) + d.VatInGrossAmount - d.GrossDiscount NetPayble

							from  Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d 
							join Pharmacy.StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
							join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s on s.Id=i.SupplierId

							where 
							--( V.ProductName  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
							--and 
							convert(date,i.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
							and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
							and (i.SupplierId = @SupplierId or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							and s.id not in ('F694BDBA-5DD9-4A97-BF51-029600CBCFA3','CE67EBF5-C7ED-490C-9F51-335A519A45EE','6E7FD206-5085-4D46-9ADB-72ABC8B856C5',
							'8E2C5E5A-B92F-4A1A-8A95-BCE69999A094','728D8E37-DA0C-425A-B725-89A1B6CA2D65')
							and (i.ReceiveTypeId not in (4,14,15,16))

			)T
			
			Group by T.SupplierName


				) tbl 
				order by tbl.SupplierName
				FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseSummaryDateWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
	
	--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyPurchaseSummaryDateWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	AS
	BEGIN
	DECLARE 
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate Date,
		@SupplierId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

		Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
		Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		Select @SupplierId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
		SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

				select(
	select * from(

	SELECT 
							SupplierName,DateEntry,DateBill, SupplierInvoiceNo,SupplierChalanNo,SoftwareInvoiceNo,
							Amount,Discount,VatAmount,GrandTotal
				FROM
	
				(


				select ss.Name [SupplierName],convert(date, s.EntryDate)  DateEntry,convert(date, s.SupplierInvoiceDate)  DateBill,
				s.SupplierInvoiceNo AS SupplierInvoiceNo,s.SupplierChallanNo AS SupplierChalanNo,s.InvoiceNo AS SoftwareInvoiceNo,
					s.TotalAmount AS Amount, s.Discount AS Discount, s.VatAmount AS VAtAmount, ROUND(s.GrandTotal,0,0) AS GrandTotal

							from  Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd 
							join Pharmacy.StockReceives s on s.Id = srd.StockReceiveId
							join [SupplyChain].Suppliers ss on ss.Id=s.SupplierId

							where 
							--( V.ProductName  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
							--and 
							convert(date,s.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
							and convert(date,s.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
							and (s.SupplierId = @SupplierId or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
							and ss.id not in (
							'F694BDBA-5DD9-4A97-BF51-029600CBCFA3',
							'CE67EBF5-C7ED-490C-9F51-335A519A45EE',
							'6E7FD206-5085-4D46-9ADB-72ABC8B856C5',
							'8E2C5E5A-B92F-4A1A-8A95-BCE69999A094',
							'728D8E37-DA0C-425A-B725-89A1B6CA2D65',
							'E763354C-C07E-4F53-ADFF-131F02395808')
			)T
			GROUP BY SupplierName,DateEntry,DateBill, SupplierInvoiceNo,SupplierChalanNo,SoftwareInvoiceNo,
							Amount,Discount,VatAmount,GrandTotal
						--ORDER BY T.SupplierName

	


				) tbl 
				order by tbl.SupplierName
				FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWise]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS

BEGIN
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWise]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	DECLARE 
    @OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@BrandExtensionsId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterTypeId int

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		 
	--Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	--RETURN
	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @FilterTypeId =  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7



	--select  @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate ,@OutletId OutID,@UserID UserI ,@FilterTypeId FType,@BrandExtensionsId Brand
	

	--	select(
	--select * from(


	select InvoiceNo,Invdate,count(*) CountRecored,sum(TotalSales) TotalSales
	,sum(Discount) TotalDiscount
	,sum(Refund) TotalRefund
	,(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from InvoiceLedgers ll
		join Pharmacy.Invoices ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
		where ii.InvoiceNo = T.InvoiceNo
	) TotalDue,
	sum(Cancell) Cancell,
	sum(DiscountAdjustment) DiscountAdjustment,
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileBanking) RegularMobileBanking,
	sum(RegularCheque) RegularCheque,
	sum(DueCash) DueCash,
	sum(DueCard) DueCard,
	sum(DueMobileBanking) DueMobileBanking,
	sum(DueCheque) DueCheque

	from 

	(
			select i.InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ) Invdate,
			case when d.TransactionType = 0 then d.debit else 0 end TotalSales,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then d.Credit else 0 end Discount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 5 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Refund,
			case when d.TransactionType = 4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Cancell,
			case when d.TransactionType = 6 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DiscountAdjustment,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCheque


			from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceLedgers d on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			where 
				convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (i.ServeTypeId = @FilterTypeId or @FilterTypeId=0)
			and (i.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and (i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId  or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by InvoiceNo,Invdate

	
	--	) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	--group by InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ),TransactionType
END

GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWiseDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS

BEGIN
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWiseDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'




	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@BrandExtensionsId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterTypeId int

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		Select @UserID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5

	set @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @BrandExtensionsId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	--set @UserID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @FilterTypeId=0
/*	Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15

	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @FilterTypeId =  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=16
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	*/

	--insert into temp_2025_1_11 values(@FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate,@OutletId,@BrandExtensionsId,'12')

		select(
	select * from(


	select InvoiceNo,Invdate,count(*) CountRecored,
	round(sum(TotalSales),0) TotalSales
	,0 AO
	,0 DWD
	,round((sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount)),0) NetSales		--Invoice Total Amount - Discount = Netsale
	--,round((sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount) - (select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from InvoiceLedgers ll
	--		join Pharmacy.Invoices ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
	--		where ii.InvoiceNo = T.InvoiceNo
	--	) - sum(Cancell)),0) 
		
	,round((
	--sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount) - sum(Cancell)
	+sum(RegularCash)
	+sum(RegularCard)
	+sum(RegularMobileBanking)
	+sum(RegularCheque) 

	+sum(DueCash)
	+sum(DueCard)
	+sum(DueMobileBanking)
	+sum(DueCheque) 
	- sum(Refund)
	)
	
	
	,0)	
		NetCollection		--Total Invoice Amount - discount- due- cancel amount- check if there is any more = Net Collectipn
	,round(sum(Discount)  ,0)   TotalDiscount
	,sum(Refund) TotalRefund
	,round((select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from InvoiceLedgers ll
		join Pharmacy.Invoices ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
		where ii.InvoiceNo = T.InvoiceNo
	),0) TotalDue,
	round(sum(Cancell),0) Cancell,
	round(sum(DiscountAdjustment),0) DiscountAdjustment,
	round(sum(RegularCash),0) RegularCash,
	round(sum(RegularCard),0) RegularCard,
	round(sum(RegularMobileBanking),0) RegularMobileBanking,
	round(sum(RegularCheque),0) RegularCheque,
	round(sum(DueCash),0) DueCash,
	round(sum(DueCard),0) DueCard,
	round(sum(DueMobileBanking),0) DueMobileBanking,
	round(sum(DueCheque),0) DueCheque

	from 

	(
			select i.InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ) Invdate,
			case when d.TransactionType = 0 then d.debit else 0 end TotalSales,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then d.Credit else 0 end Discount,
			0 DueDiscount,
			--case when d.TransactionType = 5 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Refund,
						case when d.TransactionType = 5 and i.ServeTypeId =15 then i.grandtotal *-1 
			when d.TransactionType = 5 and i.ServeTypeId <> 15 then Debit else 0 end Refund,
			case when d.TransactionType = 4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Cancell,
			case when d.TransactionType = 6 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DiscountAdjustment,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCheque


			from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceLedgers d on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			where 
				convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (i.ServeTypeId = @FilterTypeId or @FilterTypeId=0)
			and (i.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and (i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId  or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


			union all


			select p.InvoiceNo InvoiceNo,convert(date,d.paydate ) Invdate,
			0 TotalSales,
			0 Discount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then amount else 0 end DueDiscount,
			0 Refund,
			0 Cancell,
			0 DiscountAdjustment,

			0 RegularCash,
			0 RegularCard,
			0 RegularMobileBanking,
			0 RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then amount else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then amount else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then amount else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then amount else 0 end DueCheque


			from [Pharmacy].[PIPDDueCollections] d
			join [Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p on p.id = d.IPDPatientId
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			
			where 
				convert(date,d.paydate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,d.paydate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (d.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		

								union all

			select i.InvoiceNo  InvoiceNo,convert(date,d.EntryDate ) Invdate,
			0 TotalSales,
			0 Discount,
			 0  DueDiscount,
			0 Refund,
			0 Cancell,
			0 DiscountAdjustment,

			0 RegularCash,
			0 RegularCard,
			0 RegularMobileBanking,
			0 RegularCheque,


			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=1 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=2 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=3 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=4 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueCheque
			
			


			from [Pharmacy].[PLoyalMemberLedgers] d
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = d.CreatedBy 
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			join Pharmacy.Invoices i on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
			

			where 
					convert(date,d.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,d.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (d.CreatedBy = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')


	)T
	group by InvoiceNo,Invdate

	
		) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	--group by InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ),TransactionType
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWiseSummry]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS

BEGIN
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWiseSummry]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'




	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@BrandExtensionsId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserID nvarchar(max),
	@FilterTypeId INT
	,@temp NVARCHAR (MAX)

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	
	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @FilterTypeId =  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7



	--select  @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate ,@OutletId OutID,@UserID UserI ,@FilterTypeId FType,@BrandExtensionsId Brand
	

	--	select(
	--select * from(


	select count(distinct InvoiceNo) InvoiceCount,sum(TotalSales) TotalSales
	,sum(Discount) TotalDiscount
	,sum(Refund) TotalRefund,
	--,(select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from InvoiceLedgers ll
		--join Pharmacy.Invoices ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
		--where ii.InvoiceNo = T.InvoiceNo
	--) TotalDue,
	sum(Cancell) Cancell,
	sum(DiscountAdjustment) DiscountAdjustment,

	sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount)  [NetSales],
	sum(RegularCash) RegularCash,
	sum(RegularCard) RegularCard,
	sum(RegularMobileBanking) RegularMobileBanking,
	sum(RegularCheque) RegularCheque,
	sum(DueCash) DueCash,
	sum(DueCard) DueCard,
	sum(DueMobileBanking) DueMobileBanking,
	sum(DueCheque) DueCheque,
	id,
	UserName

	from 

	(
			select i.InvoiceNo,
			case when d.TransactionType = 0 then d.debit else 0 end TotalSales,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then d.Credit else 0 end Discount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 5 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Refund,
			case when d.TransactionType = 4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Cancell,
			case when d.TransactionType = 6 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DiscountAdjustment,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCheque,
			
			u.UserName,
			u.Id


			from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceLedgers d on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = i.UserId 
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			where 
				convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (i.ServeTypeId = @FilterTypeId or @FilterTypeId=0)
			and (i.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and (i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId  or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	)T
	group by Id,UserName

	
	--	) tbl order by tbl.InvoiceNo FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data

	--group by InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ),TransactionType
END


GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWiseSummryDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS

BEGIN
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacySalesReportUserWiseSummryDynamic]'2024-10-26,2024-12-27,2024,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@BrandExtensionsId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@UserID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterTypeId int

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
		Select @UserID=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
/*	Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15

	Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=5
	Select @FilterTypeId =  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=16
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	*/
	set @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @BrandExtensionsId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	set @FilterTypeId=0


	--select  @FilterStartDate,@FilterEndDate ,@OutletId OutID,@UserID UserI ,@FilterTypeId FType,@BrandExtensionsId Brand
	

	select(
	select * from(


	select count(distinct InvoiceNo) InvoiceCount,
	round(sum(TotalSales),0) TotalSales
	,round(sum(Discount)  ,0) TotalDiscount
	,round(sum(Refund),0) TotalRefund,

	round((select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from pharmacy.InvoiceLedgers ll
		join Pharmacy.Invoices ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
		where ii.UserId = T.Id and
		convert(date,ii.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,ii.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	),0) TotalDue,

	0 AOC,
	0 DWD,
	--round((sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount)-sum(Refund) - (select sum(debit) - sum(credit) from InvoiceLedgers ll
	--		join Pharmacy.Invoices ii on ii.Id = ll.InvoiceId
	--		where ii.UserId = T.Id and
	--	convert(date,ii.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
	--		and convert(date,ii.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
	--	)),0) NetCollection,		--Total Invoice Amount - discount- due- cancel amount- check if there is any more = Net Collectipn
	
	round((
	--sum(TotalSales) - sum(Discount) - sum(Cancell)
	+sum(RegularCash)
	+sum(RegularCard)
	+sum(RegularMobileBanking)
	+sum(RegularCheque) 

	+sum(DueCash)
	+sum(DueCard)
	+sum(DueMobileBanking)
	+sum(DueCheque) 
	- sum(Refund)
	)
	
	,0)	NetCollection,	
	round(sum(Cancell),0) Cancell,
	round(sum(DiscountAdjustment),0) DiscountAdjustment,

	round(sum(TotalSales),0) - round(sum(Discount),0)  [NetSales],
	round(sum(RegularCash),0) RegularCash,
	round(sum(RegularCard),0) RegularCard,
	round(sum(RegularMobileBanking),0) RegularMobileBanking,
	round(sum(RegularCheque),0) RegularCheque,
	round(sum(DueCash),0) DueCash,
	--99 DueCash,
	round(sum(DueCard),0) DueCard,
	round(sum(DueMobileBanking),0) DueMobileBanking,
	round(sum(DueCheque),0) DueCheque,
	id,
	UserName

	from 

	(
			select i.InvoiceNo,
			
			case when d.TransactionType = 0 then d.debit else 0 end TotalSales,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then d.Credit else 0 end Discount,
			0 DueDiscount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 5 then Debit else 0 end Refund,
			case when d.TransactionType = 4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end Cancell,
			case when d.TransactionType = 6 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DiscountAdjustment,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=1 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=2 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=3 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 3 and m.Id=4 then d.debit + d.Credit else 0 end DueCheque,
			
			u.UserName,
			u.Id


			from Pharmacy.Invoices i 
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceLedgers d on i.Id = d.InvoiceId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = i.UserId 
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			where 
				convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (i.ServeTypeId = @FilterTypeId or @FilterTypeId=0)
			and (i.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and (i.MedicineOutLetId = @OutletId  or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

			union all

			select '' InvoiceNo,
			
			0 TotalSales,
			0 Discount,
			case when d.TransactionType = 1 then amount else 0 end DueDiscount,
			0 Refund,
			0 Cancell,
			0 DiscountAdjustment,

			0 RegularCash,
			0 RegularCard,
			0 RegularMobileBanking,
			0 RegularCheque,

			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=1 then amount else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=2 then amount else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=3 then amount else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.TransactionType = 2 and m.Id=4 then amount else 0 end DueCheque,
			
			u.UserName,
			u.Id


			from [Pharmacy].[PIPDDueCollections] d
			join [Hospital].IPDPatientRecords p on p.id = d.IPDPatientId
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = d.UserId 
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			

			where 
				convert(date,d.paydate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,d.paydate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (d.UserId = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

						union all

			select '' InvoiceNo,
			
			0 TotalSales,
			0 Discount,
			0  DueDiscount,
			0 Refund,
			0 Cancell,
			0 DiscountAdjustment,

			0 RegularCash,
			0 RegularCard,
			0 RegularMobileBanking,
			0 RegularCheque,

			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=1 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueCash,
			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=2 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueCard,
			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=3 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueMobileBanking,
			case when d.Description = 'Payment for Due Collection'  and m.Id=4 then Credit + Debit else 0 end DueCheque,
			
			u.UserName,
			u.Id


			from [Pharmacy].[PLoyalMemberLedgers] d
			join [Identity].Users u on u.id = d.CreatedBy 
			left join admin.PaymentChannels c on c.Id = d.PaymentChannelId
			left join admin.PaymentModes m on m.Id = c.PaymentModeId
			

			where 
					convert(date,d.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
			and convert(date,d.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
			and (d.CreatedBy = @UserID or @UserID ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

	)T
	group by Id,UserName

	
	) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	--group by InvoiceNo,convert(date,i.Invdate ),TransactionType
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyStockReport]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyStockReport]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

	DECLARE 
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@SupplierId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FormationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@BrandExtensionsId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@FilterStartDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	
	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7
	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

	Select @FormationId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=9
	
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10

	


	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	(
		BrandExtensionsid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER ,
		ShortFormation nvarchar(max),
		brandName nvarchar(max),
		FullName nvarchar(max),
		StrengthsValue  nvarchar(max),
		UnitName nvarchar(max),
		CostPrice float,
		SalesPrice float,
		OpeningReceivedQty float,
		OpeningInvoiceQty float,
		OpeningTransferQty float,
		CurrentReceivedQty float,
		CurrentInvoiceQty float,
		CurrentTransferQty float,
		OpeningBalance float,
		ManufacturersName nvarchar(max)

	)
	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	(
		BrandExtensionsid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		CostPrice float,
		SalesPrice float,
	)

	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty
	(
		BrandExtensionsid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		OpeningReceivedQty float,
		OpeningInvoiceQty float,
		OpeningTransferQty float,
		CurrentReceivedQty float,
		CurrentInvoiceQty float,
		CurrentTransferQty float

	)
	
	

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	select  d.BrandExtensionId, isnull(AVG(d.PurchaseRate),0.00),isnull(AVG(d.SaleRate),0.00)
			from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
			join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.StockReceiveId = r.Id
			join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
			--where d.BrandExtensionId =#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport.BrandExtensionsid
			group by d.BrandExtensionId

		
	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty
	select BrandExtensionId,sum(T.ReceivedQty) ReceivedQty ,  sum(InvoiceQty )   InvoiceQty , sum(TransferQty) TransferQty ,0 Received_Qty,0 Invoice_Qty ,0 Transfer_Qty
	from 
		(
			select  d.BrandExtensionId,
			case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end
			 ReceivedQty ,0 InvoiceQty,0 TransferQty ,
			 case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Received_Qty,0 Invoice_Qty ,0 Transfer_Qty
			from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
			join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on r.id = d.StockReceiveId
			where (r.OutLetId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
			

			union all

			select d.BrandExtensionId,0, 
			case when convert(date,i.Invdate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end InvoiceQty,
			0 TransferQty ,0,
			case when convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Invoice_Qty,0
			from Pharmacy.Invoices i
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on i.id = d.InvoiceId
			where (i.MedicineOutLetId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
			

			union all

			select d.BrandExtensionId,0,0, 
			case when convert(date,tst.TransferDate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end TransferQty ,0,0,
			case when convert(date,tst.TransferDate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Transfer_Qty
			from Pharmacy.StockTransfer tst
			join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on tst.Id = d.TransferId
			where (tst.ToOutletId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
		)T
		Group by T.BrandExtensionId
	
	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	select distinct bx.Id, f.ShortFormation,b.Name brandName ,
	( f.ShortFormation + ' ' + b.Name + ' ' + ISNULL(s.Value, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(bx.Unit, '')) FullName,
	s.Value,u.Name,isnull(cs.CostPrice,0.00),isnull(cs.SalesPrice,0.00),
	stock.OpeningReceivedQty ,stock.OpeningInvoiceQty , stock.OpeningTransferQty,
	stock.CurrentReceivedQty ,stock.CurrentInvoiceQty , stock.CurrentTransferQty,
	stock.OpeningReceivedQty -stock.OpeningInvoiceQty - stock.OpeningTransferQty [OpeningBalance],
	m.name ManufacturersName 
	from Pharmacy.BrandExtensions bx
	 join Pharmacy.BrandNames b on b.Id=bx.BrandId
	left join Pharmacy.Strengths s on s.Id=bx.StrengthId
	left join Pharmacy.Formations f on f.Id = bx.FormationId
	left join Pharmacy.Generics g on g.Id = bx.GenericId
	left join Pharmacy.Units u on u.Name = bx.Unit
	left join Pharmacy.Manufacturers m on m.Id = b.ManufacturerId
	left Join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale cs on cs.BrandExtensionsid = bx.Id
	left Join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty stock on stock.BrandExtensionsid = bx.Id
	where (bx.Id =@BrandExtensionsId or @BrandExtensionsId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and (m.Id =  @SupplierId  or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	and (f.Id =  @FormationId  or @FormationId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	and ( f.ShortFormation + ' ' + b.Name + ' ' + ISNULL(s.Value, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(bx.Unit, '')  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
	
	   	  
	--update #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport set
	--CostPrice =
	--isnull((
	--		select  AVG(d.PurchaseRate)
	--		from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
	--		join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.StockReceiveId = r.Id
	--		join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
	--		where d.BrandExtensionId =#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport.BrandExtensionsid
	--		group by d.BrandExtensionId
	--),0.00)

		
	select(
	select * from(
	select 
	BrandExtensionsid  ,
		ShortFormation ,
		brandName ,
		FullName,
		StrengthsValue ,
		UnitName ,
		CostPrice ,
		SalesPrice ,
		OpeningBalance ,
		CurrentReceivedQty ,
		CurrentInvoiceQty ,
		CurrentTransferQty ,
		OpeningBalance + CurrentReceivedQty - CurrentInvoiceQty- CurrentTransferQty [ClosingBlanace],
		OpeningBalance *  CostPrice [OpeningAmount],
		CurrentReceivedQty * CostPrice [CurrentReceiveAmount],
		CurrentInvoiceQty * CostPrice [CurrentInvoiceAmount],
		CurrentTransferQty * CostPrice [CurrentTransferAmount],
		--OpeningReceivedQty ,
		--OpeningInvoiceQty ,
		--OpeningTransferQty ,
		ManufacturersName
		
		from #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
		) tbl order by tbl.BrandExtensionsid FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	drop table #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale

end


GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- =============================================

--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyStockReportDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyStockReportDynamic]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE 
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@FormationId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@ProductName nvarchar(max) = '',
	@BrandExtensionsId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@FilterStartDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

	

	/*
	Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15

	Select @OutletId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
	Select @FormationId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14
	*/
	


	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	(
		BrandExtensionsid uniqueidentifier ,
		ShortFormation nvarchar(max),
		brandName nvarchar(max),
		BrandFullName nvarchar(max),
		StrengthsValue  nvarchar(max),
		UnitName nvarchar(max),
		CostPrice float,
		SalesPrice float,
		OpeningReceivedQty float,
		OpeningInvoiceQty float,
		OpeningTransferQty float,
		CurrentReceivedQty float,
		CurrentInvoiceQty float,
		CurrentTransferQty float,
		OpeningBalance float,
		ManufacturersName nvarchar(max),
		SupplierName nvarchar(max),
		FormationName nvarchar(max),
	)
	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	(
		BrandExtensionsid uniqueidentifier,
		CostPrice float,
		SalesPrice float,
	)

	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty
	(
		BrandExtensionsid uniqueidentifier,
		OpeningReceivedQty float,
		OpeningInvoiceQty float,
		OpeningTransferQty float,
		CurrentReceivedQty float,
		CurrentInvoiceQty float,
		CurrentTransferQty float

	)

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	select  d.BrandExtensionId, isnull(AVG(d.PurchaseRate),0.00),isnull(AVG(d.SaleRate),0.00)
			from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
			join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.StockReceiveId = r.Id
			join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
			--where d.BrandExtensionId =#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport.BrandExtensionsid
			where (r.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <=@FilterStartDate
			group by d.BrandExtensionId
	--select * from #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	--return

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty
	select BrandExtensionId,sum(T.ReceivedQty) ReceivedQty ,  sum(InvoiceQty )   InvoiceQty , sum(TransferQty) TransferQty ,sum(Received_Qty) Received_Qty,sum(Invoice_Qty) Invoice_Qty ,sum(Transfer_Qty) Transfer_Qty
	from 
		(
			select  d.BrandExtensionId,
			case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end
			 ReceivedQty ,0 InvoiceQty,0 TransferQty ,
			 case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Received_Qty,0 Invoice_Qty ,0 Transfer_Qty
			from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
			join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on r.id = d.StockReceiveId
			where (r.OutLetId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
			
			and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <=@FilterStartDate
			union all

			select d.BrandExtensionId,0, 
			case when convert(date,i.Invdate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end InvoiceQty,
			0 TransferQty ,0,
			case when convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Invoice_Qty,0
			from Pharmacy.Invoices i
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on i.id = d.InvoiceId
			where (i.MedicineOutLetId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterStartDate

			union all

			select d.BrandExtensionId,0,0, 
			case when convert(date,tst.TransferDate) <=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end TransferQty ,0,0,
			case when convert(date,tst.TransferDate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Transfer_Qty
			from Pharmacy.StockTransfer tst
			join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on tst.Id = d.TransferId
			where (tst.ToOutletId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and convert(date,tst.TransferDate) <=@FilterStartDate
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
		)T
		Group by T.BrandExtensionId

		

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	select distinct bx.Id, f.ShortFormation,b.Name brandName ,
	( f.ShortFormation + ' ' + b.Name + ' ' + ISNULL(s.Value, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(bx.Unit, '')) BrandFullName,
	s.Value,u.Name,isnull(cs.CostPrice,0.00),isnull(cs.SalesPrice,0.00),
	stock.OpeningReceivedQty ,stock.OpeningInvoiceQty , stock.OpeningTransferQty,
	stock.CurrentReceivedQty ,stock.CurrentInvoiceQty , stock.CurrentTransferQty,
	stock.OpeningReceivedQty -stock.OpeningInvoiceQty - stock.OpeningTransferQty [OpeningBalance],
	m.name ManufacturersName,
	su.Name SupplierName,
	f.Name FormationName
	from Pharmacy.BrandExtensions bx
	 join Pharmacy.BrandNames b on b.Id=bx.BrandId
	 join Pharmacy.Strengths s on s.Id=bx.StrengthId
	 join Pharmacy.Formations f on f.Id = bx.FormationId
	 join Pharmacy.Generics g on g.Id = bx.GenericId
	 join Pharmacy.Units u on u.Name = bx.Unit
	 join Pharmacy.Manufacturers m on m.Id = b.ManufacturerId
	 join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers su on  su.ManufacturerId = m.Id
	 left Join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale cs on cs.BrandExtensionsid = bx.Id
	 left Join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty stock on stock.BrandExtensionsid = bx.Id
	where (bx.Id =@BrandExtensionsId or @BrandExtensionsId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and (m.Id =  @SupplierId  or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	and (f.Id =  @FormationId  or @FormationId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	
	and ( f.ShortFormation + ' ' + b.Name + ' ' + ISNULL(s.Value, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(bx.Unit, '')  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
	
	   	  
	--update #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport set
	--CostPrice =
	--isnull((
	--		select  AVG(d.PurchaseRate)
	--		from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
	--		join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.StockReceiveId = r.Id
	--		join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
	--		where d.BrandExtensionId =#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport.BrandExtensionsid
	--		group by d.BrandExtensionId
	--),0.00)

		
 select(
	select * from(
	
	select 
	BrandExtensionsid  ,
		
		--BrandName,
		BrandFullName,
		--isnull(StrengthsValue, '') StrengthsValue ,
		--UnitName ,
		isnull(CostPrice, 0) CP,
		isnull(SalesPrice, 0) MRP,
		isnull(OpeningBalance, 0) BF,
		isnull(CurrentReceivedQty,0) Debit,
		isnull(CurrentInvoiceQty,0) Credit,
		isnull(CurrentTransferQty,0) [Transfer],
		isnull(OpeningBalance + CurrentReceivedQty - CurrentInvoiceQty- CurrentTransferQty,0) [ClosingBalance],
		isnull(OpeningBalance *  CostPrice,0) [BFAmount],
		isnull(CurrentReceivedQty * CostPrice,0) [DebitAmount],
		isnull(CurrentInvoiceQty * CostPrice,0) [CreditAmount],
		isnull(CurrentTransferQty * CostPrice,0) [TransferAmount],
		--(isnull(OpeningBalance + CurrentReceivedQty - CurrentInvoiceQty- CurrentTransferQty,0)) * isnull(CostPrice, 0) [ClosingBlanaceAmount],
		(isnull(OpeningBalance *  CostPrice,0)) + (isnull(CurrentReceivedQty * CostPrice,0)) -  (isnull(CurrentInvoiceQty * CostPrice,0))
		- (isnull(CurrentTransferQty * CostPrice,0)) [ClosingBalanceAmount],

		isnull(SupplierName,'') SupplierName,
		isnull(FormationName,'') FormationName
		
		from #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
		
		--order by BrandFullName
		) T 
		where T.CP <> 0 or T.MRP <> 0 or T.BF <> 0 or T.Debit <> 0 or T.Credit <> 0 or T.[Transfer] <> 0 or T.[ClosingBalance] <> 0 or T.[BFAmount] <> 0
		or T.[DebitAmount] <> 0 or T.[CreditAmount] <> 0 or T.[TransferAmount] <> 0
		order by T.SupplierName FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	drop table #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale

end

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID,15.@StockReceivedID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyStockReportDynamic]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, ,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

Create     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPharmacyStockReportDynamicTemp]
	@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE 
	@OutletId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@FormationId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@ProductName nvarchar(max) = '',
	@BrandExtensionsId uniqueidentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
	@FilterStartDate date

	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1

	Select @OutletId=  Convert(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=7

	insert into temp_2025_1_11 values(@FilterStartDate,'',@OutletId,'','1')

	/*
	Select @BrandExtensionsId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=15

	Select @OutletId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=11
	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=12
	Select @FormationId=  Convert(bigint,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=13
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=14
	*/
	


	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	(
		BrandExtensionsid uniqueidentifier ,
		ShortFormation nvarchar(max),
		brandName nvarchar(max),
		BrandFullName nvarchar(max),
		StrengthsValue  nvarchar(max),
		UnitName nvarchar(max),
		CostPrice float,
		SalesPrice float,
		OpeningReceivedQty float,
		OpeningInvoiceQty float,
		OpeningTransferQty float,
		CurrentReceivedQty float,
		CurrentInvoiceQty float,
		CurrentTransferQty float,
		OpeningBalance float,
		ManufacturersName nvarchar(max),
		SupplierName nvarchar(max),
		FormationName nvarchar(max),
	)
	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	(
		BrandExtensionsid uniqueidentifier,
		CostPrice float,
		SalesPrice float,
	)

	CREATE TABLE #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty
	(
		BrandExtensionsid uniqueidentifier,
		OpeningReceivedQty float,
		OpeningInvoiceQty float,
		OpeningTransferQty float,
		CurrentReceivedQty float,
		CurrentInvoiceQty float,
		CurrentTransferQty float

	)

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	select  d.BrandExtensionId, isnull(AVG(d.PurchaseRate),0.00),isnull(AVG(d.SaleRate),0.00)
			from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
			join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.StockReceiveId = r.Id
			join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
			--where d.BrandExtensionId =#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport.BrandExtensionsid
			where (r.OutLetId = @OutletId or @OutletId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <=@FilterStartDate
			group by d.BrandExtensionId
	--select * from #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale
	--return

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty
	select BrandExtensionId,sum(T.ReceivedQty) ReceivedQty ,  sum(InvoiceQty )   InvoiceQty , sum(TransferQty) TransferQty ,sum(Received_Qty) Received_Qty,sum(Invoice_Qty) Invoice_Qty ,sum(Transfer_Qty) Transfer_Qty
	from 
		(
			select  d.BrandExtensionId,
			case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end
			 ReceivedQty ,0 InvoiceQty,0 TransferQty ,
			 case when convert(date,r.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Received_Qty,0 Invoice_Qty ,0 Transfer_Qty
			from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
			join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on r.id = d.StockReceiveId
			where (r.OutLetId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
			
			and convert(date,r.EntryDate) <=@FilterStartDate
			union all

			select d.BrandExtensionId,0, 
			case when convert(date,i.Invdate) <@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end InvoiceQty,
			0 TransferQty ,0,
			case when convert(date,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Invoice_Qty,0
			from Pharmacy.Invoices i
			join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails d on i.id = d.InvoiceId
			where (i.MedicineOutLetId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
			and convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterStartDate

			union all

			select d.BrandExtensionId,0,0, 
			case when convert(date,tst.TransferDate) <=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end TransferQty ,0,0,
			case when convert(date,tst.TransferDate) >=@FilterStartDate then  d.Qty else 0 end Transfer_Qty
			from Pharmacy.StockTransfer tst
			join Pharmacy.StockTransferDetails d on tst.Id = d.TransferId
			where (tst.ToOutletId =@OutletId or @OutletId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			and convert(date,tst.TransferDate) <=@FilterStartDate
			--join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport  tt on tt.BrandExtensionsid = d.BrandExtensionId
		)T
		Group by T.BrandExtensionId

		

	insert into #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	select distinct bx.Id, f.ShortFormation,b.Name brandName ,
	( f.ShortFormation + ' ' + b.Name + ' ' + ISNULL(s.Value, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(bx.Unit, '')) BrandFullName,
	s.Value,u.Name,isnull(cs.CostPrice,0.00),isnull(cs.SalesPrice,0.00),
	stock.OpeningReceivedQty ,stock.OpeningInvoiceQty , stock.OpeningTransferQty,
	stock.CurrentReceivedQty ,stock.CurrentInvoiceQty , stock.CurrentTransferQty,
	stock.OpeningReceivedQty -stock.OpeningInvoiceQty - stock.OpeningTransferQty [OpeningBalance],
	m.name ManufacturersName,
	su.Name SupplierName,
	f.Name FormationName
	from Pharmacy.BrandExtensions bx
	 join Pharmacy.BrandNames b on b.Id=bx.BrandId
	 join Pharmacy.Strengths s on s.Id=bx.StrengthId
	 join Pharmacy.Formations f on f.Id = bx.FormationId
	 join Pharmacy.Generics g on g.Id = bx.GenericId
	 join Pharmacy.Units u on u.Name = bx.Unit
	 join Pharmacy.Manufacturers m on m.Id = b.ManufacturerId
	 join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers su on  su.ManufacturerId = m.Id
	 left Join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale cs on cs.BrandExtensionsid = bx.Id
	 left Join #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportStockQty stock on stock.BrandExtensionsid = bx.Id
	where (bx.Id =@BrandExtensionsId or @BrandExtensionsId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
	and (m.Id =  @SupplierId  or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	and (f.Id =  @FormationId  or @FormationId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' )
	
	and ( f.ShortFormation + ' ' + b.Name + ' ' + ISNULL(s.Value, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(bx.Unit, '')  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
	
	   	  
	--update #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport set
	--CostPrice =
	--isnull((
	--		select  AVG(d.PurchaseRate)
	--		from Pharmacy.StockReceives r
	--		join Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails d on d.StockReceiveId = r.Id
	--		join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
	--		where d.BrandExtensionId =#TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport.BrandExtensionsid
	--		group by d.BrandExtensionId
	--),0.00)

		
 select(
	select * from(
	
	select 
	BrandExtensionsid  ,
		
		--BrandName,
		BrandFullName,
		--isnull(StrengthsValue, '') StrengthsValue ,
		--UnitName ,
		isnull(CostPrice, 0) CP,
		isnull(SalesPrice, 0) MRP,
		isnull(OpeningBalance, 0) BF,
		isnull(CurrentReceivedQty,0) Debit,
		isnull(CurrentInvoiceQty,0) Credit,
		isnull(CurrentTransferQty,0) [Transfer],
		isnull(OpeningBalance + CurrentReceivedQty - CurrentInvoiceQty- CurrentTransferQty,0) [ClosingBalance],
		isnull(OpeningBalance *  CostPrice,0) [BFAmount],
		isnull(CurrentReceivedQty * CostPrice,0) [DebitAmount],
		isnull(CurrentInvoiceQty * CostPrice,0) [CreditAmount],
		isnull(CurrentTransferQty * CostPrice,0) [TransferAmount],
		--(isnull(OpeningBalance + CurrentReceivedQty - CurrentInvoiceQty- CurrentTransferQty,0)) * isnull(CostPrice, 0) [ClosingBlanaceAmount],
		(isnull(OpeningBalance *  CostPrice,0)) + (isnull(CurrentReceivedQty * CostPrice,0)) -  (isnull(CurrentInvoiceQty * CostPrice,0))
		- (isnull(CurrentTransferQty * CostPrice,0)) [ClosingBalanceAmount],

		isnull(SupplierName,'') SupplierName,
		isnull(FormationName,'') FormationName
		
		from #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
		
		--order by BrandFullName
		) T 
		where T.CP <> 0 or T.MRP <> 0 or T.BF <> 0 or T.Debit <> 0 or T.Credit <> 0 or T.[Transfer] <> 0 or T.[ClosingBalance] <> 0 or T.[BFAmount] <> 0
		or T.[DebitAmount] <> 0 or T.[CreditAmount] <> 0 or T.[TransferAmount] <> 0
		order by T.SupplierName FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	drop table #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReport
	drop table #TempSpGetPharmacyStockReportCostSale

end

-- =============================================

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPLoyalMemeberLedger] 

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPLoyalMemeberLedger]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	
AS
BEGIN
	select sr.Id,sr.Name,sr.ContactNo,sr.ReferranceName,sr.Remarks,tbl.DueAmount
	 from
	    (
			select gl.PLoyalMemberId,convert(real,SUM(gl.Debit-gl.Credit)) DueAmount
			from [Pharmacy].[PLoyalMemberLedgers] gl
			group by gl.PLoyalMemberId
		) tbl inner join
		[Pharmacy].[PLoyalMembers] sr on tbl.PLoyalMemberId=sr.Id 
END

--++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ SpGetProductLedger ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductLedger]
	@FilterStartDate DATE,
	@FilterEndDate DATE ,
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ProductId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN

	CREATE TABLE #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger(
		AutoID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1),
		TransDateTime DATETIME,
		Particulats	NVARCHAR(MAX),
		OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		productid  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		OPD_IPD		NVARCHAR(MAX), 
		--Op_Stock	float,	
		--PurchaseQty	float,
		--OutletReceive	float,
		--SalesReturn	float,
		--SRreceive float,
		--CertifiedReceive float,	
		--SaleQty	float,
		--OutletTransfer float,
		--SupplierReturn float,
		--Certifiedissue float,
		--Damage float,
		--ClosingStock float,  
		SysACTION BIGINT,
		EventType NVARCHAR(MAX),
		EventQty float)


		CREATE TABLE #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery
		(
		AutoID BIGINT,
		TransDateTime DATETIME,
		Particulats	NVARCHAR(MAX),
		OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		--productid  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
		OPD_IPD		NVARCHAR(MAX), 
		Op_Stock	float,	
		PurchaseQty	float,
		OutletReceive	float,
		SalesReturn	float,
		SRreceive float,
		CertifiedReceive float,	
		SaleQty	float,
		OutletTransfer float,
		SupplierReturn float,
		Certifiedissue float,
		Damage float,
		ClosingStock float,  
		SysACTION BIGINT
		--EventType NVARCHAR(MAX),
		--EventQty float
		)
		
		 

		INSERT INTO #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger
		(TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		--PurchaseQty,
		SysACTION,
		EventType,
		EventQty

		)
		SELECT dateadd(day,-1,@FilterStartDate), @ProductId,'',@OutletId, '' InvoiceNo,'OpeningBalance',[Pharmacy].[fnGetProductLedger](
			@FilterStartDate ,
			@FilterEndDate  ,
			@OutletId ,
			@ProductId 
		)  
		
		

		INSERT INTO #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger
		(TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		--PurchaseQty,
		SysACTION,
		EventType,
		EventQty

		)
		SELECT sr.EntryDate, srd.BrandExtensionId,'',sr.OutLetId, sr.InvoiceNo,'PurchaseQty',srd.Qty  
		FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives sr 
		JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd ON srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
		JOIN Admin.ServeTypes st ON st.id=sr.ReceiveTypeId
		WHERE st.id=13 AND srd.BrandExtensionId=@ProductId
		AND CONVERT(DATE,sr.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,sr.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
		AND sr.OutLetId=@OutletId


		INSERT INTO #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger
		(
		TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		SysACTION,
		EventType,
		EventQty

		)
		SELECT sr.EntryDate, srd.BrandExtensionId,'',sr.OutLetId,sr.InvoiceNo,'OutletReceive',srd.qty  FROM Pharmacy.StockReceives sr 
		JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd ON srd.StockReceiveId=sr.Id
		JOIN Admin.ServeTypes st ON st.id=sr.ReceiveTypeId
		WHERE st.id=16 AND srd.BrandExtensionId=@ProductId
		AND CONVERT(DATE,sr.EntryDate)>=@FilterStartDate AND CONVERT(DATE,sr.EntryDate)<=@FilterEndDate
		AND sr.OutLetId=@OutletId


		INSERT INTO #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger
		(
		TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		SysACTION,
		EventType,
		EventQty

		)

DECLARE   @AutoID bigint;
DECLARE   @OpeningQty float;
DECLARE   @CloseQty float;
DECLARE   @EventType nvarchar(max) =''
DECLARE   @EventQty float

set @OpeningQty = 0;
set @CloseQty =0;


DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR SELECT 
        AutoID,EventType,EventQty
    FROM 
        #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger
		order by TransDateTime
		;

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @AutoID,@EventType,@EventQty;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        insert into #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery 
		(
		Autoid,
		TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		SysACTION)
		select 
		AutoID,
		TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		SysACTION from #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger where Autoid = @AutoID

		if @CloseQty< 0  
		Begin	
			set @CloseQty = 0
		END 
		
		update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
		Op_Stock= @CloseQty
		where autoid = @AutoID
		
		IF @EventType ='OpeningBalance'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			Op_Stock = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='OpeningBalance'
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		ELSE IF @EventType ='PurchaseQty'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			PurchaseQty = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='Purchase Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		ELSE IF @EventType ='OutletReceive'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;

			
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			OutletReceive = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='OR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='SalesReturn'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SalesReturn = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='SR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END


		ELSE IF @EventType ='SRreceive'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SRreceive = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='SRreceive Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

				ELSE IF @EventType ='CertifiedReceive'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			CertifiedReceive = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='CR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		ELSE IF @EventType ='SaleQty'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SaleQty = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='Sale Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='OutletTransfer'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;


			if @CloseQty < 0 
			begin
				set @CloseQty = 0
				set @EventQty =0 
			end 
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			OutletTransfer = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='OTr Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

			ELSE IF @EventType ='SupplierReturn'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SupplierReturn = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='SR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='CertifiedIssue'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			Certifiedissue = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='CI Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='Damage'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			Damage = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='Damage Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		
		
		
		
		
        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
            @AutoID,@EventType,@EventQty;
    END

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

			

SELECT TransDateTime, Particulats, OutletId, OPD_IPD,isnull(Op_Stock,0) Op_Stock,isnull(PurchaseQty,0) PurchaseQty,isnull(OutletReceive,0) OutletReceive,isnull(SalesReturn,0) SalesReturn
		,isnull(SRreceive,0) SRreceive,isnull(CertifiedReceive,0) CertifiedReceive,isnull(SaleQty,0) SaleQty, isnull(OutletTransfer,0) OutletTransfer,isnull(SupplierReturn,0) SupplierReturn
		,isnull(Certifiedissue,0) Certifiedissue, isnull(Damage,0) Damage, ClosingStock,SysACTION FROM #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery
	order by TransDateTime 

		--SELECT * FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i 
		--		JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id ON id.InvoiceId=i.id
		--		JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd ON bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductLedgerDatewise]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE    procedure [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductLedgerDatewise]
(
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@ProductId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
)
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @CurrentStock   float,
	@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
	@ProductStockFilterEndDate nvarchar(max),
	@Char char ='#',
	@AvgCost char ='@',
	@Outlet char ='$',
	@LastChar char ='*'

	
	

	--return

	

	

		DECLARE @AvgCost_Vat char ='$'
	
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_ID uniqueidentifier
		DECLARE @CurrentProduct_stock float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCost float
		DECLARE @FilterStartProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @FilterEndProductAvgCostVat float
		DECLARE @OpeningOutletID nvarchar(max)

		
		
		declare @tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory TABLE   
		(

			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			ProductWiseStock nvarchar(250)
		)
		
		declare @tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory TABLE   
		(

		
			[AutoId] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			FilterDate date,
			ProductID uniqueidentifier,
			FilterStartDateStock float,
			FilterEndDateStock float,
			FilterStartProductAvgCost float,
			OutletID uniqueidentifier
		)


		
		
		

		select @ProductStock= t.ProductStock from [Pharmacy].[PharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterStartDate
		
		

		

		insert into @tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory
			(ProductWiseStock)
			select * from dbo.fnSplitString(@ProductStock,',')

			--select * from @tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory return 

			


		

--==========================================================--
DECLARE @ProductCurrentStock nvarchar(max)

DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR 
	select  ProductWiseStock from @tempPharmacyStockInfoesDateWiseHistory order by AutoId

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @ProductCurrentStock;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

		
select  @CurrentProduct_ID = SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,0,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock))
		select  @CurrentProduct_stock = convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
		--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock)
		(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock) - CHARINDEX(@Char,@ProductCurrentStock) -1 )

		))

				select  @FilterStartProductAvgCost = 
				convert(float, SUBSTRING(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1, 
				--len(@ProductCurrentStock) -CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)
				(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost_Vat,@ProductCurrentStock)) -(CHARINDEX(@AvgCost,@ProductCurrentStock)+1)
				))

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)

				--print @ProductCurrentStock
				--print (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))
				--print ( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock))
				select @OpeningOutletID = substring(@ProductCurrentStock,CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock)+1,
				( CHARINDEX(@LastChar,@ProductCurrentStock) - (CHARINDEX(@Outlet,@ProductCurrentStock))-1 )
				
				)
				--print @OpeningOutletID

		insert into @tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory
		(FilterDate,ProductID,FilterStartDateStock,FilterStartProductAvgCost,OutletID)
		select @FilterStartDate,Convert(uniqueidentifier, @CurrentProduct_ID),@CurrentProduct_stock,@FilterStartProductAvgCost,@OpeningOutletID

	  FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
		@ProductCurrentStock
	;
    END;

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

--==========================================================--




DECLARE @OpeningQty float =0


select @OpeningQty = isnull(FilterStartDateStock,0) from @tempPharmacyStockWiseInfoesDateWiseHistory where ProductID =@ProductId
and OutletID = @OutletId


		select @OpeningQty
END


GO
