set @OpeningQty = 0;
set @CloseQty =0;


DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
FOR SELECT 
        AutoID,EventType,EventQty
    FROM 
        #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger
		order by TransDateTime
		;

OPEN cursor_product;

FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
    @AutoID,@EventType,@EventQty;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        insert into #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery 
		(
		Autoid,
		TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		SysACTION)
		select 
		AutoID,
		TransDateTime,
		Particulats,
		OPD_IPD,
		OutletId,
		SysACTION from #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedger where Autoid = @AutoID
		
		update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
		Op_Stock= @CloseQty
		where autoid = @AutoID
		
		IF @EventType ='PurchaseQty'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			PurchaseQty = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='Purchase Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		ELSE IF @EventType ='OutletReceive'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			OutletReceive = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='OR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='SalesReturn'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SalesReturn = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='SR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END


		ELSE IF @EventType ='SRreceive'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty + @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SRreceive = @EventQty,

				ELSE IF @EventType ='CertifiedReceive'
		BEGIN

			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			CertifiedReceive = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='CR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		ELSE IF @EventType ='SaleQty'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,

			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='OutletTransfer'

			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			OutletTransfer = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='OTr Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

			ELSE IF @EventType ='SupplierReturn'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,

			Particulats  ='SR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;

		ELSE IF @EventType ='CertifiedIssue'

        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO

CLOSE cursor_product;

			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			CertifiedReceive = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='CR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		ELSE IF @EventType ='SaleQty'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SaleQty = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='Sale Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='OutletTransfer'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;

			---  2025-03-19
			------if @CloseQty < 0 
			------begin
			------	set @CloseQty = 0
			------	set @EventQty =0 
			------end 
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			OutletTransfer = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='OTr Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

			ELSE IF @EventType ='SupplierReturn'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			SupplierReturn = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='SR Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='CertifiedIssue'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			Certifiedissue = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='CI Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END

		ELSE IF @EventType ='Damage'
		BEGIN
			set @CloseQty = @CloseQty - @EventQty;
			
			update #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery set
			ClosingStock = @CloseQty,
			Damage = @EventQty,
			Particulats  ='Damage Invoice No : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),#TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery.SysACTION)
			where autoid = @Autoid;
			
		END
		
		
		
		
		
		
        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
            @AutoID,@EventType,@EventQty;
    END

CLOSE cursor_product;

DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

			

		SELECT TransDateTime,Particulats,OutletId,OPD_IPD,isnull(Op_Stock,0) Op_Stock,isnull(PurchaseQty,0) PurchaseQty,isnull(OutletReceive,0) OutletReceive,isnull(SalesReturn,0) SalesReturn
			   ,isnull(SRreceive,0) SRreceive,isnull(CertifiedReceive,0) CertifiedReceive,isnull(SaleQty,0) SaleQty, isnull(OutletTransfer,0) OutletTransfer,isnull(SupplierReturn,0) SupplierReturn
			   ,isnull(Certifiedissue,0) Certifiedissue, isnull(Damage,0) Damage, ClosingStock,SysACTION FROM #TempPharmacySpGetProductLedgerSummery
			   order by TransDateTime 

				--SELECT * FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i 
				--		JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id ON id.InvoiceId=i.id
				--		JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd ON bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
		END


GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductWiseReturnStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductWiseReturnStatement]'2021-01-15,2024-03-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
@FilterStartDate date,
@FilterEndDate date

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
----Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
----SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=19

select(select * from(
			select 
						ProductName,Abs(sum(ReturnQty)) ReturnQty, 
						--SaleRate,
						Abs(sum(ReturnAmount))ReturnAmount
			from (
					select bd.ProductName ProductName,id.Qty ReturnQty,id.SaleRate SaleRate ,
					id.Qty*id.SaleRate ReturnAmount

					--case when id.ser
					from Pharmacy.Invoices i
								join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id on id.InvoiceId=i.Id
								join Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd on bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
								where	convert(date,i.Invdate)>=@FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate and 
									(i.ServeTypeId=14 or i.ServeTypeId=15)
									--group by bd.ProductName
			)T
			group by t.ProductName,t.SaleRate

	) tbl order by tbl.ProductName FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data

END
GO

AS
BEGIN

Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (

----Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (

--select(select * from(

						ProductName,Abs(sum(ReturnQty)) ReturnQty, 
						--SaleRate,
						Abs(sum(ReturnAmount))ReturnAmount

								join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id on id.InvoiceId=i.Id

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductWiseSaleReport]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetProductWiseSaleReport]'2024-09-01,2024-09-01,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE
@FilterStartDate date,
@FilterEndDate date

Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
----Select @UserID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
----SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=19

select(
select 
ProductName,	SaleQty,	SaleRate,	round(TotalSalePrice,2) TotalSalePrice,	round(PurchaseRate,2) PurchaseRate,	round(TotalPurchasePrice,2) TotalPurchasePrice
from(
					select bd.ProductName ProductName, sum(id.Qty) SaleQty, round(avg(id.SaleRate),2) SaleRate,
					sum(id.Qty) * round(avg(id.SaleRate),2) TotalSalePrice,
					round(avg(id.PurchaseRate),0) PurchaseRate, sum(id.Qty) * round(avg(id.PurchaseRate),2) TotalPurchasePrice
					--case when id.ser
					from Pharmacy.Invoices i
								join Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id on id.InvoiceId=i.Id
								join Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd on bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
								left join Pharmacy.PLoyalMemberLedgers l on l.InvoiceId=i.id
								--join Pharmacy.PLoyalMembers lm on lm.id=l.PLoyalMemberId
								where	convert(date,i.Invdate)>=@FilterStartDate and
									convert(date,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
									and i.ServeTypeId not in (10)
									and (isnull(l.PLoyalMemberId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') not in ('B4EDA66F-25F5-474C-9A9B-08DC405107C2','8C2A9F7A-2ABA-487B-18C6-08DC8B5BBA91'))
									group by bd.ProductName

	) tbl order by tbl.ProductName 
	FOR JSON AUTO
) as Data
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPurchaseOrderByDateOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@OrderId uniqueidentifier,  
	@EntryDate DateTime,
	@GetById int   -- '0' or '1'  0-> by datetime, 1->Bu OrderId
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
if(@GetById=0)
BEGIN
	select po.Id,po.OrderNo,po.OrderToSupplierId,po.PurchaseDateTime,s.Name as SupplierName,po.Status,po.EntryDate,po.UserId
			from [Pharmacy].[PurchaseOrders] po inner join
			     [SupplyChain ].[Suppliers] s on po.OrderToSupplierId=s.Id
			where CONVERT(date,po.EntryDate)=CONVERT(date,@EntryDate)
END 
ELSE
BEGIN
	select po.Id,po.OrderNo,po.OrderToSupplierId,po.PurchaseDateTime,s.Name as SupplierName,po.Status,po.EntryDate,po.UserId
			from [Pharmacy].[PurchaseOrders] po inner join
			     [SupplyChain ].[Suppliers] s on po.OrderToSupplierId=s.Id
			where po.Id=@OrderId
END
END

---exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetPurchaseOrderDetailByOrderId] 'CBAC5ABE-7DD3-4225-A932-08DACD804802'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetPurchaseOrderDetailByOrderId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@OrderId uniqueidentifier 
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select po.Id, po.OrderId, po.BrandExtensionId, po.Qty, bd.ProductName,bd.PurchasePrice,bd.SalePrice,
	isnull(sum(cs.CurrentStock),0) CurrentStock,u.UserName UserName,
	po.Status
			from [Pharmacy].[PurchaseOrders] P inner join
			[Pharmacy].[PurchaseOrderDetails] po on po.OrderId=p.Id inner join 
			     [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on po.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId
				 LEFT join Pharmacy.ViewCurrentStock cs on cs.BrandExtensionId=po.BrandExtensionId
				 join [Identity].Users u on u.id=p.UserId
			where po.OrderId=@OrderId
			group by po.Id,po.OrderId,po.BrandExtensionId,po.Qty,bd.ProductName,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice,po.Status,u.UserName
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetRolRecordById]

AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF(@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
BEGIN
	SELECT rr.Id,rr.OutletId,rr.BrandExtensionId,rr.ROL,mo.Name OutletName,bd.ProductName

		 [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd ON rr.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId
	WHERE rr.Id=@Id
	ORDER BY rr.CreatedOn DESC
END
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetStockReceiveByDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
AS
BEGIN
	select sr.Id,sr.SupplierId,sr.InvoiceNo,sr.OrderId,sr.OutLetId,sr.EntryDate,sr.Remarks,sr.TotalAmount,sr.Discount,sr.VatAmount,sr.GrandTotal,sr.SupplierInvoiceDate,sr.SupplierInvoiceNo
		   ,sr.SupplierChallanNo,sr.IPDReturnBillId,sr.OPDReturnBillId,sr.UserId,sr.TenantId,s.Name SupplierName,u.UserName,mo.Name OutletName,sr.SupplierReturnIndentNo,sr.ReceiveTypeId
	  from [Pharmacy].[StockReceives] sr inner join

		   [Identity].[Users] u on sr.UserId=u.Id inner join
		   [Pharmacy].[MedicineOutlets] mo on sr.OutLetId=mo.Id
	 where cast(sr.EntryDate as date) >= cast(@FromDate as date) and cast(sr.EntryDate as date) <= cast(@ToDate as date)
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetSupplierReturnIndentByDatesOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@OutletId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	select sr.Id,sr.SupplierId, sr.ReceiveId, sr.RetDate,sr.RetStatus,sr.UserId,sr.FromOutletId,sr.IndentNo,s.Name SupplierName,st.Name RetStatusTxt,mo.Name FromOutletName,u.UserName IndentBy

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetSupplierReturnIndentDetailByIndentId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@IndentId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT srid.Id,srid.SupplierReturnIndentId,srid.BrandExtensionId,bd.ProductName,srid.Qty,srid.LotRecordId,srid.Status,lr.BatchNo,lr.ExpireDate,st.Name StatusTxt,srid.ReturnBrandExtentionId,rbd.ProductName ReturnProductName,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice
	FROM [Pharmacy].[SupplierReturnIndentDetails] srid INNER JOIN
		 [Pharmacy].[SupplierReturnIndents] sri on srid.SupplierReturnIndentId=sri.Id inner join
		 [Pharmacy].[ViewBrandAndStockDetails] bd ON srid.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId and srid.LotRecordId=bd.LotId and sri.FromOutletId=bd.OutLetId INNER JOIN
		 [Pharmacy].[LotRecords] lr ON srid.LotRecordId=lr.Id left join
		 [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on srid.Status=st.Id left join
		 [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] rbd on srid.ReturnBrandExtentionId=rbd.ProductId
	WHERE srid.SupplierReturnIndentId=@IndentId
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [Pharmacy].[SpGetSupplierWiseSaleReport]'2024-01-15,2024-01-30,2024,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'


CREATE     PROCEDURE [Pharmacy].[SpGetSupplierWiseSaleReport]
	@Paramas NVARCHAR(max)
AS
BEGIN
	Declare
		@FilterStartDate date,
		@FilterEndDate DATE,
		@SupplierID uniqueidentifier

					Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
					Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
					Select @SupplierID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
					SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8

						select(
							select * from(


	SELECT 
			bd.ProductName AS ProductName,
			bd.SalePrice AS SaleRate,
			SUM(id.Qty) AS SaleQty,
			SUM(id.Qty) * bd.SalePrice [TotalSaleAmount],
			bd.PurchasePrice AS PurchaseRate,
			s.Name AS SupplierName
			FROM Pharmacy.Invoices i
			JOIN Pharmacy.InvoiceDetails id ON id.InvoiceId=i.Id
			JOIN Pharmacy.BrandDetails bd ON bd.ProductId=id.BrandExtensionId
			--JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails srd ON srd.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId
			--JOIN Pharmacy.StockReceives sr ON sr.id=srd.StockReceiveId

								JOIN Pharmacy.Manufacturers m ON m.id=bd.ManufacturerId
			JOIN [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s ON s.ManufacturerId=m.Id
			WHERE convert(DATE,i.Invdate) >=@FilterStartDate
			AND convert(DATE,i.Invdate) <=@FilterEndDate
			AND (i.ServeTypeId IN (7,8,14,15))
			and (@SupplierID=s.Id or @SupplierID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
			GROUP BY bd.ProductName,bd.SalePrice,bd.PurchasePrice,s.Name

				) tbl  FOR JSON AUTO
							) as Data
END

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-------------------------


-- Exec [Rx].[GetAppointmentInvoiceByDatesByDates] '2025-01-23','2025-01-23', 0

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Rx].[GetAppointmentInvoiceByDatesByDates]
	@StartDate Date,
	@EndDateTime Date,
	@Type int
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if(@Type = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			da.Id
		   ,da.UHID
		   ,da.DoctorId
		   ,d.Name DoctorName
		   ,da.VisitTypeId
		   ,da.AppointmentDate
		   ,da.AppointmentTime
		   ,da.Fee
		   ,da.Status
		   ,da.CreatedBy
		   ,da.CreatedOn
		   ,da.LastModifiedBy
		   ,da.LastModifiedOn
		   ,da.IsDeleted
		   ,da.IsSynced
		   ,da.Remarks
		   ,da.SerialNo
		   ,da.UserId
		   ,cpr.InvoiceNo
		   ,cpr.CreatedOn InvoiceTime
		   ,cpr.DoctorAppointmentId
		   ,cpr.UHID
		   ,cpr.FullName
		   ,cpr.MobileNo
		   ,cpr.AgeYear
		   ,cpr.AgeMonth
		   ,cpr.AgeDay
		   ,cpr.Gender
		   --,ccr.Id
		   ,ccr.CPPatientRecordId
		   ,ccr.CPId
		   ,ccr.VisitTypeId
		   ,ccr.VisitDate
		   ,ccr.VisitFee
		   ,ccr.Status AS CcrStatus
		FROM OPD.DoctorAppointments da
			left join Rx.InitialDatas id on da.Id = id.AppointmentId
			Left JOIN OPD.CPPatientRecords cpr ON da.Id = cpr.DoctorAppointmentId
			Left JOIN OPD.CPFeeCollectionRecords ccr ON cpr.Id = ccr.CPPatientRecordId
			Left JOIN Marketing.Doctors d ON d.Id = da.DoctorId
		WHERE da.Status IN ('Invoiced') 
			AND id.AppointmentId is null
			AND CAST(da.AppointmentDate as Date) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDateTime
	 END
	 ELSe
	 BEGIN
 		SELECT
			da.Id
		   ,da.UHID
		   ,da.DoctorId
		   ,d.Name DoctorName
		   ,da.VisitTypeId
		   ,da.AppointmentDate
		   ,da.AppointmentTime
		   ,da.Fee
		   ,da.Status
		   ,da.CreatedBy
		   ,da.CreatedOn
		   ,da.LastModifiedBy
		   ,da.LastModifiedOn
		   ,da.IsDeleted
		   ,da.IsSynced
		   ,da.Remarks
		   ,da.SerialNo
		   ,da.UserId
		   ,cpr.InvoiceNo
		   ,cpr.CreatedOn InvoiceTime
		   ,cpr.DoctorAppointmentId
		   ,cpr.UHID
		   ,cpr.FullName
		   ,cpr.MobileNo
		   ,cpr.AgeYear
		   ,cpr.AgeMonth
		   ,cpr.AgeDay
		   ,cpr.Gender
		   --,ccr.Id
		   ,ccr.CPPatientRecordId
		   ,ccr.CPId
		   ,ccr.VisitTypeId
		   ,ccr.VisitDate
		   ,ccr.VisitFee
		   ,ccr.Status AS CcrStatus
		FROM OPD.DoctorAppointments da
			Left JOIN OPD.CPPatientRecords cpr ON da.Id = cpr.DoctorAppointmentId
			Left JOIN OPD.CPFeeCollectionRecords ccr ON cpr.Id = ccr.CPPatientRecordId
			Left JOIN Marketing.Doctors d ON d.Id = da.DoctorId
		WHERE da.Status IN ('Vital', 'Prescribed') AND
		CAST(da.AppointmentDate as Date) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDateTime
	 END
END

-- Exec [Rx].[GetOPDProdureSuggessionPatientByDates] '2025-03-11','2025-03-12'

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Rx].[GetOPDProdureSuggessionPatientByDates]
	@StartDate date,
	@EndDateTime date
AS
BEGIN
	select rr.UHID,rr.FullName,rr.AgeYear, rr.MobileNo, vh.VisitDate,vh.Id VisitId, pro.IndentStatus, Pro.IndentBy, Pro.IndentNo, Pro.IndentDate, pro.Remarks
	  from (
	   select ps.RxVisitId, 
		   ISNULL(r.IndentStatus,'pending') as IndentStatus, 
		   ps.IndentBy, 
		   CONVERT(SmallDateTime,  ps.CreatedOn) as IndentDate, 
		   ps.IndentNo, 
		   ps.Remarks
	   from [Rx].[OPDProdureSuggessions] ps 
		join Rx.VisitHistories vh on vh.Id = ps.RxVisitId
		join Hospital.VitalSignRecords r on r.Id = vh.VitalSignRecordId
		group by ps.RxVisitId,r.IndentStatus, ps.IndentBy, ps.IndentNo,ps.Remarks,CONVERT(SmallDateTime,  ps.CreatedOn)
	  )pro left JOIN
	  
	  [Rx].[VisitHistories] vh on pro.RxVisitId=vh.Id inner join
	  [Rx].[PatientMasterDatas] md on vh.PatientMasterDataId=md.Id inner join
	  [Hospital].[RegRecords] rr on md.UHID=rr.UHID
	where CAST(pro.IndentDate as date)  between   @StartDate and @EndDateTime
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Rx].[spGetDoctorAppointmentsByMobileNo]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- exec [Rx].[spGetDoctorAppointmentsByMobileNo] '01312345789'

CREATE       PROCEDURE [Rx].[spGetDoctorAppointmentsByMobileNo]
	@mobileNo nvarchar(100)
AS 
BEGIN 
	Select
		ap.Id,
		v.RxNo,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (select 1)) SrlNo, 
		ap.UHID, 
		ap.VisitTypeId, 
		vt.Name VisitType,
		ap.Id, 
		ap.Fee, 
		ap.Status, 
		ap.RxInitDDate, 
		ap.FullName, 
		ap.MobileNo, 
		ap.AgeYear, 
		ap.AgeDay, 
		ap.AgeMonth, 
		ap.Sex, 
		ap.AppointmentDate, 
		cpCol.VisitDate As BillingTime, 
		ap.AppointmentTime, 
		ap.Remarks as Remarks, 
		ap.SerialNo, 
		ap.UserId, 
		u.UserName, 
		ap.DoctorId, 
		d.Name DoctorName,
		isnull(rd.Name,'') RefdDoctorName,
		ap.ClinicalFindings,
		ap.ClinicalImpression,
		ISNULL(rxd.Name, '') DepartmentName,
		ISNULL(rxd.FeatureKey, '') DeptFeatureKey
	from OPD.DoctorAppointments ap
		join rx.VisitHistories v on v.AppointmentId = ap.Id
		join Marketing.Doctors d on ap.DoctorId = d.Id 
		Join [Identity].Users u on ap.UserId = u.Id 
		join OPD.PatientVisitTypes vt on vt.Id = ap.VisitTypeId
		left join Marketing.Doctors rd on ap.RefdDoctorId = rd.Id 
		Left join OPD.CPPatientRecords as cpR On cpR.DoctorAppointmentId = ap.Id 
		Left join OPD.CPFeeCollectionRecords as cpCol On cpCol.CPPatientRecordId = cpR.Id
		Left join Rx.RxDepartments as rxd On ap.RxDepartmentId = rxd.Id
	where  ap.MobileNo = @mobileNo
END
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [Rx].[SpGetDrugByPrescriptionId]
	@PrescriptionId uniqueidentifier,
	@OutletId uniqueIdentifier = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select d.Id,d.RxVisitId,
		d.BrandExtensionId,
		d.Dosage,
		d.Duration,
		d.Qty,
		isnull((select sum(CurrentStock) from Pharmacy.ViewBrandAndStockDetails where OutLetId = @OutletId and ProductId = d.BrandExtensionId),0) CurrentStock,
		isNull(bd.ProductName, d.ManualDrugName) as ProductName,
		d.ManualDrugName,
		d.TreatmentType
	  from [Rx].[Drugs] d 
	  left join [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on d.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId
	 where d.PrescriptionId=@PrescriptionId
	 order by d.DisplayOrder
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO






-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [Rx].[SpGetRunningDrugByUHID] 23122010527, 1

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Rx].[SpGetRunningDrugByUHID]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UHID bigint,
	@NotRunning int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @MasterId as uniqueidentifier;
	declare @LastVistId as uniqueidentifier;
	set @MasterId=(select top 1 pmd.Id from [Rx].[PatientMasterDatas] pmd where pmd.UHID=@UHID order by pmd.CreatedOn desc);
	set @LastVistId=(select top 1 vh.Id from [Rx].[VisitHistories] vh where vh.PatientMasterDataId=@MasterId order by vh.VisitNo desc)
	if(@NotRunning=0)
	begin
		select d.Id,d.RxVisitId,d.BrandExtensionId,d.Dosage,d.Duration,d.Qty,bd.ProductName,d.TreatmentType
		  from [Rx].[Drugs] d inner join
			   [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on d.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId
		 where d.RxVisitId=@LastVistId
	end
	else
	begin
		select d.Id,d.RxVisitId,d.BrandExtensionId,d.Dosage,d.Duration,d.Qty,bd.ProductName,d.TreatmentType
		  from [Rx].[Drugs] d inner join
			   [Pharmacy].[BrandDetails] bd on d.BrandExtensionId=bd.ProductId inner join
			   [Rx].[VisitHistories] vh on d.RxVisitId=vh.Id
		 where d.RxVisitId!=@LastVistId and vh.PatientMasterDataId=@MasterId
	end
END
GO

-- exec [Rx].[SpGetRxInvestigationHistoryByUHID] 2501180000202

Create      PROCEDURE [Rx].[SpGetRxInvestigationHistoryByUHID]
	@UHID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT 
	  id.id InvoiceDetailId, 
	  inv.uhid, 
	  inv.invoiceno, 
	  inv.entrydate [Date], 
	  ti.NAME TestName, 
	  ti.Id TestId,
	  tg.ParentGroupId,
	  tg.NAME TestGroup, 
	  Isnull(d.NAME, '') RefdDoctor 
	FROM 
	  diag.investigationinvoices inv 
	  JOIN diag.investigationinvoicedetails id ON inv.id = id.investigationinvoiceid 
	  JOIN diag.testitems ti ON ti.id = id.testitemid 
	  JOIN diag.testgroups tg ON tg.id = ti.testgroupid 
	  LEFT JOIN vwdoctors d ON inv.refddoctorid = d.id 
	WHERE 
	  inv.uhid = @UHID and ti.TestGroupId != '24269BFC-372B-41C8-A127-913C1FC0D9DA'
END

-- =============================================

--Exec [Rx].[SpGetRxRegRecordByDoctorId] '4aa5d4a9-3459-4e70-9ae9-08da89b3f48f'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [Rx].[SpGetRxRegRecordByDoctorId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DoctorId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT rr.Id,rr.UHIDPrefix,rr.UHID,rr.Title,rr.GivenName,rr.Surname,rr.FullName,rr.AgeYear,rr.AgeMonth,rr.AgeDay,
			rr.Dob,rr.Sex,rr.FatherName,rr.MotherName,rr.MaritalStatus,rr.Profession,rr.MobileNo,rr.Email,rr.CareOf,rr.HouseNo,rr.RoadNo,rr.Po,rr.ArearOrThana,
			rr.District,rr.PatientAddress,rr.MembershipType,rr.UnionId,rr.Cpname,rr.CphouseNo,rr.CproadNo,rr.Cpvillage,rr.Cppo,rr.CparearOrThana,rr.Cpdistrict,
			rr.Cpaddress,rr.Cpmobile,rr.CpnationalId,rr.RelationWithPatient,rr.BloodGroup,rr.SpouseName,rr.Status,rr.CompanyId,rr.Others,rr.NationalId,rr.DesignationId,
			rr.NoOfSons,rr.NoOfDaughters,rr.Village,rr.UpazilaOrAreaId,rr.LocalGurdianUpazilaOrAreaId,rr.RegDate,rr.IsRegisterd,rr.RefdId,rr.EmployeeId,rr.TenantId,rr.IDType,rr.IDNo,
			isnull(pm.Id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') PatientMasterDataId
	FROM 
		(select * from 
		[Hospital].[RegRecords] r where r.UHID in 
		(
			select distinct a.UHID from (
				SELECT vh.DoctorId, pmd.UHID
				FROM 
					[Rx].[VisitHistories] vh INNER JOIN
					[Rx].[PatientMasterDatas] pmd ON pmd.Id=vh.PatientMasterDataId
				WHERE vh.DoctorId=@DoctorId
				GROUP BY vh.DoctorId, pmd.UHID
				union 
				select da.DoctorId,da.UHID
				from [OPD].[DoctorAppointments] da where da.DoctorId=@DoctorId) a
		)) rr
		left join
		(select pmda.Id,pmda.UHID
		from 
		[Rx].[PatientMasterDatas] pmda inner join
		[Rx].[VisitHistories] vh on pmda.Id = vh.PatientMasterDataId where vh.DoctorId=@DoctorId) pm on rr.UHID=pm.UHID
		group by rr.Id,rr.UHIDPrefix,rr.UHID,rr.Title,rr.GivenName,rr.Surname,rr.FullName,rr.AgeYear,rr.AgeMonth,rr.AgeDay,
			rr.Dob,rr.Sex,rr.FatherName,rr.MotherName,rr.MaritalStatus,rr.Profession,rr.MobileNo,rr.Email,rr.CareOf,rr.HouseNo,rr.RoadNo,rr.Po,rr.ArearOrThana,
			rr.District,rr.PatientAddress,rr.MembershipType,rr.UnionId,rr.Cpname,rr.CphouseNo,rr.CproadNo,rr.Cpvillage,rr.Cppo,rr.CparearOrThana,rr.Cpdistrict,
			rr.Cpaddress,rr.Cpmobile,rr.CpnationalId,rr.RelationWithPatient,rr.BloodGroup,rr.SpouseName,rr.Status,rr.CompanyId,rr.Others,rr.NationalId,rr.DesignationId,
			rr.NoOfSons,rr.NoOfDaughters,rr.Village,rr.UpazilaOrAreaId,rr.LocalGurdianUpazilaOrAreaId,rr.RegDate,rr.IsRegisterd,rr.RefdId,rr.EmployeeId,rr.TenantId,rr.IDType,rr.IDNo,
			pm.Id
		
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseRequisiontionWithApprovalLevel]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>

--exec [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseRequisiontionWithApprovalLevel] '2023-01-01','2023-12-01','58a5ec47-d314-46c5-8441-f0ecffe132b6'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseRequisiontionWithApprovalLevel]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@RoleId nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @TmpTbl table (
		Id uniqueidentifier,
		RequisitionNo bigint,
		MainStoreId uniqueidentifier,
		StoreId uniqueidentifier,
		RequisitionDate datetime,
		RequisitionTime nvarchar(max),
		Note nvarchar(max),
		TermsOfCondition nvarchar(max),
		UserId uniqueidentifier,
		MainStoreName nvarchar(max),
		UserName nvarchar(max),
		StoreDeptId uniqueidentifier,
		SupplierId uniqueidentifier,
		IsCashPurchase bit,
		IsCreditPurchase bit,
		StoreDeptName nvarchar(max),
		SupplierName nvarchar(max),
		PRSubmittedId uniqueidentifier
	);
	insert into @TmpTbl
		exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetPurchaseRequisiontionByDatesOrId] @FromDate,@ToDate,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0;
	select t.*,isnull(Approvaled.ApprovalLevelId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') ApprovalLevelId,isnull(Approvaled.NextApprovalLevelId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') NextApprovalLevelId
	from @TmpTbl t left join
		(
			SELECT m1.RequisitionId,m1.ApprovalLevelId,m1.NextApprovalLevelId
			FROM [SupplyChain ].[RequisitionApprovals] m1 LEFT JOIN [SupplyChain ].[RequisitionApprovals] m2
			 ON (m1.RequisitionId = m2.RequisitionId AND m1.ApprovalDate < m2.ApprovalDate)
			WHERE m2.Id IS NULL
		) Approvaled on t.Id=Approvaled.RequisitionId inner join
		(
			select COUNT(sia.Id) LevelCnt,sia.MainStoreId
			 from [SupplyChain ].[SCMPurchaseApprovalSettings] sia group by MainStoreId
		)lc on t.MainStoreId=lc.MainStoreId left join
		[SupplyChain ].[SCMPurchaseApprovalSettings] si on t.MainStoreId=si.MainStoreId and si.RoleId=@RoleId left join
		[SupplyChain ].[SCMPurchaseApprovalSettings] sias on Approvaled.NextApprovalLevelId=sias.Id and sias.RoleId=@RoleId 
	where (((lc.LevelCnt=1 and si.ApprovalLevel='Final') or (lc.LevelCnt>1 and si.ApprovalLevel='Level1' )) and Approvaled.ApprovalLevelId is null) or (Approvaled.NextApprovalLevelId is not null and sias.Id is not null)
END


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [SupplyChain ].[SP_SET_SupplyChain_Opening_Stock]    Script Date: 09/27/25 6:46:22 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SP_SET_SupplyChain_Opening_Stock]
	@FilterDate date
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
		@ProductId int, 
		@CurrentStock   float,
		@ProductStock nvarchar(max),
		@Char char ='#',
		@EndFilterChar char ='@',
		@EndFilterCharWithVat char ='$',
		@EndFilterCharWithOurtlet char ='*',
		@ProductAvgCost float,
		@ProductAvgCostWithVat float,

		@Id uniqueidentifier,
		@Stock float,
		@PurchaseRate float,
		@OutletID int

		set @ProductStock =''

		DECLARE cursor_product CURSOR
		FOR 
			
		  

		  select [Id],sum([ReceivedStock])  - sum(IssueQty) [Stock],avg([PurchaseRate]) [PurchaseRate],OutLetId
from 
(

			select b.id,d.Qty [ReceivedStock] ,0 IssueQty,  d.PurchaseRate  [PurchaseRate], 0  OutLetId
			from [SupplyChain ].StockReceiveDetails d
			join [SupplyChain ].StockReceives r on r.Id = d.StockReceiveId
			join [SupplyChain ].BrandExtensions be on be.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
			join [SupplyChain ].BrandNames b on b.Id = be.BrandId


			union all

			select b.id,0 [Stock] , rd.Qty,  0  [PurchaseRate], 0  OutLetId
			from [SupplyChain ].IssueDetails rd
			join [SupplyChain ].Issues r on r.Id = rd.IssueId
			join [SupplyChain ].BrandExtensions be on be.Id = rd.BrandExtensionId
			join [SupplyChain ].BrandNames b on b.Id = be.BrandId



				/*
				SELECT 
				b.[Id]
			  ,sum(v.CurrentStock) [Stock]
			  --,AVG(vd.PurchasePrice) [PurchaseRate]
			  ,0 [PurchaseRate]
			  ,v.OutLetId
			 
		  FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  --join [Pharmacy].ViewBrandAndStockDetails vd 
		  	--where b.id ='EFF3E987-3BEF-4BE0-96CC-68CF9AFD0E13'
		  group by b.[Id],v.OutLetId,v.BrandExtensionId

		  union all


		  SELECT 
				b.[Id]
			  ,0 [Stock]
			  ,AVG(vd.PurchaseAvgRate) [PurchaseRate]
			  ,v.OutLetId
			 
		  FROM [Pharmacy].[ViewCurrentStock] v
		  join Pharmacy.BrandExtensions b on b.Id = v.BrandExtensionId
		  join ViewBrandAndStockDetailsWithoutlot vd 
		  on		vd.ProductId = v.BrandExtensionId
				and vd.OutLetId = v.OutLetId
				--where b.id ='EFF3E987-3BEF-4BE0-96CC-68CF9AFD0E13'
		  group by b.[Id],v.OutLetId
		  )T
		  group by  [Id],OutLetId
		  */
		  
		  /*
		  select srd.BrandExtensionId [Id] ,sum(srd.Qty) [Stock], 
sum(srd.Qty * srd.PurchaseRate) /sum(srd.Qty)

[PurchaseRate] ,sr.OutLetId 
FROM            Pharmacy.StockReceives AS sr INNER JOIN
                         Pharmacy.StockReceiveDetails AS srd ON sr.Id = srd.StockReceiveId
						 where convert(date,sr.EntryDate) <>'2023-09-07'
						 group by srd.BrandExtensionId, sr.OutLetId
		  
		  */
		  )T
		  group by T.Id,T.OutLetId
		OPEN cursor_product;

		FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
				@Id
			   ,@Stock
			  ,@PurchaseRate
			  ,@OutletID
			 

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
				set @ProductStock = @ProductStock + ','+convert(varchar(max),@Id) +@Char
				+convert(varchar(50),@Stock) +@EndFilterChar
				+ convert(varchar(50),isnull(@PurchaseRate,0)) + @EndFilterCharWithVat
				+ convert(varchar(50),isnull(@OutletID,0)) + @EndFilterCharWithOurtlet

				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_product INTO 
				@Id
			   ,@Stock
			  ,@PurchaseRate
			  ,@OutletID

		END;

CLOSE cursor_product;
DEALLOCATE cursor_product;

set @ProductStock = substring(@ProductStock,2,len(@ProductStock)+1)

print @ProductStock

Declare @RowCount int =0
Declare @RowAutoID int
select  @RowCount = count(*) from [SupplyChain].[SupplyChainStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] t where t.FilterDate = @FilterDate


if  @RowCount =0 
begin 
	insert into [SupplyChain].[SupplyChainStockInfoesDateWiseHistories] 
	(FilterDate,BrandStock)
	values (@FilterDate,@ProductStock)
	print '---Done-'
End


END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetPurchaseRequisiontionByDatesOrId] '2025-06-03','2025-06-03','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0
-- exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetApprovedPurchaseRequisition] '2025-06-04','2025-06-04'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetApprovedPurchaseRequisition]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
AS
BEGIN
	declare @TmpTbl table (
		Id uniqueidentifier,
		RequisitionNo bigint,
		MainStoreId uniqueidentifier,
		StoreId uniqueidentifier,
		RequisitionDate datetime,
		RequisitionTime nvarchar(max),
		Note nvarchar(max),
		TermsOfCondition nvarchar(max),
		UserId uniqueidentifier,
		MainStoreName nvarchar(max),
		UserName nvarchar(max),
		StoreDeptId uniqueidentifier,
		SupplierId uniqueidentifier,
		IsCashPurchase bit,
		IsCreditPurchase bit,
		StoreDeptName nvarchar(max),
		SupplierName nvarchar(max),
		PRSubmittedId uniqueidentifier
	);
	insert into @TmpTbl
		exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetPurchaseRequisiontionByDatesOrId] @FromDate,@ToDate,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0;
	select t.*,ISNULL(po.Id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')OrderId
	from @TmpTbl t left join
		(
			SELECT m1.RequisitionId,m1.ApprovalLevelId,m1.NextApprovalLevelId
			FROM [SupplyChain ].[RequisitionApprovals] m1 LEFT JOIN [SupplyChain ].[RequisitionApprovals] m2
			 ON (m1.RequisitionId = m2.RequisitionId AND m1.ApprovalDate < m2.ApprovalDate)
			WHERE m2.Id IS NULL
		) Approvaled on t.Id=Approvaled.RequisitionId inner join
		(
			select COUNT(sia.Id) LevelCnt,sia.MainStoreId
			 from [SupplyChain ].[SCMPurchaseApprovalSettings] sia group by sia.MainStoreId
		)lc on t.MainStoreId=lc.MainStoreId inner join
		[SupplyChain ].[SCMPurchaseApprovalSettings] si on Approvaled.ApprovalLevelId=si.Id and si.ApprovalLevel='Final'
		left join SupplyChain.PurchaseOrders po on t.id=po.RequisitionId
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetBrandExtensionCurrentStock] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE       PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetBrandExtensionCurrentStock]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;	
		select be.Id,be.BrandId,be.Name,be.PurchasePrice,be.SalePrice,bn.Name BrandName,bn.Unit,isnull(StockTbl.LotRecordId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') LotRecordId
				,isnull(StockTbl.CurStock,0) CurStock,lr.ExpireDate,be.ROL
		  from [SupplyChain ].[BrandExtensions] be left join
			   [SupplyChain ].[BrandNames] bn on be.BrandId=bn.Id left join
			   (
					select isnull(StockIn.BrandExtensionId,StockOut.BrandExtensionId) BrandExtensionId,isnull(StockIn.LotRecordId,StockOut.LotRecordId) LotRecordId,(isnull(StockIn.InQty,0)-isnull(StockOut.OutQty,0)) CurStock
					 from 
					    (
							select srd.BrandExtensionId,srd.LotRecordId,sum(srd.Qty) InQty
								from [SupplyChain ].[SStockTransferDetails] srd
								inner join [SupplyChain ].[SStockTransfer] st on st.Id=srd.TransferId
								inner join [SupplyChain ].[Stores] s on st.SubStoreId=s.Id
							group by srd.BrandExtensionId, srd.LotRecordId
						) StockIn left join
						(
							select id.BrandExtensionId,id.LotRecordId,sum(id.Qty) OutQty
								from [SupplyChain ].[IssueDetails] id 
							group by id.BrandExtensionId,id.LotRecordId
						) StockOut on StockIn.BrandExtensionId=StockOut.BrandExtensionId --and StockIn.LotRecordId=StockOut.LotRecordId
			   ) StockTbl on be.Id=StockTbl.BrandExtensionId left join
			   [SupplyChain ].[LotRecords] lr on lr.Id=StockTbl.LotRecordId
		where be.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
END
GO

CREATE         PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetBrandExtensionCurrentStockFromMainStore]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;	
		select be.Id,be.BrandId,be.Name,be.PurchasePrice,be.SalePrice,bn.Name BrandName,bn.Unit,isnull(StockTbl.LotRecordId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') LotRecordId
				,isnull(StockTbl.CurStock,0) CurStock,lr.ExpireDate,be.ROL
		  from [SupplyChain ].[BrandExtensions] be left join
			   [SupplyChain ].[BrandNames] bn on be.BrandId=bn.Id left join
			   (
					select isnull(StockIn.BrandExtensionId,StockOut.BrandExtensionId) BrandExtensionId,isnull(StockIn.LotRecordId,StockOut.LotRecordId) LotRecordId,(isnull(StockIn.InQty,0)-isnull(StockOut.OutQty,0)) CurStock
					 from 
					    (
							select srd.BrandExtensionId,srd.LotRecordId,sum(srd.Qty) InQty
								from [SupplyChain ].[StockReceiveDetails] srd 
								inner join [SupplyChain ].[StockReceives] sr on sr.Id=srd.StockReceiveId
								inner join [SupplyChain ].MainStores ms on ms.Id=sr.MainStoreId
							group by srd.BrandExtensionId, srd.LotRecordId
						) StockIn left join
						(
							select std.BrandExtensionId,std.LotRecordId,sum(std.Qty) OutQty
								from [SupplyChain ].[SStockTransferDetails] std
								inner join [SupplyChain ].[SStockTransfer] st on st.Id=std.TransferId
								inner join [SupplyChain ].[MainStores] ms on st.MainStoreId=ms.Id
							group by std.BrandExtensionId,std.LotRecordId
						) StockOut on StockIn.BrandExtensionId=StockOut.BrandExtensionId --and StockIn.LotRecordId=StockOut.LotRecordId
			   ) StockTbl on be.Id=StockTbl.BrandExtensionId left join
			   [SupplyChain ].[LotRecords] lr on lr.Id=StockTbl.LotRecordId
		where be.Id=@Id or @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudiesCompareReport]
@CSNo nvarchar(max) =''
AS
--exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudiesCompareReport]  'CS1234567'

BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @DynamicPivotQuery AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @ColumnName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)


	
	SELECT m.Id,m.CSDate,m.CSNo,s.Name [SupplierName],s.Address,b.Name [BrandName],d.Qty,d.UnitPrice,d.TotalPrice,d.VatInTk,d.AITInTk 
	into #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils
	from [SupplyChain ].ComparativeStudies m 
	join [SupplyChain ].ComparativeStudyDetails d on d.ComparativeStudyId = m.Id
	join [SupplyChain ].BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
	join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s on s.id = d.SupplierId
	where 
	(@CSNo ='' or m.CSNo =@CSNo)




	select  ID,CSDate,CSNo,BrandName,Qty
	into  #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
	from 
	#TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils
	group by ID,CSDate,CSNo,BrandName,Qty 

	


	DECLARE @Supplier_Name nvarchar(max)

	DECLARE Cursor_Supplier CURSOR
		FOR select Distinct SupplierName from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils;
	OPEN Cursor_Supplier;
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_Supplier INTO
		@Supplier_Name;
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
	BEGIN
		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='alter table #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
		add ['+@Supplier_Name+'UnitPrice]  float'
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery

		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='alter table #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
		add ['+@Supplier_Name+'TotalPrice]  float'
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery

	

		


		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='update #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery set ['+@Supplier_Name+'UnitPrice] =
		(
			select unitprice from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils  where suppliername ='''+@Supplier_Name+'''
		) '
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery
		
		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='update #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery set ['+@Supplier_Name+'TotalPrice] =
		['+@Supplier_Name+'UnitPrice] * Qty '
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery


		


		

		FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_Supplier INTO
		@Supplier_Name;
	END
	CLOSE Cursor_Supplier
	DEALLOCATE Cursor_Supplier

	
	
	select * from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
	

END
GO

-- Exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetails] 'CS0000001','','','2024-01-01','2024-08-26'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetails]
@CSNo nvarchar(max) ='',
@SupplierName nvarchar(max) ='',
@BrandName nvarchar(max) ='',
@FilterStartDate date ='2000-1-1',
@FilterEndDate date  ='2050-1-1'
AS
BEGIN


	
	SELECT m.Id,m.CSDate,m.CSNo,s.Name [SupplierName],s.Address,b.Name [BrandName],d.Qty,d.UnitPrice,d.TotalPrice,d.VatInTk,d.AITInTk 
	into #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils
	from [SupplyChain ].ComparativeStudies m 
	join [SupplyChain ].ComparativeStudyDetails d on d.ComparativeStudyId = m.Id
	join [SupplyChain ].BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
	join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s on s.id = d.SupplierId
	where 
	(@CSNo ='' or m.CSNo =@CSNo)
	and (@BrandName ='' or b.Name  like '%'+@BrandName+'%')
	and (@SupplierName ='' or s.Name  like '%'+@SupplierName+'%')
	
	and convert(date,m.CSDate)>=@FilterStartDate
	and convert(date,m.CSDate)<=@FilterEndDate


	select t.CSNo,t.CSDate,t.SupplierName,t.BrandName [ProductName],t.Qty, t.UnitPrice,t.TotalPrice from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils t


END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudiesCompareReportTemp]
@CSNo nvarchar(max) =''
AS
--exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudiesCompareReportTemp]  'CS1234567'
BEGIN
	DECLARE @DynamicPivotQuery AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @ColumnName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)


	
	SELECT m.Id,m.CSDate,m.CSNo,s.Name [SupplierName],s.Address,b.Name [BrandName],d.Qty,d.UnitPrice,d.TotalPrice,d.VatInTk,d.AITInTk 
	into #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils
	from [SupplyChain ].ComparativeStudies m 
	join [SupplyChain ].ComparativeStudyDetails d on d.ComparativeStudyId = m.Id
	join [SupplyChain ].BrandExtensions b on b.Id = d.BrandExtensionId
	join [SupplyChain ].Suppliers s on s.id = d.SupplierId
	where 
	(@CSNo ='' or m.CSNo =@CSNo)
	

	SELECT @ColumnName= ISNULL(@ColumnName + ',','') + QUOTENAME(SupplierName)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SupplierName FROM #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils) AS SupplierName


SET @DynamicPivotQuery = 
  N'
  select * from 
  (
		SELECT Id,CSDate,CSNo,qty,SupplierName,unitprice
		from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils
  ) src
  PIVOT
  (
		SUM(unitprice) 
		FOR SupplierName IN (' + @ColumnName + ')
  )
  AS PVTTable
  '

		  EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery
--SET @DynamicPivotQuery = 'select * from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery'
--EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery


return 

	select  ID,CSDate,CSNo,BrandName, qty
	into  #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
	from 
	#TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils
	group by ID,CSDate,CSNo,BrandName,Qty 



	DECLARE @Supplier_Name nvarchar(max)

	DECLARE Cursor_Supplier CURSOR
		FOR select Distinct SupplierName from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils;
	OPEN Cursor_Supplier;
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_Supplier INTO
		@Supplier_Name;
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
	BEGIN
		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='alter table #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
		add ['+@Supplier_Name+'UnitPrice]  float'
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery

		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='alter table #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery
		add ['+@Supplier_Name+'TotalPrice]  float'
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery
			   
		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='update #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery set ['+@Supplier_Name+'UnitPrice] =
		(
			select unitprice from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportDetils  where suppliername ='''+@Supplier_Name+'''
		) '
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery
		
		set @DynamicPivotQuery ='update #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery set ['+@Supplier_Name+'TotalPrice] =
		['+@Supplier_Name+'UnitPrice] * Qty'
		EXEC sp_executesql @DynamicPivotQuery


		
		FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_Supplier INTO
		@Supplier_Name;
	END
	CLOSE Cursor_Supplier
	DEALLOCATE Cursor_Supplier

	select * from #TempComparativeStudiesCompareReportSummery



END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudyByDatesOrId] '2022-01-02','2022-01-02','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000','',0,'CS0000001'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetComparativeStudyByDatesOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime,
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@Status nvarchar(max),
	@GetAllPending int,
	@CSNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	if(@GetAllPending=0)
	begin
		if(@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		begin
			select cs.Id,cs.CSNo,cs.CSDate,cs.UserId,cs.Status,u.UserName
			  from [SupplyChain ].[ComparativeStudies] cs left join
				   [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
			where (cs.CSNo=@CSNo and @CSNo!='') or (@CSNo='' and convert(date,cs.CSDate)>=convert(date,@DateFrom) and convert(date,cs.CSDate)<=convert(date,@DateTo) and (cs.Status=@Status or @Status=''))
		end
		else
		begin
			select cs.Id,cs.CSNo,cs.CSDate,cs.UserId,cs.Status,u.UserName
			  from [SupplyChain ].[ComparativeStudies] cs left join
				   [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
			where cs.Id=@Id
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		select cs.Id,cs.CSNo,cs.CSDate,cs.UserId,cs.Status,u.UserName
		  from [SupplyChain ].[ComparativeStudies] cs left join
			   [Identity].[Users] u on cs.UserId=u.Id
		where cs.Status='Pending'
	end
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetCSRecordByStaffId] '3DC13F8B-3CCF-4597-8EFA-05CB2906CEAE','2024-08-01','2024-08-25'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetCSRecordByStaffId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StaffId uniqueidentifier,
	@DateFrom datetime,
	@DateTo datetime
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	SELECT la.Id,la.CSNo,la.CSDate,la.UserId,la.Status,u.UserName,tbl.IsThisTheHighestLevelApproval
	FROM [SupplyChain ].[ComparativeStudies] la left join
			[Identity].[Users] u on u.Id=la.UserId inner join
			(select las.ApprovLevel,las.DeptId,las.LevelOrder,las.IsThisTheHighestLevelApproval,
					case when las.LevelTagKey='Level1' then 'Pending'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level2' then 'Level1'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level3' then 'Level2'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level4' then 'Level3'
						when las.LevelTagKey='Level5' then 'Level4'
						end as TagKey,las.LevelTagKey
				from [SupplyChain ].[CSApprovalSettings] las 
				where las.LevelApprovebyStaffRecordId=@StaffId) tbl on la.Status=tbl.TagKey
	WHERE CONVERT(date,la.CSDate)>=convert(date,@DateFrom) and convert(date,la.CSDate)<=convert(date,la.CSDate)
END
GO

--EXEC [SupplyChain].[SpGetPRIndentDetailByStoreIndentId] '5521EBF8-BFA7-4F35-33B0-08DD9DC8BC41',true
CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetPRIndentDetailByStoreIndentId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StoreIndentId uniqueidentifier,
	@IsPRIndent bit
AS
BEGIN
	declare @StockTbl table (
		Id uniqueidentifier,
		BrandId uniqueidentifier,
		[Name] nvarchar(max),
		PurchasePrice real,
		SalePrice real,
		BrandName nvarchar(max),
		Unit nvarchar(max),
		LotRecordId uniqueidentifier,
		CurStock int,
		[ExpireDate] nvarchar(max),
		ROL bigint
	);
if(@IsPRIndent=1)
begin
	insert into @StockTbl
		exec [SupplyChain].[SpGetBrandExtensionCurrentStockFromMainStore] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	select pd.Id,pd.PRIndentId, pd.StoreIndentId,pd.BrandExtensionId,pd.Qty,pd.ServedQty,stb.Name BrandExtensionName,pd.ApprovedQty,stb.TStock StockQty, (0) PreQty,(0) UsedQty,(0) UnUsedQty
	  from [SupplyChain].[PRIndentDetails] pd inner join
	       (
				select Id,sum(CurStock) TStock, Name from @StockTbl group by Id,[Name]
		   ) stb on pd.BrandExtensionId=stb.Id
	 where pd.PRIndentId=@StoreIndentId or @StoreIndentId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
end
else
begin
	insert into @StockTbl
		exec [SupplyChain].[SpGetBrandExtensionCurrentStock] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	select pd.Id,pd.PRIndentId, pd.StoreIndentId,pd.BrandExtensionId,pd.Qty,pd.ServedQty,stb.Name BrandExtensionName,pd.ApprovedQty,stb.TStock StockQty, (0) PreQty,(0) UsedQty,(0) UnUsedQty
	  from [SupplyChain].[PRIndentDetails] pd inner join
	       (
				select Id,sum(CurStock) TStock, Name from @StockTbl group by Id,[Name]
		   ) stb on pd.BrandExtensionId=stb.Id
	 where pd.StoreIndentId=@StoreIndentId or @StoreIndentId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
	 end
END
GO

-- exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetPurchaseRequisiontionByDatesOrId] '2025-06-01','2025-06-04','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',0
CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetPurchaseRequisiontionByDatesOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@Id uniqueidentifier,
	@RequisitionNo bigint
AS
BEGIN
	select pr.Id,pr.RequisitionNo,pr.MainStoreId,pr.StoreId,pr.RequisitionDate,pr.RequisitionTime,pr.Note,pr.TermsOfCondition,pr.UserId,ms.Name MainStoreName,u.UserName,pr.StoreDeptId,pr.SupplierId,pr.IsCashPurchase,pr.IsCreditPurchase,sdt.Name StoreDeptName,s.Name SupplierName,pr.PRSubmittedId
	  from [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseRequisiontions] pr inner join
		   [SupplyChain ].[MainStores] ms on pr.MainStoreId=ms.Id left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on pr.UserId=u.Id left join
		   [SupplyChain ].[StoreDepts] sdt on pr.StoreDeptId=sdt.Id left join
		   [SupplyChain ].[Suppliers] s on pr.SupplierId=s.Id
	 where (@Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and @RequisitionNo=0 and CONVERT(date,pr.RequisitionDate) >= convert(date,@FromDate) and convert(date,pr.RequisitionDate) <= convert(date,@ToDate))
	 or (@Id!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and pr.Id=@Id) or (@RequisitionNo!=0 and pr.RequisitionNo=@RequisitionNo)
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetSPurchaseOrderByDateOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@OrderId uniqueidentifier,  
	@EntryDate DateTime,
	@GetById int,   -- '0' or '1'  0-> by datetime, 1->Bu OrderId,
	@OrderNo nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	
if(@GetById=0)
BEGIN
	select po.Id,po.OrderNo,po.OrderToSupplierId,po.PurchaseDateTime,s.Name as SupplierName,po.Status,po.EntryDate,po.UserId,u.UserName
			from [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseOrders] po inner join
			     [SupplyChain ].[Suppliers] s on po.OrderToSupplierId=s.Id left join
				 [Identity].[Users] u on po.UserId=u.Id
			where CONVERT(date,po.EntryDate)=CONVERT(date,@EntryDate)
END 
ELSE
BEGIN
	select po.Id,po.OrderNo,po.OrderToSupplierId,po.PurchaseDateTime,s.Name as SupplierName,po.Status,po.EntryDate,po.UserId,u.UserName
			from [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseOrders] po inner join
			     [SupplyChain ].[Suppliers] s on po.OrderToSupplierId=s.Id left join
				 [Identity].[Users] u on po.UserId=u.Id
			where (po.Id=@OrderId and @OrderId!='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or (@OrderId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' and po.OrderNo=@OrderNo)
END
END
GO

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

--Exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetStoreDeptUserAccessByUserId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE       PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetStoreDeptUserAccessByUserId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UserId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tbl
	SELECT * INTO #Tbl
	FROM [SupplyChain ].[StoreDeptUserAccesses]
	CROSS APPLY [HR].[fnSplit](StoreDeptIds, ',');
	

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp
	SELECT ifpa.Id, ifpa.UserId,ifpa.StoreDeptIds, ifpa.item, u.UserName,ISNULL(sd.Name, '') DepartmentName into #Tmp
	FROM 
	(SELECT * FROM #Tbl WHERE LEN(item) = 36 AND item IS NOT NULL) ifpa INNER JOIN
		[Identity].[Users] u ON ifpa.UserId = u.Id LEFT JOIN
		[SupplyChain ].[StoreDepts] sd on sd.Id=ifpa.item
	WHERE @UserId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' OR ifpa.UserId=@UserId


	SELECT a.Id, a.UserId, a.StoreDeptIds,a.UserName,STRING_AGG(a.DepartmentName, ',') as StoreDeptNames
	FROM #Tmp a
	GROUP BY a.Id, a.UserId, a.StoreDeptIds,a.UserName
END




GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetStoreIndentByDatesOrId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@Id uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	select si.Id,si.IndentNo,si.StoreId,si.Priority,si.IndentDate,si.IndentBy,si.ServeTypeId,
		CAST(case when si.Priority=0 then 'Routine' 
			  when si.Priority=1 then 'Emergency' 
			  when si.Priority=2 then 'Critical Care' 
			  when si.Priority=3 then 'Others'
			  when si.Priority=4 then 'New Admission'
			  else 'Discharge' end as nvarchar) as PriorityTxt,u.UserName,st.Name ServeTypeTxt,s.Name StoreName
	  from [SupplyChain ].[StoreIndents] si inner join
		   [SupplyChain ].[Stores] s on si.StoreId=s.Id left join
		   [Identity].[Users] u on si.IndentBy=u.Id left join
		   [Admin].[ServeTypes] st on si.ServeTypeId=st.Id
	 where ((CONVERT(date,si.IndentDate) >= convert(date,@FromDate) and convert(date,si.IndentDate) <= convert(date,@ToDate) and @Id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') or si.Id=@Id) and si.indentStatus='Approved'
END
GO

--exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetStoreIndentWithApprovalLevel] '2023-01-01','2023-12-01','58a5ec47-d314-46c5-8441-f0ecffe132b6'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetStoreIndentWithApprovalLevel]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@RoleId nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @TmpTbl table (
		Id uniqueidentifier,
		IndentNo bigint,
		StoreId uniqueidentifier,
		[Priority] int,
		IndentDate datetime,
		IndentBy uniqueidentifier,
		ServeTypeId int,
		PriorityTxt nvarchar(max),
		UserName nvarchar(max),
		ServeTypeTxt nvarchar(max),
		StoreName nvarchar(max)
	);
	insert into @TmpTbl
		exec [SupplyChain ].[SpGetStoreIndentByDatesOrIdForPending] @FromDate,@ToDate,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
	select t.*,isnull(Approvaled.ApprovalLevelId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') ApprovalLevelId,isnull(Approvaled.NextApprovalLevelId,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') NextApprovalLevelId
	from @TmpTbl t left join
		(
			SELECT m1.IndentId,m1.ApprovalLevelId,m1.NextApprovalLevelId
			FROM [SupplyChain ].[IndentApprovals] m1 LEFT JOIN [SupplyChain ].[IndentApprovals] m2
			 ON (m1.IndentId = m2.IndentId AND m1.ApprovalDate < m2.ApprovalDate)
			WHERE m2.Id IS NULL
		) Approvaled on t.Id=Approvaled.IndentId inner join
		(
			select COUNT(sia.Id) LevelCnt,sia.StoreId
			 from [SupplyChain ].[StoreIndentApprovalSettings] sia group by StoreId
		)lc on t.StoreId=lc.StoreId left join
		[SupplyChain ].[StoreIndentApprovalSettings] si on t.StoreId=si.StoreId and si.RoleId=@RoleId left join
		[SupplyChain ].[StoreIndentApprovalSettings] sias on Approvaled.NextApprovalLevelId=sias.Id and sias.RoleId=@RoleId 
	where (((lc.LevelCnt=1 and si.ApprovalLevel='Final') or (lc.LevelCnt>1 and si.ApprovalLevel='Level1' )) and Approvaled.ApprovalLevelId is null) or (Approvaled.NextApprovalLevelId is not null and sias.Id is not null)
END
GO

	@UserId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

		FROM [SupplyChain ].[IssueStoreAcesses] sa inner join

END

@paramas nvarchar(max)=''

	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2

	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10

	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
	--Select @StockReceivedID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=17

	
	

	--	select(
	--select * from(

		select 
		i.id ReceivedId,
		l.ExpireDate,
		s.id,
		s.Name Supplier,
		i.SupplierInvoiceNo,
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		d.Qty,
		d.PurchaseRate,
		d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate GrantTotal
		----,
		----d.GrossDiscount,
		----d.VatInGrossAmount,
		----(d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate) + d.VatInGrossAmount - d.GrossDiscount NetSales

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].Suppliers s on s.Id=i.SupplierId

		and ( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')
		
	--		) tbl order by tbl.ReceivedId FOR JSON AUTO
	--) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetSupplyChainPurchaseStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [SupplyChain].[SpGetSupplyChainPurchaseStatement] '2020-01-15,2024-12-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,7398413B-492A-4221-9C38-01C9F3D5F93B,0,IC,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId int,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier,
	@StockReceivedID uniqueidentifier,
	@Temp nvarchar(max)



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10

	Select @SupplierId=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=8
	--Select @StockReceivedID=  Convert(uniqueidentifier,T.Value) from (
	--SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=17

	
	

		select(
	select * from(

		select 
		i.id ReceivedId,
		i.EntryDate,
		s.id,
		s.Name Supplier,
		i.SupplierInvoiceNo,
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		d.Qty,
		d.PurchaseRate,
		d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate GrantTotal
		----,
		----d.GrossDiscount,
		----d.VatInGrossAmount,
		----(d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate) + d.VatInGrossAmount - d.GrossDiscount NetSales

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].Suppliers s on s.Id=i.SupplierId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where 
		convert(date,i.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and (i.SupplierId = @SupplierId or @SupplierId ='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
		and ( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')

			) tbl order by tbl.ReceivedId FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec [SupplyChain].[SpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement] '2020-01-15,2024-12-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,7398413B-492A-4221-9C38-01C9F3D5F93B,0,IC,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId int,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier,
	@StockReceivedID uniqueidentifier,
	@Temp nvarchar(max)



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10

	SELECT V.id, 
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		0 OpeningQty,
		0 NewPurchaseQty,
		0 TotalQty,
		--0 IndentQty,
		0 ServedQty,
		0 ClosingQty,
		0 PurchaseRate,
		0 GrantTotal
		
	INTO #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement
	from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V

		

	Update #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement set
	OpeningQty =
	isnull((
		select 
		sum(d.Qty)

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where v.id = #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement.id
		and convert(date,i.EntryDate) < @FilterStartDate
	),0)

	Update #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement set
	OpeningQty = OpeningQty - 
	isnull((
		select 
		sum(d.ServedQty)

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StoreIndentDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].[StoreIndents] i on i.Id = d.StoreIndentId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where v.id = #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement.id
		and convert(date,i.IndentDate) <@FilterStartDate
	),0)

	Update #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement set
	NewPurchaseQty =
	isnull((
		select 
		sum(d.Qty)

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where v.id = #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement.id
		and convert(date,i.EntryDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.EntryDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	),0)
	
	Update #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement set
	TotalQty =OpeningQty + NewPurchaseQty

	Update #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement set
	ServedQty =  
	isnull((
		select 
		sum(d.ServedQty)

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StoreIndentDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].[StoreIndents] i on i.Id = d.StoreIndentId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where v.id = #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement.id
		and convert(date,i.IndentDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.IndentDate) <=@FilterEndDate
	),0)

	Update #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement set
	ClosingQty =TotalQty -ServedQty

	select(
	select * from(
	select * from #TempSpGetSupplyChainPurchaseWiseStockStatement
	) tbl order by tbl.BrandExtensionsName FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data

	RETURN 




	select BrandExtensionsName,sum(PurchaseQty) PurchaseQty,sum(IndentQty) IndentQty, sum(ServedQty)ServedQty,
	sum(PurchaseQty) - sum(ServedQty) StockQty,sum(PurchaseQty*PurchaseRate) PurchaseGrantTotal
	from(

		select 
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		0 PurchaseQty,
		0 PurchaseRate,
		0 GrantTotal,
		0 IndentQty,
		0 ServedQty

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V

		UNION ALL
		select 
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		d.Qty PurchaseQty,
		d.PurchaseRate,
		d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate GrantTotal,
		0 IndentQty,
		0 ServedQty

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where ( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')

		union all

		select 
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		0 Qty,
		0 PurchaseRate,
		0 GrantTotal,
		d.Qty,
		d.ServedQty

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StoreIndentDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].[StoreIndents] i on i.Id = d.StoreIndentId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where 
		( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')

		) tbl
		group by BrandExtensionsName

	

	--	select(
	select BrandExtensionsName,sum(PurchaseQty) PurchaseQty,sum(IndentQty) IndentQty, sum(ServedQty)ServedQty,
	sum(PurchaseQty) - sum(ServedQty) StockQty,sum(PurchaseQty*PurchaseRate) PurchaseGrantTotal
	from(

		select 
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		d.Qty PurchaseQty,
		d.PurchaseRate,
		d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate GrantTotal,
		0 IndentQty,
		0 ServedQty

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceiveDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].StockReceives i on i.Id = d.StockReceiveId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where ( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')

		union all

		select 
		v.Name BrandExtensionsName,
		0 Qty,
		0 PurchaseRate,
		0 GrantTotal,
		d.Qty,
		d.ServedQty

		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StoreIndentDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].[StoreIndents] i on i.Id = d.StoreIndentId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where 
		( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')

		) tbl
		group by BrandExtensionsName


	
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGetSupplyChainStoreIndentDetails]
@paramas nvarchar(max)=''
--Order: 1. datefrom, 2. dateto, 3. year, 4. month, 5.UserID, 6. TenantId, 7.@OutletId, 8.@SupplierId, 9.@FormationId, 10.@productname 11.@BrandExtensionsId, 12.FilterTypeId, 13.GenericId, 14.CCID

--exec  [SupplyChain].[SpGetSupplyChainStoreIndentDetails] '2020-01-15,2024-12-19,2023,4,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000,0,Tissue,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,0,0,0'

AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE 
	@OutletId int,
	@ProductName nvarchar(max),
	@FilterStartDate date,
	@FilterEndDate date,
	@SupplierId uniqueidentifier,
	@StockReceivedID uniqueidentifier,
	@Temp nvarchar(max)



	Select @FilterStartDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=1
	Select @FilterEndDate=  Convert(date,T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=2
	Select @ProductName=  Convert(nvarchar(max),T.Value) from (
	SELECT * FROM  dbo.FN_SpCSVParamToListTable(@paramas) ) T Where T.OrderNo=10


	
	

		select(
	select * from(

		select 
		i.id IndentId,
		i.IndentDate,
		b.Name  ItemName,
		d.Qty,
		d.ServedQty
		--d.PurchaseRate,
		--d.Qty*d.PurchaseRate GrantTotal


		from 
		[SupplyChain].BrandExtensions V
		join [SupplyChain].StoreIndentDetails d on d.BrandExtensionId = V.Id
		join [SupplyChain].[StoreIndents] i on i.Id = d.StoreIndentId
		join [SupplyChain].BrandNames b on b.id = v.BrandId
		where 
		convert(date,i.IndentDate) >=@FilterStartDate
		and convert(date,i.IndentDate) <=@FilterEndDate
		and ( v.Name  like '%'+ @ProductName +'%' or @ProductName ='')

			) tbl order by tbl.IndentId FOR JSON AUTO
	) as Data
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [SupplyChain ].[SpGRNDetailWithPODetailByGRNId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@GRNId uniqueidentifier 
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select isnull(gf.Id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') Id,gr.Id GRNId,pod.BrandExtensionId,isnull(gf.Qty,pod.Qty) Qty,gf.Description,bd.Name ProductName
			from [SupplyChain ].[GRNs] gr left join 
				 [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseOrders] po on gr.PO=po.OrderNo left join
				 [SupplyChain ].[PurchaseOrderDetails] pod on po.Id=pod.OrderId left join
				 [SupplyChain ].[GRNFaultDescriptions] gf on gr.Id=gf.GRNId and pod.BrandExtensionId=gf.BrandExtensionId left join
				 [SupplyChain ].[BrandExtensions] bd on pod.BrandExtensionId=bd.Id
			     
			where gr.Id=@GRNId
END

--Exec [TransfusionMedicine].[SpGetCrossMatchingRecordByPatientId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE PROCEDURE [TransfusionMedicine].[SpGetCrossMatchingRecordByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select cr.Id,cr.IPDPatientRecordId,cr.CMDateTime,cr.BloodGroup,cr.Rhfactor,cr.Speciman,cr.CrossMatchingResultId,pr.FullName PatientName,pr.Age,pr.Sex
			,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.CabinNo,pr.AssignedDoctorName,crt.Result CrossMatchingResultName,cr.BloodComponentId,bc.Name BloodComponentName,
			(d.Name + ',' + d.ProfessionalIdentity1+ ',' + d.ProfessionalIdentity2+ ',' + d.ProfessionalIdentity3+ ',' + d.ProfessionalIdentity4+ ',' + d.ProfessionalIdentity5+ ',' + d.ProfessionalIdentity6) DoctorName
			,cr.DoctorId,cr.TechnologistId,(t.Name+ ',' + t.Identity1 + ',' + t.Identity2+ ',' + t.Identity3+ ',' + t.Identity4) TechnologistName
	  from [TransfusionMedicine].[CrossMatchingRecords] cr inner join
	       [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pr on cr.IPDPatientRecordId=pr.Id left join
		   [TransfusionMedicine].[CrossMatchingResults] crt on cr.CrossMatchingResultId=crt.Id left join
		   [TransfusionMedicine].[BloodComponents] bc on cr.BloodComponentId=bc.Id left join
		   [Marketing].[Doctors] d on cr.DoctorId=d.Id left join
		   [Diag].[Technologists] t on cr.TechnologistId=t.Id
	 where cr.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId or @PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
END
GO

--Exec [TransfusionMedicine].[SpGetCrossMatchingValueCrossMatchingRecordId] '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

CREATE     PROCEDURE [TransfusionMedicine].[SpGetCrossMatchingValueCrossMatchingRecordId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@CrossMatchingRecordId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select cv.Id,cv.CrossMatchingRecordId,cv.BCParameterId,cv.Result,bp.Name BCParameterName,bp.[Values] ValueItems
	  from [TransfusionMedicine].[CrossMatchingValues] cv inner join
		   [TransfusionMedicine].[BCParameters] bp on cv.BCParameterId=bp.Id
	 where cv.CrossMatchingRecordId=@CrossMatchingRecordId or @CrossMatchingRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
END
GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [TransfusionMedicine].[SpGetDonorContributionRecordByCrossMatchingRecordId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@CrossMatchingRecordId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select cr.Id,cr.CrossMatchingRecordId,cr.BloodGroup,cr.Rhfactor,cr.BagId,cr.ExpireDate,cr.BloodDonorId,bd.Name DonorName,bd.DonorIDNo
	  from [TransfusionMedicine].[DonorContributionRecords] cr left join
	       [TransfusionMedicine].[BloodDonors] bd on cr.BloodDonorId=bd.Id
	 where cr.CrossMatchingRecordId=@CrossMatchingRecordId or @CrossMatchingRecordId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [TransfusionMedicine].[SpGetSerologyRecordByPatientId]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PatientId uniqueidentifier
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select sr.Id,sr.IPDPatientRecordId,sr.SDate,sr.Speciman,sr.BloodComponentId,pr.FullName PatientName,pr.Age,pr.Sex,pr.InvoiceNo,pr.CabinNo,pr.AssignedDoctorName,bc.Name BloodComponentName
	  from [TransfusionMedicine].[SerologyRecords] sr inner join
		   [Hospital].[VWHospitalPatientDetails] pr on sr.IPDPatientRecordId=pr.Id left join
		   [TransfusionMedicine].[BloodComponents] bc on sr.BloodComponentId=bc.Id
	 where sr.IPDPatientRecordId=@PatientId or @PatientId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

END
GO
